title: From Subjective Judgments to Auditable Standards:Protocol-Guided AI Auditing of Website Redundancy
summary: Website redundancy does not have a single fixed meaning. The same repeated element may distract during one task and provide backup during another. We introduce CORA (Counterfactual, Observable Redundancy Audit), which measures repetition load, normal-use tax, and failure-domain recovery reserve separately. Each run retains screenshots, stable element identities, and task traces. A versioned vision-language model proposes the annotations. Typed validation and release checks then determine whether a calibrated dimension can be reported; failed or malformed outputs stay in the fixed denominator. On a transparent mechanistic testbed, the factorized CORA representation separated reserve from normal-use tax and predicted perturbed success more accurately than scalar-load baselines. The model studies then showed why repeatability is not enough: two small local vision-language models produced recurring outputs, but neither instrument met all release requirements. CORA therefore withheld automated scores from both instruments while retaining the raw responses and failure records. Separate checker fixtures confirmed that the typed validator and hardened release gates implement their specifications; these tests do not establish semantic grounding or accuracy on production sites. Taken together, the results position CORA as an auditable candidate procedure for the controlled benchmark studied here rather than a general standard. Human agreement, AI-versus-human accuracy, and validation on independent production sites remain open empirical questions.

AI.tldr: CORA是一个用于审计网站冗余度的框架，将冗余度分解为重复负载、正常使用税和故障域恢复储备三个独立维度，并通过版本化视觉语言模型进行注释和校准验证。在透明测试平台上，CORA的分解表示比标量负载基线更准确地预测扰动后的成功率，但因两个小型模型未满足发布要求而拒绝自动评分。
AI.motivation: 网站冗余度没有单一固定的含义，相同的重复元素在不同任务中可能产生干扰或提供备用支持，因此需要一个能够区分不同冗余维度的可审计测量框架。
AI.method: CORA引入三个独立测量维度：重复负载、正常使用税和故障域恢复储备。每次运行保留截图、稳定元素身份和任务轨迹；使用版本化视觉语言模型提出注释；通过类型化验证和发布检查决定是否报告校准维度，失败输出保留在固定分母中。
AI.result: 在透明机制测试平台上，CORA的分解表示成功将储备与正常使用税分离，且比标量负载基线更准确地预测扰动后的成功率。两个小型局部视觉语言模型产生重复输出，但均未满足所有发布要求，CORA因此拒绝自动评分但保留原始响应和失败记录。独立检查装置确认验证器和发布门控实现符合规范。
AI.conclusion: CORA被定位为受控基准测试中可审计的候选程序，而非通用标准。人类一致性、AI与人类准确率对比以及独立生产站点的验证仍是待解决的开放实证问题。

title: SLICE: Specification-Level Isolation of Contract Enforcement
summary: Programming problems commonly specify both the computation a function should perform and the conditions that its inputs must satisfy. Large language models are widely used to generate code from these problem specifications, and the generated function must implement the required computation while enforcing the stated input conditions. The stated input conditions collectively form an input contract. Enforcing this contract is difficult: incomplete enforcement accepts inputs that should be rejected, whereas overly restrictive enforcement rejects inputs that should be accepted. Existing code generation methods do not provide a generation process that identifies both the input contract and the functional requirements and generates code that satisfies them jointly. We therefore introduce SLICE, a generation framework that identifies both requirements and addresses them through separate generation stages. SLICE consists of three stages: (i) Graph-based specification structuring, which grounds contract conditions to description segments in a specification graph and removes contract-only segments to form a functional view; (ii) Functional body generation, which produces multiple candidate function bodies through greedy and sampled decoding, ranks them using execution scores, and resolves ties using difference-region log probabilities; and (iii) Contract assertion generation, which generates input-validation assertions from the identified contract conditions and attaches them to the selected function body. We evaluate SLICE on ContractEval across four LLMs and compare it with six competing methods. Relative to the strongest evaluated baseline for each model, SLICE improves performance in generating code that satisfies both the functional requirements and the input contract by an average of 6.58%. Our code is available at https://github.com/suhanmen/SLICE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SLICE框架，将程序生成的输入契约（input contract）和功能需求分离处理，通过三个阶段（图结构规范、功能体生成、契约断言生成）联合满足两者，在ContractEval基准上相比最强基线平均提升6.58%。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成方法无法同时识别输入契约和功能需求，导致生成的代码要么过度限制输入（拒绝本该接受的输入），要么限制不足（接受本该拒绝的输入），缺乏一个能联合处理两者需求的生成流程。
AI.method: SLICE包含三个阶段：(i) 基于图的规范结构化——将契约条件锚定到规范图中的描述片段，移除仅含契约的片段形成功能视图；(ii) 功能体生成——通过贪心解码和采样解码生成多个候选函数体，用执行分数排序，用差异区域对数概率解决并列；(iii) 契约断言生成——从识别出的契约条件生成输入验证断言并附加到选定的函数体。
AI.result: 在ContractEval基准上，跨四个LLM并与六个竞争方法比较，SLICE相比每个模型的最强基线，在生成同时满足功能需求和输入契约的代码方面平均提升6.58%。
AI.conclusion: SLICE通过将输入契约与功能需求分离并分阶段处理，能更有效地生成同时满足两者的代码，代码已开源。

title: Composable Building Blocks for Resilient Asynchronous Code
summary: Asynchronous calls to a network service, database, or language model must cope with transient errors, slow or missing responses, throttling, and atomicity violations. We show how higher-order combinators solve such problems uniformly, including timeouts, retries, rate limiting, caching, reentrant locking, and cancellation. Every combinator maps an async function to another of the same type, so they share a uniform \emph{shape} and compose by nesting into one expression that implements a program's whole resilience and concurrency policy, leaving its business logic untouched. The same design spans both of JavaScript's native async shapes, promise-returning and async-iterable-returning functions, with one vocabulary of concerns. Solutions exist across the ecosystem but are scattered over differently shaped libraries that are hard to combine. We present case studies where the combinators are used to harden real packages by adding missing resilience or concurrency control and replacing bespoke policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用高阶组合子（higher-order combinators）统一解决异步编程中的各类问题，包括超时、重试、限流、缓存、可重入锁和取消等。每个组合子将异步函数映射为同类型函数，保持统一"形状"，可通过嵌套组合实现完整的韧性与并发策略，且不改变业务逻辑。该设计同时适用于JavaScript的两种原生异步形态（返回Promise和返回async-iterable的函数），并通过案例研究验证了其在真实包中的应用。
AI.motivation: 异步调用（如网络服务、数据库、语言模型）必须应对瞬时错误、慢响应、丢包、限流和原子性违规等问题。现有解决方案分散在形态各异、难以组合的库中，缺乏统一的方法。
AI.method: 提出高阶组合子方法：每个组合子将异步函数映射为同类型异步函数（统一shape），可通过嵌套组合成一个表达式实现完整的韧性和并发策略，业务逻辑保持不变。该设计同时覆盖JavaScript中Promise返回型和async-iterable返回型两种异步函数形态。
AI.result: 通过案例研究展示了组合子如何加固真实软件包：添加缺失的韧性和并发控制能力，并取代原有的专门策略。
AI.conclusion: 高阶组合子为异步编程中的韧性与并发问题提供了统一、可组合的解决方案，减少了重复实现，简化了策略管理，并能实际应用于现存软件包的加固。

title: BeTaL-GBI: Admission-Aware Benchmark Tuning and Full-Stack Verification of Geometric Belief Interfaces
comment: 30 pages, Geometric Belief Interface, Decentralized Cryptographic Sheaf-Enclave, GBI, DCSE, GBI-DCSE, BoundaryBench v0.1, BeTaL-GBI v0.2, GBI v2, GBI-DCSE v3
summary:
A verification substrate is more credible when exposing errors in its own claims, not just model outputs. GBI-DCSE v3 falsified an architectural claim: the reported Fisher value epsilon ~ 0.066 satisfies the kappa^2 <= 10^4 budget only on the slice [epsilon, 3, 4, 5], while the full box [epsilon, 20]^4 requires epsilon ~ 0.326472. This erratum highlights whether an enterprise verification architecture can isolate interface failure, task competence, policy admissibility, and control integrity while keeping claims auditable.
  BoundaryBench v0.1 established the baseline: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 completed 768 frozen executions, but 0% cleared the contract (369 failed parsing, 399 failed validation), limiting downstream selectivity metrics. This companion study evaluates three successive improvements.
  First, BeTaL-GBI v0.2 applies Benchmark Tuning with an LLM-in-the-loop over 2,218,750,380 grid points, separating format admission from conditional performance (rho_adm = N_admitted/N; rho_task = N_verified/N_admitted). Following schema repair, a model-free feedback search achieves a 2.87% mean held-out target gap, outperforming non-feedback baselines (13.61%, 11.46%).
  Second, GBI v2 swaps static keys for a reference-independent witness state W and policy P. Across 512 synthetic tasks, a 16-gate policy detects all 116 injected severe contradictions and accepts all 99 clean records (broad denominator: 4.27%). Hallucinator and evidence-forger surrogates are blocked with zero silent promotions.
  Third, GBI-DCSE v3 maps 99 claims to machine-readable evidence: 95 of 96 testable claims pass, with 148 standalone checks executed without failure. The harness exercises signed ledgers, PBFT quorums, and enclave forgery across 62 configurations. Under synthetic conditions, GBI-DCSE is a selective, policy-versioned, self-auditing test and routing substrate.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三代迭代（BeTaL-GBI v0.2、GBI v2、GBI-DCSE v3）构建企业级验证基板，从基准失败（Qwen3模型0%通过率）出发，逐步解决格式准入、策略检测和声明可审计性问题，最终实现95/96可测试声明通过及稳健的自我审计能力。
AI.motivation: 验证基板的可信度取决于其能否暴露自身声明中的错误，而非仅检查模型输出。GBI-DCSE v3自身发现的Fisher值epsilon矛盾暴露了原架构声明的缺陷，这凸显了企业验证架构需要同时隔离接口失败、任务能力、策略可接受性和控制完整性，并保持声明的可审计性。
AI.method: 论文提出三个递进式改进：(1) BeTaL-GBI v0.2采用Benchmark Tuning与LLM-in-the-loop，在22亿网格点上分离格式准入与条件性能，使用无模型反馈搜索优化目标差距；(2) GBI v2以参考无关的见证状态W和策略P替代静态密钥，通过16门策略在512个合成任务中检测矛盾；(3) GBI-DCSE v3将99个声明映射为机器可读证据，执行签名账本、PBFT法定人数和飞地伪造测试，覆盖62种配置。
AI.result: BeTaL-GBI达到2.87%的平均held-out目标差距（优于非反馈基线13.61%/11.46%）；GBI v2检测全部116个严重矛盾并接受99个干净记录，零静默提升阻止幻觉与伪造代理；GBI-DCSE v3中95/96可测试声明通过，148项独立检查无失败。
AI.conclusion: 在合成条件下，GBI-DCSE被证明是一种具备选择性、策略版本化和自我审计能力的测试与路由基板。该工作强调验证基板自身声明的可证伪性是其可信度的核心。

title: JANUS: Online Jacobian-Aligned Infill for Black-Box Optimization
summary: Population optimizers such as CMA-ES, DE, and multi-objective evolutionary algorithms drive search mainly through selection signals that are scalar or rank based: such a signal indicates that one candidate outperforms another, but not the local direction responsible for the improvement. JANUS (\emph{Jacobian-Aligned Newton-Unified Search}) is a plug-and-play infill module that extracts this missing local geometric signal without replacing the host optimizer. It estimates a local Jacobian from the recent evaluation trace; the same Jacobian yields both a damped Gauss--Newton exploitation candidate and a trace-preserving exploration metric, reserving a fraction of the host's per-generation candidate slots for geometry-guided infill rather than spending evaluations on top of the host's budget. Unlike MetaBBO methods, JANUS needs no offline training or task distribution, estimating this geometry on the fly from the current run alone, while the host keeps full control of selection, survival, covariance adaptation, and step-size control. Under same-protocol comparisons, JANUS improves the CMA-ES host on \textbf{11--15/16} BBOB functions across $d\in\{30,100,500\}$. It also attains the best mean error on \textbf{13 of the 16} functions at $d{=}500$ in the complete NN-BBO/MetaBBO baseline comparison, with no training cost, and yields a $936\times$ geometric-mean improvement over the host on a $d{=}1000$ BBOB subset. On structured and multi-objective tasks, JANUS gives the best mean cost on 1135-dimensional UAV path planning ($-12.8\%$ vs.\ the strongest baseline), and it improves SMS-EMOA/AGE-MOEA2 hosts on 12/38 multi-objective tasks with zero significant regressions. Code is available at https://github.com/hongyuanyu/JANUS.

AI.tldr: JANUS是一个即插即用的几何信息填充模块，通过估计局部雅可比矩阵来为CMA-ES、DE等群体优化器提供局部梯度方向信号，无需离线训练，在BBOB、UAV路径规划和多目标优化任务上显著提升宿主优化器性能。
AI.motivation: 现有群体优化器（如CMA-ES、DE、多目标进化算法）主要依赖标量或基于排名的选择信号来驱动搜索，这种信号只能表明某个候选解优于另一个，却无法提供改进背后的局部方向信息。作者希望提取这种缺失的局部几何信号，而不需要替换宿主优化器。
AI.method: JANUS从最近的评估轨迹中估计局部雅可比矩阵，利用该雅可比矩阵同时生成：(1)基于阻尼高斯-牛顿法的开发候选解；(2)保持轨迹的探索指标。它将宿主的每代候选槽位的一部分预留用于几何引导的填充，不额外增加评估预算。与MetaBBO方法不同，JANUS不需要离线训练或任务分布，完全在运行中实时估计几何信息，宿主保留选择、生存、协方差适应和步长控制的完全控制权。
AI.result: 在相同协议比较下，JANUS在d∈{30,100,500}维度下在16个BBOB函数中改进了11-15个CMA-ES宿主；在d=500时，在完整NN-BBO/MetaBBO基线比较中，16个函数中的13个取得最佳平均误差且无训练成本；在d=1000的BBOB子集上相对宿主取得936倍几何均值改进。在结构化任务上，1135维UAV路径规划中取得最佳平均成本（比最强基线低12.8%）；在多目标任务中，在38个任务中改进SMS-EMOA/AGE-MOEA2宿主12个任务且无显著退化。
AI.conclusion: JANUS证明了在不额外消耗评估预算、无需离线训练的前提下，通过提取局部几何信号可以有效增强现有群体优化器的性能，是一种轻量级、通用且即插即用的优化增强模块。

title: Metric Distortion of Social Welfare Functions
summary:
Metric distortion has primarily been studied for social choice functions, which select a single winner from ordinal preferences. We extend this framework to social welfare functions, which output a ranking of $m$ candidates. We associate each voter $v$ with a monotone weight vector $\mathbf{w}_v = (w_{v1},\ldots,w_{vm})$, specifying the importance of the $i$-th position for voter $v$, and define the cost of a ranking as the position-weighted sum of their distances to the ranked candidates. This model generalizes both single-winner voting and committee selection. We consider three information regimes.
  First, we study the setting where the positional weight vectors are known. A natural approach recursively applies a single-winner rule with distortion $β$ to construct the ranking one position at a time. We show that this yields distortion at most $3β$ in general. This gap is not merely an artifact of the analysis: we show that no analysis based solely on per-round guarantees can certify a bound better than $2β$. By exploiting structural properties specific to Fractional Veto of Kizilkaya and Kempe, we show that its recursive extension achieves the optimal distortion of 3.
  Second, when all voters share the same unknown weight vector, recursively applying any social choice function with distortion $β$ achieves distortion at most $1+(β-1)\text{range}(\mathbf{w})$, where $\text{range}(\mathbf{w})=(w_1-w_m)/w_1$ denotes the normalized range of the common weight vector $\mathbf{w}$. Finally, we study unknown heterogeneous weights. Without further assumptions, every rule has unbounded distortion. We therefore consider two natural normalizations: unit-sum, where each voter distributes one unit of value across the ranking, and unit-top, where every voter assigns unit value to the first position. Under both models, we show that the optimal distortion is $Θ(m)$.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将度量失真（metric distortion）从单赢家社会选择函数扩展到社会福利函数（输出m个候选人的排序）。每个选民有一个单调权重向量，定义排序代价为位置加权距离和。研究三种信息体制：已知权重、共享未知权重、异构未知权重，分别给出相应的失真界。
AI.motivation: 此前度量失真研究主要集中在单赢家选择函数上，而现实中许多场景需要产出完整的候选人排序（社会福利函数），如委员会选举、排名系统等。作者希望将此理论框架推广到排序输出场景，并统一单赢家投票和委员会选举两种模型。
AI.method: 1) 构建位置加权的一般化排序代价模型，推广单赢家投票和委员会选举；2) 对已知权重情形，采用递归应用单赢家规则构造排序，证明失真上界3β，并证明基于逐轮分析无法改进到2β以下，同时利用Fractional Veto的结构特性达到最优失真3；3) 对共享未知权重情形，证明递归应用失真β的社会选择函数可达1+(β-1)range(w)；4) 对异构未知权重，引入unit-sum和unit-top两种归一化假设，证明最优失真为Θ(m)。
AI.result: 已知权重时递归方法达到3β的一般界（最优为3，通过Fractional Veto实现）；共享未知权重时界为1+(β-1)range(w)；异构未知权重在两种自然归一化下最优失真均为Θ(m)。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了社会福利函数的度量失真理论框架，表明递归构造方法在多种信息体制下都能取得接近最优的失真界，并揭示了不同信息可及性下问题的复杂性差异。

title: ReART: Reference-Guided Retrieval and Refinement for Emotion-Aware Art Generation
comment: Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026 (Grand Challenge Track 1), 7 pages, 3 figures
summary: Emotion-aware artistic image generation requires a model to satisfy semantic content, artistic style, and target emotion simultaneously. The key challenge is that artistic captions conflate these axes into underspecified free-form text, making fine-grained visual attributes such as brushwork, composition, and tonal atmosphere difficult to ground concretely. We present ReART, a reference-guided retrieval and refinement framework. Our method decomposes test captions and each image annotation in the EmoArt database into structured visual fields, and performs field-wise retrieval over subject, layout, brush-line, and tone-mood dimensions to retrieve role-specific visual references that supply the perceptual detail text alone cannot convey; these references are used alongside a structured prompt for initial synthesis. For samples where any Attribute Alignment Score (AAS) axis falls below threshold, an AAS-driven refinement loop diagnoses failures, constructs constrained repair plans specifying elements to keep, errors to fix, and operations to avoid, routes references by correction purpose, and performs controlled editing under structural preservation constraints. Our system ranks 2nd in Track 1 of the AffectiveArt 2026 Grand Challenge, achieving a perfect AAS of 1.00 and an overall score of 0.78. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/ReART.git.

AI.tldr: ReART是一个参考引导的检索与精炼框架，用于情感感知的艺术图像生成。它将标题和图像注释分解为结构化视觉字段，进行字段级检索以获取角色特定的视觉参考，并采用AAS驱动的精炼循环进行受控编辑。该系统在AffectiveArt 2026挑战赛Track 1中排名第二，AAS达1.00，总分为0.78。
AI.motivation: 情感感知的艺术图像生成需要同时满足语义内容、艺术风格和目标情感，但艺术标题将这三个维度混为一谈，导致笔触、构图、色调氛围等细粒度视觉属性难以具体落地。
AI.method: 1) 将测试标题和EmoArt数据库中的图像注释分解为结构化视觉字段；2) 在主体、布局、笔线和色调-情绪维度上进行字段级检索，获取角色特定的视觉参考；3) 结合结构化提示进行初始合成；4) 对于AAS分数低于阈值的样本，采用AAS驱动的精炼循环，诊断失败、构建受约束的修复计划（指定保留元素、修复错误、避免操作），并按修正目的路由参考，在结构保持约束下进行受控编辑。
AI.result: 在AffectiveArt 2026大挑战赛Track 1中排名第二，实现完美的AAS 1.00和0.78的总分。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦视觉字段并提供角色特定的参考检索，以及基于AAS的迭代精炼机制，ReART有效提升了情感艺术图像生成中细粒度视觉属性的可控性和准确性。

title: Retrieval Needs Multivectors: An Exponential Separation
summary:
Recent works have highlighted the expressive limitations of embedding based retrieval models through both theoretical analyses and challenging benchmarks such as LIMIT. While multi-vector embeddings consistently outperform single-vector embeddings, the precise representational gap between them remains poorly understood. In this work, following Jayaram's work, we provide the first explicit family of query and document sets, together with their relevance matrices, for which single-vector embeddings that rank all relevant documents above irrelevant ones require exponential size, whereas polynomial-size multi-vector embeddings suffice. Our result establishes an exponential separation between the expressive power of single-vector and multi-vector embeddings for the task of ranking of documents as opposed to approximating numerical scores as in the work of Jayaram.
  Motivated by our theoretical construction, we introduce ANDOR, a new retrieval benchmark that naturally instantiates these hard examples. We show that state-of-the-art single-vector embedding models perform poorly on ANDOR in the zero-shot setting and exhibit only marginal improvements after fine-tuning, highlighting the inherent difficulty of the benchmark compared to prior work. In contrast, multi-vector models consistently outperform their single-vector counterparts and improve substantially with fine-tuning, closely aligning with our theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从理论上证明了单向量嵌入与多向量嵌入在文档排序任务上存在指数级表达能力差距，并基于理论构造提出了ANDOR基准测试，实验验证了多向量模型在零样本和微调场景下均显著优于单向量模型。
AI.motivation: 现有工作虽然指出嵌入检索模型存在表达限制，且多向量嵌入一致优于单向量嵌入，但二者之间的精确表达差距尚不清楚。作者希望通过理论分析和实际基准来明确这一差距，并推动更好的检索模型设计。
AI.method: 作者遵循Jayaram的工作思路，首次构造了显式的查询和文档集合及其相关性矩阵，证明了单向量嵌入需要指数级规模才能正确排序所有相关文档，而多项式规模的多向量嵌入即可胜任。同时，基于理论构造设计了ANDOR基准测试来在真实场景中实例化这些困难样本。
AI.result: 理论结果为排序任务（而非Jayaram工作中的数值分数近似）建立了单向量与多向量嵌入之间的指数级表达能力分离。实验表明，SOTA单向量嵌入模型在ANDOR零样本场景下表现差，微调后仅有微小提升；而多向量模型一致优于单向量模型，且微调后大幅提升，与理论预测高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 本文在理论上确立了单向量与多向量嵌入在文档排序上的指数级表达差距，并通过ANDOR基准实证验证了该差距在真实模型中的存在性。这为未来检索模型的设计（尤其是多向量方法）提供了理论依据和评测工具。

title: Distinguishing Revision and Delayed Elaboration in Incremental Narrative Interpretation
comment: Accepted as a full paper for presentation at the 2026 Workshop on Computational Models of Narrative (CMN 2026). This preprint corresponds to the workshop version
summary:
Both human and AI systems that process narrative or long-form content operate incrementally: input is received over time, and internal representations must be updated accordingly. Incremental interpretation, therefore, depends not only on what is represented but also on how the representational state evolves under new evidence.
  We distinguish two structurally different update operators that arise in narrative interpretation: revision-driven update and delayed elaboration. Revision-driven updates retract or replace previously committed structure in response to a contradiction and are therefore non-monotonic. Delayed elaboration, by contrast, refines initially underspecified elements through constraint addition without retracting prior commitments, yielding monotonic extension of the interpretive state. Although both operators may alter how earlier material is understood, they impose fundamentally different structural requirements on state transitions.
  Using visual narratives as a diagnostic domain, we demonstrate how a structured narrative representation can explicitly separate committed from underspecified content and support both update operators during incremental construction. Through a worked example, we show how delayed elaboration enables monotonic refinement of interpretive state, while revision requires non-monotonic correction. We discuss the broader relevance of this structural distinction for incremental reasoning and hybrid symbolic-neural systems.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了叙事理解中两种结构上不同的更新算子：修订驱动的更新（非单调，撤回或替换已承诺的结构）和延迟细化（单调，通过约束添加精化未指定的元素而不撤回先前承诺）。使用视觉叙事作为诊断领域，展示结构化叙事表征如何分离已承诺与未指定内容，并同时支持这两种增量构建中的更新算子。
AI.motivation: 人类和AI系统在处理叙事或长内容时都是增量式的，输入随时间接收，内部表征必须相应更新。但增量解释不仅取决于表征了什么，还取决于表征状态在新证据下如何演化。现有的研究缺乏对叙事解释中不同更新算子的结构性区分，因此需要阐明修订驱动更新与延迟细化这两种根本不同的状态转换机制。
AI.method: 论文在概念层面区分两种更新算子：一是修订驱动的更新，因矛盾而撤回或替换先前承诺的结构，是非单调的；二是延迟细化，通过约束添加来精化初始未指定的元素而不撤销先前的承诺，是单调扩展。以视觉叙事为诊断领域，演示结构化叙事表征如何显式分离已承诺内容与未指定内容，并通过一个工作示例展示两种算子在增量构建中的操作。
AI.result: 通过工作示例表明，延迟细化能够实现对解释状态的单调精化，而修订则需要非单调的纠正。该结构性区分对增量推理和混合符号-神经系统的设计具有更广泛的相关性。
AI.conclusion: 叙事解释中的状态更新并非单一机制，应区分单调的延迟细化与非单调的修订驱动更新。这种区分对于增量推理架构以及混合符号-神经系统的设计与实现具有重要启示。

title: Topology of a Smile: Persistent Homology in Dental Imaging
summary: CBCT (Cone Beam Computed Tomography) scans provide detailed three-dimensional images, widely used in dentistry for diagnostic and treatment planning tasks. While invaluable, analyzing and documenting these scans is labor-intensive, prompting efforts to automate key steps like the classification and segmentation of anatomical structures to identify tooth types and associated pathologies. In this article, we propose an approach to automation that leverages persistent homology, a framework from topological data analysis that studies the shape of data by identifying features like connected components, holes, and voids across multiple scales. Persistent homology, together with a support vector machine, allows us to classify teeth in a CBCT scan and to perform diagnostics. Our method advances the state of the art, reaching average accuracy scores of 97.67% for tooth-labeling and 96.77% for diagnostic tasks, outperforming a CNN trained on the same data with accuracy of 70.27% and 86.67%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于持久同调（persistent homology）和支持向量机的方法，用于CBCT扫描中的牙齿分类与病理诊断，在牙齿标注和诊断任务上分别达到97.67%和96.77%的平均准确率，显著优于在同一数据上训练的CNN（70.27%和86.67%）。
AI.motivation: CBCT扫描提供详细的三维图像，广泛应用于牙科诊断和治疗规划，但分析记录这些扫描耗时费力。自动化牙齿分类和病理诊断是急需解决的关键步骤，以减轻临床工作负担。
AI.method: 利用拓扑数据分析中的持久同调框架，通过识别连通分量、孔洞和空洞等多尺度特征来研究数据形状，结合支持向量机（SVM）对CBCT扫描中的牙齿进行分类和诊断。
AI.result: 牙齿标注任务平均准确率达97.67%，诊断任务平均准确率达96.77%，均优于在同一数据上训练的CNN（分别为70.27%和86.67%）。
AI.conclusion: 基于持久同调的方法在CBCT牙齿分类和诊断任务上显著优于深度学习基线，证明了拓扑数据分析在该领域的有效性和优越性。

title: Model of Models: When Does Emitting a Specialist Beat Attending, Adapting, or Tuning?
summary: Given a task described by a few examples, how should a model be specialized to it? Four mechanisms are available -- zero-shot, in-context attention, test-time gradient adaptation, and emitting specialist weights from a hypernetwork -- yet the operating regime of the last is rarely mapped. We run the identical four-way comparison across six tasks spanning regression, generation, language modeling, reinforcement learning, and clinical and genomic classification, holding the specialist, the context, and (where we can) the training budget fixed. The clearest wins for emission are about cost at matched quality: it ties the state-of-the-art amortized tabular model (TabPFN) on clinical few-shot classification while emitting a reusable specialist instead of re-attending the support set per query, and reaches noise-floor shape generation with a $132$-float per-instance program. On few-shot sinusoid regression it is $2$--$3$ orders of magnitude below MAML at zero test-time gradient steps -- a margin that narrows to $\sim$$30\times$ but persists once training budgets are equalized. Emission cannot match in-context attention on high-dimensional sequence modeling: under matched-budget pre-training a one-pass adapter recovers only a minority of the in-context gain ($14.0\pm0.9\%$ at $5$M, $11.2\pm0.5\%$ at $15$M), and a LoRA-rank sweep shows this shortfall is a partial capacity limit -- capture climbs from $5\%$ to $21\%$ as rank grows but plateaus far below full recovery. Mechanism ablations confirm the emitted specialist is genuinely task-conditioned, not a memorized prior; and, more speculatively, emitted specialists compose in weight space -- interpolating two of them tracks the corresponding blend of their functions. We close with a falsifiable thesis, operationalized through a per-task resolution measure, bounding when each conditioning mechanism should be preferred.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了四种模型特化机制（零样本、上下文注意力、测试时梯度自适应、超网络生成专家权重）在六个跨领域任务上的表现，发现"发射专家权重"（emission）在成本匹配质量上最有利（如临床少样本分类持平TabPFN、正弦回归比MAML低2-3个数量级），但在高维序列建模上无法匹敌上下文注意力，并提出了何时应优先选择各机制的可证伪命题。
AI.motivation: 四种模型特化机制中，超网络发射专家权重（emission）的工作区间很少被系统测绘。作者希望在同等的专家、上下文和训练预算条件下，对四种机制进行公平的四向对比，以明确emission的适用边界。
AI.method: 在六个任务（回归、生成、语言建模、强化学习、临床及基因组分类）上运行完全相同的四机制对比，固定专家、上下文及训练预算；辅以LoRA秩扫描、机制消融、权重空间插值实验，并提出基于每任务分辨率度量的可证伪命题来界定各机制的适用条件。
AI.result: Emission在成本匹配质量上优势显著：临床分类持平TabPFN且可复用专家而非逐查询重算；形状生成达到噪声底限仅需132浮点数/实例；正弦回归比MAML低2-3个数量级（预算均衡后仍约30倍）。但无法匹敌上下文注意力于高维序列建模（仅恢复14%/11%收益），能力受限是部分原因（秩从5%升至21%仍远未恢复）。消融证实发射的专家确为任务条件化而非记忆先验；专家在权重空间可组合（插值对应功能混合）。
AI.conclusion: Emission在低成本、可复用专家和强组合性的场景下是优选机制，但在高维序列建模中受容量限制无法取代上下文注意力。作者提出基于分辨率度量的可证伪命题，为按任务选择特化机制给出边界条件。

title: KVBoost: Chunk-Level Key-Value Cache Reuse with Deviation-Guided Recomputation for Efficient Large Language Model Inference
summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) incur high prefill latency because key-value (KV) tensors must be recomputed for each request. Existing prefix-caching systems reduce this cost but require prompts to share a leading contiguous prefix, limiting effectiveness when shared content appears at arbitrary positions. We present KVBoost, a chunk-level KV cache reuse system for HuggingFace-compatible decoder models that enables reuse regardless of content position. KVBoost introduces a dual-hash keying scheme that separates positional identity (prefix hash) from content identity (content hash), supporting both exact and approximate cache matches. To address attention boundary errors from independently cached chunks, KVBoost employs two repair strategies: SelectiveRecompute, which re-encodes boundary regions, and CacheBlendRecompute, which identifies and recomputes high-deviation tokens after a probe pass. The system further incorporates asymmetric KV quantization (int8/int4), adaptive chunk boundary splitting, and importance-weighted eviction under a fixed memory budget. Evaluated on Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B over 1,000 bug-localization samples, KVBoost achieves a 4.49x reduction in time-to-first-token (142.4 ms vs.\ 639.1 ms) and outperforms prefix caching by 16%, with no loss in accuracy (99.2% vs.\ 99.1%). KVBoost provides a practical, memory-bounded inference acceleration layer compatible with RoPE-based models without architectural modification.

AI.tldr: KVBoost是一个块级KV缓存复用系统，通过双哈希键控方案（前缀哈希+内容哈希）实现任意位置的内容复用，结合选择性重计算和CacheBlend重计算策略修复注意力边界误差，并采用非对称KV量化和重要性加权驱逐。在Qwen2.5-3B上实现4.49倍TTFT加速，准确率不损失。
AI.motivation: Transformer大语言模型因每个请求都需要重算KV张量而产生高预填充延迟。现有前缀缓存系统要求提示共享连续的前缀，限制了共享内容出现在任意位置场景下的缓存复用效率。
AI.method: 1) 双哈希键控方案：前缀哈希（位置身份）与内容哈希（内容身份）分离，支持精确和近似缓存匹配；2) 两种边界修复策略：SelectiveRecompute重编码边界区域，CacheBlendRecompute通过探针通识别并重计算高偏差token；3) 非对称KV量化(int8/int4)；4) 自适应块边界切分；5) 固定内存预算下按重要性权重的驱逐策略。
AI.result: 在Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B上对1000个bug定位样本评估，TTFT从639.1ms降至142.4ms（4.49倍加速），比前缀缓存优16%，准确率99.2% vs 99.1%（无损失）。
AI.conclusion: KVBoost提供了一个实用、内存受限的推理加速层，兼容RoPE模型且无需架构修改，在保持精度的前提下显著降低预填充延迟。

title: Neuro-Formal Verification: Agentic Language-Agnostic Formal Program Reasoning
summary:
Formal verification offers the strongest assurance available for software, and verification-aware languages have made its automation real. Yet the benefits reach few mainstream developers, most of whose languages have no verification support. Besides, specifying properties and modeling the environment require expertise in formal methods. Proof is therefore reserved for a few celebrated artifacts, while the production code that ships is attested only through review and testing.
  We introduce neuro-formal verification (NFV), which harnesses that automation for developers of mainstream programming languages: an AI coding agent translates, an established verifier decides, and a question posed in a mainstream language is answered push-button, at empirical accuracy rather than soundness, with a machine-checked proof. Results on a dataset of correct and incorrect solutions to Python programming problems are encouraging: NFV returns a Dafny proof of correctness or of a bug on 57% of the entries at 92% precision, and a CBMC counterexample for 63% of the buggy programs at 90% precision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经形式验证（NFV）框架，利用AI编码智能体将主流编程语言（如Python）的代码自动翻译为验证器可处理的形式，使主流开发者无需形式化方法专业知识即可获得机器可验证的证明。在Python编程问题数据集上，NFV能以92%精度为57%的条目生成Dafny正确性证明或bug证明，并以90%精度为63%的错误程序生成CBMC反例。
AI.motivation: 形式化验证虽然能提供最强软件保障且已有自动化工具体系，但仅局限于少数验证感知语言，主流开发者无法受益。此外，编写规格说明和建模环境需要形式化方法专业知识，导致证明仅用于少数杰出手工艺品，而实际生产代码仍依赖评审和测试。
AI.method: 提出神经形式验证（NFV）框架：AI编码智能体负责将主流语言（如Python）的代码翻译为验证器可理解的形式（如Dafny），由成熟的验证器执行判定，用户以主流语言提问并以按钮式方式获得答案。该方法以经验准确性而非完全可靠性为目标，但生成的内容经机器检查。
AI.result: 在正确与错误的Python编程问题数据集上：NFV为57%的条目返回Dafny证明（正确性或bug），精度达到92%；对63%的错误程序返回CBMC反例，精度达到90%。
AI.conclusion: 神经形式验证展示了将形式化验证的自动化能力扩展到主流开发者群体的可行路径，在保持机器可检查证明的基础上，用AI智能体弥补了形式化方法的专业门槛，取得了令人鼓舞的初步成果。

title: Basins of Attraction to Multiple Fixed Points in Discrete-time Hysteresis Neural Networks
summary: This paper studies multiple fixed points in a discrete-time hysteresis neural network. The network consists of binary hysteresis neurons characterized by the threshold parameter. Depending on the parameter, the network can have a variety of multiple binary fixed points. Stability of each fixed point is characterized by basin of attraction (BOA): the set of initial points falling into the fixed point. In order to evaluate the distribution of BOA sizes, we present entropy. In order to escape from the curse of dimensionality, we introduce a simple problem: classification of binary data set. In the classification, BOAs correspond to classes. In the problem, we clarify that the threshold parameter can control the entropy, especially, can maximize the entropy: the distribution approaches to uniform. As a concrete example, we consider an item response data set in education. Using two fundamental metrics in the item response theory, the classification results are evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文研究离散时间迟滞神经网络中的多重不动点问题。网络由具有阈值参数的二元迟滞神经元组成，根据参数不同可产生多种二元不动点。通过吸引盆（BOA）刻画各不动点的稳定性，并引入熵来评估BOA大小的分布。为解决维度灾难，提出了二元数据集分类问题，其中BOA对应类别。研究发现阈值参数可以控制熵，尤其能使熵最大化（分布趋于均匀）。以教育领域的项目反应数据集为实例，用项目反应理论的两个基本指标评估分类结果。
AI.motivation: 需要评估迟滞神经网络中多重不动点的稳定性及其分布，解决高维问题带来的维度灾难，并探索阈值参数对系统行为的影响。
AI.method: 引入熵作为衡量吸引盆大小分布的指标；将问题简化为二元数据集分类（BOA对应类别）；通过调节阈值参数控制熵的大小；使用项目反应理论的两个基本指标进行评估。
AI.result: 发现阈值参数可以控制熵，特别能最大化熵使分布趋于均匀。在教育项目响应数据集的实验中验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 迟滞神经网络的阈值参数是控制系统不动点分布均匀性的有效手段，通过最大化熵可实现分类的均匀性，在教育数据分类中展示了实际应用价值。

title: The Complexity of Minimizing Subsidies in Envy-Free House Allocation
summary: The house allocation problem is a classical one-sided matching problem that concerns the assignment of a set of $m$ houses to $n$ agents according to their preferences, where each agent is assigned exactly one house. Among the various objectives studied in this setting, envy-freeness is one of the most widely adopted fairness criteria. As envy-free house allocations do not always exist, we address this challenge by introducing subsidies and aim to compute allocations that achieve envy-freeness with minimum total subsidy. For binary instances, we show that a total subsidy of at most $(n-1)$ suffices to guarantee envy-freeness in house allocation, and this bound is tight. Building on the known NP-hardness for general utilities, we further show that computing an allocation that minimizes the total subsidy is NP-hard, even under binary utilities. However, when there are only a bounded number of types of agents with binary utilities, the problem can be solved in polynomial time. Finally, we present a polynomial time algorithm that computes the minimum subsidy required to achieve envy-freeness for two types of agents with general utilities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究房产分配问题中的无嫉妒公平性，通过引入补贴（subsidies）来实现无嫉妒分配，并最小化总补贴。针对二元效用，证明最多(n-1)的补贴足以保证无嫉妒且该界是紧的；同时证明即使二元效用下最小化总补贴也是NP难的。但当代理人类型数量有界时可在多项式时间内求解。最后，针对两类代理人且一般效用的情形，提出了多项式时间算法。
AI.motivation: 房产分配中无嫉妒分配并不总是存在，因此需要引入补贴来达成公平性。核心动机是：在保证无嫉妒公平性的前提下，如何最小化所需的补贴总额，并探索不同效用设定下的计算复杂度边界。
AI.method: 1) 对二元效用实例，给出总补贴最多(n-1)的上界构造并证明其紧性；2) 基于一般效用下已知的NP-hardness，将NP-hard结果推广到二元效用情形；3) 当代理人类型数量有界（二元效用）时，设计多项式时间算法；4) 对两类代理人且一般效用的情形，提出计算最小补贴的多项式时间算法。
AI.result: 1) 二元效用下，总补贴(n-1)足以保证无嫉妒，且该界是紧的；2) 即使二元效用下，最小化总补贴的分配计算是NP难的；3) 代理人类型数量有界时，二元效用的情形可在多项式时间内求解；4) 两类代理人的一般效用情形存在多项式时间算法。
AI.conclusion: 论文系统地刻画了带补贴的无嫉妒房产分配问题的复杂度图谱：二元效用下补贴上界为(n-1)且紧，一般情况计算困难，但在有界类型或两类代理人等特殊结构下可实现多项式时间求解，为实际应用提供了可计算的求解路径。

title: Motion-Aware Reasoning from Speech to Mask Tracks: Runner-up Solution for the MeViS-Audio Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge 2026
summary: Speech-guided referring video object segmentation aims to recover the mask tracks of objects specified by a spoken motion description. Here, speech carries a linguistic instruction rather than acoustic evidence from a sounding object, so a solution must connect speech recognition, motion-centric temporal grounding, mask tracking, and explicit no-target handling. We introduce Speech2MaskTrack, our approach for the MeViS-Audio track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge. Speech2MaskTrack transcribes the spoken query and compiles it into structured constraints over category, count, direction, interaction role, and temporal phase. SAM3.1 enumerates multiple instance tracks, which TRACE ranks using complete-trajectory motion and relation evidence. A frozen lexical presence gate may suppress the ranked SAM3.1 base prediction. When the gate predicts that a target is present, an available full-expression-conditioned SaSaSa2VA track replaces the SAM3.1 mask. Only outputs that remain empty enter GPT-assisted recovery, which invokes SaSaSa2VA again under query- and mask-level verification. Speech2MaskTrack achieved second place in the official challenge ranking.

AI.tldr: Speech2MaskTrack 是一种针对语音引导的指代视频目标分割的方法，在 MeViS-Audio 挑战赛中获得第二名。它通过语音转写、结构化约束编译、SAM3.1 实例轨迹枚举、TRACE 排序以及多级验证机制，实现了对语音描述目标的精确掩码跟踪。
AI.motivation: 语音引导的指代视频目标分割面临独特挑战：语音既包含语言指令又可能含有声学干扰；需要同时解决语音识别、运动中心的时间定位、掩码跟踪以及无目标处理等问题。现有方法难以统一处理这些复杂约束。
AI.method: Speech2MaskTrack 采用多阶段流水线：(1) 转写语音查询并编译为类别、数量、方向、交互角色和时间阶段的结构化约束；(2) 使用 SAM3.1 枚举多个实例轨迹；(3) 通过 TRACE 基于完整轨迹运动和关系证据进行排序；(4) 利用冻结词汇存在门抑制不匹配的基础预测；(5) 当存在门预测目标存在时，用 SaSaSa2VA 的完整表达式条件轨迹替换 SAM3.1 掩码；(6) 对空输出执行 GPT 辅助恢复，再次调用 SaSaSa2VA 进行查询和掩码级验证。
AI.result: Speech2MaskTrack 在第八届 LSVOS 挑战赛 MeViS-Audio 赛道官方排名中荣获第二名。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语音识别、结构化约束、多模型候选轨迹生成与分层验证机制相结合，Speech2MaskTrack 有效解决了语音引导指代视频分割中的复杂任务，证明了综合多模态信息处理在视频目标分割中的有效性。

title: Why didn't more people see it? Recommendation: Transparency for providers
summary: Transparency in recommender systems has been widely studied from the perspective of those receiving recommendations, yet the needs of item providers, the creators whose content is distributed through these platforms, remain largely unexplored. Providers often lack insight into how their items do or do not receive exposure in users' recommendation lists. In this work, we address this gap by proposing a surrogate modeling approach to explain item exposure at a system level. Rather than explaining individual user-item pairs, we train a proxy model to approximate the exposure distribution produced by a recommender. By quantifying the contribution of each feature, we seek to explain the factors driving the recommendation model's decisions across the entire user base. We evaluate our approach on two datasets and three recommendation models. Results show that the surrogate model captures the global behavior of all three recommenders with high fidelity and that the most influential factors vary meaningfully across models and domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种替代模型（surrogate model）方法，从物品提供者的视角解释推荐系统中物品曝光度的全局影响因素，而不仅仅是传统研究中面向接收者的单一推荐解释。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统透明性研究长期聚焦于接收推荐的一方（用户），而物品提供者（内容创作者）缺乏对其物品在推荐列表中曝光机制的理解，这是一个尚未被充分探索的重要研究空白。
AI.method: 与传统解释单个用户-物品对不同，作者训练一个代理模型来近似推荐系统产生的曝光分布，并通过量化每个特征的贡献来解释推荐模型在整个用户群体中的决策驱动因素。
AI.result: 在两个数据集和三个推荐模型上的评估表明，替代模型能够以高保真度捕获所有三个推荐系统的全局行为，且最有影响力的因素在不同模型和领域之间存在有意义的差异。
AI.conclusion: 替代建模方法可以有效解释推荐系统在系统层面的物品曝光机制，帮助物品提供者理解其内容获得或失去曝光的原因，且解释结果具有模型和领域特异性。

title: KSE-Web: An Analysis of Hybrid Retrieval and LLM-Assisted Query Expansion for Low-Resource Khmer Semantic Search
summary: As a low-resource language, Khmer presents several retrieval challenges, including limited annotated data, ambiguous word boundaries, weak support in multilingual embedding models, and frequent mixed Khmer-English usage. This paper presents KSE-Web, an analysis of hybrid retrieval and LLM-assisted query expansion for Khmer semantic search. We construct the dataset from approximately 17K candidate Khmer titles and retain 3K cleaned full-text Khmer documents after filtering, normalization, deduplication, and document-length control. The dataset includes 300 manually reviewed user-style Khmer search queries and silver relevance labels with partial human verification. We evaluate character n-gram BM25, multilingual dense retrieval, hybrid BM25+dense retrieval, and LLM-assisted query expansion using Qwen2.5 models. Experimental results show that BM25 achieves the strongest overall performance, reaching 0.943 Recall and 0.876 nDCG. Hybrid BM25+dense retrieval performs comparably, achieving 0.929 Recall and 0.871 nDCG, while dense retrieval alone performs lower. LLM-assisted query expansion does not outperform non-expanded retrieval; however, Qwen2.5-3B produces substantially stronger expanded-query results than Qwen2.5-0.5B, suggesting that LLM size and expansion quality matter for low-resource Khmer retrieval. Our analysis further shows that direct LLM expansion can introduce topic drift, generic terms, and noisy reformulations, while simple filtering may remove useful semantic cues. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of LLM-assisted retrieval for Khmer semantic search and provide a foundation for future Khmer retrieval datasets with stronger human-verified annotations and Khmer-aware retrieval models. The dataset and documentation will be made available at github.com/back-kh/KhmerSemantic-Search.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了KSE-Web，一个针对柬埔寨语（高棉语）语义搜索的混合检索与LLM辅助查询扩展分析研究。研究构建了包含3K清洗后全文文档和300个人工审核查询的检索数据集，评估了BM25、稠密检索、混合检索及LLM查询扩展等方法，发现BM25表现最佳（Recall 0.943，nDCG 0.876），LLM扩展未能超越基线，但更大模型（Qwen2.5-3B）显著优于小模型（0.5B）。
AI.motivation: 柬埔寨语作为低资源语言面临多重检索挑战：标注数据稀缺、词边界模糊、多语言嵌入模型支持薄弱、高棉语与英语混用频繁。现有检索方法在低资源语言上的表现缺乏系统研究，需要构建专用数据集并评估各种检索策略的有效性。
AI.method: 构建KSE-Web数据集：从约17K候选柬埔寨语标题中，经过过滤、归一化、去重和文档长度控制后保留3K清洗全文文档；包含300条人工审核的用户风格查询和部分人工验证的银相关性标签。评估方法包括：字符n-gram BM25、多语言稠密检索、BM25+稠密混合检索，以及使用Qwen2.5（0.5B和3B）进行LLM辅助查询扩展。
AI.result: BM25在整体表现上最强（Recall 0.943，nDCG 0.876）；混合BM25+稠密检索表现接近（Recall 0.929，nDCG 0.871）；纯稠密检索表现较低；LLM辅助查询扩展未超越未扩展基线，但Qwen2.5-3B的扩展查询结果明显优于0.5B版本。分析还发现LLM扩展可能引入主题漂移、通用术语和噪声改写，简单过滤会丢失有用的语义线索。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了LLM辅助检索在低资源高棉语语义搜索中的潜力与局限。BM25等词法方法仍是强基线，LLM扩展效果依赖模型规模，直接扩展可能引入噪声。该工作为未来构建更强人工验证标注的柬埔寨语检索数据集和高棉语感知检索模型奠定了基础。

title: EditStream: A Unified Autoregressive Framework for Interactive Video Generation and Editing
summary: Interactive video generation and editing are becoming increasingly important for creative design. In this report, we introduce EditStream: a unified framework for interactive video generation and editing. EditStream unifies multiple video creation and manipulation tasks within a single DiT-based model through flexible task-specific conditioning, and further transforms it into a fast, few-step autoregressive model for efficient streaming. It supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Video-to-Video, Editing Propagation, Reference-guided Video Editing, and Camera Pose Change, enabling flexible control over video generation, transformation, and editing within one system. To make the unified model practical for interactive use, we develop a two-stage distillation approach that combines Velocity Moment Matching (VMM) with autoregressive unrolling. VMM matches conditional velocity moments at student-reached intermediate states to preserve generation quality and motion, while unrolling exposes the student to its own autoregressive predictions to improve temporal stability. Together, they alleviate common challenges in few-step autoregressive video generation, including over-saturation, degraded motion, temporal instability, and complex training. EditStream provides a practical and scalable solution that bridges high-quality diffusion-based video models with interactive creative workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EditStream，一个统一的交互式视频生成与编辑框架，基于单个DiT模型支持多种视频任务，并通过两阶段蒸馏（VMM + 自回归展开）实现快速少步生成，兼顾生成质量、运动保真和时间稳定性。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频生成和编辑对创意设计日益重要，但现有扩散模型生成缓慢，且缺乏统一框架来支持多种视频任务（如文本生成、图像生成、视频编辑等），难以满足实时交互需求。
AI.method: 1) 统一框架：基于单个DiT模型，通过灵活的任务特定条件支持Text-to-Video、Image-to-Video、Video-to-Video、Editing Propagation、Reference-guided Video Editing和Camera Pose Change。2) 两阶段蒸馏：结合Velocity Moment Matching（VMM）匹配学生到达中间状态的条件速度矩以保持质量与运动，并与自回归展开结合，暴露学生自身预测以提高时间稳定性。
AI.result: EditStream将统一模型转化为快速、少步的自回归模型，实现了高效流式生成，并缓解了少步自回归视频生成中的过饱和、运动退化、时间不稳定和训练复杂等问题。
AI.conclusion: EditStream提供了一个实用且可扩展的解决方案，弥合了高质量扩散视频模型与交互式创意工作流之间的鸿沟。

title: Runtime Action Interference for AI Control of AlphaStar in StarCraft II
summary: A trained reinforcement learning policy does not determine the complete behavior that users encounter: deployment code still schedules, admits, suppresses, or replaces its proposed actions. We contribute \emph{runtime action interference} (RAI), an AI control mechanism that preserves policy parameters while regulating action pacing and filtering configured action patterns after inference. RAI releases a proposed action only when its cooldown condition is satisfied and its content detector does not flag the action; otherwise, it dispatches a no-op. The detector covers specified toxic behaviors, including worker-unit harassment, while the cooldown controls action rate. We implement RAI in a replication of AlphaStar actor.py and make the implementation and reproducibility materials available through an open source code repository. We deployed RAI in a \textit{StarCraft~II} human participant study that compared two presentations of the same opponent with high capability and rate limited actions; we withheld its capability claim in one presentation and disclosed it in the other. On response scales from 1 to 5, we observed pooled fairness, trust, and toxicity means of 3.90, 3.50, and 2.00 under claim withholding, compared with 2.62, 4.31, and 2.85 under disclosure. Disclosure corresponded with lower perceived fairness and higher perceived toxicity across every expertise group, whereas trust increased among novices and experts but decreased among intermediate participants. Our human evaluation therefore shows that perceptions of an opponent controlled through RAI can vary substantially with the capability information presented to users, even when the configured control remains constant. We conclude that human-computer evaluations must separate control within the execution stack from capability disclosure and assess fairness, trust, and toxicity as distinct dimensions of human experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出运行时动作干扰（RAI），一种AI控制机制，在推理后调节动作节奏并过滤配置的动作模式，而无需改变策略参数。通过AlphaStar复制实现并在星际争霸II人机研究中验证，发现能力披露显著影响用户对公平性、信任和毒性的感知。
AI.motivation: 训练好的强化学习策略并不能完全决定用户遇到的行为，部署代码仍会调度、接纳、抑制或替换其建议动作，但现有研究往往忽视了这一执行层面对人机交互体验的影响。
AI.method: RAI在推理后通过冷却条件控制和内容检测器过滤动作，不符合条件时发送no-op。在AlphaStar actor.py复制中实现，并在星际争霸II中进行人机参与研究，对比披露与不披露对手能力声明两种呈现方式。
AI.result: 不披露能力时公平性、信任、毒性均值分别为3.90、3.50、2.00；披露时分别为2.62、4.31、2.85。披露导致感知公平性降低、感知毒性升高，信任在新手和专家中增加但在中级参与者中降低。
AI.conclusion: 人机评估必须将执行栈内的控制与能力披露分离，并将公平性、信任和毒性作为人类体验的独立维度进行评估。

title: AIREP: A Protocol for Per-Decision Evidence in AI Runtime Governance
comment: 8 pages. Reference implementation and two-verifier conformance kit: https://github.com/halvrenofviryel/ai-runtime-evidence-protocol
summary: A protocol is presented for recording the governance decisions of automated AI runtimes. When a runtime releases, blocks, defers, redacts, or escalates an individual output, AIREP records that decision as a single signed object that any party can check offline, independent of the runtime that produced it. A record carries the decision as one of a closed set of verbs under a stated policy basis, references its input, output, and evidence by hash rather than by value, and declares both what its evidence covers and what it does not. Records form a SHA-256 hash chain that binds each record to its position, so that tampering and gaps are detectable by recomputation. Vendor-, model-, and domain-specific content is confined to a single optional namespace, and a mechanical neutrality test keeps the shared format free of it. A reference implementation and a two-language conformance kit are described. Some implementation issues are considered, and problems such as alignment of the canonical form across implementations, freshness witnesses, and multi-runtime chains are exposed. The format is offered for adoption by any AI runtime that records governance decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为AIREP的协议，用于记录自动化AI运行时的治理决策（如发布、阻止、延迟、删除或升级输出）。每条记录是一个签名对象，可离线验证，通过SHA-256哈希链绑定位置以检测篡改和缺失，并采用中性命名空间设计确保格式通用性。
AI.motivation: 随着AI运行时对输出的治理决策（如内容审核、安全限制）日益频繁，需要一个标准化的、可审计的、独立于具体运行时的记录格式，以便任何第三方都能离线验证这些决策的真实性和完整性，确保AI治理的透明性和可追溯性。
AI.method: AIREP将治理决策编码为带签名的记录对象：包含封闭动词集合（如release/block等）、策略依据、通过哈希引用输入输出及证据、声明证据覆盖范围。记录通过SHA-256形成哈希链绑定位置，内容隔离在可选命名空间内，并通过机械中立性测试确保格式通用性。
AI.result: 提供了参考实现和双语言一致性测试套件，识别了跨实现规范形式对齐、新鲜度见证（freshness witnesses）和多运行时哈希链等实现挑战。
AI.conclusion: AIREP格式可供任何记录治理决策的AI运行时采纳，作为一种开放、可验证、与厂商无关的审计标准。

title: Large Language Models for Requirements Engineering: A Cross-Task Empirical Evaluation
summary: Requirements-related information is scattered across heterogeneous artefacts such as user feedback, developer discussions, and software repositories, making the extraction of actionable requirements knowledge labour-intensive and hard to scale. Large Language Models (LLMs) can support many Requirements Engineering (RE) activities, from classification and traceability identification to specification and explanation generation, but existing evidence is fragmented across tasks, artefact types, and evaluation settings, and studies rarely offer cross-task evaluations or replication packages. We present two complementary empirical studies evaluating LLMs across five RE-related activities. The first is a controlled experiment on five lightweight open-source LLMs for feedback-driven requirements classification and specification generation. The second is an exploratory industrial case study on two frontier LLMs for traceability link identification and traceability explanation generation using real project artefacts. Classification and traceability identification were assessed with quantitative metrics, and generation tasks through human evaluation. LLM performance is strongly task-dependent, ranging from moderate to high, and no single model consistently outperformed the others, indicating that effective adoption depends on selecting models and prompting strategies per task. Our contributions are: (i) the first cross-task empirical evaluation of LLMs spanning five RE-related activities, (ii) replication materials supporting reproducibility, and (iii) a broader understanding of the capabilities, limitations, and practical readiness of current LLMs for RE.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两项互补的实证研究，系统评估了LLM在五项需求工程（RE）相关活动中的表现，包括受控实验（五个轻量级开源LLM进行反馈驱动需求分类和规格生成）和探索性工业案例研究（两个前沿LLM进行可追溯性链接识别和解释生成）。研究发现LLM性能高度依赖任务，没有单一模型能稳定胜出，并提供了可复制的实验材料。
AI.motivation: 需求相关信息分散在异构工件中（用户反馈、开发者讨论、软件仓库），提取可操作的需求知识劳动密集且难以规模化。虽然LLM已能支持多项RE活动，但现有证据碎片化，缺乏跨任务评估和复制包，阻碍了实践者有效采用。
AI.method: 设计两项互补实证研究：第一项为受控实验，使用五个轻量级开源LLM进行反馈驱动的需求分类与规格生成；第二项为探索性工业案例研究，使用两个前沿LLM在真实项目工件上进行可追溯性链接识别与解释生成。分类和可追溯性任务用定量指标评估，生成任务用人工评估。
AI.result: LLM性能高度依赖具体任务，整体表现从中等到高水平不等，没有任何单一模型能一致优于其他模型，说明有效采用取决于针对每个任务选择合适的模型和提示策略。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献包括：（i）首个覆盖五项RE相关活动的跨任务LLM实证评估；（ii）支持可复现性的复制材料；（iii）对当前LLM在RE领域的能力、局限和实际就绪程度的更全面理解。

title: Spicing up Genetic Netlist Generation with LLMs
summary: Analog circuit topology synthesis remains challenging because useful designs occupy a tiny fraction of a combinatorial search space, and small structural changes can induce highly nonlinear changes in behavior. Evolutionary algorithms are attractive because they can optimize over discrete circuit topologies using only black-box evaluations, but they often require many SPICE simulations and may converge prematurely. We introduce LLM-SPICEMixer, a hybrid synthesis framework that augments genetic netlist generation with IGEL (Inspiration-Guided Evolution with LLMs), an LLM-based proposal operator. During search, IGEL prompts an LLM with high-performing circuits from the elite set and instructs it to generate a new SPICE netlist, which is then evaluated by SPICE and selected using the same reward mechanism as conventional genetic operators. Thus, the LLM contributes structured topology proposals while simulation remains the source of truth. We evaluate LLM-SPICEMixer on a challenging benchmark task: synthesizing transistor-level circuits that implement a discriminant function for Iris classification. Compared with the genetic framework without LLM guidance, LLM-SPICEMixer improves the median final training reward by 8.4% and the median validation-selected test reward by 8.8%. The best validation-selected circuit achieves 93.3% test accuracy at the nominal tt corner and 85.9% average test accuracy across 17 process, voltage, and temperature corners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-SPICEMixer，一种混合模拟电路拓扑综合框架，将LLM作为进化算法中的灵感引导提案算子（IGEL），与遗传算法结合，用LLM生成的SPICE网表丰富搜索过程，同时保持SPICE仿真作为评估真理。在Iris分类判别电路的晶体管级综合任务上，相比无LLM引导的遗传框架，中位最终训练奖励提升8.4%，中位验证选择测试奖励提升8.8%。
AI.motivation: 模拟电路拓扑综合极具挑战性，因为有效设计在组合搜索空间中占比极小，且微小结构变化可引起高度非线性的行为变化。虽然进化算法可利用黑盒评估优化离散电路拓扑，但通常需要大量SPICE仿真且容易过早收敛。
AI.method: 提出LLM-SPICEMixer混合综合框架，其中IGEL（Inspiration-Guided Evolution with LLMs）作为基于LLM的提案算子。在搜索过程中，IGEL从精英集（elite set）中选取高性能电路作为提示，指导LLM生成新的SPICE网表，随后该网表由SPICE评估，并与传统遗传算子使用相同的奖励机制进行选择。LLM贡献结构化拓扑提案，而仿真结果作为唯一评判标准。
AI.result: 在Iris分类的晶体管级判别电路综合任务上，相比无LLM引导的遗传框架，LLM-SPICEMixer将中位最终训练奖励提高8.4%，中位验证选择测试奖励提高8.8%。最佳验证选择电路在标称tt角落达到93.3%测试准确率，在17个工艺-电压-温度角落下平均测试准确率达85.9%。
AI.conclusion: LLM引导的提案算子能有效增强遗传算法在模拟电路拓扑搜索中的表现，在保持仿真真实性的同时，利用LLM的结构化知识生成更优的拓扑提案，显著提升搜索效果和泛化鲁棒性。

title: On Deterministic Optimal Mechanisms in a Two-Item Setting for Distributions with Nondecreasing Density
summary:
Consider the problem of designing a revenue-optimal auction mechanism when two heterogeneous items are sold to a single buyer having independent valuations over the items. The distributions of the buyer's valuation for the items are assumed to have densities that are positive, nondecreasing, and continuously differentiable on their support sets $[c_i,c_i+b_i]$ in the positive axis. I prove that the optimal mechanism is deterministic if at least one of the minimum valuations (i.e., either $c_1$ or $c_2$) is sufficiently high. I provide a method to calculate the threshold of $(c_1,c_2)$ beyond which the optimal mechanism is deterministic. I also provide a sufficient condition on the distributions of buyer's valuations for which the individual sale mechanism is optimal.
  I show that when $c_1$ is low and $c_2$ is high, it is optimal for the seller to sell item $2$ at the minimum valuation $c_2$, thus effectively reducing the problem to finding the optimal mechanism in the one-dimensional setting only for item $1$. I conjecture with promising preliminary results that this result can be extended to the three-item setting. Specifically, I conjecture that when $c_1$ and $c_2$ are low but $c_3$ is high, it is optimal for the seller to sell item $3$ at the minimum valuation $c_3$, thus effectively reducing the problem to finding the optimal mechanism in the two-dimensional setting for items $1$ and $2$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在单买家、两件异质商品、独立估值且密度非负非减的条件下，设计收益最优拍卖机制的问题。作者证明了当至少一个商品的最低估值足够高时，最优机制是确定性的，并提供了计算该阈值的具体方法。此外，还给出了个人销售机制最优的充分条件，并猜想该结果可推广至三件商品的情形。
AI.motivation: 在多物品拍卖机制设计中，确定最优机制通常是极其复杂的问题，尤其是在多件异质商品和单买家的场景下。作者希望找到一类条件，使得最优机制可以简化为确定性的形式，从而降低求解复杂度。这一问题的关键在于识别出决定机制复杂性的关键参数（即商品的最低估值），并为实际应用提供可操作的计算方法。
AI.method: 作者采用理论分析方法，在假设买家对两件商品的估值分布密度为正、非减且连续可微的约束下，通过数学推导证明当最小估值（c1或c2）足够高时最优机制为确定性机制。同时提出了计算确定性机制成立阈值的具体方法，并给出了个人销售机制最优的分布充分条件。对于三件商品的情形，作者通过猜想和初步结果探索扩展方向。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 证明当至少一个商品的最低估值足够高时，两物品最优拍卖机制是确定性的；(2) 提供了计算条件阈值（c1,c2）的具体方法；(3) 给出了个人销售机制最优的充分条件；(4) 发现当c1低而c2高时，最优策略是以最小值c2出售商品2，从而将问题降维为一维优化；(5) 对三物品情形提出了相应的推广猜想及初步验证结果。
AI.conclusion: 作者的研究表明，在满足特定分布假设的情况下，多物品最优拍卖机制可以显著简化：通过提高最低估值门槛可以使机制变为确定性的，或是通过固定某些商品的售价将高维问题降为低维问题。这一研究成果为多物品拍卖机制的实践设计提供了理论支撑，且三物品情形的猜想为进一步研究指明了方向。

title: Adaptive Hierarchical Representation Alliance for Multimodal Learning
comment: This study has been accepted by EMNLP 2026 (Findings)
summary: Multimodal models often align language, vision, and audio in a single final-layer latent space, implicitly assuming that task-relevant evidence emerges at the same semantic depth across modalities. Using layer-wise CKA analysis, we observe that this assumption leads to semantic granularity mismatch: textual cues usually require deeper contextual abstraction, whereas visual and acoustic cues often provide discriminative perceptual evidence in shallow or middle layers. This mismatch can flatten fine-grained modality-private cues and reduce reliability under noisy, imbalanced, or missing inputs. To address this, we proposed Adaptive Hierarchical Representation Alliance (AHRA), a hierarchical shared--private expert framework. AHRA factorizes each modality into shared and private streams across semantic levels, regularizes them with shared alignment and private decorrelation, routes shared information through a cross-modal expert, and enhances task-relevant private tokens with modality-specific experts guided by a sparsity-controlled soft-gating mechanism (foreground exam). A hierarchical co-fusion module then performs intra-level expert coordination and inter-level semantic selection. Experiments on six benchmarks across image-text classification, multimodal intent recognition, and trimodal sentiment analysis show that AHRA consistently improves over strong baselines and remains robust under noisy and missing-modality settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AHRA框架，通过分层共享-私有专家结构解决多模态模型中模态间语义粒度不匹配的问题，在六个基准数据集上超越强基线并保持对噪声和缺失模态的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态模型通常将所有模态对齐到单一最终层潜空间，但通过层级CKA分析发现这种假设存在缺陷：文本线索需要更深的上下文抽象，而视觉和音频线索在浅层或中层就提供判别性感知证据。这种粒度不匹配会扁平化细粒度的模态私有线索，并在噪声、不均衡或缺失输入下降低可靠性。
AI.method: AHRA包含多个关键组件：将各模态分解为跨语义层的共享流和私有流；使用共享对齐和私有去相关进行正则化；通过跨模态专家路由共享信息；利用可控稀疏软门控机制（前景考试）指导模态专属专家增强任务相关私有标记；通过分层协同融合模块实现层内专家协调和层间语义选择。
AI.result: 在图像-文本分类、多模态意图识别和三模态情感分析六个基准上的实验表明，AHRA一致地优于强基线，并在噪声和缺失模态设置下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 分层的方式建模模态间的共享和私有信息可以有效缓解语义粒度不匹配问题，提升多模态模型在复杂和退化环境下的表现与可靠性。

title: Why This, Not That? Mining User Profiles for Pair-wise Counterfactuals
summary: The topic of explanation in recommender systems has seen steady research attention since the earliest days of the field. With some exceptions, this work has focused on the explanation of single items in a recommendation list and, especially recently, has emphasized approaches that are decoupled from the logic of the recommendation algorithm itself. Based on findings in the psychology of interpersonal communication, we propose a new task, pairwise interpretation of item rankings, asking the comparative question ``Why is item A ranked higher than item B?''. An effective solution to this task, we argue, is inherently grounded in the operation of the recommendation algorithm. We propose a class of techniques based on counterfactual learning to uncover the items in a user's profile that have contributed to the relative ranking of items. Using multiple datasets, we show that it is possible to identify such items as potential basis for comparative explanation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出推荐系统中的新任务——成对排名解释（pairwise interpretation of item rankings），即回答"为什么物品A排名高于物品B"这一比较性问题。作者基于人际沟通心理学中的研究发现，提出使用反事实学习（counterfactual learning）技术来揭示用户画像中哪些物品对物品的相对排名产生了贡献，并在多个数据集上验证了该方法能够识别出这些物品，为比较性解释提供基础。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统解释工作大多聚焦于推荐列表中单个物品的解释，且近年来的方法倾向于与推荐算法本身的逻辑脱钩（decoupled）。作者认为这种解释方式存在局限，基于人际沟通心理学的研究成果，提出了一种新的解释任务——成对排名解释，该任务天然地与推荐算法的运作机制相关联，能够提供更本质、更有说服力的解释。
AI.method: 提出一类基于反事实学习（counterfactual learning）的技术方法，通过构造反事实场景来揭示用户个人画像（user profile）中哪些物品对两个物品的相对排名产生了贡献，从而为比较性解释提供依据。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上验证了该方法能够有效识别出对物品相对排名有贡献的用户画像物品，可作为比较性解释的潜在基础。
AI.conclusion: 成对排名解释是一个值得探索的新任务，基于反事实学习的方法能够有效地将解释与推荐算法逻辑绑定，为推荐系统提供更具说服力的比较性解释。

title: Wazobia Eval: A Benchmark for Nigerian Pidgin Emotion Understanding, Sarcasm Detection, and Cultural Reasoning
summary: Nigerian Pidgin is one of Africa's most widely spoken languages, yet remains severely underrepresented in language model evaluation. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on translation, transcription, or generic sentiment analysis, leaving critical aspects of culturally grounded language understanding unmeasured. We introduce Wazobia Eval, a benchmark for evaluating Nigerian Pidgin emotion understanding, sarcasm detection, and cultural reasoning. The benchmark is built on a manually annotated dataset containing over 550 examples and a 16-category emotion taxonomy designed to capture culturally specific emotional registers that are not represented in conventional sentiment frameworks. Wazobia Eval provides standardized evaluation protocols and benchmark tasks for assessing model performance on nuanced Nigerian language understanding. We present the benchmark design, annotation methodology, taxonomy development process, and preliminary pilot evaluation results. Our goal is to provide foundational evaluation infrastructure for Nigerian language AI and establish a reproducible benchmark for future research. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/WAZOBIALABS.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Wazobia Eval，一个用于评估尼日利亚皮钦语（Nigerian Pidgin）情感理解、讽刺检测和文化推理能力的基准测试。该基准基于包含550多个手工标注示例的数据集，采用16类情感分类体系来捕捉传统情感框架中未体现的文化特异性情感表达。
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚皮钦语是非洲使用最广泛的语言之一，但在语言模型评估中严重缺乏代表性。现有基准主要聚焦于翻译、转录或通用情感分析，忽略了文化背景下的语言理解这一关键维度。
AI.method: 构建了包含550多个手工标注示例的数据集，设计了16类情感分类体系以捕捉文化特异性情感，并提供了标准化的评估协议和基准任务。
AI.result: 提供了基准设计、标注方法论、分类体系开发过程以及初步试点评估结果，数据集已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: 旨在为尼日利亚语言AI提供基础评估基础设施，并为未来研究建立可复现的基准。

title: Aligning Human Sense: Calibrated Distributional Reward Learning for Video Generation
summary: Video generation is central to AI-powered content creation. Aligning generated videos with human preferences is a key criterion for evaluating generation quality. Despite significant progress in visual quality, three key challenges remain. First, the reliability of reward signals is constrained by the quality of human preference data, which is often affected by subjective noise and bias. Second, standard scalar reward models collapse multi-aspect human preferences into a single value, leading to the loss of dynamic trade-offs across multiple preference dimensions. Third, in policy optimization, the widely adopted KL divergence imposes primarily local constraints and may fail to capture the global structure of human preferences. To address these challenges, we propose a unified preference-aware learning framework for video generation. First, we introduce elite-guided filtering to calibrate preference data and construct reliable supervision for reward model training. We then model video quality as a multidimensional reward distribution to capture the uncertainty inherent in human preferences, and use the Wasserstein distance to align the learned reward distribution with the empirical human preference distribution. Finally, we introduce Wasserstein-based distributional alignment into GRPO, guiding policy optimization to better match the global structure of human preferences over videos. Experiments on reward modeling and video generation demonstrate that our approach improves the reliability of reward signals and the perceptual consistency of generated videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/alignhs26/ahs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的偏好感知学习框架（AHS），用于视频生成中的对齐。该框架包含三个关键组件：精英引导过滤校准偏好数据、多维奖励分布建模视频质量并用Wasserstein距离对齐人类偏好分布、以及将基于Wasserstein的分布对齐引入GRPO策略优化。实验表明该框架提升了奖励信号的可靠性和生成视频的感知一致性。
AI.motivation: 视频生成与人类偏好对齐面临三个核心挑战：(1) 人类偏好数据存在主观噪声和偏差，限制了奖励信号的可靠性；(2) 标量奖励模型将多维人类偏好压缩为单一数值，丢失了多偏好维度间的动态权衡；(3) 策略优化中广泛使用的KL散度主要施加局部约束，无法捕捉人类偏好的全局结构。
AI.method: 提出统一的偏好感知学习框架，包含三个部分：1) 精英引导过滤（elite-guided filtering）校准偏好数据，构建可靠的奖励模型训练监督信号；2) 将视频质量建模为多维奖励分布，用Wasserstein距离对齐学习的奖励分布与经验人类偏好分布；3) 将基于Wasserstein的分布对齐引入GRPO，引导策略优化更好地匹配人类偏好的全局结构。
AI.result: 在奖励建模和视频生成任务上的实验表明，该方法提高了奖励信号的可靠性以及生成视频的感知一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将偏好数据校准、多维奖励分布建模和Wasserstein分布对齐相结合，该框架有效解决了视频生成中对齐的可靠性、多维性和全局结构三个关键问题，为视频生成与人类偏好对齐提供了统一解决方案。

title: Federated Ensemble Forecasting Under Supply-Chain Market Volatility
summary: Supply chain forecasting systems increasingly operate under market shocks, non-identically distributed regional demand, and limited willingness to centralize commercial data. This work proposes Federated Ensemble Forecasting with Negative-Correlation Learning (FEF NCL), a distributed method that trains specialized forecasting experts across client nodes while discouraging redundant model errors. The framework combines temporal feature encoders, client level drift scoring, reliability-weighted aggregation, and an explain ability layer that exposes the market and supplier variables most responsible for each forecast. A single synthetic dataset is used to evaluate the design. It contains 124,800 weekly SKU region observations from ten regional client nodes, 60 product families, 40 suppliers, five commodity groups, and a 2021-2024 volatility profile with explicit price-shock regimes. Because the dataset is synthetic, the reported results should be interpreted as controlled evidence of internal consistency rather than real-world validation. Across the synthetic test split, FEF NCL reduces weighted mean absolute percentage error from 13.9% for the best federated baseline to 12.4%, improves delay-risk macro-F1 from 0.755 to 0.801, and lowers the high volatility quintile error by 2.1 percentage points relative to SCAFFOLD. The analysis suggests that negative-correlation specialization is useful when clients face different supplier, freight, and commodity conditions, although deployment would require stronger privacy analysis, live drift monitoring, and operational calibration. Index Terms federated learning, ensemble learning, negative correlation learning, supply chain forecasting, market volatility, data drift, demand planning, risk governance

AI.tldr: 提出FEF NCL，一种分布式联邦集成预测方法，通过负相关学习训练专业化预测专家，并在合成数据集上验证了其相对于联邦基线的改进（WMAPE从13.9%降至12.4%，延迟风险macro-F1从0.755提升至0.801）。
AI.motivation: 供应链预测系统面临市场冲击、区域需求非独立同分布以及商业数据集中化意愿有限等挑战，现有联邦方法难以应对跨客户节点的高度异质性和数据漂移问题。
AI.method: 结合时间特征编码器、客户端级漂移评分、可靠性加权聚合和可解释性层，并通过负相关学习机制训练各节点的专业化专家模型，抑制冗余误差。
AI.result: 在包含124,800条周度SKU-区域观测的合成数据集上，FEF NCL将加权平均绝对百分比误差从13.9%降至12.4%，延迟风险macro-F1从0.755提升至0.801，高风险波动五分位误差相对SCAFFOLD降低2.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 负相关专业化在客户端面临不同供应商、运费和商品条件时有效，但实际部署需加强隐私分析、实时漂移监控和运营校准。

title: Reviewing Model Collapse and Countermeasures
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, Accepted and published in Proceedings of IEEE AAIML 2026
summary: Driven by massive amounts of web-scale data, generative AI (GenAI) has achieved remarkable progress, enabling various applications in diverse sectors. The advances of GenAI have actuated practitioners to use AI-synthesized data for training next-generation AI models. Undeniably, using synthetic data has alleviated the increasing stringent demand for data supply. Unfortunately, it also introduces a new critical issue: in a self-consuming cycle between model and data, the model ultimately collapse, raising more trustworthiness concerns to GenAI. In recent years, increasingly more studies have investigated the phenomenon of model collapse (MC) and explored potential solutions to mitigate it. However, the review of the phenomenon of MC still remains blank. To fill this gap, this paper provides an up-to-date overview of these studies for consolidating and reviewing the progress of MC in different application scenarios and countermeasures for mitigating MC. We also highlight challenges and future research opportunities.

AI.tldr: 该论文对生成式AI（GenAI）中出现的"模型崩溃"（Model Collapse, MC）现象进行了全面的综述，涵盖不同应用场景下的MC进展、缓解对策以及未来的挑战与研究机会。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI的快速发展，利用AI合成数据训练下一代模型已成为趋势，但在模型与数据的自我消费循环中会导致模型崩溃，引发可信度问题。然而，目前关于模型崩溃现象的系统性综述仍然空白，因此亟需填补这一研究缺口。
AI.method: 该论文采用综述（survey）的方法，系统性地整合和回顾了近年来关于模型崩溃现象的研究成果，包括不同应用场景下的MC表现以及各类缓解策略。
AI.result: 论文提供了关于模型崩溃现象的最新综述，涵盖了不同应用场景下MC的研究进展、缓解模型崩溃的对策，并指出了当前面临的挑战和未来的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述填补了模型崩溃现象研究综述领域的空白，为后续研究提供了系统性的参考框架，并明确了未来需要解决的关键挑战与研究机会。

title: ExploreAI: Agentic Exploration Knowledge Bases for Reproducible Observable-Regression Testing of Black-Box VR and 3D Applications
summary: Black-box VR and 3D applications are difficult to regression test because observable failures depend on where a tester moves, what objects are visible, and which views are captured. Manual exploratory testing can find such failures, but its evidence is time-consuming to reproduce; systematic sweeps are reproducible, but they lack semantic guidance and spend exploration budget on low-value viewpoints. We observe that an LLM can make the high-level decisions a human tester makes during exploration: interpreting a task, choosing which objects to inspect, grouping related objects, recording what it saw, and deciding when missing evidence should trigger another attempt. Based on this observation, we present ExploreAI, an LLM-driven agentic framework that offloads repeated perception, navigation, multi-view capture execution, and logging to specialized modules while using the LLM for planning, evidence recording, capture-policy decisions, and verification decisions. ExploreAI constructs an Exploration Knowledge Base (EKB): a structured, per-object record of one exploration run. For each object the agent finds, the EKB stores the scan evidence that exposed it, the selected target, the navigation path, the multi-view capture, and the self-verification result. The EKB is a reusable testing artifact that supports reproducible observable-regression checking across versions of a VR or 3D application. Across six indoor and outdoor scenes in Unity, AI2-THOR, and BeamNG, ExploreAI constructs high-completeness EKBs under both complete and target exploration, and an LLM-module ablation shows where semantic planning, capture policy, evidence recording, and self-verification contribute. Reproduction pilots further show that EKB-guided traces help both humans and LLM-based reproducers reproduce exact object-view evidence more effectively than conditions without EKB context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ExploreAI，一个基于LLM的智能体框架，用于黑盒VR和3D应用的回归测试。它利用LLM模拟人类测试者的高级决策（任务理解、对象选择、分组、记录、验证），同时将重复的感知、导航、多视角捕获和日志记录委托给专门模块。框架构建了勘探知识库（EKB），存储每个对象的扫描证据、导航路径、多视角捕获和自我验证结果，作为可复用的测试工件。在Unity、AI2-THOR和BeamNG的六个场景中验证了高完整性EKB构建，并通过消融实验和复现试点展示了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 黑盒VR和3D应用的回归测试困难重重：可观察的故障依赖于测试者移动位置、可见对象和捕获视角。人工探索性测试可发现故障但证据难以复现；系统性扫描可复现但缺乏语义指导，浪费探索预算在低价值视角上。
AI.method: ExploreAI是一个LLM驱动的智能体框架，将重复性任务（感知、导航、多视角捕获执行、日志记录）委托给专门模块，而LLM负责高层决策（规划、证据记录、捕获策略决策、验证决策）。框架构建探索知识库（EKB），为每个发现的对象存储扫描证据、选定目标、导航路径、多视角捕获和自我验证结果。
AI.result: 在Unity、AI2-THOR和BeamNG的六个室内外场景中，ExploreAI在完整和目标探索两种模式下均构建了高完整性的EKB。LLM模块消融实验揭示了语义规划、捕获策略、证据记录和自我验证的各自贡献。复现试点表明，EKB引导的痕迹能帮助人类和LLM复现者更有效地复现精确对象视角证据。
AI.conclusion: ExploreAI通过LLM驱动的智能体框架成功将人类探索性测试的语义智能与系统化捕获的可复现性结合起来，EKB作为可复用的测试工件有效支持跨版本的VR/3D应用可观察回归检查。

title: Mycelial Search: A Graph-Structured Metaheuristic for Continuous Optimisation
comment: Submitted to "Expert Systems With Applications"; 18 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. To facilitate reproducibility, the Python implementation of Mycelial Search (Myco) is publicly available on [GitHub](https://github.com/dehshibi/Mycelia-Search)
summary: Continuous optimisation methods need to balance sharing information and maintaining alternative search directions. In this paper, we introduce Mycelial Search (Myco), a graph-structured metaheuristic designed around active tips, community-weighted flow, adaptive cord plasticity, and anchor-based injection. Candidate solutions form an evolving spatial graph in which a Louvain partition distinguishes within-community from cross-community information exchange. Adaptive cord plasticity subsequently modifies active tip-to-tip edges according to their alignment with the local flow. An anchor-based injection mechanism supplements the graph-driven tip dynamics. We evaluated Myco on the CEC 2022 single-objective bound-constrained benchmark suite at dimensions $D=10$ and $D=20$, using 30 independent runs per algorithm-function pair. The comparison includes eleven established optimisers from several search families. Myco reaches competitive results on selected functions across both dimensions. The ablation analysis further shows that community structure regulates the range of graph-based information exchange, whereas cord plasticity controls the persistence of local directional influence. These findings indicate that graph-structured local interaction can support continuous optimisation, while its effectiveness depends on landscape structure and information transfer across local search regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mycelial Search (Myco)，一种基于图结构的元启发式连续优化算法，灵感源自菌丝网络。该算法通过活动尖端、社区加权流、自适应弦可塑性和锚点注入机制，在CEC 2022基准套件（D=10和D=20）上与11种既有优化器对比，在部分函数上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 连续优化方法需要在共享信息与维持替代搜索方向之间取得平衡，现有方法在这一权衡上仍有改进空间，图结构化的局部交互或能更好地调节信息交换范围。
AI.method: Myco将候选解构成为演化的空间图，通过Louvain社区检测区分社区内与跨社区信息交换；自适应弦塑性根据与局部流的对齐程度修改活动尖端间的边；锚点注入机制补充图驱动的尖端动力学。
AI.result: 在CEC 2022单目标有界约束基准套件的D=10和D=20维度下，与11种来自不同搜索家族的既有优化器比较，Myco在部分函数上达到有竞争力的结果。消融分析显示社区结构调节图信息交换范围，弦塑性控制局部方向性影响的持续性。
AI.conclusion: 图结构化的局部交互能够支持连续优化，但其有效性依赖于地貌结构和跨局部搜索区域的信息传递。

title: Randomized Strategyproof Facility Location: Two Facilities and Beyond
summary:
We design and analyze randomized strategyproof mechanisms for multi-facility location under the utilitarian social-cost objective, the sum of the agents' distances to their nearest facilities. For two facilities, the Pairwise-Distance mechanism locates facilities at a pair of reported locations sampled with probability proportional to their distance. It is strategyproof on Ptolemaic spaces, including Euclidean and Hilbert spaces as special cases, and has an approximation ratio of \(4\). The resulting Hybrid-Distance mechanism is a fixed-probability mixture: it selects the classical Proportional mechanism [Lu et al., EC'10] with probability \(λ^*=\frac{5+4\sqrt3}{23}\) and Pairwise-Distance with probability $1-λ^*$. It is strategyproof on Ptolemaic spaces and has a tight approximation ratio of \(\frac{74+4\sqrt3}{23}\approx3.5186\), breaking the long-standing factor-\(4\) benchmark of [Lu et al., EC'10].
  We complement the two-facility results by studying more facilities. First, for \(n\) agents and \(k=n-1\) facilities, we introduce the Inverse-Square mechanism, which omits one report with probability proportional to the inverse square of its nearest-neighbor distance and locates facilities at all remaining reports. It is strategyproof on any metric space and has an approximation ratio of \(Θ(\sqrt{n})\), improving the previous best-known ratio of \(\frac{n}{2}\) [Escoffier et al., ADT'11]. Second, for $k$ facilities on the line, we introduce the Gap-Product mechanism, which locates facilities at \(k\) reports and weights each set by the product of the gaps between consecutive selected reports. When \(k=3\), it is strategyproof and has a \(6\)-approximation, replacing the previous \(n\)-dependent guarantee [Fotakis and Tzamos, EC'13] by a constant, whereas it is not strategyproof for any \(k\ge4\).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多设施选址问题中的随机策略证明机制。对于两个设施，提出了Pairwise-Distance机制（在Ptolemaic空间上策略证明，近似比为4）和Hybrid-Distance机制（混合Proportional与Pairwise-Distance，策略证明且紧近似比为约3.5186，突破了长期以来的4倍基准）。对于更多设施，提出了Inverse-Square机制（n个代理k=n-1个设施时，任意度量空间策略证明，近似比为Θ(√n)）和Gap-Product机制（直线上k=3个设施时策略证明且6-近似，但k≥4时不策略证明）。
AI.motivation: 多设施选址问题是在社会选择与算法博弈论中的核心问题，目标是最小化社会福利（代理到最近设施的距离之和）。在策略证明约束下设计近似机制长期是一个开放难题，尤其是两设施情形下4倍的近似比基准已多年未被突破，且多设施情形下的近似比往往依赖于代理数量n，无法给出常数保证。
AI.method: 1) Pairwise-Distance机制：以两报告点距离为概率权重采样一对报告位置作为设施位置。2) Hybrid-Distance机制：以固定概率λ*选择Proportional机制、以1-λ*选择Pairwise-Distance机制的混合。3) Inverse-Square机制：以报告与其最近邻距离平方的倒数为概率省略一个报告，其余报告作为设施。4) Gap-Product机制：选择k个报告并将每个集合以连续报告间间隔乘积为权重的概率机制。
AI.result: 两设施：Pairwise-Distance在Ptolemaic空间上策略证明且4-近似；Hybrid-Distance在Ptolemaic空间上策略证明且紧近似比为(74+4√3)/23≈3.5186，突破长期4倍基准。多设施：Inverse-Square机制在任意度量空间策略证明且Θ(√n)-近似，改进此前n/2的最优结果；Gap-Product机制在k=3时策略证明且6-近似（将n依赖改进为常数），但对k≥4不策略证明。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过设计新的随机策略证明机制，在两设施情形下首次打破了4倍近似比的长期瓶颈，并在多设施情形下给出了改进的近似保证（Inverse-Square在n-1个设施情形下显著优于之前；Gap-Product为3个设施提供常数近似）。同时揭示了Ptolemaic空间这一更一般的空间类别上的策略证明性质，并为k≥4时的策略证明性建立了不可能结果。

title: SACHA: Semantic-Aware Compression for 3D Gaussian Head Avatars
summary: Animatable 3D Gaussian head avatars offer high-fidelity and flexible facial rendering, but typically require substantial storage and transmission costs for numerous Gaussian primitives. Existing Gaussian head avatar methods overlook the visual saliency of different head semantic regions for more appropriate Gaussian primitive allocation, as well as the efficient compression of trained head avatar sequences. To tackle this obstacle, we propose SACHA, a dynamic head avatar compression framework that leverages both semantic-aware density control and appearance-motion decomposition to achieve compact representation and high-quality novel-view rendering of head avatar sequences. Specifically, the semantic-aware density control guides the adaptive allocation of Gaussian primitives across different head regions with region-adaptive densification and pruning. In addition, the appearance-motion decomposed compression further reduces the temporal redundancy of the avatar sequence by transmitting only head-prior parameters for avatar movements. Together, these designs enable a compact representation for efficient transmission of dynamic Gaussian head avatars while preserving visual fidelity. Experiments demonstrate that SACHA achieves a superior rate-distortion performance over existing Gaussian head avatar representation and compression methods while maintaining high-quality novel-view and novel-expression rendering.

AI.tldr: SACHA是一个动态头部化身高斯压缩框架，通过语义感知密度控制和外观-运动分解实现紧凑表达，在保持高保真渲染的同时显著降低存储和传输成本。
AI.motivation: 现有可动化3D高斯头部化身虽能提供高保真渲染，但需要大量存储和传输成本；已有方法忽视了不同头部语义区域在视觉显著性上的差异，导致高斯基元分配不合理，且缺乏对已训练头部化身序列的高效压缩手段。
AI.method: 1) 语义感知密度控制：根据头部不同语义区域的自适应显著度进行高斯基元的稠密化和剪枝；2) 外观-运动分解压缩：仅传输头部先验参数用于化身运动，减少序列的时间冗余。
AI.result: 实验表明SACHA在率失真性能上优于现有的高斯头部化身表示及压缩方法，同时保持高质量的novel-view和novel-expression渲染。
AI.conclusion: SACHA通过语义感知的基元分配和外观-运动分解压缩，成功实现了动态高斯头部化身的紧凑表示与高效传输，在压缩率和视觉保真度之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Revisiting N2DCG: An Empirically Grounded Reformulation of Carousel Recommendation Evaluation
summary:
Carousel interfaces have been widely used in video and music streaming services, yet it remains unclear how to properly evaluate recommender systems in these two-dimensional layouts. N2DCG has been proposed to address this gap by adapting NDCG to carousel-based recommendation, but it relies on unverified assumptions borrowed from the single-list web-search setting that do not transfer well to two-dimensional carousel layouts.
  We identify two substantial limitations of N2DCG: its ideal ranking, used for normalization, violates carousel constraints, and its discount function does not reflect user browsing behavior observed in empirical data. To address both limitations, we propose a reformulation of N2DCG that normalizes appropriately by respecting constraints and uses an empirically grounded discount function. We validate the proposed metric, showing that it better reflects users' empirical behavior on real-world eye-tracking data and better predicts the comparison results of carousel layouts simulated based on empirical examination patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有用于评估轮播式推荐系统的指标N2DCG存在两个重大缺陷：归一化时使用的理想排序违反轮播约束，以及折扣函数未能反映真实的用户浏览行为。作者提出了一种重新表述的N2DCG指标，通过尊重约束条件进行适当的归一化，并使用基于经验数据的折扣函数，在真实眼动数据和模拟实验中验证了新指标更符合用户实际行为。
AI.motivation: 轮播式界面广泛应用于视频和音乐流媒体服务，但缺乏适合这种二维布局的推荐系统评估指标。现有的N2DCG虽然被提出用于此目的，但它的假设源自单列表的网页搜索场景，无法有效迁移到二维轮播布局中，导致评估结果可能失真。
AI.method: 作者首先识别出N2DCG的两个关键局限：(1)用于归一化的理想排序违反了轮播界面的约束条件；(2)折扣函数没有反映实证数据中观察到的用户浏览行为。针对这两个问题，作者重新表述了N2DCG：通过尊重轮播约束进行合理的归一化，并采用基于实证数据的折扣函数。
AI.result: 通过真实世界眼动数据验证，新提出的指标能更好地反映用户的实证浏览行为；在基于实证检查模式模拟的轮播布局对比实验中，新指标也能更准确地预测布局方案的比较结果。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出的重新表述的N2DCG指标克服了原有指标在轮播布局中的根本缺陷，为二维推荐界面的评估提供了更可靠和更有经验依据的度量标准。

title: On the Role of Citations in Preference Data
summary: Many NLP tasks require systems to provide attribution in their outputs--i.e. citations to grounding sources. Attribution serves as a bulwark against model hallucination and as a means for users to verify the credibility of model outputs. Yet, it is unclear how humans and LLMs evaluate citations when comparing outputs, a process central to reward modeling and modern LLM post-training. This paper studies the role of citations in the preferences of human judges and four open-source LLMs within the context of scientific question answering, leveraging mixed effects models to investigate the influence of citations on pairwise judgments. Among our key findings are (1) that humans prefer more diverse citations but fewer overall, and (2) that LLMs show some citation-related preferences compared to humans, despite lacking access to the sources, but these preferences depend on the data and specific models. We further discuss the implications of our findings for preference data collection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了引用（citations）在人类和LLM评判科学问答输出时扮演的角色，通过混合效应模型分析成对评判中引用的影响。主要发现包括：人类偏好更多样化但总数更少的引用；LLM尽管无法访问来源，仍表现出与引用相关的偏好，但这些偏好依赖于数据具体内容和模型。
AI.motivation: 许多NLP任务要求系统在输出中提供引用来源以对抗幻觉并帮助用户验证可信度，但人类和LLM在比较输出时如何评估引用尚不清晰，而这对于奖励建模和LLM后训练至关重要。
AI.method: 在科学问答情境下，收集人类评审员和四种开源LLM对输出的成对判断，利用混合效应模型（mixed effects models）分析引用对判断偏好的影响。
AI.result: (1) 人类偏好引用更多样化但总数更少的输出；(2) LLM表现出与人类不同且依赖于数据与特定模型的引用相关偏好，尽管它们无法访问引用来源。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果对偏好数据收集实践具有重要启示，强调了理解引用在评判中作用对奖励建模和LLM后训练的关键意义。

title: AI Visual Inspection for Garment Production
summary:
The garment manufacturing industry is under increasing pressure to improve product quality, reduce costs, and accelerate digital transformation toward Industry 4.0. One of the most challenging quality-control activities is sewing-line inspection, where defects such as broken stitches and skipped stitches are difficult to detect consistently through manual inspection. Human-based inspection is often affected by fatigue, subjective judgement, and inconsistent performance, resulting in defect leakage, rework, and reduced production efficiency.
  This study presents the development and validation of an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based visual inspection system for garment sewing-line quality control. The system utilizes Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to detect sewing defects and was initially trained using black fabric and black sewing thread samples. Experimental testing was conducted on black, red, dark green, light blue, silver, and fluorescent yellow fabrics. The results demonstrated successful detection of jump sewing-line defects on black, red, and dark green materials, while performance limitations were observed for broken sewing-line defects and fabrics with significantly different visual characteristics, including light blue, silver, and fluorescent yellow colours. These findings indicate that model accuracy is strongly influenced by the diversity of training data and the ability to generalize across different fabric and thread colours.
