Finally, we show why scope and budget enforcement cannot be delegated to system prompts: prompts do not constrain what actually executes. Inspectra, our implemented platform, serves as a worked instantiation, with mechanisms labelled shipped, partial, or planned, including those that did not work.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对十个常用安全工具的手动评估，系统化了智能体安全（Agentic Security）系统在实际部署中反复出现的操作失败模式，引入了四维集成摩擦指数，并推导出若干定量规律，解释了长期会话证据丢失、两级裁决级联、不可评估结果偏差、模型路由、以及无法通过系统提示词委派预算执行等问题。作者还通过实现平台 Inspectra 作为工作实例，标注了各机制的实现状态。
AI.motivation: 智能体安全系统正从演示走向产品部署，但实践者反复遭遇相同的操作失败。这些失败缺乏系统性整理和定量解释，阻碍了该领域的可靠工程化进展。
AI.method: 对十个涵盖静态、动态、云、编排和AI红队工具进行实际操作评估，用于无人值守流水线。引入四维集成摩擦指数（Integration Friction Index）区分一次性工程成本与经常性组织、法律和运维成本。将智能体安全系统建模为随机LLM策略包裹在确定性中介器中，推导出定量规律，包括证据保留、裁决级联似然比、不可评估结果偏差、路由的背包问题建模与闭式执行上限，以及系统提示词无法约束实际执行的问题。通过实现平台 Inspectra 验证。
AI.result: 推导出多个定量规律：长期会话的证据随阶段数丢失，而短期子智能体根据原始证据与摘要的压缩比延长可用时间；两阶段裁决级联可以倍增打分者似然比，但在打分者错误相关时收益甚微；将不可评估结果当作攻击失败会向规避性和严重响应方向偏置下游测量；规划者-工作者模型路由可建模为背包问题，重尾工具的执行上限为闭式解 eta* = alpha v/c；系统提示词无法强制执行范围和预算限制。
AI.conclusion: 智能体安全系统的操作失败不是偶发事件，而是可以用定量规律系统化描述的结构性问题。这些规律为设计更可靠的智能体安全架构提供了理论基础，Inspectra 平台作为实证实例展示了哪些机制有效、哪些机制部分有效、哪些机制无效。

title: WorldMind: Decoupled Game World Model for State-Aware NPC Behavior
summary: Game world models have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in generating visually coherent and action-controllable gameplay videos. However, non-player character (NPC) behavior in existing models is either implicitly entangled with video generation or explicitly prescribed through external control signals. Consequently, a game world model has to jointly understand the state, plan the NPC's response and render its visual outcome, limiting its ability to produce responsive and state-aware NPC behavior. The challenge lies in the lack of an explicit interface for state-grounded decision-making. To this end, we introduce WorldMind, to our knowledge the first decoupled framework for state-aware NPC behavior in game world models. WorldMind separates interactive world modeling into four layers: an Understanding Layer that constructs a compact state from generated frames; a Decision Layer that reasons over the compact state to plan the NPC's next action; a Control Layer that translates the actions into temporally aligned conditions; and a Generation Layer that synthesizes their visual outcomes. By reconnecting layers in a closed interaction loop, WorldMind grounds NPC behavior in the evolving game state. We further introduce BOSS-140K, a dataset of gameplay videos paired with rich internal game states, together with an agent that automates the collection at scale. Experiments on BOSS-140K demonstrate reliable compact state reconstruction and mechanics-grounded planning, with WorldMind preferred over the baselines in approximately 70% of pairwise comparisons for its more tactically appropriate and coherent NPC behavior. Project page: https://teawhite.cn/worldmind_projectpage/

AI.tldr: WorldMind是首个将游戏世界模型中的NPC行为进行解耦建模的框架，通过四层架构（理解层、决策层、控制层、生成层）将NPC行为锚定在显式的游戏状态上，并配套发布了BOSS-140K数据集用于规模化收集与验证。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏世界模型中NPC行为要么与视频生成隐式纠缠在一起，要么依赖外部控制信号显式规定，缺乏显式的状态基决策接口，导致模型难以生成响应式且状态感知的NPC行为。
AI.method: 将交互式世界建模解耦为四层：理解层从生成帧构建紧凑状态；决策层基于紧凑状态推理NPC下一步动作；控制层将动作转化为时间对齐的条件；生成层合成视觉结果。四层通过闭环交互循环重新连接，使NPC行为基于动态游戏状态。同时提出BOSS-140K数据集及自动化收集agent。
AI.result: 在BOSS-140K上验证了可靠的紧凑状态重建与机制感知的规划能力，WorldMind在约70%的成对比较中因战术更合适、行为更连贯而被偏好。
AI.conclusion: WorldMind通过显式解耦NPC状态感知决策与视频生成，为游戏世界模型中的NPC行为提供了可解释、可交互的新范式，并提供了大规模数据支撑。

title: ChemDIRT: A Diversified Instruction, Representation, and Task Benchmark for Robust Chemistry-LLM Evaluation
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has led to increasing interest in their application to scientific domains such as chemistry. However, existing chemistry benchmarks often provide only a narrow view of model capability, focusing on limited task sets while overlooking robustness to variations in problem formulation and chemical representation. As a result, reported performance may overestimate a model's true ability to reason consistently across realistic settings. To address this challenge, we introduce ChemDIRT (Diversified Instruction, Representation, and Task Benchmark), a comprehensive evaluation framework designed to assess the robustness of chemical reasoning in LLMs. ChemDIRT systematically measures model performance across variations in instructions and molecular representations while spanning eight categories of chemistry tasks. By evaluating both accuracy and consistency under these controlled perturbations, ChemDIRT provides a more reliable assessment of model reasoning capabilities than conventional single-format benchmarks. We benchmark a diverse set of open- and closed-source LLMs, revealing substantial prompt sensitivity, representation dependence, and uneven performance across task families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ChemDIRT（Diversified Instruction, Representation, and Task Benchmark），一个全面的化学推理评估框架，系统性地衡量LLM在不同指令、不同分子表示以及八类化学任务下的鲁棒性，通过准确率和一致性双重指标提供比传统单一格式基准更可靠的评估。
AI.motivation: 现有化学基准测试往往只覆盖有限的任务集，且忽视了对问题表述（instruction）和化学表示方式（如SMILES、IUPAC等）变化的鲁棒性考量，导致报告的模型性能可能高估了其在真实场景下的推理一致性能力。
AI.method: 构建ChemDIRT基准框架：(1) 系统性地引入指令变化和分子表示变化的受控扰动；(2) 覆盖八个类别的化学任务；(3) 同时评估模型的准确率和一致性，以提供更可靠的推理能力评估。
AI.result: 对多种开源和闭源LLM进行基准测试，发现模型存在显著的提示敏感性（prompt sensitivity）、表示依赖性（representation dependence），以及不同任务族之间性能不均衡的现象。
AI.conclusion: ChemDIRT表明传统单一格式基准可能高估LLM的化学推理能力，模型对指令和表示变化的鲁棒性不足，提示未来需要更全面的评估协议来真实反映模型能力。

title: Spyre-Accelerated Retrieval-Augmented Generation on IBM LinuxONE: A Cloud-Native Architecture for Secure, High-Throughput Enterprise AI Inference
summary:
Running large language models inside enterprise environments has always bumped up against a practical wall: the data lives in one place, the AI horsepower sits somewhere else, and moving sensitive records between the two creates real headaches around latency, security, and regulatory exposure. IBM's Spyre accelerator PCIe inference card built for LinuxONE and the broader IBM Z family changes that equation.
  In this paper we lay out a six-subsystem RAG architecture that runs entirely on IBM LinuxONE, using Spyre for generative inference, the Telum II on-chip accelerator for lightweight classification tasks, and Red Hat OpenShift for container orchestration. Every piece of the pipeline from query intake through vector retrieval, prompt assembly, LLM inference, compliance filtering, and response delivery stays within a single LinuxONE system, so sensitive data never has to leave the hardware perimeter.
  We walk through the design choices behind each subsystem, dig into the Spyre compilation and serving stack, explain how LinuxONE's Secure Execution technology extends confidential-computing guarantees to AI workloads, and benchmark the architecture against cloud-GPU and on-premises alternatives. Early analysis points to end-to-end RAG latencies under two seconds and up to a 20x reduction compared to off-platform inference, all while keeping the strong encryption and auditability posture that regulated industries actually need.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个完全运行在IBM LinuxONE上的六子系统RAG架构，利用Spyre PCIe推理卡进行生成式推理、Telum II芯片加速器处理轻量级分类任务、Red Hat OpenShift进行容器编排，确保敏感数据始终不离开硬件边界。该架构实现了端到端RAG延迟低于2秒，相比平台外推理最高可降低20倍延迟，同时保持监管行业所需的强加密和可审计性。
AI.motivation: 在企业环境中运行大型语言模型面临实际障碍：数据与AI算力分离，在两者之间移动敏感记录会产生延迟、安全和合规风险。传统的云端GPU方案无法满足监管严格行业的本地数据驻留要求。
AI.method: 设计了一个六子系统RAG架构，完全部署在单个IBM LinuxONE系统上：查询接收、向量检索、提示词组装、LLM推理、合规过滤和响应交付。利用Spyre PCIe推理卡进行生成推理，Telum II片上加速器处理轻量分类任务，OpenShift负责容器编排，并通过LinuxONE Secure Execution技术将机密计算保障扩展到AI工作负载。论文详述了各子系统的设计选择、Spyre编译与serving栈，并与云GPU和本地替代方案进行了基准对比。
AI.result: 早期分析表明该架构实现端到端RAG延迟低于2秒，与平台外推理相比延迟降低最高达20倍，同时保持了强加密和可审计性，满足监管行业的需求。
AI.conclusion: 通过将整个AI工作流（从推理到合规）整合在单台LinuxONE机器内，该方案有效解决了企业LLM部署中的数据驻留、安全和延迟问题，为受监管行业提供了一种可行的本地AI推理替代方案。

title: LLM-Enhanced Commit Message Generation via Issue Information: An Exploratory Study
comment: 28 pages, 7 images, 11 tables, Manuscript submitted to a journal (2026)
summary: Commit messages help developers understand code changes, support collaboration, and improve long-term maintenance. However, the use of issue information alone as the external context for LLM-based CMG has not been systematically studied. We propose an ISsue-Augmented framework for Commit message generation (ISAC) by combining code diffs with issue information as LLM input. To support the evaluation, we construct ApacheCM-Issue, a commit-issue aligned dataset built upon ApacheCM by linking commits with issues from GitHub and Apache Jira. Using samples from Scala, Java, and C++ projects, we evaluate four input configurations using two representative LLMs, GPT-5.5 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash in different reasoning configurations. The results show that incorporating issue information consistently improves LLM-based CMG across all evaluated model configurations and metrics, with the largest gains observed for CIDEr. Incorporating a similar historical commit further improves automatic metric scores, while replacing full issue information with a structured issue summary decreases them. ISAC also outperforms the four reproduced state-of-the-art (SOTA) CMG baselines across all five automatic metrics on the experimental dataset. The human evaluation further shows that structured issue summaries may improve perceived completeness, although replacing the original issue information can sacrifice contextual details and lead to worse results on automatic metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ISAC框架，将issue信息与代码diff结合作为LLM输入用于commit message生成，并构建了ApacheCM-Issue数据集进行评估，实验表明引入issue信息能稳定提升LLM-based CMG性能。
AI.motivation: 以往关于LLM-based commit message生成（CMG）的研究中，外部上下文的利用大多聚焦于代码diff本身，而单独使用issue信息作为外部上下文的系统性研究尚属空白。作者希望填补这一研究空缺，探究issue信息对LLM生成commit message的贡献。
AI.method: 提出ISAC（ISsue-Augmented框架），将代码diff与issue信息拼接作为LLM输入；构建ApacheCM-Issue数据集，将ApacheCM中的提交与GitHub和Apache Jira上的issue进行链接；使用Scala、Java、C++项目的样本，评估四种输入配置，采用GPT-5.5和DeepSeek-V4-Flash两个LLM在不同推理配置下进行实验，并与四个SOTA基线及人工评估对比。
AI.result: 引入issue信息在所有模型配置和指标上均一致提升CMG性能，CIDEr指标提升最大；加入相似历史提交可进一步提升自动指标；用结构化issue摘要替换完整issue信息反而导致指标下降。ISAC在五个自动指标上均优于四个SOTA基线。人工评估显示结构化issue摘要可提升感知完整性，但会牺牲上下文细节。
AI.conclusion: issue信息是LLM-based CMG中有效且重要的外部上下文，ISAC框架能显著提升commit message生成质量；但完整issue信息与结构化摘要之间存在权衡——后者提升完整性感知，前者保留更丰富上下文细节，自动指标更优。

title: Query-Driven Multimodal Information Extraction from Long Documents
summary: In domain-specific multimodal long documents, images and text jointly convey complex knowledge that cannot be fully captured by plain text alone. However, existing paradigms like DocVQA primarily focus on generating textual answers or localizing evidence regions, rather than outputting query-specific textual attribute values and corresponding images. To address this gap, we propose query-driven image-text joint extraction from long documents, requiring models to output query-requested textual attribute values and corresponding image bounding boxes. Based on challenges related to both user intent and document content, we designed a two-level taxonomy that operates at the query and instance levels. Further, we construct ITJoint, the first high-quality, manually annotated benchmark for this new task, comprising 2,455 pages of domain-specific documents with numerous non-decorative images, 316 queries, and 910 answer instances. Finally, we evaluate representative standalone Vision-Language Models from different providers and further design Q2IT, a multi-agent collaborative framework consisting of three progressively collaborating agents for evidence collection, page selection, and target-image localization. Using a joint evaluation approach that assesses both text extraction and image localization, our experiments show that standalone VLMs struggle with this task, while Q2IT significantly improves performance on ITJoint, although a substantial gap remains toward perfect results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的任务——查询驱动的图像-文本联合抽取（query-driven image-text joint extraction），即在长文档中根据查询同时输出文本属性值和对应的图像边界框。作者构建了首个手动标注的高质量基准数据集ITJoint（2455页、316个查询、910个答案实例），并设计了Q2IT多智能体协作框架（包括证据收集、页面选择和目标图像定位三个渐进协作的智能体）。实验表明独立VLM在此任务上表现不佳，而Q2IT显著提升了性能，但仍与完美结果存在差距。
AI.motivation: 现有范式（如DocVQA）主要聚焦于生成文本答案或定位证据区域，无法同时输出查询所需的文本属性值和对应图像。在领域特定的多模态长文档中，图像和文本共同承载复杂知识，仅靠纯文本无法完整捕捉，因此需要新的任务定义和方法来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 1) 定义新的查询驱动的图像-文本联合抽取任务；2) 设计基于用户意图和文档内容的两级分类体系（查询级和实例级）；3) 构建ITJoint基准数据集（2455页领域特定文档、316个查询、910个答案实例）；4) 设计Q2IT多智能体协作框架，包含证据收集、页面选择、目标图像定位三个渐进协作的智能体；5) 采用联合评估方法同时评估文本提取和图像定位效果。
AI.result: 实验使用联合评估方法显示：独立VLM在此任务上表现不佳，无法有效完成文本和图像的联合抽取；Q2IT框架在ITJoint上显著提升了性能；但即使使用Q2IT，与完美结果之间仍存在较大差距，表明该任务仍有很大的改进空间。
AI.conclusion: 查询驱动的图像-文本联合抽取是文档理解中一个富有挑战性的新任务，多智能体协作框架Q2IT证明了其有效性，但当前VLM能力仍不足以完美解决该任务，未来需要更强大的模型和更精细的协作机制来进一步缩小与理想结果的差距。

title: GRAFT: Graph-Distilled Generative Retrieval for Facet-Aware Scientific Literature Exploration
summary: Scientific papers may relate by problem, method, result, or contribution, but document-level retrievers collapse these into a single similarity score without saying why they are related. Citation- and similarity-based retrieval alone also confines search to the neighbourhood of what is already known, whereas generative retrieval generates document identifiers directly, enabling the exploratory retrieval that scientific discovery depends on. We connect papers in a graph whose edges are typed by these four facets, derived from facet items and citation signals, and distil it into a generative retriever whose identifiers are the papers' own facet text. Two graph properties do not survive naive distillation. First, because every training pair is an edge, naive enumeration indexes just 84% of the corpus. Coverage-aware distillation makes every paper learnable through a reverse-neighbour fallback, a minimum-coverage threshold, and edge-importance weighting. Second, constrained decoding guarantees that every generated identifier is a valid paper, but not that the graph connects it to the query. Graph-weighted reciprocal rank fusion scales each candidate's rank term by its query-candidate edge weight, dropping unsupported ones. On LitWeave, our constructed corpus of 11,359 NLP papers, Graft recovers 91% of its graph teacher's Recall@20 with no nearest-neighbour index or encoder at inference, and outperforms the graph teacher on query papers outside the corpus. It reproduces the graph's own facet labels at 0.922 precision, so every returned paper arrives labelled with the facet that surfaced it rather than an opaque score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Graft方法，将科学论文之间的四种关系（问题、方法、结果、贡献）构建为带类型标签的图，并通过生成式检索器直接生成论文自身的方面文本作为标识符。通过覆盖感知蒸馏和图加权倒数排名融合两个技术，解决了朴素蒸馏导致的语料覆盖不足和生成标识符与查询无图连接的问题。在LitWeave（11,359篇NLP论文）上，Graft无需最近邻索引或编码器即可恢复图教师Recall@20的91%，且在语料外查询上优于图教师。
AI.motivation: 现有文档级检索器将论文关系压缩为单一相似度分数，无法解释论文为何相关；基于引文和相似度的检索局限于已知邻域，限制探索性检索。生成式检索虽能直接生成标识符支持探索，但缺乏对论文间细粒度关系（问题、方法、结果、贡献）的建模。
AI.method: 1) 构建带四类方面边的论文图（源自方面项与引文信号）；2) 覆盖感知蒸馏：通过反邻回退、最小覆盖阈值和边重要性加权使每篇论文都可学习；3) 图加权倒数排名融合：按查询-候选边权重缩放每个候选的排名项，丢弃无图支撑的候选项；标识符为论文自身的方面文本。
AI.result: 在LitWeave语料上，Graft恢复图教师Recall@20的91%，推理时无需最近邻索引或编码器；在语料外查询上优于图教师；方面标签复现精度达0.922，每个返回论文均带有触发它的方面标签而非不透明分数。
AI.conclusion: Graft证明了将论文关系图蒸馏为生成式检索器的可行性，既保留了检索结果的方面可解释性，又支持探索性检索，且不依赖语料内最近邻索引，在语料外查询上更具泛化能力。

title: CyrillicQA: The Influence of Phonetically Encoded Secret Language on LLM Performance
comment: 4 pages, in English; 4 pages, in German (original); German version originally published in: Rüdian, S. (2026). Prompt-Engineering in Education (1st ed., pp. 39-42). Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21413892
summary: Due to the selection of their training data, large language models (LLMs) perform best on standard-language inputs from languages using the Latin alphabet with large speaker populations, while disadvantaging other language varieties. Nevertheless, they can also be a versatile tool for preserving precisely such endangered languages. But do they also possess the necessary creativity and capacity for abstraction to decode phonetically encoded language the same way humans do?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理非标准语言变体（尤其是濒危语言）时的能力局限，并提出疑问：LLMs是否具备像人类一样解码语音编码语言所需的创造力和抽象能力。
AI.motivation: 由于训练数据的偏差，LLMs在标准拉丁字母、大语种人口的语言上表现最佳，而忽视了其他语言变体。然而LLMs同时可能成为保护濒危语言的工具，因此需要评估其在这方面的实际能力。
AI.method: 本文属于观点/问题提出型论文，目前仅提出核心研究问题，即评估LLMs是否具备与人类相当的解码语音编码语言的创造力和抽象能力，尚未展示具体方法。
AI.result: 该摘要未提供具体实验结果，尚处于提出问题阶段。
AI.conclusion: 指出LLMs在语言多样性方面的训练偏差问题，同时提出关键研究问题：LLMs能否像人类一样通过创造力和抽象能力解码语音编码语言，为后续研究奠定方向。

title: Text-Guided Visual Dependency Graph Learning with Cross-Modal Attention Priors
summary: Estimating interpretable conditional-dependence structures from multimodal visual-linguistic features remains largely unexplored. We propose CM-GLasso (Cross-Modal Graphical Lasso), a framework that bridges vision-language representation learning and sparse Gaussian Graphical Models. CM-GLasso introduces three key components: (i) a text visualization strategy that renders class-attribute descriptions as images and processes them through the same SigLIP-2 vision encoder as natural images, yielding prototype-indexed patch-level attention footprints in a shared feature coordinate system; (ii) a cross-attention distillation mechanism that condenses high-dimensional patches into a small set of semantic graph nodes, whose attention-footprint similarities yield cross-modal structural priors for non-uniform L1 penalization; (iii) a joint ADMM formulation that estimates shared and class-specific precision components within a single convex objective, avoiding the need to first estimate and then decompose separate class-wise graphs. The learned sparse graph topologies directly support a parameter-free, precision-based classification rule and a lightweight topology-aware segmentation head. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate that CM-GLasso achieves competitive or superior performance compared with strong feature-based and task-specific baselines. Under the matched controlled protocol, it attains the highest average classification accuracy (91.97%) and the highest segmentation mIoU among the controlled baselines on VOC (74.75%) and ADE20K (64.01%), while also yielding explicit sparse conditional-dependence graphs with common-specific decomposition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CM-GLasso框架，将视觉-语言表示学习与稀疏高斯图模型相结合，用于估计可解释的跨模态条件依赖结构。通过文本可视化、跨注意力蒸馏和联合ADMM优化，同时估计共享与类别专属的精度矩阵，在八个基准上达到竞争性或更优的分类与分割性能。
AI.motivation: 从多模态视觉-语言特征中估计可解释的条件依赖结构这一方向尚未被充分探索，现有方法缺乏将视觉与语言特征统一在共享坐标体系中进行图结构建模的手段。
AI.method: CM-GLasso包含三个核心组件：(i)文本可视化策略，将类别-属性描述渲染为图像并通过SigLIP-2视觉编码器处理，生成原型索引的patch级注意力足迹；(ii)跨注意力蒸馏机制，将高维patch压缩为少量语义图节点，通过注意力足迹相似度构建非均匀L1惩罚的跨模态结构先验；(iii)联合ADMM公式，在单一凸目标中估计共享与类别专属的精度分量，并通过稀疏图拓扑支持无参数分类规则和轻量级拓扑感知分割头。
AI.result: 在八个基准上的大量实验表明，CM-GLasso相比强特征基线和任务特定基线具有竞争性或更优性能。在受控匹配协议下取得最高平均分类准确率(91.97%)，并在VOC(74.75%)和ADE20K(64.01%)上取得最高分割mIoU，同时生成具有公共-专属分解的显式稀疏条件依赖图。
AI.conclusion: CM-GLasso成功将图模型结构先验注入视觉-语言多模态学习，在提升分类与分割性能的同时提供可解释的稀疏图结构，验证了跨模态条件依赖建模的实用价值。

title: Multimodal Injury Risk and Performance Prediction in Tennis Using Weighted Ensemble Learning
comment: 8 pages. Accepted author manuscript. Published as Early Access in IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Magazine
summary: Machine learning has had a positive impact on the sports industry, with one of its most promising applications being the prediction of athlete performance and injury risk. Recent advances have employed state-of-the-art models to improve prediction accuracy, yet progress remains limited by data availability and the reliance on subjective observations or expert assessments. To address these limitations, researchers in sports such as soccer, basketball, and wrestling have begun integrating heterogeneous data sources, such as wearable device readings, with traditional subjective assessments. However, similar multimodal approaches remain underexplored in tennis. In this work, we propose a multimodal weighted ensemble learning framework, Predictive Athlete Readiness for Tennis (PART), to monitor athlete wellness and estimate near-term injury risk in tennis players. PART processes a wide range of inputs, including physiological metrics, training and match data, sleep information from wearable devices, self-reported questionnaires, vertical jump assessments, and motion analysis from match-play videos. From these modalities, specialized machine learning and deep learning models independently extract four athlete-specific characteristics: overall wellness, injury risk, physical capability, and playing style. To overcome the complexity of combining these diverse modalities, PART employs a supervised weighted ensemble integration strategy, assigning adaptive weights to each predictive model based on its reliability. Evaluation of multimodal data collected from nine collegiate tennis players demonstrates that PART achieves strong performance in monitoring athlete wellness and estimating near-term injury susceptibility. Beyond collegiate athletes, the framework also shows promise for recreational tennis players, offering personalized insights to mitigate injury risk and optimize performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PART框架，一个多模态加权集成学习框架，用于监测网球运动员健康状况并预测短期受伤风险。PART整合生理指标、训练与比赛数据、可穿戴设备睡眠信息、自我报告问卷、垂直跳跃评估和比赛视频动作分析等多源数据，通过专门的机器学习和深度学习模型提取四项运动员特征（整体健康、受伤风险、身体能力、比赛风格），并采用监督加权集成策略自适应分配各模型权重。在9名大学网球运动员的多模态数据评估中表现优异，并有望推广至业余网球运动员。
AI.motivation: 现有运动员表现与受伤风险预测方法受限于数据可用性以及依赖主观观察或专家评估。虽然足球、篮球和摔跤等领域已开始整合可穿戴设备等多源异构数据，但网球领域的多模态方法仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出PART（Predictive Athlete Readiness for Tennis）多模态加权集成学习框架。处理多种输入模态（生理指标、训练与比赛数据、可穿戴睡眠数据、问卷、垂直跳跃、视频动作分析），各模态由专门的机器学习/深度学习模型独立提取四项运动员特征；随后采用监督加权集成策略，根据各预测模型可靠性自适应分配权重进行融合。
AI.result: 在9名大学网球运动员的多模态数据评估中，PART在监测运动员健康状态和估计短期受伤风险方面实现了强性能；框架对业余网球运动员同样展现出应用前景。
AI.conclusion: PART证明多模态集成方法能有效克服单一数据源限制，为网球运动员提供个性化的受伤风险缓解和表现优化洞察，填补了网球领域多模态运动员监测的研究空白，并具有向更广泛人群推广的潜力。

title: Hate Speech Classification In Roman Urdu: A Comparative Study On Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning And Prompt Engineering
summary: Due to the widespread accessibility of the internet and social media, toxic and hateful con-tent has grown exponentially, causing significant distress and negative societal impacts. Ro-man Urdu, a low-resource language used in Pakistan and among Urdu-speaking communities worldwide, presents additional challenges because of its informal grammar, inconsistent sen-tence structures, and multiple variations in word spellings. This research aims to identify the most effective techniques for hate speech classification in such low-resource settings with limited data. To address this, the study investigates and compares the latest approaches, in-cluding prompt tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using LoRA, and prompt en-gineering, under various experimental configurations. To achieve this objective, four exper-iments were designed. The first experiment involved direct inferencing with LLMs without any fine-tuning, to evaluate how well these models understand Roman Urdu in a zero-shot setting, especially given limited data. The second experiment utilized parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) with LoRA, which updates only a small subset of parameters, thereby reducing computational cost. The third experiment explored prompt tuning with both mixed and manually crafted prompts, using very small sets of training examples relative to the entire dataset, making it computationally efficient as well. Finally, the fourth experiment applied prompt engineering through zero-shot and few-shot learning, relying solely on care-fully designed instruction prompts for classification without further training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究罗马乌尔都语（一种低资源语言）中的仇恨言论分类问题，比较了三种最新技术：提示微调、基于LoRA的参数高效微调（PEFT）和提示工程，通过四个实验在有限数据条件下评估各方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 互联网和社交媒体上有毒和仇恨内容急剧增长，造成严重的社会负面影响。罗马乌尔都语作为一种低资源语言，存在非正式语法、不一致的句子结构和多种拼写变体，使得仇恨言论检测更具挑战性。研究旨在在有限数据条件下找出最有效的仇恨言论分类技术。
AI.method: 设计了四个实验：(1) 直接使用LLM进行零样本推理，评估模型对罗马乌尔都语的理解能力；(2) 使用LoRA进行参数高效微调（PEFT），仅更新少量参数以降低计算成本；(3) 提示调优（prompt tuning），使用混合和人工制作的提示，配合极少量训练样本；(4) 提示工程，通过零样本和少样本学习，仅依赖精心设计的指令提示进行分类。
AI.result: 论文比较了提示调优、基于LoRA的PEFT和提示工程三种方法在罗马乌尔都语仇恨言论分类中的表现，评估了它们在低资源、有限数据场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为低资源语言（特别是罗马乌尔都语）的仇恨言论分类提供了系统性的方法比较，旨在确定最有效的技术方案，以在计算成本和分类性能之间取得最佳平衡。

title: W-RAG: Source-Aware Retrieval for Enterprise Document Generation from Heterogeneous Knowledge Bases
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables large language models to incorporate external knowledge during generation, improving factual grounding and domain adaptability. However, existing RAG pipelines assume that evidence retrieved from multiple repositories can be ranked globally using a single similarity function. While suitable for open-domain retrieval, this assumption breaks down in enterprise document generation, where heterogeneous knowledge bases (such as policies, regulations, technical documentation, and departmental guidelines) serve distinct roles and must be jointly represented in the generated document. As a result, global ranking often produces unbalanced context dominated by a subset of sources, leading to incomplete enterprise drafts. To address this limitation, we propose W-RAG, a source-aware retrieval framework that performs ontology-guided retrieval, local ranking within each knowledge base, and source-level weighting to regulate evidence composition. We further introduce a new dataset for retrieval-grounded enterprise document generation spanning multiple document types and industry domains. Experiments show that standard RAG pipelines struggle on this task, while W-RAG significantly improves document coverage and generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出W-RAG，一个源感知的检索增强生成框架，通过本体引导检索、知识库内局部排序和源级加权来调节证据组成，解决企业文档生成中异构知识库全局排序导致的上下文不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG管线假设多源检索到的证据可以用单一相似度函数进行全局排序，这种假设在开放域检索中有效，但在企业文档生成场景中失效。企业异构知识库（政策、法规、技术文档、部门指南）各自扮演不同角色，需要共同呈现在生成文档中，而全局排序会导致上下文被少数来源主导，产生不完整的企业草稿。
AI.method: W-RAG框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 本体引导检索（ontology-guided retrieval），利用本体知识指导检索过程；(2) 每个知识库内的局部排序（local ranking within each knowledge base）；(3) 源级加权（source-level weighting）来调节证据组成比例。同时作者构建了一个新的检索导向企业文档生成数据集，涵盖多种文档类型和行业领域。
AI.result: 实验表明标准RAG管线在该任务上表现不佳，而W-RAG显著提升了文档覆盖率和生成质量。
AI.conclusion: W-RAG证明在异构知识源的企业文档生成场景中，源感知的检索策略（而非全局统一排序）是必要的，能有效改善上下文平衡性和最终文档质量。

title: Beyond What Meets the Eye: Unveiling Situational Illusions for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Real-world situation appearances can deviate from their underlying physical states, challenging the reliability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in practical applications. In this paper, we term this phenomenon situational illusions and investigate: (1) how MLLMs perform under such illusions, and (2) how to mitigate the limitations. We first develop a comprehensive where-what-how taxonomy that characterizes where situational illusions occur, what targets they take, and how they arise. Building on this taxonomy, we introduce MSIBench, a benchmark designed to assess the discrimination, understanding, and reasoning capabilities of MLLMs under situational illusions. Evaluations of 27 model configurations reveal that current MLLMs are highly vulnerable to these illusions and exhibit 6 typical failure modes related to visual observation, grounding, and reasoning. To mitigate the limitations, we build on the core idea of systematically inspecting and reasoning over visual evidence for contextual understanding, developing prompting for closed-source models and supervised fine-tuning for open-source models, respectively. These two simple yet effective methods improve model performances by 20% at most, suggesting a practical path toward more reliable multimodal perception and reasoning in complex real-world environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"情境错觉"（situational illusions）概念，指现实世界外观与物理状态偏离的现象，并构建了where-what-how分类体系及MSIBench基准来评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在此类错觉下的表现，发现27种模型配置易受其影响并呈现6种典型失败模式，随后通过提示工程和监督微调两种方法将性能提升最多20%。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的情境外观可能与底层物理状态不一致，这严重挑战了多模态大语言模型在实际应用中的可靠性，但该问题此前未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出情境错觉概念，构建where-what-how分类体系刻画错觉的发生位置、目标和成因；基于此开发MSIBench基准评估模型的判别、理解和推理能力；并基于系统检查与推理视觉证据的核心思想，分别为闭源模型开发提示方法、为开源模型开发监督微调方法。
AI.result: 评估27种模型配置发现当前MLLMs对情境错觉高度脆弱，呈现6种与视觉观察、grounding和推理相关的典型失败模式；提出的两种方法最多提升20%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 系统性检查和推理视觉证据是提升MLLMs在复杂真实环境中多模态感知和推理可靠性的实用路径。

title: FashionKG-RAG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Fashion Question Answering
summary: Fashion is a knowledge-intensive domain in which effective decision-making depends on integrating multiple types of knowledge. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed many areas, their application in fashion remains limited by hallucinations and weak domain specialization. Knowledge Graph (KG)-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) offers a promising way to add structured knowledge to LLMs. However, existing fashion KGs are typically restricted to product-level attributes or item relations, and fail to capture the broader fashion ecosystem. To bridge these gaps, we propose \textbf{FashionEcoKG}, a comprehensive, domain-wide knowledge graph built with expert-level precision and professionalism. It is constructed through a three-stage agentic pipeline that extracts high-fidelity knowledge cores from authoritative textbooks and strengthens structural connectivity through cross-domain augmentation and generative expansion. To leverage this resource, we further develop \textbf{PG-RAG} (Pruning-Grounding RAG), a training-free framework designed to handle the conceptual density and linguistic noise of fashion queries. Specifically, we introduce a Dual-Granularity Path Re-Ranking (DGPR) module of two stages. The Pruning-based Semantic Ranking (PSR) module distills each query into a skeleton form to improve retrieval recall, while the Grounding-based Agentic Ranking (GAR) performs point-wise scrutiny of candidate paths against the original full query to ensure global relevance. Experiments on a curated fashion QA dataset show that PG-RAG effectively leverages FashionEcoKG to improve retrieval and answer accuracy, outperforming both non-RAG and existing KG-RAG baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FashionEcoKG，一个面向时尚领域的全面知识图谱，通过三阶段智能体流水线从权威教材中提取知识并增强结构连通性；同时提出PG-RAG（剪枝-接地RAG）框架，包含双粒度路径重排序模块（PSR和GAR），在时尚QA数据集上超越非RAG和现有KG-RAG基线。
AI.motivation: 时尚是知识密集型领域，LLM在该领域的应用受限于幻觉和领域专业化不足。现有时尚知识图谱仅限于产品级属性或物品关系，无法捕捉更广泛的时尚生态系统，缺乏全面的领域知识支撑。
AI.method: 1) 构建FashionEcoKG：通过三阶段智能体流水线（提取高保真知识核心、跨域增强、生成扩展）从权威教材构建全领域知识图谱。2) 提出PG-RAG框架：包含Dual-Granularity Path Re-Ranking (DGPR)模块，其中PSR模块将查询提炼为骨架形式提升检索召回率，GAR模块基于原始完整查询对候选路径进行逐点审查确保全局相关性。
AI.result: 在精心策划的时尚QA数据集上，PG-RAG有效利用FashionEcoKG提升了检索和答案准确率，性能超越非RAG和现有KG-RAG基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建全面的时尚知识图谱和设计无需训练即可处理时尚查询概念密集性和语言噪声的RAG框架，有效提升了LLM在时尚领域的检索和问答能力，验证了KG-RAG在垂直领域应用中的潜力。

title: Forgotten in Weights, Recovered by Tools: Agentic Tool Unlearning for LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented agents, where responses can depend on tool calls and external observations rather than model parameters alone. This creates an evaluation mismatch for LLM unlearning: previous unlearning methods may suppress direct parametric recall, but an agent can still recover the same forget target through tools such as web search, retrieval, or database lookup. We identify this failure mode as tool-mediated recovery and study agentic tool unlearning, which aims to reduce both parametric recall and tool-mediated recovery while preserving normal tool use for retained knowledge. To address this challenge, we propose Agentic Tool Unlearning (ATU), a two-stage framework. The first stage applies parametric knowledge unlearning to suppress direct recall, while the second stage performs trajectory-level reinforcement learning in simulated tool-augmented environments to penalize target-seeking tool behavior and final-answer leakage. Experiments on RWKU and MUSE across different LLM architectures show that ATU achieves a better balance between target forgetting and retained utility, making unlearning more robust under tool-augmented agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic Tool Unlearning (ATU)框架，解决大语言模型作为工具增强智能体时的遗忘失效问题——即传统遗忘方法只能压制参数化直接回忆，但智能体仍可通过工具调用恢复遗忘目标。ATU采用两阶段方法：第一阶段参数知识遗忘压制直接回忆，第二阶段在模拟工具环境中进行轨迹级强化学习，惩罚目标搜索行为和最终答案泄露。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地作为工具增强智能体部署，响应依赖于工具调用和外部观察而非仅模型参数。这导致LLM遗忘评估存在错位：传统遗忘方法可能抑制直接参数回忆，但智能体仍可通过网页搜索、检索或数据库查询等工具恢复遗忘目标，即"工具中介恢复"（tool-mediated recovery）失败模式。
AI.method: 提出ATU两阶段框架：(1) 第一阶段应用参数知识遗忘以抑制直接回忆；(2) 第二阶段在模拟工具增强环境中进行轨迹级强化学习，惩罚目标搜寻型工具行为和最终答案泄露，同时保留正常工具使用能力以维持保留知识的实用性。
AI.result: 在RWKU和MUSE基准上跨不同LLM架构的实验表明，ATU在目标遗忘和保留实用性之间取得了更好的平衡，使遗忘在工具增强智能体部署下更加稳健。
AI.conclusion: ATU有效解决了工具增强场景下的遗忘失效问题，证明遗忘不仅要考虑参数层面，还需考虑智能体通过工具调用间接恢复遗忘目标的能力，为LLM遗忘研究在代理部署场景下提供了更全面的解决方案。

title: ViTexSZ: Heterogeneous Vision-Text Knowledge Distillation for EEG Seizure Detection
summary: Automated seizure detection from electroencephalography (EEG) is essential for continuous neurological monitoring, particularly for subclinical epileptic seizures that may exhibit only subtle electrographic changes. Existing time-series methods are often designed for fixed EEG channel configurations, thereby limiting their applicability to heterogeneous EEG recordings with irregular channel layouts. Although visual and language modeling offer promising alternatives, aligning heterogeneous EEG representations with clinical semantics remains challenging. We introduce ViTexSZ, a heterogeneous Vision-Text knowledge distillation framework for EEG seizure detection. ViTexSZ converts EEG recordings into structured waveform images and introduces a query-based multi-channel alignment module that maps source-dependent visual features into a unified token space. A heterogeneous teacher further integrates the aligned EEG representations with clinical prompts through a multimodal large language model, associating high-level clinical semantics with seizure-related evidence. Vision-text knowledge distillation then transfers the teacher representations to a lightweight student during detection. Experiments on four EEG seizure datasets demonstrate the generalizability of ViTexSZ across both subclinical and general seizure detection scenarios, achieving the highest accuracy on all datasets and relative improvements of up to 12.9% over the second-best baselines, showing its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: ViTexSZ是一种异构视觉-文本知识蒸馏框架，用于EEG癫痫发作检测。它将EEG信号转化为结构化的波形图像，通过查询多通道对齐模块将源相关的视觉特征映射到统一令牌空间，并利用多模态大语言模型作为异构教师将对齐的EEG表征与临床提示词整合，最后通过视觉-文本知识蒸馏将教师知识迁移到轻量级学生模型中。在四个EEG癫痫数据集上取得了最高准确率，相对基线最高提升12.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG癫痫检测时间序列方法通常针对固定通道配置设计，难以适用于异构且通道布局不规则的EEG记录。虽然视觉和语言模型提供了替代方案，但将异构EEG表征与临床语义对齐仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 1) 将EEG记录转换为结构化波形图像；2) 引入基于查询的多通道对齐模块，将源相关的视觉特征映射到统一令牌空间；3) 通过多模态大语言模型作为异构教师，将对齐的EEG表征与临床提示词整合；4) 通过视觉-文本知识蒸馏将教师表征迁移至轻量级学生模型。
AI.result: 在四个EEG癫痫数据集上，ViTexSZ在临床下和一般癫痫检测场景中均表现出良好泛化性，在所有数据集上取得最高准确率，相对第二名基线方法最高提升12.9%。
AI.conclusion: ViTexSZ通过视觉-文本知识蒸馏框架有效解决了异构EEG通道配置下的癫痫检测问题，展现了对不同临床场景的通用性和有效性，验证了利用视觉与大语言模型结合进行EEG分析的潜力。

title: Federated Continual Learning as a Distributed Drift-Plus-Penalty Control Problem
comment: Accepted at 5th Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents, 2026
summary: Federated Continual Learning (FCL) is fundamental to real-world distributed learning systems, requiring models to adapt to sequential, non-IID data across clients while mitigating catastrophic forgetting and client drift. Existing approaches formulate continual learning (CL) as a sequence of per-task optimization problems, applied locally at each client and coupled through aggregation, using heuristic mechanisms such as replay, regularization, or projection-based constraints. However, forgetting in FCL is inherently a long-term, distributed phenomenon, arising from the interaction of temporal task evolution and cross-client heterogeneity, which is not explicitly regulated. In this work, we cast FCL as a stochastic control problem and propose Federated Queue-regulated Continual Learning (FedQCL), a framework based on Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty (DPP) optimization. FedQCL introduces virtual queues to track the accumulation of forgetting across tasks and clients, enabling explicit control of the stability-plasticity trade-off. By optimizing a DPP objective, the method jointly improves current-task performance while the queue-based formulation provides an interpretable and tunable mechanism to balance adaptation and retention through a single parameter, without requiring gradient projection or additional communication overhead. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks, including Split-CIFAR-10, Split-CIFAR-100, and Split-TinyImageNet, demonstrate that FedQCL outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with respect to accuracy while significantly reducing forgetting under heterogeneous data distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedQCL框架，将联邦持续学习(FCL)建模为随机控制问题，利用Lyapunov漂移加惩罚(DPP)优化和虚拟队列来显式追踪并控制遗忘的累积，通过单一参数平衡稳定性和可塑性，无需梯度投影或额外通信开销，在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有FCL方法将持续学习视为每任务局部优化与聚合耦合的序列问题，采用回放、正则化或投影约束等启发式机制，但遗忘本质上是长期分布式的现象，源于时间任务演化与跨客户端异质性的交互，现有方法缺乏对这一过程的显式调控。
AI.method: 将FCL建模为随机控制问题，提出基于Lyapunov漂移加惩罚(DPP)优化的FedQCL框架。引入虚拟队列追踪任务和客户端间遗忘的累积，通过优化DPP目标函数联合提升当前任务性能，队列机制通过单一参数提供可解释、可调的稳定性-可塑性平衡机制。
AI.result: 在Split-CIFAR-10、Split-CIFAR-100和Split-TinyImageNet基准上，FedQCL在异构数据分布下相比SOTA基线在准确率上表现更优，同时显著降低遗忘。
AI.conclusion: FedQCL通过将遗忘明确建模为可控制的队列状态，提供了一种无需梯度投影或额外通信开销的FCL新范式，实现了更好的准确率与遗忘控制之间的平衡。

title: The Abstention Protocol: RCA for Clos Fabrics
comment: Presented at Usenix OSDI 2026. 17 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables
summary:
Root cause analysis (RCA) in large datacenter networks is challenging because telemetry is noisy, partial, and asynchronous. Score-based approaches degrade under these conditions, often yielding unstable or incorrect attributions.
  We present \textsc{CoreSec}, a production RCA system that replaces weighted fusion with a PAM-style abstention algebra. Telemetry agents are composed using control flags that yield deterministic decisions and explicit abstention when evidence is ambiguous. CoreSec combines this algebra with topology-aware configurations that capture failure surfaces across Clos fabrics and converge monotonically as evidence accumulates.
  Deployed at hyperscale, CoreSec provides stable and explainable RCA behavior across diverse environments without retuning. Our experience shows that structured composition with abstention forms a practical foundation for automated RCA in real-world cloud networks.

AI.tldr: CoreSec是一个用于大规模数据中心网络的根因分析（RCA）生产系统，用PAM风格的弃权代数（abstention algebra）替代加权融合方法，通过确定性决策和显式弃权处理嘈杂、局部的遥测数据，并已在超大规模实际部署中验证。
AI.motivation: 数据中心网络中的RCA极具挑战性，因为遥测数据存在噪声、不完整和异步问题。传统的基于打分（score-based）的方法在这些条件下性能退化，常常产生不稳定或错误的归因结果。
AI.method: CoreSec采用PAM风格的弃权代数（abstention algebra）替代加权融合。具体包括：1) 使用控制标志组合遥测代理，产生确定性决策并在证据不明确时显式弃权；2) 结合拓扑感知配置，覆盖Clos架构中的故障面，并随证据积累单调收敛。
AI.result: 在超大规模环境中部署，CoreSec在多样化环境中无需重新调参即可提供稳定且可解释的RCA行为。
AI.conclusion: 结构化组合与弃权（abstention）机制构成了现实世界云网络中自动化RCA的实用基础。

title: Constraint-Driven Modeling Enabling Dual Model Checking and Simulation for Discrete Event Systems
summary: Verification and validation (V&V) are crucial methods for evaluating the requirements and specifications of dynamical models that fulfill their intended purposes. Parallel Discrete EVent System Specification (PDEVS) is a system-theoretic modeling approach for creating modular, hierarchical component-based simulation models. In this paper, we introduce Constraint-DEVS, a method for creating bounded Parallel DEVS models that lend themselves, in addition to simulation, to model checking. We extend the DEVS-Suite framework to create Constraint-DEVS specifications which can then be model checked using a proposed state exploration protocol with the Parallel DEVS abstract simulator protocol. These capabilities, along with the support for non-determinism, complex data transfer, and performance-related property checking, make Constraint-DEVS and its accompanying DEVS-Suite a unique framework for the development, verification, and validation of discrete-event systems. In order to demonstrate this work, we developed and verified models of Network-on-Chip. Also, we detail behavioral design artifacts for the DEVS-Suite framework's hybrid model-checking and simulation engine.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Constraint-DEVS方法，用于创建有界的Parallel DEVS模型，使其不仅能用于仿真，还能进行模型检验。作者扩展了DEVS-Suite框架以生成可模型检验的规范，并提出基于Parallel DEVS抽象模拟器协议的状态探索协议。通过Network-on-Chip模型验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 验证与确认（V&V）对于评估动态模型是否满足其预期目的至关重要。然而，Parallel DEVS模型通常主要用于仿真，缺乏系统性的模型检验能力，需要一种方法使模型既能仿真又能进行形式化验证。
AI.method: 1) 提出Constraint-DEVS方法，创建有界的Parallel DEVS模型；2) 扩展DEVS-Suite框架用于生成Constraint-DEVS规范；3) 提出基于Parallel DEVS抽象模拟器协议的状态探索协议进行模型检验；4) 支持非确定性、复杂数据传输及性能相关属性检查。
AI.result: 开发并验证了Network-on-Chip模型来证明该方法的可行性；该框架成为集开发、验证和确认离散事件系统于一体的独特方案。
AI.conclusion: Constraint-DEVS及其DEVS-Suite框架为离散事件系统的仿真与模型检验提供了统一的混合引擎，显著增强了V&V能力，但框架的混合模型检验与仿真引擎的行为设计工件需要进一步详细说明。

title: Rethinking Item Tokenization in Generative Recommenders: From Fixed Atoms to Semantic Subwords
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to CIKM 2026
summary:
In generative recommender systems, items are typically tokenized into fixed-length semantic ID sequences for autoregressive next-item prediction. However, for user-context modeling, this fine-grained representation triggers Intra-item Attention Overload: excessive attention is spent on low-level intra-item dependencies rather than high-level inter-item behavioral transitions.
  To address this, we propose Semantic Subword Tokenization (SST), which represents historical items as variable-length semantic subwords while preserving fixed-length target decoding. SST first applies Item-level Subword Tokenization (IST) to merge stable adjacent atom tokens into compact semantic subword tokens, thereby reducing intra-item reassembly in the encoder. It then introduces Behavior-induced Co-occurrence Augmentation (BCA) to inject coarse-grained semantic prefix transition signals, guiding the freed modeling capacity toward inter-item behavioral regularities. Extensive experiments on three public datasets and three generative recommender backbones show empirical improvements of SST over fixed-length and transferable variable-length SID baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/mxrcandy/Semantic-Subword-Tokenization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义子词分词（SST）方法，用于解决生成式推荐系统中项目细粒度语义ID表示导致的"项目内注意力过载"问题，通过项目级子词分词和基于行为共现增强来提升项目间行为转换建模能力。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐系统将项目分词为固定长度的语义ID序列进行自回归预测，但这种细粒度表示在用户上下文建模中会导致过多注意力花费在低层项目内依赖上，而非高层项目间行为转换，即"项目内注意力过载"问题。
AI.method: 提出语义子词分词（SST）方法，包含两部分：(1) 项目级子词分词（IST），将稳定的相邻原子token合并为紧凑的语义子词token，减少编码器中的项目内重组；(2) 行为诱导共现增强（BCA），注入粗粒度语义前缀转换信号，引导释放的建模能力关注项目间行为规律。SST保持可变长度语义子词表示历史项目，同时保留固定长度目标解码。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集和三个生成式推荐骨干网络上进行的大量实验表明，SST相比固定长度和可迁移可变长度SID基线均有经验性改进。
AI.conclusion: SST通过语义子词分词有效缓解了项目内注意力过载问题，将建模能力引导至项目间行为规律，在多个数据集和骨干网络上验证了其有效性。

title: Automating Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via TRIAD: From Context Extraction to Validated Dataset Generation
comment: Accepted at the 19th International Natural Language Generation Conference (INLG 2026)
summary: Recent advances in LLMs and the adoption of RAG systems in industry have created a need for domain-specific question-answer datasets that can assess RAG performance on proprietary data. Existing datasets, such as HotpotQA, challenge current RAG systems on Wikipedia-based knowledge, but they cannot be transferred directly to domain-specific settings. A comprehensive evaluation of RAG system quality requires both multi-hop queries and unanswerable questions. This paper introduces TRIAD, a three-stage automated dataset generation approach. First, it generates question--answer (QA) pairs for the domain-specific knowledge base of a RAG system. Second, a validator checks each QA-pair in a feedback loop. Third, the QA pairs are extended with relevance-labeled context documents for downstream evaluation. We evaluate this approach against the established MuSiQue and HotpotQA datasets. The results show that the generated dataset exhibits similar performance trends across different RAG setups, while human validation indicates that the questions are suitable for evaluating a domain-specific RAG system. The code used to generate the dataset and all validation results are available in our GitHub repository(https://github.com/lorenzbrehme/triad).

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRIAD，一种三阶段的自动化数据集生成方法，用于为领域特定的RAG系统生成QA数据集，包括QA对生成、验证器反馈循环和相关性标签上下文文档扩展，并通过与MuSiQue和HotpotQA的对比评估验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG评估数据集（如HotpotQA）基于Wikipedia知识，无法直接迁移到领域特定的专有数据场景中。行业需要能够评估RAG系统在专有数据上性能的领域特定QA数据集，且需同时涵盖多跳查询和不可回答问题的全面评估需求。
AI.method: TRIAD采用三阶段自动化方法：（1）为RAG系统的领域特定知识库生成QA对；（2）使用验证器在反馈循环中检查每个QA对的质量；（3）为QA对扩展带有相关性标签的上下文文档，以支持下游评估。
AI.result: 与MuSiQue和HotpotQA的对比评估表明，生成的数据集在不同RAG设置下表现出相似的性能趋势；人工验证确认生成的问答对适合评估领域特定RAG系统。
AI.conclusion: TRIAD成功解决了领域特定RAG评估数据集缺乏的问题，提供了一种自动化、可验证的数据集生成框架，并开源了代码和验证结果供社区使用。

title: BIMScript: Material-Aware Structured Scene Programs for BIM Ingestion
comment: Project Page: see https://bimscriptworld.github.io/BIMScript/ ; to be published in ECCV 2026 TwinWorld Workshop
summary: Structured-language models such as SceneScript reconstruct a scene as a short program of parametric commands, an inherently editable and semantically explicit representation. We ask three questions that stand between such models and their most compelling application, automated ingestion of existing buildings into BIM tools, studied here on synthetic scans: \emph{what} is the scene made of, \emph{how fast} can it be produced, and \emph{exactly where} is each element. BIMScript answers all three within one grammar. First, we extend the layout language with per-element \emph{material} and \emph{condition} attributes, supervised by a vision-language-model material-passport corpus we build over 100k synthetic scenes (1.9M pseudo-labeled elements), and route image appearance to the material tokens through a lifted-feature point encoder. Second, we show that autoregressive decoding of these programs is dominated not by compute but by kernel-launch and host-synchronization overhead, and remove it with an output-exact CUDA-graph decoder (1.9 vs 6.4\,ms/step, $3.4\times$) plus a grammar-parallel, tolerance-verified draft-and-verify scheme that exploits the deterministic entity schema. Third, we address the model's 5cm token-grid granularity with training-free geometric snapping and a hybrid discrete--continuous decoder head that regresses a sub-bin offset, and measure how much of the residual error each recovers. Because each command maps one-to-one onto a native Revit object, we validate direct ingestion into a BIM authoring tool end to end with a working add-in and its IFC4 export, and the same program's language form is designed to support LLM-driven, sustainability-aware reasoning over the built asset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BIMScript，一个统一的场景结构化语言模型，通过单一语法同时回答三个问题：场景由什么构成（材料与条件属性）、生成速度（CUDA图解码器+草稿-验证机制提速3.4倍）、元素精确位置（训练无关的几何吸附+混合离散连续解码头）。该模型可将合成扫描直接端到端导入BIM工具（Revit插件及IFC4导出验证）。
AI.motivation: 结构化语言模型（如SceneScript）将场景表示为可编辑且语义明确的命令程序，但其最具吸引力的应用——将现有建筑自动导入BIM工具——仍受三个关键问题制约：场景元素构成识别、生成速度、元素定位精度。作者旨在用一个统一语法解决这三方面挑战。
AI.method: 1) 扩展布局语言，为每个元素添加材料和条件属性，并通过VLM构建10万合成场景（190万伪标签元素）的材料护照语料库，用提升特征点编码器将图像外观路由到材料token；2) 识别自回归解码瓶颈为kernel启动和主机同步开销，通过输出精确的CUDA图解码器（1.9 vs 6.4 ms/步，提速3.4倍）及语法并行、公差验证的草稿-验证方案消除；3) 针对5cm token网格粒度，采用训练无关的几何吸附和混合离散-连续解码头（回归子bin偏移）来恢复残余误差。
AI.result: CUDA图解码器将每步延迟从6.4ms降至1.9ms（3.4倍加速）；几何吸附和混合解码头分别恢复部分残余定位误差；每个命令一对一同构到原生Revit对象，通过可工作的插件及IFC4导出实现了端到端直接导入BIM创作工具的验证。
AI.conclusion: BIMScript证明一个统一语法可同时解决结构化场景生成中的构成识别、速度和精度三大问题，并支持直接导入BIM工具及基于LLM的可持续性推理，为自动化建筑信息建模提供了可行路径。

title: Beyond Sparse Weights: When Is Attention Compressible?
summary: KV-cache compression is often justified by attention maps with a few large weights. This is incomplete: large weights may not contain most of the mass, omitted values can cancel, and preserving the attention output may not preserve the task. We separate these questions. Global score gaps -- not threshold counts -- determine how many tokens are needed to retain a target mass. For a realized row, the weighted sum of omitted values is the exact missing statistic. A controlled retrieval--aggregation model explains when truncation helps and when it hurts. These results motivate CertKV, a training-free compressor that reserves one tail-summary slot per head and allocates the rest by value dispersion. Under matched budgets, CertKV is top-two in seven of nine LongBench-v2 settings, remains in the leading compressed tier on 128K RULER, and realizes a ten-fold cache budget in a packed Llama prototype. Compressibility depends on the mass, values, future queries, and task -- not on a sparse-looking map alone.

AI.tldr: 本文指出KV缓存压缩的常见动机（注意力图少量大权重）是不完整的，提出考虑全局分数差距、省略值加权和等新视角，并设计训练免的压缩器CertKV，在LongBench-v2和RULER等多个基准上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩研究常以注意力图中少数大权重作为依据，但这种稀疏外观并不足以保证压缩有效——大权重可能不占质量主体、被省略的值可能相互抵消、保留注意力输出也不等于保留任务结果。作者希望厘清这些混淆的问题，建立更准确的压缩理论基础。
AI.method: 1) 分离三个问题：全局分数差距（非阈值计数）决定保留目标质量所需token数；对已实现的注意力行，省略值的加权和是精确的缺失统计量。2) 提出受控的检索-聚合模型来解释截断何时有利、何时有害。3) 据此设计CertKV：一个训练免的压缩器，每头保留一个尾部汇总槽，其余按值离散度分配。
AI.result: 在预算匹配条件下，CertKV在LongBench-v2九个设置中七个进入前二；在128K RULER上保持领先压缩档位；在打包Llama原型中实现十倍缓存预算的节省。
AI.conclusion: 可压缩性取决于质量、值、未来查询和任务——而不仅仅是有稀疏分布的注意力图。简言之，注意力图稀疏并不能单独决定压缩好坏，需要更全面的分析框架。

title: Retrieval-grounded robot program generation and simulation-based correction via Model Context Protocol
comment: Accepted by CIE53; to appear in the CIE53 Proceedings, Khalifa University, Abu Dhabi, UAE, October 20-23, 2026
summary: Flexible manufacturing requires industrial robots to be reprogrammed rapidly as product variants change. This paper presents a language-model-based workflow that generates, validates, and iteratively corrects ABB RAPID robot programs from natural language task descriptions. A dual-stream retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline grounds code generation in verified technical documentation and production templates, reducing domain-specific errors produced by ungrounded language models. A custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connects the language-model client directly to ABB RobotStudio for automated code upload, simulation execution, and diagnostic feedback. The evaluation combines a 30-query retrieval benchmark, scoped code-generation checks, and RobotStudio case studies in a simulated pickand- place manufacturing cell. The simulation loop exposes execution failures that static and semantic checks alone cannot catch, including suction release-height errors, unreachable placement targets, and configuration-dependent recovery motions. The results show how RAG and MCP can connect grounded code generation with executable feedback from industrial robot simulation software, while reducing but not eliminating expert setup and final supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于语言模型的工作流，能够从自然语言任务描述中生成、验证并迭代修正ABB RAPID机器人程序。通过双流检索增强生成（RAG）管道将代码生成锚定在已验证的技术文档和生产模板上，并通过自定义MCP服务器连接语言模型客户端与ABB RobotStudio，实现代码上传、仿真执行和诊断反馈的自动化闭环。
AI.motivation: 柔性制造要求工业机器人能够随产品变体快速重新编程，但传统编程方式耗时且需要专家介入。未锚定的语言模型在生成领域特定代码时容易产生错误，静态和语义检查又无法捕捉仿真执行中暴露的实际问题，需要一种将生成、验证和迭代修正结合的自动化工作流。
AI.method: 采用双流RAG管道，从技术文档和生产模板两个来源检索上下文以锚定代码生成；构建自定义MCP服务器连接语言模型客户端与ABB RobotStudio，支持自动化代码上传、仿真执行和诊断反馈；仿真循环用于暴露静态检查无法捕捉的执行失败（如吸盘释放高度错误、不可达放置目标、配置相关恢复运动）。
AI.result: 通过30个查询的检索基准、作用域代码生成检查和模拟拾放制造单元中的RobotStudio案例研究进行评估。仿真循环成功暴露了静态和语义检查无法发现的执行失败，验证了RAG和MCP在连接锚定代码生成与工业机器人仿真可执行反馈方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RAG和MCP能够将锚定的代码生成与工业机器人仿真软件的可执行反馈有效连接，减少但并未消除专家设置和最终监督的需求。该方法为柔性制造中基于语言模型快速重编程工业机器人提供了可行路径，但仍需人工干预以确保安全性和正确性。

title: Towards Actionable Visualization: Ten Years Later, What Generative AI Changes and What It Cannot
comment: 2026 IEEE Working Conference on Software Visualization (VISSOFT)
summary: Ten years ago, we surveyed software visualization research under the assumption that the challenge for adoption was matching developers' needs with techniques. Generative AI might have made that assumption obsolete by driving the cost of producing a visualization on demand toward zero. We argue that this mirrors a broader inversion already underway in software engineering: as AI devalues the production of artifacts, it elevates the human work of perceiving and directing them. Looking back at our 2016 research, we found that domains we flagged as neglected, such as rationale, are exactly the ones AI now makes tractable, and a tool-sustainability problem we diagnosed then is one generative AI may worsen before it helps solve. One finding shifted outright: the share of studies delivered through immersive environments grew roughly fifteen-fold, though it remains a small minority of the field. We argue that future research should focus on helping people understand large and complex software systems, including the reasoning processes generated by AI agents alongside the code itself. Humans have always been accountable for what they trust, but AI may lead them to trust without enough scrutiny. We confront the risks that follow, from the reliability of AI-generated visualization itself to the temptation of competing with machines on their own terrain, and conclude that actionable visualization is no longer a distant destination but a standard the field can now meet.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了十年前对软件可视化研究的调查，指出生成式AI正在颠覆软件工程的核心假设：AI使可视化按需生产的成本趋近于零，反而提升了人类感知和引导可视化工作的价值。文章发现十年前被忽视的领域（如rationale）如今因AI而变得可行，沉浸式环境的研究比例增长了约十五倍，并认为未来研究应聚焦于帮助人类理解大型复杂软件系统（包括AI代理的推理过程），同时警惕AI生成可视化的可靠性问题及人类过度信任AI的风险。
AI.motivation: 十年前作者假设软件可视化采纳的挑战在于将开发者需求与技术匹配，但生成式AI的出现可能使这一假设过时——可视化按需生成的成本趋近于零，迫使研究者重新审视软件可视化领域的核心问题和研究方向。
AI.method: 作者回顾并重新审视其2016年的软件可视化研究调查，将当年发现的问题与当前生成式AI环境进行对比分析，识别出领域变化趋势（如沉浸式环境增长十五倍）及被忽视但现在变得可行的研究领域。
AI.result: 发现十年前被标记为忽视的领域（如rationale）恰好是AI现在使其变得可行的地方；工具可持续性问题可能先被AI恶化后才能得到解决；沉浸式环境研究比例增长约十五倍，但仍占少数。
AI.conclusion: 未来研究应聚焦于帮助人类理解大型复杂软件系统，包括AI代理生成代码时的推理过程；必须正视AI生成可视化本身的可靠性问题，以及人类在AI时代可能过度信任而缺乏审视的风险；可操作的软件可视化不再是遥远目标，而是该领域当下即可达到的标准。

title: Results of the 1st Asynchronous CASTLE Challenge at the Joint Egocentric Vision Workshop in Conjunction with CVPR 2026
summary: This report summarizes the contributions and results of the 1st Asynchronous CASTLE Challenge at the Joint Egocentric Vision Workshop in conjunction with CVPR 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了CVPR 2026联合自我中心视觉研讨会上举办的第一届异步CASTLE挑战赛的贡献与结果。
AI.motivation: 该报告旨在总结和传播首届异步CASTLE挑战赛的成果，记录参赛方法的表现，并为自我中心视觉领域的研究社区提供参考基准。
AI.method: 作为挑战赛总结报告，主要涵盖赛事组织、参赛系统设计、评估协议和最终排名等内容，具体方法细节未在本摘要中展开。
AI.result: 报告呈现了挑战赛各参赛系统的最终结果和排名，验证了当前技术在异步自我中心视觉任务上的能力水平。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛为异步自我中心视觉任务建立了社区基准，推动了该方向的研究进展，并为未来工作提供了方向指引。

title: Risk-Aware Reranking for Agentic Tool Retrieval
summary: Tool retrieval determines which external tools are exposed to an LLM agent for a user query or task, making retrieval a critical pre-execution safety boundary. Unlike document retrieval, tool retrieval exposes executable actions: a tool that is useful for one task may be unnecessary or risky for another. However, existing tool-retrieval methods primarily optimize semantic relevance, and safety evaluations often focus on failures after tool execution rather than risks introduced during retrieval. We study risk-aware tool retrieval, where the goal is to retrieve useful tools while reducing exposure to higher-risk tools. We propose a lightweight reranking framework on top of a frozen first-stage retriever. The framework models query-conditioned relevance and tool-level exposure risk separately, combines them through an explicit parameter controlling the tradeoff between safety and utility, smooths scores over a ToolGraph, and optionally applies rule-based safety constraints. To support retrieval-time safety evaluation, we annotate 6,108 tools across UltraTool and Seal-Tools with five ordinal risk levels and define metrics that measure risky-tool exposure in the top-$k$ results. Experiments on UltraTool and Seal-Tools show that our approach improves the relevance--safety tradeoff over relevance-only retrievers and reranking baselines, with the rule-filtered variant providing a conservative operating point for safety-critical deployments. These findings indicate that retrieval-stage filtering can reduce the candidate action space exposed to agents before execution, complementing downstream tool-use safeguards. The code and supplementary materials are available at: https://github.com/qli447/risk-aware-tool-retrieval-release.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了风险感知的工具检索问题，提出一个轻量级重排序框架，在冻结的第一阶段检索器之上建模查询相关性和工具级暴露风险，通过显式参数控制安全与效用的权衡，并在ToolGraph上平滑分数，可选应用基于规则的约束。作者在UltraTool和Seal-Tools上标注了6108个工具的五级风险等级，实验证明该方法改善了相关性-安全性权衡。
AI.motivation: 与文档检索不同，工具检索会暴露可执行动作，对一个任务有用的工具对另一个任务可能不必要或有风险。现有工具检索方法主要优化语义相关性，而安全评估往往关注执行后的失败而非检索阶段引入的风险。因此需要研究风险感知的工具检索。
AI.method: 提出一个轻量级重排序框架，构建在冻结的第一阶段检索器之上。框架分别建模查询条件相关性和工具级暴露风险，通过显式参数组合二者以权衡安全性与效用，在ToolGraph上平滑分数，并可选应用基于规则的安全约束。同时标注了工具风险等级并定义衡量top-k结果中风险工具暴露的指标。
AI.result: 在UltraTool和Seal-Tools实验表明，该方法相比仅相关性检索器和重排序基线改善了相关性-安全性权衡，规则过滤变体为安全关键部署提供了保守运行点。检索阶段过滤可以在执行前减少暴露给智能体的候选动作空间。
AI.conclusion: 检索阶段的过滤能够减少智能体在执行前暴露的候选动作空间，补充下游工具使用安全机制，实现更安全的工具检索。

title: Evidence-State Reliability Under Controlled Degradation: Parser-Validity Divergence in a Multi-Stage LLM Pipeline
comment: 32 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/NaimurRahmanR/evidence-state-reliability
summary:
Multi-stage LLM pipelines can remain structurally valid even when evidence available to downstream stages becomes incomplete, compressed, or conflicting. This paper introduces and operationalizes Evidence-State Reliability (ESR), an evaluation layer concerned with whether intermediate evidence remains sufficiently complete, grounded, internally consistent, and usable for a stage's assigned function. ESR is evaluated separately from parser validity, which measures structural conformance.
  We evaluate the framework using GLM-5.2 on 60 sanitized base cases under four evidence conditions: clean, compressed-lossy, partial-dropout, and noisy-conflicting. Each condition was processed through decision, audit, and escalation stages. The design comprised 720 planned and ledgered calls, with 713 retained, sanitized execution rows.
  Across nine matched degraded-minus-clean condition-stage comparisons, all operational stage-success estimates were negative, and all 95% bootstrap intervals remained below zero. All nine parser-validity point estimates were positive, although the three partial-dropout intervals included zero. Among parser-valid degraded audit outputs, degradation detection was 1.0 in each degraded condition, while false-assurance rates remained non-zero; among parser-valid degraded escalation outputs, recovery was 0.0 in every degraded condition.
  The results show a bounded reliability-layer divergence in the evaluated pipeline: structural conformance can improve directionally while evidence-sensitive stage success deteriorates under the same controlled intervention. They also separate detection of degraded evidence from recovery. The conclusions are limited to the evaluated model configuration, pipeline design, selected sanitized cases, scoring procedure, and single scaled run.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并操作化了证据状态可靠性（ESR）评估层，用于评估多阶段LLM流水线中中间证据的完整性、接地性、一致性和可用性，与仅衡量结构符合性的解析器有效性分开评估。在GLM-5.2上对60个案例、四种证据条件（干净、压缩有损、部分丢失、噪声冲突）下进行了720次计划调用（保留713次），结果表明所有九项操作性阶段成功率估计均为负，而解析器有效性点估计均为正，显示结构符合性与证据敏感的阶段成功之间存在有界分歧。
AI.motivation: 多阶段LLM流水线即使下游阶段可用的证据变得不完整、压缩或冲突时，结构上仍可能保持有效，现有评估标准（解析器有效性）仅衡量结构符合性，无法捕捉中间证据质量退化对阶段功能的影响，因此需要引入一个独立的证据状态可靠性评估层。
AI.method: 引入ESR评估框架，将其作为与解析器有效性分离的评估层，衡量中间证据的完整性、接地性、内部一致性和可用性。使用GLM-5.2在60个消毒基础案例上，通过四种证据条件（干净、压缩有损、部分丢失、噪声冲突）和三种阶段（决策、审计、升级）进行受控实验，采用720次计划调用（保留713次执行行），并通过9对退化减干净的阶段比较和95%自助置信区间进行统计评估。
AI.result: 所有九项操作性阶段成功率估计均为负且95%自助区间低于零；所有九项解析器有效性点估计为正（三个部分丢失区间含零）；在解析器有效的退化审计输出中，退化检测率为1.0，但错误保证率非零；在解析器有效的退化升级输出中，恢复率为0.0。
AI.conclusion: 在评估的流水线中存在有界的可靠性层分歧：同一受控干预下，结构符合性可方向性改善而证据敏感的阶段成功率恶化。研究还区分了退化证据的检测与恢复。结论限于所评估的模型配置、流水线设计、选定消毒案例、评分程序和单次规模运行。

title: Beyond Visual Similarity: Entity-Aligned Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) relies on retrieving external information to answer queries involving long-tail entities. However, existing retrieval pipelines predominantly employ CLIP-style dual encoders, which prioritize surface-level visual similarity over entity-level semantic alignment. This paradigm often fails when semantically identical concepts exhibit large visual variations or when distinct entities appear visually similar. To address this, we propose KBMR, the first MLLM-based embedding retriever tailored for KB-VQA. Leveraging the robust autoregressive capabilities of MLLMs, KBMR maps images into a semantic space that better preserves concept identity. To tackle the challenge of noisy supervision in Wikipedia-scale retrieval, we introduce an MLLM-based semantic discriminator that generates continuous entity-consistency weights. These weights guide a novel continuous semantic distillation objective, enabling effective hard negative sampling and soft supervision beyond rigid binary labels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KBMR significantly outperforms CLIP baselines, yielding up to a 14.7% improvement in retrieval Recall@1 and a 9.4% gain in end-to-end VQA accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/realHarryX/KBMR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KBMR，首个面向知识库视觉问答（KB-VQA）的基于MLLM的嵌入检索器。通过利用MLLM的自回归能力将图像映射到能更好保持概念身份的语义空间，并引入MLLM语义判别器生成连续的实体一致性权重，指导连续语义蒸馏目标，实现有效的困难负样本采样和软监督。实验显示检索Recall@1提升14.7%，端到端VQA准确率提升9.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有KB-VQA检索管线主要采用CLIP风格的双编码器，优先考虑表面视觉相似性而非实体级语义对齐，当语义相同但视觉差异大或不同实体视觉相似时容易失败。需要一种能更好保持概念身份的检索方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出KBMR，首个基于MLLM的嵌入检索器，利用MLLM强大的自回归能力将图像映射到语义空间；2) 引入基于MLLM的语义判别器，生成连续的实体一致性权重；3) 提出连续的语义蒸馏目标，利用这些权重实现有效的困难负样本采样和超越二元标签的软监督。
AI.result: 大量实验表明KBMR显著优于CLIP基线，检索Recall@1提升达14.7%，端到端VQA准确率提升9.4%。
AI.conclusion: KBMR证明了MLLM作为嵌入检索器在KB-VQA中的有效性，为处理视觉变化大、实体外观相似等长尾实体检索挑战提供了新范式，代码已开源。

title: Loss-Parameterized Fisher Width Along Learning Trajectories

AI.tldr: 本文研究Fisher宽度（Fisher geometry变形后的探针集高斯宽度）沿学习轨迹的演化，探讨训练损失是否可作为该量的有效坐标。论文推导了精确的迹-形状分解和稳定性界，在总体高斯教师逻辑斯蒂模型中证明教师对齐态在损失低于log2的每个层级上极值化参数范数和Fisher宽度，并证明群体梯度流渐近选择该分支。在d≥2时给出Fisher宽度与损失平方根比值的极限公式。非线性MLP实验表明GD/SGD在匹配损失下接近，而Adam走不同分支，支持"分支式"而非"普适式"的损失参数化。
AI.motivation: 理解Fisher宽度沿学习轨迹的演化规律，探究训练损失能否作为描述Fisher宽度的有效坐标量。这一问题的意义在于，若损失可作为有效坐标，则可用损失值简洁地表征模型几何性质；但作者猜测真实情况可能是"分支式"（branchwise）的，即损失坐标仅在特定学习分支内有效。
AI.method: 1) 推导固定紧致探针集下Fisher宽度的精确迹-形状分解及确定性稳定性界；2) 在总体高斯教师逻辑斯蒂模型中分析教师对齐态的极值性质；3) 分析群体梯度流的渐近动力学，给出对齐与正交坐标的显式收敛速率；4) 在非线性MLP中采用对角模型Fisher近似，对比GD/SGD与Adam在匹配损失下的行为。
AI.result: 对于d≥2，得到极限关系式w_F(B_2^d;θ(t))/√L(θ(t))→(√6/π)E[χ_{d-1}]。全Fisher实验支持匹配损失分支与总体预测。非线性MLP中，GD与SGD在匹配损失下保持接近，Adam则走显著偏离的分支；固定探针的时间形状高度相似。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持Fisher宽度采用"分支式"而非"普适式"的损失参数化：即损失坐标仅在特定学习分支（如梯度流选择的分支）内部有效，不同优化器（如Adam）可能走向不同分支，因此不能用单一普适的损失函数来描述Fisher宽度的演化。

title: Composable Trust Infrastructure for Manufacturing Knowledge Graphs: Cross-System Provenance, Temporal Reasoning, and Decision Traceability
summary: Manufacturing knowledge graphs that integrate data from heterogeneous industrial systems face a trust deficit: consumers cannot determine whether queried data is valid, whether it was valid when a decision was made, where it originated, or how it was acted upon. We argue that four trust capabilities -- SHACL validation, PROV-O provenance, domain-aware bi-temporal versioning, and graph-native decision objects -- compose through shared correlation identifiers to produce emergent trust properties that no single capability delivers alone. We present a composable trust infrastructure that integrates these four capabilities into a unified RDF architecture. Capabilities compose through shared entity URIs, ingestion activity identifiers, and temporal correlation keys, enabling compound queries spanning all four dimensions. An experimental ablation confirms that removing any single capability causes exactly three of six composition queries to fail, demonstrating that all four are equally load-bearing. Analysis of higher-order compositions reveals four emergent three-way properties and one irreducible four-way property (full-chain auditability, 31ms execution). The infrastructure is validated on a testbed integrating eleven industrial sources -- OPC UA, TIA Portal, eClass, AAS, ISA-95, ISA-18.2, SAP S/4HANA, Teamcenter, Opcenter EX, Insights Hub, and SCM -- under an 89-class ISA-95-aligned ontology. The unified graph contains 8,743 triples across five named graphs, stitched by 81 owl:sameAs identity edges. Evaluation uses simulated but structurally realistic data from purpose-built emulators; data structures and cross-system linkage patterns are representative of real industrial installations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可组合的信任基础设施，通过将SHACL验证、PROV-O溯源、领域感知的双时态版本控制和图原生决策对象四种能力，以共享相关标识符组合到统一的RDF架构中，解决工业知识图谱的信任赤字问题。消融实验表明四种能力同等关键，组合查询揭示了涌现性质，并在集成11个工业数据源、8743条三元组的测试平台上验证。
AI.motivation: 集成异构工业系统的知识图谱面临信任赤字：消费者无法确定查询数据是否有效、决策时是否有效、数据来源及处理方式。单一信任能力无法单独解决此问题，需要探索四种信任能力的组合如何产生涌现性质。
AI.method: 提出一个可组合的信任基础设施，将四种能力（SHACL验证、PROV-O溯源、领域感知双时态版本控制、图原生决策对象）集成到统一RDF架构中。四种能力通过共享实体URI、摄取活动标识符和时间相关性键进行组合，支持跨越四个维度的复合查询。使用消融实验（移除任一能力）和更高阶组合分析来验证涌现性质，并在集成11个工业数据源（OPC UA、TIA Portal、eClass、AAS、ISA-95等）的测试平台及89类ISA-95对齐本体上进行验证。
AI.result: 消融实验确认移除任一能力恰好导致六个复合查询中的三个失败，证明四种能力同等重要。高阶组合分析揭示了四个涌现的三方性质和1个不可约的四方性质（全链路可审计性，31ms执行）。统一图包含8743条三元组、5个命名图、81条owl:sameAs身份边。评估使用仿真但结构现实的数据。
AI.conclusion: 四种信任能力通过共享相关标识符组合，能够产生任何单一能力都无法提供的涌现信任属性。全链路可审计性作为不可约的四方性质，证明了完整信任基础设施的必要性。该方法在结构现实的多源工业数据上验证有效。

title: D-Diff: An Interactive Environment for Adjusting Commit Boundaries Based on an Editable 3-way Diff
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 14th IEEE Working Conference on Software Visualization (VISSOFT 2026)
summary: In version control, it is recommended that each commit include only changes related to one task. To follow this recommendation, developers may need to adjust commit boundaries, that is, to compare and modify the diffs between two consecutive commits. Existing tools either display only a single diff at a time, forcing developers to rely on their memory when comparing diffs, or display three files simultaneously without showing the two consecutive diffs, forcing developers to infer them; both increase their cognitive load and hamper the adjustment. As a first step toward supporting this process, we propose D-Diff, an interactive diff adjustment environment for two consecutive commits that each involve the same single file. Based on a 3-way diff display, D-Diff integrates the two diffs into a single compact view, which also provides a way to modify them. A within-subjects user study with 8 participants showed that D-Diff significantly outperforms a baseline tool in terms of efficiency, reducing the median adjustment time from 530 seconds to 230 seconds (approximately 57%). D-Diff also received a higher percentage of positive responses across all usability questionnaire items, while no statistically significant difference was found in accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D-Diff，一个用于支持开发者调整两次连续提交之间diff边界的交互环境。D-Diff将两个连续的diff整合到一个紧凑的3-way diff视图中，允许开发者直接查看和修改。用户研究（8名参与者）表明，D-Diff相比基线工具在效率上显著提升，中位调整时间从530秒降至230秒（约减少57%），且在准确性上无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 版本控制中建议每次提交只包含与单一任务相关的更改，但开发者常常需要调整提交边界（即比较和修改两个连续提交之间的diff）。现有工具要么一次只显示单个diff，迫使开发者依赖记忆进行比较；要么同时显示三个文件但不直接展示两个连续diff，迫使开发者自行推断。这两种方式都增加了认知负担，妨碍了diff调整过程。
AI.method: D-Diff是一个交互式diff调整环境，针对涉及同一单个文件的两个连续提交。它基于3-way diff显示方式，将两个diff整合到一个紧凑的单一视图中，同时提供修改diff的功能。研究采用参与者内（within-subjects）设计，招募8名参与者进行用户研究，将D-Diff与基线工具进行对比评估。
AI.result: 用户研究结果表明，D-Diff在效率上显著优于基线工具，中位调整时间从530秒减少到230秒（约57%的降低）。在所有可用性问卷项目中，D-Diff获得更高比例的正面回应。在准确性方面，两者之间没有发现统计学上的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: D-Diff作为支持提交边界调整的第一步工作，通过将两个连续diff整合为单一紧凑视图，有效降低了开发者的认知负担并提高了调整效率，同时保持了相当的准确性。该工作为未来更完善的版本控制diff调整工具奠定了方向。

title: Cultural Moment Benchmark: Evaluating Video Cultural Reasoning and Grounding in Southeast Asia
summary: Cultural understanding in video means more than recognizing what is visible; it requires grasping the symbolic and temporal significance of cultural concepts. We decompose this into three abilities: naming what a concept symbolizes, visually recognizing it on video, and locating its sub-events in time. Existing video-cultural benchmarks tend to test what is seen, collapsing these three abilities into a single score that hides the bottleneck. We introduce the Cultural Moment Benchmark (CMB): 306 expert-curated concepts from seven countries in Southeast Asia across five categories. We evaluate each concept through three stages, one per ability. Given a description, Stage 1 (S1) selects from four candidate concept names, Stage 2 (S2) selects from four candidate video moments, and Stage 3 (S3) predicts the start and end times of the moment in a video. To keep each stage focused on a distinct ability, we use three design choices: semantic-similarity distractors (S1, S2), unlabeled video moments (S2), and free-form localization on a different example video (S3). Across six vision-language models, failure modes vary by ability and modality. i) Even the strongest closed-source models score below 30% when all three stages must be correct; ii) The three abilities do not fully cascade: naming a concept correctly helps half the models recognize it on video, but recognizing it has little effect on locating the sub-event in time; iii) Audio is complementary, redundant, or distracting depending on the concept, more often distracting in non-Latin-script countries; removing both audio and subtitles hurts Games and Music the most. Our 14-rater human study shows that even Expert raters score below chance on concepts from a neighboring country, indicating that CMB requires country-specific cultural knowledge. CMB acts as a diagnostic harness, attributing failures to a specific ability or modality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出文化时刻基准（CMB），将视频中的文化理解分解为命名象征、视觉识别和时序定位三种能力，通过三阶段评测（S1概念命名、S2视频时刻选择、S3起止时间预测）对东南亚七国的306个专家精选文化概念进行诊断。实验发现最强模型三阶段全对得分低于30%，三种能力不完全级联，音频的作用因概念而异，且该基准需要国家特定的文化知识。
AI.motivation: 现有视频文化基准将三种不同的能力（命名象征意义、视觉识别、时间定位）折叠为一个分数，掩盖了模型真正的瓶颈所在。研究者希望设计一个能单独诊断每种能力的基准，以准确归因模型失败的具体环节。
AI.method: 构建CMB基准，包含东南亚七国306个专家精选文化概念，覆盖五个类别。每个概念通过三个阶段评估：S1从四个候选概念名中选择（使用语义相似干扰项）、S2从四个候选视频时刻中选择（使用未标注视频时刻）、S3在另一示例视频上预测起止时间（自由形式定位）。三阶段使用不同的设计选择以聚焦单一能力，并采用14名评分者的人类研究进行验证。
AI.result: 在六个视觉语言模型上：最强闭源模型三阶段全对得分低于30%；三种能力不完全级联——正确命名能帮助一半模型进行视觉识别，但识别对时间定位几乎没有帮助；音频的作用因概念而异（互补、冗余或干扰），在非拉丁字母国家更多是干扰；移除音频和字幕对游戏和音乐类损害最大；人类专家对邻国概念的评分甚至低于随机水平。
AI.conclusion: CMB作为诊断式基准，能够将模型失败归因到具体的能力或模态，揭示了现有模型在文化视频理解中命名、识别和定位三种能力的独立瓶颈，并证明该任务需要国家特定的文化知识，为未来多模态文化理解研究提供了精确的诊断工具。

title: Same Agent, Different Answers: A Repeat-Aware Audit of Corpus-Induced Answer Churn in Retrieval-Augmented QA
summary: A retrieval-augmented QA system can return different answers after an index expansion even when its requested model identifier, prompt, retrieval policy, evidence depth, rendering, and exposed generation controls are held fixed. Aggregate accuracy may hide these changes when gains and losses cancel, while ordinary generation variability makes one-shot comparisons overstate update effects. We call the hidden phenomenon accuracy-blind answer churn and introduce the \emph{Snapshot Compatibility Audit}, which estimates excess answer churn by subtracting same-snapshot repeat disagreement from cross-snapshot disagreement. We instantiate it by expanding one frozen FineWeb prefix from one to seven shards. In a preregistered 400-question Natural Questions study, normalized-exact and blinded-semantic excess churn are 6.44 and 10.25 percentage points while exact-match accuracy changes by only $-1.50$ points. A post-hoc analysis finds repeat-stable semantic flips on 40/400 questions. A separately preregistered 200-question TriviaQA study yields smaller, directionally consistent excess churn while exact-match accuracy moves in the opposite direction. An outcome-blind post-hoc 100-question subset replication with a second DeepSeek generator and serving configuration finds 8.75 pp of semantic excess churn even as exact match rises by 3.00 percentage points. Answer-level compatibility can therefore fail without a conspicuous or consistently directed utility shift. Retrieval-augmented releases should audit compatibility alongside utility.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了检索增强问答系统中一种被忽视的现象——"精度盲回答翻转"（accuracy-blind answer churn），即索引扩展后系统回答发生变化但整体精度指标不变或反向变化。作者提出"快照兼容性审计"（Snapshot Compatibility Audit）方法，通过从跨快照分歧中减去同快照重复分歧来估计超额回答翻转，并在多个预注册实验（Natural Questions、TriviaQA）中验证了该方法能有效检测出被传统精度指标掩盖的回答不兼容问题。
AI.motivation: 检索增强问答系统在索引扩展后即使所有其他配置固定，也可能产生不同的回答。但聚合精度指标可能因得失相抵而掩盖这些变化，且普通生成变异性会使一次性比较夸大更新效应。现有方法无法可靠检测这种"精度盲"的不兼容性，需要一种专门的审计方法来估计超额回答翻转。
AI.method: 提出Snapshot Compatibility Audit方法：通过计算跨快照分歧（cross-snapshot disagreement）减去同快照重复分歧（same-snapshot repeat disagreement）来估计超额回答翻转（excess answer churn）。实验中将冻结的FineWeb前缀从一个分片扩展到七个分片，使用normalized-exact和blinded-semantic两种匹配指标进行测量。
AI.result: 在400个问题的Natural Questions预注册研究中，normalized-exact和blinded-semantic超额翻转分别为6.44和10.25个百分点，而精确匹配精度仅变化-1.50点。TriviaQA研究显示更小但方向一致的超额翻转，而精度向相反方向移动。100问题的复制实验发现8.75个百分点的语义超额翻转，即使精确匹配上升了3.00个百分点。事后分析发现40/400问题存在重复稳定的语义翻转。
AI.conclusion: 答案级兼容性可能在无明显或方向一致的效用变化时失效。检索增强系统的发布应当同时审计兼容性和效用，而非仅依赖聚合精度指标。Snapshot Compatibility Audit为检测这种精度盲的回答翻转提供了有效工具。

title: Can LLMs Truly Forget? Revealing Unlearning Gaps Through Adversarial Evaluation
summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of targeted training data from a model while preserving its remaining capabilities, but evaluating whether such information has truly become inaccessible remains challenging. Existing benchmarks primarily assess unlearning under clean, non-adversarial queries, leaving open whether information that appears forgotten can still be recovered through strategic prompting. We address this gap through a unified evaluation of prompt-based and fine-tuning-based unlearning methods on TOFU using Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, followed by an adversarial robustness evaluation of methods that perform strongly under standard metrics. We introduce Attack Success Rate (ASR), an LLM-as-judge metric that measures the fraction of adversarial responses whose leakage score exceeds $0.2$, and evaluate recovery across eight attack suites. Our results reveal a substantial gap between clean-query forgetting and adversarial robustness. Although several fine-tuning-based methods achieve Forget Quality above $0.91$, targeted information remains recoverable with ASRs between $72.8\%$ and $84.3\%$, close to the $87.5\%$ ASR of the unprotected base model. In contrast, clean multilingual reformulations yield only $2.95\%$ measured leakage. A manual audit further finds agreement between binary ASR decisions and human factual assessments in seven of ten cases, indicating that ASR provides a useful, though imperfect, signal of behavioral recoverability. These findings show that strong standard-metric performance alone is insufficient to establish robustness after unlearning and motivate adversarial stress-testing as a complementary component of unlearning evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对机器遗忘（machine unlearning）的对抗性鲁棒性评估框架，引入ASR（Attack Success Rate）指标，通过八种攻击套件测试遗忘后的模型是否仍可通过策略性提示恢复已遗忘信息。研究发现，尽管多种微调方法在标准指标上表现优异（Forget Quality > 0.91），但目标信息仍可被恢复（ASR 72.8%-84.3%），接近于未受保护的基座模型（87.5%），表明标准指标不足以证明遗忘的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘基准主要评估模型在干净、非对抗性查询下的表现，忽略了已遗忘信息是否可以通过策略性提示被重新恢复的问题。作者希望弥合这一评估空白，揭示标准指标与对抗鲁棒性之间的差距。
AI.method: 在TOFU数据集上使用Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct对基于提示和基于微调的遗忘方法进行统一评估，然后对标准指标表现优异的方法进行对抗鲁棒性测试。提出ASR指标，利用LLM-as-judge来测量对抗性回复中泄密分数超过0.2的比例，并通过八个攻击套件进行恢复评估。
AI.result: 微调方法虽达到Forget Quality > 0.91，但ASR仍高达72.8%-84.3%，接近未保护基座模型的87.5%。相比之下，干净的多语言改写仅产生2.95%的泄密。人工审计中ASR二进制判定与人类事实评估在十个案例中有七个一致，表明ASR是有用但非完美的信号。
AI.conclusion: 标准指标表现优异不足以证明遗忘后的鲁棒性，需要将对抗性压力测试作为机器遗忘评估的补充组成部分。

title: Multi-Scale Fruit Capsules: Dilated Convolutions and Dynamic Routing for In-the-Wild Explainable Fruit Recognition
summary: The same fruit appears in a bunch, unpicked, peeled, bagged in plastic, or sliced on a dish, so automated fruit classification in the wild (AFCW) must absorb wide intra- class and narrow inter-class variability in shape, size, colour and texture. Convolutional networks route information through pooling, which discards the pose and location of the region of interest and therefore generalises poorly across these presentations. We propose FruitCapsNet, a capsule network whose Fruit Capsules replace the standard convolutional front end with dilated convolutions: the receptive field grows exponentially at constant parameter cost, so each capsule encodes multi-scale context before dynamic routing resolves part whole spatial agreement. Hyper-parameters, including the dilation factor, are selected by Bayesian optimisation rather than grid search. On three public datasets (SMP, FruitsGB, Fruits-360) and a new 19-class, 10,639-image in-the-wild dataset (PD-19), FruitCapsNet exceeds ten fine-tuned transfer-learning backbones at one-third the depth, with the largest margin (+2.7% over the nearest competitor) on the hardest set. Grad-CAM saliency propagated from the DigitCaps layer shows that the improvement comes from attributing decisions to whole-fruit regions rather than to object edges, giving post-hoc evidence that the gain is not a dataset artefact.

AI.tldr: 提出FruitCapsNet，一种胶囊网络用于野外水果分类（AFCW），用扩张卷积替代标准卷积前端，使感受野呈指数级增长且参数成本不变，并通过贝叶斯优化选择超参数。在三个公开数据集和新构建的PD-19数据集上，以三分之一的网络深度超越了十个微调迁移学习骨干网络，在最难的数据集上最大领先2.7%。
AI.motivation: 野外水果分类需应对同种水果在不同呈现方式（成串、未摘、去皮、袋装、切片）下的巨大类内差异和狭窄的类间差异。传统卷积网络通过池化丢弃感兴趣区域的位置信息，导致在多样呈现下泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出FruitCapsNet胶囊网络：1）用扩张卷积替换标准卷积前端，感受野以恒定参数成本呈指数增长，使每个胶囊编码多尺度上下文；2）动态路由机制解决部分-整体空间一致性；3）使用贝叶斯优化而非网格搜索选择超参数（包括扩张因子）。
AI.result: 在SMP、FruitsGB、Fruits-360三个公开数据集及新构建的19类、10,639张图像的PD-19野外数据集上，FruitCapsNet以三分之一的深度超过十个微调迁移学习骨干网络，在最具挑战性的数据集上较最接近的竞争者领先2.7%。Grad-CAM显著性图证实改进源于将决策归因于整个水果区域而非物体边缘。
AI.conclusion: FruitCapsNet通过胶囊网络结合扩张卷积架构，有效解决了野外水果分类的类内多样性问题，其性能提升经Grad-CAM归因分析验证并非数据集伪影，而是真正学习到了更具泛化性的整体水果特征表示。

title: Anchoring Bias: A Persistent Fairness Backdoor Attack against MLLMs under Continual Learning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains where fairness is a critical safety requirement. In practice, these models are continually updated through continual learning (CL) to adapt to evolving tasks and data distributions. Prior work has shown that backdoor attacks can manipulate MLLM responses through hidden triggers, but naively implanted backdoors degrade as models undergo subsequent updates of CL. Although fairness has emerged as a central concern for MLLM deployment, whether backdoor-induced fairness violations can survive CL remains unexplored, leaving two critical questions unanswered: (1) whether a backdoor can reliably induce fairness violations in MLLMs, and (2) whether such fairness-targeted backdoors can persist through continual learning. We bridge this gap by proposing Persistent Fairness Backdoor Attack (PFBA) to inject persistent and group-specific discrimination into MLLMs. Specifically, PFBA achieves this through two novel mechanisms. The Latent Space Fairness Reinforcement reshapes the model's deep feature geometry by anchoring privileged-group representations to preserve utility while repelling and clustering targeted-group representations to sustain discrimination, and the Continual Learning Simulation iteratively optimizes the trigger against simulated parameter drift to ensure backdoor persistence across future updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PFBA induces severe fairness disparities that persist across continual learning rounds, evading standard backdoor defenses. The data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/lyygua/PFBA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出持续公平性后门攻击（PFBA），通过潜在空间公平性强化和持续学习模拟两种机制，将针对特定群体的歧视性后门注入多模态大语言模型（MLLM），使其在持续学习更新后仍能保持公平性违规，且能规避标准后门防御。
AI.motivation: MLLM在持续学习过程中不断更新，现有后门攻击在持续学习后会退化。虽然公平性已成为MLLM部署的核心关注点，但后门引发的公平性违规能否在持续学习后存活尚未被探索。作者希望回答两个关键问题：（1）后门能否可靠地诱导MLLM产生公平性违规；（2）这类针对公平性的后门能否在持续学习中持续存在。
AI.method: 提出PFBA框架，包含两个核心机制：（1）潜在空间公平性强化（Latent Space Fairness Reinforcement）：通过锚定特权群体表征以保持模型效用，同时排斥和聚类目标群体表征以维持歧视；（2）持续学习模拟（Continual Learning Simulation）：迭代优化触发器以对抗模拟的参数漂移，确保后门在未来的模型更新中持久存在。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PFBA能诱导严重的公平性差异，且这种差异在持续学习轮次中持续存在，同时能规避标准后门防御机制。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次证明针对公平性的后门攻击可以在持续学习后存活，揭示了MLLM在持续更新场景下的新安全漏洞，为后续防御研究提供了重要基线。

title: Evaluating Multimodal Narrative Understanding of Popular Hollywood Films
summary: Multimodal language models increasingly show promise for enabling the large-scale computational analysis of film, opening up new avenues for learning about film history and the evolution of narrative techniques. But the creation of stable benchmarks built around Hollywood films is complicated by copyright protections.
