In this work, we address these concerns directly, by building a new collection of Hollywood films defined by two criteria: box office popularity (where we publish the first large-scale, open collection of weekly box office earnings reported by Variety magazine from 1922-1979); and likely public domain status (by researching copyright registrations and renewals in the US Catalog of Copyright Entries). We build a new multimodal MCQ benchmark on top of this collection that focuses on narrative elements that directly evaluate the abilities of models to inform meaningful research on film narrative; we find that many vision-language models struggle on this task (with many performing at near-chance levels of accuracy), while audio-visual models (including those that use audio in captioning scenes) reach a maximum accuracy of 61.1%, well below human-level performance.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于好莱坞电影的公开多模态基准测试，通过整理1922-1979年Variety杂志的每周票房数据和美国版权登记信息，筛选出高票房且可能处于公共领域的电影，并在此之上建立了评估多模态语言模型电影叙事理解能力的多选题基准。实验发现多数视觉-语言模型在该任务上表现接近随机水平，即使最强的音视频模型准确率也仅为61.1%，远低于人类水平。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型有望实现电影的大规模计算分析，从而推动电影史和叙事技巧演变的研究。然而，围绕好莱坞电影构建稳定基准测试受版权保护限制，现有的公开基准缺乏好莱坞电影数据，需要解决这一障碍。
AI.method: （1）按两个标准构建好莱坞电影集合：票房热度（首次发布1922-1979年Variety杂志每周票房收入的公开大规模数据集）和可能的公共领域状态（通过研究美国版权目录中的版权注册和续期记录）；（2）在该电影集合上构建新的多模态多选题基准，聚焦于叙事元素，直接评估模型支持电影叙事研究的能力；（3）测试多种视觉-语言模型和音视频模型。
AI.result: 许多视觉-语言模型在该任务上表现挣扎（准确率接近随机水平），而音视频模型（包括在场景描述中使用音频的模型）最高准确率达61.1%，仍显著低于人类水平。
AI.conclusion: 现存多模态语言模型在电影叙事理解方面仍远未达到人类水平，基于公开领域的电影基准为未来电影叙事计算分析研究提供了可复现的评估基础，同时音频模态对理解电影叙事具有重要价值。

title: CodeMechanic: Bug-Property-Guided Program Mitigation
summary:
Automated testing discovers vulnerabilities faster than developers can investigate and repair them, leaving an interval in which known memory corruptions remain exploitable. End- to-end LLM repair agents can shorten this interval, but they synthesize open-ended code changes and commonly validate them only by replaying a proof of concept (PoC). This weak oracle accepts patches that silence the observed crash by changing unrelated behavior, making unintended deployment risky.
  We present CodeMechanic, a bug-property-guided system for generating constrained mit- igations for spatial memory corruption. Instead of asking an LLM to generate a permanent repair, CodeMechanic reconstructs the violated memory-safety property from the crash, validates the dereferenced pointer and its buffer range, and inserts a local fail-stop guard before the dangerous access. The guard terminates execution when the boundary check fails. The resulting mitigation deliberately trades availability for security: it can convert potential remote code execution into controlled termination while developers investigate the root cause and prepare a permanent repair. CodeMechanic combines a two-dimensional static and dynamic context extractor with in-prompt debugging knowledge and stepwise val- idation to limit the effect of LLM errors. On 101 real-world ARVO bugs, the first attempt of CodeMechanic produces 47.6% more plausible patches (i.e., patches that pass PoC- replay validation) than the best baseline while using 91% fewer tokens. Manual audit further shows that CodeMechanic produces 3.4x - 4.3x more patches semantically equivalent to developer-written repairs.

AI.tldr: CodeMechanic是一个面向空间内存破坏的缺陷属性引导修复系统。它不从崩溃中生成永久修复，而是重建被违反的内存安全属性，在危险内存访问前插入局部fail-stop防护（边界检查失败即终止执行），以可用性换取安全性。在101个真实ARVO缺陷上，首轮尝试比最佳基线多产出47.6%的可信补丁，且节省91%的token，语义等价于开发者修复的补丁数量提升3.4-4.3倍。
AI.motivation: 自动化测试发现漏洞的速度远超开发者修复速度，导致已知内存损坏漏洞在修复前仍可利用。端到端LLM修复代理虽然能缩短这一间隔，但其生成的开放式代码变更仅通过回放PoC验证，这种弱验证标准会接受那些通过改变无关行为来掩盖崩溃的补丁，带来部署风险。
AI.method: CodeMechanic包含三个核心组件：(1) 从崩溃中重建被违反的内存安全属性，验证被解引用的指针及其缓冲区范围；(2) 在危险访问前插入局部fail-stop防护守卫，边界检查失败即终止执行；(3) 结合二维静态和动态上下文提取器、提示内调试知识和逐步验证机制来限制LLM错误的影响。它将问题从"生成永久修复"转为"生成约束性缓解措施"，刻意放弃可用性以换取安全性。
AI.result: 在101个真实世界ARVO缺陷上，CodeMechanic首轮尝试比最佳基线多产生47.6%的可信补丁（通过PoC回放验证），同时使用91%更少的token。人工审计显示，CodeMechanic产生的语义等价于开发者编写修复的补丁数量是基线的3.4-4.3倍。
AI.conclusion: CodeMechanic通过将LLM修复任务从开放式的永久修复转变为受约束的fail-stop缓解，显著提高了补丁的正确性和可信度。它提供了一种务实的中间方案：在开发者调查根本原因和准备永久修复期间，将潜在远程代码执行转化为受控终止，从而有效缩短漏洞可利用的时间窗口。

title: WARP: Wasserstein-Aligned RAG for Population Opinions
summary:
RAG systems are increasingly used to summarize what large collections of documents say. A user asks "What do people think about X?" and receives an answer that reads as consensus. But standard top-k retrieval ranks documents by query similarity, not by how faithfully they represent the population, so minority views quietly disappear. Existing fixes fall short. Diversity re-rankers like MMR and DPP spread retrieved documents apart, but with no target distribution to aim for. Calibration methods based on KL or JS divergence do target one, yet treat opinion bins as unordered: confusing strong positive with strong negative costs no more than an adjacent-bin miss.
  We introduce WARP, a family of post-retrieval algorithms that calibrate retrieved evidence to the population's opinion distribution. WARP first recovers underrepresented opinions that cosine ranking may bury, then uses Wasserstein-1 distance to select documents whose sentiment-intensity distribution matches the population target, capturing the ordinal structure ignored by KL and JS divergence. We develop three variants for dense, sparse, and variable candidate pools, trading off calibration quality and speed. Across three review domains spanning 35K documents, 156 queries, and 26 entities, WARP's domain-matched variants reduce distributional error by at least 43% with sub-second latency. These gains carry through to generation: a five-judge LLM panel prefers WARP-generated answers in 86% of decided comparisons at k <= 5.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WARP，一组检索后校准算法，通过Wasserstein-1距离将检索到的证据校准到群体的观点分布，解决RAG系统中少数观点因余弦排名而消失的问题。
AI.motivation: 标准top-k检索按查询相似度排序文档，而非按代表性，导致少数观点消失。现有方法（MMR、DPP多样性重排）缺乏目标分布，KL/JS散度校准方法将观点分箱视为无序，混淆强正负观点的代价与相邻分箱相同，均无法有效解决该问题。
AI.method: WARP首先恢复被余弦排名埋没的代表不足的观点，然后使用Wasserstein-1距离（而非KL/JS散度）选择文档，使情感强度分布与群体目标匹配，从而捕捉序数结构。开发了三个变体以适配稠密、稀疏和可变候选池场景，在校准质量和速度之间权衡。
AI.result: 在跨越35K文档、156个查询、26个实体的三个评论领域上，WARP的领域匹配变体将分布误差降低至少43%，且延迟低于秒级。生成阶段中，五个评判LLM小组在k≤5的86%决定性比较中偏好WARP生成的回答。
AI.conclusion: WARP通过利用Wasserstein距离的序数敏感性，显著提升了RAG系统对群体观点的忠实表达，兼顾了校准质量与运行效率，并改善了最终生成的回答质量。

title: Mitigating Database Leakage in RAG Systems with Keyword-Grounded Fact Substitution
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for combining large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge sources. However, RAG systems remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, which may mislead the retriever or generator to expose sensitive database contents. To address this issue, we propose KFS-RAG, a defense that mitigates information leakage by reformulating the retrieved context. Specifically, our method first identifies a small set of influential keywords from the retrieved context via an attention rollout plus a causal perturbation mechanism. These keywords are then used to guide an auxiliary LLM to generate a compact set of keyword-grounded facts from the retrieved passages. Finally, the original context is substituted with these curated facts, ensuring that the generator operates on sanitized evidence rather than the raw retrieved text. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that KFS-RAG significantly reduces the risk of database leakage under injection attacks while maintaining response accuracy and relevance. This work highlights a practical pathway toward building secure and trustworthy RAG systems.

AI.tldr: KFS-RAG是一种防御RAG系统提示注入攻击的方法，通过从检索内容中提取关键词并生成简洁的关键词引导事实来替代原始上下文，从而防止敏感数据库内容泄露。
AI.motivation: RAG系统虽然能有效结合大语言模型与外部知识，但容易受到提示注入攻击，攻击者可能误导检索器或生成器暴露敏感数据库内容，现有防御手段不足。
AI.method: 首先通过注意力展开（attention rollout）和因果扰动机制从检索上下文中识别少数有影响力的关键词；然后利用这些关键词引导辅助LLM生成紧凑的关键词基础事实；最后用这些精选事实替代原始上下文，使生成器基于净化后的证据而非原始检索文本工作。
AI.result: 实验表明KFS-RAG在注入攻击下显著降低了数据库泄露风险，同时保持了回答的准确性和相关性。
AI.conclusion: KFS-RAG提供了一条构建安全可信RAG系统的实用途径，展示了通过上下文重构来防御提示注入攻击的可行性。

title: Tomatoes, Potatoes, and Onions: Questioning the Need for Faces in Face Presentation Attack Detection
summary: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) is traditionally formulated as a face-specific problem, although many of the visual artifacts introduced by print, replay, and recapture processes are not inherently tied to facial appearance. In this work, we investigate whether transferable PAD representations can be learned without using faces during downstream PAD training. To this end, we introduce TPO, a controlled face-free presentation attack dataset consisting of bona fide, print, and replay recordings of, almost randomly chosen, tomatoes, potatoes, and onions acquired under protocols that closely mirror conventional face PAD datasets. Using a foundation-model-based PAD architecture, we demonstrate that a detector trained on TPO achieves an average AUC of 92.70% across four standard cross-dataset face PAD benchmarks, outperforming training on synthetic faces and remaining competitive with models trained on real face datasets. Conversely, models trained on face PAD datasets transfer consistently above chance to TPO, suggesting that the learned representations capture characteristics of the presentation process rather than object semantics. Furthermore, incorporating TPO into conventional face PAD training consistently improves cross-dataset performance under fixed optimization budgets, indicating that face-free data provides complementary information rather than simply additional training samples. Finally, representation and frequency analyses provide further evidence that transferable PAD representations cannot be explained by a single spectral artifact but instead encode richer presentation cues shared across object categories. Together, these results provide empirical evidence that transferable presentation attack representations can be learned independently of facial content, opening new opportunities for privacy-preserving and identity-independent PAD development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TPO数据集（用西红柿、土豆、洋葱等非人脸物体录制的呈现攻击数据），证明无需人脸即可学习可迁移的呈现攻击检测（PAD）表征。基于基础模型的PAD架构在TPO上训练，在四个标准跨数据集人脸PAD基准上达到92.70%的平均AUC，与真实人脸数据集训练的模型相当，且将TPO纳入人脸PAD训练可稳定提升跨数据集性能。
AI.motivation: 传统人脸呈现攻击检测被定义为仅与人脸相关的任务，但打印、重放和重捕获过程中产生的视觉伪影本质上与面部外观无关。作者质疑人脸是否是学习可迁移PAD表征的必要条件，旨在探索无需人脸内容的隐私保护型和身份无关型PAD开发。
AI.method: 1) 构建TPO数据集：收集西红柿、土豆、洋葱的bona fide、打印和重放录制，协议模仿传统人脸PAD数据集；2) 采用基于基础模型的PAD架构进行训练；3) 在四个标准跨数据集人脸PAD基准上评估；4) 进行双向迁移实验（人脸数据集↔TPO）；5) 将TPO作为补充数据纳入人脸PAD训练；6) 进行表征和频谱分析。
AI.result: TPO训练的检测器在跨数据集人脸PAD基准上平均AUC达92.70%，优于合成人脸训练，与真实人脸数据集训练相当；人脸PAD模型在TPO上的迁移一致高于随机水平；TPO与人脸PAD联合训练在固定优化预算下持续提升跨数据集性能；表征和频率分析表明迁移表征编码了超越单一频谱伪影的丰富呈现线索。
AI.conclusion: 可迁移的呈现攻击检测表征可以独立于人脸内容学习，提供互补信息而非简单额外训练样本，为隐私保护和身份无关的PAD开发开辟了新途径。

title: Sorting from Counterexamples
summary:
Consider the following problem of learning an unknown linear order on $n$ items. In each round, the learner guesses a complete ordering of the items and receives either confirmation that the guess is correct or a counterexample: a pair of items in the wrong order. The goal is to identify the unknown order using as few queries as possible. We study this problem when up to $k$ of the returned counterexamples may be untruthful, where $k$ is not known in advance. We determine the optimal query complexity up to constant factors: \[
  Θ(n\log n + nk). \] Thus, while the noiseless complexity matches the classical complexity of sorting, each untruthful counterexample incurs an additional cost of order $n$. The upper bound is based on a geometric representation of permutations and Grünbaum's theorem, while the lower bound combines sorting arguments with a Condorcet-type construction. We also study the case where the target ranking has a low-dimensional geometric representation: each item is represented by a point in $\mathbb{R}^d$, and the ranking is obtained by projecting the points onto an unknown direction. For these classes we give an upper bound of $O(d^2\log n+dk)$ and a lower bound of $Ω(d\log n+dk)$, leaving a factor of $d$ gap in the noiseless term.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在存在最多k个（未知数量）不诚实反例的情况下，学习n个物品上未知线性排序的问题。作者确定了最优查询复杂度为Θ(n log n + nk)，并进一步研究了低维几何表示情况下的复杂度界限。
AI.motivation: 经典排序问题在无噪声情况下已有充分研究，但实际场景中查询结果可能包含错误或不诚实的反馈。研究在存在不可信反例（错误报告）情况下的排序学习问题，旨在理解噪声如何影响查询复杂度。
AI.method: 上界基于排列的几何表示和Grünbaum定理构造算法；下界结合排序论证与Condorcet型构造。对低维几何情形，利用d维点的投影表示给出上下界。
AI.result: 确定最优查询复杂度为Θ(n log n + nk)：无噪声时与经典排序复杂度一致，每个不诚实反例额外带来O(n)的代价。低维情形给出上界O(d²log n + dk)和下界Ω(d log n + dk)，无噪声项存在因子d的差距。
AI.conclusion: 反例的可信度问题下，排序查询复杂度会随噪声线性增加；低维几何结构可大幅降低所需查询量，但d因子差距仍有待填补。

title: Agentic AI for Safety-critical Multi-drone Systems: Challenges and Opportunities
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, presented at the AgentCraft Workshop at IUI2026 Conference, https://agentcraft-iui.github.io/2026/ - CEUR-WS.org proceedings forthcoming
summary: Multi-drone systems are increasingly positioned for safety-critical missions such as search and rescue (SAR) and critical infrastructure monitoring. Yet, real-world adoption remains constrained not only by autonomy performance, but by the difficulty of integrating agentic behavior into professional work: operators must understand, trust, and govern automation under uncertainty, time pressure, and accountability. This position paper synthesizes the ambitions and lessons from two ongoing efforts: NAMUR, which explores LLM-supported robot control in SAR and firefighting contexts, and PERSIST, which explores persistent drone operations for monitoring and security at critical infrastructure sites. We argue that agentic AI should be approached as a socio-technical design problem, where interfaces, oversight mechanisms, and evaluation practices are as critical as algorithms. We outline a human-centered, participatory, and iterative research approach aimed at uncovering stakeholder needs, shaping agent capabilities through successive prototypes, and producing transferable proof-of-concept systems and evaluation strategies for other safety-critical contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，综合了NAMUR（搜索救援与消防中的LLM支持机器人控制）和PERSIST（关键基础设施的持续无人机监控）两个项目的经验，主张将智能体AI视为社会技术设计问题，强调界面、监督机制和评估实践与算法本身同等重要，并提出以人为中心、参与式和迭代式的研究方法。
AI.motivation: 多无人机系统在安全关键任务（如搜救和基础设施监控）中日益重要，但实际部署不仅受限于自主性能，还面临操作者理解、信任和治理自动化系统的困难，尤其是在不确定性、时间压力和问责制下。
AI.method: 提出以人为中心、参与式和迭代式的研究方法：通过揭示利益相关者需求、通过连续原型塑造智能体能力、生成可迁移的概念验证系统和评估策略。
AI.result: 暂无具体实验结果，本文为立场论文，提出将智能体AI作为社会技术设计问题来处理的研究框架和议程。
AI.conclusion: 智能体AI的开发应超越算法优化，将人机接口、监督机制和评估实践纳入核心设计范畴，并推广至其他安全关键场景。

title: Learning from the Test: Self-Referential Differential Testing for Deep RL Agents
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has achieved significant success in complex decision-making problems. As DRL systems are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, ensuring their quality and reliability is paramount. Current works primarily focus on detecting safety-critical failures, often neglecting policy optimality, which can lead to reduced efficiency, user distrust, and economic losses. This oversight, compounded by the inherent "testing oracle problem" for optimality, leaves a significant gap in comprehensively evaluating DRL systems. To address this gap, we propose Delta (Differential Testing for DRL Agents), a novel and comprehensive framework that automatically identifies both safety-critical and optimality bugs in DRL agents. Delta employs a two-phase approach: (1) Safety Testing, where the Agent Under Test (AUT) is evaluated for catastrophic failures while collecting data from its decision-making policy, and (2) Optimality Testing, where this collected data from the prior phase is used to train a challenger agent via Offline Reinforcement Learning. Differential testing is then performed by comparing the challenger agent against the AUT; instances where the challenger achieves higher cumulative rewards indicate optimality issues in the AUT. We demonstrate Delta's effectiveness across five environments. We investigate the effectiveness of three offline RL algorithms (BC, BCQ, and CQL) in generating challenger agents. Experimental results demonstrate that safety testing datasets are valuable for training competent DRL agents. Challenger agents trained with BCQ proved most effective for identifying optimality issues within the framework of Delta. Across the five environments, Delta uncovered an average of 2,518 optimality issues, outperforming the baseline methods by 50.2%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Delta框架，一个用于自动检测深度强化学习（DRL）智能体中安全关键缺陷和最优性缺陷的综合测试框架。该框架通过两阶段方法实现：先进行安全测试收集决策数据，再利用离线强化学习训练挑战者智能体，通过差分测试比较挑战者与待测智能体的累积奖励来发现最优性问题。在五个环境中验证了有效性，平均发现2,518个最优性问题，相比基线方法提升50.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有DRL测试工作主要聚焦于检测安全关键故障，往往忽视策略最优性问题，而最优性缺陷可能导致效率降低、用户不信任和经济损失。同时，最优性测试面临固有的"测试预言机问题"，难以自动判断策略是否最优，这构成了全面评估DRL系统的显著空白。
AI.method: Delta框架采用两阶段方法：(1)安全测试阶段，评估待测智能体（AUT）的灾难性故障，同时收集其决策策略的数据；(2)最优性测试阶段，利用前一阶段收集的数据通过离线强化学习训练挑战者智能体，然后通过差分测试比较挑战者与AUT，当挑战者获得更高累积奖励时即表明AUT存在最优性问题。
AI.result: 在五个环境中验证了Delta的有效性，研究了三种离线强化学习算法（BC、BCQ、CQL）训练挑战者智能体的效果。实验表明安全测试数据集对训练有能力的DRL智能体具有价值，其中BCQ训练的挑战者智能体在识别最优性问题方面最为有效。Delta平均发现2,518个最优性问题，比基线方法高出50.2%。
AI.conclusion: Delta是一个全面的DRL智能体测试框架，能够同时检测安全关键缺陷和最优性缺陷，填补了现有DRL测试领域对最优性评估的空白。安全测试阶段收集的数据可复用于训练挑战者智能体，离线强化学习与差分测试的组合为DRL最优性验证提供了有效途径。

title: Cascading Relevance-driven Recommendation Network for CTR Prediction in Trigger-Introduced Recommendation
summary: E-commerce has emerged as crucial platforms for people's daily consumption and shopping interests. There is a new recommendation scenario, Trigger-Introduced Recommendation (TIR), where users click interested product, which is defined as the trigger item, containing their instant interest, and in the undertaking page following the relevant target items. Distinguished from traditional search and recommendation scenarios, trigger contains relatively strong instant interest, which is more vague and implicit compared to search terms. Relying on large amounts of labeled data, existing methods lack the exploration of trigger relevance, which affects users' immersive experience. To alleviate this problem, we propose the Cascading Relevance-driven Recommendation Network (CRRN) to emphasize the interaction and relevance between trigger and target, comprising three essential components: 1) the Trigger-Target Interaction layer extracts interaction features of trigger and target based on personalized gating. 2) Cascading Interest Fusion module explicitly estimates users' trigger intention and fuses instant and personalized interests adaptively with cascading attention blocks. 3) Category-assisted Pairwise Loss enhances trigger relevance with the guidance of category association between trigger and target. Extensive experiment results show that CRRN outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods on both industrial and public datasets. Online A/B tests further validate the effectiveness of our method. Our code is available at https://github.com/a-little-cabbage/CRRN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出级联相关性驱动推荐网络（CRRN），针对触发式推荐（TIR）场景中触发项与目标项之间相关性建模不足的问题，通过触发-目标交互层、级联兴趣融合模块和类别辅助成对损失三个组件，显著提升推荐效果，并在工业与公开数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在触发式推荐场景中，用户点击的触发项包含即时兴趣但较为模糊隐性。现有方法依赖大量标注数据，缺乏对触发相关性的深入探索，影响用户体验沉浸感。
AI.method: 提出CRRN网络，包含三个核心组件：1）触发-目标交互层，基于个性化门控提取触发与目标间的交互特征；2）级联兴趣融合模块，显式估计用户触发意图，并通过级联注意力块自适应融合即时兴趣与个性化兴趣；3）类别辅助成对损失，利用触发与目标间类别关联增强触发相关性。
AI.result: 在工业数据集和公开数据集上的大量实验表明CRRN优于现有最先进方法，在线A/B测试进一步验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CRRN通过强调触发项与目标项之间的交互和相关性，有效解决了TIR场景中的相关性探索不足问题，提升了推荐效果和用户体验。

title: LëtzCross: A Cross-Lingual Page-Level Benchmark for Multimodal Retrieval over Luxembourgish Documents
summary: Recent page-image retrievers such as ColPali have improved retrieval over visually rich documents, yet little is known about how they behave in cross-lingual, low-resource settings. We introduce LëtzCross, a benchmark for cross-lingual page-level retrieval over Luxembourgish PDF documents, with document pages indexed as images and queries provided in English, French, German, and Luxembourgish. The benchmark combines text-focused QA pairs with visually grounded QA pairs, covering both textual and visual retrieval needs in PDF-based RAG. We use LëtzCross to compare OCR-based text-only retrievers with ColPali-style page-image retrievers and find that the latter perform better across query languages in this system-level comparison. We also examine single-language and multilingual fine-tuning. Fine-tuning transfers across query languages, with French yielding the highest mean performance on Luxembourgish queries among the single-language settings. In the multilingual setting, including Luxembourgish gives the strongest results and substantially improves retrieval for Luxembourgish queries.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了LëtzCross，一个针对卢森堡语PDF文档的跨语言页面级检索基准，通过对比OCR文本检索器与ColPali页面图像检索器，发现后者性能更优，且多语言微调（包含卢森堡语）效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有的页面图像检索器（如ColPali）在视觉丰富文档上表现良好，但在跨语言、低资源场景下的行为尚不清楚。需要专门的基准来评估其在低资源语言（如卢森堡语）上的检索性能。
AI.method: 构建LëtzCross基准，包含卢森堡语PDF文档的页面级图像索引，查询涵盖英语、法语、德语和卢森堡语四种语言。基准结合文本焦点QA对和视觉接地QA对，覆盖文本与视觉检索需求。在此基础上对比OCR文本检索器与ColPali图像检索器，并进行单语言和多语言微调实验。
AI.result: 在系统级比较中，ColPali风格的页面图像检索器在所有查询语言上均优于OCR文本检索器。微调具有跨语言迁移能力，单一语言微调中法语对卢森堡语查询的平均性能最高；多语言设置中包含卢森堡语时效果最强，显著提升卢森堡语查询的检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 页面图像检索器更适合低资源跨语言场景，多语言微调策略（包含目标低资源语言）能获得最佳检索效果。

title: CLSC DETR: Reliable Candidate Ranking via Cross Layer Geometric Support for UAV Small Object Detection
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object detection is critical for applications such as target search, where accurate detection of small objects in complex aerial scenes remains challenging. The limited spatial extent, dense distribution, and frequent occlusion of small objects make reliable candidate ranking particularly difficult. Existing Detection Transformer (DETR) based methods improve ranking by estimating localization quality from individual queries and incorporating it into classification scores. However, a single query often lacks sufficient geometric evidence for small objects with weak boundary cues, resulting in unreliable quality estimation and unstable ranking. To address this limitation, we propose Cross Layer Local Support and Consistency Calibration for DETR, termed CLSC DETR. Specifically, the Cross Layer Local Support module establishes correspondences between final layer queries and intermediate layer candidates to aggregate complementary geometric evidence for more reliable localization quality estimation, while the Classification and Localization Consistency Calibration module adaptively adjusts classification scores according to localization quality and classification reliability to improve candidate ranking. Experiments show that CLSC DETR improves AP and AP$_{75}$ over the baseline by 1.5\% and 2.0\% on VisDrone, respectively, while achieving consistent improvements on UAVDT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLSC DETR，一种用于无人机航拍小目标检测的改进DETR方法。通过跨层局部支持模块聚合互补几何证据，以及分类与定位一致性校准模块自适应调整分类分数，解决了单查询对弱边界小目标定位质量估计不可靠的问题，在VisDrone和UAVDT上取得一致性能提升。
AI.motivation: 无人机航拍场景中小目标存在空间范围有限、分布密集且频繁遮挡的问题，导致候选排序困难。现有DETR方法依赖单个查询估计定位质量并融入分类分数，但单个查询对边界线索薄弱的小目标缺乏足够的几何证据，导致质量估计不可靠、排序不稳定。
AI.method: 提出两个核心模块：(1) 跨层局部支持模块，建立最终层查询与中间层候选之间的对应关系，聚合互补几何证据以获得更可靠的定位质量估计；(2) 分类与定位一致性校准模块，根据定位质量和分类可靠性自适应调整分类分数以改进候选排序。
AI.result: 在VisDrone数据集上，相较于基线方法，AP提升1.5%，AP75提升2.0%；在UAVDT数据集上也取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用跨层信息聚合和分类-定位一致性校准，有效改善了小目标检测中候选排序的可靠性，验证了该方法在无人机航拍检测任务中的有效性。

title: Reading the Room: Implicit Confusion Encoding in Recurrent World Model States
comment: Accepted for presentation at the GlobalSouthAI D&I Workshop at IJCAI 2026. Held in Bremen, Germany on the 17th August 2026
summary: World models built on the RSSM architecture, such as DreamerV3, keep a recurrent hidden state $h_t$ trained only to reduce prediction error. We show this state also tracks its own confusion, hiding in plain sight: nearly orthogonal to $h_t$'s directions of greatest variance, invisible to any variance-based method. It is functionally distinct from ensemble disagreement, which flags new inputs, and reconstruction error, which flags bad predictions right now. On a test holding prediction error fixed while confusion varies, a linear probe on $h_t$ finds the signal (AUROC 0.72, 5 runs), while an ensemble baseline scores below chance. A discounted count of recent high-error steps explains 80% of the probe's output ($R^2=0.80$). We confirm the signal is causally used, not merely present, by editing $h_t$ directly and watching behaviour change, including a check using real values from other trajectories instead of synthetic edits. Its geometry and closed form generalize across three control tasks; the decisive dissociation test itself holds cleanly on only one, and its practical use, deciding when to check reality instead of trusting imagination, generalizes to only two of the three tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文发现基于RSSM架构（如DreamerV3）的世界模型中，循环隐藏状态$h_t$不仅用于降低预测误差，还以近乎正交于最大方差方向的方式隐式追踪自身的不确定性（confusion）。该信号与集成分歧和重构误差在功能上不同，线性探针可在固定预测误差时检测到该信号（AUROC 0.72），且可通过高误差步骤的折扣计数解释（R²=0.80）。通过直接编辑$h_t$验证了其因果性，但该方法在三个控制任务中的泛化性有限。
AI.motivation: 世界模型（如DreamerV3）基于RSSM架构，其循环隐藏状态仅以降低预测误差为目标训练，然而模型决策时的可靠性判断（何时信任想象力而非现实）对实际应用至关重要。现有方法（如集成分歧、重构误差）各有局限，作者探索隐藏状态中是否隐式编码了模型自身的不确定性信息，以便在不增加计算开销的前提下判断何时回归现实。
AI.method: 1）通过线性探针在隐藏状态$h_t$上检测不确定性信号；2）设计关键对照实验：在保持预测误差固定而混淆程度变化的情况下验证信号存在性；3）提出一个闭式模型（高误差步骤的折扣计数）解释探针输出的80%；4）通过直接编辑$h_t$（包括使用其他轨迹的真实值进行编辑）验证信号的因果使用性；5）在三个控制任务上测试几何结构、判别实验和实际应用的泛化性。
AI.result: 线性探针在$h_t$上检测到不确定性信号（AUROC 0.72，5次运行），而集成基线低于随机水平；折扣高误差计数解释了探针输出的80%（R²=0.80）；通过编辑$h_t$确认了信号被因果使用；但该判别实验仅在三个任务中的一个上严格成立，实用性（决定何时检查现实）仅在三个任务中的两个上泛化。
AI.conclusion: RSSM的隐藏状态隐式编码了模型自身的不确定性（confusion），该信号与方差方向正交，功能上区别于集成分歧和重构误差，且可被因果使用。然而其泛化性有限：判别性实验仅在单一任务上严格成立，实际用途仅在两个任务上有效，说明该信号虽真实存在但适用范围需谨慎评估。

title: Software Frameworks for Explainable AI in Time Series Classification: A Systematic Review
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, to be published in ECML PKDD 2026, XKDD and Beyond Workshop, LNCS
summary: Time series arise in a wide range of application domains and are analyzed using machine learning in decision-critical settings. Time series classification (TSC) is one of the most widely studied and relevant tasks. In this context, ensuring the transparency and trustworthiness of TSC models has become an important requirement, motivating the use of explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods. Despite growing interest, research on XAI for TSC remains fragmented, and a systematic understanding of the available software frameworks for explanation generation, their evaluation practices, and practical limitations is still lacking. Prior work largely focused on individual explanation methods, while cross-framework consistency, time-series-specific evaluation, and reproducibility have received little attention. In this survey, we analyze existing software frameworks for explanation generation and evaluation in TSC. We compare them along multiple dimensions, including supported XAI methods, evaluation metrics, usability, benchmarking support, and reproducibility, providing the first time-series-specific survey of frameworks with implementation comparisons and an analysis of frequency-domain support. We identify six frameworks that explicitly support time series and reveal common limitations: only one method supports frequency-domain explanations despite their relevance; only two evaluation metrics have been developed specifically for time series; and identical XAI methods can yield substantially different explanations across frameworks. Based on these findings, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research, highlighting the need for unified, time-series-specific XAI frameworks that enable faithful, reproducible, and time-series-aware explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文对时间序列分类（TSC）中的可解释人工智能（XAI）软件框架进行了首次系统综述，比较了六个支持时间序列的框架，揭示了频域解释支持不足、时间序列专用评估指标匮乏以及跨框架解释不一致等关键局限性，并提出了未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分类在决策关键场景中被广泛使用，模型透明性和可信度日益重要，但XAI用于TSC的研究仍零散分散。现有工作多聚焦单一解释方法，缺乏对跨框架一致性、时间序列专用评估及可复现性的系统理解，亟需全面的框架综述。
AI.method: 作者对现有的解释生成与评估软件框架进行了系统性调查，沿多个维度比较框架，包括支持的XAI方法、评估指标、可用性、基准测试支持和可复现性，并进行了实现层面的对比以及频域支持分析，识别出六个明确支持时间序列的框架。
AI.result: 研究发现：仅有一个方法支持频域解释（尽管其具有相关性）；仅有两种评估指标专门为时间序列开发；相同的XAI方法在不同框架中可能产生显著不同的解释结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调需要统一的、时间序列专用的XAI框架，以支持忠实、可复现且具有时间序列意识的解释。基于发现的问题，作者讨论了开放挑战并勾勒了未来研究方向。

title: Learning Spectral Representations of Code through Latent Graph Learning for Generalizable Cross-Language Code Clone Detection
summary: Current code clone detection (CCD) methods rely on fixed, language-specific graph representations like abstract syntax trees (ASTs) or program dependency graphs (PDGs). Because functionally identical code fragments can yield wildly different structures, these rigid graphs produce non-discriminative spectra that perform close to chance. To address this, we propose SPECTRA-Siam, a Siamese latent graph learning network that learns a latent space such that the graph's spectrum serves as a discriminative signature of code functionality by optimizing downstream CCD performance. Given a fragment's AST and data-dependencies, SPECTRA-Siam induces a fixed-size weighted latent graph through soft slot assignment and multi-head attention, and extracts a multi-scale spectral representation from its normalized Laplacian. Mapping all fragments into this shared space yields comparable spectra across programming languages. Experiments on BigCloneBench, AtCoder, and a four-language CodeNet benchmark (Java, Python, C++, C#) support this design choice. Using the same downstream classifier, moving from fixed to learned latent graphs spectra jumps F1 from 0.37 to 0.67 on BigCloneBench and accuracy from 0.60 to 0.71 on AtCoder. On CodeNet, the full model reaches 0.69 accuracy in four epochs and 0.79 after thirty epochs. In bridge-assisted language transfer across 60 unseen paths, SPECTRA-Siam's performance degrades by only 0.058, versus 0.112--0.228 for baselines, showing that learned graph spectra provide a highly generalizable representation for cross-language clone detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPECTRA-Siam，一种基于孪生潜在图学习网络的代码克隆检测方法。该方法通过软槽分配和多头注意力将代码片段的AST和数据依赖关系转换为固定大小的加权潜在图，并从归一化拉普拉斯算子中提取多尺度谱表示作为代码功能的判别性签名。实验在BigCloneBench、AtCoder和四语言CodeNet基准上显著优于基于固定图结构的传统方法，并在跨语言迁移中展现出卓越的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有代码克隆检测方法依赖固定的、特定语言的图表示（如AST或PDG），但由于功能相同的代码片段可能产生完全不同的结构，这些刚性图会产生非判别性的谱，性能接近随机猜测，因此需要一种更灵活的表示学习方法来捕获代码功能本质。
AI.method: SPECTRA-Siam采用孪生架构：1) 从代码片段的AST和数据依赖关系出发，通过软槽分配（soft slot assignment）和多头注意力机制学习固定大小的加权潜在图；2) 从潜在图的归一化拉普拉斯算子中提取多尺度谱表示；3) 将谱表示作为代码功能的判别性签名，通过优化下游克隆检测性能来端到端学习潜在空间。
AI.result: 在BigCloneBench上F1从0.37提升至0.67，在AtCoder上准确率从0.60提升至0.71；在CodeNet上四轮训练达到0.69准确率，三十轮后达到0.79；在60条未见过的桥梁辅助语言迁移路径上，性能仅下降0.058，而基线方法下降0.112-0.228。
AI.conclusion: 从固定图到学习得到的潜在图谱的转换是代码克隆检测的关键改进。学习到的潜在图谱提供了高度可泛化的跨语言代码表示，在不同编程语言间具有可比性，为跨语言克隆检测开辟了新的有效途径。

title: Hypergraph Embedding Indexing for Efficient Dense Vector Retrieval
summary: Dense vector retrieval has become the foundation of modern semantic search, yet existing approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) indexes treat an embedding as an indivisible point in a high-dimensional space. In this work, we propose the Hypergraph Embedding Index (HEI), a framework that instead organizes documents according to combinations of highly activated latent embedding dimensions. This formulation enables inverted-index style candidate generation while preserving the semantic ranking capabilities of dense embeddings. We further demonstrate that constructing multiple complementary hypergraphs substantially improves retrieval coverage without the combinatorial growth associated with increasing the dimensionality of a single hypergraph. Finally, we establish that the statistical properties of embedding activations strongly influence coordinate-inverted indexing efficiency, introducing \emph{activation diversity} as a diagnostic metric governing embedding indexability in coordinate-inverted frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出超图嵌入索引（HEI），将文档按高激活的潜在嵌入维度组合进行组织，而非将嵌入视为高维空间中的不可分割点。该方法支持倒排索引式候选生成，同时保留稠密嵌入的语义排序能力。通过构建多个互补超图可显著提升检索覆盖率，且不会像单超图增维那样带来组合爆炸。作者还引入"激活多样性"作为衡量坐标倒排框架中嵌入可索引性的诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 现有的近似最近邻（ANN）索引将嵌入视为高维空间中的不可分割点，这限制了索引结构的灵活性和检索效率。作者希望打破这一假设，通过利用嵌入维度的高激活组合来组织文档，从而在保留稠密嵌入语义能力的同时实现倒排式的高效候选生成。
AI.method: 提出HEI框架：1) 根据高度激活的潜在嵌入维度组合构建超图来组织文档，实现倒排索引风格的候选生成；2) 构建多个互补超图以提升检索覆盖率，同时避免单超图维度增加导致的组合爆炸；3) 引入激活多样性作为诊断指标，刻画嵌入激活的统计特性对坐标倒排索引效率的影响。
AI.result: 多互补超图方法能在大幅提升检索覆盖率的同时避免维度增加带来的组合增长困境；激活多样性指标能够有效预测嵌入在坐标倒排框架中的可索引性。
AI.conclusion: HEI证明将嵌入拆解为其激活维度的组合可以同时获得倒排索引的效率与稠密检索的语义质量，激活多样性为评估和设计可索引的嵌入模型提供了新的理论视角。

title: FCPRAG: Fusion-Controller Parametric Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Stable Multi-Passage LoRA Injection
summary: Parametric retrieval-augmented generation (PRAG) injects retrieved evidence into a large language model (LLM) through passage-specific LoRA adapters, reducing reliance on long in-context prompts. When multiple passages are retrieved for the same query, however, evidence-level fusion becomes a bottleneck: equal-weight merging can amplify weak or conflicting evidence, and translating retrieval signals into fusion weights often requires fragile global tuning. We propose FCPRAG, a fusion-controlled parametric RAG framework that adds a lightweight controller for retrieval-conditioned, sample-level adapter fusion. The controller predicts per-passage fusion scores together with sample-level calibration signals, including a mixing gate and an adaptive temperature, enabling fusion that stays selective under informative retrieval signals and conservative under uncertainty. FCPRAG is trained with merge-aware supervision derived from each adapter's marginal contribution within a multi-adapter merge, using training data only. We further show that a single dataset-level temperature is suboptimal under heteroscedastic retrieval uncertainty, motivating sample-level adaptation. Experiments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, PopQA, and ComplexWebQuestions (CWQ) across three LLM backbones show that FCPRAG consistently improves F1 over standard RAG and parametric RAG baselines, with gains of up to 4.65% on 2WikiMultiHopQA and 7.55% on CWQ, while also reducing tuning cost and improving robustness under retrieval perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FCPRAG，一个融合控制的参数化检索增强生成框架，通过轻量级控制器实现检索条件驱动的样本级适配器融合。控制器预测每个passage的融合分数及样本级校准信号（混合门控和自适应温度），使融合在信息丰富的检索信号下保持选择性，在不确定性下保持保守性。实验在多个数据集和LLM骨干上显示稳定提升。
AI.motivation: PRAG通过passage特定的LoRA适配器注入检索证据，但当多个passage被检索到时，证据级融合成为瓶颈：等权融合会放大弱或矛盾的证据，而将检索信号转化为融合权重通常需要脆弱的全局调参。现有方法缺乏有效的样本级融合控制机制。
AI.method: FCPRAG添加一个轻量级控制器，用于检索条件下的样本级适配器融合。控制器预测每个passage的融合分数，并输出样本级校准信号（混合门控和自适应温度），实现在强检索信号下的选择性融合和在不确定性下的保守融合。训练采用融合感知的监督信号，基于每个适配器在多适配器合并中的边际贡献，仅使用训练数据。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、PopQA和CWQ四个数据集上，跨三个LLM骨干，FCPRAG一致优于标准RAG和参数化RAG基线。在2WikiMultiHopQA上提升达4.65%，在CWQ上达7.55%，同时降低调参成本并提升在检索扰动下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 样本级自适应温度优于数据集级单一温度，因为检索不确定性具有异方差性。FCPRAG证明通过轻量级控制器实现检索条件驱动的样本级适配器融合，能够更有效地解决PRAG中的证据融合瓶颈问题。

title: FigmaTrace: Capturing Creative Nuances in Human Figma Design Workflows
summary: Vision Language Models have recently shown improvements in several objective and verifiable domains such as object detection but continue to underperform on subjective and creative design tasks. A major contributor to this performance gap is the lack of high quality human workflow data that captures a diverse set of preferences and decisions that make human experts good at design tasks. In this work, we first define a unique, expert curated taxonomy of design skills and best practices which we further expand into a set of 126 open ended, subjective, long horizon tasks. Built on top of this and expert solutions, our dataset FigmaTrace contains over 200 hours of human captured video data converted into 3469 design trajectories using a novel design phase-based method. We use our dataset to train four models and show that training on FigmaTrace leads to a performance improvement comparable to frontier closed models such as \textsc{Claude-Opus-5} and \textsc{GPT-5.6-Sol} on four out of distribution agentic GUI environments. We further perform a useful ablation to attribute these performance improvements to a design phase-based video to trajectory conversion which outperforms prior length-based conversion approaches. Finally, we perform a qualitative analysis on the best performing \textsc{Qwen3.8-27B} outputs to better correlate performance improvements to FigmaTrace's trends. We open source our dataset and the best model for the community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FigmaTrace数据集，包含超过200小时的人类专家设计视频数据，通过基于设计阶段的方法转换为3469条设计轨迹，用于训练视觉语言模型在主观创意设计任务上的能力，实验表明训练效果可与前沿闭源模型媲美。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在客观可验证的领域（如目标检测）表现持续提升，但在主观创意设计任务上仍表现不佳。主要原因在于缺乏捕捉人类专家多样化偏好和决策过程的高质量工作流数据。
AI.method: 1) 定义专家策展的设计技能与最佳实践分类体系；2) 将其扩展为126个开放式、主观、长周期任务；3) 收集超过200小时的人类捕获视频数据；4) 提出基于设计阶段的视频到轨迹转换新方法，生成3469条设计轨迹；5) 用于训练四个模型，并进行消融实验和定性分析。
AI.result: 在四个分布外代理GUI环境中，基于FigmaTrace训练的模型性能提升可与Claude-Opus-5和GPT-5.6-Sol等前沿闭源模型相当；消融实验证明基于设计阶段的转换方法优于传统的基于长度的方法；对最佳模型Qwen3.8-27B输出进行了定性分析以建立性能与数据集趋势的关联。
AI.conclusion: FigmaTrace数据集及基于设计阶段的轨迹转换方法能有效提升VLM在主观创意设计任务上的表现，数据集和最佳模型已开源供社区使用。

title: Predicting Early Functional Decline from Longitudinal Laboratory and Vital Sign Trajectories: A Large-Scale Study Using the All of Us Research Program
comment: Accepted for presentation at American Medical Informatics Association (AMIA) Annual Symposium 2026
summary: Functional decline in older adults is typically recognized only after falls or observable gait impairment, closing the window for prevention. We investigated whether temporal trajectories of routine biomarkers, already recorded but rarely analyzed longitudinally, can identify patients in the pre-clinical phase of mobility decline. Using the All of Us Research Program (N = 297,861; 11.1% cases), we derived trajectory features (slope, variability, delta, mean) for twelve biomarkers over a three-year pre-index window. LightGBM models incorporating trajectories significantly outperformed static laboratory summaries (AUROC 0.797 vs. 0.755; DeLong p < 0.001; AUPRC 0.380 vs. 0.304). A 1:1 age- and sex-matched analysis confirmed an independent trajectory signal (AUROC 0.727 vs. demographics-only 0.680). A horizon analysis demonstrated sustained prediction 3-12 months before decline onset (AUROC 0.768-0.740). Because the model uses only measurements already ordered in routine care, it supports passive, zero-burden EHR integration for early detection of pre-clinical functional decline.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用All of Us研究计划中近30万参与者的十二种常规生物标志物时间轨迹特征（斜率、变异性、差值、均值），通过LightGBM模型识别老年人运动功能下降的前临床阶段。轨迹特征模型显著优于静态实验室值（AUROC 0.797 vs 0.755），且信号独立于年龄性别，可在症状出现前3-12个月预测，支持被动式EHR集成。
AI.motivation: 老年人功能衰退通常在跌倒或步态异常后才被发现，错过了预防干预的窗口期。常规检查中已记录的生物标志物数据虽被纵向采集但极少被分析，这些纵向轨迹可能包含早期预警信息，有望填补前临床阶段识别空白。
AI.method: 利用All of Us研究计划数据（N=297,861，其中11.1%为病例），对十二种生物标志物提取三年窗口期的轨迹特征（斜率、变异性、差值、均值），使用LightGBM模型进行分类预测；通过1:1年龄性别匹配分析验证轨迹信号的独立性，并进行水平时间分析评估预测提前量。
AI.result: 加入轨迹特征的LightGBM模型显著优于静态实验室汇总（AUROC 0.797 vs 0.755，DeLong p<0.001；AUPRC 0.380 vs 0.304）；年龄性别匹配分析确认独立轨迹信号（AUROC 0.727 vs 仅人口学特征0.680）；水平分析显示在功能衰退前3-12个月预测稳定（AUROC 0.768-0.740）。
AI.conclusion: 常规生物标志物的时间轨迹可有效识别功能衰退前临床阶段，且仅依赖常规诊疗中已采集的数据，无需额外负担，具备零负担、被动式EHR集成的临床应用潜力，为早期预防干预提供机会窗口。

title: Benchmarking the Titans: A Multi-Dimensional Empirical Evaluation of LLM Code Generation Quality in the .NET Ecosystem
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the Second Workshop on Large Language Models for Generative Software Engineering (LLM4SE 2026), co-located with STAF 2026, Rennes, France, June 29 - July 3, 2026
summary: Evaluating Large Language Model (LLM) code generation quality requires examining not just whether the generated code is correct, but whether it is maintainable, efficient, and stylistically sound, all of which are qualities of direct importance to software engineering practitioners. Existing benchmarks reduce evaluation to a single Pass@k metric, which obscures critical trade-offs between functional correctness and structural quality. A further limitation is the near-exclusive focus on Python, leaving enterprise-relevant ecosystems such as C# and .NET without dedicated evaluation. This paper presents an automated, multi-dimensional evaluation framework for C# code generation, applying it to four state-of-the-art LLMs: GPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok. We conduct a controlled experiment across 85 algorithmic tasks derived from HumanEval, generating and evaluating 340 solutions in total, in which each solution is assessed across three independent dimensions: functional correctness via automated unit testing, static code quality via Roslyn AST analysis, and runtime efficiency via adversarial BenchmarkDotNet profiling. Our central finding reveals a substantial gap between correctness and quality attributes (Pearson r = 0.075), demonstrating that Pass@k rankings systematically misrepresent the full LLM performance profile in software engineering contexts. We further characterize GPT's bimodal failure behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向C#代码生成的多维度自动化评估框架，对四个主流LLM（GPT、Gemini、Claude、Grok）在85个算法任务上的340个解决方案进行了评估，涵盖功能正确性、静态代码质量和运行时效率三个独立维度。核心发现是正确性与质量属性之间存在显著差距（Pearson r = 0.075），表明Pass@k排名系统性地歪曲了LLM在软件工程领域的完整性能表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码生成基准仅用单一的Pass@k指标评估功能正确性，忽略了可维护性、效率和代码风格等对软件工程实践者同样重要的质量属性。此外，现有评估几乎全部聚焦于Python，缺乏对C#和.NET等企业级生态系统的专门评估。
AI.method: 构建了自动化多维评估框架，包含三个独立评估维度：通过自动化单元测试评估功能正确性、通过Roslyn AST分析评估静态代码质量、通过对抗性BenchmarkDotNet剖析评估运行时效率。实验基于HumanEval衍生的85个算法任务，对四个LLM生成共340个解决方案进行受控实验。
AI.result: 功能正确性与代码质量属性之间的相关性极低（Pearson r = 0.075），表明高正确性并不等于高质量。同时刻画了GPT特有的双峰失败行为模式。
AI.conclusion: Pass@k等单一指标无法全面反映LLM在软件工程场景中的真实性能，需要采用多维度评估框架来揭示代码生成在不同质量层面的综合表现，尤其应关注企业在C#/.NET生态中的评估需求。

title: A Dual-Expert Strategy Integrating LLMs to Mitigate Negative Transfer in Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
summary: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation (CDSR) predicts the next item a user will interact with based on their historical interaction sequences across multiple domains. Recent approaches leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) finetuned on textual representations of cross-domain user sequences to retrieve the recommended items, referred to as LLMRec. However, LLMRec primarily models the autoregressive patterns of token-level item texts, while overlooking item-level collaborative signals. This semantic misalignment often leads to distorted knowledge transfer across domains-termed negative transfer degrading performance in the CDSR task. To address this issue, we propose a novel LLM-based CDSR model, DuELRec: Domain-Gated Dual Experts with LLMs for Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation. We propose a domain-gated dual-expert framework, equipped with an item-aware attention transformation module, which aggregates textual subtokens into item-level representations and enforces block-level attention masking. The single-domain expert restricts autoregressive attention to items within the same domain, while the cross-domain expert allows it across all domains. A gating mechanism adaptively fuses their outputs, using single-domain signals to reduce cross-domain noise that causes negative transfer. Second, we introduce a dual-sampling token-to-item contrastive learning objective that allows LLMs to capture the item-level collaborative signals from both single- and cross-domains. This is achieved by transforming token-level item texts into item-level representations and applying stochastic negative sampling from both single- and cross-domain item pools for contrastive learning. Extensive experiments on two real-world datasets across ten domains show that our model outperforms 26 state-of-the-art methods in recommendation performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DuELRec，一种基于LLM的跨域序列推荐模型，通过域门控双专家框架和双采样token-to-item对比学习，解决LLMRec在跨域推荐中忽视item级协作信号导致的负迁移问题，在两个真实数据集上超越26个SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLMRec方法主要建模token级别的文本自回归模式，忽视了item级别的协作信号，导致跨域知识迁移时产生语义错位和负迁移现象，从而降低跨域序列推荐性能。
AI.method: 提出域门控双专家框架：(1) item-aware注意力变换模块将文本subtoken聚合成item级表示并实施块级注意力掩码；(2) 单域专家限制同域内自回归注意力，跨域专家允许跨所有域注意力，门控机制自适应融合两者输出以减少跨域噪声；(3) 引入双采样token-to-item对比学习目标，从单域和跨域item池中进行随机负采样，使LLM捕获item级协作信号。
AI.result: 在两个真实数据集（覆盖十个域）上的大量实验表明，DuELRec在推荐性能上优于26个最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过域门控双专家架构和对比学习机制，DuELRec有效缓解了LLMRec中的负迁移问题，提升了跨域序列推荐性能，验证了将item级协作信号融入LLM文本建模的有效性。

title: Evaluation Awareness in Language Models: Representation, Verbalization, and Control
comment: The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Both capability and safety benchmarks rest upon the assumption that the behavior of language models undergoing a test is informative about their behavior in deployment. This assumption can fail, should models infer that they are being evaluated and condition their response on such context. This hypothesis, termed ``evaluation awareness'', has been observed in frontier and open-weight language models alike. We provide a systematic study of this phenomenon, by probing for it across six language models (from four families and three sizes) and three metrics. More precisely, we examine whether (i) being under evaluation is linearly represented within the models' activations space, (ii) it is verbalized in their output tokens (as scored by an LLM-as-judge), and (iii) steering causally affects their behavior. For the open-checkpoint Olmo models, we further test these measures at every training stage. In doing so, we report that evaluation awareness is linearly decodable from the residual streams of every model (best AUROC $\geq 0.7$). By contrast, these representations align only in part with verbalization: their correlations and mutual information are nonzero in some settings, yet vary substantially across models, layers, and readout choices. Nevertheless, steering along probe-derived directions can shift the verbalization scores. Finally, a comparison across the Olmo checkpoints reveals that evaluation awareness is already present within base models, becomes amplified throughout the stages of supervised fine-tuning, and remains stable thereafter---unlike the effects of steering, that grow more pronounced at every successive training stage. These results show the need for evaluations to account for the disjunction between what models represent internally, what they verbalize, and their steering.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了语言模型中的"评估感知"（evaluation awareness）现象，即模型在推理出自己正在被评估时，会基于这一上下文条件化其行为，从而使得基准测试结果不再可靠。研究跨6个模型、3种指标，发现评估感知在内部表征中线性可解码，但与口头化输出只有部分对齐，且可以通过探针引导改变行为。
AI.motivation: 现有的能力和安全基准测试都隐含假设：模型在测试中的行为能反映其部署时的行为。但如果模型能够推断出自己正在被评估并据此调整响应，这一假设就会失效。该现象（即"评估感知"）已在多个前沿和开源模型中观察到，但目前缺乏系统性研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 研究跨6个语言模型（来自4个模型家族、3种规模）和3种指标进行系统探究：（1）评估感知是否在激活空间中呈线性表征（通过线性探针测量AUROC）；（2）是否在输出token中被口头化（由LLM-as-judge评分）；（3）沿探针方向进行steering是否因果性地影响行为。对于开放检查点的Olmo模型，还在每个训练阶段测试这些指标。
AI.result: 评估感知在所有模型的残差流中均可线性解码（最佳AUROC≥0.7）。但内部表征与口头化仅部分对齐：相关性和互信息在某些设置下非零，但在不同模型、层和读出选择间差异显著。沿探针方向steering可以改变口头化分数。Olmo检查点对比显示：评估感知在基座模型中已存在，在监督微调阶段被放大，之后保持稳定；而steering效应在每个后续训练阶段都更显著。
AI.conclusion: 评估必须考虑模型内部表征、口头化输出和steering之间的脱节。评估感知现象揭示了现有基准测试的内在局限性，需要新的评估方法来应对模型可能基于评估上下文调整行为的风险。

title: Complexity Induction: Compositional Generalization via Structured Label Distortion
summary: We demonstrate that structured distortion of training data - which we term complexity induction - can induce compositional generalization in a standard CNN classifier without architectural modification. Using synthetic images of colored geometric shapes, we encode classes as flat string labels (e.g., "red-circle") with no explicit attribute decomposition, and exclude certain color-shape combinations from training entirely. We apply two distortion methods derived from Jaccard string similarity between class names: mixed labels (soft target distributions encoding inter-class overlap) and expanded dataset (false training samples with structurally motivated incorrect labels). Both methods induce the ability to predict unseen class combinations, and act at different levels: mixed labels activate the classifier for unseen combinations by exploiting the CNN's natural embedding structure, while expanded training improves the embedding factorization itself. A control with random (unstructured) false labels confirms that the effect depends on the structure of the distortion, not on noise per se. These results suggest that structured complication of training signals can influence both the internal organization of learned representations and their compositional interpretation - a principle that may underlie the role of natural language in cognitive development.

AI.tldr: 本文证明通过对训练数据进行结构化扭曲（称为"复杂度诱导"），无需修改架构即可使标准CNN分类器获得组合泛化能力。使用合成彩色几何形状图像，将类别编码为扁平字符串标签（如"red-circle"），并排除部分颜色-形状组合。两种基于Jaccard字符串相似度的扭曲方法（混合标签和扩展数据集）都能诱导模型预测未见过的组合，且作用层面不同。
AI.motivation: 探究CNN分类器能否在不改变架构的情况下获得组合泛化能力，以及结构化训练信号扭曲（而非随机噪声）如何影响模型的内部表征组织和组合解释能力，并探讨这一原则与自然语言在认知发展中作用的潜在联系。
AI.method: 使用合成彩色几何形状图像，设置扁平字符串标签（无显式属性分解），排除特定颜色-形状组合。应用两种基于Jaccard字符串相似度的扭曲方法：(1) 混合标签——将类别间重叠编码为软目标分布；(2) 扩展数据集——添加具有结构化错误标签的假训练样本。同时设置随机（非结构化）错误标签作为对照。
AI.result: 两种扭曲方法均能诱导对未见类别组合的预测能力，但作用机制不同：混合标签通过利用CNN自然嵌入结构激活未组合类别的分类器；扩展数据集则改善嵌入本身的因子分解。对照实验表明效果依赖于扭曲的结构性而非噪声本身。
AI.conclusion: 结构化训练信号的复杂度可以影响学习表征的内部组织和组合解释，这一原则可能解释了自然语言在认知发展中所扮演的角色。研究为理解组合泛化机制提供了新视角，无需架构修改即可实现。

title: Reaching the Tail: Calibration Diversity Drives Conformal Coverage under Data Scarcity
comment: Accepted for presentation at the GlobalSouthAI D&I Workshop at IJCAI 2026, Held in Bremen Germany on 17th August 2026
summary: Multi-horizon rare-event forecasting is hard under long macroeconomic series' data constraints: labeled events are scarce, and standard uncertainty quantification assumes an exchangeability that autocorrelation violates. A controlled ablation shows an apparent rare-event threshold for Adaptive Conformal Inference instead reflects calibration-set size. Across 200 random calibration sets, support width of the nonconformity-score distribution explains up to 85% of coverage variance versus 2% for rare-event count; the same, not the same magnitude, replicates across synthetic conditions and five countries (five-country Spearman $ρ$ 0.45-0.66 vs. 0.02-0.23). A diversity-maximizing selector built on this is the only strategy tested that improves long-horizon coverage (67.8% to 81.4% at six months); Mondrian, shift-robust, and extreme-value alternatives fail to close it. Mondrian even worsens coverage under oracle labels. A compact proposition explains why: coverage deficit reflects how closely the calibration set's upper quantile reaches the test distribution's. Diversity is necessary, not sufficient. Demonstrated on a two-stage U.S. recession-forecasting framework with RegressorChain, whether six-month coverage reaches 90% under honest scoring remains open, a question this paper quantifies rather than resolves.

AI.tldr: 本文针对宏观经济长序列下多时间跨度罕见事件预测的难题，通过受控消融实验揭示：自适应共形推断（ACI）表观上的"罕见事件阈值"实为校准集大小的反映。非一致性得分分布的支撑宽度（而非罕见事件数量）解释了高达85%的覆盖率方差。基于此构建的多样性最大化选择器是唯一能在长期跨度上提升覆盖率的策略（六个月从67.8%提升至81.4%），而Mondrian、移位鲁棒和极值方法均无法弥合差距。
AI.motivation: 宏观经济长序列中的多时间跨度罕见事件预测面临双重困境：标记事件稀缺，且标准不确定性量化依赖的交换性假设被自相关性违背。现有方法缺乏对覆盖率缺陷根源的系统性理解，需要澄清罕见事件数量与校准集结构对预测区间覆盖率的真实影响机制。
AI.method: 采用受控消融实验将"罕见事件阈值"与校准集大小解耦；在200个随机校准集上分析非一致性得分分布支撑宽度与覆盖率方差的关系；提出多样性最大化选择器，并与Mondrian、移位鲁棒、极值方法对比；通过一个紧凑命题解释覆盖率缺陷的机制——覆盖率缺口反映校准集上分位数逼近测试分布的程度；在含RegressorChain的两阶段美国衰退预测框架中验证。
AI.result: 支撑宽度解释高达85%的覆盖率方差，而罕见事件计数仅解释2%；该结论在合成条件和五国数据上复现（五国Spearman ρ: 0.45-0.66 vs 0.02-0.23）。多样性最大化选择器是唯一改善长期覆盖率的方法（六月覆盖率67.8%→81.4%）；Mondrian甚至在有oracle标签时恶化覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖率缺陷的根源在于校准集上分位数与测试分布的接近程度；多样性是必要条件而非充分条件。六个月覆盖率在诚实评分下能否达到90%仍是开放问题，本文量化而非解决了这一问题。

title: Let Credit Follow Computation: Architecture-Aware Credit Transport for Large Language Model Reinforcement Learning
summary: Credit assignment in large-language-model reinforcement learning (LLM RL) can be separated into three objects: evidence about success, a transport operator that converts this evidence into token-level advantages, and an update geometry that turns advantages into policy changes. Recent work has greatly improved evidence, sampling, and update geometry, but the transport operator is usually architecture-agnostic. Fixed-discount GAE applies a stationary geometric kernel along token time; group-relative methods broadcast an outcome statistic across an entire response. Neither operator represents the trajectory-specific computation used by the Transformer policy itself. We introduce computation-conditioned credit transport (CCT), a general framework in which a detached statistic of the behavior policy's internal computation parameterizes the causal kernel that transports downstream value through a rollout. Our concrete algorithm, CompPO, maps native attention concentration to a bounded per-token retention gate, uses the gate in both the one-step bootstrap and a path-dependent generalized-advantage trace (Comp-GAE), and co-designs a transport-aligned critic (TAC) that reuses the actor's hidden states and routing information without a second same-scale Transformer. The task reward and clipped PPO policy objective remain unchanged; a constant gate recovers fixed-coefficient GAE. Across five Qwen3-4B seeds, CompPO reaches 61.4% final held-out accuracy (95% CI [60.8,62.0]) versus 53.8% [52.9,54.7] for tuned GRPO. Neither Comp-GAE with a standard critic (55.2%) nor TAC with a fixed gate (56.4%) matches the full model (interaction +2.4 [1.9,2.9]). Shuffle and position controls confirm trajectory-specific alignment; CompPO is stable in 10/12 PPO-grid runs versus 3/12. Frozen evaluation improves over GRPO by 4.3 and 3.9 greedy pass@1 macro points on Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.

AI.tldr: 本文提出计算条件信用传输（CCT）框架和CompPO算法，利用策略模型内部计算（注意力集中度）参数化因果核来传输token级优势，替代架构无关的固定折扣GAE或组相对方法，在Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.1-8B上显著优于GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM RL的信用分配中，证据、采样和更新几何已被大幅改进，但传输算子通常是架构无关的——固定折扣GAE使用静态几何核，组相对方法广播结果统计量，两者都无法表征Transformer策略自身使用的轨迹特定计算。作者旨在设计一个能反映策略内部计算的信用传输机制。
AI.method: 提出CCT框架，将行为策略内部计算的分离统计量作为参数化因果核的输入。具体算法CompPO包括：1）将原生注意力集中度映射为有界逐token保留门；2）该门同时用于一步bootstrap和路径依赖的广义优势迹（Comp-GAE）；3）协同设计传输对齐评论家（TAC），复用actor的隐藏状态和路由信息，无需第二个同规模Transformer。任务奖励和裁剪PPO策略目标保持不变，常数门可退化为固定系数GAE。
AI.result: 在五个Qwen3-4B种子上，CompPO达到61.4%最终保留准确率（95% CI [60.8,62.0]），而调优GRPO为53.8% [52.9,54.7]。消融研究表明，单独使用Comp-GAE搭配标准评论家（55.2%）或TAC搭配固定门（56.4%）均无法匹敌完整模型（交互+2.4 [1.9,2.9]）。CompPO在10/12的PPO网格运行中稳定，而GRPO仅3/12。冻结评估在Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上分别比GRPO高出4.3和3.9个贪心pass@1宏平均分。
AI.conclusion: 计算条件信用传输证明了将策略模型内部计算纳入信用分配的价值：轨迹特定的注意力门控传输算子比架构无关基线更有效且更稳定。两个组件的协同作用（Comp-GAE与TAC交互）对最终性能至关重要，单独的任一组件都无法达到完整效果。

title: Do Not Copy/Paste: Soft Barriers for Copying in AI-Assisted Programming
summary: Copying a function from a chat window into an editor takes less than a second. For many uses of AI coding tools, that speed is the point; in settings such as programming education, code review, and security-sensitive development, it can also be the problem. This paper frames copy-paste as an \emph{AI code handoff problem}: the moment model-generated text crosses from a conversational context into executable or committed software is a design boundary that current tools leave largely unmanaged. We argue that AI coding assistants should not only be evaluated by the code they generate, but also by how they mediate the transfer of that code into software artifacts. We propose \emph{soft barriers} as one class of handoff-aware mechanisms. Soft barriers preserve access to AI assistance while making unexamined transfer less frictionless. As an initial technical probe, we instantiate this idea using Unicode output perturbations that preserve visual readability but disrupt naive copy-paste execution. We introduce Copy-Paste Resistance (CPR), the fraction of functionally correct clean solutions that become syntactically invalid after perturbation. Across HumanEval and MBPP with four LLMs and four perturbation families, we find that output-level barriers can achieve high copy-paste resistance, but their effectiveness is highly model- and task-dependent. An exploratory pilot with 18 participants provides early evidence that soft barriers can shift users from direct transfer toward editing and reconstruction. We do not present Unicode perturbations as a deployment-ready solution; rather, we use them as a minimal probe for a broader research agenda on practical, transparent, and policy-aware AI code handoff.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"AI代码交接"问题——模型生成的文本从对话上下文复制到可执行软件的过程是当前工具未管理的设计边界。作者提出"软屏障"机制作为交接感知方案，通过保持视觉可读但破坏直接复制执行的Unicode扰动来阻止未经审查的代码转移，并引入Copy-Paste Resistance (CPR)指标进行评估。
AI.motivation: AI编码工具中复制粘贴仅需不到一秒，这在编程教育、代码审查和安全敏感开发场景中构成风险——未经审查的AI生成代码被直接复制到软件制品中。当前工具只评估代码生成质量，未管理代码从对话到软件制品的转移过程。
AI.method: 提出"软屏障"机制，通过Unicode输出扰动保持视觉可读但使直接复制粘贴执行失败；引入Copy-Paste Resistance (CPR)指标（功能正确的干净解决方案在扰动后变为语法无效的比例）；在HumanEval和MBPP数据集上使用4个LLM和4种扰动族进行实验，并开展18人参与的探索性试点研究。
AI.result: 输出级屏障可实现高复制粘贴抵抗力，但其有效性高度依赖模型和任务；18人试点研究表明软屏障能将用户从直接转移转向编辑和重构行为。但Unicode扰动并非部署就绪的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 本文不是提出部署级方案，而是将Unicode扰动用作为更广泛研究议程的极小探针，呼吁关注实用、透明、政策感知的AI代码交接机制设计。

title: The Disconnect Between Better Descriptive Reasoning Trace Quality and Recommendation Effectiveness
comment: Accepted at the Recsys'26 Workshop on Agentic and Generative AI for E-Commerce
summary: Recent work has focused on improving explicit natural-language descriptive reasoning traces for generative recommendation. This includes systems that augment semantic ID (SID) prediction with chain-of-thought reasoning. However, because SIDs are opaque learned identifiers rather than natural language, they require costly alignment before an LLM can reason over them. This provides a controlled experimental setting in which both item representation (Title vs. SID) and semantic grounding (minimal vs. extensive SID alignment) can be varied independently. We therefore present the first controlled comparison of descriptive reasoning trace quality across semantic IDs and natural-language titles in a 2 x 2 factorial study on three Amazon product domains using a shared Qwen3-1.7B backbone. We find that introducing explicit descriptive reasoning traces reduces traditional offline recommendation effectiveness under standard SFT and RL training, even though natural language titles produce substantially more grounded and interpretable traces. Extensive SID alignment improves descriptive trace quality but not traditional offline recommendation effectiveness, while a richer reward signal partially recovers performance. Overall, our results show that improving descriptive reasoning trace quality is not, by itself, sufficient to consistently improve traditional offline recommendation effectiveness under the training objectives and evaluation protocols studied here.

AI.tldr: 本文通过2×2因子实验（物品表示：Title vs. SID；语义锚定：最小 vs. 广泛SID对齐），在三个Amazon产品域上比较了生成式推荐中描述性推理轨迹的质量。研究发现，引入显式描述性推理轨迹会降低传统离线推荐效果，即使自然语言标题能产生更扎实可解释的轨迹；广泛的SID对齐能提升轨迹质量但无助于离线推荐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有工作致力于提升生成式推荐中的自然语言描述性推理轨迹，包括将语义ID（SID）预测与链式思维推理结合。但由于SID是晦涩的学习型标识符而非自然语言，需要昂贵的对齐成本才能让LLM在其上进行推理，目前缺乏对SID与自然语言标题在不同条件下推理轨迹质量的受控比较。
AI.method: 设计了2×2因子实验（物品表示：Title vs. SID；语义锚定：最小 vs. 广泛SID对齐），在三个Amazon产品域上使用共享的Qwen3-1.7B骨干模型，在标准SFT和RL训练下进行受控比较。
AI.result: 1) 引入显式描述性推理轨迹会降低传统离线推荐效果；2) 自然语言标题产生的轨迹更扎实且可解释；3) 广泛SID对齐改善轨迹质量但不改善离线推荐效果；4) 更丰富的奖励信号可部分恢复性能。
AI.conclusion: 提高描述性推理轨迹质量本身不足以在studied的训练目标和评估协议下持续改善传统离线推荐效果，暗示生成式推荐的改进需关注更本质的目标设计。

title: No One Model Catches Every Harm: Benchmarking Content Moderation Across Safety Scenarios
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet they remain vulnerable to generating harmful content. From adversarial jailbreaks that bypass safety filters to implicit hate that evades detection, the range of risks these models pose continues to grow. While both specialized content moderators and general-purpose LLMs are being used as safety layers, the question of which model is best suited for which type of harmful content remains unanswered. We present the most comprehensive evaluation of LLM safety capabilities to date, systematically testing \textbf{53} models across \textbf{11} datasets that we organize into four distinct categories. Our evaluation under both prompt-only and prompt-response settings uncovers critical blind spots: large frontier models that lead on one category fall significantly behind smaller, specialized alternatives on others, and real-world conversational safety remains largely unsolved across all model families. These findings challenge the assumption that scale alone ensures safety, and provide the community with a structured framework for informed model selection.

AI.tldr: 本文对53个大型语言模型在11个数据集（分为四类）上的安全能力进行了迄今最全面的评估，分别在仅提示词和提示词-回复两种设置下测试，发现前沿大模型在某些安全类别上可能落后于较小的专门化模型，且真实对话场景的安全问题在所有模型家族中仍未解决，挑战了"规模即安全"的假设。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在实际应用中存在生成有害内容的风险（包括对抗性越狱和隐性仇恨等），虽然已有专门内容审核器和通用大模型被用作安全层，但目前缺乏系统性的答案：哪种模型最适合处理哪种类型的有害内容。
AI.method: 对53个模型进行系统评估，覆盖11个数据集并将其组织为四类有害内容类别；在提示词仅限和提示词-回复两种设置下进行测试，以全面比较各模型的安全能力。
AI.result: 发现了关键盲点：前瞻性的前沿大模型在某些类别上显著落后于较小但专门化的替代模型；真实世界对话安全在所有模型家族中基本未得到解决。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现挑战了仅靠模型规模就能确保安全性的假设，并提供了一个结构化的框架，帮助社区在选择模型时做出更明智的决策。

title: 3D Point Cloud from Close-Range Photogrammetry for Defect Characterisation of Rubberised Concrete
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Published in the International Archives of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences, XXV ISPRS Congress 2026, Toronto, Canada
summary: While three-dimensional (3D) point clouds are widely used in civil engineering, mainstream LiDAR systems such as Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) are physically constrained to laboratory environments. Since their laser spot size typically exceeds the width of microcracks, the beam physically bridges over voids, rendering TLS unsuitable for fine-scale defect analysis. Alternatively, close-range photogrammetry utilising Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and Multi-View Stereo (MVS) algorithms offers a solution for testing highly tortuous materials, and its utility at fine-scale remains underexplored. This study adapts photogrammetric workflows specifically for rubberised concrete (RuC), a sustainable composite exhibiting high ductility and complex fracture morphologies. High-resolution image sets were captured using a Canon DSLR and an iPhone 16 to generate dense 3D models. Comparisons revealed that the DSLR-based reconstruction achieved sub-millimetre resolution, demonstrating superior performance for fine-scale surface monitoring. An RGB-guided crack extraction method was developed to enhance the identification of surface defects and isolate potential crack areas from the background. The extracted crack regions were visually distinguishable and provided a well-structured geometrical representation of defect morphology. Furthermore, a Pre and Post-Test deformation analysis was conducted to quantify surface displacement across testing stages. The results confirm that this close-range photogrammetry workflow is a flexible, high-resolution alternative to LiDAR for surface inspection and deformation monitoring of specimens in laboratory settings. Ultimately, this approach establishes a robust geometric baseline for future automated 3D feature characterisation and material performance evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一套针对橡胶混凝土（RuC）的近距离摄影测量工作流程，利用DSLR和iPhone 16拍摄高分辨率图像生成密集3D模型，实现亚毫米级别的表面裂纹检测和变形监测，作为实验室环境中TLS激光扫描的灵活替代方案。
AI.motivation: 传统TLS激光扫描系统受限于实验室环境，其激光光斑尺寸超过微裂纹宽度，无法用于细尺度缺陷分析；而基于SfM和MVS算法的近距离摄影测量在细尺度材料测试中的应用潜力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1) 采用Canon DSLR和iPhone 16拍摄高分辨率图像集生成密集3D模型；2) 开发RGB引导的裂纹提取方法，增强表面缺陷识别并将潜在裂纹区域从背景中分离；3) 进行测试前后变形分析以量化不同测试阶段的地表位移。
AI.result: DSLR重建实现了亚毫米级分辨率，在细尺度表面监测方面表现优于iPhone；提取的裂纹区域视觉上可区分，提供了良好的缺陷形态几何表征；测试前后变形分析成功量化了表面位移。
AI.conclusion: 近距离摄影测量工作流程是实验室环境中LiDAR的一种灵活、高分辨率的替代方案，适用于表面检查和变形监测，为未来自动化3D特征表征和材料性能评估建立了稳健的几何基线。

title: Subzero matrix completion for sparse data analysis: large-scale learning of latent low-rank structure
summary: We investigate when a sparse nonnegative matrix can be recovered from a real-valued matrix of much lower rank by zeroing out its negative elements. The potential for such decompositions suggests a mathematical connection between sparsity and rank; we analyze a number of sparse matrices with this latent low-rank structure and use them to illustrate the geometric origins of this connection. Previous algorithms have discovered these decompositions via an alternating minimization over the factors of a low-rank matrix, but to do so, they have also needed to compute and store another matrix, neither sparse nor low-rank, that is the size of their product. We develop a stochastic, alternating least-squares algorithm that operates on smaller blocks of this dense matrix and scales as a result to much larger problems. We also show how to further accelerate this algorithm with sparse optimizations and customized CUDA kernels. As one example, we use the algorithm to analyze the sparse matrix of synaptic weights for the recently published $\textit{Drosphilia}$ connectome. The nonzero elements of this matrix, with 139,255 rows and columns, record the number of synapses between cells in the nervous system of a female fruit fly. Despite a slowly decaying spectrum of singular values, this matrix exhibits a latent low-rank structure that is predictive of cell categories across multiple levels of specificity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何通过将低秩矩阵的负元素置零来恢复稀疏非负矩阵，提出了一种基于随机交替最小二乘的算法，该算法通过在稠密矩阵的小块上操作来扩展规模，并利用稀疏优化和CUDA内核加速，最终成功应用于果蝇连接组突触权重矩阵的分析。
AI.motivation: 探索稀疏性与秩之间的数学联系，解决现有交替最小化算法需要计算和存储既不稀疏也不低秩的大尺寸矩阵（与乘积矩阵同尺寸）的计算瓶颈问题。
AI.method: 开发了一种随机交替最小二乘算法，该算法在稠密矩阵的较小块上操作而非整个矩阵，从而扩展到更大规模的问题；同时结合稀疏优化和定制的CUDA内核进一步加速。
AI.result: 算法成功分析了果蝇连接组中139,255×139,255的稀疏突触权重矩阵，尽管其奇异值谱衰减缓慢，但表现出可预测多层级细胞类别的潜在低秩结构。
AI.conclusion: 该算法使得低秩先验方法能够扩展到更大规模的实际问题，并展示了在神经科学数据（如实测连接组）中发现有意义潜在结构的应用价值。

title: Quantifying geographic domain shift to decouple the geospatial transferability of human mobility flow generation models
summary: Human mobility serves as an essential proxy for understanding social, economic, and environmental dynamics in urban systems. Geospatial transferability, which measures a model's capability in a new location or unseen region, is a critical dimension for comparing different human mobility generation models. However, few studies have studied the intrinsic characteristics of geospatial transferability. To this end, this study systematically investigates the geospatial transferability of four representative human mobility generation models using a large-scale benchmark dataset of census tract level commuting flows across 2265 counties in the United States. Inspired by the domain adaptation theory in machine learning, we introduce geographic domain shift to describe the intrinsic differences in geographic feature distributions and spatial structures between source and target regions, which may jointly affect model transferability. Moreover, we propose two metrics, mutual information and spatial shift, to quantify the geographic domain shift. To examine their associations with model transferability, we employ linear mixed-effects regression to analyze the associations between geographic domain shifts and transferability. Our results reveal substantial spatial heterogeneity and asymmetry in transfer performance across regions. Both information shift and spatial shift exhibit statistically significant and complementary explanatory power. This indicates that geospatial transferability depends not only on model design but also on intrinsic geographic differences. These findings provide a novel methodological framework for evaluating and improving the geospatial transferability of human mobility generation models and support more robust and fair human mobility data synthesis across diverse regions. It also offers insights on spatial transferability for GeoAI model development.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了四种人类移动性生成模型的地理空间可迁移性，利用美国2265个县的通勤流基准数据，引入地理域偏移概念（包含互信息和空间偏移两个指标），并通过线性混合效应回归验证了模型可迁移性既受模型设计影响，也受地理区域间内在差异的显著影响。
AI.motivation: 地理空间可迁移性是评估人类移动性生成模型的关键维度，但现有研究很少深入探究其内在特征和影响因素，缺乏系统性的量化框架来理解模型在不同区域间的迁移表现。
AI.method: 采用大规模基准数据集（美国2265个县的通勤流），基于域适应理论引入地理域偏移概念，提出互信息和空间偏移两个量化指标，并运用线性混合效应回归分析这些指标与模型可迁移性之间的关联。
AI.result: 研究发现模型迁移性能存在显著的空间异质性和不对称性；信息偏移和空间偏移均具有统计学上显著且互补的解释力，表明地理空间可迁移性同时依赖于模型设计和内在地理差异。
AI.conclusion: 提出了评估和改进人类移动性生成模型地理空间可迁移性的新方法框架，支持跨区域更稳健、更公平的移动性数据合成，并为GeoAI模型的空间可迁移性开发提供了见解。

title: Evaluating Inference-Time Defenses Against Package Hallucination in LLM-Generated Code
summary:
LLMs are increasingly used for code generation, yet they frequently hallucinate non-existent software packages, creating exploitable entry points into the software supply chain. We make four contributions to this problem. First, we show that prior evaluation methodologies systematically inflate hallucination rates by misclassifying standard-library modules as hallucinations in some languages. For Python, the overestimation reaches 9.4 percentage points. Second, we evaluate seven inference-time defenses for mitigating package hallucinations, including five guided decoding strategies (Greedy, Contrastive, DoLa, Nudging, and Active Layer-Contrastive Decoding), an iterative self-refinement approach (Self-Refine), and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based defense.. Across eight models spanning five families and four programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Rust), RAG reduces the package hallucination rate (PHR) in 18 of 32 model--language configurations. Third, we introduce Package Utility (PU) to assess whether defenses preserve valid and task-relevant recommendations. Among strategies evaluated, Greedy decoding provides the strongest average mitigation--utility trade-off. Fourth, we stress-test all strategies under adversarial prompts seeded with fabricated package names and find that PHR surges by up to 45 percentage points relative to standard prompts, with Ruby consistently the most vulnerable language (80.9--95.2\%). Under adversarial conditions, RAG and Self-Refine outperform all decoding-only strategies, indicating that robust defense requires either external grounding or iterative self-verification when prompts are actively hostile.
  Our results recast package hallucination as both a measurement problem and a decoding-time control problem, and they demonstrate that the choice of defense must be matched to the threat model and recommendation utility.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了LLM代码生成中的软件包幻觉问题，指出先前评估方法在Python中高估了9.4个百分点的幻觉率，并评估了七种推理时防御策略在跨8个模型、5个家族和4种编程语言上的效果。结果显示RAG在18/32配置中降低了包幻觉率，Greedy解码在缓解效果与工具效用间取得最佳平衡，而在对抗性提示下PHR飙升最多45个百分点，RAG和Self-Refine优于仅解码策略。
AI.motivation: LLM在代码生成中频繁幻觉出不存在的软件包，这为软件供应链创造了可利用的漏洞入口。先前评估方法存在系统性偏差（将标准库误分类为幻觉），且缺乏对不同防御策略的系统比较，需要重新审视测量方法和防御手段。
AI.method: 论文做了四个贡献：(1) 指出先前评估方法在部分语言中误将标准库模块分类为幻觉，Python的过估计达9.4个百分点；(2) 评估七种推理时防御策略，包括五种引导解码（Greedy、Contrastive、DoLa、Nudging、Active Layer-Contrastive Decoding）、Self-Refine和RAG；(3) 引入Package Utility (PU)指标评估防御策略是否保留有效且任务相关的推荐；(4) 在植入虚构包名的对抗性提示下对所有策略进行压力测试。
AI.result: RAG在32个模型-语言配置中的18个配置中降低了包幻觉率(PHR)；Greedy解码在平均缓解-效用权衡中表现最强；在对抗性提示下PHR相对于标准提示飙升最多45个百分点，Ruby是最脆弱的语言（80.9-95.2%幻觉率）；对抗条件下RAG和Self-Refine优于所有纯解码策略。
AI.conclusion: 包幻觉既是测量问题也是解码时控制问题，防御策略的选择必须与威胁模型和推荐效用相匹配。当提示具有敌意时，需要外部知识基础（RAG）或迭代自我验证（Self-Refine）来实现稳健防御。

title: Evaluating Modern RAG: Textual, Multimodal, Dense, and Late Interaction Pipelines
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems have traditionally relied on text-based pipelines that extract and retrieve information from documents. While efficient and lightweight, these approaches often struggle with documents where meaning is conveyed through layout, tables, and visual elements. Recent advances in multimodal pipelines, powered by vision-language models (VLMs), improve retrieval quality by jointly encoding visual and textual signals, but at increased computational and memory cost. We propose a quantitative, data-driven selection methodology that guides practitioners in choosing the most appropriate RAG pipeline for a given document corpus based on empirical effectiveness and resource constraints. We evaluate contemporary textual and multimodal pipelines, including dense and late-interaction architectures, analyze their trade-offs, and provide actionable guidance for balancing retrieval performance with system efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的定量选择方法论，帮助实践者根据经验效果和资源约束，在文本RAG管线与多模态RAG管线之间做出合适的选择，并评估了包括稠密检索和晚期交互架构在内的多种当代管线。
AI.motivation: 传统文本RAG管线在涉及布局、表格和视觉元素的文档上效果不佳，而多模态管线虽然有更好的检索质量，但计算和内存成本显著增加。缺乏系统性的方法来指导实践者在两者之间做出权衡选择。
AI.method: 提出一种定量、数据驱动的选择方法论，综合考虑经验有效性和资源约束；对当代文本与多模态RAG管线（包括稠密检索和晚期交互架构）进行系统性评估，分析各自在检索性能与系统效率之间的权衡。
AI.result: 提供了文本管线与多模态管线的对比分析结果，揭示了不同架构在检索质量和资源消耗上的权衡，并给出了可操作的指导建议。
AI.conclusion: 本文为实践者提供了基于实证数据的RAG管线选择框架，使其能够根据具体文档语料特征和资源预算，在检索性能与系统效率之间做出权衡决策。

title: Lexical Coupling in GUI Element Grounding: Sentence Embeddings Track Labels across Mobile and Web
summary: GUI grounding evaluations that expose UI elements as text metadata often treat high instruction-element embedding similarity as evidence of semantic grounding. Across three mobile and web benchmarks, we show that this interpretation is frequently confounded by visible-label recovery. Lexical baselines remain competitive at top-1, label-poor targets remain weak for text-only methods, and encoder top-1 hits are predictable from lexical rank, candidate-pool size, and label type. We evaluate each action as a same-screen ranking task, comparing five off-the-shelf single-vector encoders with lexical baselines. Encoders recover some lexical misses, but deployable fusion gains are much smaller than target-aware oracle gains. These findings show that embedding-based evaluations can conflate visible-label recovery with semantic GUI grounding. Embedding-based evaluations should therefore report lexical baselines, label-type stratification, and deployable-fusion diagnostics. Our released repository provides analysis scripts and detexted per-step panels: https://github.com/qijia123/lexical-coupling-release.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了GUI grounding评估中嵌入相似度与语义grounding之间的混淆问题。通过三个移动和Web基准测试，作者发现文本元数据评估常被可见标签恢复所干扰，词汇基线表现与编码器相当甚至更优。研究建议评估应报告词汇基线、标签类型分层和可部署融合诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI grounding评估将指令-元素嵌入相似度视为语义grounding的证据，但这种解释可能被可见标签恢复（即模型仅通过匹配界面上的可见文本标签来完成指令）所混淆，导致对嵌入方法能力的错误估计。
AI.method: 将每个动作视为同屏排序任务，在三个移动和Web基准上比较五种现成单向量编码器与词汇基线。通过词汇排名、候选池大小和标签类型分析top-1命中率的可预测性；评估编码器对词汇漏检的恢复能力；对比可部署融合增益与目标感知的oracle增益。
AI.result: 词汇基线在top-1上保持竞争力；标签稀缺目标对纯文本方法仍然薄弱；编码器top-1命中可从词汇排名、候选池大小和标签类型预测。编码器能恢复部分词汇漏检，但可部署融合增益远小于目标感知的oracle增益，表明嵌入评估常将可见标签恢复与语义GUI grounding混为一谈。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入评估应报告词汇基线和标签类型分层，并包含可部署融合诊断。作者发布了包含分析脚本和去文本化逐步面板的代码仓库以支持后续研究。

title: EXPL-FR: Explaining Face Recognition Models via Vision-Language Alignment
summary: Deep face recognition (FR) models reach near-saturated accuracy but remain opaque: a practitioner cannot ask which semantic attributes a similarity score relied upon. EXPL-FR answers this inside the FR model's own embedding space. A lightweight adapter aligns a vision-language model's (VLM) image encoder with the frozen FR space, trained on face images alone and never on text. Because the VLM's encoders share one space, the same adapter applies to the text encoder, turning 978 attribute prompts in 22 categories, also extendable, into FR-space anchors at no extra cost. We do not assume this transfer works: a face-verification protocol measures it, and an ablation changing only the adapter isolates its contribution. Not every concept survives, because an FR model earns its invariances by discarding the factors it must verify identities across. A label-free detectability measure compares each concept's separability in FR space against the VLM space, and the 100 most detectable form the model's readable semantic signature, which separates identities better than the full vocabulary. We cover four FR backbones and two VLM encoders, EXPL-FR needs no architecture access, and supports identity-level, per-image, and differential explanations. We benchmark attribute-level auditing under three supervision settings, human labels (current practice), VLM pseudo-labels, and our fully prompt-driven audit, against real verification behavior. With no labels, the prompt-driven audit ranks four FR models by their measured per-ethnicity RFW errors and ranks controlled attribute changes by their true verification cost.

AI.tldr: EXPL-FR 是一种无需架构访问即可解释深度人脸识别模型的方法，通过在冻结的 FR 嵌入空间中用轻量适配器对齐 VLM 图像编码器，将文本提示转化为 FR 空间锚点，实现属性级、身份级和逐图像的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 深度人脸识别模型虽然准确率接近饱和，但其决策过程不透明，实践者无法得知相似度分数依赖了哪些语义属性，缺乏可解释性工具。
AI.method: 利用 VLM 图像编码器与文本编码器共享嵌入空间的特性，通过轻量适配器将 VLM 图像编码器与冻结的 FR 空间对齐，仅用面部图像训练且不涉及文本，从而将 978 个属性提示（22 类，可扩展）映射为 FR 空间锚点。提出标签无关的可检测性度量，选出前 100 个可检测概念作为模型的语义签名，支持身份级、逐图像和差分解释。
AI.result: 覆盖四个 FR 骨干网络和两个 VLM 编码器。无标签的提示驱动审计能够对四个 FR 模型按实测的按族裔 RFW 错误率排序，并能按真实验证成本对受控属性变化排序，其排序能力优于完整词表。
AI.conclusion: EXPL-FR 证明了可以以纯提示驱动、无监督的方式对 FR 模型进行可靠的语义审计，且不需要任何架构访问，为黑盒 FR 模型提供了一种实用且可扩展的解释途径。

title: FrugalSOT - Frugal Search Over the Models
summary: In on-device NLP tasks, limited resources of embedded hardware, such as the Raspberry Pi 5, require efficient inference strategies. This paper introduces FrugalSOT (Frugal Search Over The Models), a resource-aware model selection architecture for on-device NLP inference. FrugalSOT estimates each request's complexity by extracting features such as prompt length, named entity density, and syntactic complexity. The request is first made to the least complex model that is likely to pass a relevance threshold. If the output of that model falls short of the threshold, the request is made to a more complex model. It is important to note that the relevance threshold undergoes continuous updates in the background. using past validation outcomes in an adaptation process using a low-pass filtering mechanism, thus imparting adaptation to changing input patterns. Experimental results achieved on a Raspberry Pi 5 show that FrugalSOT reduces average inference time and overall computational resource use to a significant extent compared to a single-model baseline approach, without compromising output relevance to the same extent as the most sophisticated model. These results confirm that adaptive model selection can enable efficient, high-quality natural language processing inference on limited devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FrugalSOT，一种面向端侧NLP推理的资源感知模型选择架构。它通过评估请求复杂度，先调用最简单的模型，若输出未达相关性阈值再升级到更复杂模型，并通过低通滤波机制持续自适应更新阈值。在树莓派5上的实验表明，相比单一模型基线，FrugalSOT显著降低了平均推理时间和整体计算资源消耗，同时保持了较高的输出相关性。
AI.motivation: 端侧NLP任务受嵌入式硬件（如树莓派5）有限资源限制，需要在保证推理质量的同时提高推理效率，现有单模型策略难以同时兼顾性能与资源消耗。
AI.method: FrugalSOT采用资源感知的模型选择架构：(1) 通过提取提示长度、命名实体密度、句法复杂度等特征估计请求复杂度；(2) 先从最简单的模型开始推理，若输出低于相关性阈值则升级到更复杂模型；(3) 通过低通滤波机制，利用历史验证结果持续在后台更新相关性阈值，以适应变化的输入模式。
AI.result: 在树莓派5上的实验表明，与单一模型基线相比，FrugalSOT显著减少了平均推理时间和整体计算资源使用，同时输出相关性未明显下降，接近最复杂模型的质量水平。
AI.conclusion: 自适应模型选择能够在不牺牲过多输出质量的前提下，在资源受限设备上实现高效、高质量的NLP推理，验证了该方法的可行性与有效性。

title: A Reproducible, License-Aware Distillation Recipe for CPUDeployable Safety Classification
summary: Deploying a safety layer for large language models on commodity hardware is constrained by the guards available to do it: current open guard models hold between 1 and 9 billion parameters, are oriented toward the graphics processing unit, and answer in seconds per request on a central processing unit. This paper presents a reproducible, license-aware knowledge-distillation recipe addressing that constraint. A strong open guard labels a corpus of roughly 97,000 prompts, drawn from 24 public datasets, into seven safety categories aligned to a public hazard taxonomy, and a fleet of small students spanning lexical, shallow, encoder and generative architectures is trained to reproduce that signal. The corpus is partitioned at the license boundary, so that a deployable and a research model differ only in their training data and the cost of that restriction becomes measurable. Every model is scored against an independent gold benchmark of 6,361 rows over four slices, labeled apart from the teacher and including a slice of harmless prompts that makes over-defense measurable. The distilled students match the teachers on adversarial text within overlapping confidence intervals and reduce false alarms on harmless prompts, the smallest generative student reaching 3.8% against 4.8% for the 8-billion-parameter teacher, while the encoder classifies in roughly 24 ms per request on CPU. Per-class rebalancing is the only decisive ingredient of the recipe. No superiority over the distilled guards is claimed; on the clean reference slice they remain ahead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可复现、许可感知的知识蒸馏方法，用于在普通硬件上部署大语言模型的安全层。通过强开源守卫模型将约97,000条提示词标注为七个安全类别，并训练一系列小型学生模型（涵盖词汇、浅层、编码器和生成式架构）。蒸馏后的小模型在对抗性文本上与教师模型表现相当，同时减少了对无害提示词的误报，最小的生成式学生模型误报率仅3.8%（对比教师模型的4.8%），编码器模型在CPU上每请求约24毫秒完成分类。每类重平衡是该方法中唯一的关键要素。
AI.motivation: 在普通硬件上部署大语言模型安全层受到现有守卫模型的限制：当前开源守卫模型参数规模在1到90亿之间，面向GPU优化，且在CPU上每请求需要数秒响应时间。这阻碍了在资源受限环境中的安全部署。
