comment: Extended version of the paper accepted at DAC 2026. Extends the conference version with evaluations on AIME 2024 and GPQA-Diamond and a prediction-oracle upper-bound analysis
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting improves LLM reasoning by decomposing complex problems into intermediate steps, but its sequential nature increases decoding latency and memory usage. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity through sparse expert activation, yet their full expert weights often exceed GPU memory and require costly GPU-CPU transfers. Existing runtimes treat all tokens uniformly, overlooking a key structural property of CoT traces: consecutive reasoning stages exhibit coherent and predictable expert activation patterns. Ignoring this stage-level regularity leads to inefficient caching and unnecessary data movement. We propose SAEM, a stage-aware MoE inference runtime that detects reasoning stage boundaries and exploits stage-level activation coherence to guide expert placement. SAEM combines stage-aware caching, expert-aligned token repacking, and in-situ CPU execution to reduce data transfer and kernel fragmentation. On mathematical and scientific reasoning workloads, SAEM achieves an average 1.33x throughput improvement over the strongest state-of-the-art caching and offloading baselines under constrained GPU memory, rising to 1.54x when calibration data matches the workload, demonstrating the effectiveness of stage-aware, locality-driven MoE inference for CoT reasoning.

AI.tldr: SAEM是一个面向CoT推理的阶段感知MoE推理运行时，通过检测推理阶段边界并利用阶段级专家激活一致性来优化专家放置，结合阶段感知缓存、专家对齐的token重打包和原位CPU执行，在受限GPU内存下较最先进基线平均提升1.33倍吞吐量。
AI.motivation: CoT提示通过分解复杂问题提升LLM推理，但顺序式解码增加了延迟和内存开销；MoE模型虽通过稀疏激活扩展容量，但完整专家权重常超出GPU内存，需昂贵的GPU-CPU传输。现有运行时对所有token统一处理，忽视了一个关键结构特性：CoT轨迹中连续推理阶段呈现一致的、可预测的专家激活模式，这种忽略导致缓存效率低下和多余的数据移动。
AI.method: SAEM采用三种核心技术：(1) 阶段感知缓存（stage-aware caching），利用推理阶段级别的激活一致性智能管理专家缓存；(2) 专家对齐的token重打包（expert-aligned token repacking），减少内核碎片化；(3) 原位CPU执行（in-situ CPU execution），降低数据搬运开销。SAEM首先检测推理阶段边界，然后基于阶段级激活规律指导专家放置策略。
AI.result: 在数学和科学推理工作负载上，SAEM在受限GPU内存下相较于最强的SOTA缓存和卸载基线实现了平均1.33倍的吞吐量提升；当校准数据与工作负载匹配时，提升可达1.54倍。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了阶段感知、局部性驱动的MoE推理方法对CoT推理任务的有效性，表明利用CoT轨迹中固有的阶段级专家激活规律可以显著优化MoE推理性能。

title: LLMCrater: Lifecycle-Aware FAIR Metadata Generation using Large Language Models
comment: 2 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the 22nd IEEE International Conference on e-Science (eScience 2026)
summary: FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) metadata is essential for the discovery, interoperability, and reuse of scientific research assets. However, creating and maintaining FAIR metadata remains largely manual, making the process time-consuming for heterogeneous research artifacts generated throughout the research lifecycle. Existing approaches primarily generate metadata at publication time, missing opportunities to capture contextual information as it becomes available. To address this limitation, we present \emph{LLMCrater}, a lifecycle-aware metadata generation framework that combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with stage-specific RO-Crate metadata profiles. The framework progressively enriches metadata across four research lifecycle stages (Design, Development, Deployment, and Execution \& Provenance) while remaining compatible with RO-Crate~1.1 and EOSC metadata recommendations. It automatically extracts metadata from heterogeneous artifacts, generates and validates machine-actionable RO-Crates, and supports publication to FAIR repositories and PID services (e.g., Zenodo). We demonstrate the approach using two representative use cases: a 5G experimentation environment within SLICES-RI and an experiment on GreenDIGIT's EcoJupyter platform. Results show that LLMCrater progressively enriches metadata throughout the research lifecycle and generates valid RO-Crates conforming to the RO-Crate~1.1 specification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLMCrater框架，一个结合大语言模型与阶段特定RO-Crate元数据配置的生命周期感知元数据生成框架，能够在研究生命周期四个阶段（设计、开发、部署、执行与溯源）逐步丰富FAIR元数据，并在两个真实用例中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: FAIR元数据对科研资产的发现、互操作和重用至关重要，但创建和维护FAIR元数据主要依赖人工操作，耗时且难以适应异构研究工件。现有方法多在发表时才生成元数据，错失了在信息产生时捕获上下文信息的时机。
AI.method: LLMCrater框架将LLMs与阶段特定的RO-Crate元数据配置相结合，覆盖四个研究生命周期阶段（设计、开发、部署、执行与溯源），保持与RO-Crate 1.1及EOSC元数据推荐标准兼容；自动从异构工件中提取元数据，生成并验证机器可操作的RO-Crates，并支持发布到FAIR仓库和PID服务（如Zenodo）。
AI.result: 通过5G实验环境（SLICES-RI）和GreenDIGIT的EcoJupyter平台两个代表性用例验证，结果显示LLMCrater能够在整个研究生命周期中渐进式丰富元数据，并生成符合RO-Crate 1.1规范的有效RO-Crates。
AI.conclusion: LLMCrater有效解决了研究生命周期中FAIR元数据手工生成耗时且信息捕获不及时的问题，通过生命周期感知的渐进式元数据生成方式提升了科研资产的可发现性、可访问性、可互操作性和可重用性。

title: PUMA: A Polish Benchmark for Culturally Grounded Multimodal Understanding
summary: Large language models are increasingly moving beyond text processing, adding support for other modalities such as images and audio. While text understanding and generation have been extensively studied, multimodal data processing capabilities, particularly in the context of cultures and languages other than English, have not yet been evaluated comprehensively. In this paper, we propose PUMA (Polish Unified Multimodal Assessment), a novel benchmark of 900 hand-crafted tasks designed to probe the limits of multimodal models in the Polish cultural and linguistic context. The dataset evaluates both cultural understanding and practical skill in processing text, images, audio, and visually rich documents. Our extensive evaluation of frontier commercial models, open-weights models, and specialized smaller systems highlights a significant performance gap. While top commercial models achieve high scores in visual question answering, most models struggle with complex audio or document understanding. We open-source our evaluation framework to advance localized multimodal AI research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PUMA，一个包含900个人工设计的任务的波兰语多模态评估基准，用于评估多模态模型在波兰文化语境下处理文本、图像、音频和视觉富文档的能力。实验发现商业模型在视觉问答上表现优异，但在复杂音频和文档理解上普遍困难。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型正在向多模态扩展，但现有评估主要集中于英语和英语文化背景。多模态模型在非英语语言和文化情境下的能力尚未被全面评估，存在评估空白。
AI.method: 构建PUMA基准评估框架，包含900个手工设计任务，覆盖文化理解和实用技能两个维度，涉及文本、图像、音频和视觉富文档四种模态。评估对象包括前沿商业模型、开源模型和专用小型系统。
AI.result: 顶级商业模型在视觉问答任务上得分较高，但大多数模型在复杂的音频理解和文档理解任务上表现不佳，存在显著的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型在非英语（波兰语）情境下的表现仍有明显不足，尤其在音频和文档理解方面，亟需推进本地化多模态AI研究。评估框架已开源。

title: SketchFlow: Zero-Shot Vector Sketch Generation via GMM Prior Flow in CLIP Latent Space
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers. 16 pages
summary: Vector sketches remain one of the most concise and immediate mediums for abstract human expression. However, generating high-quality vector strokes that exhibit human-like drawing styles remains an open challenge due to the severe scarcity of fine-grained, high-quality text-to-sketch paired data. Existing text-conditioned generation methods often rely on unstable, time-consuming optimization or struggle to generalize to unseen categories in a zero-shot manner. To address these limitations, we present SketchFlow, a novel generative framework rooted in Optimal Transport (OT) theory and flow matching. By leveraging pre-trained CLIP models to bypass labor-intensive image-level text annotations, we formulate cross-modal alignment as a continuous mapping problem directly within the CLIP latent space. To bridge the inevitable modality gap between discrete text concepts and continuous sketch features, we first inject noise into discrete category embeddings to construct a continuous Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) prior. We then utilize an Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching (OT-CFM) model to learn a deterministic vector field mapping from this continuous GMM prior to the target sketch feature distribution. Finally, a Hybrid Diffusion Decoder, fusing 1D U-Net and Transformer architectures, is designed to decode these features into fast and high-fidelity stroke trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SketchFlow substantially outperforms existing baselines in visual quality and adherence to natural human drawing styles. Furthermore, our geometry-preserving framework demonstrates promising local zero-shot synthesis for prompts beyond the QuickDraw training vocabulary, including unseen concept labels and semantic modifiers, while enabling smooth, continuous semantic interpolation between distinct concepts. Source code is available at: https://github.com/QiuHong-1202/SketchFlow.

AI.tldr: SketchFlow是一个基于最优传输理论和流匹配的新型生成框架，通过利用预训练CLIP模型和构建高斯混合模型先验，在CLIP潜在空间中学习连续映射，并采用混合扩散解码器生成高质量、类人绘画风格的矢量笔画，支持零样本合成和语义插值。
AI.motivation: 矢量草图是简洁的人类抽象表达媒介，但现有文本条件生成方法面临两个主要挑战：一是由于细粒度高质量文-图配对数据严重匮乏，难以生成高质量类人绘画风格的矢量笔触；二是现有方法依赖不稳定且耗时的优化过程，或难以对未见类别进行零样本泛化。
AI.method: 1) 利用预训练CLIP模型绕过繁琐的图像级文本标注，将跨模态对齐形式化为CLIP潜在空间中的连续映射问题；2) 向离散类别嵌入注入噪声构建连续高斯混合模型先验，以弥合离散文本概念与连续草图特征之间的模态鸿沟；3) 使用最优传输条件流匹配(OT-CFM)模型学习从GMM先验到目标草图特征分布的确定性向量场映射；4) 设计融合1D U-Net和Transformer架构的混合扩散解码器，将特征解码为快速且高保真的笔画轨迹。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SketchFlow在视觉质量和符合自然人类绘画风格方面显著优于现有基线方法，并展现出对QuickDraw训练词汇之外的提示（包括未见概念标签和语义修饰符）的良好局部零样本合成能力，同时支持不同概念间的平滑连续语义插值。
AI.conclusion: SketchFlow通过OT理论驱动的流匹配框架有效解决了矢量草图生成中的数据稀缺和零样本泛化问题，其几何保持特性为实现跨类别泛化和语义插值提供了新的可能性，代码已开源。

title: Variational Structure at the Edge of Stability
summary: When discrete-time optimizers operate at the edge of stability, they exhibit near-two-periodic behavior. These oscillatory dynamics are reminiscent of conservative systems, such as the dynamics generated by symplectic integrators. However, a precise formulation of the connection between discrete-time optimizers at the edge of stability and discrete mechanics remains underexplored. Recently, Litman introduced the "edge coupling": a functional on consecutive gradient descent iterates whose critical points encode the fixed points and two-point orbits of the gradient descent dynamics. Here we extend the edge coupling to heavy-ball and Nesterov momentum. We show that its critical points characterize the fixed points and two-point orbits, with its Hessian characterizing their stability. We also show that the edge coupling can be identified with the symmetric Verlet action, formalizing the connection between the edge of stability and discrete mechanics.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了"edge coupling"（边缘耦合）这一泛函到heavy-ball和Nesterov动量优化器，证明其临界点刻画了梯度下降动力学的固定点和二点轨道，并揭示了它与对称Verlet作用的等价性，从而形式化了边缘稳定性与离散力学之间的联系。
AI.motivation: 离散时间优化器在稳定性边缘表现出近二周期振荡行为，这些动力学与保守系统（如辛积分器产生的动力学）相似，但两者之间的精确联系尚未被充分探索。Litman之前引入了"edge coupling"泛函连接梯度下降迭代，但尚未推广到动量方法，且与离散力学的形式化联系仍待建立。
AI.method: 作者将edge coupling从梯度下降推广到heavy-ball和Nesterov动量方法，通过分析其临界点来刻画固定点和二点轨道，并利用Hessian矩阵表征其稳定性。此外，作者将edge coupling识别为对称Verlet作用（symmetric Verlet action），从而建立了与离散力学（discrete mechanics）的正式联系。
AI.result: 作者证明了在heavy-ball和Nesterov动量方法中，edge coupling的临界点恰好表征了固定点和二点轨道，其Hessian可表征这些轨道的稳定性。更重要的是，edge coupling可被识别为对称Verlet作用，这形式化了优化器边缘稳定性与离散力学之间的深层联系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究架起了优化理论与离散力学之间的桥梁，表明梯度类优化器在稳定性边缘的振荡行为本质上可以用离散力学框架（特别是Verlet积分器）来理解，为分析动量方法的收敛性和动力学行为提供了新的理论工具。

title: Measuring Activation Control in Large Language Models
summary: Safe deployment of increasingly capable models will likely come to rely on latent-space monitoring as a complement to behavioral evaluations, especially when evaluation-aware models exhibit scheming or deception. However, if models can also control their own activations, deception could extend into the latent space itself. With this in mind, we introduce the Activation Controllability Benchmark to quantify the extent to which models can modulate their residual stream via natural-language instruction. Across model families and capability levels, we find that most LLMs can control the direction and magnitude of their residual stream activations with some degree of temporal resolution, though performance varies considerably across models. In simple tasks, this level of control can evade activation-based monitoring methods (including linear probes, natural language autoencoders, activation oracles, and the Jacobian lens), albeit imperfectly. These results suggest that control over the activation space itself could become a confound for monitoring as introspective capabilities increase; therefore, we recommend that frontier labs and evaluators track activation controllability in future models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"激活可控性基准"（Activation Controllability Benchmark），用于量化大语言模型能否通过自然语言指令调控自身残差流激活。研究发现大多数LLM能在一定程度上控制激活的方向、幅度和时间分辨率，并且这种控制可以（虽不完美地）规避多种基于激活的监控方法，因此作者建议前沿实验室跟踪模型的激活可控性。
AI.motivation: 随着模型能力增强，评估感知型模型可能表现出欺骗行为，单纯依赖行为评估不够，需要引入潜在空间监控作为补充。但如果模型能控制自身的激活，欺骗就可能延伸到潜在空间本身，使监控失效。因此需要量化模型对自身激活的控制能力。
AI.method: 提出了Activation Controllability Benchmark，通过自然语言指令让模型调控自己的残差流（residual stream）激活，定量测量模型控制激活方向、幅度以及时间分辨率的能力，并在多种模型家族和能力水平上进行评测。
AI.result: 大多数LLM能在一定程度上控制残差流激活的方向和幅度，且具有一定的时序控制能力，但不同模型间表现差异显著。在简单任务中，这种控制可以规避多种激活监控方法（线性探针、自然语言自编码器、激活预言机、Jacobian lens），但规避并不完美。
AI.conclusion: 激活空间本身的可控性可能随着模型内省能力的提升而成为监控的混淆因素，因此建议前沿实验室和评估方在未来模型中跟踪激活可控性指标。

title: TianoForge: An Automated Bug Triage Approach for the TianoCore UEFI Firmware Development Community
comment: ACM International Workshop on Firmware Testing and Analysis (FTA) 2026, Co-located with ISSTA 2026
summary: We propose a novel approach to bug triage in the TianoCore open-source UEFI firmware development ecosystem. This integrated approach, called TianoForge, deploys the state of the art in artificial intelligence, specifically machine learning, to enable automated bug triage. This includes invalid bug report detection, duplicate bug report detection, bug report prioritization, and bug report assignment. We use various Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT) Large Language Models (LLMs) with and without Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to automate these tasks. Given the crucial role of bug triage in software maintenance and the huge number of untriaged issues in the TianoCore community, in particular, their primary project, EDK II, we expect a significant impact on the efficiency of TianoCore software maintenance processes, primarily bug triage and resolution. Our experimental study shows that TianoForge reduces the average bug triage time from around 11 days to approximately 7 minutes, which is a 99.95% reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TianoForge，一种针对TianoCore开源UEFI固件开发生态系统的自动化Bug分类方法，利用GPT大语言模型（结合或不结合RAG）实现无效Bug报告检测、重复Bug检测、Bug优先级排序和Bug分配，将平均Bug分类时间从约11天降至约7分钟（减少99.95%）。
AI.motivation: TianoCore社区（特别是EDK II项目）存在大量未分类的Bug问题，Bug分类在软件维护中至关重要，传统人工分类效率低下，亟需自动化解决方案。
AI.method: TianoForge采用集成式方法，部署先进的机器学习/AI技术，使用多种GPT大语言模型（结合和不结合检索增强生成RAG）来自动化四个核心任务：无效Bug报告检测、重复Bug报告检测、Bug报告优先级排序和Bug报告分配。
AI.result: 实验研究表明，TianoForge将平均Bug分类时间从约11天大幅减少到约7分钟，实现了99.95%的时间缩减。
AI.conclusion: TianoForge对TianoCore软件维护流程（尤其是Bug分类与解决）的效率提升具有显著影响，证明了LLM和RAG在开源固件生态系统中自动化Bug分类的可行性和有效性。

title: HiDiffTIR: Hierarchical Difficulty-Aware Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Tool-Integrated Reasoning
summary: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) is a fundamental capability for LLM agents to solve complex tasks by interacting with external tools iteratively. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become the dominant paradigm for enabling this capability. However, existing approaches typically assign uniform trajectory-level advantages and treat all correct tool calls equally, ignoring the varying difficulty and learning value across trajectories and reasoning steps. This can lead to imprecise learning signals that do not adequately distinguish between trivial and challenging tool-use patterns. To address this limitation, we propose HiDiffTIR, a Hierarchical Difficulty-aware policy optimization framework for multi-turn TIR. HiDiffTIR performs difficulty-aware credit assignment at both trajectory and turn levels, enabling the policy to focus on more informative trajectories and harder reasoning steps. Notably, this fine-grained optimization is achieved without additional supervision, relying solely on group-level statistics derived from standard RL rollouts. Extensive experiments on three tool-using benchmarks demonstrate that HiDiffTIR consistently improves multi-turn TIR performance and tool invocation accuracy over strong RL baselines, highlighting the necessity of difficulty-aware credit assignment for effective policy optimization in tool-integrated LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiDiffTIR，一个面向多轮工具集成推理的分层难度感知策略优化框架，在轨迹层和回合层分别进行难度感知的信用分配，仅依赖标准RL rollout的组级统计量，无需额外监督，在三类工具使用基准上显著提升多轮TIR性能和工具调用准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的强化学习范式为所有轨迹分配统一的轨迹级优势，将所有正确的工具调用视为同等重要，忽略了不同轨迹和推理步骤在难度与学习价值上的差异，导致学习信号不够精确，无法充分区分简单与具有挑战性的工具使用模式。
AI.method: HiDiffTIR框架在轨迹级和回合级两个层次上进行难度感知的信用分配，使策略能够聚焦于信息量更丰富的轨迹和更难的推理步骤。该方法不需要额外监督，仅利用标准强化学习rollout产生的组级统计量来实现细粒度优化。
AI.result: 在三个工具使用基准上的广泛实验表明，HiDiffTIR在多种强化学习基线上持续提升了多轮TIR性能和工具调用准确率，验证了难度感知信用分配在工具集成LLM智能体策略优化中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 难度感知的信用分配对于多轮工具集成LLM智能体的有效策略优化是必要的，HiDiffTIR通过层次化的难度感知机制克服了传统统一信用分配的局限性，为TIR领域的强化学习提供了一种更精细优化的新思路。

title: Emotion Intensity Matters: Generating Realistic Expressions in Virtual Humans with CVAEs
summary: Generating expressive facial behavior in virtual humans (VHs) remains a central challenge in affective computing and character animation. This paper presents a novel approach based on Conditional Variational Autoencoders (CVAEs), trained on real human facial expression data, to synthesize controllable emotional expressions at varying intensities. Using a dataset comprising six basic emotions represented at two intensity levels (low and high), we train a CVAE model to generate synthetic facial expression data while preserving semantic consistency with real human expressions. Despite the limited amount of training data (only 7,680 facial expression samples), the proposed approach learns meaningful latent representations and generates coherent emotional variations. Our method enables control over emotional intensity, making it suitable for animating virtual characters without requiring actor performances or manual artistic intervention. Our research aimed to evaluate whether the method (CVAE) preserves the characteristics associated with the different intensity levels present in the dataset. Results show that the proposed model preserves key expressive characteristics across intensity levels while supporting generalization across emotional intensity levels, contributing to the creation of emotionally expressive virtual characters from relatively small datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）的方法，利用真实人类面部表情数据（六种基本情绪、两种强度水平，共7,680个样本）来合成可控情绪强度的虚拟人类面部表情，无需演员表演或手动艺术干预即可实现情感表达动画。
AI.motivation: 在虚拟人中生成富有表现力的面部行为是情感计算和角色动画领域的核心挑战，传统方法依赖演员表演或手动艺术干预，成本高且缺乏可控性。
AI.method: 采用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）架构，在包含六种基本情绪和两种强度水平（低/高）的真实人类面部表情数据集上进行训练，学习潜在表征以生成保持语义一致性的合成面部表情数据，并支持对情绪强度的可控调节。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，模型在较小的训练数据集上成功学习了有意义的潜在表征，生成了连贯的情绪变异。该模型能够保留不同强度水平下的关键表达特征，并在情绪强度水平之间实现良好的泛化。
AI.conclusion: CVAE方法能够从相对较小的数据集中有效生成情绪化虚拟角色的表情，保留关键表达特征并支持情绪强度控制，为创建情感表达的虚拟角色提供了一种低成本的自动化途径。

title: SynEHR: Joint Modeling Inter-visit Temporal Evolution and Intra-visit Clinical Structure for Longitudinal EHR Synthesis
summary: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) document patients' sequences of clinical visits over time, preserving the temporal evolution of disease progression and care delivery. However, real longitudinal EHRs are difficult to access because they contain large amounts of fine-grained, patient-specific information. Synthetic EHR generation therefore provides a valuable approach for preserving the statistical patterns and clinical structure of patient visit trajectories, enabling broader modeling and analysis when real records are limited. Although recent generative models have made progress in producing future visit sequences, they remain limited in explicitly integrating inter-visit irregular temporal evolution and intra-visit clinical event structures in EHRs, leading to clinically inconsistent and temporally unrealistic visit sequences. In this work, we propose SynEHR, a lightweight adaptive LLM-based framework for longitudinal EHR synthesis. There are two novel designs in SynEHR, i.e., a Temporal State Conditioning Module captures irregular temporal states across visits and a Temporal-Relational Adaptation Module combines these states with patient history to dynamically construct patient-specific relational representations. SynEHR then builds on a parameter-efficient LoRA-adapted language-model generator with next-visit generation capability to train the two modules for temporally and clinically informed generation. Extensive experiments on real-world EHR datasets across fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility evaluations demonstrate that SynEHR outperforms state-of-the-art models by generating more clinically coherent and temporally faithful longitudinal EHR data.

AI.tldr: 提出了SynEHR，一个基于LLM的轻量级纵向EHR合成框架，通过时间状态条件模块和时间关系适应模块，结合LoRA参数高效适配的语言模型生成器，生成在临床一致性和时间保真度上优于现有方法的合成纵向EHR数据。
AI.motivation: 真实纵向EHR数据因包含大量细粒度患者特定信息而难以获取，合成生成是保留统计模式和临床结构的重要途径。然而现有生成模型未能显式整合诊间不规则时间演化与诊内临床事件结构，导致生成的访视序列在临床和时间维度上不真实。
AI.method: SynEHR包含两个核心设计：1) 时间状态条件模块（Temporal State Conditioning Module），捕捉跨访视的不规则时间状态；2) 时间关系适应模块（Temporal-Relational Adaptation Module），将时间状态与患者历史结合，动态构建患者特定关系表示。整体构建在参数高效的LoRA适配语言模型生成器之上，具备下一代生成能力，用于训练这两个模块。
AI.result: 在真实EHR数据集上从保真度、隐私和下游效用三个维度进行广泛实验，结果表明SynEHR在生成临床更连贯、时间上更忠实的纵向EHR数据方面优于现有最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: SynEHR通过显式建模不规则时间演化和临床事件结构，有效提升了纵向EHR合成的临床一致性与时间真实性，为有限的真实数据场景提供了更可靠的合成数据方案。

title: From Mastery Profile to Simulated Response: Stochastic Student Knowledge Graphs (SSKG) for Faithful LLM Student Simulation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate students at different mastery levels. These simulations can generate synthetic training data and stress-test tutoring systems. However, common prompt-based approaches leave the answer decision to the LLM, which tends to perform according to its built-in capabilities even when instructed to simulate a student with low mastery. As a result, these approaches may have difficulty distinguishing students with low and high levels of mastery. We demonstrate this limitation using 379 College Board-calibrated SAT Algebra items and five archetypal mastery profiles. Three LLMs from three vendors (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, Claude Haiku 4.5, and GPT-5.4-mini) achieve 96.8-100% accuracy across all profiles. To address this limitation, we introduce a method grounded in a Stochastic Student Knowledge Graph (SSKG). A curriculum knowledge graph (CKG) is extracted from an open algebra textbook, and each SAT solution is decomposed into a chain of required triples. The SSKG assigns a mastery probability to each triple, which is sampled to determine question correctness. An LLM then generates a first-person rationale consistent with the outcome. The simulation reduces accuracy to 44.1-85.2% across profiles and produces a clear monotone mastery gradient.

AI.tldr: 本文指出大型语言模型模拟不同掌握水平学生时的局限性——即使指示其模拟低掌握水平学生，LLM仍按其自身能力作答，难以区分高低掌握水平。作者提出基于随机学生知识图谱(SSKG)的方法，从代数教科书提取课程知识图谱，将SAT解题拆解为三元组链，通过采样掌握概率决定正确性，再由LLM生成合理解释，从而产生清晰的掌握梯度。
AI.motivation: LLM被广泛用于模拟不同掌握水平的学生以生成合成训练数据和压力测试辅导系统，但常见的基于提示词的方法无法真正模拟低掌握水平学生，因为LLM倾向于按其内置能力作答，导致无法区分不同掌握水平的学生。
AI.method: 提出随机学生知识图谱(SSKG)方法：首先从开放代数教科书提取课程知识图谱(CKG)，然后将每个SAT解题过程分解为所需三元组链；SSKG为每个三元组分配掌握概率并采样决定答案正确性；最后LLM根据结果生成与一致的第一人称推理过程。
AI.result: 使用379道College Board校准的SAT代数题和五种原型掌握画像，三种不同供应商的LLM(Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.4-mini)在基线方法上达到96.8-100%的准确率（无法区分掌握水平），而SSKG方法将准确率降至44.1-85.2%并产生清晰的单调掌握梯度。
AI.conclusion: SSKG方法有效解决了LLM模拟低掌握水平学生的局限性，通过知识图谱驱动的随机采样机制而非依赖LLM自身能力来判断答题正确性，能够真实地区分不同掌握水平的学生，为生成更逼真的合成训练数据和更有效的辅导系统压力测试提供了可行方案。

title: An Empirical Study of the TianoCore Community
comment: ACM International Workshop on Firmware Testing and Analysis (FTA) 2026, Co-located with ISSTA 2026
summary: We investigate the software security and maintenance practices adopted by stakeholders in the TianoCore community and identify opportunities to improve firmware development workflows. We conduct a survey and a limited interview study with participants representing independent firmware vendors, original equipment manufacturers, security experts, firmware developers, and academic researchers. This open-source development community maintains a reference implementation for the core of the UEFI firmware. We highlight important gaps in the current state of firmware development within the TianoCore ecosystem and identify key areas in which improved security practices, greater adoption of memory-safe technologies, and increased automation of manual processes could strengthen the maintenance and security of the UEFI firmware.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过问卷调查和访谈，调查了TianoCore社区（UEFI固件参考实现的开源社区）中各利益相关者所采用的软件安全与维护实践，识别出固件开发工作流中的改进机会，并指出在安全实践、内存安全技术采用和手动流程自动化方面的关键差距。
AI.motivation: UEFI固件作为系统底层软件，其安全性和可维护性至关重要，但当前对TianoCore开源社区中实际开发实践的了解有限，需要通过研究识别现有实践中的差距和改进机会。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查和有限的访谈研究，参与者包括独立固件供应商、原始设备制造商（OEM）、安全专家、固件开发者和学术研究人员等各类利益相关者。
AI.result: 研究揭示了TianoCore生态系统中固件开发当前状态的重要差距，明确了在改进安全实践、更广泛采用内存安全技术以及增加手动流程自动化方面的关键领域。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别TianoCore社区中固件开发工作流的具体不足，为强化UEFI固件的维护和安全提供了有针对性的改进方向。

title: HIRA: A Human-in-the-Loop Retrieval-Augmented Cascade for Document Classification in Regulated Industries
summary:
Document classification in regulated industries is constrained by data residency, limited cold-start labels, scarce review capacity, and costly model-governance procedures. We present HIRA, a training-free, on-premises retrieval-augmented cascade for document classification in regulated deployments that combines BM25 over OCR text, dense text embeddings, and image-level representations through validation-calibrated weighted reciprocal-rank fusion. Confident documents are classified directly by retrieval; uncertain or visually confusable documents are passed to a locally hosted LLM verifier, which receives the OCR text, retrieved exemplars, label descriptions, and confusion-specific terms. When the verifier remains uncertain, the document is sent to human review. Each correction is stored as a margin-weighted retrieval exemplar and updates a Dirichlet-smoothed confusion graph, letting the system improve without updating model weights.
  On a private 80-class trade-finance corpus, HIRA processes the full 30,233-document production stream while requesting human correction for only 1,945 documents (6.4%), improving Macro-F1 from 0.6218 to 0.8548. On the corrected Tobacco-3482 benchmark, HIRA reaches 0.9423 Macro-F1 with a locally hosted DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B verifier, 17.4 percentage points above the zero-shot LLM baseline, while invoking the verifier for only about 40% of documents and reducing LLM calls by approximately 60%. With 518 human corrections (24.8% of the pool), HIRA matches the fully labelled pool oracle, in which all 2,086 pool documents are indexed with their ground-truth labels. These results show that selective human feedback and retrieval-memory adaptation can be a practical alternative to repeated model retraining for long-tail document classification in regulated deployments.

AI.tldr: HIRA是一个无需训练的本地检索增强级联系统，用于受监管行业的文档分类。它结合BM25、稠密文本嵌入和图像级表征进行加权倒数排名融合，不确定的文档由本地LLM验证器处理，仍不确定则转人工审核。每次修正以边际加权检索范例存储并更新混淆图，系统无需更新模型权重即可持续改进。在80类贸易金融语料上，仅需6.4%的人工修正即将Macro-F1从0.6218提升至0.8548。
AI.motivation: 受监管行业的文档分类面临多重约束：数据驻留要求（数据不能离开本地）、冷启动标签稀缺、人工审核能力有限，以及模型治理流程成本高昂。作者旨在设计一种不依赖频繁模型重训练、可在本地部署的实用方案，以应对长尾文档分类挑战。
AI.method: HIRA采用三阶段级联架构：(1) 检索阶段，通过BM25（OCR文本）、稠密文本嵌入和图像级表示进行验证校准的加权倒数排名融合（WRRF）；(2) LLM验证阶段，仅对不确定或视觉易混淆的文档调用本地托管LLM，输入包括OCR文本、检索范例、标签描述和混淆特定术语；(3) 人工审核阶段，验证器仍不确定时转人工。系统通过边际加权检索范例存储和Dirichlet平滑混淆图实现无需权重更新的持续改进。
AI.result: 在私有80类贸易金融语料库（30,233篇文档生产流）上，仅需1,945篇（6.4%）人工修正，Macro-F1从0.6218提升至0.8548。在Tobacco-3482基准上，使用本地DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B验证器达到0.9423 Macro-F1，比零样本LLM基线高17.4个百分点，且仅对约40%文档调用验证器，LLM调用减少约60%。仅用518次人工修正（占池24.8%）即匹配合部标注池oracle的性能。
AI.conclusion: 选择性人工反馈与检索记忆自适应可以作为受监管部署中长尾文档分类的实用替代方案，避免重复模型重训练的高昂成本。该系统在保持数据本地化和治理合规的同时，通过检索增强和主动审核实现了接近全标注的性能，为数据驻留受限场景提供了可行的分类范式。

title: The Chase Is the Curriculum, the Capture Anchors the Credit: Pursuit-Evasion Self-Play for Zero-Data LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become the dominant recipe for improving large language model reasoning, yet it presumes large human-curated task collections. Zero-data self-play removes this dependency, but existing methods vet learnability only by probing candidates and rejecting post hoc, never learning where along an environment's difficulty axis to place a task, and credit the solver with sparse terminal rewards alone. We recast zero-data self-play as a pursuit-evasion game: in LURE, an LLM evader positions tasks along each environment's difficulty axis to stay one step ahead of a planner-executor pursuer that hunts it down through verifiable interaction. The evader is trained on a capture-frontier reward that peaks when the solver captures it on exactly half of its rollouts, turning barely catchable into a learned positioning strategy rather than a hand-tuned rejection band. The pursuer earns capture-anchored dense process credit, in which monotone verifier progress is group-normalized jointly with the terminal capture under a round-anchored KL that keeps the co-evolution stable. Across three verifiable reasoning environments and three backbone families, LURE outperforms advanced baselines under unified/specialist settings, while the unified model attains stronger aggregate OOD zero-shot accuracy than all trained baselines across nine held-out benchmarks from three task families.

AI.tldr: LURE将零数据自博弈重新定义为追逃博弈：LLM逃避者沿环境难度轴定位任务，始终领先于规划-执行追逐者一步。逃避者通过捕获前沿奖励训练（当求解者恰好在半数rollout中捕获它时达到峰值），将"勉强可捕获"转为学习到的定位策略；追逐者获得捕获锚定的密集过程奖励，通过轮次锚定的KL保持共同进化稳定。在三个可验证推理环境和三个骨干家族上优于先进基线。
AI.motivation: 现有可验证奖励的强化学习依赖大规模人工策划的任务集合，而零数据自博弈方法仅通过事后探测和拒绝来验证可学习性，从未学习沿环境难度轴应将任务放置在何处，且仅以稀疏的终止奖励评价求解者。这限制了零数据自博弈的训练效率和任务定位能力。
AI.method: 将零数据自博弈建模为追逃博弈：1) LLM逃避者沿每个环境的难度轴定位任务以保持领先追逐者一步；2) 逃避者用捕获前沿奖励训练，当求解者在恰好一半rollout捕获它时奖励达到峰值；3) 追逐者获得捕获锚定的密集过程奖励，将单调验证者进展与终止捕获联合进行组归一化；4) 使用轮次锚定的KL保证共同进化稳定。
AI.result: 在三个可验证推理环境和三个骨干家族上，LURE在统一/专家设置下均优于先进基线；统一模型在所有训练基线上取得更强的聚合OOD零样本准确率，覆盖三个任务家族的九个保留基准。
AI.conclusion: LURE通过把任务定位作为学习到的策略而非手工调整的拒绝区间，并引入捕获锚定的密集过程信用，有效提升了零数据自博弈的推理训练效果，且统一模型展现出更强的分布外泛化能力。

title: StereoDiffuer: Diffusion-based Progressive Geometry Modeling with Saliency Attention Perception for Stereo Matching
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, and 11 tables. Accepted by Signal Processing: Image Communication
summary: With the advance of deep neural networks, the quality of disparity maps obtained through stereo matching has steadily improved. However, existing stereo matching methods still struggle to preserve fine-grained geometric details, resulting in blurred edges and over-smoothed predictions in challenging regions. To address these limitations, we propose StereoDiffuer, an iterative diffusion-based stereo matching framework that explicitly models geometric details and progressively refines disparity estimates. The framework incorporates a Saliency Attention Perception (SAP) module to extract salient geometric cues, including object boundaries, thin structures, and sharp edges. Confidence-guided SAP features are combined with the initial disparity estimate to condition an iterative denoising diffusion process, which corrects residual disparity errors and restores geometric details suppressed during cost-volume regularization and upsampling. Experimental results on the Scene Flow and KITTI benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and its competitive performance relative to the compared stereo matching methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StereoDiffuser，一个基于迭代扩散的立体匹配框架，通过显著注意力感知模块提取几何细节线索，并结合置信度引导的扩散去噪过程逐步细化视差估计，在Scene Flow和KITTI基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有立体匹配方法虽在深度神经网络帮助下视差图质量不断提升，但在保持细粒度几何细节方面仍有不足，导致边缘模糊和困难区域过度平滑的问题。
AI.method: 提出StereoDiffuser框架，包含：(1) 显著注意力感知模块提取物体边界、细结构和尖锐边缘等几何线索；(2) 将置信度引导的显著特征与初始视差估计结合；(3) 通过迭代去噪扩散过程修正残差视差误差并恢复在代价体正则化和上采样中被抑制的几何细节。
AI.result: 在Scene Flow和KITTI基准上的实验证明了该框架的有效性，并相对所比较的立体匹配方法展现了有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型可以显式建模几何细节并逐步细化视差估计，为解决立体匹配中细节丢失问题提供了一种有效的新思路。

title: Read, Write, Relax: Why Neural PDE Surrogates Need Both Global and Local Processing
summary: Recent mesh-based simulation advances have, in no small part, relied on neural surrogates of two distinct families: global models that route information through a small set of latent tokens, and local models that perform message passing across mesh edges. Consistent with both classes is the inability to perform beyond low-dimensional problems and small-scale or oversimplified meshes, the simulation regimes where industrial problems reside. Our work shows this explicitly and presents a unified formulation. In global approaches, latent-token attention acts as a spatial low-pass filter, while local message passing lacks the global reach necessary to propagate information across large mesh spaces. Viewed through the error, the two operators are the halves of a multigrid cycle: one corrects errors at the lower end of the spectrum, the other at the higher end, and neither can do the other's job. We introduce Read-Write-Relax (RWR), which interleaves latent attention with message-passing relaxation under a unified formulation. The interleaved processor lowers error across the entire spectrum, making RWR the most accurate model in nearly every comparison across our industrial and public benchmarks. It is also markedly data-efficient in the scarce-data regimes, accurate on the engineering quantities of interest, and scales full-field predictions to challenging, large-scale problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Read-Write-Relax (RWR)框架，统一了全局潜变量注意力模型和局部消息传递模型两种网格模拟神经代理范式，通过交错执行这两种操作来实现在全频谱上的误差校正，在工业基准和公共基准上均取得了最先进的精度，同时具备数据高效性和大规模问题扩展能力。
AI.motivation: 现有两类网格模拟神经代理——全局模型（通过少量潜变量token路由信息）和局部模型（在网格边上进行消息传递）——都无法处理工业问题所依赖的高维、大规模或复杂网格。作者明确指出这一局限，并从频谱分析角度揭示了两类方法的本质缺陷：全局注意力相当于空间低通滤波器，只能修正频谱低端误差；局部消息传递缺乏全局流动性，只能修正高端误差。两者各自覆盖频谱的一半，无法相互替代。
AI.method: 作者提出RWR（Read-Write-Relax）统一框架，将潜变量注意力与消息传递松弛交错执行。该方法借鉴多重网格（multigrid）循环的思想——全局注意力作为粗网格校正处理低频误差，消息传递作为松弛算子处理高频误差，两者在统一框架下交替应用，从而在整个误差频谱上实现校正。
AI.result: RWR在几乎所有工业基准和公共基准的比较中取得了最准确的结果。在数据稀缺场景下表现出显著的数据效率，对工程关心的物理量（如应力、位移等）预测准确，并能将全场预测扩展到具有挑战性的大规模问题。
AI.conclusion: RWR通过频谱互补的统一框架，首次将两类看似对立的神经模拟范式有机整合，证明了两者的关系本质上是多重网格循环的两个互补算子。该工作为工业级网格模拟提供了可扩展、数据高效且高精度的神经替代方案。

title: Context as an Environment: Programmatic Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly take on long-running tasks whose history grows far beyond a single model context window. Existing approaches compress earlier interactions or extract selected information into fixed memory representations, committing to what to preserve before future needs are known. We present Scroll, a context manager that treats each agent session as an executable Session Environment. The environment is backed by an append-only Event Log and a sandboxed, persistent Python kernel. The kernel maintains a typed namespace across model calls, allowing tool outputs, retrieved history, and derived state to be bound to variables rather than serialized into the prompt at each call. Model-written code searches, materializes, and transforms session state through exec; only explicitly printed projections enter the model's working view for the next call. Context management thus becomes a programming task that inherits the improving coding abilities of LLMs, while the Event Log preserves lossless historical ground truth. As the working view approaches its budget, stale spans are evicted but remain recoverable: an eviction index keeps compact landmarks tied to exact Event Log addresses, so that the agent navigates directly to evicted regions instead of searching the full log. With Qwen3.8-Max as the backbone, Scroll achieves 94.8% on LongMemEval_S; 73.1% on BEAM_10M, surpassing the best published memory system by 5.1 points; and 86.7% on LOCA_256K, exceeding the best published long-horizon agent by 37.4 points.

AI.tldr: Scroll是一个上下文管理器，将每个智能体会话视为可执行的"会话环境"，由追加式事件日志和持久化的沙箱Python内核支持。模型编写的代码通过exec搜索、物化和转换会话状态，仅显式打印的投影进入模型工作视图，将上下文管理转化为编程任务。
AI.motivation: LLM代理越来越多地处理长期任务，其历史远超单一模型上下文窗口。现有方法通过压缩早期交互或将选定信息提取到固定记忆表示中，在未来的需求未知之前就承诺保存内容，这存在信息丢失和灵活性不足的问题。
AI.method: Scroll将每个代理会话视为可执行的Session Environment，由两个核心组件支撑：(1) 追加式Event Log（保真历史事实）；(2) 沙箱化的持久Python内核（在模型调用间维持类型化命名空间）。工具输出和检索历史绑定到变量而非序列化进提示。模型编写的代码通过exec搜索、物化和转换状态，仅打印的投影进入模型工作视图。当工作视图接近预算时，过时跨度被驱逐但仍可通过驱逐索引（携带有精确Event Log地址的紧凑地标）直接恢复。
AI.result: 以Qwen3.8-Max为骨干，Scroll在LongMemEval_S上达94.8%，在BEAM_10M上达73.1%（超越最佳已发布记忆系统5.1个百分点），在LOCA_256K上达86.7%（超越最佳已发布长程代理37.4个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将上下文管理重构为编程任务，Scroll利用LLM日益增强的编码能力，同时事件日志保证了无损的历史真值，实现了显著的基准性能提升。

title: From Natural Language Policies to Executable Obligations: A Verification Harness for Dependable In-Car LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) agents deployed in vehicles must satisfy a written operating policy on every turn: a single hallucinated identifier, omitted mandatory side-effect, or premature completion claim fails the task. We present AgentGuardUtil, our entry to CAR-bench Track~1, which treats the AI planer (LLM) as a fallible proposer inside a grounded verify-and-revise loop. Its core novelty is a runtime policy compiler: the natural-language policy shipped with each conversation is compiled, once per policy, into typed machine-checkable rules, a subset of which receive an executable form. A deterministic obligation engine interprets these rules against live tool results and the simulated post-write state of the draft itself, emitting the exact remedial calls with computed arguments rather than natural-language reminders. Around this engine, 25 deterministic gates (identifier provenance, schema and enum validity, gather-before-act, confirmation and future-time protocols) and an LLM critic produce tiered findings that drive a bounded revision loop tuned for the pass k metric.

AI.tldr: AgentGuardUtil 是 CAR-bench Track 1 的参赛系统，将 LLM 规划器视为可犯错的提议者，置于基于验证与修正循环的框架中。核心创新是运行时策略编译器，将自然语言策略编译为类型化、机器可检查的规则，并由确定性义务引擎结合实时工具结果和草稿后写入状态执行，输出精确的补救调用。外围集成 25 个确定性门控和 LLM 评论器，驱动有界的迭代修正循环以优化 pass@k 指标。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体部署在车辆中必须在每一轮遵循书面操作策略，任何单个幻觉标识符、遗漏的强制性副作用或过早的完成声明都会导致任务失败。这要求极高的策略遵循可靠性，单纯依赖 LLM 自身推理不足以满足这种严格约束。
AI.method: 采用"验证-修正"循环架构：1) 运行时策略编译器将随对话提供的自然语言策略编译为类型化机器可检查规则；2) 确定性义务引擎基于实时工具结果和草稿模拟后写入状态解释规则，发出带计算参数的精确补救调用而非自然语言提醒；3) 25 个确定性门控（涵盖标识符来源、模式与枚举有效性、先收集后行动、确认与未来时态协议等）及 LLM 评论器产生分层发现；4) 有界修正循环针对 pass@k 指标进行调优。
AI.result: 系统在 CAR-bench Track 1 中成功参赛，通过确定性引擎和修正循环机制确保策略遵循，针对 pass@k 指标优化了任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将 LLM 从策略的唯一执行者降级为提议者，辅以确定性的策略编译与义务追踪机制，是确保车载智能体严格遵循书面操作策略的有效途径。

title: BanglaVeilGuard: Cross-Script Safety Benchmarking and Lightweight Guardrails for Bangla Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at the 4th International Conference on Computing Advancements (ICCA 2026). 8 pages
summary: Bangla large language model (LLM) safety is difficult to evaluate with English-centric or standard-script benchmarks because Bangla users routinely write across scripts, spellings, code-mixed forms, and regional registers. This paper presents BanglaVeilGuard, a compact Bangla-first safety benchmark and lightweight prompt guard for six language forms: standard Bangla, Romanized Bangla, Banglish, code-mixed Bangla--English, noisy Bangla, and dialectal Bangla. The benchmark contains 2,366 quality-filtered prompts and a held-out 354-prompt evaluation split spanning unsafe, safe, and safe-sensitive requests. BanglaVeilGuard uses non-destructive multi-view normalization with a prompt-risk classifier and thresholded pre-generation gate, allowing it to screen prompts for heterogeneous target models without changing their weights. Across target-model families, guarded runs reduce attack success under deterministic response scoring from 93.8--100.0\% to 6.3\% for Claude Opus 4.8, BanglaLLama, and TituLLM; TigerLLM-1B with BanglaVeilGuard achieves 78.2\% accuracy with 8.8\% ASR. The prompt guard also attains 88.5\% unsafe recall, substantially above the evaluated prompt-only guard baselines. The main remaining cost is over-refusal on dialectal and noisy benign prompts, revealing a concrete safety-helpfulness frontier for Bangla LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BanglaVeilGuard，一个面向孟加拉语（Bangla）的轻量级安全基准测试与提示词防护系统，覆盖六种语言形式（标准孟加拉语、罗马化孟加拉语、Banglish、孟英混合码、噪声孟加拉语、方言孟加拉语），包含2,366条筛选后的基准提示词和354条留出测试集。该系统通过非破坏性多视图归一化结合提示风险分类器和阈值化生成前门控，在多种目标模型上将攻击成功率从93.8-100%降至6.3%，同时达到88.5%的不安全内容召回率。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语LLM的安全评估面临独特挑战：孟加拉用户习惯使用多种书写系统、拼写变体、代码混用和地区方言，而现有的以英语为中心或标准书写系统的安全基准无法有效评估这些多样化的语言形式，导致孟加拉语LLM的安全防护存在明显空白。
AI.method: BanglaVeilGuard包含两部分：(1) 孟加拉语优先的安全基准，覆盖六种语言形式，含2,366条质量筛选提示和354条留出评估集；(2) 轻量级提示防护系统，采用非破坏性多视图归一化，结合提示风险分类器和带阈值的生成前门控机制，不修改目标模型权重即可对异构目标模型进行提示筛选。
AI.result: 在不同目标模型家族上，防护后的运行将确定性响应评分下的攻击成功率从93.8-100%降至6.3%（针对Claude Opus 4.8、BanglaLLama和TituLLM）；TigerLLM-1B配合BanglaVeilGuard达到78.2%的准确率和8.8%的攻击成功率；提示防护在提示不安全内容上达到88.5%召回率，显著高于被评估的仅提示防护基线。
AI.conclusion: BanglaVeilGuard有效提升了孟加拉语LLM的安全防护水平，但主要代价是对方言和噪声良性提示的过度拒绝，揭示了孟加拉语LLM部署中安全性与有用性之间的现实权衡边界。

title: The Plan, Not the Decoder: Diagnosing and Repairing Compositional Failure in Reasoning-Augmented Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Reasoning-augmented text-to-image models such as GoT-R1 emit an explicit textual plan - object names, attributes, and bounding boxes - before generating image tokens. When such a model fails a compositional prompt, is the plan wrong, or is the plan right and the decoder unfaithful? Because the plan is machine-readable it can be edited before decoding, which makes the two separable. We first validate the ruler. Swapping the two bounding boxes inside the model's own chain demonstrably flips the generated layout: detector-based accuracy falls 0.75 -> 0.48 (p<1e-3), while a widely used VQA-based spatial metric rises. A five-rater human study agrees with the detector on 81% of items and with the VQA judge on 57%. All spatial results therefore use geometric scoring. Under sound measurement the decoder is a faithful executor: 94% of generated layouts realize the planned relation, and object-box binding survives reordering of the plan's object segments. The planner is the bottleneck. It writes wrong relations for phrasing-dependent reasons - 98% accuracy on "left" against 54% on "right" for semantically identical layouts, a raster-order bias we isolate with a mention-order control - and cluttered geometry that the decoder faithfully reproduces. Editing the plan therefore fixes the image without retraining: symbolic verification with resampling gives +5.0 points (p<1e-3), minimal in-place repair +6.0 (p=.02), rewriting only box geometry +10.7 (p<1e-4), and replacing the plan outright +13.3 (p=1e-4). Gains are indifferent to the plan's prose style and to its likelihood under the planner, but not to its geometry. Modular planner-decoder designs are therefore viable, provided the plan is internally consistent: box-text contradictions induce object duplication and identity fusion. We release the plan-fidelity evaluation protocol, all plans, and 12k generated images.

AI.tldr: 本文研究推理增强的文本到图像模型（如GoT-R1）失败时，问题出在规划器生成的文本计划错误，还是解码器对计划的执行不忠实。通过可编辑计划将两者分离验证，发现解码器是忠实的执行者，瓶颈在规划器。通过编辑计划（而非重训练）即可修复图像，带来高达+13.3分的提升。
AI.motivation: 推理增强的文本到图像模型会先输出显式文本计划（对象名、属性、边界框）再生成图像。当模型在组合提示上失败时，无法判断是计划本身错误还是解码器执行不忠实。由于计划可机器读取、可编辑，这提供了分离两者的机会，从而定位系统瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 构造"交换边界框"对照实验验证测量工具的有效性；2) 用几何评分与人类标注评估检测器与VQA指标的可靠性；3) 分别测试解码器的空间执行忠实度与对象-框绑定忠实度；4) 通过四种计划编辑干预（符号验证重采样、最小就地修复、只重写框几何、整体替换计划）来验证规划器是瓶颈。
AI.result: 解码器是忠实执行者：94%的生成布局实现了计划中的关系。规划器是瓶颈：对"left"准确率98%而对"right"仅54%（栅格序偏差），且对杂乱几何忠实复现。编辑计划无需重训练即可修复图像：符号验证重采样+5.0分，最小修复+6.0分，重写框几何+10.7分，整体替换计划+13.3分。提升与计划文体和似然无关，但与几何相关。框-文本矛盾会导致对象复制和身份融合。
AI.conclusion: 模块化规划器-解码器设计是可行的，前提是计划内部一致（框与文本无矛盾）。研究发布了计划保真度评估协议、所有计划及1.2万张生成图像，为推理增强图像生成系统的可诊断性和可修复性提供了证据。

title: Benchmarking Composable Compression Techniques in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
summary:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs scale model capacity efficiently through sparse activation, but their large expert parameter footprint, routing imbalance, and long-context KV-cache growth make deployment difficult on commodity hardware. Practical deployment often requires stacking multiple compression techniques: expert pruning removes redundant experts, weight quantization lowers model memory footprint, and KV-cache compression reduces long-context memory pressure. However, these techniques are typically evaluated in isolation, leaving open how they interact when applied together in realistic deployment pipelines.
  In this work, we present MoEXBench, a systematic benchmark for evaluating composable MoE compression as an end-to-end deployment workflow. MoEXBench studies 10 MoE models ranging from 30B to 235B total parameters across standard-attention, hybrid linear-attention, and sliding window attention architectures. It evaluates 20%-50% expert pruning rates, 1 to 16 bit weight-quantization schemes, and multiple KV-cache precision settings, applied both individually and in combination.
  MoEXBench introduces an eight-module evaluation suite that jointly measures composable-compression quality, workload and architecture robustness, pruning/quantization/KV cache sensitivity, and deployment efficiency on commodity hardware. Our results reveal non-trivial interactions among compression methods: composable compression cannot be predicted from standalone techniques, compression rate alone does not reliably predict quality loss or runtime gain, expert pruning is the dominant degradation source, and average quality can hide workload and architecture-specific failures. By releasing normalized module scores, compressed artifacts, and reproducible scripts, MoEXBench enables practical accuracy-memory-latency comparison across MoE families and hardware backends.

AI.tldr: MoEXBench是一个系统性的基准测试工具，用于评估MoE大语言模型在端到端部署流程中组合式压缩技术（专家剪枝、权重量化、KV缓存压缩）的相互作用和整体效果。
AI.motivation: MoE LLM在实际部署中常需要叠加多种压缩技术，但这些技术通常在孤立环境下评估，忽略了它们组合应用时的交互效应。缺乏一个系统性的基准来评估组合压缩的整体部署效果。
AI.method: MoEXBench覆盖10个MoE模型（30B-235B参数），涵盖标准注意力、混合线性注意力和滑动窗口注意力架构，评估20%-50%专家剪枝率、1-16比特权重量化方案以及多种KV缓存精度设置，并引入了八模块评估套件来综合衡量压缩质量、鲁棒性、敏感性和部署效率。
AI.result: 研究发现组合压缩无法从单独技术的结果预测；压缩率本身不能可靠预测质量损失或运行时增益；专家剪枝是质量下降的主要来源；平均质量可能掩盖特定工作负载和架构的失败。
AI.conclusion: MoEXBench通过发布标准化模块分数、压缩工件和可复现脚本，实现了跨MoE家族和硬件后端的准确率-内存-延迟比较，为实际部署提供了可靠指导。

title: From Association to Causation: Improving Retrieval Precision of Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Causal Relations and an Attention Mechanism
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, 1 algorithm. Code available at https://github.com/Silk-Road/causal-rag-rerank
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM generation on retrieved documents, but the standard terminal retrieval stage--dense-vector similarity, optionally followed by reranking--often returns documents that share keywords with the query without containing the needed information, a failure mode that grows with the knowledge base. We trace it to a conceptual gap: similarity captures only associational relations, whereas the documents that matter are linked to the query causally. We model the terminal retrieval stage with a causal graph grounded in Reichenbach's common cause principle: the keywords shared by the query and a retrieved document form a latent common cause A, and the document's residual keywords form a latent set B linking the document to the ideal output. Since a retrieved document is a collider (A -> d <- B), retrieval itself opens an associational path between the query and B, which licenses a training-free, attention-style re-scoring rule: the cosine similarity between the query embedding and the weighted centroid embedding of B. Unlike causality-enhanced RAG variants that model causal relations inside the knowledge content, our graph models the causal structure of the retrieval process itself. On a real 471-document enterprise knowledge base, the method promotes a relevant guideline from rank 6 to the top 3; on a controlled diagnostic corpus reproducing the keyword-stuffing regime, it improves the mean target rank from 2.88 to 1.25, while a trained cross-encoder reranker barely helps (2.63). Conversely, on three BEIR benchmarks the score underperforms the similarity baseline, delineating the applicability boundary: the method guards the keyword-stuffing regime of growing proprietary knowledge bases and complements neural rerankers; a corpus-level calibration gate selects the correct regime with >= 95% reliability. A fully local testbed demonstrates deployability.

AI.tldr: 本文指出RAG标准检索终端的稠密向量相似度仅捕捉相关性而非因果关系，导致关键词匹配但信息缺失的失败模式。作者用Reichenbach共同原因原理对检索过程建模，将被检索文档视为collider（A→d←B），提出无需训练、基于注意力风格的重新打分规则（查询嵌入与B的加权质心嵌入间的余弦相似度）。在真实471文档企业知识库和有控诊断语料上均显著提升，但在BEIR基准上表现不如相似度基线，因此提出语料级校准门以选择正确场景（≥95%可靠性）。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG的终端检索（稠密向量相似度+可选重排）常返回共享关键词但缺乏所需信息的文档，且随知识库增大而加剧。作者将此归因于概念性缺陷：相似度只捕获关联关系，而真正重要的文档与查询之间存在因果关系。
AI.method: 用因果图建模终端检索阶段：查询与检索文档共享的关键词构成潜在共同原因A，文档残差关键词构成潜在集B将文档与理想输出相连。因检索文档是collider（A→d←B），检索本身打开了查询与B之间的关联路径，从而提出无训练的注意力风格重新打分规则：查询嵌入与B的加权质心嵌入的余弦相似度。此外设计语料级校准门来选择合适的检索机制。
AI.result: 真实企业知识库（471文档）：将相关指南从第6名提升到前3名；受控诊断语料：平均目标排名从2.88提升到1.25（训练过的交叉编码器重排仅2.63）；三个BEIR基准上低于相似度基线；校准门在≥95%可靠性下选择正确机制。
AI.conclusion: 该方法专门守卫增长中的专有知识库的"关键词填充"（keyword-stuffing）场景，可补充神经重排器；语料级校准门确保在正确场景中部署，且全本地测试床证明了可部署性。

title: DPIAgent: Divide, Protocol, Isolate for Agentic Reproduction Test Generation
summary: Reproduction test generation, producing a failing-then-passing test that captures a reported bug, is a critical step in automated software engineering. Existing agentic methods treat this as a monolithic loop, despite the task inherently comprising two subtasks of distinct nature: diagnosing the root cause and writing a fail-to-pass test. Without explicit separation, the agent faces a compound objective with underspecified intermediate goals, leading to goal drift. We propose DPIAgent, a structured agentic framework built on three principles, Divide, Protocol, Isolate (DPI), that mitigates compound-objective ambiguity and goal drift: it Divides the task into single-objective phases of defect exploration and test generation; enforces a handoff Protocol that records the diagnosis and test plan, preventing context loss; and Isolates each phase's action space by tailoring the toolset to its task, preventing irrelevant tools from misleading execution. On SWT-Bench Verified, DPIAgent outperforms seven baselines across three backbone LLMs. With DPI alone it reaches 81.76% success rate on GPT-5, the highest reported among open-source methods, gaining up to 11.88 points over the strongest baseline on GPT-5-Mini; adding test selection further raises it to 86.17%. Our analysis shows that architectural structure and backbone capability are complementary axes rather than substitutes, demonstrating DPI's generalizability across model classes.

AI.tldr: DPIAgent是一个基于"Divide, Protocol, Isolate"三原则的结构化智能体框架，用于自动化重现软件缺陷的测试生成（fail-to-pass测试）。它将任务显式划分为缺陷探查和测试生成两个单一目标阶段，通过交接协议记录诊断结果防止上下文丢失，并隔离各阶段的工具集。在SWT-Bench Verified上，DPIAgent在GPT-5上达到81.76%成功率，结合测试选择后提升至86.17%，超越七个基线。
AI.motivation: 现有agentic方法将重现测试生成视为单一整体循环，但该任务本质上包含根因诊断和编写fail-to-pass测试两个性质不同的子任务。缺乏显式分离会导致复合目标下的中间目标不明确，引发目标漂移（goal drift）问题。
AI.method: 提出DPIAgent框架，基于三个原则：(1) Divide：将任务划分为缺陷探索和测试生成两个单一目标阶段；(2) Protocol：强制执行交接协议，记录诊断结果和测试计划，防止上下文丢失；(3) Isolate：隔离每个阶段的操作空间，根据任务定制工具集，防止无关工具误导执行。
AI.result: 在SWT-Bench Verified上，DPIAgent在三种骨干LLM上均优于七个基线。单独使用DPI在GPT-5上达到81.76%成功率，为开源方法中最高，比GPT-5-Mini上最强基线高出11.88个百分点；结合测试选择后进一步提升至86.17%。
AI.conclusion: 架构结构与骨干模型能力是互补而非替代的维度，DPI原则在不同模型类别上具有通用性。显式任务分解和结构化协议能有效缓解复合目标带来的模糊性与目标漂移问题。

title: Modeling Claim Dependency Structure for Patent Litigation Prediction with Graph Attention Networks
summary: Patent litigation imposes substantial costs on firms and distorts R&D incentives, making early risk identification a practically important task. While prior work has applied BERT-based models to patent claim text, two fundamental limitations remain: flat sequence encoding loses the dependency structure between independent and dependent claims that legally determines patent scope, and feeding the entire claim set to a single encoder discards legally critical text. A six-model ablation on 1.34 million USPTO utility patents confirms that per-claim encoding, graph connectivity, attention, and Attentional Aggregation each provide independent, additive predictive value. We propose ClaimGAT, a Graph Attention Network that encodes each claim independently, constructs a directed claim dependency graph, processes it with GATConv layers, and aggregates independent claims via Attentional Aggregation to yield both a litigation risk score and claim-level gate weights that enable post-hoc structural analysis. ClaimGAT achieves an AUC-ROC of 0.818 and a lift of 4.89x at the top 10%, using only information observable at the time of patent grant. It reveals a tendency in high-risk patents for structural selection and content sensitivity to diverge, a pattern consistent with defensive claim drafting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClaimGAT，一种基于图注意力网络的专利诉讼风险预测模型。它克服了传统BERT方法将权利要求作平铺序列编码、丢失从属权利要求与独立权利要求间依赖结构的问题。ClaimGAT将每个权利要求独立编码，构建有向权利要求依赖图，通过GATConv层处理并用注意力聚合独立权利要求，输出诉讼风险评分及权利要求级门控权重。在134万件美国实用专利上，AUC-ROC达0.818，前10%提升达4.89倍，且仅使用授权时可见信息。研究还发现高风险专利中结构选择与内容敏感性呈背离趋势，与防御性权利要求起草模式一致。
AI.motivation: 专利诉讼给企业带来巨大成本并扭曲研发激励，早期风险识别具有重要实践价值。现有基于BERT的方法存在两个根本局限：一是平铺序列编码丢失了独立与从属权利要求之间的依赖结构（该结构在法律上决定了专利保护范围）；二是将整个权利要求集合输入单一编码器会丢弃法律上关键的信息。因此需要一种能建模权利要求结构依赖并聚焦关键法律文本的模型。
AI.method: ClaimGAT采用图注意力网络架构：1) 每个权利要求独立编码（per-claim encoding）；2) 构建有向权利要求依赖图；3) 使用GATConv层处理依赖图；4) 通过注意力聚合（Attentional Aggregation）整合独立权利要求。模型同时输出诉讼风险评分和权利要求级门控权重，支持事后结构分析。作者还设计六模型消融实验验证各组件（per-claim编码、图连接性、注意力机制、注意力聚合）的独立且加性的预测价值。
AI.result: 在134万件USPTO实用专利上的六模型消融实验证实per-claim编码、图连接性、注意力和注意力聚合各自提供独立且加性的预测价值。ClaimGAT达到0.818的AUC-ROC和4.89倍的前10%提升率，且仅使用专利授权时可用信息即可实现。实验还发现高风险专利中结构选择与内容敏感性呈现背离趋势，与防御性权利要求的起草模式一致。
AI.conclusion: ClaimGAT通过图注意力网络有效建模权利要求间的依赖结构，显著提升了专利诉讼风险预测的准确性和可解释性。其发现的高风险专利中结构选择与内容敏感性的背离现象揭示了防御性权利要求起草模式，为理解专利诉讼风险提供了新的结构层面的洞察。该模型仅利用授权时可见信息即可实现强预测性能，具有实际部署价值。

title: Calibrate What You SHIP: Post-Selection Risk Control for Verifier-Guided Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Verifier-guided text-to-image systems increasingly use test-time search to select, refine, or stop among multiple candidates, yet release thresholds are often calibrated on individual images. This creates a candidate-to-policy calibration mismatch: search changes both which prompts receive an output and which candidate is released, so candidate-level risk control need not imply control of released-output risk. We formalize this estimand shift through prompt reweighting and within-prompt selection, and introduce SHIP, Selection-aware Held-out calibration of Inference Policies. SHIP runs or replays the complete deployed policy on held-out prompts, evaluates the image it actually releases using an independent target judge, and selects the most permissive threshold whose risk upper bound satisfies a prescribed budget. For replayable policies with a prespecified threshold grid, simultaneous confidence control provides finite-sample validity. Experiments across fixed, sequential, and adaptive T2I inference procedures show that policy-level calibration recovers lower-risk operating points while exposing policy-dependent tradeoffs among risk, coverage, and compute. On GenEval2 with FLUX at N=16, a pooled-candidate threshold yields released risk 0.310, whereas SHIP reduces it to 0.162. Across 200 cached-stream splits, the fixed-grid certificate has no target crossing. Reliable inference-time scaling therefore requires calibrating the output distribution induced by the complete deployed policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SHIP（Selection-aware Held-out calibration of Inference Policies），解决文本到图像生成系统中测试时搜索策略的校准问题。传统方法在单个候选图像上校准阈值，但实际部署策略涉及候选选择，导致校准失配。SHIP通过回放完整部署策略、使用独立评判器评估实际释放的图像，并选择满足风险预算的最宽松阈值，实现策略级校准。
AI.motivation: 验证器引导的T2I系统在测试时搜索中选择候选图像，但发布阈值通常在单个图像上校准。搜索改变了哪些提示获得输出以及释放哪个候选，因此候选级别的风险控制无法保证释放输出的风险可控。这种候选到策略的校准失配（estimand shift）是现有方法的核心问题。
AI.method: SHIP框架：(1) 通过提示重加权和提示内选择形式化estimand shift；(2) 在保留提示上运行或回放完整部署策略；(3) 使用独立目标评判器评估实际释放的图像；(4) 选择最宽松的阈值，其风险上限满足预定预算；(5) 对于可回放策略和预设阈值网格，采用同时置信控制（simultaneous confidence control）提供有限样本有效性。
AI.result: 在GenEval2上使用FLUX且N=16时，池化候选阈值产生释放风险0.310，而SHIP将其降至0.162。在200个缓存流划分中，固定网格证书无目标越界。实验覆盖固定、顺序和自适应T2I推理流程，表明策略级校准能发现更低风险的工作点，同时揭示风险、覆盖率和计算量之间的策略依赖权衡。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的推理时扩展需要校准完整部署策略所诱导的输出分布，而非单个候选图像。策略级校准框架SHIP提供了有限样本有效性的风险控制，为T2I系统安全、可靠的推理时扩展奠定了方法论基础。

title: Posterior Information Dynamics of Diffusion Models for Linear Inverse Problems
summary: Diffusion models are widely used as priors for linear inverse problems, yet endpoint quality does not reveal when measurement information enters reverse denoising or how it is allocated across signal directions. We study this process through the smoothed likelihood force, the difference between exact posterior and prior scores at each noise level. For a fixed measurement, its expected squared norm gives both posterior--prior relative-entropy dissipation and reverse-path relative-entropy growth. Averaging over measurements yields an information--minimum mean-square error (I-MMSE) identity linking information gain to denoising-error reduction. Under finite second moments, the force energy and its ratio to prior-score energy decay quadratically in the noising kernel's signal coefficient at high noise. Solvable models show that conditioning removes class separation already explained by the measurement, reduces a uniform index entropy over \(n\) empirical samples from \(\log n\) to \(H(I\mid r)\), and makes assimilation depend on operator--prior alignment even for identical singular values. Experiments in models with tractable posteriors evaluate these predictions. In a separate illustration with a frozen FFHQ model, masks sharing the same spectrum yield different prior-normalized null-space trajectory statistics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"平滑似然力"（smoothed likelihood force）——即精确后验与先验分数之间的差异——来研究扩散模型作为线性逆问题先验时，测量信息在反向去噪过程中何时进入以及如何在不同信号方向上分配的问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型广泛用于线性逆问题，但端点质量无法揭示测量信息何时进入反向去噪过程，也无法揭示信息如何在不同信号方向上进行分配。作者希望从机制层面深入理解这一过程。
AI.method: 引入平滑似然力（每个噪声水平下精确后验与先验分数之差），证明其期望平方范数同时对应后验-先验相对熵耗散和反向路径相对熵增长。对测量取平均得到I-MMSE恒等式，将信息增益与去噪误差减少联系起来。在有限二阶矩条件下，证明高噪声区力的能量及其与先验分数能量之比按噪声核信号系数的平方衰减。通过可解模型和实验验证预测。
AI.result: 可解模型显示：条件化能移除测量已解释的类别分离；使n个经验样本上的均匀指数熵从log n降至H(I|r)；信息同化取决于算子-先验对齐，即使奇异值相同。FFHQ实验表明共享相同谱的掩码产生不同的先验归一化零空间轨迹统计。
AI.conclusion: 为理解测量信息在扩散模型反向去噪中的进入时机与方向分配提供了理论框架，揭示了信息同化依赖于算子与先验的匹配关系，为设计更好的逆问题求解策略提供指导。

title: ATHENA: Knowledge-guided agentic neural architecture search for AutoFormer-based electronic health record modeling
summary: Transformer-based models are widely used for clinical prediction from electronic health records (EHRs), yet their architectures still require substantial manual tuning, and the optimal configuration may vary across tasks and hospitals. Neural architecture search (NAS) automates architecture design, but conventional methods are computationally costly for Transformer-based EHR models. Recent large language model (LLM)-guided NAS methods reduce manual search design but typically conduct each search independently, without reusing architecture knowledge across hospitals. In this study, we propose ATHENA (Agentic Transfer across Hospitals for EHR Neural Architecture Search), a knowledge-guided agentic NAS framework for Transformer-based EHR modeling. ATHENA uses a weight-sharing supernet that is pretrained once per hospital, allowing candidate architectures to be instantiated as inherited subnetworks and evaluated through fine-tuning rather than independent pretraining. It also incorporates a two-layer cross-hospital architecture prior. The first layer retrieves high-performing architecture examples from source sites based on task descriptors, while the second estimates the effects of architectural components using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based meta-regression. These priors guide a multi-agent LLM search together with validation feedback from the target hospital. Across six clinical prediction tasks and two independent health systems, ATHENA matches or outperforms four NAS baselines in 9 of 12 hospital-task evaluations at a search budget of 30. It also shows more consistent architecture selection across repeated searches. ATHENA provides a practical approach for reducing manual architecture tuning in Transformer-based EHR modeling. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/GatorAIM/ATHENA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATHENA，一个用于Transformer-based EHR模型的知识引导代理型神经架构搜索框架。它通过权重共享的超网络（每个医院预训练一次）和跨医院架构先验（基于任务描述符检索高表现架构+SHAP元回归估计组件效应），引导多代理LLM搜索。在6个临床预测任务和2个独立医疗系统中，ATHENA在12个医院-任务评估中的9个达到或超过4个NAS基线，且架构选择更一致。
AI.motivation: Transformer-based EHR模型仍需要大量手动架构调优，且最优配置因任务和医院而异。传统NAS计算成本高，现有LLM-guided NAS方法每次独立搜索，未能跨医院复用架构知识。
AI.method: 1) 权重共享超网络，每个医院预训练一次，候选架构作为继承子网络通过微调评估；2) 两层跨医院架构先验：第一层按任务描述符从源站点检索高表现架构示例，第二层用SHAP-based元回归估计架构组件效应；3) 多代理LLM搜索，结合目标医院验证反馈。
AI.result: 在6个临床预测任务和2个独立医疗系统中，ATHENA在12个医院-任务评估中的9个达到或超过4个NAS基线，搜索预算为30；在重复搜索中架构选择更一致。
AI.conclusion: ATHENA提供了减少Transformer-based EHR建模手动架构调优的实用方法，通过跨医院知识迁移和代理化搜索实现高效、一致的架构发现。

title: Formalizing and Automating Fine-Grained Move Refactorings Across Methods
comment: (C) 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary: Developers use automated Move refactorings to improve the modular structure of source code and the assignment of responsibilities. Class- and method-level Move refactorings are automated in modern IDEs, but statement- and expression-level moves that adjust method boundaries remain largely unautomated. We formalize five variants of Move Statement refactoring as preconditions and steps grounded in four basic conditions covering data reachability, execution count, side effects, and syntactic constraints required for compilation, of which all but the side-effect condition are checked statically. Combined with existing techniques, this also yields finer-grained moves of expressions and partial expressions. We further refine the formalization iteratively against a real project, deriving twenty additional preconditions and steps that handle Java syntactic diversity in practice. We evaluate applicability and compilability on ten projects, and behavior preservation in a case study on one of them: Move Statement refactorings yield compilable code in 93.3-97.0% of applicable cases, and the case study shows that the observed behavioral changes stem from side-effect reordering left to developer judgment, not from defects in the statically checked conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了五类Move Statement重构（语句级移动），基于数据可达性、执行次数、副作用和语法约束四个基本条件，其中除副作用外均静态检查。通过真实项目迭代细化出额外20条前提条件和步骤，在10个项目上评估，93.3-97.0%的情况下可生成可编译代码。
AI.motivation: 类和方法级别的Move重构已在现代IDE中自动化，但语句级和表达式级的移动（调整方法边界）在很大程度上仍未自动化。
AI.method: 形式化五类Move Statement重构变体，以四个基本条件（数据可达性、执行次数、副作用、语法约束）为前提和步骤；结合现有技术实现更细粒度的表达式及部分表达式移动；针对真实项目迭代细化形式化，补充20条额外前提条件和步骤以处理Java语法多样性。
AI.result: 在10个项目上评估，Move Statement重构在适用情况下的可编译率达93.3%-97.0%；案例分析表明观察到的行为变化源于副作用重排序（交由开发者判断），而非静态检查条件的缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 静态检查的条件可以确保行为保留，副作用重排序是行为变化的唯一来源，应由开发者自行判断。

title: RAG Collapse: LLM Responses Collapse When Retrieved Documents Are Self-Authored
summary: LLM responses are based on the internet (via training or RAG), and AI is now used to generate a significant amount of content online (Paredes et al., 2026), creating the potential for a self-reinforcing feedback loop. Prior work has shown that when LLMs are recursively trained on their own output, they experience model collapse (Shumailov et al., 2024): responses become less diverse, and eventually no longer resemble the original training data. In this paper, we show that a similar collapse occurs if LLM-based AI systems retrieve references they authored using a search tool. We call this RAG collapse. We conduct extensive experiments with three types of simulations of AI systems retrieving references they generated, using three model families, and 1,019 information-seeking prompts, totaling 1,528 simulations and over one million LLM API calls, and find that 79.6% (1,216/1,528) of simulations end in collapse. Surprisingly, even a single self-authored reference can trigger collapse because the LLM disproportionately cites its own content. This self-bias persists even after controlling for reference quality.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM系统在通过检索工具（RAG）引用自己生成的内容时会发生"RAG collapse"，即与模型坍缩类似的退化现象。实验覆盖3种模型家族、1528次模拟、超过一百万次API调用，发现79.6%的模拟最终坍缩，且即使仅引用一条自生成内容也可能因LLM的自我偏向而触发坍缩。
AI.motivation: LLM的训练或RAG检索均基于互联网内容，而互联网上越来越多内容由AI生成，形成自我强化的反馈循环。已有研究表明LLM在自身输出上递归训练会发生模型坍缩，本文想探究类似现象是否也会发生在基于检索（而非训练）的LLM系统中。
AI.method: 设计了三种AI系统模拟（检索自己生成的参考文献），使用三个模型家族和1,019个信息寻求提示词，总共进行1,528次模拟和超过一百万次LLM API调用，并通过控制参考文献质量来检验LLM的自我引用偏向。
AI.result: 79.6%（1,216/1,528）的模拟以坍塌告终。令人惊讶的是，即使只有一条自生成的参考文献也能触发坍塌，因为LLM不成比例地引用自己的内容，且这种自我偏向在控制参考文献质量后仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: RAG collapse是真实存在的风险，LLM在检索过程中对自己生成内容的偏向引用会导致系统整体退化。这提示需要关注AI生成内容在检索生态中的累积效应，以及如何设计更稳健的检索系统来避免自我强化的坍塌循环。

title: EDGE: Experience-Distillation for Guided Exploration in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning with outcome-based objectives such as GRPO enables LLM-based agents to solve complex, long-horizon tasks, yet the reusable exploration patterns embedded in interaction trajectories are largely discarded after a single policy update. Existing experience-augmented approaches retrieve historical guidance at inference time, but they apply experiences without accounting for the policy's evolving capability and create persistent dependencies on external retrieval. We propose EDGE (Experience-Distillation for Guided Exploration), a framework that treats retrieved experiences as temporary training-time scaffolds and progressively internalizes their benefits into the parametric policy. Concretely, EDGE partitions each rollout group into experience-conditioned and experience-free trajectories to estimate and admit only positive marginal gains without extra sampling, then distills the induced behavior into the base policy via a reverse-KL objective on its own empirical support. A co-evolutionary experience bank further synthesizes guidance from emerging failure modes and prunes obsolete entries as the policy evolves. On ALFWorld and WebShop, EDGE improves over GRPO by 8.3 and 12.5 success-rate points at the 7B scale and retains 96.0% of its scaffolded performance when external experiences are removed at inference time. The code is available at https://github.com/xvolcano02/EDGE.

AI.tldr: EDGE提出了一种将检索到的经验作为训练期临时脚手架、并通过蒸馏将其内化为策略参数的框架，在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别比GRPO提升8.3和12.5个成功率的百分点，且移除外部经验后仍保留96.0%的脚手架性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于结果目标的强化学习方法（如GRPO）使LLM智能体能解决复杂长时程任务，但交互轨迹中可复用的探索模式在一次策略更新后就被丢弃了。已有的经验增强方法虽然在推理时检索历史指导，但没有考虑策略能力的变化，并且对外部检索产生持续依赖。
AI.method: EDGE将检索到的经验视为训练时的临时脚手架，并将其收益逐步内化到参数化策略中。具体来说：(1) 将每次rollout分组分为经验条件轨迹和无经验轨迹，以估算并只接纳正向边际收益（无需额外采样）；(2) 通过在其自身经验支持上的反向KL目标，将诱导行为蒸馏到基础策略中；(3) 采用共同进化的经验库，从新出现的失败模式中合成指导，并随策略演化修剪过时条目。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，EDGE在7B规模下相对GRPO分别提升8.3和12.5个成功率的百分点；当推理时移除外部经验后，仍保留其脚手架性能的96.0%。
AI.conclusion: EDGE通过将外部经验作为临时训练脚手架并蒸馏内化到策略参数中，既获得了经验增强的性能提升，又在推理时消除了对外部检索的依赖，实现了经验的有益特征与策略能力演化的协同演进。

title: Fidelity-Diversity-Consistency (FDC): Data Pruning for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Despite the success of data pruning (DP) in reducing training data sizes and improving downstream model performance in classification and segmentation tasks, its potential in remote sensing change detection remains unexplored. For the first time, we benchmark six representative DP methods across building- and forest-change datasets, CNN- and transformer-based models, and three pruning budgets, and show that existing baselines yield no reliable advantage over random selection. Notably, even the strongest evaluated baseline, Feature Diversity, is matched or exceeded by $\sim$33\% of randomly sampled subsets. To understand the underlying mechanism, we conduct a systematic regression study over 540 randomly sampled data subsets, characterizing each with four descriptors covering label statistics, image diversity, and feature-space geometry. Random Forest models show that \emph{change distribution fidelity} is the most prominent factor in determining the quality of change detection data subsets, a property absent from the existing pruning literature. Our analyses further show that pixel-wise image diversity and label-feature consistency are secondary factors. We translate these findings into Fidelity-Diversity-Consistency (FDC), a simple two-stage pruning method that shows consistent improvements over existing baselines across change detection benchmarks and backbones, especially at lower pruning ratios. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/ddydyd32/fidelity-diversity-consistency}{https://github.com/ddydyd32/fidelity-diversity-consistency}.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地将数据剪枝（DP）方法应用于遥感变化检测任务，基准测试了六种代表性DP方法，发现现有基线在变化检测中并无可靠优势（甚至不如随机选择）。通过对540个随机数据子集的回归分析，发现"变化分布保真度"是决定子集质量的最关键因素。基于此提出了FDC（Fidelity-Diversity-Consistency）两阶段剪枝方法，在多个变化检测基准和骨干网络上取得了一致改进。
AI.motivation: 数据剪枝在分类和分割任务中已取得显著成功，但尚未在遥感变化检测中探索。作者希望填补这一空白，同时揭示现有DP方法在该领域失效的原因，并据此提出更有效的方法。
AI.method: 1) 基准测试六种代表性DP方法在两个变化检测数据集（建筑和森林）、两种骨干网络（CNN和Transformer）以及三种剪枝预算下的表现；2) 对540个随机采样的数据子集进行系统回归研究，用四个描述子（标签统计、图像多样性、特征空间几何）刻画子集特征，用随机森林模型识别影响子集质量的关键因素；3) 基于"变化分布保真度"作为首要因素，提出FDC两阶段剪枝方法。
AI.result: 现有DP基线在变化检测中无可靠优势，最强基线Feature Diversity甚至被约33%的随机子集匹配或超越。回归分析表明"变化分布保真度"是最关键因素，像素级图像多样性和标签-特征一致性为次要因素。FDC方法在变化检测基准和骨干网络上持续优于现有基线，尤其在低剪枝比例下改进更显著。
AI.conclusion: 现有数据剪枝方法在变化检测任务中失效的根本原因在于它们忽视了"变化分布保真度"这一独特属性。FDC通过将这一洞察转化为简单有效的两阶段剪枝策略，证明了在变化检测中数据剪枝仍可实现持续收益。

title: Reinforcement Learning on Benign Facts Amplifies Leakage of Memorized Private Data
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is deployed to make models better at reasoning tasks, but its side effect on what models will divulge is under studied. Here we show that RLVR on facts increases extraction of personally identifiable information (PII) the instruct model had already memorized. We first confirm that instruct models have already memorized PII but leave them latent, rarely surfacing one when asked. We then apply RL on benign factual data that contains no PII of any kind, and re-probe: a targeted probe over name->email pairs, and an untargeted free-recall prompt that simply asks the model to list the addresses it knows. PII extraction rises sharply under both: on DeepSeek-V3.1, verbatim recall@k increases from 0.155 to 0.370, a 2.4x gain. The effect scales with model size: across three models spanning 8B to 671B parameters, absolute leakage is largest in the biggest model. Meanwhile model's reasoning abilities and refusal rates are retained, indicating that RL selectively changes which memorized information is accessible rather than broadly altering the model. In summary, memorized private data can be made markedly more extractable by training that never touches it. This gives an adversary a route to memorized data that requires no privacy-relevant training signal and no access to the data itself -- only the ability to fine-tune on something innocuous.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在良性事实数据上进行训练，会显著提高模型提取已记忆的个人身份信息（PII）的能力。在DeepSeek-V3.1上，姓名到邮箱的逐字召回率从0.155提高到0.370（2.4倍），且该效应随模型规模增大而增强。这为攻击者提供了一条无需隐私相关训练信号、无需访问数据本身即可提取记忆数据的路径。
AI.motivation: RLVR被广泛用于提升模型的推理能力，但其对模型信息泄露的副作用尚未被充分研究。作者希望探究RLVR训练是否会意外增加模型提取已记忆的PII的风险。
AI.method: 首先确认指令模型已记忆PII但保持潜在状态（很少主动浮现）；然后在完全不含PII的良性事实数据上应用强化学习，随后通过两种方式重新探测：针对性探测（姓名->邮箱对）和非针对性自由回忆提示（要求模型列出已知地址）。
AI.result: PII提取率在两种探测下均急剧上升：DeepSeek-V3.1上逐字召回率从0.155升至0.370（2.4倍）。该效应随模型规模扩大而增强（8B到671B参数），最大模型泄露量最大。同时，模型的推理能力和拒答率保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 记忆中的私有数据可以通过从未接触这些数据的训练而被显著提升可提取性。RL选择性改变了哪些记忆信息可被访问，而非广泛改变模型行为。这为攻击者提供了一条无需隐私相关训练信号、无需访问数据本身即可提取记忆数据的途径。

title: Ask or Answer: A Decision Framework for Multi-Turn Health Misinformation Intervention
summary: Correcting health misinformation in dialogue requires more than producing a factual rebuttal: users differ in what they know, what they believe, and what they need to hear, so an effective intervention often depends on first asking the right clarifying question. Yet existing methods either respond immediately or probe indiscriminately, treating clarification as either unnecessary or always beneficial. We propose Reward-Optimized Probe-and-Respond (RO-PnR), a framework that learns when asking is worth its cost. At each turn, RO-PnR chooses between probing for more information and committing to a final correction, guided by a turn-level reward that weighs the expected gain from probing against its interaction cost. To capture how user heterogeneity affects probing value, we model each simulated user with a latent state along health literacy and belief commitment. Experiments show that RO-PnR achieves the highest cost-adjusted utility across three health-misinformation datasets and three base models, using 30% fewer turns than always-probe baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RO-PnR框架，用于健康错误信息对话纠正。该框架通过学习判断何时提问比直接纠正更有价值，在每次对话中权衡"探索性提问"与"直接纠正"两种策略，并考虑用户的健康素养和信念承诺等潜在状态，从而在更少轮次下实现更高的成本调整效用。
AI.motivation: 纠正健康错误信息不能仅仅给出事实性反驳，因为不同用户的知识水平、信念和需求各不相同。有效的干预往往需要先提出合适的澄清问题。然而现有方法要么立即回应（忽略澄清的必要性），要么不加区分地提问（不考虑提问成本），缺乏对"何时提问值得"的智能判断。
AI.method: 提出Reward-Optimized Probe-and-Respond (RO-PnR)框架。每轮对话中，该框架在"探询更多信息"和"直接给出最终纠正"之间做出选择，由回合级奖励函数驱动，该奖励权衡了探询带来的预期收益与其交互成本。为捕捉用户异质性对探询价值的影响，通过健康素养和信念承诺两个维度为每个模拟用户建模潜在状态。
AI.result: 在三个健康错误信息数据集和三个基础模型上，RO-PnR取得了最高的成本调整效用，并且比始终探询的基线方法节省了30%的对话轮次。
AI.conclusion: 智能地判断何时提问而非盲目提问，能够显著提升健康错误信息纠正对话的效用与效率，验证了将提问视为有成本、有条件性策略的有效性。

title: An Interactive Agent for Requirement-Driven Candidate Sourcing
summary: Finding people from a natural-language description (``ML engineers transitioning to research roles in biotech'') is increasingly delegated to LLM agents and framed as information retrieval. We argue that it is fundamentally a requirements engineering task: such a request is an under-determined requirement with implicit constraints, many valid answers, and no acceptance criterion, so useful answers require eliciting, validating, and verifying the requirement before search can matter. We present \sys{}, to our knowledge the first interactive, requirements-driven candidate-sourcing agent (it elicits, validates, retrieves, and verifies a vague people-request into a justified slate through bounded elicitation, workflow templates, a two-stage commit protocol, and bidirectional termination guards) and \bench{}, a benchmark that runs the requirements lifecycle (criteria-anchored validation, multi-model evidence-grounded oracle construction, and cost-aware verification). Across $21$ systems and all $691$ requirements, \sys{} dominates breadth ($100%$ coverage at $2.5\times$ the yield) and is \emph{near-orthogonal} to the field, with $90%$ of the people it returns are surfaced by \emph{none} of $20$ strong LLM-plus-web baselines combined. Beyond breadth, an evidence-grounded judging of every system shows \sys{} \emph{recalls} the most relevant real people: $0.241$ of the union pool, $1.9\times$ the next system, with a bootstrap $95%$ interval disjoint from every baseline. \sys{} is thus the strongest \emph{sourcing} engine (the deepest real, reachable candidate pool), while precision-ranking LLMs serve as~complementary verifiers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将"从自然语言描述中寻找人才"这一任务重新定义为需求工程任务而非单纯的信息检索，并为此构建了首个交互式、需求驱动的候选人才挖掘Agent（\sys{}）及其配套基准（\bench{}）。实验表明\sys{}在覆盖率和召回率上显著优于20个强基线系统，其返回的90%人才是其他系统从未发现的，展现了近正交的互补优势。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM Agent将模糊的人才搜索请求当作信息检索任务处理，但这类请求本质上是欠定义的需求——包含隐式约束、存在多个有效答案、且缺乏验收标准。仅靠检索无法产生有用的结果，必须先进行需求的澄清、验证和确认。
AI.method: 提出\sys{}，一个需求驱动的候选挖掘Agent，包含四个关键机制：有界澄清（bounded elicitation）、工作流模板（workflow templates）、两阶段提交协议（two-stage commit protocol）和双向终止守卫（bidirectional termination guards），覆盖需求的引出、验证、检索和核实全流程。同时构建\bench{}基准，实现基于标准锚定的验证、多模型证据构建的oracle，以及成本感知的核实。
AI.result: 在21个系统和691个需求上，\sys{}实现了100%覆盖率和2.5倍产出；90%的返回人才未被20个强基线系统发现。在证据导向的评估中，\sys{}的真实相关人才召回率达0.241，是次优系统的1.9倍，bootstrap 95%置信区间与所有基线不相交。
AI.conclusion: \sys{}是最强的人才挖掘引擎（构建了最深、可触达的真实候选人池），而面向精度排序的LLM可作为互补的验证工具，两者形成协同而非竞争关系。

title: VERDICT: Agreement Beats Pixel-Space Verification in Real-Document OCSR
summary: Optical Chemical Structure Recognition (OCSR) converts 2D molecular depictions in the published literature into SMILES, and is increasingly important for constructing large-scale chemical training datasets. Automation at that scale requires identifying unreliable predictions in the absence of ground truth. Three families of label-free signals were compared on $263$ ACS journal depictions with verified ground truth: model confidence, re-rendering similarity, and agreement among recognizers. Pixel-space re-rendering performed little better than chance (AUROC $0.547$, $95\%$ CI $[0.465,0.629]$), and an oracle-tuned threshold on it reduced correct labels per image from $0.745$ to $0.205$. Agreement among four architecturally distinct recognizers instead reached an AUROC of $0.916$ ($[0.880,0.952]$). The two-of-four rule accepted $81.7\%$ of images at $88.8\%$ precision, the three-of-four rule $52.1\%$ at $98.5\%$. The same pattern held on CLEF-IP, UOB, and USPTO. This distinction is obscured on synthetic benchmarks, where re-rendered predictions naturally resemble their inputs. A substance filter removed $2{,}193$ false agreements on wildcards and R-group fragments, after which the three-of-four rule rejected all $68$ generic depictions. VERDICT was then applied to PMC Open Access, producing $6{,}146$ structure labels for $4{,}833$ molecules; chemist adjudication of $400$ released labels in two independent samples yielded precisions of $0.995$ for the three-of-four tier and $0.958$ for the two-of-four tier. VERDICT therefore enables validated labels for multimodal molecular databases linking structure images, machine-readable representations, and source-publication information. In SES AI's Molecular Universe platform, VERDICT further serves as an image-based interface for searching and retrieving molecular records.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VERDICT框架，利用多识别器一致性（而非重渲染相似度或模型置信度）作为无标签信号来筛选OCSR预测结果，在多种数据集上验证了其有效性，并用于PMC开放获取文献的大规模化学结构标注。
AI.motivation: 大规模化学数据集构建需要OCSR自动转换分子结构图，但自动化流程缺乏真实标签来识别不可靠预测。作者对比三种无标签信号（模型置信度、重渲染相似度、多识别器一致性），发现广泛使用的重渲染方法几乎无效，需要更可靠的质量控制信号。
AI.method: 对比三种无标签信号（模型置信度、像素空间重渲染相似度、四个架构不同的识别器之间的协议），采用two-of-four和three-of-four投票规则评估预测可靠性，并通过物质过滤器去除通配符和R基团片段导致的虚假一致，最终应用到PMC开放获取数据集生成标注。
AI.result: 重渲染相似度AUROC仅0.547（接近随机），而多识别器一致性AUROC达0.916。three-of-four规则在接受52.1%图像时达到98.5%精度；在PMC上产出6,146个结构标签，经化学家仲裁两独立样本精度达0.995（三选四）和0.958（二选四）。
AI.conclusion: VERDICT通过多识别器一致性为无真实标签的OCSR输出提供可靠的置信度信号，能够生成经验证的高精度化学结构标签，支持大规模多模态分子数据库的构建，已在SES AI的Molecular Universe平台中作为图像检索界面实际应用。

title: Bulbul: A Dataset for Dialectal Arabic Speech Recognition
summary: Arabic automatic speech recognition (ASR) faces unique challenges due to diglossia, extensive regional dialect variation, and limited speech resources. Existing speech datasets often focus on single dialects or large-scale broadcast/web data, leading to trade-offs between linguistic diversity and annotation quality. We present BULBUL, a multi-dialect Arabic ASR dataset collected from 275 speakers in 11 Arab countries. BULBUL includes structured dialect and sub-dialect coverage, as well as recordings of classical Arabic and modern standard Arabic spoken by participants in their native dialectal accents to support accent-aware modeling. The quality of the recordings was ensured through a two-level human verification process. We further benchmark a range of recent ASR systems, establishing strong baselines for modern dialectal and accented Arabic ASR.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了BULBUL，一个多方言阿拉伯语ASR数据集，收录了来自11个阿拉伯国家275位讲话者的语音数据，包含结构化方言/次方言覆盖以及古典阿拉伯语和现代标准阿拉伯语的录音，并通过两级人工验证确保质量，同时评测了多种最新ASR系统建立基线。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语ASR面临diglossia（双言现象）、广泛的地区方言差异和语音资源有限等独特挑战。现有数据集要么集中于单一方言，要么依赖大规模的广播/网络数据，导致语言多样性和标注质量之间存在权衡，需要一个新的数据集来同时兼顾方言覆盖度和标注质量。
AI.method: 从11个阿拉伯国家的275位讲话者收集多方言语音数据；设计了结构化的方言和次方言覆盖体系；包括参与者以其母语方言口音朗读的古典阿拉伯语和现代标准阿拉伯语录音，以支持口音感知建模；采用两级人工验证流程确保录音质量。
AI.result: 构建了BULBUL数据集，覆盖多方言和不同阿拉伯语变体，并通过两级人工验证保证了数据质量。此外，对多种近期的ASR系统进行了基准评测，为现代方言和带口音的阿拉伯语ASR建立了强基线。
AI.conclusion: BULBUL数据集通过平衡语言多样性与标注质量，为阿拉伯语方言ASR研究提供了高质量资源，其基线评测将推动口音感知和多方言阿拉伯语语音识别的研究进展。

title: Learning to Look Again: Loss-Gap Supervision for Free-form Crop Routing in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) fail many detail-centric questions for a concrete reason: the answer is visible in the image, yet lost after the image is compressed into a low-resolution global view.
