Allocating more visual tokens to every query improves some OCR and document cases, but it spends computation indiscriminately and can disturb tasks that rely on global context. We propose GapSight, a framework for learning visual re-reading: a VLM first takes a global glance, then selectively returns to a free-form region when the question calls for local evidence. The supervision comes from the target model's own failure signal. Offline, we compare answer loss or multiple-choice option margin under a global-only view and candidate crop-augmented views; crops that improve the target answer become model-specific review labels. A lightweight free-form crop router distills these labels into a one-shot inference policy that predicts whether to review, expected utility, and a continuous crop box from the global state. Across LLaVA-1.5-7B, InternVL2.5-8B, and Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, GapSight improves the Base no-zoom baseline on six benchmarks spanning OCR, documents, charts, infographics, VStarBench, and MME-RealWorld-Lite. On InternVL2.5-8B, GapSight raises the six-benchmark average from 52.25 to 64.29, above CropVLM (57.16), ViCrop (55.84), and ZoomRefine (54.43). Mechanism analyses show that the router rescues concrete wrong answers, adapts its action rate by task, and forms a favorable token-performance profile. These results position loss-gap supervision as a practical route to teaching VLMs when and where to look again.

AI.tldr: GapSight是一个让视觉语言模型(VLM)学会"重新阅读"的框架。模型先全局扫视，当问题需要局部证据时，再选择性回到自由区域查看细节。通过目标模型自身的失败信号（损失或选项间隔）离线生成审查标签，训练轻量级路由器实现一次性推断策略。在多个基准上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: VLM在处理细节密集型问题时经常失败，根本原因是答案虽在图像中可见，但在图像被压缩成低分辨率全局视图的过程中丢失了。现有的增加视觉token方法会不加区分地消耗计算资源，甚至干扰依赖全局上下文的任务。因此需要一种能选择性回顾局部区域的机制。
AI.method: GapSight框架：(1) VLM先进行全局扫视；(2) 离线阶段，通过比较全局视图与候选裁剪增强视图下的答案损失或多选选项间隔，找出能改善目标答案的裁剪作为模型特定的审查标签；(3) 用轻量级自由形式裁剪路由器蒸馏这些标签，训练出一站式推断策略，能预测是否需要审查、预期效用及连续裁剪框。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B、InternVL2.5-8B和Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct上，GapSight在六个基准（OCR、文档、图表、信息图、VStarBench、MME-RealWorld-Lite）上均优于Base无缩放基线。在InternVL2.5-8B上，六基准平均分从52.25提升到64.29，超过CropVLM(57.16)、ViCrop(55.84)和ZoomRefine(54.43)。机制分析显示路由器能纠正具体错误答案、按任务自适应行动率，并形成有利的token-性能配置。
AI.conclusion: 损失差距监督为教会VLM"何时何地再次查看"提供了实用路径，GapSight通过选择性视觉重读在细节任务上取得显著性能提升。

title: Adaptive Multilevel Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo for Rare Events Estimation in Language Models
summary: Rare unsafe behaviors in large language models can remain practically significant even when their probability is extremely small, particularly at deployment scales involving millions or billions of interactions. Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) provides a principled framework for rare-event probability estimation by learning twist functions that guide generation toward a target event. However, the standard twist learning framework relies on positive samples from the rare-event target distribution, which may be nearly absent before an informative twist has been learned, resulting in unreliable rare-event estimation. We propose Adaptive Multilevel Twisted SMC, which learns the rare-event twist through a sequence of progressively rarer intermediate events. At each level, the learned twist provides more informative positive examples for learning the next twist, ultimately leading to a more accurate final twist for the target rare event. Experiments across diverse tasks and model scales show that the proposed method produces more accurate rare-event probability estimates. By enabling more reliable discovery of hard-to-observe unsafe behaviors, our method provides a practical tool for strengthening the evaluation and safety alignment of deployed language models.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应多级扭曲序贯蒙特卡洛方法（Adaptive Multilevel Twisted SMC），通过一系列逐步变难的中间事件来逐步学习扭曲函数，从而更准确地估计大语言模型中极低概率的罕见不安全行为的发生概率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型中罕见的危险行为即使在概率极小时也可能在数十亿次交互的部署规模下造成重大影响。现有的Twisted SMC框架依赖从稀有事件目标分布中采样正样本，但在扭曲函数尚未学到有效信息之前，正样本几乎不存在，导致稀有事件概率估计不可靠。
AI.method: 提出自适应多级扭曲SMC框架：通过一系列逐步变稀有的中间事件构建学习阶梯，在每一级利用上一级学到的扭曲函数生成有信息量的正样本，用于指导学习下一级更稀有事件的扭曲函数，最终获得对目标稀有事件更精准的扭曲估计。
AI.result: 在多种任务和不同模型规模上的实验表明，该方法比现有方法产生更准确的稀有事件概率估计，能更可靠地发现难以观察到的危险行为。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为评估和强化已部署语言模型的安全性提供了实用工具，通过更准确地估计和发现稀有危险行为来支持安全对齐工作。

title: ECHO: A Cognitively Inspired, Auditable Memory Plane for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents need memory that identifies relevant experience, resolves revisions, and exposes checkable provenance. We present ECHO (Embodied Context and History Orchestration), an auditable memory architecture and service prototype inspired by episodic encoding, consolidation, contextual reinstatement, reconsolidation, and executive control. This is functional inspiration, not neural equivalence; the empirical analysis focuses on retrieval and context construction. Development runs reach 96.29% Hit@10 and 73.64% turn Recall@5 on 1,536 LoCoMo category 1-4 questions, and 97.60% Hit@10, 88.84% turn Recall@5, and 88.71% session Recall@5 on all 500 LongMemEval-S questions. A five-history BEAM gate fails, and in a separate matched 91-question QA sample Mem0 OSS scores 64.84% versus ECHO's 41.76% (exact McNemar p = 0.00107), with a history-cluster interval crossing zero. A post-hoc audit found source-specific phrases in the query-expansion rules. Although no gold answer field entered the runtime, expansion-enabled retrieval scores are therefore descriptive development measurements, not independent confirmation.

AI.tldr: ECHO是一个受认知记忆机制（情景编码、整合、情境重提、再巩固和执行控制）启发的可审计记忆架构，专为长时程智能体设计，用于识别相关经验、处理修订并暴露可核查的来源。开发阶段实验在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S数据集上取得较好检索指标，但BEAM门控失败，且与Mem0基线对比中指标波动。事后审计发现查询扩展规则中含有特定来源短语，因此尽管运行时未注入正确答案，扩展式检索结果只能视为描述性开发测量，而非独立验证。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体在记忆管理上面临三大关键挑战：需要从海量历史中识别相关经验、处理信息的修订与更新、以及为用户提供可验证的来源证据。现有方法缺乏能够系统应对这些需求的记忆架构，因此需要一种可审计的记忆方案来支撑长时程决策。
AI.method: 提出ECHO（Embodied Context and History Orchestration）记忆架构，该架构从情景记忆编码、记忆巩固、情境重提、再巩固及执行控制等认知机制中获得功能性启发（非神经等价），并实现为服务原型。实证分析聚焦于检索能力和上下文构建两部分。
AI.result: 开发运行在1,536个LoCoMo类别1-4问题上达到96.29% Hit@10和73.64% turn Recall@5；在全部500个LongMemEval-S问题上达到97.60% Hit@10、88.84% turn Recall@5和88.71% session Recall@5。但五历史的BEAM门控失败。在匹配的91问题QA样本中，Mem0 OSS得分64.84%而ECHO为41.76%（精确McNemar p=0.00107），历史簇区间跨越零。事后审计发现查询扩展规则中含来源特定短语，使扩展式检索结果只能作为描述性开发测量。
AI.conclusion: ECHO在内部开发数据集上展示出有前景的检索性能，但存在明显局限：BEAM门控机制失败、与Mem0对比的QA结果不稳健，且查询扩展规则中的来源污染使结果只能视为描述性而非独立的性能确认。该工作仍需通过消除潜在数据泄漏后重新评估来建立可靠的有效性证据。

title: ExecRubrics: Executable Tool-Augmented Rubrics for Verifiable and Efficient Long-Form Evaluation
summary: Rubrics aim to make language-model evaluation transparent by decomposing response quality into interpretable criteria. However, natural-language rubrics are often ambiguous, require black-box LLM judges, and typically assume criteria aggregate independently through linear weighted sums, limiting their ability to capture dependencies, alternatives, penalties, and override conditions. We propose ExecRubrics, a framework for representing rubrics as compact executable programs. ExecRubrics encodes evaluation logic as verifiable Python scoring functions, giving natural-language rubric intent an operational semantics: a fixed decision procedure that can be inspected, executed, and edited. On three long-form response benchmarks-HealthBench, HelpSteer, and ArgQuality-we show that ExecRubrics can substitute for expensive black-box judges in ranking preferred over dispreferred responses, matching or improving NL rubric baselines with best preference accuracies of 53%, 78%, and 92%, respectively, while reducing evaluation latency by up to 320 times. We show that incorporating external logic and resources from text processing libraries such as NLTK and spaCy further improves preference accuracy. Our results suggest a novel way of looking at evaluation, by offering a faster, more explainable, and less ambiguous alternative to black-box rubric evaluation, particularly in high-stakes domains such as healthcare and banking where precision and auditability are critical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ExecRubrics框架，将评估标准（rubrics）表示为可执行的Python评分程序，替代昂贵的黑盒LLM评判器。在三个长文本响应基准上，ExecRubrics以最高92%的偏好准确率匹配或超越自然语言标准基线，并将评估延迟降低最多320倍，提供了更快、更可解释、更少歧义的评估方案。
AI.motivation: 自然语言评估标准存在歧义、依赖黑盒LLM评判器、且假设各标准通过线性加权独立聚合，无法捕捉标准之间的依赖关系、替代方案、惩罚条件和覆盖逻辑等复杂评估情况。
AI.method: ExecRubrics将评估标准编码为紧凑的可执行Python评分函数，赋予自然语言标准意图以操作语义——一个可检查、可执行、可编辑的固定决策过程。同时整合NLTK和spaCy等文本处理库的外部逻辑与资源来提升表现。
AI.result: 在HealthBench、HelpSteer和ArgQuality三个基准上，偏好准确率分别达到53%、78%和92%，匹配或超越NL rubric基线，同时将评估延迟降低最多320倍。引入外部文本处理库可进一步提升偏好准确率。
AI.conclusion: ExecRubrics提供了一种新颖的评估视角，作为黑盒评估标准的替代方案，在高风险领域（如医疗和金融）中具有更快的速度、更好的可解释性和更少的歧义，对精度和可审计性至关重要。

title: ToSCA: Leveraging Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning on Temporal and Strategic Abstractions of Conversational Agents
summary: Humans have multiple levels of temporal abstractions on daily interaction and thinking, such as concept perception and strategic planning. Inspired by this nature, we propose a two-level hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework for conversational agents, bridging the gap between previous token-level or utterance-level RL methods. Developed on a two-level MDP, the token-level response decoding is conditioned on the utterance-level action, the explicit textual strategies. Based on theoretical derivation and efficiency consideration, we use DQN to solve the high-level critic and PPO to solve the low-level actor-critic. To further alleviate the reward sparsity and facilitate the convergence, we also design the dual-granularity reward mechanism, in which the utterance-level satisfaction score is integrated with token-level intrinsic motivation and K-L penalty. Experiments on both daily and emotional support conversations show that our method outperforms versatile baselines in strategy determination and response quality. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/AaronJi/ToSCA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向对话智能体的两层级强化学习框架（ToSCA），在token级和utterance级两个层次上进行分层决策，采用DQN解决高层策略决策、PPO解决低层响应生成，并设计双粒度奖励机制缓解奖励稀疏问题，在日常对话和情感支持对话任务上均优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 人类在日常交互和思考中具有多层级的时间抽象能力（如概念感知和战略规划），而以往面向对话智能体的强化学习方法仅停留在token级或utterance级，缺乏对这两个层级进行统一建模的框架，难以实现更自然的策略规划和响应生成。
AI.method: 提出一个两层级马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）框架：高层（utterance-level）负责显式文本策略选择，通过DQN求解；低层（token-level）响应解码以高层策略为条件，通过PPO求解actor-critic。同时设计双粒度奖励机制，将utterance级满意度分数与token级内在动机和KL惩罚相结合，以缓解奖励稀疏问题并促进收敛。
AI.result: 在日常对话和情感支持对话两个场景的实验表明，该方法在策略确定和响应质量方面均优于多种基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 两层级分层强化学习框架能够有效弥合token级与utterance级RL方法之间的差距，通过显式策略引导和双粒度奖励机制提升对话智能体的策略选择能力和响应质量。

title: LiteEvent-AE: Lightweight Autoencoder for Event-Based Vision on Low-Latency Energy-Constrained Edge Devices
summary: Event-based vision has emerged as a promising paradigm for energy-aware artificial intelligence (AI), offering sparse, low-latency visual signals that reduce redundant data processing and support sustainable edge computing. However, the asynchronous and noise-prone nature of event streams creates challenges for conventional deep learning models, which are often too computationally intensive for low-power embedded platforms. This work presents a compact and configurable event-driven autoencoder that efficiently compresses neuromorphic data while preserving essential spatiotemporal structure for downstream inference. The architecture integrates lightweight convolutional encoding with robust performance under adaptive event thresholding and a minimal classifier head, enabling substantial reductions in computational cost without degrading recognition fidelity. Extensive evaluations on the Smart Event Face Dataset (SEFD) and Event-Based Crossing Dataset (EBCD) show that the proposed framework achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared to YOLOv9 while requiring up to 35.6$\times$ fewer parameters. To assess real-world sustainability, the model is deployed on resource-constrained hardware: a Raspberry Pi 4B and a NVIDIA Jetson Nano. On NVIDIA Jetson Nano, it delivers real-time throughput of 44.8 FPS. On a Raspberry Pi 4B CPU, the 50\% autoencoder classifier consumes 16.19 J for the evaluated inference workload, corresponding to approximately 726.3$\times$ lower energy consumption than YOLOv9 under the same evaluation protocol. These results demonstrate the potential of compact event-driven models to advance environmentally conscious, low-power AI systems for high-speed perception in autonomous, mobile, and embedded computing environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种紧凑且可配置的事件驱动自编码器，用于高效压缩神经形态数据，同时保留下游推理所需的关键时空结构。在SEFD和EBCD数据集上达到与YOLOv9相当或更优的精度，参数减少高达35.6倍。部署在Jetson Nano上达到44.8 FPS实时吞吐，在树莓派4B上能耗比YOLOv9低726.3倍，展示了事件驱动紧凑模型在低功耗边缘AI中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 事件视觉为节能AI提供了有前景的范式，但事件流的异步性和噪声特性为传统深度学习模型带来挑战，这些模型往往计算密集，难以在低功耗嵌入式平台上运行。存在对高效压缩神经形态数据并支持低功耗边缘计算的紧凑模型的需求。
AI.method: 提出一个紧凑、可配置的事件驱动自编码器架构，集成了轻量级卷积编码、自适应事件阈值下的鲁棒性能以及极简分类头。通过压缩减少计算成本，同时保留时空结构用于下游推理。
AI.result: 在SEFD和EBCD数据集上达到与YOLOv9竞争或更优的准确率，参数减少高达35.6倍。在Jetson Nano上达到44.8 FPS实时吞吐；在树莓派4B CPU上50%自编码器分类器推理能耗为16.19 J，比YOLOv9低约726.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑事件驱动模型能够在保持识别性能的同时大幅降低计算和能耗成本，为自主、移动和嵌入式环境中的高速感知提供环境友好、低功耗AI解决方案。

title: Width-Independent Compressibility of Deep Neural Networks
comment: 11 pages main text, 28 pages total, 4 figures
summary: It has long been known that well-trained neural networks can be compressed very strongly without affecting their performance, an important phenomenon that remains poorly understood. We prove a uniform compressibility theorem for deep multilayer perceptrons with analytic activations. For a deep, wide fixed teacher network, there exists a narrow (same depth) network that approximately represents the same function as the original. The reachable compressed width is strikingly independent of the original width, but is $O((\log(1/\varepsilon))^{d_{in}})$, where $\varepsilon$ is the error budget and $d_{in}$ is the effective input dimension. Our construction involves a novel derivative-matching technique which is aware of the low-dimensional input, and a layer-wise reweighting that preserves the input-output mapping.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一个深度多层感知机（使用解析激活函数）的均匀可压缩性定理：对于任意深度和宽度的教师网络，存在一个同深度但更窄的网络，能以任意小误差近似表示同一函数。压缩后的宽度仅与误差预算的对数和有效输入维度相关，与原始网络宽度无关。
AI.motivation: 经验表明训练良好的神经网络可以被大幅压缩而不影响性能，这一重要现象长期缺乏理论解释。作者旨在从理论上阐明神经网络的强可压缩性，填补这一理解空白。
AI.method: 提出了两种关键技术：(1) 一种低维输入感知的导数匹配（derivative-matching）技术，用于在压缩时保持函数的导数信息；(2) 一种逐层重新加权（layer-wise reweighting）方法，确保输入-输出映射在压缩前后得到保持。
AI.result: 证明压缩后的网络宽度可以达到 O((log(1/ε))^{d_in})，其中 ε 为误差预算，d_in 为有效输入维度。这一宽度界限引人注目地与原始网络宽度完全独立，深刻揭示了深度网络冗余性的本质。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从理论层面解释了神经网络可压缩性的根源：深度网络虽宽但本质上由低维有效输入维度决定其信息复杂度。压缩宽度依赖于误差的对数而非多项式，意味着极高的压缩率在理论上总是可行。

title: What Does CLIP Learn for Regional Geolocalization? Probing Visual Cues and Scene Configuration After Adaptation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Manuscript under review
summary: Large collections of street-view imagery provide rich visual information about urban environments, but extracting fine-grained geographic information from such data remains challenging. In particular, fine-grained regional geolocalization is challenging because nearby areas often share coarse geographic cues. We study regional geolocalization within a metropolitan area and ask whether pretrained CLIP features are sufficient for regional discrimination, and what visual information supports performance after adaptation. Using 9,085 street-view images from eight Greater Los Angeles regions, we compare zero-shot CLIP, frozen-encoder readouts, partial encoder updating, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and full fine-tuning. Frozen readouts remain near the 39.03% zero-shot accuracy, whereas encoder adaptation achieves 75.94-82.10%. Full fine-tuning also reduces the mean distance to the predicted region center from 12.30 km to 3.86 km. We probe these gains through semantic cue removal, appearance reduction using edge maps and blur, and scene-configuration disruption using patch scrambling. Adapted models achieve higher edge and blur accuracy and switch 42.92-45.56% of predictions after scrambling, compared with 10.79-14.60% for frozen methods. However, adaptation does not improve the fraction of performance retained after appearance reduction, while vegetation and sky remain influential. A Caltech101 control further shows that scrambling sensitivity is not unique to geolocalization. Overall, encoder adaptation substantially improves nearby-region discrimination and is associated with greater sensitivity to intact scene configuration, without evidence that coarse structure alone becomes sufficient for prediction. These conclusions concern viewpoint variation near known locations rather than geographically disjoint generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大都市区域内的细粒度地理定位问题，比较了零样本CLIP、冻结编码器、部分更新、LoRA和全量微调等方法在8个洛杉矶地区9,085张街景图像上的表现。结果表明编码器适应显著提升性能（75.94-82.10%对比零样本39.03%），但性能提升与对完整场景配置的敏感性增强相关，而非仅依赖粗粒度结构。
AI.motivation: 街景图像包含丰富的城市环境视觉信息，但从中提取细粒度地理信息具有挑战性。特别是都市区域内的细粒度地理定位很难，因为相邻区域往往共享粗粒度的地理线索。作者希望探究预训练CLIP特征是否足以进行区域判别，以及适应（adaptation）后哪些视觉信息支撑了性能提升。
AI.method: 使用9,085张来自大洛杉矶地区8个区域的街景图像，系统比较了五种方法：零样本CLIP、冻结编码器读出、部分编码器更新、Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)以及全量微调。通过语义线索移除、边缘图和模糊化的外观缩减、以及块打乱的场景配置破坏等消融实验来探明性能增益来源。
AI.result: 冻结读出方案保持接近39.03%的零样本准确率，而编码器适应达到75.94-82.10%。全量微调将预测区域中心的平均距离从12.30公里降至3.86公里。适应模型在边缘图和模糊图上的准确率更高，且块打乱后预测切换比例为42.92-45.56%（冻结方法仅为10.79-14.60%）。但适应并未改善外观缩减后的性能保留比例，且植被和天空仍是影响性能的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 编码器适应显著提升邻近区域判别能力，并与对完整场景配置的更高敏感性相关。但没有证据表明仅靠粗粒度结构就能实现预测。实验还通过Caltech101对照实验表明打乱敏感性并非地理定位所独有。结论限于已知位置附近的视角变化，而非地理上不重叠的泛化。

title: Repo2Skill-Evo: Repository Skills Go Stale in Silence
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over evolving software repositories, where success depends on repository-specific procedural knowledge: which APIs to call, which scripts to run, and which conventions the current release expects. Agent skills externalize this knowledge into reusable units, and prior work shows that they can improve agent performance. What remains unclear is whether that improvement is durable. The same version specificity that makes a skill useful also makes it fragile: after a release, it may become stale without raising any explicit signal, while continuing to provide obsolete guidance. Externalizing knowledge into a skill can therefore make its decay invisible.
  We study whether agents can keep this externalized knowledge current. Repo2Skill-Evo casts each release transition as a skill-maintenance task: given a V1 skill set and the official V1-to-V2 patch, an agent must update obsolete skill content while preserving guidance that remains valid. Across 57 real-world repositories and 105 selected release transitions, every evaluated transition invalidates part of the V1 skill set. Yet six frontier agents reach only 29.9%-69.7% avg@3 macro F1 under a patch-grounded removal metric that balances stale-content recall against over-editing precision. Across runs, two opposing errors dominate: incomplete coverage of affected files in the skill set leaves stale content untouched, while overbroad editing is associated with higher recall but lower precision. Repository skills go stale in silence, and even frontier agents cannot reliably maintain them.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM智能体能否维护外部化的仓库技能知识。通过Repo2Skill-Evo框架，将每次版本发布转换视为技能维护任务，在57个真实仓库和105个版本转换上测试六个前沿智能体，发现所有转换都会使部分V1技能失效，而最佳智能体在修补基础的移除指标下仅达69.7% avg@3 macro F1。仓库技能会无声失效，前沿智能体也无法可靠维护。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖仓库特定的程序性知识（API调用、脚本、约定），技能外部化虽能提升性能，但其版本特异性导致知识会随版本发布而过时且无显式信号提示。现有研究忽视了技能维护的持久性问题——技能会无声地腐烂（silent decay），因此需要研究智能体能否保持外部化知识的时效性。
AI.method: 提出Repo2Skill-Evo框架，将每次版本发布转换建模为技能维护任务：给定V1技能集和官方V1-to-V2补丁，智能体需更新过时技能内容同时保留仍然有效的指导。在57个真实仓库的105个版本转换上评估，采用修补基础的移除指标（patch-grounded removal metric），平衡过时内容召回率与过度编辑精确率。
AI.result: 所有评估的版本转换都会使部分V1技能集失效。六个前沿智能体仅达到29.9%-69.7% avg@3 macro F1。两类主要错误主导：对技能集中受影响文件覆盖不完整导致过时内容未被处理；过度广泛的编辑与更高召回率但更低精确率相关。
AI.conclusion: 仓库技能无声地过时失效，即使前沿智能体也无法可靠地维护它们。技能外部化会使知识衰退变得不可见，这一问题需要引起研究界关注。

title: Enrich-Retrieve-Rank: Scaling Capability Discovery Beyond In-Context Routing
summary: Agent ecosystems now include thousands of MATS components (Models, Agents, Tools, and Skills), yet their discovery still relies on in-context routing. These systems read a registry (names, hints, or descriptions, as context budget permits), pick a candidate, invoke it, and retry on failure. This pattern degrades with scale, and registries are growing fast. We recast capability discovery as search over a registry by defining an offline enrichment step that turns sparse metadata into searchable profiles, and an online retrieve-then-rank pipeline that returns a ranked shortlist without invoking any candidates online. We show that from N=10 to 7,278 capabilities, in-context routing's top-1 accuracy (Match@1) collapses (0.85 to 0.12), while retrieve-then-rank degrades more gently (0.81 to 0.39) because its reranker still ranks the right capability first 0.70-0.87 of the time once retrieval finds it. In the Nova Micro sweep, the crossover is around N=500. We compare against two in-context baselines. Full-Ctx puts the whole registry in the prompt and asks the LLM to pick. Search&Pick gives the LLM a search tool to narrow candidates before it picks. At full scale the pipeline leads Search&Pick by 6.5 percentage points (pp) on Match@1 at about half the cost. It reduces cost 70x versus Full-Ctx. We use a fixed configuration (same enrichment, retriever, and scorer weights) across agent, tool, and skill registries. The pipeline runs in production as the default capability-discovery layer of a large-scale multi-agent platform.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将智能体生态中的能力发现（MATS组件）从"上下文内路由"重构为"检索-重排"流水线：通过离线富化将稀疏元数据转化为可搜索档案，在线采用检索后重排返回候选短名单。实验表明从N=10到7,278个能力，上下文路由的Match@1从0.85暴跌至0.12，而检索-重排仅从0.81降至0.39。在N≈500处出现交叉点，全规模下比Search&Pick高6.5pp且成本减半，比Full-Ctx成本降低70倍，已作为大规模多智能体平台的默认能力发现层在生产环境运行。
AI.motivation: Agent生态系统包含数千个MATS组件，但现有发现机制依赖上下文内路由（把注册表作为上下文读取并选择候选），这种模式随规模增长严重退化。注册表快速增长，亟需可扩展的能力发现方法。
AI.method: 将能力发现重构为两阶段流水线：(1) 离线富化——将稀疏元数据转换为可搜索的丰富档案；(2) 在线检索-重排——先检索候选，再通过重排器返回排序短名单，全程不调用任何候选组件。使用固定配置（相同的富化、检索器和评分权重）跨Agent、工具和技能注册表通用。
AI.result: N从10增至7,278时，上下文路由Match@1从0.85暴跌至0.12，而检索-重排仅从0.81降至0.39（重排器在检索命中后仍以0.70-0.87概率将正确能力排第一）。交叉点在N≈500。全规模下比Search&Pick高6.5pp（Match@1）且成本约减半，比Full-Ctx成本降低70倍。
AI.conclusion: 检索-重排范式在能力发现上显著优于上下文内路由，尤其是在大规模注册表场景下，兼具更高准确率和更低成本，并已在生产环境中验证可行。

title: Machine learning and digital pragmatics: Which word category influences emoji use most?
summary: This study examines the performance of the state-of-the-art MARBERT model in identifying the lexical/pragmatic category associated with emoji use on X within a digital pragmatics approach (DPA). A net corpus of 15856 Colloquial Arabic (CA) posts containing emojis was collected from X using Python. The texts were tokenized and normalized into 4 lexical categories, namely noun_norm, verb_norm, adj_norm, and adverb_norm, and 2 pragmatic/structural categories, question_norm and exclamation_norm. MARBERT was finetuned and optimized to identify which category scores standard metrics more, hence associated with emoji use, while binary logistic regression was used to examine which category is statistically associated with emoji occurrence. Findings unveil that nouns dominate the corpus in normalized frequency (M = 0.675, SD = 0.161), followed by verbs (M = 0.083, SD = 0.100). However, verbs have the strongest influence of emoji use indicated by verb density (\b{eta} = 0.821, p = .001, 95% CI [0.332, 1.309]). The study concludes that in digital pragmatics of CA on X, emoji use association with lexical/pragmatic category can be explained by a hybrid approach of computational, statistical, and pragmatic methods, reflecting the interaction among machine learning, linguistic/lexical features, contextual representation, and pragmatic communication.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用MARBERT模型和二元逻辑回归，分析X平台上15856条阿拉伯语口语帖子中emoji使用与词汇/语用类别的关联。发现名词在语料库中频率最高（M=0.675），但动词密度对emoji使用的影响最强（β=0.821, p=.001），证明需要混合计算方法来理解数字语用学中的emoji使用。
AI.motivation: 探索数字语用学框架下，emoji使用与阿拉伯语口语中不同词汇/语用类别（名词、动词、形容词、副词、疑问句、感叹句）之间的关联，以更好地理解emoji在社交媒体中的交际功能。
AI.method: 从X平台收集15856条含emoji的阿拉伯语口语帖子，进行分词和归一化为4个词汇类别（noun_norm, verb_norm, adj_norm, adverb_norm）和2个语用/结构类别（question_norm, exclamation_norm）。微调MARBERT模型识别各类别指标，并采用二元逻辑回归检验哪些类别与emoji出现统计相关。
AI.result: 名词在语料库中归一化频率最高（M=0.675, SD=0.161），动词次之（M=0.083, SD=0.100）。但动词密度对emoji使用的影响最强（β=0.821, p=.001, 95% CI [0.332, 1.309]）。
AI.conclusion: 在X平台上阿拉伯语口语的数字语用学中，emoji使用与词汇/语用类别的关联可通过计算、统计和语用方法的混合途径来解释，反映了机器学习、语言/词汇特征、语境表征和语用交际之间的相互作用。

title: SpatialDiff: 3D-Aware Object Movement via Implicit Spatial Modeling
summary: Recent advances in image editing allow impressive manipulation of objects, existing methods still struggle to handle spatial movement in complex scenes, such as objects span different depth layers or are partially occluded. Most image editing methods focus solely on prior information from 2D datasets, emphasizing planar features while lacking support for spatial structures. Even approaches that incorporate explicit positional information fail to capture true 3D spatial relationships, thus limiting accurate object movement in complex scenes. In this paper, we present SpatialDiff, a method that effectively captures 3D spatial structures, enabling precise and consistent object movements in complex scenes. Our core innovations are twofold: (1) Implicit 3D Spatial Modeling, which introduces 3D prior knowledge and enables the model to internally build a comprehensive understanding of the three-dimensional spatial structure; and (2) Global Spatial Supervision, which constrains the latent spatial features to enable the model to perceive changes in object spatial positions caused by editing operations. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly improves the accuracy and fidelity of spatial movement in complex scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出SpatialDiff方法，通过隐式3D空间建模和全局空间监督，实现复杂场景中精确且一致的对象空间移动编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑方法在处理复杂场景（如对象跨越不同深度层或部分遮挡）中的空间移动时表现不佳，主要因为多数方法仅依赖2D数据集先验信息，缺乏对真实3D空间关系的理解，即使引入显式位置信息也无法准确捕捉3D空间结构。
AI.method: 两大核心创新：(1) 隐式3D空间建模——引入3D先验知识，使模型内部构建对三维空间结构的全面理解；(2) 全局空间监督——约束潜在空间特征，使模型能够感知编辑操作引起的对象空间位置变化。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SpatialDiff方法在复杂场景中的空间移动准确性和保真度方面显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SpatialDiff通过结合3D空间先验与全局空间约束，有效解决了复杂场景中对象空间移动的难题，为图像编辑领域提供了更精准的3D感知方案。

title: How Architecture and Training Affect TPC Representations Across Experiments
summary:
Deep-learning efforts have increasingly shifted toward foundation model approaches. In experimental physics, this allows models and learned representations to be reused beyond the experiments in which they were developed. This work evaluates the reusability of representations across experiments and detector systems using probes on frozen encoders. These probes reveal task-relevant structure before downstream adaptation, complementing fine-tuning. Together with random-weight controls, they distinguish contributions from architecture and encoder training that downstream performance alone cannot resolve.
  Time projection chamber (TPC) data provide a useful testbed because events from TPC systems can be represented as variable-length sparse tensors, while detector geometries, event topologies, and scientific tasks can differ substantially. We investigate whether fixed-dimensional TPC event representations can be reused across classification tasks, experiments, and detector systems. Sparse ResNet and PointNet-style encoders produce 512-dimensional embeddings for four datasets from the GADGET II TPC and AT-TPC. Randomly initialized encoders isolate the contribution from architecture before supervised training. We then train each encoder on a classification task, freeze its parameters, and train a linear or nonlinear probe for each downstream task. We find that this architecture-induced structure remains useful across experiments and detector systems. The randomly initialized PointNet-style representation is highly informative on several tasks. The two architectures organize their embedding spaces differently, but neither exhibits a large, systematic loss of utility cross-detector. These results show that architecture is a major source of task-relevant structure in TPC embeddings and should be treated explicitly when assessing representation learning and developing reusable detector models.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了端到端基础模型方法在实验物理领域的表征可复用性。通过使用冻结编码器上的探针（probes）方法，研究了TPC（时间投影室）数据的嵌入表征能否跨分类任务、实验和探测器系统复用。研究发现，架构本身（即使随机初始化）就能产生具有任务相关结构的有用表征，且这种结构跨探测器依然有效。
AI.motivation: 基础模型方法在实验物理中越来越重要，允许模型和学到的表征在开发它们的实验之外被复用。但跨实验和探测器系统的表征可复用性问题尚未被系统评估，特别是需要区分架构贡献与编码器训练贡献。
AI.method: 使用四种数据集（来自GADGET II TPC和AT-TPC），采用稀疏ResNet和PointNet风格编码器生成512维嵌入。通过三种对照实验：随机初始化编码器（隔离架构贡献）、在分类任务上训练后冻结编码器、对每个下游任务训练线性或非线性探针。同时与随机权重对照相结合。
AI.result: 架构诱导的结构在跨实验和探测器系统中保持有用。随机初始化的PointNet风格表征在多个任务上信息量很高。两种架构以不同方式组织嵌入空间，但都没有表现出跨探测器的系统性大损失。
AI.conclusion: 架构是TPC嵌入中任务相关结构的主要来源，在评估表征学习和开发可复用探测器模型时应被显式考虑。

title: Physics-Knowledge-Guided Hybrid Neural Learning for Arctic Sea Ice Concentration Evolution and Short-Range Prediction
summary: Accurate modeling of sea ice concentration (SIC) evolution is essential for polar climate assessment and short?range sea ice prediction. Numerical and data-driven approaches constitute major foundations for SIC modeling, but the former often require complex parameterizations and substantial compu?tation, whereas the latter rarely encode physical dependencies explicitly. This study presents the Physics-Informed Hybrid Ice Model (PIHIM), a differentiable data-driven hybrid ice model for daily SIC evolution that organizes its network structure according to the physical dependencies encoded in the sea ice continuity equation and explicitly accounts for dynamical transport, ther?modynamically driven areal growth and loss, and unresolved local processes. PIHIM preserves the representation capacity of deep learning while providing a process-decomposed formulation of ice displacement, freeze-melt areal change, and local error closure. Two evaluation settings are adopted: reanalysis-forced simulation examines SIC evolution stability under reanalysis forcing, and forecast-forced prediction assesses short-range performance un?der forecast-forced conditions, with reanalysis and observational SIC serving as verification references. Results indicate enhanced ice-edge preservation and error-growth control in reanalysis?forced simulation, while PIHIM retains measurable short-range prediction skill under forecast-forced conditions. Our code will be made publicly available after the paper is accepted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PHIHIM（物理信息混合冰模型），一种可微分的混合数据驱动模型，通过将网络结构组织为遵循海冰连续性方程中的物理依赖关系，显式编码动力输运、热力学驱动的面积增长与损失，以及未解析的局地过程，用于每日海冰浓度（SIC）演化的建模。
AI.motivation: 数值方法需要复杂参数化和大量计算，而纯数据驱动方法很少显式编码物理依赖关系。准确建模SIC演化对极地气候评估和短期海冰预测至关重要，现有方法在物理一致性与表示能力之间存在权衡。
AI.method: PHIHIM将网络结构按照海冰连续性方程中的物理依赖关系组织，提供一个过程分解的公式化表达，涵盖冰位移、冻融面积变化和局地误差闭合。在保持深度学习表示能力的同时，实现了物理约束的显式编码。采用两种评估设置：再分析强迫模拟和预报强迫预测。
AI.result: 在再分析强迫模拟中，PHIHIM增强了冰边缘保持和误差增长控制；在预报强迫条件下，PHIHIM保持了可测量的短期预测技能。
AI.conclusion: PHIHIM成功将物理知识融入数据驱动框架，在SIC建模中兼顾了物理可解释性和深度学习能力，为极地海冰建模提供了一种新的混合建模思路。代码将在论文接收后公开。

title: Disagree to Explore, Agree to Commit: Routing-Guided Test-Time Scaling for Software Agents
summary: Software-engineering agents solve repository-level tasks through long, stochastic tool-use trajectories, and repeated attempts often find fixes missed by one run. Test-time scaling is difficult because patches lack canonical answer forms, while sibling actions from a shared prefix are correlated. We study whether native MoE router traces can guide steering and selection without an external judge or selection-time test execution. Our analysis shows that routing provides a robust behavioral role signal; token-granular readouts and decision-matched comparison sets turn it into effective control. We therefore introduce Risa (Routing-Informed Steering and Arbitration): within trajectories, routing encourages diverse exploration and controlled convergence during patch commitment; across separately sampled trajectories, agreement at informative patch positions selects a final candidate. We evaluate on SWE-bench Verified using open-weight sparse MoE agents across scales and reasoning-effort settings. Risa's routing arbitration raises the macro-average resolved rate from 44.9% under uniform sampling to 48.2% on the gpt-oss family, matching text consensus without answer-string matching, and it transfers to Qwen3.6, where it improves on uniform choice and matches text consensus on the full 500-task benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Risa（路由信息引导的调度与仲裁）方法，利用稀疏MoE模型中的路由器轨迹来引导和选择软件工程代理生成的补丁，无需外部评判器或测试执行即可实现测试时扩展。
AI.motivation: 软件工程代理通过长而随机的工具使用轨迹解决仓库级任务，多次尝试往往能发现单次运行遗漏的修复。但测试时扩展面临挑战：补丁缺乏规范的答案形式，且共享前缀的兄弟动作具有相关性，导致难以有效地进行引导和选择。
AI.method: Risa利用MoE路由器轨迹作为行为角色信号：在轨迹内部，路由信息鼓励多样化的探索并在补丁提交阶段控制收敛；在跨轨迹之间，利用信息丰富补丁位置的路由一致性来选择最终候选。采用token粒度的路由读取和决策匹配的比较集设计。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified基准上，使用gpt-oss系列开源稀疏MoE代理，Risa的路由仲裁将宏平均解决率从均匀采样的44.9%提升到48.2%，匹配了文本共识而无需答案字符串匹配；在Qwen3.6上也能超越均匀选择并匹配文本共识，在完整500任务基准上有效。
AI.conclusion: MoE路由器轨迹提供了一种无需外部评判器或测试执行的补丁引导与选择机制，证明了原生路由器信号可以作为测试时扩展的有效控制手段，并具有跨不同MoE模型家族的泛化能力。

title: The Compaction Cliff in Long-Running AI Agent Memory
summary: A safety rule and an episodic log compete for the same tokens in an AI agent's context. When the budget overflows, both are summarized at the same rate; only the rule needs exact wording to remain enforceable. On 20 production agent configurations, Claude Code's /compact prompt on Sonnet 4.6 preserves 53\% of safety rules after one compaction round and 10\% after five. We name this the Compaction Cliff. We address it with Knowledge Triage, a framework that classifies each line of an agent's knowledge base by type and routes each type through its own retention policy. Three deterministic operators implement this triage across the three context-management operations: TypeCompact rewrites items in place under per-type fidelity, TypeDecompose partitions a topic too large to compact safely, replicating in-scope safety rules across partitions, and TypeRetrieve fetches items from external storage with in-scope rules pinned ahead of relevance. On five public corpora, TypeCompact preserves 2--4$\times$ more safety rules than the strongest single-shot LLM compactor at every ratio, with 96\% recall over five rounds. TypeDecompose reaches 0\% locality violations against 93\% under uniform partitioning. TypeRetrieve reaches 100\% recall@50 against 73\% for the best single-shot LLM retriever. On three downstream behavioral benchmarks, we outperform the production Sonnet compactor on medical compliance (paired McNemar $p < 10^{-8}$ on preservation, $N = 200$), the full-policy and hierarchical baselines on retail task pass rate ($p < 0.01$, $N = 115$), and the hierarchical compaction on the airline domain ($p = 0.024$). We release AgentArtifactCorpus (396{,}934 agent configurations from 54{,}628 public GitHub repositories), the classifier, and the reference implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文发现AI智能体上下文中安全规则与日志竞争token，导致压缩后规则保真度急剧下降（"Compaction Cliff"）。提出Knowledge Triage框架，通过三种确定性算子按类型分类管理知识库，显著提升安全规则保持率和下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 在AI智能体的上下文管理中，安全规则（safety rules）和事件日志（episodic logs）共用同一token预算。当预算溢出时，两者以相同方式被压缩，但安全规则需要精确措辞才能保持可执行性。实验表明Claude Code的/compact提示在Sonnet 4.6上经过一轮压缩仅保留53%的安全规则，五轮后仅剩10%。这种"Compaction Cliff"现象暴露了现有统一压缩策略的根本缺陷。
AI.method: 提出Knowledge Triage框架，对知识库逐行分类，每种类型采用独立保留策略，通过三个确定性算子实现：TypeCompact（按类型保真度原地重写）、TypeDecompose（将过大主题分解并跨分区复制安全规则）、TypeRetrieve（从外部存储获取并优先固定作用域内规则）。
AI.result: 在五个公开语料上，TypeCompact在所有压缩比率下比最强单次LLM压缩器多保留2-4倍安全规则，五轮召回率达96%；TypeDecompose达到0%局部性违规（对比均匀划分的93%）；TypeRetrieve在recall@50上达100%（对比最佳单次LLM检索器的73%）。在三个下游行为基准中，医疗合规（McNemar p<10^-8）、零售任务通过率（p<0.01）、航空领域（p=0.024）均显著优于基线。同时发布了包含396,934个智能体配置的AgentArtifactCorpus数据集。
AI.conclusion: Knowledge Triage证明了按类型差异化处理上下文压缩可有效避免安全规则衰退，为AI智能体的长期上下文管理提供了可部署的实践方案，并开源了基准数据集、分类器和参考实现以促进后续研究。

title: Align, Unify, Suppress, Route: A Coherentist View of Transformer Computation
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has identified transformer circuits, but lacks a shared vocabulary for describing how their functions compose across tasks and architectures. We introduce Coherentist Probabilistic Compositionalism (CPC), an interpretive framework that grounds transformer computation in coherentist theories of interpretation and describes it through four operator roles. Alignment identifies candidate relations, unification integrates supporting information, suppression reduces incompatible alternatives, and routing carries selected information to the output. Across 15 models from five architecture families, the suppression, unification, and routing weight-space signatures correlate with held-out activation-level role measures above random baselines. Suppression is more stable across tasks than unification. Ablating alignment heads reduces downstream suppressive activity beyond a random-head control in 10 models, but similar effects on no-conflict prompts indicate a general upstream dependency, not contradiction-specific coupling. Explicit contradictions significantly shift a layerwise coherence proxy in 14 models; after removing shared residual covariance, the gap has the predicted direction in every model. Base and instruction-tuned variants preserve induction-head score structure ($r{\geq}0.98$) without a consistent shift of operator signatures towards later layers. These results support CPC as a shared vocabulary for comparing transformer mechanisms while showing that their depth and geometric expression remain architecture-specific.

AI.tldr: 本文提出相干主义概率组合论（CPC），一种用于描述Transformer电路功能组合的共享解释框架，通过四个算子角色（对齐、统一、抑制、路由）在15个模型、五个架构家族上进行验证，证明其作为比较Transformer机制的共享词汇的有效性。
AI.motivation: 机械可解释性已识别出Transformer电路，但缺乏共享词汇来描述其功能如何在任务和架构间进行组合，导致不同研究之间难以进行比较和累积。
AI.method: 提出CPC框架，将Transformer计算基于相干主义解释理论，通过四个算子角色描述：对齐（识别候选关系）、统一（整合支持性信息）、抑制（减少不兼容替代方案）、路由（将选定信息传至输出）。在15个模型、五个架构家族中验证四个算子的权重空间签名与激活水平角色测量的相关性，并进行各类消融和统计分析。
AI.result: 抑制、统一、路由的权重空间签名与激活水平角色测量在随机基线以上相关；抑制比统一跨任务更稳定；消融对齐头在10个模型中降低下游抑制活动；显式矛盾在14个模型中显著改变层间相干性代理；去除共享残差协方差后，所有模型的差距方向符合预测；基座与指令微调变体的归纳头分数结构高度保留（r≥0.98）。
AI.conclusion: CPC可作为比较Transformer机制的共享词汇，但算子签名的深度和几何表达仍具有架构特异性，说明该框架在提供统一描述语言的同时需要保留对架构差异的敏感性。

title: DefaultShift: Auditing Semantic Default Shift in Accelerated Text-to-Image Models
summary: Few-step text-to-image models increasingly replace slower generators, yet acceleration can silently change distributions over unspecified attributes even when individual outputs remain plausible and aligned. We call these distributions semantic defaults and their change under replacement semantic default shift. Existing quality, preference, and diversity evaluations do not test whether a replacement preserves its reference model's semantic defaults. We introduce DefaultShift, a paired audit that labels repeated samples with closed semantic vocabularies, measures probability-mass movement, and separates interpretable ranking from confirmatory cross-fit inference. Across 14 reference and replacement pairs, adjusted color discrepancies range from 0.054 to 0.303 with recipe-specific directions. A 1,000-image human audit reproduces the ordering. We further introduce DefaultShift-Select, an offline calibration method that reduces human-measured shift by 10.3 percent to 35.1 percent across Turbo, DMD2, and FLUX without material quality loss. Under balanced evaluation, selected data recover 4.3 accuracy points and 7.5 worst-group points over uncalibrated replacement data. DefaultShift makes semantic preservation under acceleration measurable and actionable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DefaultShift框架，用于衡量和校准快速文本生成图像模型（如Turbo、DMD2、FLUX）在加速替代过程中产生的"语义默认值"偏移问题，通过配对审计和离线校准方法（DefaultShift-Select）在保持质量的同时显著降低分布偏移。
AI.motivation: 快速文本到图像模型日益取代较慢的生成器，但加速过程可能静默改变未指定属性的分布，即使单个输出仍然合理且对齐。现有质量、偏好和多样性评估无法测试替代模型是否保留参考模型的语义默认值，缺乏对这种分布偏移的度量与纠正手段。
AI.method: 1) 提出DefaultShift，一种配对审计方法：对重复样本进行封闭语义词汇表标注，测量概率质量移动，分离可解释排序与验证性交叉拟合推断。2) 提出DefaultShift-Select，一种离线校准方法，通过数据选择降低人工测量的偏移。
AI.result: 在14对参考和替代模型上，调整后的颜色差异范围为0.054至0.303，且方向与具体生成配方相关；1000张图像的人工审计复现了排序。DefaultShift-Select在Turbo、DMD2和FLUX上使人工测量的偏移降低10.3%至35.1%，且无显著质量损失。均衡评估下，选择的数据相比未校准替代数据恢复4.3个准确率点和7.5个最差组点。
AI.conclusion: DefaultShift使加速条件下的语义保留变得可测量且可操作，为快速生成模型的部署提供了新的评估维度和校准工具。

title: A Fixed-Radius Distance-Band Benchmark for Dimensionality-Reduction Fidelity
comment: 20 pages, 13 figures. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21380823
summary: Dimensionality-reduction (DR) methods are routinely judged by how well each point's k nearest neighbors survive the 2-D embedding (recall@k, trustworthiness, continuity). We argue this family is a biased measure of distance fidelity: its per-point variable radius and hard inclusion threshold favor neighbor-graph methods (t-SNE, UMAP) and penalize methods that preserve absolute distances. We instead score DR fidelity with a fixed-radius distance-band Shepard rho: the Spearman correlation between high-D and 2-D pairwise distances, restricted to cumulative distance bands so that near and global structure are reported separately, with every point judged on the same absolute radius. On synthetic datasets with known ground-truth geometry (non-uniform density, dense clusters, a closed-loop transition, off-subspace outliers, imbalanced two-population data) at realistic noise (SNR=1, D=768, N=1000), we benchmark eight methods -- PCA, Isomap, t-SNE, UMAP, PyMDE, PCC, DREAMS, and the closed-source toorPIA -- and show that (i) high global Shepard rho can coexist with a ~93x collapse of within-cluster scale, invisible to rank-based scores but obvious in a value-based over-compression metric; (ii) recall@k and the fixed-radius band disagree systematically, in the direction the bias predicts; (iii) a membership-restricted Shepard rho resolves single-point and minority-population questions that many-pair statistics cannot -- questions on which even DREAMS, a recent local-plus-global hybrid, fails silently. A supplementary out-of-sample (addplot) test asks whether a never-seen anomaly lands outside the normal region and whether its direction identifies its source. All metrics are computed exactly on all pairwise distances, independently of any method's internals, and every number is reproducible offline: the closed-source method's output coordinates (not its algorithm) are committed to the artifact.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了以recall@k、trustworthiness、continuity为代表的降维评估指标，认为这类基于k近邻的排名方法存在偏见（逐点可变半径+硬阈值），偏向邻域图方法（t-SNE、UMAP）而惩罚保留绝对距离的方法。作者提出用固定半径的距离带Shepard rho（斯皮尔曼相关）来评估降维保真度，在合成数据集上对八种方法进行基准测试，证明新指标能揭示排名指标无法发现的问题，如全局保真与簇内尺度93倍坍塌共存。
AI.motivation: 现有的降维评估指标（recall@k等）存在系统性偏差：其逐点可变半径和硬性包含阈值结构性地偏向t-SNE、UMAP等邻域图方法，而惩罚PCA、Isomap等保留绝对距离的方法。需要一种无偏、固定半径的保真度评估方式。
AI.method: 提出固定半径距离带Shepard rho指标：在高维与2D成对距离之间计算Spearman相关，并按累积距离带分解，使近程与全局结构分别报告，每个点用相同的绝对半径评判。同时提出成员限定的Shepard rho用于单点和少数群体问题，以及补充的out-of-sample测试。所有指标在全部成对距离上精确计算，独立于方法内部实现。
AI.result: 在合成数据集（非均匀密度、密集簇、闭环过渡、子空间外离群点、不平衡双群体）上（SNR=1, D=768, N=1000）基准测试八种方法（PCA、Isomap、t-SNE、UMAP、PyMDE、PCC、DREAMS、toorPIA），发现：(i)全局Shepard rho高可伴随簇内尺度约93倍坍塌（排名指标不可见，但基于值的过度压缩指标明显）；(ii)recall@k与固定半径带系统性不一致，方向与预测的偏差一致；(iii)成员限定Shepard rho解决了多对统计量无法处理的单点与少数群体问题，连DREAMS此类局部-全局混合方法也会静默失败。
AI.conclusion: 基于k近邻的排名型降维评估指标存在固有偏见，应使用固定半径的距离带Shepard rho作为补充或替代评估维度，以更全面地衡量降维保真度。本文所有指标均可在离线精确复现，闭源方法输出坐标也提交为工件以保证可复现性。

title: Concepts for Securing Agentic AI Coding and the Terok Environment
comment: to be published in the proceedings of the AGENSYS workshop (Workshop on Knowledge Discovery, Maintenance and Distributed Intelligence in Multi-Agent Systems) at ECML PKDD 2026 conference in Sept. 2026
summary:
Agentic AI is a fascinating new tool for software development. It is a huge step forward compared to "conventional" AI assisted coding, which in turn was a considerable breakthrough earlier. AI support through LLMs is a young and very fast-moving field. The "conventional" (non-agentic) flavor became useful and productive in early 2025 (around 18 months ago) and the agentic flavor followed in fall 2025 (approximately 9 months ago). Besides all its benefits and potential, it also carries some fundamental risks for IT security. And the agentic approach added very severe risks while making others much more dangerous.
  With all the motivation to explore this fascinating new tool we should not ignore the risks but actively address them. We present (I) an assessment of the IT security risks, (II) a concept for mitigating them without breaking its benefits, and (III) an overview about an implementation of our concept. In this very dynamic field this is likely not the final and once-and-for-all answer to the identified issues but still a substantial step forward in responsible usage of Agentic AI for software development. It should also be a contribution to the community to allow early and eager evaluation of the potential of agentic AI for software development without actually suffering from its implied IT security risks.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了Agentic AI在软件开发中带来的IT安全风险，提出了一套缓解方案并给出了实现概述，旨在让社区能够安全地利用Agentic AI的优势而不受其安全风险的困扰。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI是软件开发领域的新兴工具，比传统AI辅助编程更强大，但也引入了更严重和多样化的IT安全风险。作者认为在探索这一工具潜力的同时，必须主动应对其安全风险，而不是忽视它们。
AI.method: 论文包含三个部分：(I) 对Agentic AI在软件开发中的IT安全风险进行全面评估；(II) 提出一个在不损害其收益的前提下缓解这些风险的概念方案；(III) 概述该概念方案的一个具体实现。
AI.result: 作者提供了一个实质性的安全缓解方案，使开发者能够在不对IT安全造成严重影响的前提下，早期评估和利用Agentic AI在软件开发中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 这是对Agentic AI安全风险管理的一个重大步骤，但鉴于该领域发展迅速，这并非最终的一劳永逸的解决方案，而是一个面向社区的阶段性贡献，鼓励早期和积极的评估。

title: Better Retrieval, Worse Robustness:How Multi-hop RAG Amplifies Upstream ASR Errors
summary: Speech-based applications pass spoken queries through automatic speech recognition (ASR) before any retrieval module, so ASR errors enter the pipeline as a fixed upstream constraint. We empirically test whether two extensions to standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), entity-graph linking and iterative reformulation, absorb or amplify these errors. Using four English accents synthesized through neural TTS, we evaluate four RAG configurations on three multi-hop QA benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA and MuSiQue) against a clean-text oracle. Although the structurally richer configurations generally retain higher absolute F1 under ASR input, both extensions amplify the error: the F1 gap from clean text to the highest-WER accent is 36-67% larger under their combination than under naive dense retrieval, on all three benchmarks. The dominant failure mode is corruption of one or more query entities, accounting for 87-96% of degradation cases on 2WikiMultiHopQA across all four methods. Two lightweight surface-form mitigations leave most of the gap intact, indicating that downstream retrieval structure amplifies remaining entity errors. We release code and data at https://github.com/ZhenghuaBao/spoken-multihop-rag .

AI.tldr: 本研究通过四种英语口音的神经TTS合成语音，在三个多跳问答基准（HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue）上系统评估了RAG的两种扩展——实体图谱链接和迭代重构——对ASR错误的吸收或放大效应。结果表明，虽然结构更丰富的配置在ASR输入下保持更高的绝对F1，但两种扩展都会放大ASR误差：在三种基准上，从干净文本到最高WER口音的F1差距比朴素稠密检索大36-67%。主要失败模式是查询中一个或多个实体的损坏，在2WikiMultiHopQA上占退化案例的87-96%。两种轻量级表面对策无法弥补大部分差距，表明下游检索结构放大了残留的实体错误。
AI.motivation: 基于语音的应用在检索模块之前必须通过ASR处理口语查询，因此ASR错误作为固定的上游约束进入流水线。现有RAG扩展（实体图谱链接和迭代重构）在文本输入下表现良好，但它们在ASR噪声下的表现尚未得到系统评估，作者希望弄清这些结构增强方法是否会吸收还是放大ASR引入的错误。
AI.method: 使用四种英语口音通过神经TTS合成语音，在三个多跳QA基准上评估四种RAG配置（朴素稠密检索及其实体图谱链接、迭代重构及两者组合），以干净文本oracle为参照基准，对比各配置在ASR输入下的F1性能差距。
AI.result: 结构更丰富的RAG配置在ASR输入下保持更高的绝对F1，但实体图谱链接和迭代重构都系统性放大ASR错误：组合配置下F1差距比朴素检索大36-67%。主要失败模式是查询实体损坏（占退化案例87-96%），且两种轻量表面对策无法弥补大多数性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 语音场景下，尽管RAG的结构扩展提升了整体性能，但它们会放大上游ASR错误，尤其是实体级错误。这提示语音RAG系统需将ASR鲁棒性作为第一公民考量，单纯依赖下游检索结构增强不足以缓解语音输入噪声问题。

title: Real-TurnTurk: A Multimodal Turkish Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction
comment: Accepted to INTCEC 2026. This is the author's pre-print version. The final authenticated version will be available through the conference proceedings
summary: Turn-taking is a basic organizational feature of human conversation and remains difficult to model in natural, synchronous dialog systems. While existing research has explored multimodal approaches and large language models for turn-ending prediction, there is a lack of naturalistic conversational corpora specifically addressing turn-taking dynamics in Turkish. This study introduces a multimodal Turkish conversational dataset of unscripted dyadic interactions, comprising synchronized front-facing video, per-speaker audio channels that allow overlapping speech to be attributed to individual speakers, and time-aligned transcriptions. Turn-taking prediction is formulated as a binary classification problem, and a Genetic Algorithm (GA) is employed to optimize interpretable decision rules derived from visual, acoustic, and linguistic features. A hybrid AND-OR rule representation is adopted in the proposed framework to represent the alternative cue combinations that precede a turn transition.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个土耳其语多模态对话数据集，包含同步正面视频、分说话人音频通道和时间对齐的转录文本，用于研究自然对话中的话轮转换预测。该研究将话轮转换预测建模为二分类问题，并采用遗传算法优化由视觉、声学和语言特征导出的可解释决策规则，使用混合AND-OR规则表示来捕捉话轮转换前的交替线索组合。
AI.motivation: 话轮转换是人类对话的基本组织特征，但在自然同步对话系统中仍难以建模。现有研究虽探索了多模态方法和大型语言模型进行话轮结束预测，但缺乏针对土耳其语话轮转换动态的自然对话语料库。本研究旨在填补这一语言资源空白。
AI.method: 研究构建了一个无脚本双人互动的土耳其语多模态对话数据集，包含同步正面视频、可归属重叠语音的分说话人音频通道及时间对齐转录。话轮转换预测被形式化为二分类问题，采用遗传算法优化从视觉、声学和语言特征中提取的可解释决策规则，框架采用混合AND-OR规则表示来表征话轮转换前的多种线索组合。
AI.result: 论文摘要中未明确报告具体的定量实验结果或性能指标，主要贡献集中在新数据集的构建和基于遗传算法的可解释话轮转换预测框架的设计上。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为土耳其语话轮转换研究提供了首个自然对话多模态数据集，并通过遗传算法优化的可解释规则框架为同步对话系统中的话轮转换建模提供了新的方法路径。混合AND-OR规则表示允许灵活捕捉多种线索组合，增强模型的可解释性。

title: HP-UniIF: Hierarchical Prompt Learning for Unified Image Fusion
summary: General image fusion seeks to integrate complementary information from multiple source images, yet real-world applications often require a single system to support heterogeneous fusion, degradation restoration, and task-oriented perception simultaneously. Existing unified frameworks struggle with these orthogonal objectives, resulting in entangled representations and degraded performance across subtasks. We propose HP-UniIF, a unified vision framework that leverages diffusion priors to bridge heterogeneous fusion, visual restoration, and downstream perception. To address the limited adaptability of diffusion models to domain-, degradation-, and task-level objectives within one pipeline, HP-UniIF introduces a depth-wise hierarchical conditional modulation strategy that decouples these objectives across network stages. Task prompt modulation at bottleneck layers adapts the backbone to different fusion paradigms, the degradation prompt router at shallow layers injects degradation-aware constraints for local restoration, and the application prompt bank at decoding stages aligns generation with downstream tasks. This hierarchical design enables HP-UniIF to produce visually faithful results while preserving task-relevant semantics. Extensive experiments across multiple fusion tasks, diverse degradations, and various downstream applications demonstrate the superior performance of HP-UniIF.

AI.tldr: HP-UniIF是一个基于扩散先验的统一视觉框架，通过深度分层条件调制策略（任务提示调制、退化提示路由、应用提示库），同时支持异构融合、退化恢复和任务导向感知，在多项任务中展现优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现实应用需要单一系统同时支持异构融合、退化恢复和任务导向感知，但现有统一框架难以处理这些正交目标，导致表示纠缠和子任务性能下降。
AI.method: 提出HP-UniIF框架，利用扩散先验桥接多种任务。核心是深度分层条件调制策略：瓶颈层使用任务提示调制适配不同融合范式，浅层使用退化提示路由注入退化感知约束，解码阶段使用应用提示库与下游任务对齐。
AI.result: 在多种融合任务、多样退化场景和各类下游应用中均表现出优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 分层条件调制能有效解耦域级、退化级和任务级目标，使统一框架在保持视觉逼真度的同时保留任务相关语义。

title: MSM-Mem: A Universal Medical Structured Multimodal Memory Framework for Medical AI Agents
summary: Clinical decision-making is inherently experience-driven: physicians progressively refine their reasoning by synthesizing patient history, multimodal observations, and prior diagnostic experiences across interactions. In contrast, current multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based medical AI agents largely operate as stateless inference systems, generating decisions independently for each interaction without retaining or internalizing experiential knowledge. This discrepancy limits their ability to progressively improve reasoning reliability through usage and adapt to longitudinal patient contexts in real-world clinical workflows. In this study, we propose Medical Structured Multimodal Memory (MSM-Mem), an agentic memory framework that enables medical AI agents to evolve through accumulated clinical experiences. MSM-Mem organizes heterogeneous clinical experiences into semantic, episodic, and visual memory and incrementally updates them during inference, allowing the agent to retrieve prior experiences to inform current reasoning and progressively refine decision-making over time. Evaluations on MoE-LLaVA backbones demonstrate consistent performance improve- ments with further gains observed through continued usage. In general, MSM-Mem offers a viable pathway toward medical AI agents capable of evolving their reasoning competence in a manner analogous to the way clinicians learn from practice over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MSM-Mem（医学结构化多模态记忆框架），一种能让医疗AI代理像临床医生一样通过积累临床经验不断进化的代理记忆框架。它将异构临床经验组织成语义、情景和视觉记忆，并在推理过程中增量更新，使代理能够检索先前经验来指导当前推理，从而逐步优化决策能力。
AI.motivation: 当前的MLLM医疗AI代理本质上是无状态的推理系统，每次交互都独立生成决策，无法保留或内化经验知识，这与临床医生通过实践积累经验、逐步提升推理可靠性的方式存在根本性差异，限制了其在真实临床工作流中适应纵向患者场景的能力。
AI.method: 提出MSM-Mem框架，设计了三种类型的记忆——语义记忆、情景记忆和视觉记忆——用于组织异构临床经验；在推理过程中增量更新记忆，使代理能够检索先前的经验来指导当前的推理过程，实现随时间推移的渐进式决策优化。
AI.result: 在MoE-LLaVA骨干网络上的评估显示性能持续提升，且随着持续使用（积累更多经验）可获得进一步的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: MSM-Mem为医疗AI代理提供了一条可行的路径，使其能够以类似临床医生从实践中学习的方式进化推理能力，有望改善医疗AI在真实临床场景中的长期适应性和可靠性。

title: Hints, Critics, and Teachers: Prior Injection for Sparse-Reward RL in Vision-Language Math Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning for vision-language math reasoning starves under sparse reward: on a pool of 20,830 visual-math problems where Qwen2-VL-2B answers 3.6% of rollouts correctly, 85-97% of GRPO rollout groups are entirely wrong and contribute zero gradient. We train eleven methods under identical conditions in this regime, each injecting a different prior: text (reference-solution hints), distribution (on-policy distillation from a 7B teacher), and value (a value-pretrained critic with an MSE or HL-Gauss categorical loss). A prior helps exactly when it is delivered: the six arms whose prior effectively reaches the policy separate with no overlap from the remaining five -- the no-prior baseline and four arms whose prior is teacher-capped, gated away, or lost to a mis-parameterized critic -- both on the pooled in-domain metric and on cross-domain transfer (DynaMath). The central finding, however, concerns evaluation: one slice of the in-domain pool -- long used as this project's general-distribution check -- anti-correlates with genuine cross-domain transfer (Spearman rho = -0.74, n = 11 arms, permutation p = 0.011), while the hardest in-domain slice predicts it closely (rho = +0.89, p < 0.001). We attribute the inversion to a near-chance multiple-choice subset that rewards models for not having changed; read through it, the best cross-domain method looked mediocre and the worst looked like the champion. Among the methods, hint-guided exploration -- not UFT's auxiliary loss -- drives hint gains, and replacing the critic's MSE loss with HL-Gauss cross-entropy is worth +14.4 points in-domain. All accuracies are blind-judged, with paired exact tests.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉-语言数学推理中强化学习在稀疏奖励下的失效问题。在20,830道视觉数学题中，Qwen2-VL-2B仅3.6%的rollout正确，85-97%的GRPO分组全错且梯度为零。作者在相同条件下训练了11种注入不同先验的方法（文本提示、分布蒸馏、价值函数），发现先验只有实际传递到策略时才有效。核心发现是评估问题：一个长期用作通用分布检验的数据子集与真实跨域迁移呈反相关（Spearman rho=-0.74），而最难的域内子集则高度正相关（rho=+0.89）。反相关源于接近随机猜测的多选题子集，它奖励"未改变"的模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言数学推理中，强化学习面临极其稀疏的奖励信号——大多数rollout分组完全没有正确样本，导致梯度为零、训练"饿死"。作者旨在系统研究在这样极端的稀疏奖励机制下，注入不同先验（文本、分布、价值）是否能真正帮助策略学习，并揭示评估指标选择对方法比较结论的深远影响。
AI.method: 在相同实验条件下训练11种方法，各自注入不同先验：(1) 文本先验：参考解答提示（包括hint-guided exploration与UFT辅助损失两种变体）；(2) 分布先验：从7B教师模型进行on-policy蒸馏；(3) 价值先验：使用MSE或HL-Gauss分类损失预训练的价值critic。所有准确率采用盲审（blind-judged）和配对精确检验。
AI.result: 六个先验有效传递到策略的方法与其余五个方法（含无先验基线和先验被教师封顶、门控或critic参数化错误的四种）在域内指标和跨域迁移（DynaMath）上完全分离。关键发现：域内池中一个长期用作通用检验的子集与真实跨域迁移反相关（rho=-0.74），而最难的域内子集高度预测跨域迁移（rho=+0.89）。HL-Gauss损失相比MSE为critic带来+14.4点域内提升，hint收益主要来自hint-guided exploration而非UFT辅助损失。
AI.conclusion: 先验对稀疏奖励RL的帮助取决于其是否真正到达策略。更重要的是，评估基准的选择可能彻底颠倒方法排名——接近随机的多选题子集奖励"未改变"的模型，导致最优跨域方法看起来平庸、最差方法反被误认为冠军。研究者需警惕评估分布与真实目标的错配。

title: PatchWrite: One Line, Not One Section -- Compile-Gated, Validity-Preserving Editing for AI-Drafted Manuscripts
summary: Automated manuscript pipelines often regenerate an entire section to repair a local defect, allowing unrelated metrics and citations to change even when the resulting PDF still builds. PatchWrite instead constrains how candidate edits become committed manuscript states: it reuses bounded EDIT N M editing and rollback, but tightens compilation acceptance with fatal-log checks and adds evidence locks that require every cited key and experimental numeric token to be attested by a reference registry or experimental log. Candidates that fail either check are rejected and the previous HEAD is retained. On a 24-manuscript x 8-fault oracle stress test (768 jobs, evenly split between compile-breaking and content-only faults), whole-slot rewriting mutated an unrelated "12-layer" line in every case (0/192 preserved; numeric Jaccard 0.6667), whereas PatchWrite preserved it in 192/192 cases. Removing the compile gate reduced acceptance to 0, while removing the evidence gate allowed a hallucinated citation to pass. The same pattern held across all eight faults. To test the protocol with generation rather than oracle edits, we reran the 192 jobs with the writer model proposing the edits. The model's candidates were accepted in 75% of cases; nearly all rejections came from one reproducible failure mode in which the model attempted to delete a line using an empty replacement unsupported by the current grammar. Every accepted candidate passed both gates, and 93.75% fixed the injected fault; the remaining cases involved a technically valid but sentence-inappropriate citation and one markup-changing near-miss. In a blind evaluation of sixteen PDF pairs, both raters preferred PatchWrite for preserving lab-grounded facts (C1 Likert 5.0 vs. 2.0), while rating prose quality nearly identically. Logs from 193 in-product drafting tasks show the same classes of failures occurring in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PatchWrite，一种约束自动手稿编辑流水线的方法，通过bounded EDIT N M编辑、编译致命日志检查和证据锁（要求所有引文键和实验数字均被参考注册表或实验日志证实）来防止无关指标和引文在局部缺陷修复中被意外改变。实验表明其在24篇手稿×8种故障的压力测试中100%保留无关内容，而整段重写则全部破坏（0/192保留），并有效阻止幻觉引文通过。
AI.motivation: 自动手稿流水线在修复局部缺陷时常重新生成整个章节，导致无关的指标和引文被篡改，即使PDF仍能成功构建。这种"修复一个缺陷却引入更多问题"的行为需要被约束，但目前缺少一种既能精准局部修复又防止无关内容漂移的机制。
AI.method: PatchWrite包含三个核心组件：(1) 复用有界的EDIT N M编辑和回滚机制；(2) 用致命日志（fatal-log）检查收紧编译接受标准；(3) 增加证据锁（evidence locks），要求每个被引用键和实验数字记号必须有参考注册表或实验日志作为依据。任何未通过检查的候选编辑都会被拒绝并保留之前的HEAD。
AI.result: 在768个job（编译破坏与内容故障各半）的oracle压力测试中，整段重写在所有案例中变异了无关的"12-layer"行（0/192保留，数值Jaccard 0.6667），而PatchWrite在192/192案例中保留了它。移除编译门使接受率降为0，移除证据门则允许幻觉引文通过。与生成模型配合时，75%推理候选被接受，93.75%修复了注入故障，且所有接受候选均通过两道检查。盲评中两位评审者均偏好PatchWrite在保护实验事实方面的表现（Likert 5.0 vs 2.0），但散文质量评分几乎相同。
AI.conclusion: PatchWrite通过编译门和证据门的组合有效防止了自动编辑中对无关内容的意外篡改，同时保持较高的修复成功率。该方法在实际产品环境中也观察到同样的故障类别，表明此工作具有实际部署价值。

title: TSWAP: A Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Thai Wellness Advisor
comment: 8 pages, 2 tables. Data and evaluation logs: https://huggingface.co/datasets/iapp/tswap-wellness-benchmark
summary: We present TSWAP, a deployed eight-language conversational wellness advisor grounded, via retrieval-augmented generation, in a verified knowledge base of Thai traditional medicine and certified wellness providers. An unmodified open-weight LLM (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on vLLM) is grounded on a ~30.6K-chunk Thai index by a hybrid dense-sparse retriever with cross-encoder reranking; a first-turn query classifier forces tool-based retrieval for entity lookups; a rule-based safety layer enforces medical scope and Thai emergency routing; and all eight languages are served zero-shot with translate-then-retrieve. We release the first Thai traditional-medicine/wellness retrieval benchmark (50 questions with gold document IDs; Recall@5 = 0.88), production QA logs (91.1% test-retest pass over 259 cases), and a 71-question frontier no-retrieval probe showing what each grounding pillar contributes: without the safety prompt the backend model family produced a full drug-dosing schedule and complied with out-of-scope requests, and without the knowledge base it produced zero verifiable provider recommendations. We further report two transferable deployment findings: English-calibrated 4-bit AWQ quantization corrupts Thai tone marks, and forced-retrieval routing is necessary for reliable grounding.

AI.tldr: TSWAP是一个部署在八个语言环境中的对话式健康顾问系统，基于检索增强生成（RAG）技术，以泰国传统医学和认证健康服务提供商的验证知识库为基础。系统采用未修改的开权重LLM（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on vLLM），结合混合密集-稀疏检索器和交叉编码器重排序，并通过规则安全层确保医疗范围合规和泰国紧急路径。系统发布了首个泰国传统医学/健康检索基准（50题，Recall@5=0.88）和测试-重测通过率达91.1%的生产QA日志。
AI.motivation: 动机在于构建一个可靠的多语言健康顾问系统，特别是在医疗保健领域需要确保内容的安全性和准确性。研究者希望验证在医疗场景中，检索增强生成（RAG）、安全提示和强制检索路由等接地（grounding）支柱各自的作用，并验证现成的开源LLM能否在部署环境中可靠地提供医疗建议。
AI.method: 方法包括：1) 使用未修改的开权重LLM（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）部署在vLLM上；2) 基于约3.06万块的泰语索引，采用混合密集-稀疏检索器和交叉编码器重排序；3) 首轮查询分类器强制工具检索以进行实体查找；4) 基于规则的安全层执行医疗范围和泰语紧急事件路由；5) 所有八种语言通过"先翻译后检索"（translate-then-retrieve）提供零样本服务。
AI.result: 结果包括：1) 发布了首个泰国传统医学/健康检索基准（50个问题，Recall@5=0.88）；2) 生产QA日志显示259例中测试-重测通过率达91.1%；3) 71个问题的无检索探针实验表明：没有安全提示时后端模型生成了完整的药物给药方案并遵从了超出范围的要求，没有知识库时产生了零个可验证的服务提供商推荐；4) 发现两个可迁移的部署问题：英文校准的4-bit AWQ量化会损坏泰语声调标记，强制检索路由对接地（grounding）至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：系统展示了部署现成开源LLM构建多语言医疗顾问的可行性；接地支柱（安全提示、知识库、强制检索）对医疗场景的安全性至关重要，缺一不可；同时揭示了量化对低资源语言（如泰语）的潜在风险以及强制检索路由的必要性，这些发现对其他多语言医疗AI部署具有可迁移的参考价值。

title: Spine-Branch Coordination for Multi-agent Computer Use
summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems that decompose a task into multiple subtasks executed across parallel virtual machines (VMs). However, a critical physical bottleneck is that the state of two VMs cannot be merged. Previous systems handle this ad-hoc rather than treating it as a first-class concern. We propose Spine-Branch Coordination for multi-agent computer use, a framework that decomposes a task into a "spine-branch" graph, where the spine carries the main task flow with continuous VM state and branch tasks execute in parallel to collect information the spine needs to complete the task. Branch VMs are discarded once their tasks finish, so no VM merging ever occurs. Experiments show that on 200 long-horizon tasks from Odysseys and across three CUA backbones, Spine-Branch improves success rate over the baseline system by 6.0% to 16.5%, while reducing per-task cost by 34% to 70%, indicating that explicitly modeling VM-state merging constraint enables multi-agent computer use to scale efficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spine-Branch Coordination框架，用于多智能体计算机使用系统。该框架将任务分解为"主干-分支"图结构，主干承载主任务流并保持连续VM状态，分支任务并行执行以收集信息，完成后即丢弃分支VM，从而避免VM状态合并这一物理瓶颈。实验表明在200个长时程任务上成功率提升6.0%-16.5%，成本降低34%-70%。
AI.motivation: 多智能体计算机使用代理（CUA）将任务分解为在并行虚拟机上执行的子任务，但两个VM的状态无法合并是关键的物理瓶颈。以往系统对此采用临时性（ad-hoc）处理方式，未将其作为首要问题对待，限制了多智能体CUA系统的可扩展性和效率。
AI.method: 提出Spine-Branch Coordination框架：将任务分解为"spine-branch"图。主干（spine）承载主要任务流程并保持连续的VM状态；分支（branch）任务并行执行以收集主干完成任务所需的信息。分支VM在任务完成后即被丢弃，因此系统从不发生VM合并操作，从根本上规避了VM状态无法合并的限制。
AI.result: 在来自Odyssees的200个长时程任务上，使用三种CUA骨干网络进行测试：相比基线系统，成功率提升6.0%至16.5%，每个任务成本降低34%至70%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模VM状态合并约束能够使多智能体计算机使用系统高效扩展，证明了将物理系统约束作为一等的设计考量（而非事后处理）在CUA多智能体系统中的重要价值。

title: SAFE-G: Structure-aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) aims to answer queries that necessitate reasoning over external knowledge sources beyond the visual content. Typically, current methods fuse multimodal features to retrieve external information, subsequently leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to derive answers from the retrieved evidence. However, these methods often struggle to capture structural associations within complex contexts to effectively filter noise. Furthermore, they frequently fail to ensure that the reasoning process remains strictly faithful to the retrieved evidence. To address these challenges, we propose SAFE-G, a Structure-Aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation framework, which enables precise evidence localization and trustworthy reasoning. Specifically, we first employ a coarse-grained hybrid search fusing visual and textual modalities to recall candidate documents, and subsequently implement a structure-aware fine-grained graph retrieval that captures structural dependencies to filter noise and pinpoint precise evidence. Moreover, we introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) strategy with an evidence-grounded reward that assigns credit to correct answers only when the selected evidence is correct. This strict alignment constraint compels the model to anchor its response in the retrieved context, effectively enhancing its capability to locate evidence via multimodal features and perform faithful reasoning. Extensive experiments on the Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek benchmarks demonstrate that SAFE-G outperforms prior methods by a margin of 8.9% and 3.5%, substantially enhancing the overall reasoning accuracy. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/MINE-USTC/SAFE-G.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFE-G框架，利用结构感知的细粒度图检索和基于证据的强化学习策略，实现精确证据定位和忠实推理，在KB-VQA任务上超越现有方法8.9%和3.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有KB-VQA方法融合多模态特征检索外部信息，但难以捕捉复杂上下文中的结构关联以有效过滤噪声，且推理过程无法严格忠实于检索到的证据。
AI.method: 采用两阶段检索：粗粒度混合搜索（融合视觉和文本模态）召回候选文档，随后进行结构感知的细粒度图检索以捕捉结构依赖、过滤噪声并定位精确证据；引入基于证据奖励的强化学习策略，仅当所选证据正确时才对正确答案赋予信用分，强制模型锚定于检索上下文进行忠实推理。
AI.result: 在Encyclopedic-VQA基准上超越先前方法8.9%，在InfoSeek基准上超越3.5%，显著提升整体推理准确性。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-G通过结构感知检索和证据约束的强化学习，有效解决了KB-VQA中噪声过滤和推理忠实性问题，代码已公开。

title: Resilient Concurrent Causal Discovery for Topological Event Sequences
summary: Causal discovery on topological event sequences is crucial for ensuring the reliability of networks. However, existing methods struggle to capture the complex causal relationships arising from concurrent events and lack robustness to incomplete event sequences. To address these issues, we propose a resilient concurrent causal discovery method, termed RCCD, enabling robust learning of causal graphs from topological event sequences. Specifically, we first introduce an influence-aware hyperedge causal attention mechanism, which incorporates event duration into the embedding representation, aggregates concurrent event features via hyperedge causal convolution, and injects network prior knowledge to capture the complex many-to-one causal interactions. Furthermore, we design a masked-based alternating causal optimization framework, which forces the model to recover masked event types based on context through self-supervised mask reconstruction, thereby enhancing the resilience of the predictor to missing data. To validate the effectiveness of our method, we conduct extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world telecommunication network datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in both accuracy and robustness, making it more suitable for real-world telecommunication network environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RCCD方法，用于从拓扑事件序列中实现具有鲁棒性的并发因果发现。方法包含影响力感知的超边因果注意力机制和基于掩码的交替因果优化框架，在模拟和真实电信网络数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现方法难以捕捉并发事件产生的复杂因果关系，且对不完整事件序列缺乏鲁棒性，无法满足电信网络可靠性的需求。
AI.method: 1) 影响力感知超边因果注意力机制：将事件持续时间融入嵌入表示，通过超边因果卷积聚合并发事件特征，并注入网络先验知识以捕捉多对一因果交互。2) 基于掩码的交替因果优化框架：通过自监督掩码重构迫使模型根据上下文恢复被掩码的事件类型，增强预测器对缺失数据的弹性。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实电信网络数据集上的大量实验表明，RCCD在准确性和鲁棒性两方面均显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: RCCD更适用于真实电信网络环境，能够有效处理并发事件和缺失数据场景下的因果发现任务。

title: VisAdj: Learning Adjacency Matrices from Node-Link Images
summary: Learning adjacency matrices from node-link images is a fundamental problem for recovering structured graph information from visual observations. Existing methods typically rely on fixed KNN-based heuristics for candidate edge selection and fail to capture dependencies among edges. To overcome these limitations, we propose VisAdj, a new framework for topology-aware adjacency prediction. VisAdj introduces an attention-sparse neighbor sampler to adaptively select a high-recall set of candidate node pairs and performs joint edge inference using a line-graph transformer that treats candidate edges as tokens and explicitly models dependencies among incident edges. Extensive experiments on synthetic graphs, road networks, and vessel images demonstrate that VisAdj consistently outperforms existing baselines by clear margins.

AI.tldr: VisAdj是一个用于从节点-链接图像中预测邻接矩阵的新框架，通过注意力稀疏邻居采样器和线图Transformer实现自适应的候选边选择和联合边推理，在合成图、道路网络和血管图像上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖固定的KNN启发式算法进行候选边选择，无法适应不同图结构，且未能捕捉边之间的依赖关系，导致邻接矩阵预测性能受限。
AI.method: VisAdj框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 注意力稀疏邻居采样器，自适应选择高召回率的候选节点对集合；(2) 线图Transformer，将候选边视为token并进行联合边推理，显式建模相邻边之间的依赖关系。
AI.result: 在合成图、道路网络和血管图像三类数据集上的大量实验表明，VisAdj始终以明显优势超越现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应候选采样和拓扑感知的联合边推理，VisAdj有效解决了传统方法在候选边选择和边依赖建模方面的不足，证明了拓扑感知方法在邻接矩阵预测任务中的有效性。

title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
comment: 44 pages, 15 figures. Project website and code: https://aka.ms/AutoSaddler-website
summary: LLM agents remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, where small local failures can compound over extended interactions and lead to overall task failure. Although external harnesses can substantially improve robustness, harness design remains a manual and expensive process that requires searching over a large space of prompts, tool configurations, and control logic. We propose AutoSaddler, an automatic harness optimization framework that formulates harness improvement as an offline learning problem and iteratively updates the harness using failure signals from mini-batches. AutoSaddler combines failure-trace diagnosis, structured patch generation that treats the harness as code, and validation-based update selection. Experiments on GAIA2, SWE-Bench Pro, and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that AutoSaddler substantially improves agent performance over the corresponding base harnesses, achieving gains of 9.0, 9.6, and 10.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies further suggest that effective harness optimization benefits from three ingredients: deep debugging rather than shallow reflection, targeted modifications rather than unconstrained editing, and generalization-aware selection rather than trajectory-specific repair. Together, these results suggest that automatic harness optimization is a promising path toward more performant and reliable agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoSaddler，一个自动harness优化框架，将harness改进视为离线学习问题，通过失败轨迹诊断、结构化补丁生成和基于验证的更新选择，在GAIA2、SWE-Bench Pro和Terminal-Bench 2.0上分别提升9.0、9.6和10.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长时程任务上不可靠，局部小故障会在长交互中累积导致整体失败。虽然外部harness能显著提升鲁棒性，但harness设计仍是手动且昂贵的过程，需要在大量提示词、工具配置和控制逻辑中进行搜索。
AI.method: AutoSaddler将harness改进形式化为离线学习问题，通过迭代方式使用mini-batch的失败信号更新harness。具体包含三个核心组件：失败轨迹诊断、将harness视为代码的结构化补丁生成，以及基于验证的更新选择。
AI.result: 在GAIA2、SWE-Bench Pro和Terminal-Bench 2.0三个基准上，AutoSaddler分别比基线harness提升9.0、9.6和10.0个百分点。消融实验表明有效优化需要三个要素：深度调试而非浅层反思、针对性修改而非无约束编辑、泛化感知选择而非轨迹特定修复。
AI.conclusion: 自动harness优化是提升智能体系统性能和可靠性的有前景的路径。

title: Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators
summary: Large language models can produce fluent reasoning traces whose local semantic errors propagate to an incorrect conclusion, while unconstrained self-correction may preserve, amplify, or introduce errors. Existing diffusion language models provide iterative refinement, but usually define noise as token masking or replacement rather than as errors in the reasoning process. We present Semantic Reasoning Denoising (SRD), an operatorized Markov denoising method for natural-language reasoning trajectories. SRD represents semantic noise with executable error operators that describe the error type, its location, and the corrupted and repaired propositions. Composing these operators constructs progressively noisier states. During training, the model learns to identify the semantic noise active in the current trajectory and to reconstruct the paired adjacent lower-noise state. During inference, noise-level-aware denoising repeatedly predicts an inverse operator and checks whether it is applicable, so each executed update makes a localized move toward a stable trajectory. Across six in-domain benchmarks spanning mathematics, code, knowledge, and commonsense, SRD improves the strongest same backbone baseline by 3.2 points on average. On seven cross-dataset transfer targets, it remains competitive with Llama-3-8B-Instruct and improves the strongest Qwen3-8B baseline average by 2.9 points. Analyses of noise sources, objectives, and denoising depth further show that structured semantic-noise prediction and iterative operator execution are central to the improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义推理去噪（SRD）方法，将推理轨迹中的语义错误建模为可执行的操作算子，通过马尔可夫去噪框架实现渐进式推理修正，在数学、代码、知识、常识等多个基准上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的推理轨迹中，局部语义错误会传播并导致错误结论；而现有自我纠错方法不受约束，可能保留、放大甚至引入新的错误。现有的扩散语言模型虽然支持迭代精炼，但通常将噪声定义为token掩码或替换，而非推理过程中的语义错误，难以直接应用于推理修正任务。
AI.method: SRD是一种算子化的马尔可夫去噪方法：1）用可执行的错误算子表示语义噪声，描述错误类型、位置以及被破坏和修复后的命题；2）通过组合这些算子构造逐级加噪的状态；3）训练时模型学习识别当前轨迹中的语义噪声并重建相邻的低噪状态；4）推理时按噪声级别感知去噪，反复预测逆算子并检查其可适用性，每次更新向稳定轨迹做局部移动。
AI.result: 在六个领域内基准（数学、代码、知识、常识）上，SRD平均比最强同骨干基线提升3.2分；在七个跨数据集迁移目标上，与Llama-3-8B-Instruct保持竞争力，比最强Qwen3-8B基线平均提升2.9分。
AI.conclusion: 结构化语义噪声预测与迭代算子执行是性能提升的核心因素。对噪声来源、目标和去噪深度的分析进一步验证了该方法的有效性。

title: FlashReg: GPU-Accelerated 3-Clique Point Cloud Registration for Real-Time Correspondence-to-Pose Estimation
summary: Graph-based point cloud registration achieves high robustness by identifying geometrically consistent correspondence sets, but constructing second-order compatibility graphs and enumerating candidate cliques remain compute- and memory-intensive. This work presents FlashReg, a GPU-oriented correspondence-to-pose estimator that avoids materializing the dense scored second-order graph. Its Fast First- and Second-Order Graph (FFSOG) construction builds a capacity-bounded sparse second-order graph directly from the binary first-order graph. A dataflow-optimized three-node clique (3-clique) search then selects pivots from compact per-row candidate pools and enumerates triples through sorted sparse-neighborhood intersections. Across indoor and outdoor benchmarks, FlashReg reduces correspondence-to-pose latency by 2--3x relative to TurboReg at comparable registration recall, while using about 50% of its peak allocated tensor memory on an embedded GPU. These results make FlashReg suitable as a high-throughput registration backend within onboard perception pipelines.

AI.tldr: FlashReg是一种面向GPU的基于图的点云配准对应到位姿估计器，通过快速一阶/二阶图构建和有数据流优化的三节点团搜索，在保持配准召回率的同时将延迟降低2-3倍，峰值张量内存减少约50%。
AI.motivation: 基于图的点云配准通过识别几何一致的对应集合获得高鲁棒性，但构建二阶兼容性图和枚举候选团是计算密集型和内存密集型的，现有方法（如TurboReg）在嵌入式中难以满足高吞吐需求。
AI.method: 1) Fast First- and Second-Order Graph (FFSOG)：直接从二元一阶图构建容量有界的稀疏二阶图，避免物化密集评分的二阶图。2) 数据流优化的三节点团搜索：从紧凑的逐行候选池中选择枢轴，通过排序的稀疏邻域交集枚举三元组。
AI.result: 在室内和室外基准测试中，与TurboReg相比，对应到位姿延迟降低2-3倍，配准召回率相当，峰值张量内存占用约为TurboReg的50%（在嵌入式GPU上）。
AI.conclusion: FlashReg可作为机载感知管线中的高吞吐量配准后端，适合资源受限的嵌入式GPU环境。

title: A Physics-informed Neural Network Approach for Robust Buckling Load Prediction and Reliability-Based Design of Thin Truncated Conical Shells
summary: Thin-walled truncated conical shells are widely used in aerospace, marine, offshore, and lightweight infrastructure systems due to their high strength-to-weight ratio and geometric efficiency. Their buckling resistance under axial compression, however, is highly sensitive to geometric imperfections, manufacturing tolerances, material variability, and nonlinear instability effects. Conventional design procedures rely on conservative knockdown factors (KDFs), such as those recommended in NASA SP-8019, which do not explicitly account for shell geometry, fabrication quality, data uncertainty, or target reliability. This study develops a physics-informed neural network (PiNN) framework for predicting critical buckling loads of thin truncated conical shells and integrates the trained surrogate within a reliability-based design (RBD) formulation. The model combines geometric and material descriptors with mechanics-informed features derived from shell stability theory and the localized reduced stiffness method (LRSM). A physics-informed loss function penalizes mechanically inadmissible predictions exceeding the theoretical elastic buckling load. The framework is trained and evaluated using 133 experimental Mylar conical shell tests under axial compression. Compared with a conventional deep neural network (DNN), the PiNN improves predictive accuracy, reduces mean absolute error, and enhances physical consistency. The trained PiNN is then used to evaluate reliability indices and calibrate safety-consistent KDFs for prescribed target reliability levels. Results demonstrate that the PiNN-RBD framework provides an efficient approach for uncertainty-aware design of imperfection-sensitive shell structures.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种物理信息神经网络（PiNN）框架，用于预测薄壁截锥壳在轴向压缩下的临界屈曲载荷，并将其集成到基于可靠性的设计（RBD）框架中。该模型结合了几何、材料描述符及力学信息特征（基于壳体稳定理论和局部减刚度方法），并通过物理信息损失函数惩罚力学上不合理的预测。利用133个Mylar截锥壳实验测试进行训练和评估，相比传统深度神经网络（DNN），PiNN在预测精度、平均绝对误差和物理一致性方面均有提升。训练后的PiNN用于评估可靠性指标并校准安全一致的折减因子（KDF）。
AI.motivation: 薄壁截锥壳在航空航天等领域广泛应用，但其屈曲抗力对几何缺陷、制造公差、材料变异和非线性失稳效应高度敏感。传统设计方法（如NASA SP-8019）依赖保守的折减因子（KDF），未显式考虑壳体几何、制造质量、数据不确定性和目标可靠性。因此需要一种能够将物理知识与数据驱动方法结合、并考虑不确定性的高效设计框架。
AI.method: 本文提出PiNN框架，将几何和材料描述符与基于壳体稳定理论和局部减刚度方法（LRSM）导出的力学信息特征相结合。采用物理信息损失函数，惩罚超过理论弹性屈曲载荷的力学不可接受预测。框架使用133个Mylar截锥壳轴向压缩实验数据进行训练和评估，并与传统深度神经网络（DNN）对比。训练后的PiNN被进一步用于评估可靠性指标和校准不同目标可靠性水平下的安全一致性KDF。
AI.result: 与常规DNN相比，PiNN提高了预测精度、降低了平均绝对误差，并增强了物理一致性。PiNN-RBD框架成功实现了对缺陷敏感壳体结构的不确定性感知设计，可校准安全一致的KDF。
AI.conclusion: PiNN-RBD框架为缺陷敏感壳体结构提供了一种高效且考虑不确定性的设计方法，兼具物理可解释性和数据驱动的预测能力，有望成为传统保守KDF方法的替代方案。

title: Beyond Success and Failure: Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents powered by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for automating tasks across diverse digital environments, where reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant training paradigm. However, widely used methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) suffer from reward-gradient misalignment, leading to inefficient and unstable optimization. Recent work addresses this issue by reformulating RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) as contrastive or classification-based objectives, which improve stability by eliminating problematic gradient behaviors. Despite this progress, existing contrastive RLVR methods rely primarily on outcome-level supervision and fail to capture fine-grained differences in trajectory quality within the same outcome category. In this paper, we propose Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents (LACL-GUI), a contrastive RLVR framework that incorporates trajectory-level quality signals into policy optimization. LACL-GUI introduces structured preferences within both successful and failed trajectories, encouraging concise successful executions and differentiating failure quality based on divergence from successful trajectories, while preserving optimization stability. Experiments on GUI agent benchmarks show that LACL-GUI provides more effective learning signals and consistently improves agent performance over prior methods, highlighting the value of trajectory-level supervision in contrastive RLVR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LACL-GUI，一个用于GUI智能体的长度感知对比强化学习框架。它通过在成功和失败轨迹内部引入结构化偏好，捕获轨迹级质量信号，在保持优化稳定性的同时提升智能体性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的对比RLVR方法主要依赖结果级监督，无法捕获同一结果类别内轨迹质量的细粒度差异。GRPO等方法存在奖励梯度错配问题，导致优化低效不稳定。
AI.method: LACL-GUI采用对比RLVR框架，在成功轨迹中鼓励简洁执行（长度感知），在失败轨迹中根据与成功轨迹的偏离程度区分失败质量，同时保留优化稳定性。
AI.result: 在GUI智能体基准测试上，LACL-GUI提供了更有效的学习信号，并稳定优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级监督在对比RLVR中具有重要价值，LACL-GUI验证了在GUI智能体强化学习中加入细粒度轨迹质量信号能显著提升性能。

title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
summary: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions.
