AI.result: 核心发现包括：算子放置是表达方式的属性而非计算内容的属性（融合RMSNorm完全可入ANE而其算术等价的分解版本仅CPU）；权重编码决定加速器可用性（25.85M参数的conv-heavy fp16模型100%驻留CPU，同图int8/2-bit回归83%驻留且快1.8-2.2x）；解码成本是每token流式字节，恒定约为编码标称宽度的0.77倍；三值模型综合表现最佳，25M三值模型驻留10.0-10.8 MB、0.62-0.64 ms/token；最佳组合为half-attention三值25M（10.5 MB, 0.63 ms）和50M（16.8 MB, 0.86 ms），比初始conv-heavy fp16设计小9.8x/6.1x并快3.0x/2.2x。
AI.conclusion: 从测量结果得出明确的设计程序：先选择权重编码（这是决定能否上ANE的关键门槛），然后在编码约束下将字节预算分配给参数。三值编码与half-attention架构的组合在ANE上达到了最优的尺寸-速度平衡。

title: DynaContext: Self-Improving Dynamic Contextualization of Optimized Prompts for Heterogeneous Parameter Extraction
summary: Automated prompt and skill optimization typically produces a single static instruction that is reused across inference instances until the next optimization cycle. However, this approach cannot adapt when the required context, constraints, and evidence vary from one instance to another. For instance, parameter extraction from electronic component descriptions breaks this assumption: resistors, capacitors, transistors, and connectors require different fields, unit constraints, and demonstrations, and each input provides a different evidence state. We introduce DynaContext, a framework that combines an offline-optimized extraction core, learned with GEPA or SkillOpt, with inference-time contextual adaptation and validation-gated self-improvement. DynaContext routes each item through internal, external, or fallback evidence paths and composes an item-specific prompt from the core, schema, evidence, unresolved fields, and validated demonstrations. Deterministic validation and an LLM judge gate every output, uncertain cases go to human review, and only human-verified corrections enter the demonstration memory. On a single-category benchmark, average accuracy increases from 86.6% for the base prompt to 96.9% for standalone SkillOpt and 98.6% for the best DynaContext configuration. Across 850 heterogeneous gold parameter facts, average field-level F1 increases from 51.8% for an unoptimized, demonstration-free control to 59.2% with dynamic demonstrations alone, 66.9% with the optimized core alone, and 71.0% with both. Holding the model fixed, the full configuration outperforms the deployed static-prompting pipeline by 17.3 F1 points on average.

AI.tldr: DynaContext是一个结合离线优化的提取核心（基于GEPA或SkillOpt）与推理时上下文适配及验证门控自改进的框架，用于处理电子元件参数提取等需要逐实例适配的任务。它通过内部/外部/回退证据路径路由每个item，动态组合item-specific提示，并用确定性验证和LLM judge门控输出，不确定案例转人工审核，人工验证的修正进入演示记忆。在异构参数提取基准上，相比静态提示管线平均提升17.3 F1点。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动提示和技能优化方法通常产生单一的静态指令，在推理实例间重复使用，无法适应不同实例间上下文、约束和证据的变化。以电子元件参数提取为例，电阻、电容、晶体管和连接器需要不同的字段、单位约束和演示，且每个输入提供不同的证据状态，静态提示方法难以应对这种异质性。
AI.method: DynaContext框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 离线优化的提取核心（用GEPA或SkillOpt学习）；(2) 推理时的上下文适配，通过内部、外部或回退证据路径路由每个item，并从核心、schema、证据、未解析字段和验证过的演示中组合item-specific提示；(3) 验证门控的自改进，用确定性验证和LLM judge门控每个输出，不确定案例转人工审查，仅人工验证的修正进入演示记忆。
AI.result: 在单类别基准上，平均准确率从基础提示的86.6%提升到独立SkillOpt的96.9%和最佳DynaContext配置的98.6%。在850个异构黄金参数事实上，字段级F1从不带优化和演示的对照组51.8%提升到仅动态演示的59.2%、仅优化核心的66.9%、两者结合的71.0%。在固定模型下，完整配置比部署的静态提示管线平均高出17.3 F1点。
AI.conclusion: DynaContext证明了将离线提示优化与推理时动态上下文适配相结合的可行性，动态演示和优化核心共同作用优于任何单一组件，验证门控的自改进机制能够安全地积累人类验证的知识，为异构信息抽取任务提供了超越静态提示方案的有效框架。

title: When Not to Imitate: Boundary-Aware Skill Memory for Reliable Tool-Use LLM Agents
summary: Extracting skills from past successes is critical for the efficient evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents. Prevailing agent self-evolution paradigms typically rely on a core assumption: equipping LLMs with skill memories derived from successful trajectories will monotonically improve their problem-solving capabilities. However, probe analyses reveal that extracting skills solely from successful trajectories traps the model in a \textbf{Skill Imitation Trap}. For tasks that resemble past successes but require different tools, retrieving more skills paradoxically increases the model's confidence in wrong tool calls---procedure skills raise the wrong-tool margin by $47\%$ over a memory-free baseline. To overcome this limitation, we propose \textbf{Boundary-Aware Skill Memory} (BASM), which augments each skill with explicit boundary fields---applicability conditions, risk cues, avoidance rules, and recovery notes. These fields transform each retrieved skill from an unconditional action template into state-conditioned guidance: the agent applies the skill when its conditions hold, suppresses inapplicable tool calls when they do not, and issues targeted repairs when execution fails. Across three agent benchmarks and four model scales, BASM consistently outperforms success-distilled skill-memory baselines: it improves task success rate by up to $23.8\%$ on AppWorld, accuracy by up to $5.0\%$ on BFCL, and reduces attack success rate by $4.6\%$ on AgentDojo, while simultaneously reducing average AppWorld steps by up to $6.6\%$ relative to the memory-free baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出边界感知技能记忆（BASM），揭示并解决LLM智能体自我进化中的"技能模仿陷阱"问题——仅从成功轨迹提取技能会让模型在面对相似但需不同工具的任务时过度自信地调用错误工具。BASM为每条技能增添适用条件、风险线索、规避规则和恢复说明等边界字段，将技能从无条件操作模板转化为状态条件化指导，在多个基准上显著提升任务成功率、准确率并降低攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体自我演进范式的核心假设是：从成功轨迹中提取技能记忆能单调提升问题解决能力。但探测分析发现这一假设存在根本缺陷——仅从成功轨迹提取技能会陷入"技能模仿陷阱"：当面对与过去成功相似但需要不同工具的任务时，检索更多技能反而会提高模型对错误工具调用的置信度（程序性技能使错误工具边缘提升47%）。这暴露了技能记忆中缺乏边界信息（何时适用、何时不适用）的问题。
AI.method: 提出边界感知技能记忆（Boundary-Aware Skill Memory, BASM）：为每条技能显式增强四个边界字段——(1) 适用条件（applicability conditions）、(2) 风险线索（risk cues）、(3) 规避规则（avoidance rules）、(4) 恢复说明（recovery notes）。这些字段将每条检索到的技能从无条件行动模板转变为状态条件化指导：条件成立时应用技能，条件不成立时抑制不适用工具调用，执行失败时给出针对性修复。在三个智能体基准和四种模型规模上进行评估。
AI.result: BASM在三个智能体基准和四种模型规模上一致超越成功蒸馏技能记忆基线：AppWorld上任务成功率最高提升23.8%，BFCL上准确率最高提升5.0%，AgentDojo上攻击成功率降低4.6%，同时相较于无记忆基线，AppWorld平均步骤数最多降低6.6%。
AI.conclusion: 过度依赖成功轨迹提取技能存在根本性局限，技能记忆必须包含"何时不该用"的边界信息才能有效指导智能体决策。BASM通过显式的条件化边界字段，不仅提升了任务成功率，还增强了安全性和效率，为LLM智能体的自我进化提供了更稳健的技能记忆范式。

title: Trustworthy Visual Quality Inspection under Data Scarcity in Manufacturing
comment: Accepted at International Conference on the Economics of Grids, Clouds, Systems, and Services (GECON) 2026
summary: Automated visual inspection in manufacturing aims to replace slow and inconsistent manual checks, but its economic value depends on whether its decisions can be trusted enough to automate routine inspection while reserving human expertise for ambiguous cases. In production-line settings, defective samples are scarce, since the process is optimized to produce good parts, which limits any learning-based inspector trained on real data alone. Compounding this, defect decisions emitted as hard labels with no confidence estimate carry an asymmetric cost: a false reject wastes a good product, while a false accept may increase the risk of undetected defects progressing through the production process. We address both problems by mitigating data scarcity through the generation of synthetic defective samples with a diffusion model, and meeting the need for confidence-aware decisions with a Bayesian classifier that defers ambiguous units to human review rather than misclassifying them. These components are embedded in a staged pipeline of successive, complementary checks. We evaluate how synthetic augmentation affects classification and localization on a test set of real defects, and examine the system's trustworthiness at three points: the decision, the synthetic data, and the pipeline structure. This work-in-progress reports preliminary results suggesting that diffusion-generated defects, combined with uncertainty-aware classification, can lower the cost of reaching a trustworthy, deployable inspection model under data scarcity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合扩散模型合成缺陷样本与贝叶斯不确定性分类器的自动化视觉检测流水线，解决制造场景中缺陷样本稀缺和硬标签决策成本不对称的问题，初步实验表明该方法能降低在数据匮乏下构建可信检测模型的成本。
AI.motivation: 制造业中自动化视觉检测的经济价值取决于决策的可信度，但存在两大挑战：(1) 生产线上缺陷样本稀缺，限制了基于真实数据的监督学习；(2) 硬标签决策缺乏置信度估计，且误拒和误收具有不对称成本。现有方法难以同时解决数据稀缺和不确定性感知决策问题。
AI.method: 设计了一个分阶段的流水线，包含两个核心组件：(1) 使用扩散模型生成合成缺陷样本来缓解数据稀缺问题；(2) 采用贝叶斯分类器，对不确定的样本推迟到人工审查而非强行分类。两个组件嵌入到一系列互补检查的级联流水线中。
AI.result: 在真实缺陷测试集上评估了合成数据增强对分类和定位的影响，并从三个维度（决策层面、合成数据层面、流水线结构层面）检验了系统的可信度。初步结果表明扩散模型生成的缺陷结合不确定性感知分类能够降低在数据匮乏条件下构建可信检测模型的成本。
AI.conclusion: 目前是进行中的工作，初步结果支持扩散模型生成缺陷样本与不确定性感知分类相结合的方案在数据稀缺的制造检测场景中具有可行性，有望降低达到可信可部署检测模型的成本。

title: Symbolic Neural ODEs: Learning interpretable models from time-series data
comment: Submitted to the SIAM J. Dynamical Systems
summary: We present a machine learning framework for identifying sparse, interpretable models of dynamical systems directly from time-series data. Our approach parameterizes the underlying vector field using a neural architecture and trains it by minimizing a multi-step prediction loss over a finite horizon. To ensure numerical tractability, we optimize a mean absolute error objective averaged across prediction steps, and progressively increase the horizon during training. A key feature of this formulation is that it enforces consistency under repeated composition of the learned dynamics. As a result, the identified models exhibit significantly improved stability compared with approaches based on one-step regression of the vector field. When combined with sparsity-promoting regularization, this leads to parsimonious models that generalize beyond the training data. We demonstrate accurate recovery of systems exhibiting a wide range of behaviors, including stable and unstable fixed points, periodic orbits, and chaotic attractors. For chaotic systems, while long-term trajectory prediction is inherently limited by sensitivity to initial conditions, we show that multi-step training yields models with accurate short-term dynamics and strong agreement in long-time statistical properties, including mean, variance, and Lyapunov exponents. Moreover, we establish theoretical bounds linking trajectory error to statistical accuracy, providing a step toward a principled explanation for this behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种机器学习框架，直接从时间序列数据中识别稀疏、可解释的动力系统模型。该方法用神经网络参数化向量场，通过最小化多步预测损失进行训练，并结合稀疏正则化，从而获得具备良好稳定性和泛化能力的简约模型。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于一步回归的向量场识别方法在模型稳定性方面表现不佳，反复组合学习到的动力学可能导致误差累积和系统发散。作者希望开发一种方法，能够识别出不仅准确而且稳定的动力系统模型，同时保持模型的稀疏性和可解释性。
AI.method: 1) 用神经网络参数化底层向量场；2) 训练时最小化有限时间范围内的多步预测损失（MAE目标）；3) 训练过程中逐步增加预测时域（课程学习策略）；4) 关键在于多步公式强制要求学习到的动力学在反复组合下保持一致；5) 结合稀疏性促进正则化以获得简约模型。
AI.result: 该方法能准确恢复多种动力系统行为，包括稳定/不稳定不动点、周期轨道和混沌吸引子。对于混沌系统，多步训练能获得准确的短期动力学和良好匹配的长期统计特性（均值、方差、Lyapunov指数）。还建立了连接轨迹误差与统计精度的理论界限。
AI.conclusion: 多步预测训练相比一步回归能显著提高模型稳定性，结合稀疏正则化可得到超越训练数据泛化的简约模型。论文还提供了理论依据，解释为何多步训练能带来良好的统计精度。

title: SPAR-Hate: An Auditor-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Bilingual Hate Speech Parsing
summary: Hate speech detection has recently shifted from coarse-grained classification to structured parsing, where systems must jointly identify hateful targets, arguments, and target-level labels. However, existing studies primarily emphasize benchmark evaluation while paying less attention to the cultural, linguistic, and social-group challenges involved in structured hate speech parsing. To address these challenges, we propose SPAR-Hate, an auditor-guided multi-agent framework for bilingual hate speech parsing. The framework first decomposes documents into clause-level decision units and then generates evidence-grounded judgments from three complementary perspectives: Victim, Moderator, and Cultural Bystander. An evidence-constrained arbitration process resolves conflicts among role-specific predictions and aggregates them into structured sample-level outputs. Experiments on the STATE-ToxiCN and TBO benchmarks show that SPAR-Hate consistently improves bilingual hate parsing across diverse large language models. The framework achieves state-of-the-art results on bilingual multi-tuple extraction tasks, with the largest gains observed under stricter structural evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPAR-Hate，一个审核员引导的多智能体框架，用于双语仇恨言论结构化解析。框架将文档分解为子句级决策单元，从受害者、审核员、文化旁观者三个互补视角生成基于证据的判断，并通过证据约束的仲裁过程解决冲突、聚合为结构化输出。在STATE-ToxiCN和TBO基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有仇恨言论检测研究从粗粒度分类转向结构化解析（需联合识别仇恨目标、论点和目标级标签），但现有研究主要关注基准评估，忽视了结构化仇恨言论解析中涉及的文化、语言和社会群体挑战。
AI.method: SPAR-Hate框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 将文档分解为子句级决策单元；(2) 从受害者、审核员、文化旁观者三个互补视角生成基于证据的判断；(3) 采用证据约束的仲裁过程解决角色间预测冲突并聚合为样本级结构化输出。
AI.result: 在STATE-ToxiCN和TBO基准上，SPAR-Hate在多种大语言模型上持续改进双语仇恨解析性能，在双语多元组提取任务上达到最先进水平，且在更严格的结构化评估指标下获得最大增益。
AI.conclusion: SPAR-Hate通过审计员引导的多智能体协作和证据约束仲裁，有效应对双语仇恨言论解析中的文化、语言和社会群体挑战，验证了多视角证据驱动方法在结构化仇恨解析中的有效性。

title: Context-Aware Cluster Decoding: Semantic Anchor-Driven Coherence in dMLLMs
comment: This paper is accepted by EMNLP 2026. 19 pages, 12 figures, 13 tables
summary: Diffusion multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) frequently produce long-form outputs marred by semantic drift and repetition, with quality generally degrading as output length increases. We identify two structural deficiencies in existing decoding methods as primary drivers of these failures: confidence-based scoring ignores decoded-neighbor support, and block partitioning prevents access to high-readiness semantic anchors, together causing tokens to be committed before their local context is sufficiently established. We propose \ours{} (\textbf{C}ontext-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{C}luster \textbf{D}ecoding), a training-free decoding method that scores each masked position by a multiplicative composite of softmax confidence and neighbor proximity, promoting contextually ready tokens above isolated candidates while suppressing low-confidence positional noise, operating block-free to keep high-readiness anchors globally accessible. \ours{} further applies architecture-aware calibration to handle confidence heterogeneity induced by diverse visual integration strategies. Experiments on three dMLLMs across four benchmarks demonstrate consistent quality gains and hallucination reduction over Original, with larger gains in several longer generation settings, highlighting the importance of neighbor support and visual integration strategy for future dMLLM decoding method design. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/zhaoyk-sysu/CACD-dMLLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的上下文感知聚类解码方法(CACD)，通过结合softmax置信度和邻居邻近度的乘性复合得分来评估掩码位置，并采用无块架构保持高就绪语义锚点的全局可访问性，有效缓解扩散多模态大语言模型(dMLLMs)在长文本生成中的语义漂移和重复问题。
AI.motivation: dMLLMs在生成长文本时经常出现语义漂移和重复，质量随输出长度增加而下降。现有解码方法存在两个结构性缺陷：基于置信度的评分忽略了已解码邻居的支持，以及块划分限制了高就绪语义锚点的访问，导致token在局部上下文尚未充分建立时就被过早确定。
AI.method: 提出CACD解码方法：1)对每个掩码位置使用softmax置信度与邻居邻近度的乘性复合得分进行评分，促进上下文就绪的token同时抑制低置信度位置噪声；2)采用无块操作使高就绪锚点保持全局可访问；3)应用架构感知校准以处理不同视觉集成策略导致的置信度异质性。
AI.result: 在三个dMLLMs和四个基准上的实验表明，该方法相比Original方法持续取得质量提升和幻觉减少，且在多个较长生成设置中获得更大增益。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明邻居支持和视觉集成策略对dMLLM解码方法设计具有重要意义，为未来dMLLM解码方法的发展提供了方向。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Visual Prompting: Guiding Foundation Models in Two-Photon Imaging
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Supplementary material included
summary:
Two-photon calcium imaging presents a challenging setting for foundation models: image appearance varies substantially across recordings and experimental conditions, annotations are scarce, and rapid adaptation is often needed. Rather than adapting model weights through fine-tuning, we ask whether a foundation model can be guided at inference time by injecting external visual memory directly into its input. We implement this idea with SAM 3 and introduce Retrieval-Augmented Visual Prompting (RAVP), a framework in which each target tile is augmented with a retrieved annotated exemplar whose bounding box is used as a concept prompt.
  RAVP turns retrieval into a form of visual prompting and enables adaptation through input design alone. We study multiple exemplar selection strategies, including fluorescence-guided heuristics and a lightweight recall predictor trained to estimate which exemplar is most informative for a target tile. Experiments on the Allen Brain Observatory show that exemplar-augmented inference consistently strengthens zero-shot neuron detection and instance segmentation. Ablation studies further show that a single carefully selected exemplar is more effective than prompting with multiple retrieved examples. These results position inference-time visual memory injection as a simple and effective alternative to parameter adaptation for foundation models in specialized biomedical imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出检索增强视觉提示（RAVP）框架，基于SAM 3在双光子钙成像领域实现推理时的外部视觉记忆注入。通过在输入中附加检索到的注释示例及其边界框作为概念提示，无需微调模型权重即可实现零样本神经元检测和实例分割，实验证明单一精心选择的示例比多个检索示例更有效。
AI.motivation: 双光子钙成像对基础模型极具挑战性：图像外观在不同记录和实验条件下差异大、标注稀缺、且需要快速适应。传统微调权重的方式成本高且不灵活，因此作者探索是否可以通过在推理时向输入注入外部视觉记忆来引导模型，而非调整模型参数。
AI.method: 基于SAM 3实现RAVP框架：每个目标切片附加一个检索到的注释示例，使用该示例的边界框作为概念提示。研究多种示例选择策略，包括荧光引导的启发式方法和轻量级召回预测器（用于估计哪个示例对目标切片最具信息量）。
AI.result: 在Allen Brain Observatory上的实验表明，示例增强推理持续增强零样本神经元检测和实例分割性能。消融研究表明，单个精心选择的示例比多个检索示例更有效。
AI.conclusion: 推理时视觉记忆注入是专用生物医学成像中基础模型的一种简单有效的参数适应替代方案，将检索转化为一种视觉提示形式，仅通过输入设计即可实现适应。

title: CST: Collaborative Selective Transmission for Communication-Efficient Multimodal Edge Inference
summary: Collaborative multimodal inference improves edge perception by combining observations from distributed sensing devices, but transmitting high-dimensional helper representations incurs substantial communication overhead and can lead to high end-to-end latency. Existing communication-efficient methods reduce payloads through compression, semantic coding, or feature selection, yet typically optimize compactness or task relevance without explicitly accounting for information already represented at the main device. Consequently, task-relevant but redundant helper features may still consume bandwidth. We present Collaborative Selective Transmission (CST), a main-directed query--response framework that retrieves only helper information complementary to the current main representation. Inspired by Partial Information Decomposition and the Multiview Redundancy Assumption, CST learns sample-adaptive, helper-specific sparse retrieval supports while discouraging retrieval of semantics already covered by the main device or duplicated across helpers. During inference, the main device transmits only support indices, and each helper returns the corresponding latent values, avoiding dense helper-feature exchange. Across three real-world multimodal sensing benchmarks, CST transmits no more than 14.18% of helper feature values while achieving best or near-best task performance among the evaluated methods. Experiments on a five-node NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano testbed across 5--100 Mbps demonstrate up to a $4.27\times$ speedup over Transmit-All in end-to-end inference, confirming practical end-to-end latency reductions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出协作选择性传输（CST）框架，通过主节点定向查询-响应机制，仅检索与当前主表示互补的辅助信息，避免冗余特征传输。在三个多模态感知基准上，CST仅传输不超过14.18%的辅助特征值即可达到最佳或接近最佳性能，并在五节点Jetson Orin Nano测试平台上实现最高4.27倍的端到端推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有协同多模态推理方法虽通过压缩、语义编码或特征选择降低通信开销，但通常只优化紧凑性或任务相关性，未显式考虑主设备已表示的信息，导致任务相关但冗余的辅助特征仍占用带宽。
AI.method: CST框架基于部分信息分解和多视图冗余假设，学习样本自适应、辅助特征特定的稀疏检索支持，同时抑制检索已被主设备覆盖或辅助设备间重复的语义。推理时主设备仅传输支持索引，辅助设备返回对应的潜在值，避免密集的辅助特征交换。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界多模态感知基准上，CST仅传输不超过14.18%的辅助特征值即达到最佳或接近最佳性能；在5-100 Mbps的五节点NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano测试平台上，相比全量传输实现最高4.27倍端到端推理加速。
AI.conclusion: CST通过主导向的互补信息检索策略，有效解决了协同推理中冗余特征占用带宽的问题，在保持任务性能的同时显著降低了通信开销和端到端延迟，验证了其在实际边缘系统中的实用性。

title: One-Step Evolution for Long-Time Extrapolation: An Error-Bound-Informed and Prior-Guided Neural Residual Framework for Autonomous PDEs
summary: Accurate simulation of the long-time evolution of systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) is central to scientific computing. Among existing deep learning?based approaches for solving PDEs, neural operators typically rely on extensive trajectory data, whereas physics-informed meth?ods often exhibit limited stability during long-time extrapolation. For a well-posed autonomous PDE, long-time trajectories can be generated by repeated composition of a fixed-step evolution operator; hence, long-time extrapolation depends on controlling the approximation error of this operator and the propagation of that error under recursive composition. Accordingly, we propose a numerical-prior-guided, physics-constrained method trained without ground-truth trajectory supervision: a low-cost numerical prior reduces the difficulty of approximating the one?step evolution operator, while a weak-form PDE residual provides a computable proxy for the one-step error term in the error?propagation bound. We validate the method on five benchmark cases spanning four PDE classes and compare it with ten physics?informed learning methods under a unified protocol that excludes ground-truth trajectories from training and model selection. The results indicate that, in all five cases, the proposed method reduces long-time extrapolation error relative to the numerical prior and outperforms the best competing baseline in each case, thereby improving long-time simulation accuracy across different PDEs without ground-truth trajectory supervision. The source code developed for this paper will be made publicly available upon acceptance of the manuscript.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数值先验引导的物理约束方法，无需真实轨迹监督即可实现PDE系统的长时间演化模拟，在五个基准案例（涵盖四类PDE）上均降低了长时间外推误差，并优于十种物理信息学习方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度学习方法求解PDE存在两大瓶颈：神经算子依赖大量轨迹数据，而物理信息方法在长时间外推时稳定性有限。长时间演化可视为固定步长演化算子的反复组合，因此控制单步算子近似误差及其在递归组合下的传播是关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出数值先验引导的物理约束方法：1）使用低成本的数值先验来降低单步演化算子逼近的难度；2）利用弱形式PDE残差作为单步误差项的可计算代理，用于误差传播界的估计。整个训练过程无需真实轨迹数据作为监督信号。
AI.result: 在涵盖四类PDE的五个基准案例上，与十种物理信息学习方法在排除真实轨迹的统一协议下比较，所提方法在全部五个案例中均降低了相对于数值先验的长时间外推误差，并在每个案例中优于最佳竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在无需真实轨迹监督的情况下，能有效提升不同PDE的长时间仿真精度，兼顾了数值先验的低成本优势和物理约束的稳定性，为长时间PDE演化模拟提供了可行的深度学习方案。

title: Can Large Language Models "Hyper-Thread"?
summary: Large language models generate tokens sequentially, but can they execute multiple tasks concurrently while forming each token? Broader attention allocation may provide a mechanism for such task concurrency. Existing approaches to scaling inference primarily rely on longer generations, more samples, or additional verification stages, while attention dispersion is often treated as a signal of interference or error. Task concurrency within serial generation therefore remains underexplored. We propose the Model Hyper-Threading Hypothesis and evaluate its predictions using multiple coordinated tasks that share state within the same problem. We design three conditions (Baseline, Serial Functional Scheduling, and Concurrent Functional Loading) and evaluate their benefits and costs using accuracy, output-token distributions, and attention metrics. On an AIME 2025 development set, Concurrent Functional Loading achieves the highest accuracy. Relative to Serial Functional Scheduling, its typical output length is similar and it is shorter on most problems, while exhibiting greater attention dispersion and higher task-relevant coverage, albeit with a heavier output-length tail. Within-step concurrency and its causal mechanism still require direct tests. Our results show that more dispersed attention can coexist with higher accuracy, providing preliminary behavioral and correlational evidence for the hyper-threading hypothesis. These findings motivate a shift in perspective on inference scaling from "generating more tokens" toward "having each generation step carry more tasks," pointing to a new avenue for improving reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"模型超线程假说"，认为大语言模型在串行生成每个token时可以在单步内并行执行多个任务。通过三种条件（基线、串行功能调度、并发功能加载）的实验，发现并发功能加载在AIME 2025开发集上准确率最高，且注意力更分散但任务相关覆盖更高，表明注意力分散可以与更高准确率共存，为推理扩展提供了从"生成更多token"转向"每步承载更多任务"的新视角。
AI.motivation: 现有推理扩展方法主要依赖更长的生成、更多样本或额外的验证阶段，而注意力分散常被视为干扰或错误的信号。在串行生成中实现任务并发的机制尚未被探索，作者希望填补这一空白，将注意力分散重新视为潜在的计算资源而非缺陷。
AI.method: 提出模型超线程假说，设计三种实验条件：基线（Baseline）、串行功能调度（Serial Functional Scheduling）、并发功能加载（Concurrent Functional Loading）。在共享状态的多协调任务上评估，使用准确率、输出token分布和注意力指标衡量收益与代价。
AI.result: 在AIME 2025开发集上，并发功能加载取得最高准确率。与串行功能调度相比，其典型输出长度相似且多数问题更短，注意力更分散但任务相关覆盖率更高，不过输出长度尾部更重。
AI.conclusion: 步内并发及其因果机制仍需直接测试，但已有结果表明注意力分散可与更高准确率共存，为超线程假说提供了初步的行为与相关性证据。这推动推理扩展从"生成更多token"转向"每步承载更多任务"的范式转变。

title: Improved denoising diffusion probabilistic models with efficient non-diagonal covariance modeling
summary: The sampling process of Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) can be accelerated by leveraging second-order information in the form of approximations to the denoising posterior covariance -- allowing samples of acceptable quality to be produced in fewer but larger sampling steps. Previous attempts at using such information have used drastic (e.g.\ diagonal) simplifications of the covariance. These do not do justice to the peculiar statistical structure of natural images, which exhibit strong non-diagonal correlations between pixels and color channels, and a slow-decaying power-law frequency spectrum. Here, we develop a novel covariance model that captures these features. Our Kronecker-DCT (K-DCT) model uses a Kronecker-factored decomposition of inter-color covariances and spatial covariances modeled in the frequency domain using the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT). The use of the DCT reduces the computational complexity from quadratic to log-linear, resulting in negligible computational and memory overhead in each denoising step. By learning K-DCT-structured amortizations of the denoising posterior covariance using pre-trained score models on CIFAR-10, Celeb-A, ImageNet and LSUN datasets, we show improved performance compared to previous SOTA denoising samplers, both in terms of FID and likelihoods, especially in the regime of few denoising steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的Kronecker-DCT (K-DCT)协方差模型，用于加速扩散模型（DDPMs）的采样过程。该模型利用Kronecker分解来建模颜色通道间的协方差，并在DCT频域中建模空间协方差，将计算复杂度从二次降至对数线性。基于预训练评分模型在CIFAR-10、Celeb-A、ImageNet和LSUN数据集上学习该协方差结构，在少步采样场景下取得了优于SOTA方法的FID和似然性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型采样加速可以通过利用去噪后验协方差的二阶信息来实现，允许在更少但更大的采样步骤中生成可接受质量的样本。然而以往尝试使用极度简化（如对角化）的协方差近似，未能充分捕捉自然图像中像素与颜色通道间强烈的非对角相关性以及慢衰减的幂律频谱结构。
AI.method: 提出K-DCT协方差模型：(1) 使用Kronecker分解分别建模色彩间协方差和空间协方差；(2) 空间协方差在DCT频域中建模，将计算复杂度从二次降至对数线性；(3) 通过学习K-DCT结构的去噪后验协方差摊销，利用预训练评分模型进行训练。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、Celeb-A、ImageNet和LSUN数据集上，该方法在FID和似然指标上均优于之前的SOTA去噪采样器，尤其在少步数采样场景下改进显著，且计算和内存开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: K-DCT协方差模型通过对自然图像统计结构的合理建模（保留非对角相关性及频域特征），能够在几乎无额外计算开销的情况下显著提升扩散模型在少步采样下的性能，为二阶信息在扩散采样中的应用提供了更有效的方案。

title: TANGO: Token-Aggregated Nonlinear Gating Operators for Natural and Formal Language Modeling
summary:
A standard Transformer block separates cross-token interaction in self-attention from a nonlinear feed-forward network applied independently at each position. We introduce the TANGO model (Token-Aggregated Nonlinear Gating Operators), which replaces these two sublayers with one cross-token gated residual update. Each source token produces a SwiGLU gate vector. Query-key similarities determine a weighted average of source gates for each destination, and the resulting gate rescales projected destination features. TANGO assigns a separate weight to every causally visible source and is quadratic in sequence length. The WANGO model (Windowed Aggregation of Nonlinear Gating Operators) retains the same unnormalized scores within a recent window and uses positive feature-map prefix statistics for older sources, giving linear sequence-length complexity for fixed window and feature dimensions.
  We compare TANGO and WANGO with Recurrent and Untied Transformer++, full-attention GAU, and FLASH. All models have approximately 44.3M nonembedding parameters and are trained in three matched runs. TANGO, WANGO, and Recurrent Transformer++ apply one shared block four times; the other architectures use four independent blocks. TANGO obtains the lowest mean validation negative log-likelihood on FineWeb-Edu, Lean, and DeepMind Mathematics, although it has the largest analytical forward-pass operation count. WANGO obtains the lowest mean FineWeb-Edu NLL among the architectures with computation linear in sequence length and outperforms Recurrent Transformer++ at nearly the same analytical forward-pass multiply-accumulate count.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TANGO和WANGO两种新架构，用跨token门控残差更新替代Transformer中自注意力与前馈网络的组合。TANGO为每个因果可见源分配独立权重（二次复杂度），WANGO结合窗口内精确得分与旧token的正向特征图前缀统计（线性复杂度）。实验显示TANGO在多个数据集上取得最低验证困惑度，WANGO在线性复杂度架构中表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer块将跨token交互（自注意力）和逐位置非线性前馈网络分离为两个子层，这种分离可能不是最优的设计。作者希望探索能否用单一操作同时完成跨token信息聚合和特征非线性变换，从而简化架构并可能提升效果。
AI.method: TANGO：每个源token生成SwiGLU门控向量，通过查询-键相似度对源门控做加权平均，所得门控向量重新缩放投影后的目标特征；每个因果可见源有独立权重，复杂度为序列长度二次方。WANGO：在近期窗口内保留相同的未归一化分数，对更早的源使用正向特征图前缀统计，固定窗口和特征维度下序列长度复杂度为线性。
AI.result: 在约44.3M非嵌入参数的匹配设置下，TANGO在FineWeb-Edu、Lean和DeepMind Mathematics上取得最低的平均验证负对数似然（尽管其前向传播操作数最多）。WANGO在线性序列长度复杂度的架构中取得最低FineWeb-Edu NLL，并在相近的MAC计算量下优于Recurrent Transformer++。
AI.conclusion: 将跨token交互与非线性格控融合为单一操作是可行的，TANGO证明了更强的表达能力（但计算代价更高），WANGO则在效率和效果之间取得了良好平衡。该工作为设计更简洁、高效的序列建模架构提供了新方向。

title: More Accurate or More Efficient? Evaluating Locally Deployed Compact Open-Weight Language Models for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed on local hardware for privacy, cost, and accessibility reasons. Yet many evaluations emphasize accuracy while fewer quantify local runtime and energy, characterize failure modes, or apply paired statistical comparisons under controlled conditions. This paper presents a controlled, documented procedure for evaluating locally hosted LLMs on mathematical reasoning. It combines fixed inference settings, hierarchical answer extraction and verification, explicit failure-mode classification, and per-question resource measurement, and reports accuracy with paired significance tests and effect sizes. We demonstrate it in a preliminary study of three compact open-weight models under five billion parameters, Gemma3:4b (Google), Phi3:3.8b (Microsoft), and Qwen3:4b (Alibaba), across datasets spanning Grade 8 Math, Calculus I, and Advanced Probability and Statistics. All models ran through the same local inference server on one workstation, using a shared prompt template, controlled settings, and a matched question set per dataset. No single model dominates. Qwen3:4b is most accurate on two datasets and Gemma3:4b on Calculus I, yet Gemma3:4b returns roughly three times more correct answers per watt-hour than Qwen3:4b on every dataset while generating far fewer output tokens; Qwen3:4b requires substantially more generation time, energy, and output per question. Phi3:3.8b is substantially less accurate on all three datasets; its low extraction-failure rate indicates incorrect answers rather than unparsed output, though we caveat possible prompt-format effects. These preliminary findings indicate that accuracy alone is an insufficient basis for selecting a local model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套受控、可复现的本地LLM数学推理评估流程，结合固定推理设置、分层答案提取与验证、显式失败模式分类及逐题资源测量，并在三个五亿参数以下的开源模型（Gemma3:4b、Phi3:3.8b、Qwen3:4b）上进行初步研究，发现没有单一模型全面占优，且准确率不足以作为选择本地模型的唯一标准。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地部署在本地硬件上，但现有评估大多强调准确率，很少量化本地运行时间和能耗、刻画失败模式，或采用受控条件下的配对统计比较。作者认为需要一种更全面的评估方法，帮助用户基于准确率以外的维度（如能效、生成开销）选择本地模型。
AI.method: 提出一个受控、文档化的评估流程，包含：固定推理设置、分层答案提取与验证、显式失败模式分类、逐题资源测量，并使用配对显著性检验和效应量报告准确率。在单个工作站上，通过同一本地推理服务器、共享提示模板和受控设置，对三个紧凑开源模型在三个数学数据集（八年级数学、微积分I、高级概率统计）上进行评估。
AI.result: 没有单一模型在所有数据集上全面占优：Qwen3:4b在两个数据集上准确率最高，Gemma3:4b在微积分I上最高。但Gemma3:4b在每个数据集上每瓦时正确回答数量约为Qwen3:4b的三倍，且生成token远少于后者；Qwen3:4b在生成时间、能耗和每问输出上显著更高。Phi3:3.8b在三个数据集上准确率明显偏低，其低提取失败率表明是答案错误而非解析失败所致。
AI.conclusion: 准确率单独不足以作为选择本地模型的依据；能效、生成开销和失败模式等维度同样关键。初步结果表明，不同模型在准确率与资源效率之间存在明显权衡，评估框架可为此类选择提供更全面的依据。

title: ProBel: Propaganda Detection with Techniques, Spans, and Explanations
summary: Propaganda detection includes several related prediction levels, ranging from sentence-level decisions to technique classification and span identification. However, it remains unclear how supervision at these levels interacts when learned jointly across Arabic and English. We present ProBel, an Arabic and English resource that aligns binary labels, multi-label annotations over 23 propaganda techniques grouped into six coarse categories, technique-labeled spans, and reference explanations for the same news sentences. It includes a substantially larger English collection and supports matched binary, coarse-grained, multi-label, and span-level tasks in both languages. We evaluate zero-shot prompting, task-specific fine-tuning, and joint training under a shared setup. A single bilingual multi-task model achieves the best overall performance and remains competitive across tasks and languages. Cross-task analysis shows that transfer depends on the supervision level. Joint classification training preserves binary performance, whereas span-only training can weaken sentence-level prediction. Joint bilingual training yields the most stable results, while monolingual fine-tuning can reduce transfer to the other language. We will release the data, code, and evaluation scripts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProBel，一个同时覆盖阿拉伯语和英语的宣传检测资源，支持二元标签、多标签技术分类、跨度识别和解释四个监督层级。实验表明单一双语多任务模型综合表现最佳，且跨任务迁移效果取决于监督层级——联合分类训练保留二元性能，而仅跨度训练会削弱句子级预测。
AI.motivation: 宣传检测涉及多个相关预测层级（句子级判定、技术分类、跨度识别），但目前尚不清楚这些层级在跨阿拉伯语和英语联合学习时如何相互影响。需要一个统一资源来系统研究监督层级间的交互。
AI.method: 构建ProBel资源，包含对齐的二元标签、23种宣传技术（归为6个粗粒度类别）的多标签标注、技术标注跨度及参考解释。在共享设置下评估零样本提示、任务专用微调和联合训练三种策略。
AI.result: 单一双语多任务模型综合表现最佳，在各任务和语言上保持竞争力。联合分类训练能保留二元性能，跨度仅训练会削弱句子级预测；联合双语训练结果最稳定，单语微调会降低向另一种语言的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 跨任务迁移效果取决于监督层级，双语联合训练优于单语微调。作者将公开发布数据、代码和评估脚本以促进该领域研究。

title: Close Shortcut Wins Long: Seeking Diverse and Stable Generators for Data-Free Knowledge Distillation
summary: Data-Free Knowledge Distillation (DFKD) preserves privacy by transferring knowledge without real data access. However, existing generator-based DFKD methods suffer from over-reliance on teacher preferences and pattern collapse, exhibiting "generative shortcut learning" in the frequency domain: dependent on specific frequency components and frequency positions, resulting in inconsistent synthetic image quality and class diversity. In this paper, we propose a CSWL framework aimed at introducing insights from the frequency domain perspective to improve generator diversity and training stability to Close the phenomenon of Shortcut learning to Win in the Longer term. To address the issue of generative shortcut learning, we introduce frequency-domain augmentation at the feature level, encouraging the generator to attend to the full frequency spectrum and thereby suppress shortcut learning behavior. To tackle training instability, we propose a Cross-Stage Frequency Reconstruction (CSFR) auxiliary task, which implicitly constructs an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) mechanism to promote long-term optimization and stability. Extensive experiments, including downstream tasks and various image recognition datasets at multiple resolutions, validate the effectiveness of CSWL in improving both diversity and stability from the frequency view.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CSWL框架，从频率域视角解决无数据知识蒸馏（DFKD）中生成器存在的"生成式捷径学习"问题（过度依赖特定频率成分和位置），通过特征层面的频率域增强和跨阶段频率重建（CSFR）辅助任务，提升合成图像的多样性和训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于生成器的DFKD方法过度依赖教师偏好且存在模式坍塌问题，在频率域表现出"生成式捷径学习"——依赖特定的频率成分和频率位置，导致合成图像质量不一致、类别多样性不足。
AI.method: 提出CSWL框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 特征层面的频率域增强，鼓励生成器关注完整频率谱，抑制捷径学习行为；(2) 跨阶段频率重建（CSFR）辅助任务，通过隐式构造指数移动平均（EMA）机制促进长期优化和训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在下游任务和多种分辨率的多类图像识别数据集上的大量实验验证了CSWL在从频率视角提升多样性和稳定性方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 从频率域角度分析并解决了DFKD中的生成式捷径学习问题，通过频率增强和CSFR辅助任务有效提升了生成器的多样性与训练稳定性。

title: The Price of Decentralization in Top-$K$ Arm Identification
summary: Cooperative teams often need to agree on the best few options rather than simply accumulate reward, and they must do so while each member sees only a fragment of the team's collective experience. We study this as top-$K$ joint-arm identification in multi-agent multi-armed bandits: at every round $M$ agents simultaneously choose individual actions that compose a joint arm, and the team must ultimately return the $K$ joint arms of highest mean reward. The difficulty is that an agent may not observe the actions of others, their rewards, or either. We treat three observability regimes---(A) shared rewards with hidden actions, (B) observed actions with private rewards, and (C) full asymmetry---and design communication-free elimination algorithms (UCB-Intervals) that reconstruct implicit coordination from whatever signal each regime leaves intact: a shared arm ordering in (A), observable deviations in (B), and enlarged confidence radii under (C). We give matching analyses in both the fixed-budget and fixed-confidence objectives, then fold all three regimes into a single meta-guarantee indexed by a multiplicity $c$ and a consensus factor $ρ$. Our central result is quantitative rather than merely algorithmic: change-of-measure lower bounds show that shared-reward identification is optimal up to one universal logarithmic factor, and that the entire statistical price of removing communication is a multiplicative $ρ^2$ in sample complexity---a fixed $4\times$ penalty under full asymmetry. The resulting stopping time scales as $O\!\left(\sum_{\mathbf{a}} \frac{\log(A^M/δ)}{Δ_{\mathbf{a}}^2}\right)$ and the fixed-budget error as $\exp(-Θ(T/H_1))$, with the dependence on the joint-action count $A^M$ shown to be unavoidable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体多臂老虎机中的top-K联合臂识别问题：M个智能体各自选择动作组成联合臂，团队需找出均值奖励最高的K个联合臂。作者设计了无通信的消除算法（UCB-Intervals），涵盖三种可观测性模式（共享奖励隐藏动作、可见动作私有奖励、完全不对称），并给出了固定预算和固定置信度两种目标下的匹配分析，以及一个统一的元保证。核心定量结论是：共享奖励识别最优（仅差一个通用对数因子），移除通信的统计代价是样本复杂度上的ρ²倍（完全不对称下为固定4倍惩罚）。
AI.motivation: 协作团队往往需要对少数最佳选项达成共识（top-K），而非简单累积奖励，且每个成员只能看到团队集体经验的一部分。已有研究主要关注单智能体或集中式场景，多智能体分布式场景下agent间无法通信、只能看到局部信息时如何进行top-K联合臂识别仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 作者提出UCB-Intervals无通信消除算法，针对三种可观测性模式分别利用各自留下的信号进行隐式协调：(A)共享奖励下利用共享的臂排序；(B)可见动作下利用可观测的偏差；(C)完全不对称下利用扩大的置信半径。通过统一参数c（多重性）和ρ（共识因子）给出统一的元保证分析，并结合变化测度下界证明最优性。
AI.result: 变化测度下界表明共享奖励识别在通用对数因子内最优；移除通信的统计代价为ρ²倍样本复杂度（完全不对称下为固定4×惩罚）。停止时间O(Σ log(A^M/δ)/Δ²)，固定预算误差为exp(-Θ(T/H₁))，且对联合动作数A^M的依赖被证明不可避免。
AI.conclusion: 本文为多智能体无通信top-K联合臂识别提供了完整的理论刻画，从算法设计、复杂度分析到最优性证明均有系统贡献，揭示了不同可观测性模式下隐式协调的机制与代价。

title: GenCoord: Skill-Path Commitments under Private Information
comment: 25 pages, 10 figures, and 23 tables, including supplementary material. Peng He and Junning Zhu contributed equally. Paper source and compact evidence: https://github.com/JulianZJN/GenCoord
summary: Suppose one embodied agent knows what must be built, while its teammate alone knows which transformation its workcell can perform. Neither local view determines who should act, what should be handed off, or how the joint task should continue. We introduce GenCoord, which turns the task consequence of such private facts into an executable skill-path commitment. A local Qwen3.5-0.8B model emits a multi-step SELF plan and peer REQ; bounded feedback conditions route revision when the deciding capability is peer-local. The resolved commitment is parsed, checked, canonically materialized, compiled to Mineflayer skills, and verified by handoff and terminal state. Counterfactual interventions that hold the world, call schedule, and executor unchanged make requester revision and receiver execution follow the injected task consequence in both directions. Across three independently trained seeds, correct capability feedback closes the paired local-information gap from 50% to 100%. Multi-step commitments improve held-out-template success by 6.9 points while reducing model decisions by 32%. At matched closed-loop quality on 128 held-out semantic clusters, Short DSL reduces peer traffic by 92.8% and median time-to-commitment by 68.2% relative to controlled free-form communication. These results identify executable task consequences as the coordination unit connecting distributed local reasoning to verified joint action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenCoord框架，通过将私有事实的任务后果转化为可执行的技能路径承诺，解决具身智能体在局部信息不对称下的协同规划问题。实验表明该方法将配对局部信息差距从50%提升至100%，并通过短DSL显著降低通信开销。
AI.motivation: 在具身多智能体协作中，一个智能体知道要构建什么，另一个智能体独自知道其工作单元能执行什么变换，双方局部视图均不足以决定谁该行动、交接什么或如何继续联合任务。这种局部信息不对称导致协同规划无法收敛。
AI.method: GenCoord使用本地Qwen3.5-0.8B模型生成多步SELF计划和同伴REQ请求；通过有界反馈条件路由在决策能力位于同伴本地时触发修订；将解析后的承诺进行校验、规范化物化、编译为Mineflayer技能，并通过交接和终端状态验证。同时引入Short DSL以减少通信开销。
AI.result: 正确的能力反馈将配对局部信息差距从50%缩小至100%；多步承诺使保留模板成功率提升6.9个点并减少32%模型决策；在128个保留语义簇上，Short DSL相对受控自由形式通信减少92.8%的同伴流量和68.2%的中位承诺时间。
AI.conclusion: 可执行的任务后果是连接分布式局部推理与已验证联合行动的协调单元，GenCoord有效解决了具身多智能体在信息不对称下的协同问题。

title: SchemaGUI: A Schema-Driven Benchmark for Controllable GUI Generation Evaluation
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, and 7 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/xdong2002/SchemaGUI
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential in graphical user interface (GUI) generation, but reliable evaluation remains challenging due to uncontrolled data distributions, noisy annotations, and limited layout scenario coverage. To address this, we propose SchemaGUI, a template-based benchmark for controllable GUI generation evaluation. By synthesizing paired natural language instructions and deterministic function-call references from parameterized interface schemas, SchemaGUI can generate thousands of deterministically annotated tasks in seconds without human labeling. Based on 1,000 evaluated instances per scenario and language across six representative bilingual scenarios, we benchmark five mainstream models, including the Qwen3.5 family, Qwen3-Coder-30B, and DeepSeek-R1. Our extensive analysis reveals three key insights. First, precise geometric spatial control remains an important bottleneck; while scaling Qwen3.5 from 4B to 27B improves Schema Feasibility from 91.56% to 99.63%, the Geometry score improves more modestly (from 67.05% to 75.30%). Second, generation difficulty is highly sensitive to layout complexity, with current LLMs excelling at simple sequential arrangements but suffering severe coordinate drift in dense grids and multi-region compositions. Third, thinking mode increases token consumption while generally reducing GUI Score, particularly for smaller models.

AI.tldr: 提出了SchemaGUI，一个基于模板的可控GUI生成评估基准。通过参数化接口模式合成自然语言指令和确定性函数调用参考，无需人工标注即可生成数千个确定性标注任务。在六个双语场景中评估五个主流模型，揭示了三项关键发现：精确几何空间控制仍是瓶颈、生成难度对布局复杂度高度敏感、思维模式会增加token消耗并降低GUI得分。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在GUI生成方面潜力巨大，但可靠评估仍面临挑战，包括不可控的数据分布、噪声标注以及有限的布局场景覆盖。需要一个可控、确定性标注的评估基准来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 通过参数化接口模式（parameterized interface schemas）合成配对的自然语言指令和确定性函数调用参考（deterministic function-call references），可在数秒内生成数千个确定性标注任务而无需人工标注。覆盖六个双语场景，每个场景评估1000个实例。
AI.result: 基准测试了Qwen3.5家族、Qwen3-Coder-30B和DeepSeek-R1等五个主流模型。发现：(1) 从4B扩展到27B，Schema Feasibility从91.56%提升至99.63%，但Geometry得分仅从67.05%提升至75.30%；(2) 当前LLM擅长简单顺序排列，但在密集网格和多区域组合中遭遇严重的坐标漂移；(3) 思维模式增加token消耗，同时普遍降低GUI得分，尤其对较小模型影响显著。
AI.conclusion: 精确的几何空间控制仍是GUI生成的重要瓶颈，布局复杂度对生成难度影响显著。思维模式在当前GUI生成任务中弊大于利。这些发现为未来GUI生成模型的设计和评估提供了重要指导。

title: ORBIT++: Benchmarking SfM in the Wild with 360° Video
comment: A revision was Accepted at CVPR 2026
summary: Structure-from-Motion (SfM) is a cornerstone of 3D perception, yet current methods often fail when applied to complex videos involving challenging camera motions or dynamic scenes. Compounding the problem, the field lacks reliable ground-truth benchmarks for such difficult scenarios, making it hard to gauge real-world progress or to pinpoint where improvements are most needed. To address this gap, we introduce a new benchmark for evaluating camera pose estimation. Our key insight is to leverage online panoramic 360° video as a source of data from which to construct challenging clips, while still enabling robust ground-truth trajectory recovery. The panoramic nature of these videos provides richer visual context for tracking camera motion, even when parts of the view are affected by blur, motion, or dynamic objects. After tracking camera motion across full 360° videos, we crop and reproject selected portions to generate perspective-view clips that serve as our benchmark, called ORBIT. Experiments show that COLMAP, as well as recent optimization-based and feed-forward SfM methods struggle to accurately estimate camera poses on our benchmark. Hence, ORBIT provides a valuable testbed where researchers can meaningfully measure progress on truly challenging, real-world SfM problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ORBIT，一个基于全景360°视频构建的相机位姿估计基准测试。通过利用全景视频丰富的视觉上下文，从真实挑战性场景中裁剪并重投影生成透视视角片段，解决了SfM领域缺乏困难场景可靠基准的问题。实验表明COLMAP及现有SfM方法在此基准上表现不佳，为研究者提供了衡量真实世界SfM进展的测试平台。
AI.motivation: 现有SfM方法在处理复杂相机运动或动态场景时经常失败，且该领域缺乏针对此类困难场景的可靠地面真值基准，导致难以评估真实世界进展或确定改进方向。
AI.method: 利用在线全景360°视频作为数据来源，通过跟踪完整360°视频中的相机运动获得稳健的地面真值轨迹，然后裁剪并重投影选定部分以生成透视视角片段，构建名为ORBIT的基准测试。
AI.result: 实验表明COLMAP以及最近基于优化的和前馈式SfM方法都难以在ORBIT基准上准确估计相机位姿，说明该基准确实包含真实世界的挑战性SfM问题。
AI.conclusion: ORBIT为研究者提供了一个有价值的测试平台，能够在真正具有挑战性的真实世界SfM问题上有意义地衡量算法进展。

title: Decoupled Physical Modeling and Execution for Physics Reasoning
summary: Physics reasoning requires constructing a consistent model of the underlying physical system rather than relying solely on symbolic or formula-based manipulation. Although large language models have shown strong ability in solving math and coding problems, they still struggle with physics problems, as these problems entangle the physical modeling process with mathematical calculations. Humans approach physics by first building a representation of the system before performing calculations. Inspired by this, we introduce a unified framework that distills intermediate representations that explicitly encode the physical modeling process and adopt a two-stage post-training strategy, where supervised fine-tuning establishes structured modeling, and reinforcement learning with rubric-based feedback improves the quality of the modeling process. Experiments on multiple multimodal physics benchmarks show that our approach leads to consistent improvements in reasoning performance across different models and datasets. On PhysReason, PhyX and SeePhys benchmarks, physical modeling output performs GRPO by an average ~3%, showing that explicit physical modeling is an efficient strategy of improving physics reasoning for small LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，通过蒸馏中间表征来显式编码物理建模过程，并采用两阶段后训练策略（SFT建立结构化建模，基于rubric的RL提升建模质量），在多模态物理基准上显著提升小LLM的物理推理性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在数学和编程问题上表现出色，但在物理问题上仍然困难，因为物理问题需要将物理建模过程与数学计算纠缠在一起。人类解决物理问题的方式是先构建系统表征再计算，而现有方法主要依赖符号或公式操作，缺乏对物理建模过程的显式建模。因此作者希望引入显式的物理建模中间表征来提升小模型的物理推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出统一框架，蒸馏中间表征以显式编码物理建模过程；2) 采用两阶段后训练策略：先通过监督微调(SFT)建立结构化建模能力，再用基于rubric反馈的强化学习(RL)优化建模过程质量。
AI.result: 在PhysReason、PhyX和SeePhys等多个多模态物理基准上，该方法在不同模型和数据集上均带来一致的推理性能提升。在PhysReason、PhyX和SeePhys上，物理建模输出相比GRPO平均提升约3%，表明显式物理建模是提升小LLM物理推理的有效策略。
AI.conclusion: 显式物理建模（先建模后计算）是一种高效提升小规模大语言模型物理推理能力的方法，通过蒸馏中间表征和两阶段后训练（SFT+基于rubric的RL），能够在多个物理基准上取得一致且显著的改进。

title: MEMORY Wins All: Indirect Bias Injection Attacks via Social Media Feeds
summary: Personal AI agents routinely consume external content while performing tasks such as web browsing, email processing, and SNS feed summarization, and they retain selected information or execution results in persistent memory for later use. We show that this ordinary ingestion of external content opens an indirect path for manipulating subsequent agent behavior. Based on this observation, we present IBIA, an Indirect Bias Injection Attack that plants an adversary-aligned stance on a specific topic into a victim agent's memory through external content, without direct access to the agent, its memory, or future user queries. For this, IBIA combines three mechanisms: comment cloaking, which keeps the crafted content consistent with the surrounding discussion, comment watermarking, which enables lightweight identification during curation, and category anchoring, which makes the retained stance salient under later related requests. We evaluate IBIA on BiasBench, a benchmark of 6,000 adversary-crafted social comments and 120 email instances. The watermark-based curation identifies 95.9% of the injected comments. Under the OpenClaw setting, IBIA achieves adversary-aligned response rates (AARs) of 91.2% on average across four downstream tasks, including 86.6% on the frontier GPT-5.5. We further propose a memory boundary defense that detects the injected bias and reduces AARs to 80.6%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IBIA（间接偏见注入攻击），证明个人AI代理在浏览网页、处理邮件等日常任务中摄取外部内容时，会通过持久记忆为攻击者提供间接操控后续行为的路径。攻击通过评论伪装、评论水印和类别锚定三种机制，在无需直接访问代理的前提下注入对抗性立场。
AI.motivation: 个人AI代理日常消费大量外部内容并存入持久记忆，但这种普通的内容摄取行为可能为攻击者提供间接操控代理后续行为的路径，而现有研究尚未充分关注这一安全漏洞。
AI.method: IBIA结合三种机制：1）评论伪装——使伪造内容与周围讨论保持一致；2）评论水印——实现策展过程中的轻量级识别；3）类别锚定——使保留的立场在后续相关请求下显著突出。在BiasBench基准（6000条对抗性社交评论和120个邮件实例）上评估。
AI.result: 基于水印的策展可识别95.9%的注入评论。在OpenClaw设置下，IBIA在四个下游任务上平均实现91.2%的对抗性对齐响应率（AAR），其中在GPT-5.5上达到86.6%。提出的记忆边界防御可将AAR降至80.6%。
AI.conclusion: 记忆中毒是个人AI代理面临的实际安全威胁，间接偏见注入攻击能有效操控代理行为。作者提出记忆边界防御作为缓解措施，但80.6%的AAR表明该防御仍然不足，需要更强的防护机制。

title: Don' t Box Me In: Dynamic Cultural Adaptation and Cognitive Tracking for Social Understanding
summary: Social interaction increasingly takes place in multicultural settings, where individuals may draw on multiple cultural influences and adapt their communicative behavior across contexts. Despite recent advances in equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with social understanding capabilities, existing approaches often model culture as a static demographic attribute, limiting their ability to accommodate hybrid and dynamically expressed communicative preferences. Therefore, in this paper, we propose \textbf{DyCAC}, a training-free framework that achieves fluid social alignment by incorporating \underline{Dy}namic \underline{C}ultural \underline{A}daptation with continuous \underline{C}ognitive tracking. Rather than inferring a fixed cultural identity, DyCAC models culturally relevant communicative preferences as a time-varying mixture of population-level cultural reference profiles. This reference-based representation is further calibrated using dialogue-style signals observed in the ongoing interaction, enabling the model to capture both composite cultural influences and turn-level shifts in communicative behavior. In parallel, a memory module driven by Theory of Mind (ToM) continuously tracks the cognitive states of the interlocutor. Extensive experiments on interactive social and cultural benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our approach. The proposed framework outperforms existing baselines, exhibiting enhanced social intelligence and broad adaptability across varied multicultural contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DyCAC框架，一种无需训练的社交对齐方法，通过动态文化适应与连续认知追踪，将文化建模为随时间变化的混合文化参考画像，并利用对话风格信号校准，配合基于心智理论的记忆模块追踪对话者认知状态，在交互式社交与文化基准上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM的社交理解方法将文化视为静态的人口统计学属性，无法处理多元文化背景下混合的、动态表达的交际偏好。多文化场景中个体可能受多种文化影响并随情境调整交际行为，需要更灵活的建模方式。
AI.method: DyCAC采用双模块设计：(1) 动态文化适应——将文化相关交际偏好建模为随时间变化的群体级文化参考画像的混合，并利用对话中的风格信号进行校准，以捕捉复合文化影响和逐轮行为变化；(2) 连续认知追踪——基于心智理论(ToM)的记忆模块持续追踪对话者的认知状态。整体为训练-free框架。
AI.result: 在交互式社交和文化基准上的实验表明，DyCAC优于现有基线方法，展现出更强的社交智能和在多样跨文化情境中的广泛适应性。
AI.conclusion: 将文化从静态属性转变为动态混合表示，并结合认知状态追踪，能够更有效地实现LLM在多元文化社会交互中的灵活对齐，为跨文化社交智能提供了新思路。

title: Robust Global Structure-from-Motion via View Graph Pruning
summary: Structure-from-Motion (SfM) aims to estimate camera poses and reconstruct 3D structures from a collection of unordered images. Compared with incremental SfM, global SfM achieves better scalability by jointly estimating camera poses based on a view graph constructed from pairwise correspondences. However, its performance is highly sensitive to erroneous edges caused by visually ambiguous matches, which may lead to incorrect camera registration and reconstruction artifacts. In this work, we propose a subgraph-guided view graph pruning framework for robust global SfM. Our key idea is to exploit the internal consistency of reliable subgraphs to identify and remove unreliable connections. Specifically, we first partition the view graph into locally consistent subgraphs and perform global SfM within each subgraph to obtain reliable camera poses. We then apply RANSAC-based edge pruning across subgraphs to remove inconsistent edges, and finally perform global SfM on the refined view graph. Extensive experiments on ambiguous, sequential, and unordered image datasets demonstrate that our method improves the robustness of global SfM under challenging conditions. Further evaluation with neural rendering shows that the improved camera estimation leads to higher-quality novel view synthesis results.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于子图引导的视图图剪枝框架，用于鲁棒的全局运动恢复结构（SfM）。通过将视图图划分为局部一致的子图，在子图内执行全局SfM获得可靠相机位姿，再利用RANSAC跨子图剪除不一致边，最后在精炼后的视图图上执行全局SfM。实验表明该方法在模糊、序列和无序图像数据集上均提升了全局SfM的鲁棒性，并改善了神经渲染的新视角合成质量。
AI.motivation: 全局SfM相比增量SfM具有更好的可扩展性，但其性能对视觉模糊匹配产生的错误边高度敏感，这些错误边可能导致相机注册错误和重建伪影。因此需要一种鲁棒的方法来识别并移除不可靠的连接。
AI.method: 1) 将视图图划分为局部一致的子图；2) 在每个子图内执行全局SfM获得可靠相机位姿；3) 利用RANSAC在子图间进行边剪枝，移除不一致的边；4) 在精炼后的视图图上执行全局SfM。
AI.result: 在模糊、序列和无序图像数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法提升了全局SfM在挑战性条件下的鲁棒性；进一步的神经渲染评估显示，改进的相机估计带来了更高质量的新视角合成结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的子图引导视图图剪枝框架能够有效利用可靠子图的内部一致性来识别和移除不可靠连接，从而提升全局SfM的鲁棒性，并间接改善下游神经渲染任务的质量。

title: Who Should Teach? Confidence-Aware Dual-Teacher Learning for Few-Shot Node Classification on Text-Attributed Graphs
summary: Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs) integrate graph structures and node-associated textual attributes, and recent studies have increasingly leveraged Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve TAG learning in few-shot settings. However, existing approaches typically utilize LLM-derived information uniformly across all nodes, despite substantial variations in its reliability, while also incurring considerable monetary costs. We argue that the most appropriate source of supervision may differ across nodes, as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and LLMs exhibit complementary strengths in exploiting structural and semantic information, respectively. To this end, we propose CoTeach, a Confidence-aware dual-teacher learning framework that dynamically selects the more reliable teacher for each node. Experimental results demonstrate that CoTeach consistently improves few-shot node classification performance while reducing unnecessary LLM utilization and associated monetary costs.

AI.tldr: 提出了CoTeach框架，一个置信度感知的双教师学习框架，动态为每个节点选择更可靠的教师（GNN或LLM），在少样本节点分类任务中提升性能的同时降低LLM使用成本和开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的TAG学习方法在所有节点上统一使用LLM信息，但LLM信息的可靠性在不同节点间差异很大，同时使用LLM会带来高昂的金钱开销。GNN和LLM在结构信息和语义信息上具有互补优势，因此最合适的监督来源应因节点而异。
AI.method: 提出CoTeach框架，采用置信度感知的双教师（dual-teacher）学习机制，动态地为每个节点选择更可靠的教师（GNN或LLM）作为监督来源，从而在结构信息和语义信息之间进行自适应权衡。
AI.result: 实验结果表明CoTeach在少样本节点分类任务上持续提升性能，同时减少了不必要的LLM使用和相关金钱成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态节点级别的教师选择，可以在利用LLM语义优势的同时避免不必要的LLM调用，实现性能与成本的更好平衡。

title: Search Broadly, Seek Evidence on Both Sides, Decide Narrowly: Evidence-Admissible GraphRAG for Longitudinal Clinical Event Verification
summary:
Longitudinal clinical event-relation verification determines whether a patient record supports a specified relation among two or more clinical events. This task is challenging because evidence is distributed across structured records, notes, laboratory trajectories, encounters, and time, while negation, temporal mismatch, repeated documentation, and conflicting findings can make retrieved information appear relevant without establishing the relation.
  We present MedEventGraph-RAG, an evidence-admissible framework that represents event occurrences in a patient-specific graph and links each occurrence to source evidence, including structured rows, note spans, timestamps, and numerical trajectories. Given a verification query specifying events, relation, and clinical scope, the graph guides discovery of candidate event chains and retrieves evidence from both supporting and contradicting sides. A query-specific evidence contract filters information by patient identity, scope, occurrence binding, and source traceability before a separate assessor determines supported, conflicting, refuted, or insufficient outcomes.
  Across ten protocols on i2b2, n2c2, MIMIC-IV, and LUNGUAGE, MedEventGraph-RAG achieves balanced accuracies of 78.6, 67.3, and 96.8 on temporal, medication-adverse-event, and recorded-order verification, improving over the strongest matched baselines by 26.9, 4.9, and 30.4 points. Under evidence masking, it reaches 92.2 balanced accuracy with no false-support predictions. When intermediate events are hidden, it recovers complete source-traceable event chains in 57.9% of i2b2 and 70.0% of LUNGUAGE cases. These results show that separating broad evidence discovery from narrow evidence-admissible assessment improves longitudinal clinical verification and reduces unsupported conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedEventGraph-RAG，一个基于患者特定事件图谱的纵向临床事件关系验证框架，将事件发现与证据评估分离，在多个临床数据集上显著提升验证准确率并减少无依据结论。
AI.motivation: 纵向临床事件关系验证具有挑战性，因为证据分散在结构化记录、笔记、实验室轨迹、就诊和时间中，且否定表达、时间不匹配、重复记录和矛盾发现会使检索到的信息看似相关但实际无法建立关系，导致模型容易产生虚假或无依据的结论。
AI.method: MedEventGraph-RAG首先构建患者特定的事件图谱，将每个事件发生链接到来源证据（结构化行、笔记片段、时间戳、数值轨迹）。验证查询指定事件、关系和临床范围后，图谱引导发现候选事件链并从支持和矛盾两侧检索证据。查询特定的证据合约会按患者身份、范围、事件绑定和来源可追溯性过滤信息，最后由独立的评估器判定支持、冲突、否定或证据不足四种结果。
AI.result: 在i2b2、n2c2、MIMIC-IV和LUNGUAGE十个协议上，MedEventGraph-RAG在时间验证、药物不良事件验证和记录顺序验证上分别达到78.6、67.3和96.8的平衡准确率，超过最强匹配基线26.9、4.9和30.4个百分点。证据屏蔽下达到92.2平衡准确率且零虚假支持预测。中间事件隐藏时在57.9%（i2b2）和70.0%（LUNGUAGE）案例中恢复完整可追溯事件链。
AI.conclusion: 将广泛的证据发现与狭窄的证据可采纳评估分离，能够有效改善纵向临床验证并减少无依据结论的产生。

title: Rank Reversal in Multilingual LLM Judges: A Label-Free Double-Centering Calibrator
summary: Multilingual LLM judges produce different evaluator-backbone rankings depending on the prompt language: on an eight-language Agent-as-a-Judge benchmark, the top-ranked backbone alternates across English, Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Spanish, Turkish, and Swahili, and 7 of 15 backbone pairs show statistically significant pairwise rank reversal. We treat this as a measurement problem. The multilingual judge score decomposes additively into task difficulty, backbone skill, and a language-backbone interaction term, the last of which is recoverable without human labels by double-centering the cell-mean score matrix. We make this estimator (\textbf{Consensus-Based Calibration}, CBC) explicit, give an $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ finite-sample concentration bound with variance constant $(1-\tfrac{1}{m})(1-\tfrac{1}{k})$, and show that it is unbiased even when task-language interactions are present. Across 7{,}920 judge runs (6 backbones, 8 languages, 55 tasks, 3 frameworks), CBC raises held-out cross-task rank consistency $τ$ from 0.650 to 0.902 and agrees with the held-out additive-model oracle in 100\% of per-language decisions versus 68.5\% raw; these are consistency diagnostics, not human-grounded correctness measures. On a separately collected M-RewardBench panel (7 languages, 1{,}500 items per language, 10{,}500 language-item instances, 5 evaluators), panel agreement with the public human gold preferences rises from 68.7\% to 76.6\% (gain 7.9 percentage points, 95\% CI $[6.0, 9.9]$), our strongest external evidence of downstream usefulness. The estimator is the standard two-way ANOVA interaction-recovery operation under sum-to-zero contrasts; our contribution is its application as a label-free post-hoc calibrator for multilingual LLM judges, an explicit finite-sample concentration bound, and an unbiasedness result that holds even under task-language misspecification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"基于共识的校准"(CBC)的无标签后验校准方法，用于修正多语言LLM评测器在不同提示语言下产生的排名不一致问题。该方法通过双重中心化操作从评分矩阵中分解出语言-骨干交互项，并在7920次评测运行中将跨任务排名一致性从0.650提升至0.902，在M-RewardBench面板上使人类偏好一致性从68.7%提升至76.6%。CBC本质上是双因素方差分析的交互项恢复操作，具备有限样本浓度界和无偏性保证。
AI.motivation: 多语言LLM评测器在不同提示语言下会产生不同的评测骨干排名，8种语言中排名最高的骨干各不相同，且15对骨干中有7对出现显著的统计排名反转。作者将此视为测量问题而非方法论问题，希望从多语言评测得分中分离出语言这一混淆因素带来的系统性偏差。
AI.method: 将多语言评测得分加性分解为任务难度、骨干能力和语言-骨干交互项三部分。交互项无需人工标注、通过对单元均值得分矩阵进行双重中心化即可恢复。该估计器(即CBC)利用标准双向ANOVA交互恢复操作（求和为零约束），给出了O(1/√n)的有限样本浓度界，方差常数为(1-1/m)(1-1/k)，并且在存在任务-语言交互时仍然无偏。
AI.result: 在7920次评测运行（6个骨干、8种语言、55个任务、3个框架）中，CBC将留出跨任务排名一致性τ从0.650提升至0.902，与加性模型oracle在每语言决策中100%一致（原始为68.5%）。在M-RewardBench面板（7种语言、每语言1500项、10500个语言-项目实例、5个评测器）上，与人类黄金偏好的面板一致性从68.7%提升至76.6%（提升7.9个百分点，95% CI [6.0, 9.9]）。
AI.conclusion: CBC作为无标签的后验校准器，能有效消除多语言LLM评测中的语言-骨干交互偏差。贡献在于：将该标准统计操作应用于多语言评测校准这一新场景，提供了显式有限样本浓度界，并证明了即使在任务-语言错误设定下依然无偏。同时作者谨慎指出，一致性指标属于诊断性质，并非基于人类正确性的度量，而M-RewardBench上的提升是最强的外部证据。

title: Competitive Memory Readout for Robust Video Object Segmentation: 2nd Place Technical Report for the MOSEv2 Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge
summary: We present our solution for the MOSEv2 track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge at ECCV 2026. The challenge evaluates robust video object segmentation under complex temporal dynamics, including long-term occlusion, disappearance and reappearance, large appearance changes, and strong interference from visually similar objects. Our method builds on SAM~3 and focuses on its memory readout. Standard target-only memory retrieval can confuse the annotated target with same-class non-target objects because such distractors are represented only implicitly as background. Our method introduces Competitive Memory Readout, which explicitly incorporates same-class competitor evidence when retrieving target information from memory. To prevent excessive suppression of weak or reappearing targets, we further apply a lightweight adaptive restoration rule after competition. The resulting system retains the original SAM~3 tracking pipeline while improving target identity preservation in challenging videos. Our submission achieves 66.20 on the primary challenge score and ranks 2nd in the MOSEv2 track.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了用于ECCV 2026 LSVOS挑战赛MOSEv2赛道的解决方案，基于SAM 3构建，通过引入"竞争性记忆读取"（Competitive Memory Readout）机制，显式整合同类竞争对手的证据来提升目标身份保持能力，最终以66.20的主挑战分数排名第二。
AI.motivation: 标准的目标记忆检索仅返回目标信息，但在视频中存在与目标外观相似的同类干扰物时，这些干扰物仅被隐式表示为背景，容易导致目标与干扰物混淆。这一问题在长时遮挡、消失重现、外观大变化等复杂时序动态下尤为突出。
AI.method: 1) 在SAM 3的记忆读取阶段提出Competitive Memory Readout，显式纳入同类竞争目标的证据进行目标信息检索。2) 为防止对弱目标或重现目标的过度抑制，在竞争机制后应用轻量级的自适应恢复规则（adaptive restoration rule）。整体保留SAM 3原有的跟踪流水线。
AI.result: 在MOSEv2赛道取得66.20的主挑战分数，排名第2。方法有效提升了挑战性视频中的目标身份保持能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模同类干扰物的竞争信息，并辅以自适应恢复机制，可以在不改变原有跟踪框架的前提下显著增强视频目标分割的鲁棒性。

title: Blockwise Stabilized Adaptive Cubic Regularization with Subsolvers via Recurrence
summary: Cubic-regularized Newton methods have the optimal $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3/2})$ global rate and an automatic saddle-escape mechanism, but their subproblem is most often solved by a full eigendecomposition, limiting feasible model size. We introduce a blockwise optimizer that partitions parameters by tensor, minimizes an independent cubic model with an adaptive cubic constant $M_b$ per block, and accepts or rejects each block step against a monotone guard on the full loss. The subproblem solver is chosen by block size: small blocks use lazy exact cubic steps from explicitly formed per-block Hessians; arbitrarily large tensors use a matrix-free Chebyshev-bounded Krylov subspace built by the Lanczos process. The cubic shift bounds the required polynomial degree whenever the gradient-driven shift dominates negative curvature, renders the shifted operator positive semidefinite before any polynomial is applied, and preserves the $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3/2})$ rate under inexact subproblem solves. We prove these claims, and the blockwise scheme carries a monotone per-block descent guarantee. Experiments cover FINER INRs (about 199k parameters) and a 91.4M-parameter ViSIR INR, where the blockwise cubic step remains exact in the cubic-model sense on every block, including the 88.5M-parameter decoder tensor (97\% of the model). Run to full convergence on FINER, the ARC-$\varphi_1$ optimizer reaches 133.5 dB PSNR while tuned Adam plateaus at 78.2 dB at the same extended budget; in the roughly 70 minutes Adam takes to reach its peak, ARC-$\varphi_1$ reaches 95.6 dB. A companion report isolates the loss-landscape features responsible for Adam's behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARC-φ1，一种分块三次正则化牛顿优化器，按张量划分参数，每块使用自适应三次常数和独立的立方子问题求解器。小块用显式精确立方步，大张量用矩阵无关的Chebyshev有界Krylov子空间。该方法保持O(ε^{-3/2})全局收敛率，在FINER（199k参数）上达到133.5 dB PSNR（Adam仅78.2 dB），并成功应用于91.4M参数的ViSIR INR，其中88.5M参数的解码器张量仍保持精确立方步。
AI.motivation: 三次正则化牛顿方法具有最优的O(ε^{-3/2})全局收敛率和自动鞍点逃逸机制，但其子问题求解通常依赖完整的特征分解，严重限制了可处理的模型规模。作者旨在突破这一瓶颈，使三次正则化方法能够扩展到现代大规模深度学习模型。
AI.method: 将参数按张量分块，每块独立最小化带自适应三次常数M_b的立方模型，并通过对全损失设置单调保护门来控制每块步的接受/拒绝。子问题求解器按块大小选择：小块使用显式逐块Hessian的懒精确立方步；任意大规模张量使用基于Lanczos过程的矩阵无关Chebyshev有界Krylov子空间。三次移位在有界梯度驱动位移占主导时保证算子半正定，且允许非精确求解时仍保持全局收敛率。
AI.result: 在FINER（约199k参数）上，ARC-φ1收敛至133.5 dB PSNR，而Adam在同等扩展预算下仅达78.2 dB。在Adam约70分钟达到峰值的时间内，ARC-φ1已达到95.6 dB。在91.4M参数的ViSIR INR上，包括占模型97%的88.5M参数解码器张量在内，所有块的立方步在立方模型意义下均保持精确。
AI.conclusion: 分块三次正则化策略有效解决了大规模场景下三次牛顿方法的子问题求解瓶颈，在不牺牲理论收敛率的前提下实现对巨大参数张量的精确立方步优化，并在隐式神经表示任务上显著超越Adam优化器。

title: From SQL Generation to Tool Selection: A Domain-Oriented Pattern for MCP Servers
summary: Agents built on Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly reach enterprise data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and many MCP database servers maximize flexibility by exposing a single generic SQL execution tool. This paper proposes the Domain-Oriented Tooling Pattern: instead of generating SQL at query time, the model selects from a small set of domain-aligned tools whose parameterized queries encapsulate schema navigation, joins and business rules on the server side. We formalize the pattern around three architectural invariants and introduce Model Demotion, the observation that replacing SQL synthesis with intent classification lowers the model tier required to serve routine requests. As a reference implementation we present MCP Blueprint, an open-source framework in which domain tools are defined declaratively as YAML metadata plus external parameterized SQL files. We evaluate the pattern with a public reproducibility benchmark comparing three MCP server designs - raw SQL execution, a thin generic tool pack, and a verticalized domain pack - on four local models (3B-8B) across seventeen customer-facing tasks over the Sakila database (609 completed cells; temperature 0; three repetitions per cell). The verticalized pack reaches a pooled mean score of 0.939 versus 0.666 for raw SQL and 0.605 for the generic pack; the smallest model improves from 0.583 to 0.929, matching or exceeding every larger configuration while cutting cost per correct answer by an order of magnitude. All harness code, prompts, gold answers, frozen packs and per-cell results are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向领域的工具模式（Domain-Oriented Tooling Pattern），通过让LLM从预定义的领域对齐工具中选择而非直接生成SQL，大幅提升MCP数据库服务器的性能。参考实现MCP Blueprint在Sakila基准上将平均分从0.666提升至0.939，最小模型（3B）也能匹配或超越更大模型，同时将每次正确答案的成本降低一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的Agent通过MCP访问企业数据时，许多数据库服务器过度追求灵活性而暴露单一的通用SQL执行工具。这种设计迫使模型在查询时直接生成SQL，导致小模型性能差、错误率高、成本高昂。作者希望探索一种替代架构，将领域知识和查询逻辑封装在服务端，降低对模型推理能力的要求。
AI.method: 提出Domain-Oriented Tooling Pattern，包含三个架构不变量：模型仅从少量领域对齐工具中选择、参数化查询在服务端封装导航/连接/业务规则、将SQL合成降级为意图分类（Model Demotion）。参考实现MCP Blueprint通过YAML元数据加外部参数化SQL文件声明式定义领域工具。评估对比三种MCP服务器设计（raw SQL、通用工具包、垂直领域工具包），在4个本地模型（3B-8B）和17个任务上测试。
AI.result: 垂直化领域工具包在Sakila数据库上达到0.939的池化平均分，远超raw SQL（0.666）和通用工具包（0.605）。最小的3B模型从0.583提升至0.929，匹配或超过所有更大配置，同时每次正确答案的成本降低一个数量级。共完成609个评测单元，温度设为0，每个单元重复三次。
AI.conclusion: 将SQL合成替换为意图分类可以显著降低部署MCP数据库服务器所需的模型规模，小模型在领域工具模式下即可达到甚至超越大模型在直接SQL生成下的表现。该模式为构建高效、低成本的企业数据Agent提供了一条可行的架构路径，且所有代码、提示词、基准答案和结果均已公开，便于复现。

title: Aligned Alone, Misaligned Together: Forecasting Adversarial Capture in LLM Agent Populations
summary: The unit of AI safety evaluation is still the individual model, yet language-model agents are increasingly deployed in interacting populations that read and write one another's decisions. This raises a question no single-agent audit can answer: an agent that is well-calibrated on its own may still be pulled toward a different decision by the agents around it. We study this on a security-triage task, where populations of language-model monitors decide whether to escalate or dismiss alerts, and into which we can inject a committed minority that always pushes one way. We find that two alerts a single agent judges almost identically on its own can drive collective behavior far apart, so auditing any one member need not reveal what the population will do. Yet that collective behavior can be predicted in advance. From a population's benign, adversary-free operation alone, we calibrate a response function that forecasts, before any attack is run, how far a committed minority will later move it. We then ask what shifts the outcome and find that letting agents see each other's reasoning neutralizes a weak attack, while only delaying it against a strong one, turning the question from whether the population converges on the adversaries' choice into when. Finally, we exclude the hypothesis of capture being an irreversible trap: once the committed agents are removed, the population drifts back toward where it began, so capture is a temporary state. Alignment in isolation is not alignment in a population, yet what a population will do under attack can be read in advance, from how it behaves before any adversary arrives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型智能体群体（而非单个模型）在安全评估中的行为。在安全分流任务中，向智能体群体注入坚持单方向决策的少数派，发现群体行为可被少数派偏移，且这种集体偏移可在对抗发生前从良性运行中预测出来。共享推理可中和弱攻击、延迟强攻击；移除攻击者后群体可恢复，说明捕获是暂时状态。
AI.motivation: 当前AI安全评估以单个模型为单位，但实际部署中语言模型智能体以群体互动形式运行，会互相读取和影响彼此的决策。单个智能体校准良好并不能保证群体行为正确，因为没有单一智能体的审计能回答"群体被周围智能体拉向不同决策"这一问题。
AI.method: 在安全分流任务中构建语言模型监控者群体，用于决定是否升级或驳回警报。注入坚持单方向的少数派（committed minority），观察群体行为变化。从群体的良性、无对抗运行数据中校准响应函数（response function），预测该函数在对抗发生前能预测少数派将如何移动群体行为。通过对比实验检验共享推理（看到彼此推理）对强弱攻击的影响，并测试移除攻击者后群体的恢复情况。
AI.result: （1）单个智能体判断几乎相同的两条警报，在群体中会导致截然不同的集体行为，审计任一成员无法揭示群体行为；（2）群体集体行为可提前预测——从良性运行中校准的响应函数能在攻击前预测少数派造成的偏移；（3）共享推理能中和弱攻击，但对强攻击只能延迟其效果，将问题从"是否收敛"变为"何时收敛"；（4）捕获不是不可逆陷阱——移除已承诺的智能体后，群体漂移回初始状态，捕获是暂时状态。
AI.conclusion: 在孤立环境中对齐不等于在群体中对齐，但群体在攻击下的行为可以从其在任何对手出现前的行为中提前解读。这挑战了单智能体审计范式，提示安全评估需要转向群体层面的预测与防御。

title: ADMIL: Attention-Distilled Multiple Instance Learning for Selective Foundation Model Inference in Pathology
summary: Attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) using pathology foundation model embeddings is effective for slide-level tasks, but exhaustive inference requires applying a large image encoder to every foreground tile despite the subsequent attention distribution often concentrating over a small subset of informative regions. We introduce ADMIL (Attention-Distilled Multiple Instance Learning), a selective-compute framework that distills an ABMIL teacher's attention into a lightweight tile-selection model, PriorNet. Using an EfficientNet architecture, PriorNet learns the teacher attention distribution from raw tile pixels with KL divergence; at inference, it scores the foreground pool, selects the top-K tiles, and invokes the expensive foundation model only on that subset before a selected-bag ABMIL student predicts the slide label. Across BRACS, PANDA, and CAMELYON16, ADMIL matches full-teacher headline performance at K=4, 8, and 128 tiles, respectively, avoiding >98% of foundation model (Virchow2) tile embeddings and model inference FLOPs. Random and teacher-attention oracle controls show that this result depends on task-relevant selection rather than tile-count reduction alone. Quantitative and qualitative analyses suggest that PriorNet recovers the teacher's tile ordering with high fidelity while focusing on task-relevant morphological regions. ADMIL shows that nearly all expensive tile encodings can be removed without sacrificing slide-level performance, providing a potential path for more efficient deployment in clinical settings where latency and compute costs are key considerations.

AI.tldr: ADMIL是一个选择性计算框架，通过将ABMIL教师的注意力分布蒸馏到轻量级的PriorNet模型中，在推理时仅对少量关键瓦片调用昂贵的基础模型编码器，在BRACS、PANDA和CAMELYON16数据集上以极少的瓦片数（K=4,8,128）匹配全教师性能，避免超过98%的基础模型瓦片嵌入和推理FLOPs，同时保持滑级分类性能不变。
AI.motivation: ABMIL全量推理需要对每个前景瓦片应用大型病理基础模型图像编码器，计算开销巨大。然而注意力分布往往集中于少量信息区域，大部分昂贵编码是冗余的，在临床延迟和计算成本敏感的部署场景中亟需高效方案。
AI.method: ADMIL包含两个阶段：1) 蒸馏阶段——用KL散度让轻量级EfficientNet架构的PriorNet从原始瓦片像素学习ABMIL教师的注意力分布；2) 推理阶段——PriorNet先对前景池打分并选出top-K瓦片，仅对子集调用昂贵的基础模型，再由选袋ABMIL学生模型预测滑级标签。
AI.result: 在BRACS、PANDA和CAMELYON16上，ADMIL分别以K=4、8、128个瓦片匹配全教师性能，避免超过98%的Virchow2瓦片嵌入和模型推理FLOPs。随机和教师注意力oracle对照实验表明性能依赖任务相关选择而非单纯减少瓦片数量。定量和定性分析显示PriorNet能高保真恢复教师的瓦片排序并聚焦任务相关形态区域。
AI.conclusion: ADMIL证明几乎所有昂贵的瓦片编码都可以在不牺牲滑级性能的情况下被移除，为延迟和计算成本关键的临床部署提供了高效路径。

title: Learning Reduced-Order Dynamics with Singularity via Latent-Augmented Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
summary: This paper addresses the issue of self-intersecting trajectories (in phase space) in industrial reduced-order modeling and proposes the Latent-Augmented Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (LA-NODEs) framework. From the perspective of artificial intelligence, the proposed method augments conventional neural ordinary differential equations to enhance model expressiveness, enabling the representation of conflicting vector fields that may arise in reduced-order systems, thereby improving learning accuracy. Through theoretical analysis, the underlying mechanism of the framework is established, and a condition for determining the minimum required augmentation dimension is derived. From the perspective of engineering applications, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated on the reduced-order system of two representative industrial models, namely an interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) drive and a distributed energy system (DES). Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can recover system features that are difficult to capture using conventional approaches and achieve superior performance in terms of prediction accuracy and modeling fidelity, thereby providing an effective approach for high-precision data-driven modeling of complex industrial systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为潜在增强神经常微分方程（LA-NODEs）的框架，用于解决工业降阶建模中相空间轨迹自相交的问题。该方法通过增强传统神经ODEs的表达能力来表征降阶系统中可能出现的冲突向量场，并通过理论分析推导了最小增强维度的条件。在永磁同步电机驱动和分布式能源系统两个工业模型上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 工业降阶建模中存在相空间轨迹自相交的问题，导致传统神经常微分方程难以准确建模。降阶系统中可能出现相互冲突的向量场，限制了传统方法的表达能力和学习精度，因此需要一种能够处理这类情况的新框架。
AI.method: 提出潜在增强神经常微分方程（LA-NODEs）框架：通过增强传统神经ODEs的维度来提升模型表达能力，使其能够表征降阶系统中冲突的向量场；同时进行理论分析，推导出确定最小所需增强维度的条件。
AI.result: 在永磁同步电机（IPMSM）驱动系统和分布式能源系统（DES）两个代表性工业模型的降阶系统上验证了有效性。实验表明该方法能够恢复传统方法难以捕捉的系统特征，在预测精度和建模保真度方面表现优异。
AI.conclusion: LA-NODEs为复杂工业系统的高精度数据驱动建模提供了一种有效方法，既能从AI角度增强模型表达力并给出理论保障，又能从工程角度在真实工业模型上取得优于传统方法的性能。

title: Decision-Support and Modeling with Large Language Models for Geothermal Well Arrays
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Presented at the 50th Workshop on Geothermal Reservoir Engineering, Stanford University, February 10-12, 2025
summary: Geothermal well arrays, which organize multiple geothermal wells into carefully planned geometric configurations, provide opportunities to enhance energy production capacity and increase fault tolerance. The development and adoption of these emerging geothermal technologies could be accelerated through the recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and high-level high-performance languages. A challenge in LLM-based applications is the reliability of the generated outputs, as they can be prone to subjective biases and hallucinations. This study assesses the potential of cutting-edge LLMs - such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, and domain-specific models like AskGDR - as expert assistants that can synthesize insightful interpretations of complex geothermal data, as well as improve feature capabilities of geothermal models and numerical software. We developed a novel approach, leveraging Google's recently introduced AI assistant, NotebookLM, to accelerate the generation of unpublished quantitative geothermal benchmarks. The rapid generation of these evaluation instruments is essential for assessing the swiftly evolving capabilities of emerging language model technologies. In particular, we use these benchmarks and LLM-based interviews to analyze opportunities and limitations of two promising technologies: geothermal well arrays and closed-loop coaxial wells. Furthermore, we present a case study illustrating how LLMs can facilitate auto-parallelization of geothermal numerical models. Our analysis emphasizes their application in digital twins and underscores the importance of high-level, high-performance code generation. This line of research could play a transformative role in the geothermal sector by enabling the next-generation of decision-support applications, integrating data analysis, informed recommendations, and more dynamic numerical modeling workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了最新大型语言模型（如ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Grok及领域专用模型AskGDR）作为地热领域专家助手的潜力，并利用Google的NotebookLM快速生成未公开的定量地热基准测试，以分析地热井阵列和同轴闭式井两种技术的机遇与局限，同时展示LLM在地热数值模型自动并行化中的应用案例。
AI.motivation: 地热井阵列技术通过精心规划的几何配置可提升产能和容错能力，但其发展受限于传统开发方式。LLM输出的可靠性问题（主观偏见和幻觉）是应用中的关键挑战，需要系统评估其在地热领域的能力。
AI.method: 提出一种利用Google NotebookLM加速生成未公开定量地热基准测试的新方法，结合LLM访谈方式，评估多种通用及领域专用LLM的能力，并通过案例研究展示LLM辅助地热数值模型的自动并行化。
AI.result: 通过快速生成的基准测试和LLM访谈，分析了地热井阵列与同轴闭式井技术的机遇和局限性，并展示了LLM在地热数值模型自动并行化方面的可行性，强调了其在数字孪生和高级高性能代码生成中的应用前景。
AI.conclusion: LLM与高级高性能语言的结合有望在地热领域发挥变革性作用，推动下一代决策支持应用的开发，将数据分析、智能建议和更动态的数值建模工作流整合在一起。

title: Figurative Justice: Detecting metaphors in Hindi judgements with qualitative assessment and transformers
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Dataset available at https://osf.io/z398e/
summary:
Metaphors are figurative use of words for conceptual mapping. Metaphor detection in the legal context has been crucial as metaphors are persuasive juridical means of creating legal meaning and concepts resulting in significant consequences. Metaphorical framing in legal discourse by judges, lawyers, and legislators brings about real-time implications upon individuals and influences judicial decision-making, argumentation and interpretation of laws. This is crucial in Human Rights infringement cases where language determines severity of punishment, public perception and judicial outcomes.
  While automatic metaphor detection in major languages like English, Spanish, Polish, Lithuanian have aided in understanding inherent intentions of metaphorical use of language, there is no such attempt in low-resource languages like Hindi. The dearth of annotated legal corpora in Hindi makes it difficult to develop NLP models and detect metaphors in judicial proceedings. In the Indian context, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have been used for classification of bail judgements, however there are no existing models designed for metaphor detection.
  We present a Hindi Legal Metaphor Corpus (HiLeMe) by isolating judgements from Hindi Legal Data Corpus (HLDC). Legal experts annotated HiLeMe to classify metaphorical constructions using the MIPVU schema. We downstreamed an mBERT on Hindi legal metaphor detection task. We built a transformer-based architecture for metaphor detection that are known to outperform traditional models in legal classification tasks. This model provides insights into the judicial psyche for decoding judicial decisions. Our research contributes to advancing automated models in legal discourse in low-resource languages like Hindi and envisages adoption into 22 Indian schedule languages.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个印地语法律隐喻语料库（HiLeMe），从HLDC中提取判决书并由法律专家使用MIPVU标注隐喻构造，随后在mBERT上微调用于印地语法律隐喻检测任务，为低资源语言的法律语篇自动化分析提供了新范式。
AI.motivation: 隐喻在法律语篇中对司法决策、法律解释和判决结果具有重要影响，尤其在人权侵犯案件中。虽然英语、西班牙语等主要语言已有自动隐喻检测模型，但印地语等低资源语言缺乏标注法律语料库，导致无法开发NLP模型进行隐喻检测。
AI.method: 从Hindi Legal Data Corpus (HLDC)中提取判决书构建印地语法律隐喻语料库（HiLeMe），由法律专家使用MIPVU模式进行隐喻构造标注，并在mBERT上进行微调，构建基于transformer架构的隐喻检测模型。
AI.result: 成功构建了HiLeMe语料库并开发了基于mBERT的印地语法律隐喻检测模型，该模型能提供对司法心理的洞察，有助于解码司法决策过程。
AI.conclusion: 该研究推进了低资源语言（如印地语）法律语篇的自动化模型发展，并设想将该方法推广至印度的22种官方语言。

title: Spiking Neural Networks for Energy-Efficient Object Detection in Forward-Looking Sonar Imagery
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) are increasingly important tools in industries ranging from research, to energy, to defense. AUVs are power-constrained platforms operating in remote environments with fixed battery capacities, where propulsion competes with compute and sensors for power over lengthy mission durations. AUVs frequently operate in dark or turbid waters where optical sensing is of limited value, and rely on sonar as their primary sensing modality. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are the state-of-the-art solution for object detection in forward-looking sonar imagery, but are energy expensive (e.g. YOLOv8m: 322 mJ/inference). Spiking neural networks (SNNs) rely on binary spike activations and thus sparse accumulate-only operations, allowing them to be remarkably energy efficient, particularly when paired with dedicated neuromorphic hardware. The sparse, high-contrast structure of forward-looking sonar (FLS) returns is structurally matched to spike coding in a way that optical imagery is not. No prior work has assessed the suitability of SNNs for object detection in FLS imagery.
