AI.motivation: 现有TTA方法（如TENT、EATA）在损坏数据上展示增益，但聚合准确率可能掩盖自适应失败或几乎无益的具体条件。作者希望揭示在何种条件下自适应会失效、有害或实际上处于无效状态。
AI.method: 在完整CIFAR-10-C基准（15种损坏类型×5级严重度）上，对三种TTA策略（BN-Adapt、TENT、EATA的范围化重实现）与未自适应源模型进行受控对比，采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验和逐条件（condition-level）分析。
AI.result: 三种方法均显著提升平均准确率12.2-13.3个百分点（p<10^-12），但各自在8.0-9.3%的条件下表现劣于源模型，失败集中于低严重度损坏（源模型已接近上限），特别是亮度、雾、对比度和散焦模糊。EATA与BN-Adapt的平均绝对差异仅0.09个百分点，而与TENT差异为1.08个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 聚合准确率会掩盖系统性的TTA失败模式；需要条件级评估来判断自适应何时有助、有害或实际处于不活跃状态。EATA的可靠性过滤实质上限制了有效适应，使其行为更接近BN统计基线而非熵最小化方法。

title: Aggregation-Aware Synthetic Text Generation Against Authorship Re-Identification
comment: Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: Online users often release multiple texts under the same identity, giving attackers an author profile that can reveal more than any single text. Existing authorship obfuscation methods optimize privacy independently for each document, leaving them blind to cross-document correlations that make aggregation dangerous. We propose Aggregation-Aware Synthetic Text Generation (AAST), a framework that addresses this gap by jointly selecting synthetic texts at the bundle level rather than optimizing each text in isolation. AAST targets attribution and verification attacks, including cross-genre settings where attacker references come from a genre not observed during generation or selection. Experiments across same-genre, cross-genre, neural, and independent non-neural stylometric attacks show that AAST lowers account-level linkability as bundle size grows, while preserving semantic quality, linguistic acceptability, and sentiment alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AAST框架，针对作者混淆问题，在聚合层面（bundle-level）联合选择合成文本，而非逐篇独立优化，以应对跨文档相关性导致的用户身份聚合攻击风险。
AI.motivation: 在线用户在同一身份下发布多篇文本，攻击者可聚合这些文本来构建更全面的作者画像。现有混淆方法逐篇独立优化隐私，忽略了跨文档相关性所带来的聚合泄露风险。
AI.method: 提出Aggregation-Aware Synthetic Text Generation (AAST)框架，在bundle级别联合选择合成文本，同时针对归属攻击（attribution）和验证攻击（verification），并支持跨体裁场景（训练/选择时未见过的体裁）。
AI.result: 在同类体裁、跨体裁、神经风格测量和独立非神经风格测量等多类攻击下，AAST能随着bundle规模增长降低账户级别的可链接性，同时保持语义质量、语言可接受性和情感一致性。
AI.conclusion: AAST通过聚合感知的联合文本选择有效缓解了多文本场景下的作者身份泄露风险，在隐私保护与文本质量之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Iteration Without Elaboration: A Simple ReAct Architecture Suffices for Text-to-SQL Generation
summary: Modern text-to-SQL systems have become increasingly elaborate, relying on schema-linking modules, retrieval-augmented prompting, candidate generation, and multi-stage refinement pipelines. While effective, these additions introduce substantial latency and engineering overhead. To this end, we present \textbf{ReAct-SQL}, a simple yet effective zero-shot ReAct-style framework built solely on iterative reasoning and a constrained action space defined by a typed Domain-Specific Language (DSL) of 15 relational operations, rather than free-form SQL generation. The model incrementally issues DSL calls, observes compiled-SQL execution feedback, and revises its reasoning through interaction. On corrected BIRD mini-dev and EHR-SQL, ReAct-SQL achieves \textbf{84.5\%} and \textbf{73.9\%} accuracy, respectively, matching substantially more elaborate baselines while running up to $8\times$ faster. Incremental ablations further show that iteration primarily improves grounding, while the DSL improves compositional reliability.

AI.tldr: ReAct-SQL是一个零样本的ReAct风格框架，仅基于迭代推理和由15种关系操作构成的类型化DSL（而非自由格式SQL生成）来执行text-to-SQL任务。在BIRD mini-dev和EHR-SQL上分别达到84.5%和73.9%的准确率，与更复杂的基线方法性能相当，但运行速度提升高达8倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的text-to-SQL系统虽然效果良好，但依赖schema-linking、检索增强提示、候选生成和多阶段精炼等复杂组件，引入了大量延迟和工程开销。作者旨在探索是否能用更简单的方法达到相近的效果，降低系统复杂性和推理成本。
AI.method: 提出ReAct-SQL框架，核心思想是：(1) 使用ReAct（推理+行动）风格的迭代范式；(2) 将SQL生成替换为受限动作空间，即由15种关系操作组成的类型化DSL；(3) 模型逐步发出DSL调用，观察编译后的SQL执行反馈，并通过交互修订推理。通过消融实验分析迭代和DSL各自的贡献。
AI.result: 在BIRD mini-dev上达到84.5%准确率，在EHR-SQL上达到73.9%准确率，性能与更复杂的基线方法相当，同时运行速度提升高达8倍。增量消融实验表明：迭代主要改善grounding（语义对齐），而DSL主要提升组合可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过精心设计的受限DSL动作空间和ReAct式迭代推理，可以在不依赖复杂多阶段流水线的情况下实现与复杂系统相当的text-to-SQL性能，同时大幅降低延迟和工程复杂度。简单性可以是高效性和可靠性的来源。

title: Hyper^2: Unleashing Hyperbolic Geometry's Full Potential via Dual-Space Consistency
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to BMVC 2026
summary: HyperbolicCD pioneered hyperbolic geometry for point cloud completion by replacing the Euclidean Chamfer distance with arcosh(1+alpha||x-y||^2), but the reported gains are modest (3-7% Chamfer reduction across SeedFormer, PointAttN and PMP-Net backbones on PCN and ShapeNet-55). We argue the bottleneck lies elsewhere: the loss is hyperbolic but the encoder it back-propagates through is Euclidean, so the position-dependent supervision of the loss is averaged away by the chain rule before it reaches the parameters. We call this a cross-geometry mismatch, and make it testable through two model-agnostic indicators, feature-loss correlation r_FL and effective gradient utilisation u_G. On an SVDFormer backbone trained with HyperbolicCD's loss alone we measure (r_FL, u_G) = (0.68, 39%). We propose Hyper^2, a dual-space consistency framework that extends HyperbolicCD by reusing the identical arcosh(1+alpha d^2) functional form as a positional bias on the refinement attention (a hyperbolic distance encoding), paired with HyperbolicCD's hyperbolic Chamfer loss under a single shared curvature alpha. Both operators are O(N log N) scalar non-linearities on Euclidean distances and together add only ~1.6% FLOPs over SVDFormer. Hyper^2 delivers -22.9% Chamfer on ShapeNet-55 over SVDFormer (well above the 13.2% linear sum of the -12.0% loss-only and -1.2% encoding-only single-space ablations) and -37.5% on the 21 unseen ShapeNet-34 categories. The two indicators remain essentially flat for any single-space configuration but jump together to (0.95, 87%) only when both encoder and loss are hyperbolic, supporting the claim that geometric consistency across encoder and loss, rather than either operator alone, is what enables hyperbolic supervision in point cloud completion. Code is available at https://github.com/Ethan-Zheng136/Hyper-2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hyper²框架，通过双空间一致性（在编码器和损失函数中都使用双曲几何）来解决点云补全中跨几何不匹配的问题，相比仅使用双曲损失的HyperbolicCD，在ShapeNet-55上实现了-22.9%的Chamfer距离改善，并通过两个模型无关指标（特征-损失相关性r_FL和有效梯度利用率u_G）验证了"编码器和损失同时双曲化"是关键假设。
AI.motivation: HyperbolicCD虽然开创了双曲几何用于点云补全，但增益有限（仅3-7% Chamfer减少）。作者认为瓶颈不在于损失函数本身，而在于"跨几何不匹配"：损失是双曲的，但反向传播通过的编码器是欧几里得的，链式法则会平均掉损失中位置相关的监督信号。
AI.method: 提出Hyper²双空间一致性框架：(1) 复用与HyperbolicCD相同的arcosh(1+alpha·d²)函数形式作为细化注意力上的位置偏置（双曲距离编码）；(2) 与HyperbolicCD的双曲Chamfer损失配对，两者共享单一曲率alpha。两个算子都是O(N log N)的标量非线性，仅增加约1.6% FLOPs。同时提出两个指标r_FL和u_G来测试跨几何不匹配。
AI.result: Hyper²在ShapeNet-55上比SVDFormer降低-22.9% Chamfer（远超损失单独+12.0%和编码单独+1.2%的线性之和13.2%），在21个未见过的ShapeNet-34类别上降低-37.5%。指标在单一空间配置下基本不变，仅当编码器和损失都双曲化时从(0.68, 39%)跃升至(0.95, 87%)。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持核心论断：点云补全中双曲监督的有效性取决于编码器和损失之间的几何一致性，而非单一算子。仅当编码器和损失都采用双曲几何时，双曲监督才能真正发挥效用，这验证了"跨几何不匹配"是HyperbolicCD增益有限的根本原因。

title: A Query-Time Framework for Transient 2D Pore-Scale Flow Prediction and Generative Design
summary: Pore-scale flow governs transport and permeability behaviour in porous media engineering applications, yet repeated lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) simulation across many geometries and design queries remains costly for repeated deployment. This study formulates transient pore-scale flow prediction as a geometry-conditioned query-time operator and introduces QSGS-Transient-7606, a benchmark of 7,606 two-dimensional porous structures each paired with 30 logarithmically sampled LBM states. The proposed continuous-time pore-scale flow surrogate model (CT-PoreFlow) integrates topology-aware geometry encoding, compressed spectral mixing, and log-time conditioning with a late-time flux-calibration objective. On unseen test geometries, CT-PoreFlow achieves a velocity relative L2 of 0.2248 and a terminal permeability error of 12.81%. Frozen morphology and computed tomography image audits confirm reasonable cross-geometry robustness without fine-tuning. The surrogate is then embedded in an inverse design workflow, screening 9,216 generative adversarial network and diffusion candidates across 18 property targets prior to LBM verification. Guided GAN sampling attains 98.11% through-connectivity and 72.28% conditional design success, exceeding diffusion-based generation. The framework unifies transient flow prediction, transport-aware screening, and LBM-verified inverse design for porous media.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CT-PoreFlow，一种将孔隙尺度瞬态流动预测建模为几何条件算子学习的连续时间代理模型，并构建了含7,606个多孔结构的QSGS-Transient-7606基准数据集。在未见测试几何上达到速度相对L2误差0.2248、终端渗透率误差12.81%，并成功嵌入逆向设计流程，引导GAN采样实现98.11%的连通率和72.28%的条件设计成功率。
AI.motivation: 传统格子玻尔兹曼方法（LBM）模拟在不同几何和设计查询下重复部署成本高昂，难以满足多孔介质工程中大量几何结构反复仿真的需求。现有数据驱动方法缺乏对瞬态孔隙尺度流动的高效、可泛化预测能力。
AI.method: 将瞬态孔隙尺度流动预测形式化为几何条件查询算子；提出CT-PoreFlow代理模型，融合拓扑感知几何编码、压缩谱混合、对数时间条件化以及后期通量校准目标；构建QSGS-Transient-7606基准（7,606个二维多孔结构×30个对数采样LBM状态）；嵌入利用GAN和扩散模型的逆向设计流程，通过代理模型先筛选9,216个候选后再进行LBM验证。
AI.result: 在未见测试几何上，速度相对L2误差为0.2248，终端渗透率误差12.81%；冻结形态和CT图像审计确认无需微调即可保持跨几何鲁棒性；引导GAN采样达到98.11%贯穿连通率和72.28%条件设计成功率，超越扩散生成方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一了瞬态流动预测、传输感知筛选和LBM验证的逆向设计，为多孔介质工程提供高效协同的代理建模与设计优化方案，并展现出良好的跨几何泛化能力。

title: MCP-Universe RL: A Framework for Training MCP Tool-Use Agents via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective way to improve the tool-use ability of large language models (LLMs), but most existing RL frameworks stop at the policy update. For every new domain, the user is left with two hard systems problems: standing up an isolated environment for each of hundreds of concurrent trajectories and connecting it to training, and scheduling the rollout so that the GPU stays busy across long, multi-turn episodes that spend much of their time stalled on slow tool calls. We present MCP-Universe RL (MCP-U RL), an open-source framework that takes over both. It uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as the interface to the environment, so any tool already exposed as an MCP server plugs into training with no RL-specific integration code. It builds the two missing layers once and reuses them across domains: an environment-orchestration layer that provisions, isolates, and recycles the MCP environments over a pluggable container backend, and a rollout-orchestration layer whose staged pipeline overlaps trajectories to keep the GPU busy while episodes wait on tools. A backend-agnostic training layer then applies the update through an existing RL backend, with veRL and slime integrations. With one configuration, changing only the task specification, we train software-engineering, deep-research, and general tool-use agents on gpt-oss-20b and improve task reward in all three.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCP-Universe RL (MCP-U RL)，一个开源强化学习框架，解决LLM工具使用训练中环境部署和rollout调度的两大系统工程问题。它通过MCP协议作为环境接口，并构建环境编排层和rollout编排层，实现跨领域的训练复用，在软件工程、深度研究和通用工具使用三个任务上均提升了奖励。
AI.motivation: 现有RL框架在策略更新后就停止，留给用户两个棘手的系统问题：1) 为数百个并发轨迹各自搭建隔离环境并连接训练；2) 调度rollout以在长多轮episode中（大量时间等待慢速工具调用）保持GPU繁忙。这些问题阻碍了RL在LLM工具使用中的广泛应用。
AI.method: MCP-U RL使用Model Context Protocol (MCP)作为环境接口，使任何MCP server暴露的工具无需RL特定集成代码即可接入训练。框架构建了两个可复用的层：环境编排层（通过可插拔容器后端提供、隔离和回收MCP环境）和rollout编排层（使用分阶段流水线重叠轨迹，在episode等待工具时保持GPU忙碌）。训练层通过现有RL后端（veRL和slime集成）应用策略更新，且后端无关。
AI.result: 仅通过一个配置（仅改变任务说明），在gpt-oss-20b上训练了软件工程、深度研究和通用工具使用智能体，三个任务的任务奖励均得到提升。
AI.conclusion: MCP-U RL通过统一MCP接口和可复用的编排层，解决了多领域工具使用RL训练的环境与调度瓶颈，只需更改任务说明即可跨领域复用，展示了作为通用LLM工具使用RL训练基础设施的潜力。

title: Training-Free VLM Personalization via Calibrated Residual Decoding
summary:
Vision-language models can be personalized in a training-free manner by directly providing user profiles, preferences, or visual references at inference time, without updating model parameters. However, direct personalized prompting does not guarantee that the model will reliably exploit such evidence. The predictive distribution under the positive user profile often mixes two sources: personalized signals genuinely supported by the current profile, and the model's generic visual or linguistic priors. As a result, from the positive-profile response alone, it is difficult to determine whether a high-confidence answer is supported by the user profile or merely reflects the model's default preference. To address this problem, we propose a training-free calibrated residual decoding framework. Given the same image and question, we construct three evidence conditions: a positive profile , a counterfactual profile , and an empty profile . Our method keeps the prediction under
  as the anchored base, and explicitly estimates the marginal contribution of personalization from score differences across the three conditions. We further introduce normalized-entropy-based uncertainty calibration, allowing the strength of personalized enhancement to adapt to the reliability of the residual signal. Experiments on MMPB, YoLLaVA, and MyVLM show that the proposed method improves personalized multimodal understanding without fine-tuning, with consistent gains on identity-sensitive visual personalization tasks. Additional analysis shows that entropy calibration stabilizes residual decoding when the contrastive personalization signal is uncertain.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的校准残差解码框架，通过构建正/反事实/空三种证据条件，显式估计个性化信号的边际贡献，并结合归一化熵不确定性校准，在MMPB、YoLLaVA和MyVLM基准上提升个性化多模态理解性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的训练无关个性化方法直接向视觉语言模型提供用户画像，但模型可能将通用先验与真实的个性化信号混在一起，导致难以判断高置信度答案是否真正由用户证据支持。这是一个关键的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 提出训练无关的校准残差解码框架：(1) 对同一图像和问题构造三种证据条件——正画像、反事实画像、空画像；(2) 以空画像下的预测为锚定基线，通过三种条件间的分数差显式估计个人化的边际贡献；(3) 引入基于归一化熵的不确定性校准，使个性化增强强度自适应残差信号的可靠性。
AI.result: 在MMPB、YoLLaVA和MyVLM基准上，该方法无需微调即提升了个性化多模态理解性能，在身份敏感的视觉个性化任务上获得一致增益；额外分析表明熵校准在不稳定的对比个性化信号下能稳定残差解码。
AI.conclusion: 通过反事实对比和熵校准，可以训练无关地提升个性化多模态模型的可靠性与性能，为无需微调的个性化推理提供了有效解决方案。

title: Toward a First-Principles Update Geometry for the Language-Model Head
summary: We study the language-model head and softmax as a single module, deriving an update geometry from their composition rather than from the weight matrix in isolation. Under Hilbert's projective distance, the maximum change caused by an update $S$ over $\left|\left|{h}\right|\right|_2\le H$ is $H\max_{i<j}\left|\left|{s_i-s_j}\right|\right|_2$, which is $H$ times the Euclidean diameter of its token rows. Motivated by Muon's singular-value conditioning, we propose maximizing the smallest row separation while constraining this diameter, producing an approximate-equidistance problem when $V\gg d$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型头（LM head）与softmax的组合作为一个整体模块，推导出其更新几何特性。在Hilbert投影距离下，更新S对范数受限向量h的最大影响等于H乘以token行向量的欧氏直径。受Muon奇异值正则化的启发，提出在约束直径的前提下最大化最小行间距，当词表远大于维度时，这等价于一个近似等距问题。
AI.motivation: 传统方法单独分析权重矩阵的结构，忽略了LM head与softmax组合后的整体行为。作者希望从组合模块的角度理解更新几何，并利用Muon的奇异值条件化思想来指导LM head的参数更新。
AI.method: 将LM head与softmax视为单一模块，使用Hilbert投影距离推导更新导致的最大变化量公式；基于此结果提出优化目标：在约束欧氏直径的前提下最大化最小token行间距，在大词表场景下将其转化为近似等距问题。
AI.result: 推导出更新S对输入h的最大影响为H乘以token行向量间的欧氏直径（取最大行对距离），给出了该模块的更新几何刻画；并形式化了最优更新应满足的等距分布条件。
AI.conclusion: LM head的更新几何应由其与softmax的组合效应决定，而最优的更新方向应当是在保持token行间直径受限的同时，尽可能拉大最小行间距，使token在嵌入空间中呈近似等距分布。

title: Role-Specialized Mixture-of-Agents with Open-Weight LLMs for Clinical Prediction
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to clinical prediction tasks such as in-hospital mortality and readmission from electronic health records (EHRs). Privacy and compliance constraints motivate systems that can be deployed locally, which has increased interest in open-weight multi-agent designs. However, most medical multi-agent systems are evaluated as a single block, leaving unclear which agent role contributes to prediction and whether retrieval drives observed gains. We study a role-specialized Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) that combines medical knowledge retrieval with contrastive similar-patient reasoning. By varying the role design while holding the retrieval setup fixed, we localize the main effect to the final integrator. Pairing large open-weight analysts with a small open-weight integrator matches closed-model prompting on F1 for mortality prediction while flagging substantially more true high-risk patients. Mechanism analysis shows the role assignment directly yields a high-recall operating point without threshold tuning. The effect is task-dependent, with smaller gains for readmission because the available records correlate weakly with this longer-horizon outcome. These results position role design as a key factor in privacy-constrained, training-free clinical LLM prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个角色专门化的Mixture-of-Agents (MoA)系统，用于基于电子健康记录（EHR）的临床预测任务。通过固定检索设置、变化角色设计，作者将主要效果定位到最终的整合器（integrator）上。研究发现，将大型开放权重分析器与小型开放权重整合器配对，在院内死亡率预测上可媲美闭源模型提示的F1分数，同时能标记出更多真正的高风险患者。机制分析表明角色分配直接产生高召回率的操作点，无需阈值调优，但该效果具有任务依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有的大多数医疗多智能体系统作为单一整体被评估，不清楚哪个智能体角色对预测有贡献，也不清楚检索是否驱动了观测到的性能提升。在隐私和合规约束下，需要能够在本地部署的开放式多智能体系统，因此有必要厘清各角色对预测结果的贡献。
AI.method: 采用角色专门化的Mixture-of-Agents (MoA)架构，结合医学知识检索与对比相似患者推理。通过保持检索设置不变、系统地变化角色设计（如分析器与整合器的规模和组合），来定位各角色对预测性能的具体贡献，并进行机制分析。
AI.result: 主要预测性能提升来自最终整合器（integrator）角色。大型开放权重分析器配小型开放权重整合器在死亡率预测的F1上达到闭源模型水平，且能标记更多真正的高风险患者。机制分析显示角色分配直接产生高召回率操作点，无需阈值调优。但该效果在再入院预测上较弱，因为可用记录与此长期结果相关性较弱。
AI.conclusion: 角色设计（role design）是在隐私受限、无需训练的临床LLM预测系统中的关键因素。该研究为理解多智能体系统中各角色的贡献提供了新视角，并展示了开放权重模型在临床预测中的潜力。

title: WnW: Waxing-and-Waning KV Cache for Long-Form Speech LLMs
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: Long-form audio inputs make the KV cache the dominant memory cost of speech LLMs. Prefill-only KV compression methods permanently discard audio KV positions once evicted, with no pathway to recover them during decoding. We show this is fragile on long-form audio: prefill attention concentrates near the audio start (an attention-sink effect), while decode-time attention distributes broadly, and the two rankings overlap weakly. We propose WnW (Waxing-and-Waning KV cache), which classifies KV-heads into anchor, tidal, and fixed roles via offline calibration. Anchor heads remain on GPU and serve as a decode-time importance observer; tidal heads keep a CPU-resident complement that is recalled chunk-by-chunk based on aggregated anchor-head scores; fixed heads keep only an on-GPU subset, with the rest permanently discarded. On LibriSpeech-Long with two 3B backbones (Voxtral-mini-3b and Qwen2.5-Omni-3B), WnW preserves near-Full-Cache accuracy while keeping only 20% of audio tokens on GPU, where prefill-only baselines fail to terminate. Results generalize across language, task, and domain shifts, and CPU-GPU recall adds little decode-time overhead in our measurements.

AI.tldr: WnW是一种针对长音频语音LLM的KV缓存压缩方法，通过将KV头分类为锚定、潮汐和固定三类角色，在仅保留20%音频token在GPU上的情况下，保持接近全缓存的准确率，同时解决了prefill-only压缩方法在长音频中无法终止的问题。
AI.motivation: 长音频输入使得KV缓存成为语音LLM的主要内存开销。现有的prefill-only KV压缩方法在prefill阶段一旦驱逐音频KV位置便永久丢弃，无法在解码阶段恢复。然而研究发现长音频中prefill注意力集中在音频开头（注意力汇聚效应），而解码时注意力分布广泛，两者排序重叠度低，导致prefill-only方法在长音频场景下表现脆弱甚至无法正常工作。
AI.method: 提出WnW（Waxing-and-Waning）KV缓存方法。通过离线校准将KV头分为三类：1) 锚定头（anchor heads）保留在GPU上，作为解码时的重要性观测器；2) 潮汐头（tidal heads）在CPU保留补充部分，基于聚合的锚定头分数逐块召回；3) 固定头（fixed heads）仅保留GPU子集，其余永久丢弃。
AI.result: 在LibriSpeech-Long数据集上使用两个3B参数模型（Voxtral-mini-3b和Qwen2.5-Omni-3B）进行评测，WnW在仅保留20%音频token在GPU上的情况下保持了接近全缓存的准确率，而prefill-only基线方法无法终止。结果在语言、任务和领域迁移上均具有泛化性，且CPU-GPU召回带来的解码开销很小。
AI.conclusion: WnW通过识别prefill与decode阶段注意力分布的不一致，提出了一种利用解码时重要性观测的KV缓存管理策略，在显著降低GPU内存需求的同时保持模型性能，为长音频语音LLM的部署提供了有效解决方案。

title: GAN-Diff : Coupling Pretrained WGAN-GP Features with Conditional Diffusion U-Nets
summary: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) can provide efficient image generation, while diffusion models offer high-quality image restoration but require iterative sampling. This paper presents a hybrid GAN-guided diffusion framework that uses a pretrained Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP) as a feature prior for conditional diffusion-based image restoration. Intermediate features from the frozen WGAN-GP generator are incorporated into a diffusion U-Net through cross-attention and remain fixed during the DDIM sampling process. The framework is evaluated on two restoration tasks, Gaussian denoising and 2Xsuper-resolution, using CelebA face images. During development, several sources of instability were identified and addressed, including adversarial learning-rate imbalance, inappropriate diffusion initialization, excessive corruption, and insufficient parameter averaging. The resulting framework consistently improves the quality of both degraded and low-resolution images. In particular, it improves denoising performance by 4.40 dB in PSNR and super-resolution performance by 3.70 dB over their respective input baselines. These results demonstrate the potential of a frozen GAN feature prior to guide diffusion models toward stable and effective image restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种GAN引导的扩散模型混合框架，使用预训练的WGAN-GP作为特征先验，通过交叉注意力将其中间特征注入扩散U-Net，用于图像恢复任务（高斯去噪和2倍超分辨率）。该框架在CelebA数据集上分别提升PSNR 4.40 dB（去噪）和3.70 dB（超分），并解决了训练中的多种不稳定问题。
AI.motivation: GAN能高效生成图像但恢复质量有限，扩散模型恢复质量高但需要迭代采样且速度慢。作者希望结合两者优势，利用GAN的特征作为先验来引导扩散模型，实现既高效又高质量的图像恢复。
AI.method: 使用冻结的WGAN-GP生成器作为特征先验，将其中间层特征通过交叉注意力机制注入扩散U-Net中，在DDIM采样过程中保持这些特征不变。同时识别并解决了训练中的多个不稳定源，包括对抗学习率不平衡、不当的扩散初始化、过度损坏和参数平均不足等问题。
AI.result: 在CelebA人脸图像上，框架在两种恢复任务中均一致提升了图像质量：高斯去噪PSNR提升4.40 dB，2倍超分辨率PSNR提升3.70 dB（相对于输入基线）。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的GAN特征先验能有效引导扩散模型实现稳定且高效的图像恢复，证明了GAN与扩散模型混合架构的可行性。

title: DAW: Dynamics-Aware Weighting for Deep Learning Forecasts of Chaotic Systems
summary: Deep learning surrogates for forecasting chaotic dynamical systems suffer from catastrophic error accumulation over long-term autoregressive rollouts. This behavior is partly tied to the underlying systems: chaotic spatiotemporal systems, such as the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation, visit phase space unevenly - dominated by recurrent, low-dimensional quiescent states (e.g., near-laminar flows) and punctuated by rare, dynamically complex topological transitions (e.g., wave-merging events). Under a sample-wise uniform objective, standard neural surrogates allocate their finite capacity to the statistically numerous quiescent states, under-representing the transient regimes that trigger disproportionate, localized errors. Existing imbalanced-regression methods reweight samples by target-space density. However, statistical target-space rarity need not coincide with the intrinsic dynamical rarity - the recurrence geometry of the attractor that is the source of the imbalance. To address this, we introduce Dynamics-Aware Weighting (DAW), a data-centric objective reweighting framework. Using the local dimension $d$ from dynamical systems theory as an a priori measure of a state's active degrees of freedom, DAW reshapes the loss landscape to allocate representational capacity toward the sparse, high-$d$ regimes where forecast errors are systematically large. On the chaotic KS equation, DAW consistently outperforms uniform training, purely statistical density weighting, and its randomly permuted ablation, reducing long-term autoregressive error relative to all baselines. Event-level analysis shows that DAW achieves this by suppressing the localized error amplifications incurred during sharp jumps in $d$, which accompany complex physical processes such as wave-merging in the KS system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动力学感知加权（DAW）框架，利用动力系统理论中的局部维度d作为先验度量，重新加权训练样本，使深度学习代理模型在混沌时空系统（如Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程）中更好地表示高维、稀有的动力学瞬态状态，从而减少长期自回归预测中的灾难性误差累积。
AI.motivation: 深度学习代理模型在预测混沌动力学系统时存在长期误差累积问题。根本原因在于混沌系统（如KS方程）在相空间中的分布极不均匀：大量时间停留在低维准静态（如近层流状态），而罕见的、高维的拓扑转变（如波合并事件）虽然稀少却会引发不成比例的局部误差。标准的均匀损失函数和现有的基于目标空间密度的重加权方法均无法正确识别这种动力学上的罕见性，导致模型容量被浪费在统计上占多数的静止状态上。
AI.method: 提出动力学感知加权（DAW）框架：利用动力系统理论中的局部维度d作为状态下活性自由度的先验度量，对训练损失进行重新加权。核心思想是用内在的动力学稀疏性（而非统计目标空间密度）来指导损失整形，将模型容量向高d区域倾斜——这些区域正是预测误差系统性较大的地方。实验中与均匀训练、纯统计密度加权及随机置换消融进行对比。
AI.result: 在混沌KS方程上，DAW在所有基线（均匀训练、统计密度加权、随机置换消融）中持续取得最优的长期自回归误差表现。事件级分析表明，DAW通过抑制d剧烈跳变期间（伴随复杂物理过程如波合并）的局部误差放大来实现性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 统计上的稀有性与动力学上的稀有性并不一致，基于目标空间的密度加权不足以解决混沌系统预测中的不平衡问题。DAW从动力系统理论出发，提供了一种数据驱动的目标重加权方案，能够有效改善深度学习代理在混沌时空系统长期预测中的表现。

title: A Source-Grounded Framework for Constructing and Evaluating Progressive Multimodal Diagnostic Dialogues from Clinical Case Reports
comment: Accepted to IEEE HealthCom 2026, Distinguished Invited Papers Track
summary: Clinical diagnosis requires progressive integration of patient history, physical examination, laboratory findings, medical images, and diagnostic-informative tests. However, most multimodal medical benchmarks evaluate fixed inputs or endpoint answers, while fully interactive diagnostic agents conflate evidence selection with evidence interpretation. We present a source-grounded framework to construct progressive multimodal diagnostic dialogues from case reports and an evaluation strategy for assessing MLLMs on final diagnosis, diagnostic reasoning, and image-finding interpretation. Evaluation on 24 internal medicine case reports showed that our framework can accurately convert case reports into reference dialogues, achieving a diagnosis F1 of 0.99 and a reasoning-quality score of 4.79 out of 5. Evaluation on two frontier MLLMs (o4-mini and Claude Haiku 4.5) achieved reasoning-quality scores of 2.75 and 2.50, respectively, with substantially lower diagnosis, reasoning, and image-finding F1 scores. The results demonstrate that fluent responses do not necessarily reflect evidence-grounded clinical reasoning and highlight the utility of the proposed framework for evaluating multimodal diagnostic reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于病例报告的源 grounded 框架，用于构建渐进式多模态诊断对话，并用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在最终诊断、诊断推理和影像发现解读方面的能力。在24个内科病例报告上验证框架准确性（诊断F1=0.99，推理质量4.79/5），并评估了两个前沿MLLM（o4-mini和Claude Haiku 4.5），发现其推理质量分数（2.75和2.50）及诊断相关F1分数显著低于人类构建的参考对话，证明流畅的响应不等于基于证据的临床推理。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断需要渐进式整合多模态信息（病史、体格检查、实验室检查、影像等），但现有多模态医学基准要么使用固定输入，要么只评估最终答案。完全交互式诊断代理则混淆了证据选择与证据解释，缺乏能够同时评估诊断推理过程和影像解读能力的渐进式多模态诊断对话评估框架。
AI.method: 提出一个源 grounded（source-grounded）框架，从病例报告中自动构建渐进式多模态诊断对话，并设计评估策略，从三个维度评估MLLM：最终诊断、诊断推理质量、影像发现解读。
AI.result: 框架在24个内科病例报告上实现诊断F1=0.99，推理质量评分4.79/5（满分5）。两个前沿MLLM（o4-mini和Claude Haiku 4.5）的推理质量评分分别为2.75和2.50，且诊断、推理和影像发现F1分数均大幅低于参考对话。
AI.conclusion: 流畅的语言响应并不能保证基于证据的临床推理。所提出的框架有效区分了表面流畅性和真正的证据 grounded 诊断推理能力，可作为评估多模态诊断推理的有力工具。

title: OVIBench: Benchmarking Online Video Question Answering under Interruption
summary: Recent vision language models (VLMs) have achieved strong progress in video understanding. However, most existing video QA research and benchmarks still follow an offline, single-round paradigm, overlooking realistic interactions where users may interrupt the model during answer generation. To address this gap, we formulate the task of Online Video Question Answering under Interruption and introduce OVIBench, the first standardized benchmark for evaluating VLMs in this setting. OVIBench categorizes interruptions into three types: Cancellation, False Trigger, Correction and supports both open-ended and multiple-choice evaluations. To enable large-scale and reproducible testing, we develop an offline simulation protocol that reproduces interruption during generation under a unified temporal setup, together with a multi-dimensional metric suite for assessing interruption understanding and response generation. Experiments demonstrate that OVIBench effectively distinguishes models' interruption-handling abilities, especially in following correction requests. Finally, we construct a train set OVI-Train for interruption-aware fine-tuning. Models fine-tuned on this dataset achieve significant gains on OVIBench, validating the effectiveness of our benchmark and data design. OVIBench, OVI-Train, and the evaluation code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在线视频问答中用户中断场景下的基准测试OVIBench，涵盖三种中断类型（取消、误触发、纠正），并配套离线模拟协议、多维评估指标及训练数据集OVI-Train。
AI.motivation: 现有视频问答研究和基准多采用离线、单轮范式，忽略了现实中用户在模型生成答案过程中可能打断交互的真实场景，这一差距导致VLM在真实交互环境中的能力评估缺失。
AI.method: 作者定义了在线视频问答中断任务（Online Video QA under Interruption），构建OVIBench基准，包含三类中断（Cancellation、False Trigger、Correction），支持开放式与多项选择评估；设计了离线模拟协议在统一时间设定下复现生成过程中的中断，并配套多维指标套件评估中断理解与响应生成；同时构建OVI-Train训练集用于中断感知微调。
AI.result: 实验表明OVIBench能有效区分模型的中断处理能力，尤其在遵循纠正请求方面；基于OVI-Train微调的模型在OVIBench上获得显著提升，验证了基准与数据设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OVIBench填补了视频QA在交互中断场景下的评估空白，且其训练数据能有效提升模型的中断感知能力，为未来的交互式视频理解研究提供了标准和数据基础。

title: StocBench: A Benchmark for Generative Modeling of Stochastic Dynamics
summary: We benchmark transport-based generative models as well as distillation-based few-step methods for the probabilistic forecasting of stochastic fluid flows, with a particular focus on performance under limited inference budgets. All methods are evaluated on a two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow with stochastic forcing. We measure one-step distributional accuracy against large simulated reference ensembles and assess whether the invariant measure is preserved during autoregressive rollouts via the enstrophy spectrum. On the stochastic task, flow matching achieves the most accurate one-step conditional distribution at high inference budgets, while the second-order exponential integrator DPM-2 is strongest at very low NFE. Few-step distillation methods are competitive with the multi-step methods and preserve the enstrophy spectrum particularly well. A deterministic control task, in which the forcing over the prediction interval is observed, separates aleatoric from epistemic uncertainty. Model performance does not translate between the two settings: the distilled models are competitive on the stochastic task but least accurate on the control task. While stochastic diffusion samplers such as DDPM better preserve the enstrophy spectrum during rollouts in the stochastic setting, deterministic samplers such as DDIM and DPM-2 show better spectral preservation in the deterministic setting.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于传输的生成模型和基于蒸馏的少步方法在随机流体流动概率预测中的性能进行了基准测试，重点考察有限推理预算下的表现。在二维Kolmogorov流上评估各方法的一步分布精度和自回归展开中不变测度的保持情况。
AI.motivation: 随机流体流动的概率预测需要高精度的分布建模，但推理预算有限时，多步扩散采样成本高昂。需要系统比较传输类生成模型与蒸馏类少步方法在不同推理预算下的性能权衡。
AI.method: 在二维Kolmogorov流上对多种方法进行基准测试，包括flow matching、DPM-2（二阶指数积分器）、DDPM、DDIM等，同时评估随机预测和确定性控制两种任务设置。采用大型模拟参考集成评估一步分布精度，并通过enstrophy谱评估自回归展开中不变测度的保持。
AI.result: Flow matching在高推理预算下取得最优的一步条件分布精度；DPM-2在极低NFE下表现最强；蒸馏少步方法与多步方法竞争力相当且很好地保持enstrophy谱。两种任务设置下模型性能不一致：蒸馏模型在随机任务上表现好但在控制任务上最差。随机采样器（DDPM）在随机设置中更好地保持enstrophy谱，而确定性采样器（DDIM、DPM-2）在确定性设置中更好。
AI.conclusion: 不同推理预算和任务设置下，最优方法选择不同，不存在单一最优方法。蒸馏方法与多步方法的性能差距取决于任务设置，随机与确定性采样器在谱保持上的优势也与具体设置相关，模型性能不能跨设置迁移。

title: DiaRelay: Relaying Dialogue Context with a Constant-Size Memory for Emotion Recognition in Conversation
summary: Emotion Recognition in Conversation (ERC) requires models to identify subtle emotional cues that are often distributed across distant dialogue turns. Existing methods typically incorporate dialogue history through a fixed context window. However, short windows discard potentially useful long-range evidence, while enlarging the window repeatedly re-encodes overlapping utterances, increases computational and memory costs, and may introduce irrelevant context. Moreover, commonly used parameter-efficient adaptation methods, such as LoRA, mainly introduce fixed low-rank transformations in the feature space and do not explicitly maintain a dialogue-level state or condition their transformations on the evolving conversational context. To address these limitations, we propose a lightweight adapter, DiaRelay, to enable LLMs to explicitly maintain a dialogue-level memory for accurate ERC. Based on LoRA, DiaRelay introduces two extra tightly collaborative components, Selective Relay Memory Transition and Dual-axis Relay Memory Read. Selective Relay Memory Transition progressively aggregates useful historical evidence into a bounded relay memory and propagates it across successive utterance predictions. This allows earlier emotional cues to influence later predictions after they leave the local context window, without re-encoding the complete dialogue history or expanding the backbone context length. Dual-axis Relay Memory Read uses the propagated memory to dynamically modulate low-rank feature transformations, enabling context-dependent representation adaptation without test-time gradient updates. Extensive experiments show that DiaRelay can achieve SOTA weighted F1 and accuracy on MELD while obtaining competitive results on IEMOCAP with only an extra 7.1M trainable parameters, indicating the effectiveness and generalizability of our DiaRelay in enhancing LLM-based emotional understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiaRelay，一种轻量级适配器，使LLM能在对话情感识别(ERC)中显式维护对话级记忆。通过选择性中继记忆转换和双轴中继记忆读取两个协作组件，在LoRA基础上实现跨远距离回合的情感线索传播，无需扩大上下文窗口或重新编码完整对话历史，仅增加7.1M参数即在MELD上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有ERC方法存在两个关键问题：(1)固定上下文窗口难以平衡长距离情感线索的捕捉与计算开销，短窗口丢弃有用信息，长窗口重复编码且引入无关上下文；(2)常用参数高效适配方法如LoRA使用固定低秩变换，不显式维护对话级状态，无法根据演化中的对话上下文动态调整变换。
AI.method: DiaRelay基于LoRA引入两个协作组件：1) Selective Relay Memory Transition：逐步将有价值的历史证据聚合成有界的中继记忆，并在连续话语预测间传播，使早期情感线索在离开局部上下文窗口后仍影响后续预测，无需重新编码完整历史或扩展骨干上下文长度；2) Dual-axis Relay Memory Read：利用传播的记忆动态调制低秩特征变换，实现上下文依赖的表示适配，无需测试时梯度更新。
AI.result: 在MELD上达到加权F1和准确率的SOTA，在IEMOCAP上取得有竞争力的结果，仅增加7.1M可训练参数，验证了方法的有效性和泛化性。
AI.conclusion: DiaRelay通过显式维护有界对话级记忆并结合LoRA的动态条件化变换，有效解决了ERC中长期依赖捕捉与计算效率之间的矛盾，为LLM的情感理解提供了轻量且高效的增强方案。

title: DECO: Depth-Guided Co-Visibility Reasoning for Low-Altitude UAV Visual Localization
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) increasingly require robust visual localization in GNSS-denied environments. A common solution estimates UAV poses by matching keypoints between UAV images and geo-tagged orthographic reference maps derived from satellite or aerial imagery, followed by Perspective-\(n\)-Point (PnP) pose solving. However, such reference maps mainly record top-down surfaces such as roofs and ground planes, while vertical structures such as facades and walls are often compressed or missing. Consequently, many visually distinctive keypoints in low-altitude UAV images have no valid counterparts in the reference map, leading to redundant matches and inaccurate pose estimation. To address this issue, we propose DECO, a DEpth-guided CO-visibility reasoning framework for low-altitude UAV visual localization. DECO uses monocular depth priors to infer local surface geometry and estimate co-visible regions between UAV images and the reference map. Based on this prior, a Geometry-Saliency Coupled Co-visibility Score is introduced to jointly consider geometric co-visibility and detector saliency for keypoint ranking. In this way, DECO retains keypoints that are both visually distinctive and geometrically co-visible, improving feature matching and PnP-based pose estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DECO achieves superior localization performance and can be integrated with different depth models, feature detectors, and matchers. The source code will be available at https://github.com/UAV-AVL/DECO.

AI.tldr: DECO是一个面向低空无人机视觉定位的深度引导共可见性推理框架，利用单目深度先验推断局部表面几何，估计无人机图像与参考地图之间的共可见区域，并提出几何-显著性耦合的共可见性评分来筛选特征点，从而提升PnP位姿估计精度。
AI.motivation: 在GNSS拒止环境中，无人机需要鲁棒的视觉定位。现有方法通过匹配无人机图像与正射参考地图来求解位姿，但参考地图主要记录俯视表面（如屋顶、地面），而垂直结构（如立面、墙体）常被压缩或缺失，导致低空图像中许多视觉显著特征点在参考地图中没有有效对应，产生冗余匹配和不准确的位姿估计。
AI.method: DECO框架包含三个核心要素：1) 使用单目深度先验推断局部表面几何；2) 估计无人机图像与参考地图之间的共可见区域；3) 提出几何-显著性耦合共可见性评分（Geometry-Saliency Coupled Co-visibility Score），联合考虑几何共可见性和检测器显著性进行关键点排序，保留既视觉显著又几何共可见的关键点。
AI.result: 大量实验表明DECO实现了优越的定位性能，并且可以与不同的深度模型、特征检测器和匹配器集成，具有良好的通用性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: DECO通过引入深度引导的共可见性推理，有效解决了低空无人机图像与正射参考地图之间特征匹配冗余和不准确的问题，提升了GNSS拒止环境下的视觉定位精度，且验证了其跨模型、跨检测器的通用性。

title: Does a Modern-Handwriting Warm-Up Help Historical Arabic OCR? A Reproducible, Compute-Matched Evaluation on Muharaf and KHATT
summary: Whether an intermediate stage of modern Arabic handwriting helps or hurts historical Arabic HTR is usually decided from one implementation and one comparison, too thin a basis for a claim either way. We test stability by running the same nominal ablation four times, letting the base checkpoint, encoder-freezing strategy, epoch budget, precision, and learning-rate schedule vary as they naturally did during development, while holding the normalization, scorer, and interval estimation fixed. Each run compares intermediate training on modern handwriting (KHATT) then fine-tuning on historical manuscripts (Muharaf) against fine-tuning on Muharaf directly. Across the four runs the estimated effect swings from -17.64 to +14.52 CER points and reverses sign. The two extremes are exactly the two runs with an identifiable confound (a fivefold lower learning rate in one; a checkpoint of undisclosed provenance in the other); the two clean runs land at -0.25 and +0.94, i.e. no effect. A tight interval from one implementation says nothing about the next. We then run a compute-matched experiment with identical budgets over three seeds: KHATT warm-up is +2.42 CER points worse than a matched same-domain control (95% interval [+0.60, +4.25]); the part of that gap specific to the handwriting domain is only about 0.6 points a small negative effect under this configuration, not a universal result. We release a SaudiHeritage-OCR package with the normalizer, interval scorer, a verified KHATT decoder, experimental manifests, VLM baselines, and an edition-alignment protocol, so the result can be checked independently. The Al-Mahd inscription line is held strictly out and is not offered as a benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文通过四次重复同一名义消融实验，发现中间阶段现代阿拉伯手写体训练（KHATT）对历史阿拉伯语手写识别（HTR）的效果在-17.64到+14.52 CER点之间波动甚至反转符号，表明单一实现得出的结论不可靠。在干净配置下，KHATT热身比同域对照差2.42 CER点（95%区间[+0.60,+4.25]），其中领域特有效应仅约0.6点，为轻微负面效果。作者发布SaudiHeritage-OCR包供独立验证。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对现代阿拉伯手写体作为中间训练阶段是否有益于历史HTR的结论，通常仅基于单次实现和单次比较，样本基础过薄，无法支撑确定性论断。作者旨在检验该结论的稳定性与可复现性。
AI.method: 作者运行四次名义相同的消融实验，允许基础检查点、编码器冻结策略、epoch预算、精度和学习率调度自然变化，固定归一化、评分器和区间估计。每轮比较两条路径：在KHATT现代手写体上中间训练再在Muharaf历史手稿上微调，与直接在Muharaf微调。随后运行计算量匹配的三种子实验，以同域对照比较KHATT热身效应，并通过领域对照分离领域特有成分。
AI.result: 四次运行效果从-17.64到+14.52 CER点剧烈波动并反转符号。两个极端恰好对应存在可识别混淆因素的两轮（一个学习率低五倍，一个检查点来源不明）；两轮干净运行落在-0.25和+0.94，即无效应。计算匹配实验中KHATT热身比同域对照差+2.42 CER点（95%区间[+0.60,+4.25]），其中领域特有部分仅约0.6点，为小幅负面效应。
AI.conclusion: 单一实现得到的紧置信区间无法推广到其他实现；现代手写热身在此配置下仅有小幅负面效应，并非普适结论。作者强调严谨的重复实验和可验证工具链对HTR研究的重要性，并刻意将Al-Mahd铭文行严格排除，不将其作为基准。

title: Beyond Factual Knowledge: Benchmarking and Learning Step-Level Procedural Rule Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at text understanding and generation, yet still struggle to reliably understand and apply externally provided procedural rules at scale. To evaluate this capability, we introduce RuleWorld, a large-scale benchmark that reformulates rules as globally reusable abstract units rather than instance-specific facts. In RuleWorld, several scenarios, including single-rule, parallel multi-rule, and multi-hop reasoning, are settled for comprehensive evaluation. We further propose DynaRule, an end-to-end framework that injects the given rules into the KV cache and turns retrieval into an internal, learnable, step-wise process. Specifically, DynaRule employs Stacked Step-Level Attention Training with a special <search> token to enable dynamic rule re-attention and updating during inference. In this way, the model can re-attend to the most relevant rules at each step, dynamically replacing outdated ones to support more stable multi-step reasoning. Experiments on RuleWorld show that existing LLMs face challenges under large rule pools, while DynaRule improves average QA accuracy by up to 19 points and achieves over 85% Recall@1 at 10K rules, outperforming strong baselines by large margins. We make our code and dataset available here: https://github.com/SharkSpicy-NLP/Beyond-Factual-Knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RuleWorld基准测试来评估LLM理解和应用外部程序化规则的能力，并提出了DynaRule框架，通过将规则注入KV缓存并采用步进式注意力训练，实现了动态规则重新关注和更新，在10K规则规模下提升QA准确率高达19个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM在文本理解和生成方面表现优异，但在大规模场景下可靠地理解和应用外部提供的程序化规则仍存在困难。现有方法通常将规则视为实例特定的事实，缺乏对可全局复用抽象规则的处理能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出RuleWorld基准测试，将规则重构为全局可复用的抽象单元，涵盖单规则、并行多规则和多跳推理场景。2) 提出DynaRule框架，将给定规则注入KV缓存，将检索转化为内部可学习的逐步过程。具体采用堆叠步级注意力训练（Stacked Step-Level Attention Training），利用特殊<search>标记实现推理过程中的动态规则重新关注和更新。
AI.result: 实验表明现有LLM在大型规则池下面临挑战，而DynaRule在平均QA准确率上提升最多19个百分点，在10K规则规模下Recall@1超过85%，大幅优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DynaRule通过将规则检索内化为KV缓存中的可学习步进过程，使模型能够在每一步重新关注最相关的规则并动态替换过时规则，从而在大型规则池中实现更稳定的多步推理。

title: Targeted Iterative Filtering
summary: The assessment of image denoising results depends on the respective application area, i.e. image compression, still-image acquisition, and medical images require entirely different behavior of the applied denoising method. In this paper we propose a novel, nonlinear diffusion scheme that is derived from a linear diffusion process in a value space determined by the application. We show that application-driven linear diffusion in the transformed space compares favorably with existing nonlinear diffusion techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新颖的非线性扩散方案，该方案由应用决定的值空间中的线性扩散过程推导而来，在不同应用领域（图像压缩、静态图像采集、医学图像）中均优于现有非线性扩散技术。
AI.motivation: 图像去噪结果的评估依赖于具体应用领域，不同类型的应用（如图像压缩、静态图像采集和医学图像）对去噪方法的行为要求完全不同，因此需要一种能够适应不同应用需求的扩散方案。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的非线性扩散方案，该方案从由应用决定的值空间中的线性扩散过程推导而来，将应用需求编码到变换后的值空间中。
AI.result: 实验表明，在变换空间中的应用驱动线性扩散与现有非线性扩散技术相比表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 应用驱动的线性扩散在变换空间中能够比现有非线性扩散技术取得更好的去噪效果，为不同应用场景提供了灵活且有效的去噪方法。

title: Beyond Dense Adam States: Adaptive Log-Space Quantization for Memory-Efficient Optimizers
summary:
Low-precision optimizer-state methods are commonly designed for dense Adam-style moments, but memory-efficient optimizers maintain factored, confidence-based, or projected states whose quantization errors propagate differently. We characterize this heterogeneity in optimizer-state traces from language-model pre-training and introduce Adaptive Log-Space (AL) quantization, a block-wise representation for non-negative states that adapts its nonzero range per block while preserving exact zeros. AL8 and AL16 are combined with independent signed-momentum encodings and state-specific precision choices.
  Across 96 runs totaling 214.7 GPU-hours, we evaluate AdamW, Adafactor, CAME, and APOLLO paths. On a 20K-step TinyLlama-1.1B benchmark, AdamW with AL8 second moments and 8-bit uniform momentum reaches 72.90 perplexity, versus 72.48 for FP32 and 73.54 for an 8-bit dynamic-quantization baseline, while reducing measured optimizer-state storage from 8392.7 to 2119.2 MiB. CAME requires higher precision for its non-negative states: AL16 reaches 86.16 perplexity versus 86.68 for FP32, while all-AL8 reaches 90.19. In a 100K-step GPT-2 experiment, topology-aware parameter protection reduces the late-loss gap of quantized Adafactor from +0.1185 to +0.0159. These results support state- and topology-aware optimizer quantization. End-to-end comparisons use a single training seed and are reported as empirical measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应对数空间(AL)量化方法，针对不同优化器状态(因子化、基于置信度、投影等)的异构量化误差传播特性，采用逐块自适应非零范围并保留精确零值的表示方式，结合独立有符号动量编码和状态特定精度选择。在96次运行、214.7 GPU小时中验证了AdamW、Adafactor、CAME和APOLLO四种优化器路径，证明了状态感知和拓扑感知的优化器量化策略的有效性。
AI.motivation: 低精度优化器状态方法通常为稠密的Adam风格矩设计，但内存高效的优化器维护因子化、基于置信度或投影的状态，其量化误差传播方式不同。现有方法未考虑这种异构性，需要针对不同优化器状态的特性设计专用量化方案。
AI.method: 提出Adaptive Log-Space (AL)量化：一种逐块的非负状态表示方法，每个块自适应调整非零值范围同时保留精确零值。AL8和AL16与独立的符号动量编码及状态特定精度选择相结合。此外引入拓扑感知的参数保护策略。
AI.result: 在20K步TinyLlama-1.1B基准上，AdamW+AL8二阶矩+8位均匀动量达到72.90困惑度（FP32为72.48，8位动态量化基线为73.54），存储从8392.7降至2112.2 MiB。CAME需更高精度(AL16达86.16 vs FP32 86.68，all-AL8仅90.19)。GPT-2 100K步实验中，拓扑感知参数保护将量化Adafactor的晚期损失差距从+0.1185降至+0.0159。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持状态感知和拓扑感知的优化器量化策略。不同优化器状态需要不同精度配置(CAME需要更高精度)，拓扑信息可用于进一步降低量化带来的性能损失。注意到端到端比较仅使用单一训练种子，结果属于经验测量范畴。

title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading for AI Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents increasingly rely on repeated access to external artifacts, yet current reading interfaces often expose entire objects even when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute task-relevant evidence, while existing context-reduction methods mainly intervene after broad content has already entered the trajectory. We present SparseRead, a training-free, model-transparent reading layer that controls content admission before unnecessary evidence reaches the model context. SparseRead combines a regime-aware Read Gate, extensible Reader Backends, and a stateful protocol for bounded, source-anchored evidence acquisition with explicit refinement, verification, stopping, and fallback. Across six frontier models, including Claude Opus 5, and five workload scenarios, SparseRead reduces token volume by up to 92.9% and wall time by up to 89.0%, while preserving or improving task quality. Its consistent gains across three agent frameworks further demonstrate broad portability.

AI.tldr: SparseRead是一种无需训练、模型透明的阅读层，通过在上下文准入前控制内容流入，解决长时程智能体过度读取外部工件的问题，在六个前沿模型和五个工作负载场景中将token量减少高达92.9%，墙钟时间减少89.0%，同时保持或提升任务质量。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体频繁反复访问外部工件，但现有阅读接口常常暴露整个对象，即便只需要稀疏证据。这种过度读取增加了token和延迟成本，并稀释了任务相关证据。现有上下文缩减方法主要在广泛内容已进入轨迹后才介入，无法在源头阻止不必要的证据进入模型上下文。
AI.method: SparseRead由三个核心组件构成：一是机制感知的Read Gate（读取门控），用于在内容进入模型上下文前控制准入；二是可扩展的Reader Backends（阅读器后端）；三是有状态协议，实现有界、源锚定的证据获取，并具备显式精化、验证、停止和回退机制。该方法无需训练，且对模型透明。
AI.result: 在六个前沿模型（包括Claude Opus 5）和五个工作负载场景中，SparseRead将token量减少高达92.9%，墙钟时间减少89.0%，同时保持或提升任务质量。在三个智能体框架中均获得一致收益，证明了其广泛的迁移适用性。
AI.conclusion: SparseRead通过在证据进入模型上下文之前进行内容准入控制，有效解决了长时程智能体过度读取的问题，显著降低计算成本的同时保持了任务质量，且具备跨模型、跨框架的通用性。

title: XTC: Head-Aware Sampling by Excluding Top Choices
summary: Standard decoding rules for autoregressive language models promote diversity by rescaling the full next-token distribution or truncating its low-probability tail. These strategies overlook a common regime of open-ended generation in which several continuations are plausible but too much probability mass remains concentrated on the most generic choice. We introduce XTC (Exclude Top Choices), a lightweight head-aware decoding operator that targets this regime directly. XTC identifies tokens whose probabilities exceed an absolute plausibility threshold $τ$: when at least two qualify, it removes the dominant eligible choices with probability $ρ$ and retains only the weakest plausible alternative before renormalization. Across 60 experiments on Gemma 3 27B Q4, Gemma 3 12B Q6, and DeepSeek R1 14B Q6, with scaling validation on Llama 3.3 70B Q4, XTC improves the diversity-repetition Pareto frontier. On creative generation, Distinct-2 increases by 11--15% and repeat trigrams decrease by 27--47% across the four models. Combined with temperature scaling, gains reach 38% in Distinct-2 and 71% in repeat-trigram reduction over baseline. A blinded Amazon Mechanical Turk study with 150 Master raters yields a 62.3% creativity preference for XTC ($p<10^{-4}$) without reduced fluency, while a GPT-4o control judge reproduces the Anthropic-judge direction on every measure. On IFEval with Llama 3.3 70B Q4, XTC preserves prompt-level strict accuracy within 1.7 percentage points of baseline while recovering most of the diversity gain; a temperature setting matched on Distinct-2 reduces IFEval by 8.8 points. The effect is additive with temperature and repetition penalties, robust across quantization levels and model families, and consistent across twelve prompt genres. XTC has been adopted by llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2, and text-generation-webui.

AI.tldr: XTC (Exclude Top Choices) 是一种轻量级的 head-aware 解码算子，通过识别超过绝对合理性阈值τ的token，并在至少两个token符合条件时以概率ρ移除主导的合格选择，仅保留最弱的合理替代项后再重新归一化。该方法在60项实验中显著改善了多样性-重复性Pareto前沿，Distinct-2提升11-15%，重复三元组减少27-47%，并被llama.cpp、ExLlamaV2和text-generation-webui采用。
AI.motivation: 标准解码规则（如top-p、temperature rescaling）忽略了开放生成中的常见场景：存在多个合理续写但概率质量过度集中在最通用的选择上。现有方法要么重新缩放完整分布，要么截断低概率尾部，都无法直接针对这种"多个合理选项但主导选项过优"的状况。
AI.method: XTC解码算子：1) 识别概率超过绝对合理性阈值τ的token；2) 当至少两个token符合该条件时，以概率ρ移除主导的合格选择；3) 仅保留最弱的合理替代项；4) 重新归一化。该算子是head-aware的轻量级操作，与温度缩放和重复惩罚具有可加性。
AI.result: 在Gemma 3 27B Q4、Gemma 3 12B Q6、DeepSeek R1 14B Q6及Llama 3.3 70B Q4上，XTC使Distinct-2提升11-15%，重复三元组减少27-47%；结合温度缩放可获得38%的Distinct-2提升和71%的重复减少。150名Amazon Mechanical Turk Master评价者中有62.3%偏好XTC的创造力（p<10⁻⁴），流利度不降低。在IFEval上，XTC保持提示级严格准确率在基线1.7个百分点以内，同时恢复了大部分多样性增益。效果跨量化级别、模型家族和12种提示类型保持一致。
AI.conclusion: XTC针对性地解决了开放生成中"多个合理续写但概率集中"的盲区，通过简单地排除主导选项来强制探索弱化的合理替代。该方法轻量、与现有技术（温度、重复惩罚）正交且可叠加，在多样性和指令遵循之间取得了更好的权衡，已被多个主流推理框架采用。

title: Self-Calibrating Dense Displacement Fields for Reliable Co-Registration of Large Optical Satellite Imagery
summary: Co-registration underlies nearly every multi-temporal and multi-sensor use of optical satellite imagery, and operational products still carry documented offsets well above the fraction-of-a-pixel scale at which change detection, time series, and data fusion degrade. Real image pairs differ along several axes at once (sensor response, scene content, viewing geometry, resolution, mosaic seams), and the last of these is not a single global motion. Existing tools embed a motion model and constants tuned to their development data; a pair that fits is registered precisely, while one that does not either fails to match or returns a result wrong by tens of pixels with no failure reported. Learned matchers add a GPU requirement and carry no accuracy guarantee outside their training distribution. We present SCDF (self-calibrating displacement fields), a training-free, GPU-free estimator whose motion model is the dense per-pixel displacement field itself, so no scene motion falls outside the model. A single predict--measure--filter loop runs over a resolution pyramid: the accumulated field predicts where each patch of the moving image falls in the reference, RootSIFT matching and a correlation pass measure the displacement there to sub-pixel precision, and filters whose thresholds are all calibrated on the image pair itself decide what survives. One configuration, with no per-dataset tuning, processes full $8192^2$ scenes on a single CPU core. On 584 constructed-ground-truth pairs built from real Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9, and NAIP imagery, against seven classical baselines and two zero-shot pretrained matchers, SCDF registers every pair with zero failures, reduces the best baseline's real-pair median end-point error from 6.83 to 4.17m, and cuts its 90th percentile from 17.8 to 7.77m.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCDF（自校准位移场），一种无需训练、无需GPU的密集图像配准方法。它直接用稠密逐像素位移场作为运动模型，通过预测-测量-滤波循环在分辨率金字塔上迭代配准，所有阈值参数都在图像对自身校准，无需针对数据集调参。在真实Sentinel-2、Landsat-8/9和NAIP数据上，SCDF实现零失败，优于七个经典基线和两个零样本预训练匹配器。
AI.motivation: 现有图像配准工具存在根本缺陷：它们内嵌固定运动模型和针对开发数据调优的常数，当图像对不符合模型假设时要么匹配失败、要么返回数十像素的错误却无失败报告；学习型匹配器需要GPU且不保证训练分布外的精度。需要一种无需训练、自适应、鲁棒的配准方案。
AI.method: SCDF的核心是稠密逐像素位移场本身作为运动模型（无任何运动落在模型之外），通过单一"预测-测量-滤波"循环在分辨率金字塔上运行：累积位移场预测移动图像每个patch在参考图像中的位置，RootSIFT匹配结合相关计算在亚像素精度测量位移，所有滤波器阈值均在图像对内部校准决定哪些位移得以保留。单配置无需数据集调参，可在单CPU核心处理8192²完整场景。
AI.result: 在584对基于真实Sentinel-2、Landsat-8/9和NAIP构建的真值图像对上，SCDF实现零失败配准，将最佳基线方法的中值端点误差从6.83m降至4.17m，90百分位误差从17.8m降至7.77m，并在CPU单核上运行。
AI.conclusion: SCDF通过在图像对内部自校准阈值并使用稠密位移场作为运动模型，消除了传统配准工具对预设模型的依赖和失败风险，在训练免费、GPU免费的约束下实现了对多种真实卫星影像的可靠高精度配准。

title: Gaussian process learning with flow map refinement for parameter estimation in dynamical systems
summary: Parameter estimation is a central task in data-driven learning of dynamical systems. It aims to recover the underlying physical parameters from observed time-series data, thereby providing interpretable insights into the physical mechanisms governing the system. Gradient/derivative matching methods based on Gaussian process provide an efficient way to perform parameter estimation. Those methods avoid repeated numerical integration and enforce local derivative consistency. However, such local matching may result in global inconsistency with the governing flow map, particularly under scarce and noisy observations. To address this limitation, we propose a framework based on Gaussian process learning with flow map refinement (GPL-FMR), a two-stage parameter estimation framework. The first stage is based on Gaussian process learning algorithm and the posterior obtained from which is transferred as an informative prior to the second stage based on flow-map refinement. The second stage further improves the parameter estimation via optimisation based on global dynamical constraints. We demonstrate and analyse its performance on multiple numerical examples, including the Van der Pol oscillator, the Lotka-Volterra model, and the Lorenz-63 system. The results show that the proposed framework consistently improves parameter estimation accuracy, particularly under scarce and noisy observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于高斯过程学习与流映射细化（GPL-FMR）的两阶段参数估计框架，用于从时间序列数据中恢复动力系统的物理参数。第一阶段使用高斯过程学习算法获得后验，并将其作为信息先验传递给第二阶段；第二阶段基于全局动力学约束进行流映射细化优化，从而克服局部导数匹配导致的全局不一致问题，尤其在数据稀少且含噪的情况下显著提升参数估计精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于高斯过程的梯度/导数匹配方法虽然避免了重复数值积分并执行了局部导数一致性约束，但在观测数据稀少且含噪时，局部匹配可能导致与全局控制流映射不一致，从而影响参数估计的准确性。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架GPL-FMR：第一阶段基于高斯过程学习算法获取参数后验分布；第二阶段将该后验作为信息先验，基于全局动力学约束（流映射细化）通过优化进一步改进参数估计。
AI.result: 在Van der Pol振荡器、Lotka-Volterra模型和Lorenz-63系统等多个数值示例上进行验证，结果表明所提框架在数据稀少且含噪的观测条件下始终提高了参数估计的准确性。
AI.conclusion: GPL-FMR框架通过将高斯过程局部匹配与全局流映射约束相结合，有效解决了两者在全局一致性上的矛盾，为动力系统参数估计提供了一种更鲁棒的方法，尤其在挑战性观测条件下表现突出。

title: Clarify User Expertise: Towards Proactive Conversational Agents Tailoring Responses to User Proficiency
summary: In the context of information seeking, conversational agents are undergoing an evolution from reactive tools to proactive, personalized assistants. A critical aspect of this evolution is the ability to tailor strategic interactions to a user's unique needs and expectations. Unlike existing studies that focus on proactively clarifying query ambiguities, we center on clarifying the user's expertise in order to tailor responses for better user comprehension. We find that existing agents struggle to determine user expertise from queries alone, a limitation that prevents them from dynamically adapting their responses. To address this gap, we introduce PASSING to empower the agent to proactively clarify a user's expertise through targeted inquiries. This is achieved by our What-to-ask and How-to-ask strategies, induced by LLM self-play. Our extensive experiments also show our superiority. We believe that PASSING represents a crucial step towards creating more human-centric conversational agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PASSING框架，通过LLM自我博弈驱动的"What-to-ask"和"How-to-ask"策略，让对话智能体主动澄清用户专业水平，从而动态调整回复以更好地满足用户理解需求。
AI.motivation: 现有对话智能体虽能主动澄清查询歧义，但无法判断用户专业知识水平，导致回复可能过浅或过深，难以适应不同用户的个性化理解需求。
AI.method: 提出PASSING框架，通过LLM自我博弈（self-play）学习"What-to-ask"（询问什么）和"How-to-ask"（如何询问）两大策略，使智能体能够主动向用户提出针对性问题以澄清其专业知识水平。
AI.result: 大量实验证明PASSING在澄清用户专业水平及提升回复适配性方面优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: PASSING是迈向更以人为中心的对话智能体的关键一步，通过主动澄清用户专业水平实现个性化交互。

title: Don't Repeat Yourself: Stopping Verbatim Loops at Sampling Time
summary: Large Language Models generate text autoregressively, but open-ended generation is prone to verbatim looping, in which models repeat spans already present in context. Standard defenses such as repetition, presence, and frequency penalties and n-gram blocking act on token recurrence rather than the sequential structure of a loop, and often suppress looping only at strengths that also degrade formatting or fluency. We propose Don't Repeat Yourself (DRY), a sampling-time logit adjustment that penalizes a candidate token only when generating it would extend the current suffix into an exact continuation of a span seen earlier in the context. Sequence breakers protect chat templates and formatting tokens. Across models from 1.5B to 120B parameters, nine prompt families, and a 600-pair human study, DRY reduces suffix-extension rate by 47% while improving lexical diversity. An intervention-matched placebo produces no comparable reduction, identifying suffix matching as the operative mechanism. On AWQ-quantized 70B and 120B models, DRY reduces loop rate by roughly half while preserving MT-Bench, MMLU, and GSM8K performance, whereas standard alternatives lose measurable ground. DRY has been adopted by popular open-source LLM inference frameworks including llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2, and text-generation-webui, highlighting its practical impact on text generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRY（Don't Repeat Yourself）采样方法，通过在采样时仅惩罚那些会扩展当前后缀至上下文先前出现过的精确延续的候选token，有效缓解LLM开放生成中的逐字循环问题，在1.5B到120B参数模型上降低后缀扩展率47%，同时提升词汇多样性，且被多个主流开源推理框架采用。
AI.motivation: LLM的自回归开放生成容易产生逐字循环（verbatim looping）问题，即重复上下文已出现的片段。现有防御方法（如重复惩罚、频率惩罚、n-gram阻断）只针对token层面的重复，而非循环的序列结构，往往在抑制循环时会损害格式和流畅性。因此需要一个直接针对循环结构本身的采样调整方法。
AI.method: DRY是一种采样时的logit调整方法：仅在候选token会使得当前后缀扩展为上下文先前出现过的某个span的精确延续时，才对该token施加惩罚。同时引入"序列断点"（sequence breakers）来保护聊天模板和格式token不受惩罚误伤。方法通过干预匹配的安慰剂对照验证了后缀匹配是起效机制。
AI.result: 在1.5B到120B参数的多种模型、九个提示族和600对人类研究中，DRY将后缀扩展率降低47%并提升词汇多样性；干预匹配的安慰剂无类似效果，证明后缀匹配是关键机制。在AWQ量化的70B和120B模型上，DRY将循环率降低约一半，同时保持MT-Bench、MMLU和GSM8K性能，而标准替代方法会损失性能。DRY已被llama.cpp、ExLlamaV2和text-generation-webui等主流开源推理框架采用。
AI.conclusion: DRY通过直接针对循环的序列结构而非token层面的重复来实现更精准的循环抑制，在不损害生成质量和基准性能的前提下有效减少重复，且其广泛的开源采纳证明了实际价值。

title: On Tensor-Based PDEs and their Corresponding Variational Formulations with Application to Color Image Denoising
summary: The case when a partial differential equation (PDE) can be considered as an Euler-Lagrange (E-L) equation of an energy functional, consisting of a data term and a smoothness term is investigated. We show the necessary conditions for a PDE to be the E-L equation for a corresponding functional. This energy functional is applied to a color image denoising problem and it is shown that the method compares favorably to current state-of-the-art color image denoising techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了偏微分方程（PDE）何时可以被视为某个能量泛函（由数据项和平滑项组成）的欧拉-拉格朗日（E-L）方程，给出了必要条件，并将该能量泛函应用于彩色图像去噪问题，结果表明该方法优于当前最先进的彩色图像去噪技术。
AI.motivation: 探究PDE作为E-L方程的可行性条件，将变分框架与PDE方法联系起来，并应用于彩色图像去噪这一实际任务中。
AI.method: 推导PDE作为某个能量泛函（数据项+平滑项）E-L方程的必要条件，并将该能量泛函应用于彩色图像去噪。
AI.result: 该方法在彩色图像去噪上表现优于当前最先进的技术。
AI.conclusion: PDE可以作为能量泛函的E-L方程需满足特定必要条件；所提出的能量泛函在彩色图像去噪中具有优越性能。

title: SANE: State Anomaly Neutralization for Stable Extreme-Context Delta-Rule Models
summary: Delta-Rule recurrent models maintain a fixed-size state, enabling $O(1)$ inference memory but potentially becoming unstable under extreme-context extrapolation. By tracking RWKV-7 over sequences of up to 100M tokens, we empirically identify a distinct failure pattern: \textbf{localized norm explosion atop a relatively sparse substrate}, rather than global state saturation. Analysis of the recurrent update suggests that persistent decay keeps weakly updated entries small, whereas uneven injections allow a few channels to accumulate extreme values. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose \textbf{State Anomaly Neutralization (SANE)}, which applies adaptive $\tanh$ compression at chunk boundaries while preserving the intra-chunk parallel structure. Within a safe threshold range ($3 \le α\le 5$), SANE matches the baseline on 11 short-context reasoning benchmarks with no statistically significant degradation. After a 100M-token prefix, which exceeds the training length by over $24{,}000\times$, SANE retains functional reasoning ($33.46$--$35.56$) while the baseline encounters numerical overflow. In contrast, overly permissive thresholds ($α\ge 8$) remain numerically stable but lose reasoning capability entirely, showing that numerical stabilization alone does not guarantee functional reasoning and revealing a capacity--stability trade-off in state compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SANE方法，通过对Delta-Rule循环模型的状态进行自适应tanh压缩，解决了超长上下文（100M token）推理时的局部化范数爆炸问题，在不牺牲短上下文性能的同时保持了长上下文的推理能力。
AI.motivation: Delta-Rule循环模型虽然具有O(1)推理内存的优势，但在极端长上下文外推时可能变得不稳定。作者通过跟踪RWKV-7在100M token序列上的表现，发现了独特的失败模式：局部化范数爆炸而非全局状态饱和，这为针对性解决方案提供了诊断基础。
AI.method: 提出了State Anomaly Neutralization (SANE)方法：在块边界处应用自适应tanh压缩，同时保持块内并行结构。通过分析循环更新发现，持久衰减保持弱更新项较小，而不均匀注入导致少数通道累积极端值，因此SANE针对性地在块边界进行状态压缩。
AI.result: 在安全阈值范围（3≤α≤5）内，SANE在11个短上下文推理基准上与基线无显著差异。在100M token前缀（超过训练长度24,000倍）后，SANE保持功能性推理（33.46-35.56）而基线遭遇数值溢出。过宽的阈值（α≥8）虽保持数值稳定但完全丧失推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 数值稳定化本身并不能保证功能性推理，揭示了状态压缩中的容量-稳定性权衡。SANE通过自适应压缩有效地在两者之间取得平衡。

title: HERO: Human-profile Enhanced Retrieval Optimization Framework for Long-term Agent Memory
summary: Long-term memory is crucial for personalized responses and long-horizon agent interactions. Existing methods often rely on LLMs to compress or rewrite dialogue histories and use the transformed memories as retrieval evidence. Despite the progress in organizing fragmented contexts, two major drawbacks persist: (1) information loss from compression, which discards fine-grained but later useful details, and (2) semantic drift from rewriting, which erodes the original tone and situated context. In this work, we propose a novel Human-profile Enhanced Retrieval Optimization framework for long-term agent memory (HERO). Specifically, HERO converts the dialogue history into a traceable heterogeneous memory graph that preserves raw dialogue text as evidence for reasoning, thereby mitigating information loss. For retrieval, HERO extracts initial anchors from the current query and incorporates human profiles via an iterative graph traversal; these anchors and profiles provide guidance signals that adaptively activate the most informative regions of the graph. Experiments on two benchmark datasets show that HERO outperforms strong baselines on both factual and personalized reasoning, while providing more faithful access to raw dialogue evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HERO框架，将对话历史转换为可追踪的异构记忆图，保留原始对话文本作为推理证据，并通过人设增强的检索优化来缓解信息压缩损失和语义漂移问题，在事实性和个性化推理任务上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆方法依赖LLM压缩或重写对话历史，存在两大缺陷：(1) 压缩导致信息丢失，细粒度但后期有用的细节被丢弃；(2) 重写导致语义漂移，原始语气和情境上下文被侵蚀。这些问题制约了长期记忆在个性化响应和长时程智能体交互中的表现。
AI.method: HERO框架包含两个核心设计：(1) 将对话历史构建为可追踪的异构记忆图，保留原始对话文本作为推理证据，避免信息压缩损失；(2) 检索时从当前查询提取初始锚点，并结合人设信息通过迭代图遍历，自适应激活图中最具信息量的区域，实现人设增强的检索优化。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，HERO在事实性推理和个性化推理任务上均优于强基线方法，同时能够更忠实地访问原始对话证据。
AI.conclusion: HERO通过图结构记忆和融合人设的迭代检索，有效解决了长期记忆中的信息丢失和语义漂移问题，为长期智能体记忆提供了更可靠且可解释的解决方案。

title: DelistBench: Evaluating Search-Enabled LLMs for Auditable Corporate-Event Database Completion
summary: Financial institutions need an independent way to detect missing, stale, and misclassified corporate-event records in vendor databases. We introduce Search-to-Record, a database-assurance task in which search-enabled large language models reconstruct institution-defined event records from public sources for a known security universe and historical cutoff, and DelistBench, a 1,200-record benchmark for security-level delisting announcements. We evaluate five models in paired closed-book and web-enabled conditions. Web access raises announcement-date accuracy within seven days by 34.0 to 48.0 percentage points and event-status accuracy by approximately 2.8 to 21.7 points; the best system achieves 81.5% overall joint accuracy within seven days. Economy web systems achieve 75.9-78.3% overall joint accuracy within seven days at 4.5-6.6% of the API cost of the most expensive web system. Risk-based triage identifies low-error subsets, although the highest-coverage operating point still sends 27.3% of the balanced test set to review. The evaluation identifies web retrieval as the main source of timing gains and shows that low-cost systems can approach the best system's accuracy. Together, Search-to-Record, DelistBench, and the evaluation provide concrete deployment guidance: calibrate triage to local event prevalence and market mix, preserve positive-event recall, and route positive and ambiguous cases to targeted review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Search-to-Record任务（利用搜索引擎增强的大语言模型从公开来源重建金融机构定义的公司事件记录）及DelistBench基准（1200条证券退市公告记录），评估五个模型在闭卷与联网条件下的表现，发现联网检索显著提升日期与事件状态准确率，最佳系统实现81.5%的整体联合准确率，经济型系统以较低成本接近最佳性能，并提供风险分诊的部署指导。
AI.motivation: 金融机构依赖第三方供应商数据库获取公司事件记录，但供应商数据库中常存在缺失、过期和错误分类的记录，需要独立、自动化的方式来检测和验证这些记录的准确性与完整性。
AI.method: 引入了Search-to-Record任务框架和DelistBench基准（1200条退市公告记录），在闭卷（封闭知识）与联网检索两种条件下评估五个大语言模型，对比其事件记录重建的准确性，并结合风险分诊策略分析不同运行点的性能与成本权衡。
AI.result: 联网访问使公告日期准确率（7天内）提升34.0至48.0个百分点，事件状态准确率提升约2.8至21.7个百分点；最佳系统达到81.5%的七天内整体联合准确率。经济型联网系统的整体联合准确率为75.9%-78.3%，成本仅为最贵系统的4.5%-6.6%。最高覆盖率运行点仍将27.3%的平衡测试集送入人工审核。
AI.conclusion: 联网检索是时间精度提升的主要来源，低成本系统可接近最佳系统的准确性。部署时应根据本地事件发生率和市场构成校准分诊阈值、保持正样本事件召回率，并将正样本和模糊案例路由至定向人工审核。

title: Adapting Dense Vision-Language Relationships for Multi-label Classification with Partial Label
summary: Learning multi-label image classification with incomplete annotations is a challenging task that has been widely studied for its superior trade-off between high efficiency and less labor consumption on large-scale datasets. Predominant methods rely on strong prior assumptions to recover the missing semantics from partial annotations. However, these statistic priors suffer from unstable semantic mistakes and thus lead to catastrophic overfitting. Toward this end, we propose a Language-driven Dense Semantic Adaptor (LDSA) that excavates prior-adaptive relationships from multimodal pretrained CLIP models. In our approach, the densely contrastive adaptor is first proposed to construct dense visual contrastive constraints, transferring the task-specific knowledge to visual domains. We then propose a language-driven interactive decoder with the help of class-specific prompt tuning, which adapts language proxies with visual domains. With the collaborative learning of proposed modules, experimental results demonstrate our proposed LDSA achieves a new state of the art on public multi-label classification benchmarks, and interpretable analyses reveal that our LDSA discovers implicit semantic relationships with the prior-adaptive learning scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言驱动的密集语义适配器（LDSA），利用多模态预训练CLIP模型中的先验自适应关系来解决不完整标注下的多标签图像分类任务，实现了新的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 不完整标注下的多标签图像分类具有高效与省力的优势，但现有方法依赖强统计先验来恢复缺失语义，容易产生不稳定的语义错误并导致灾难性过拟合。
AI.method: 1) 提出密集对比适配器（Densely Contrastive Adaptor），构建密集视觉对比约束，将任务特定知识迁移到视觉领域；2) 提出语言驱动的交互解码器（Language-driven Interactive Decoder），结合类别特定提示微调，使语言代理与视觉领域自适应适配；3) 通过两个模块的协作学习实现先验自适应。
AI.result: 在公开多标签分类基准上取得了新的最先进（SOTA）结果，并通过可解释性分析揭示LDSA能够发现隐式的语义关系。
AI.conclusion: LDSA通过利用CLIP多模态先验和自适应学习机制，有效解决了统计先验不稳定导致过拟合的问题，为不完整标注多标签分类提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Tracing the Unlabeled Storm: Cross-Variable Transfer in a Lagrangian Atmospheric JEPA Framework
summary: Deep atmospheric convection governs South Asian monsoon variability, yet attempting to learn its latent world model directly from zero-inflated, heavy-tailed precipitation yields suboptimal predictive representations. Continuous atmospheric proxies, such as outgoing longwave radiation (OLR), express this convective organization far more coherently. We address this mismatch with \emph{cross-variable proxy learning}: M-JEPA, a multiscale Monsoon Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture, is pretrained on five continuous proxy fields over Lagrangian patches tracking moving convective systems---without rainfall supervision at any point. The resulting frozen representation is transferred to daily precipitation forecasts through a shared decoder trunk featuring parallel probabilistic and deterministic branches. Because rainfall is strictly unobserved during pretraining, downstream skill directly measures the predictive information captured in the latent rollout. A frozen-backbone probing framework with two controls (an identical architecture trained on rainfall alone, and a randomly initialized backbone) attributes the transfer specifically to proxy pretraining: direct rainfall training exhibits $36\%$ higher CRPS error ($7.52$ vs.\ $5.54$\,mm/day). Against the 51-member operational ECMWF ensemble, the transferred model attains a statistically resolved CRPS advantage ($6.81$ vs.\ $6.89$\,mm/day) and higher Brier skill ($+0.05$ vs.\ $-0.04$) using $15.4$M parameters on a single consumer GPU, concentrated at heavy-rain thresholds and fine spatial scales, while the ensemble retains an advantage in neighborhood skill and deterministic references on point metrics. The result provides a competitive monsoon precipitation forecast grounded in intraseasonal dynamics and a diagnostic framework for evaluating transferred atmospheric representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出M-JEPA（多尺度季风联合嵌入预测架构），通过在五个连续大气代理场（如OLR）上进行跨变量代理预训练来学习深层对流的世界模型，而非直接从零膨胀、重尾的降水数据中学习。预训练后的冻结表征被迁移到日常降水预报任务中，通过共享解码器（包含概率和确定性分支）实现。该模型在CRPS和Brier技能上优于直接降水训练模型及ECMWF运行集合的部分指标。
AI.motivation: 深层大气对流主导南亚季风变率，但直接从零膨胀、重尾的降水数据学习潜在世界模型会产生次优的预测表征。而连续大气代理场（如向外长波辐射OLR）能更连贯地表达对流组织，这促使作者采用跨变量代理学习范式。
AI.method: M-JEPA在多尺度拉格朗日补丁上对五个连续代理场进行预训练（无降水监督），随后将冻结表征迁移到降水预报任务。采用"冻结骨干探针"框架，通过两个对照组（仅降水训练的相同架构、随机初始化骨干）归因迁移效果，并使用并行概率/确定性分支的共享解码器。
AI.result: 直接降水训练比代理预训练的表征CRPS误差高36%（7.52 vs 5.54 mm/day）。迁移模型以1540万参数在单张消费级GPU上，相对ECMWF 51成员集合取得统计显著的CRPS优势（6.81 vs 6.89 mm/day）和更高Brier技能（+0.05 vs -0.04），优势集中在重雨阈值和精细空间尺度；集合在邻域技能和点指标确定性参考上仍占优。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了基于季节内动力学的竞争性季风降水预报方案，并建立了一套评估迁移大气表征的诊断框架，证明连续代理场预训练比直接降水训练能更有效地捕获预报所需信息。

title: Where Cognition Lives: Dissecting Emergent from Computed Function in a Minimal Complete Cognitive Architecture
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Code, preregistrations and results: https://github.com/fmarrabal/miuracognitive
summary: A cognitive architecture is more than the module that reasons: it must also decide how long to think and what deserves the effort. We built a minimal but complete system - a recurrent reasoner with adaptive halting, a homeostatic control field, and a value module - and asked of each part: does this function emerge from gradient descent, or must it be computed? Competence emerges. Stopping appears to emerge too, and to be worth more than everything decidable in advance, but that appearance is instrumentation: payoff at matched mean compute climbs from 0.467 (uniform) through 0.546 (difficulty) to 0.698 (ex-ante value), and the further climb to 0.921 (posterior self-observation) does not survive audit. PonderNet-style halting returns a halting-weighted mixture of hidden states while forced-depth baselines return one, and the language head is trained on the mixture alone; equalizing the readout annihilates the apparent advantage of native execution (residual +0.000 [0.000, 0.000]). Value does not emerge: trained couplings capture zero of a payoff an explicit allocator captures completely (+0.151, routing correlation +0.79), so the second-order decisions that pay must be computed, at least where value is orthogonal to content, as here by construction. On a frozen LLM actuator the same instruments show self-consistency voting to be a measured bound (+0.0236 [+0.0150, +0.0326]) and inter-sample agreement nearly worthless as a stopping signal, its mass concentrating on wrong answers. Every null we assert carries a mechanism and a positive control, and the protocol is part of the contribution. Executing our own falsifiable prediction, value under commitment pays +0.1312 [+0.1124, +0.1502] in a cliff-cost family, some seven times the smooth-family estimate - not because the cliff shifts information ex ante, but because it multiplies the attainable range fivefold (5.1x [3.4, 8.2]).

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个最小但完整的认知架构（包含自适应停止的循环推理器、稳态控制场和值模块），系统性地检验各组件的能力是"从梯度下降中涌现"还是"必须显式计算"。研究发现：推理能力涌现，停止行为看似涌现但对齐计算量后优势消失；值模块不能涌现而必须显式计算；在冻结LLM执行器上验证了自一致性投票的价值和停止信号的局限性。
AI.motivation: 认知架构不仅仅包含推理模块，还需要决定"思考多久"以及"什么值得思考"。作者希望区分哪些认知功能可以从梯度下降中自然涌现，哪些必须被显式计算出来，从而指导认知架构设计。
AI.method: 构建最小完整系统：循环推理器+自适应停止+PonderNet式停止加权混合+值模块。通过系统消融和正对照实验，对比涌现能力与显式计算能力。设计严格的审计协议（对齐均值计算、均衡读出层、阳性对照），确保每个零假设都带有机制解释和正对照。在冻结LLM执行器上验证投票和停止信号。
AI.result: 推理能力涌现；停止行为表面涌现但经审计后优势消失（残余+0.000）；值模块无法涌现，显式分配器完整捕获了全部回报（+0.151，路由相关+0.79）；自一致性投票有测量价值（+0.0236），但样本间一致性作为停止信号几乎无用；值承诺在悬崖成本族下收益+0.1312，因为悬崖将可达范围放大5.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 认知架构中一阶推理可以依赖梯度下降涌现，但二阶决策（何时停止、值评估）必须显式计算，尤其在值的内容与内容本身正交时。审计协议本身是重要的方法论贡献，防止视错觉式的"涌现"结论。

title: SPOC-SQL: Stage-wise Preference Optimization for Controllable Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL aims to translate natural language questions into executable SQL queries over relational databases, requiring multi-stage structured reasoning over database schemas and query constraints. However, existing methods treat this task as single-step generation, where models optimize entire SQL sequences without targeted feedback at key decision points and lack support for interacting with and controlling the intermediate generation process. To address this issue, we propose SPOC-SQL, which decomposes Text-to-SQL into four sequential subtasks following standard SQL execution logic and designs stage-specific optimization strategies for the model to learn key decisions. Specifically, we propose the implementation of fine-grained preference optimisation at key decision points across SQL stages, with the objective of enhancing structured decision-making during query construction. Furthermore, a structured decomposition strategy is designed, facilitating stage-wise intervention and correction through explicit intermediate representations. This results in more controllable and reliable SQL generation. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating stage-wise human knowledge consistently improves performance, validating the effectiveness of stage perception controllable generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPOC-SQL，将Text-to-SQL任务分解为四个遵循SQL执行逻辑的连续子任务，并在各阶段的关键决策点设计细粒度偏好优化策略，通过显式的中间表示实现阶段级干预和纠正，从而提升SQL生成的可控性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL方法将任务视为单步生成，模型优化整个SQL序列时缺乏关键决策点的针对性反馈，且不支持对中间生成过程的交互与控制，导致结构化推理能力受限。
AI.method: 1) 将Text-to-SQL分解为四个遵循SQL执行逻辑的连续子任务；2) 在每个子任务的关键决策点实施细粒度偏好优化；3) 设计结构化分解策略，通过显式中间表示实现阶段级干预和纠正。
AI.result: 实验表明，融入阶段级人工知识一致性地提升了模型性能，验证了阶段感知可控生成的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将SQL生成过程分解为可干预的阶段并进行细粒度优化，SPOC-SQL实现了更可控、更可靠的SQL生成，证明了结构化分解和阶段级反馈的价值。

title: On the Choice of Tensor Estimation for Corner Detection, Optical Flow and Denoising
summary: Many image processing methods such as corner detection, optical flow and iterative enhancement make use of image tensors. Generally, these tensors are estimated using the structure tensor. In this work we show that the gradient energy tensor can be used as an alternative to the structure tensor in several cases. We apply the gradient energy tensor to common image problem applications such as corner detection, optical flow and image enhancement. Our experimental results suggest that the gradient energy tensor enables real-time tensor-based image enhancement using the graphical processing unit (GPU) and we obtain 40% increase of frame rate without loss of image quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用梯度能量张量（Gradient Energy Tensor, GET）作为结构张量（Structure Tensor）的替代方案，应用于角点检测、光流和图像增强等常见图像处理问题。实验结果表明，GET能在GPU上实现实时张量图像增强，帧率提升40%且不损失图像质量。
AI.motivation: 传统图像处理方法（如角点检测、光流、迭代增强）通常使用结构张量来估计图像张量，但结构张量在某些场景下可能存在局限。作者希望探索梯度能量张量作为结构张量的替代方案，以提升性能或效率。
AI.method: 将梯度能量张量应用到多个常见的图像问题中，包括角点检测、光流估计和图像增强，并与传统结构张量方法进行比较。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，梯度能量张量能够实现基于GPU的实时张量图像增强，在保持图像质量不变的前提下，帧率提升了40%。
AI.conclusion: 梯度能量张量可以在多个图像处理任务中作为结构张量的有效替代方案，尤其在GPU硬件上展现出实时处理性能和效率优势。

title: Self-Supervised Graph Representation Learning for In-The-Wild Wearable and Smartphone based Emotion Recognition
summary: Wearable and smartphone-based emotion recognition (WER) remains a challenging setting in affective computing, due to the notorious difficulty and bias associated with in-the-wild label collection. The high inter-and intra-subject emotional variability motivates us to explore WER modeling through graph node classification in a limited resources learning scheme powered by Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) graph masking augmentation tasks. We employ a subgraph sampling approach during training, utilizing labeled and unlabeled data, along with supervised, semi-supervised, and SSL mechanisms in a multi-task inductive graph neural network architecture. Our evaluations on K-EmoPhone through leave-one-group-out cross-validation in the binary arousal and valence tasks yield average accuracy gains of 4.3% and 7.8%, compared to the full resource setting, utilizing only 20% and 25% of the labels, respectively. Our model analysis sheds light on the relation of SSL graph augmentations to emotional arousal and valence and justifies the approach of SSL-driven subgraph training for in-the-wild WER.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络和自监督学习的可穿戴/智能手机情感识别方法，通过子图采样和多任务学习（监督、半监督、自监督）在有限标签资源下显著提升情感识别精度。
AI.motivation: 野外真实场景下的情感标签收集困难且存在偏差，同时个体内和个体间的情感变异性大，传统的全监督方法难以应对资源受限的野外情感识别挑战。
AI.method: 采用图节点分类范式，通过子图采样利用标注和未标注数据，在归纳式图神经网络中融合监督学习、半监督学习和自监督图掩码增强任务，实现多任务联合训练。
AI.result: 在K-EmoPhone数据集上通过leave-one-group-out交叉验证，在二分类唤醒和效价任务中，仅使用20%和25%的标签，分别获得了4.3%和7.8%的平均准确率提升（相比全资源设置）。
AI.conclusion: 模型分析揭示了自监督图增强与情感唤醒度和效价之间的关系，验证了自监督驱动的子图训练方法在野外可穿戴情感识别中的有效性。

title: Addressing the Selection Problem in Explainable AI
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Explainable Artificial Intelligence at the International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence 2026 (XAI@IJCAI26)
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) research has produced a plethora of explanation techniques, yet user studies repeatedly show that available explanations are not effective in practice. We argue that, given the siloed nature of conventional XAI, users are struggling to select the appropriate XAI technique. Viewing XAI through a philosophical lens, we offer a formalization of what we call the selection problem: the systematic failure of XAI interfaces to bridge the gap between a user's natural-language uncertainty and the explanation technique that resolves it. Following a logical premise-conclusion format, we show that conventional interfaces require users to translate their uncertainty into a technique selection, a challenging prerequisite to meet. We also propose a structural solution: a multi-agent LLM orchestration tool that translates the user's query to the proper XAI explanation technique. We provide an example of how this structural solution could be instantiated to address the selection problem.

AI.tldr: 本文指出可解释AI（XAI）研究虽产生了大量解释技术，但用户研究反复表明这些解释在实践中效果不佳。作者从哲学视角将问题形式化为"选择问题"：XAI界面无法弥合用户自然语言的不确定性与能解决该不确定性的解释技术之间的鸿沟。作者提出一种结构性解决方案——多智能体LLM编排工具，将用户查询自动转化为合适的XAI解释技术。
AI.motivation: 传统XAI研究各自为政（siloed），用户难以选择合适的技术，导致大量解释技术在实际应用中效果不佳。核心痛点是用户需要用自然语言表达的不确定性必须先翻译成技术选择，这是一个对用户来说颇具挑战性的前置条件。
AI.method: 采用逻辑上的前提-结论格式，形式化描述了"选择问题"。随后提出结构性解决方案：一个基于多智能体LLM编排的工具，能够自动将用户查询翻译/映射到正确的XAI解释技术，并给出了该方案的具体实例化示例。
AI.result: 本文提供了对XAI选择问题的形式化定义和分析，并提出了一种多智能体LLM编排工具的结构性解决方案，同时给出了该方案的实例化示例以说明其实践可行性。
AI.conclusion: 传统XAI界面的根本缺陷在于要求用户跨越"自然语言不确定性"与"技术选择"之间的鸿沟。通过引入LLM驱动的多智能体编排作为中介层，可以系统性地解决这一选择问题，使XAI技术真正发挥其应有的效用。

title: TRACE: A Self-Evolving Skill Bank for Consistent, Limit-Aware LLM Agents
summary: Reliable deployment of LLM agents in user-facing products depends not on raw task-solving ability but on consistency and limit-awareness: behaving the same way across repeated trials, and recognizing when a request cannot, or cannot yet, be safely fulfilled. CAR-bench exposes this reliability gap in the domain of in-car assistants: an LLM-simulated user issues incomplete or ambiguous requests, requiring the agent to resolve uncertainty through multi-turn dialogue and tool use while strictly adhering to domain policies. Even frontier models show a substantial gap between what they can solve at least once (Pass@3) and what they solve consistently across trials (Pass^k). We bridge this gap with TRACE (TRAjectory-Contrastive Evolution), which iteratively improves a skill-based agent's behavioral knowledge without modifying model weights. This knowledge is organized as a Skill Bank of modular, retrievable skills, each encoding a self-contained set of tool-use rules and behavioral guidelines. TRACE evolves this bank through an agentic self-evolution loop: after each evaluation round, it groups trajectories by the skills invoked and refines each skill by contrasting successful and failed behaviors. The updated bank then guides subsequent rounds, while during deployment the Actor performs state-conditioned skill orchestration at every turn. On GPT-5.5, TRACE improves consistency (Pass^3) by 34.6 points, from 59.9% to 94.5%, while shrinking the gap between potential and reliable performance to just 4.0 points. On the official hidden set, TRACE achieved first place using GPT-5.6-Sol, attaining a Pass^3 score of 70%-a 40% relative improvement over the baseline. These results show that TRACE converts high model potential into stable, consistent performance gain. Project homepage: https://darwin-agent.github.io/Car-bench-TRACE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAR-bench基准测试和TRACE方法，解决车内助手场景下LLM智能体的可靠性问题（一致性与极限感知）。TRACE通过轨迹对比进化方式构建技能库，在不修改模型权重的情况下迭代改进智能体的行为知识，在GPT-5.5上将Pass^3一致性从59.9%提升至94.5%，在官方隐藏测试集上取得第一名。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在面向用户的产品中部署时，原始任务解决能力并非关键，一致性和极限感知（即在重复试验中表现一致、识别无法或暂不能安全完成的需求）才是可靠性的核心。现有模型存在"能解决一次"与"能稳定解决"之间的巨大差距，在车内助手这一高风险领域尤为突出。
AI.method: TRACE（TRAjectory-Contrastive Evolution）通过智能体自我进化循环迭代改进基于技能的智能体行为知识，无需修改模型权重。知识以技能库（Skill Bank）形式组织，包含模块化可检索的技能，每个技能编码一套工具使用规则和行为指南。每轮评估后按调用的技能对轨迹分组，通过对比成功与失败行为来细化每个技能，更新后的技能库指导后续轮次；部署时Actor在每一步执行状态条件技能编排。
