Cause, responsibility and accountability are then reported separately, each capped by an evidentiary tier, while a future research agenda is also provided.

AI.tldr: HANSARD是一个参考架构，将问责制视为生命周期属性，通过预封存的就绪档案、五个超出智能体范围的捕获点、类型化PROV-DM对齐因果图、事后重放的Halpern-Pearl因果判定以及协同剩余度量，解决自主多智能体系统中的"归因洗白"问题，使原因、责任和问责可以分离报告并由证据层级约束。
AI.motivation: 自主多智能体系统已应用于金融、软件供应链和安全运营等领域，且已出现AI编排的入侵活动。但现有方法存在根本缺陷：溯源取证在错误抽象层工作、形式因果假设因果模型已知、智能体审计信任自我记录。核心失败模式是"归因洗白"——行为在冗余智能体间分散直至无一构成but-for原因，且日志由嫌疑人自身产生，甚至记录基础设施可能共谋。
AI.method: 提出HANSARD参考架构，将问责作为生命周期属性处理，包含五个组件：(1) 运行前密封的就绪档案，约束事后可以主张的范围；(2) 在智能体不可及的五个扼流点捕获，使遗漏可检测而不仅是篡改可检测；(3) 运行期累积的类型化PROV-DM对齐因果图，用三个指标实时门控监督；(4) 事后重放在修改的Halpern-Pearl定义下产生条件效应和补偿集大小；(5) 协同剩余度量组合而非个体造成的伤害，使洗白可见。
AI.result: 该架构能够将原因、责任与问责分别报告，各自受证据层级上限约束，使归因洗白行为可见，并提供了未来研究议程。
AI.conclusion: HANSARD提供了一种将问责制嵌入系统生命周期、不依赖嫌疑人自记录可信性、能识别协同性伤害的方法，为自主多智能体系统的可靠追责奠定了基础，同时指出未来仍需进一步研究的方向。

title: Knowing Isn't Always Saying: When Do Spatial Encodings Reach Answers in Vision-Language Models?
comment: Accepted to appear in the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Vision-language models are known to encode spatial information in their hidden states, yet often fail to use it when answering. However, it remains unclear when and where this encoded information reaches the answer. We address this with direction patching, a class-conditioned causal intervention applied across layers, token positions, and prompt formats. Using spatial-ID directions constructed following prior encoding evidence, we find that causal influence on answer logits emerges only at mid-to-deep depths. Text chain-of-thought suppresses immediate object-word argmax-level transport in most models, while visually grounded prompts keep it open. Positive target-logit gain can remain below the argmax threshold, and transport can re-emerge at the final prefix token or at the answer step in deeper layers. Across the ten VLMs we study, these local effects form descriptive transport patterns. Complementary experiments characterize how these patterns shift across datasets, attributes, and encoding amplitudes. Together, these results reframe the encoding-grounding gap as a problem of conditional transport in VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过"方向修补"(direction patching)这一类条件因果干预方法，系统研究了视觉语言模型(VLM)中空间信息从编码到答案输出的"传输"(transport)过程，发现因果影响仅在中深层网络出现，文本思维链会抑制传输而视觉提示会保持传输开放，并在十个VLM上总结出描述性传输模式。
AI.motivation: 虽然已知VLM在隐藏状态中编码了空间信息，但往往无法在作答时使用这些信息（即"编码-落地差距"），然而这种信息在何时何地到达答案输出仍是未知的，需要因果层面的系统研究。
AI.method: 提出"方向修补"(direction patching)——一种类条件因果干预方法，跨层、跨token位置和跨提示格式进行干预。利用遵循先前编码证据构建的空间ID方向，对十个VLM进行系统分析。
AI.result: 因果影响仅在网络中间到深层出现；文本思维链在多数模型中抑制即时目标词argmax级传输，而视觉接地提示则保持该通道开放；正向目标logit增益可低于argmax阈值，传输可在最终前缀token或答案步骤的深层重新出现；这些局部效应在不同VLM中形成可描述的传输模式。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果将"编码-落地差距"重新定义为VLM中的条件传输问题，并揭示了传输何时、何处发生以及受何种因素调节的规律。

title: HeatTok: Enhancing Remote Sensing Image Understanding via Thermodiffusion-based Tokenization
comment: 19 pages (10 pages main text + appendix), 10 figures. Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026), Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, November 10--14, 2026
summary: Current visual tokenizers in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) predominantly rely on patch-based partitioning, which causes severe semantic mixture and object fragmentation in remote sensing imagery due to the irregular contours of geo-objects. Moreover, existing adaptive methods struggle to extract precise object-level tokens and lack dedicated geometric positional encodings for irregular regions. In this paper, we propose HeatTok, a semantic-aware tokenizer driven by thermodiffusion aggregation. Inspired by the physical principles of heat conduction, HeatTok adaptively merges adjacent homogeneous regions to generate semantically independent, object-aligned irregular tokens. To enable MLLMs to perceive these irregular shapes, we design the Gaussian Multimodal Rotary Positional Embedding (G-MRoPE), which models token spatial distributions via 2D Gaussians and explicitly injects center, scale, and orientation cues. Extensive evaluations on the VRSBench and EarthVQA datasets demonstrate that HeatTok effectively preserves object-level semantic integrity and achieves state-of-the-art performance under a reasonable token budget. The code is available: https://github.com/YingyingYan1/HeatTok.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HeatTok，一种基于热扩散聚合的语义感知分词器，通过物理热传导原理自适应合并相邻同质区域以生成语义独立、与地物对齐的不规则token，并设计了高斯多模态旋转位置编码（G-MRoPE）来建模不规则区域的几何位置信息，在VRSBench和EarthVQA数据集上取得最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型视觉分词器主要依赖基于patch的划分方式，在遥感影像中由于地物轮廓不规则，导致严重的语义混合和物体碎片化问题。此外，现有的自适应方法难以提取精确的物体级token，且缺乏针对不规则区域的专用几何位置编码。
AI.method: 提出HeatTok作为核心方法，受热传导物理原理启发，通过热扩散聚合自适应合并相邻同质区域，生成语义独立、与物体对齐的不规则token；同时设计G-MRoPE（高斯多模态旋转位置编码），利用2D高斯分布建模token空间分布，显式注入中心、尺度和方向线索。
AI.result: 在VRSBench和EarthVQA数据集上的广泛评估表明，HeatTok能有效保留物体级语义完整性，并在合理的token预算下取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: HeatTok通过热扩散驱动的语义感知分词策略，成功解决了遥感影像中patch-based分词导致的语义混合与物体碎片化问题，为MLLM在遥感场景中的视觉理解提供了更优的token化方案。

title: BLADE: Bilevel Low-rank Augmented-Lagrangian Erasure for LLM Unlearning
summary: Existing LLM unlearning methods struggle with robustness: unbounded forget losses degrade model coherence, fixed-weight balancing cannot adapt as retain difficulty shifts mid-training, and methods that work on one benchmark falter under scaling or repeated application. We propose BLADE, a constrained bilevel framework whose three mechanisms give smooth, predictable control over the optimization landscape: a clamped-entropy forget loss whose gradient is exactly zero once a token reaches sufficient uncertainty; an asymmetric augmented Lagrangian that permanently ratchets retain protection after any violation; and a bilevel structure confined to LoRA adapters that repairs retain damage before each forgetting step. BLADE dominates across three benchmark families, improving average composite scores over the strongest baselines by $6$% on TOFU, $9$% on MUSE Books, and $7$% on KnowUndo, and it remains stable under $4\times$ scaling and $4$ sequential unlearning steps on MUSE News where the best competing method collapses entirely.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BLADE，一个约束双层优化框架，通过夹紧熵遗忘损失、非对称增广拉格朗日和限于LoRA适配器的双层结构，实现对LLM遗忘任务的平滑可控优化，在三个基准上超越最强基线6%-9%，并在4倍缩放和4次连续遗忘下保持稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法缺乏鲁棒性：无界遗忘损失会降低模型连贯性，固定权重平衡无法适应训练中保留难度变化，且在不同基准、缩放或重复应用下表现不稳定。
AI.method: BLADE包含三个机制：(1) 夹紧熵遗忘损失，当token达到足够不确定性时梯度精确为零；(2) 非对称增广拉格朗日，永久提升违规后的保留保护；(3) 限于LoRA适配器的双层结构，在每次遗忘步骤前修复保留损伤。
AI.result: BLADE在三个基准家族上优于最强基线：TOFU提高6%，MUSE Books提高9%，KnowUndo提高7%；在MUSE News上，4倍缩放和4次连续遗忘步骤下保持稳定，而最强竞争方法完全崩溃。
AI.conclusion: BLADE通过约束优化与自适应机制解决了LLM遗忘的鲁棒性问题，在性能和稳定性上均显著超越现有方法。

title: CONTRAMEM: Learning Self-Evolving Procedural Memory from Contrasting Multi-Model Trajectories
summary: Autonomous computer-use agents are increasingly applied to long-horizon tasks requiring coordinated application calls, persistent state tracking, and verifier-sensitive writes, yet they remain prone to procedural failures: misreading application state, tool semantics, or task progress. Procedural memory promises more consistent decisions and less redundant exploration, but constructing high-quality memory without model training remains challenging. We introduce CONTRAMEM, a source-flexible, training-free framework for self-evolving procedural memory that treats same-task outcome variation as supervision: differences in correctness, efficiency, recovery, and failure modes expose outcome-relevant procedural distinctions, distilled into a compact bank of app-level Function Cards and task-level Skill Cards that evolves through localized curation rather than append-only accumulation or whole-bank rewriting. On held-out GAIA2/ARE computer-use tasks, CONTRAMEM more than doubles the success rate across the three source-model targets (26.2% to 55.3%), with consistent per-model gains (GPT-5.5: 27.5 to 61.0; Claude Sonnet 4.6: 28.0 to 52.5; DeepSeek V4 Pro: 23.0 to 52.5). The same bank transfers unchanged to the unseen Qwen3.7 Plus (18.5 to 35.5), indicating transferable procedural knowledge rather than model-specific behavior. The same construction carries over unchanged to AppWorld, beating both no memory and its own single-source self-memory variant for all three mid-tier agents on both public test splits. Under a matched trajectory budget, heterogeneous multi-model trajectories yield stronger memory than self- or same-model multi-rollout memory: the margin comes from contrastive behavioral diversity, not stronger source agents or more sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CONTRAMEM，一个无需训练的自我演化程序性记忆框架，通过将同任务结果的差异（正确性、效率、恢复、失败模式）作为监督信号，提炼出应用级功能卡和任务级技能卡，利用局部策展而非全量重写实现记忆演化。在 GAIA2/ARE 任务上成功率提升超过一倍（26.2%→55.3%），且记忆库可直接迁移到未见模型，在 AppWorld 上也表现优异。
AI.motivation: 自主计算机使用智能体在长时程任务中容易出错（误读应用状态、工具语义或任务进度），现有程序性记忆虽能提升决策一致性并减少冗余探索，但构建高质量记忆通常依赖模型训练，成本高昂且难以扩展。
AI.method: 将同任务的不同结果变体视为监督信号：利用正确性、效率、恢复和失败模式的差异来暴露与结果相关的程序性区别，将其提炼为紧凑的"功能卡"（应用级）和"技能卡"（任务级）库，通过局部策展机制演化记忆，而非简单追加或整个库重写。
AI.result: 在 GAIA2/ARE 任务上，CONTRAMEM 使三个源模型目标的成功率从 26.2% 提升至 55.3%（GPT-5.5: 27.5→61.0; Claude Sonnet 4.6: 28.0→52.5; DeepSeek V4 Pro: 23.0→52.5）。记忆库无需修改即可迁移到未见模型 Qwen3.7 Plus（18.5→35.5）。在 AppWorld 上对所有中端智能体的两个公共测试集均优于无记忆和单源自记忆基线。异构多模型轨迹在匹配轨迹预算下产生比自我或同模型多次采样更强的记忆。
AI.conclusion: CONTRAMEM 证明无需模型训练即可构建高质量、可迁移的程序性记忆，且异构多模型轨迹的对比性行为多样性（而非更强的源智能体或更多采样）是记忆质量的关键。

title: Learning Sample-wise Rank-aware Interpolation Weights for Composed Visual Data Retrieval
summary: At the heart of composed visual data retrieval is the fusion of a reference visual input and a textual modification into a single query. While current state-of-the-art methods utilize multimodal large language models for this fusion, their complexity introduces prohibitive querytime latency, limiting their scalability. We instead revisit the efficacy of simple linear interpolation within an embedding space, and introduce SRAIN, the first framework that dynamically predicts query-specific interpolation weights. The key challenge lies in the fact that the quality of an interpolation weight should be measured by the interpolated embedding's discriminability from negatives as well as its proximity to true targets; this makes collecting and predicting optimal weights intractable. We overcome this bottleneck through two key innovations: batch-wise rank-aware weight estimation during training, and a compact memory bank that synthesizes hard negatives during inference. SRAIN achieves the best in composed video retrieval and matches the current state of the art in composed image retrieval, all while substantially reducing querytime latency compared to MLLM-based alternatives.

AI.tldr: SRAIN是一个用于组合视觉检索的轻量级框架，通过动态预测查询特定的线性插值权重，在嵌入空间中融合参考视觉输入和文本修改，取得了与基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）方法相当甚至更优的性能，同时显著降低了查询延迟。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的组合视觉检索方法依赖多模态大语言模型进行视觉和文本的融合，虽然性能优异，但带来了高昂的查询时间延迟，限制了可扩展性。作者希望回归简单的嵌入空间线性插值方法，但如何动态确定最优插值权重是一个关键挑战——最优权重需要同时满足与负样本的可区分性和与真实目标的高接近度，这使得收集和预测最优权重变得困难。
AI.method: SRAIN框架包含两个核心创新：(1) 训练阶段采用批量感知的排序感知权重估计（batch-wise rank-aware weight estimation），用于学习如何预测查询特定的插值权重；(2) 推理阶段使用紧凑的记忆库（memory bank）合成难负样本（hard negatives），以增强插值嵌入的判别能力。整个框架在嵌入空间中进行简单线性插值，避免了复杂的MLLM推理。
AI.result: SRAIN在组合视频检索任务上取得了最佳性能，在组合图像检索任务上与当前最先进方法持平，同时相比基于MLLM的替代方案大幅降低了查询时间延迟。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了在嵌入空间中进行简单线性插值并动态预测权重，足以在组合视觉检索中达到与复杂MLLM方法相当的性能，同时提供了显著更好的推理效率，为组合检索提供了更加可扩展的解决方案。

title: Clinical Graph-JEPA: Predictive Patient-State Knowledge Graphs for Cognitive Decision Support
summary: Clinical records contain rich evidence about patient state, but converting that evidence into reliable, structured knowledge graphs remains difficult because extraction errors, ontology mismatch, missing relations, and temporal ambiguity can propagate into downstream systems. We propose a clinical knowledge graph construction and refinement framework that combines multi-agent relation proposal, ontology-aware normalization, deterministic evidence scoring, and JEPA-based latent refinement. Rather than treating a clinical knowledge graph as a static extraction artifact, we treat it as a predictive patient-state representation. For each admission, the system constructs an evidence-scored graph from structured MIMIC-IV records and inferred clinical cross-links, then learns to recover held-out clinical relations from the observed graph context. We evaluate the refiner with leakage-free leave-one-out edge recovery (MRR and Hits@k) and held-out batch-mask evaluation (AUC and MRR). To isolate the contribution of discharge-note context, we compare a note-embedding-free configuration with a note-augmented configuration that injects real discharge-note representations only into note-grounded entities. Under the same cohort and evaluation protocol, entity-grounded note injection improves overall leave-one-out MRR by 31% relative improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个临床知识图谱构建与精炼框架，融合多智能体关系提议、本体感知归一化、确定性证据评分和JEPA潜在精炼，将临床知识图谱视为预测性患者状态表征而非静态提取产物。在MIMIC-IV数据上，通过注入出院笔记表示，leave-one-out MRR相对提升31%。
AI.motivation: 临床记录包含丰富的患者状态证据，但将其转换为可靠的结构化知识图谱存在困难，包括提取错误、本体不匹配、缺失关系和时序歧义等问题，这些问题会在下游系统中传播放大。
AI.method: 提出一个四层框架：(1)多智能体关系提议；(2)本体感知归一化；(3)确定性证据评分；(4)基于JEPA的潜在精炼。系统为每次入院构建证据评分的图谱，并学习从观测图上下文中恢复被保留的临床关系。采用无泄漏的留一法边恢复和批掩码评估，并比较无笔记嵌入与注入真实出院笔记表示的两种配置。
AI.result: 实体锚定的笔记注入在相同队列和评估协议下，使整体留一法MRR相对提升31%。
AI.conclusion: 将临床知识图谱作为预测性患者状态表征，结合笔记上下文注入，能显著提升关系恢复性能，证明了临床知识图谱精炼的有效性。

title: STAGE: Stateful Translation to Agentic Graph Execution with Policy-Scoped Context and Deterministic Control
summary: Policy-governed agents must interpret case evidence while following an authorized procedure. We present \textsc{Stage}, an executable-graph framework that confines model judgment to policy-scoped nodes while placing procedural control in deterministic code. At each node, the model receives task-relevant policy context and returns a typed result, while the coordinator enforces the reviewed execution contract. We evaluate \textsc{Stage} on SOP-Bench Referral Abuse, two $τ^2$-bench domains, and Smart Dispute, a proprietary banking benchmark. Compared with monolithic full-policy execution, \textsc{Stage} generally improves task success and repeated-run reliability across workflows of varying procedural complexity. The largest gains occur on the deeper Telecom and Smart Dispute workflows, where $\mathrm{Pass}^3$ increases by 7.5--55.0 and 57.2--65.7 percentage points, respectively, depending on the model. These results show that combining policy-scoped context with deterministic procedural control can improve the reliability of policy execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Stage 框架，一种可执行图框架，将模型判断限制在策略范围内的节点中，而将程序控制交给确定性代码。在多个基准（SOP-Bench Referral Abuse、两个 τ²-bench 领域以及专有银行基准 Smart Dispute）上，相比完整的全策略执行，Stage 通常能提升任务成功率与重复运行可靠性，尤其在更深的工作流中提升显著。
AI.motivation: 策略驱动的智能体需要在遵循授权程序的同时解释案件证据，但现有的全策略执行方式在复杂流程中容易出错且不可靠，缺乏将模型判断与程序控制分离的机制。
AI.method: Stage 采用可执行图框架：每个节点限制模型在策略范围内的判断并返回类型化结果，协调器（coordinator）负责执行已审查的契约，将策略范围内的上下文与确定性程序控制相结合。
AI.result: 在 SOP-Bench Referral Abuse、两个 τ²-bench 领域和 Smart Dispute 基准上，Stage 相比全策略执行普遍提升任务成功率与重复运行可靠性。最大增益在更深的 Telecom 和 Smart Dispute 工作流中，Pass³ 分别提升 7.5–55.0 和 57.2–65.7 个百分点（取决于模型）。
AI.conclusion: 将策略范围内的上下文与确定性程序控制相结合，可以显著提升策略执行的可靠性，尤其是在流程更深、更复杂的场景中效果最为突出。

title: HelaBERT: Enhancing Sinhala Language Understanding with Dual Pooling Classification Head
summary: We present HelaBERT, a family of two BERT-based masked language models pre-trained from scratch on approximately 1 billion tokens of Sinhala text sourced from MADLAD-400, CulturaX, and a custom corpus comprising news articles, Sinhala Wikipedia, and web crawl data. HelaBERT-Small (~23.3M parameters, 6 layers) and HelaBERT-Large (~110M parameters, 12 layers) both use a SentencePiece Unigram tokenizer (vocabulary size 32,000) tailored to Sinhala's agglutinative morphology and complex script. We evaluate both models on four downstream Sinhala text classification tasks: news category classification, news source classification, sentiment analysis, and writing style classification, using 5 independent seed runs with stratified 80/20 train/test splits. We additionally propose a dual pooling classification head and evaluate it systematically across all four tasks, finding consistent improvements on sentiment analysis and a moderate gain on news category classification for HelaBERT-Small, while the standard [CLS]-linear head remains competitive on news source classification, a headline-level task with short average input length. We release both models to support further research in Sinhala NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HelaBERT，一个包含两个基于BERT的Sinhala语掩码语言模型家族（Small约23.3M参数/6层，Large约110M参数/12层），在大约10亿token的Sinhala文本上从零预训练，使用专为Sinhala黏着语形态和复杂文字定制的SentencePiece Unigram分词器（词表32,000）。作者在四个下游文本分类任务上评估模型，并提出了双池化分类头，实验表明其在情感分析和新闻分类任务上有持续改进。
AI.motivation: Sinhala语（斯里兰卡官方语言）作为低资源语言，缺乏专门预训练的语言模型。现有多语言模型对其覆盖不足，且Sinhala的黏着语形态和复杂文字系统使得对通用分词器提出挑战，因此需要构建专门针对Sinhala的预训练语言模型。
AI.method: 1）从MADLAD-400、CulturaX和自定义语料（新闻、维基百科、网页抓取）收集约10亿token的Sinhala文本；2）使用SentencePiece Unigram分词器（词表32,000）适配Sinhala的粘着语形态和复杂文字；3）从零预训练两个BERT模型（Small 6层/23.3M参数，Large 12层/110M参数）；4）提出双池化分类头（dual pooling classification head）用于下游任务；5）在四个分类任务上使用5个独立种子运行（80/20分层划分）进行系统评估。
AI.result: 双池化分类头在情感分析任务上表现出一致的改进，在HelaBERT-Small的新闻类别分类上有中等程度的提升；而标准的[CLS]-线性头在新闻来源分类（一个平均输入长度较短的标题级任务）上仍具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: HelaBERT为Sinhala语NLP提供了专用的预训练模型资源，双池化分类头在部分任务上展现了优势，模型已公开发布以支持Sinhala NLP的进一步研究。

title: TRACE: Temporal Retrieval with Anchored and Convergent Evidence for Long-Horizon Video Understanding
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 19 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://buaa-colalab.github.io/TRACE/
summary: A long-video answer is evidence-supported only when the frames decoded from the video cover every event the answer depends on. Existing evaluations score final-answer correctness or predicted evidence intervals, but the frames a method decodes before answering are rarely audited, so correct answers can still rest on incomplete observation. We introduce VES-Bench, a 600-question benchmark of Temporal Ordering and Event Counting items over 348 public long videos. Each item carries a jointly necessary set of evidence intervals, letting us audit at three strictness levels whether a method's decoded frames cover every one of them. We also propose TRACE, a training-free agent that grounds answers in raw visual clips, builds an evidence bundle round by round, and stops only when the answer stabilises as the bundle grows and a final pass over the same clips returns the same answer. Under a same-backbone audit, TRACE answers 50.7% of questions correctly with at least two decoded frames inside every evidence interval, at 98.7 frames per question: over 10 points above uniform decoding at 128 frames (40.2%), and within 2.6 points of uniform decoding at 256 frames at 0.39x its frame cost, while reaching the highest answer accuracy in the audit (63.5%). TRACE also stays competitive on Video-MME (86.1), LVBench (75.6), and LongVideoBench (75.1).

AI.tldr: 本文提出VES-Bench基准测试（600个问题，覆盖348个长视频的时间排序和事件计数任务），用于审计长视频理解方法在回答前解码的视频帧是否覆盖所有必要证据区间。同时提出TRACE方法，一种无需训练的智能体，通过逐轮构建证据包并仅当答案稳定时停止，在相同骨干网络下达到50.7%正确率（每问题98.7帧），显著优于均匀解码，并在Video-MME、LVBench和LongVideoBench上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答评估只关注最终答案正确性或预测的证据区间，但很少审计方法在回答前实际解码的帧。因此，即使答案正确，也可能基于不完整的视频观察（帧缺失），导致评估结果不可靠。需要一个能审计解码帧是否覆盖所有必要证据的基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建VES-Bench：600题基准，包含时间排序和事件计数任务，覆盖348个公开长视频，每道题标注了联合必要的证据区间，并设计了三个严格级别的审计标准。2) 提出TRACE：无训练智能体，在原始视觉片段上建立依据，逐轮构建证据包，仅当答案随证据包增长而稳定且对同一批片段进行最终复查仍得到相同答案时才停止解码。
AI.result: 在同一骨干网络审计下，TRACE达到50.7%的正确率且每个证据区间内至少有2个解码帧，每问题仅用98.7帧；比128帧均匀解码（40.2%）高10个点以上，比256帧均匀解码（0.39倍帧成本）仅低2.6个点，且达到最高答案准确率63.5%。TRACE在Video-MME（86.1）、LVBench（75.6）和LongVideoBench（75.1）上也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 长视频答案的正确性需要以充分的视觉证据为前提，不能仅凭最终答案正确性评估。VES-Bench提供了新的审计范式，TRACE证明了通过证据驱动的自适应解码可以在更少的帧成本下获得更可靠的长视频理解答案，为长视频问答评估和高效解码树立了新标杆。

title: GCA: Global Centroid Alignment in Federated Learning
summary: Autoencoder (AE)-based federated learning (FL) is attractive for anomaly detection when clients have limited local data. However, conventional FL exchanges AE parameters or gradients, incurring substantial communication overhead and potentially exposing input training data information, since AEs are explicitly optimized to reconstruct their inputs. We introduce \emph{Global Centroid Alignment (GCA)}, a latent-code-mediated FL protocol that coordinates clients without transmitting AE parameters or gradients. In each round, (1) clients first train their local AEs using a \emph{reconstruction} update and upload a small subset of encoder latent codes to the FL server. (2) The server pools these codes, fits a clustering model, and broadcasts only \emph{global latent centroids and their support counts}. (3) Each client then updates its encoder by aligning its local latent codes with the \emph{nearest} centroid using \emph{inverse-count} weighting to emphasize globally underrepresented patterns. Steps (1)--(3) repeat over communication rounds. Because GCA exchanges only sampled latent codes and centroid statistics, its communication cost depends on latent dimensionality and the numbers of uploaded codes and returned centroids rather than on AE model size. Across five tabular and two vision benchmarks, GCA yields higher reconstruction error under a server-side client data extraction attack in all 21 comparisons and clearly lower cosine similarity in 20 of 21 comparisons with FedAvg, FedProx, and FedNova, showing its ability to protect training data. It even improves test accuracy over FedAvg by up to $5.76\%$. GCA achieves extraction defense comparable to DP-FedAvg, remains effective when DP-FedAvg does not reduce target resemblance, and lowers per-round communication by up to $99.15\%$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出全局质心对齐（GCA），一种基于隐码传递的联邦学习协议，用于自编码器异常检测。GCA不传输AE参数或梯度，而是通过上传隐码、服务器端聚类并广播全局质心、客户端对齐更新三个步骤协作训练，大幅降低通信开销（最高降低99.15%）并有效抵御训练数据提取攻击，在21项对比中均表现出更优的数据保护能力。
AI.motivation: 传统基于自编码器的联邦学习需要交换AE参数或梯度，存在两大问题：(1)通信开销巨大；(2)由于AE本身被优化为重建输入，其参数可能泄露客户端训练数据信息。在客户端本地数据有限的情况下，这些问题尤为突出。
AI.method: GCA协议每轮包含三个步骤：(1)客户端用重建损失训练本地AE，上传少量编码器隐码；(2)服务器汇集隐码、拟合聚类模型，只广播全局隐质心及其支持计数；(3)客户端用逆计数加权将本地隐码与最近质心对齐，更新编码器。多轮重复此过程。通信成本仅取决于隐维度、上传码数及返回质心数，与AE模型大小无关。
AI.result: 在5个表格基准和2个视觉基准上，GCA在21项对比中均比FedAvg、FedProx、FedNova产生更高的重建误差（防御提取攻击更强），20/21项对比中余弦相似度明显更低；测试准确率比FedAvg最高提升5.76%；提取防御效果可与DP-FedAvg相当，甚至在DP-FedAvg失效时仍有效；每轮通信量最高降低99.15%。
AI.conclusion: GCA通过仅交换隐码与质心统计信息，成功实现了低通信开销、强数据隐私保护的联邦自编码器训练，为资源受限且隐私敏感场景下的联邦异常检测提供了有效方案。

title: Scaling Curriculum Learning For Autonomous Driving
comment: 31 pages, 18 figures. Under review at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Batched simulators for autonomous driving have recently enabled training reinforcement learning (RL) agents at scale, encompassing thousands of traffic scenarios and billions of interactions within a matter of days. Although such high-throughput feeds RL algorithms faster than ever, their sample-efficiency has not kept pace: As the standard training scheme, domain randomization uniformly samples scenarios, thereby consuming a vast number of interactions on cases that contribute little to learning. Curriculum learning offers a remedy by adaptively prioritizing scenarios that matter most to policy improvement. We present CL4AD, the first integration of curriculum learning into batched autonomous driving simulators by framing scenario selection as an unsupervised environment design problem. We introduce utility functions that shape curricula based on success rates and the realism of the agent's behavior, in addition to existing regret-estimation functions. Large-scale experiments in GPUDRIVE demonstrate that curriculum learning achieves a 99% success rate a billion steps earlier than domain randomization, reducing wall-clock time by 77%, and outperforms heuristic curricula with static and dynamic attributes, with only one exception at the largest scale. An ablation under limited compute shows that curriculum learning improves sample efficiency by 67%. We also investigate how utility functions behave at scale, and how prioritized scenarios evolve during training. We release an implementation of CLForAD in GPUDRIVE.

AI.tldr: CL4AD是首个将课程学习集成到批量自动驾驶模拟器中的方法，将场景选择建模为无监督环境设计问题，通过成功率、行为真实性和遗憾估计等效用函数塑造课程。在GPUDRIVE中大规模实验表明，课程学习比域随机化提前10亿步达到99%成功率，减少77%墙钟时间，样本效率提升67%。
AI.motivation: 批量自动驾驶模拟器虽然能以高吞吐量训练强化学习智能体，但标准训练方案（域随机化）均匀采样场景，浪费大量交互在贡献甚微的案例上，导致样本效率低下。需要一种自适应优先选择对策略改进最重要场景的方法。
AI.method: 将场景选择框架化为无监督环境设计问题，提出三类效用函数：基于成功率的效用、基于智能体行为真实性的效用，以及现有的遗憾估计函数，用以动态塑造课程并优先选择对学习最有价值的场景。
AI.result: 在GPUDRIVE中的大规模实验表明：课程学习比域随机化提前10亿步达到99%成功率，减少77%墙钟时间；与静态和动态属性的启发式课程相比表现更优（仅在最大规模下有一例例外）；在有限计算下的消融实验中样本效率提升67%。
AI.conclusion: CL4AD证明了课程学习在批量自动驾驶模拟中的有效性，显著提升样本效率和训练速度。作者还分析了效用函数在大规模下的行为及优先场景在训练中的演化，并开源了实现。

title: What Proves You Wrong: Benchmarking Language Models on Falsifiable Research Ideation
comment: Equal contribution by Ziyue Wang, Aomufei Yuan and Yiran Yao. Corresponding authors: Tong Yang and Xu Sun
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to propose research ideas, yet the prevailing ways of judging such ideas supply no shared decision rule: free-form judging sways with style and position, and scoring against a later paper rewards recovery of one realized trajectory. We introduce a benchmark that carries a proposal from Literature to Test: the Lit2Test benchmark centers on a six-field contract organized around a falsifying outcome, so that every proposal precommits the observation that would prove it wrong, making its quality decidable in the first place rather than merely arguable. Built prospectively from 200 real-paper neighborhoods, Lit2Test elicits proposals from four frontier models and compares them through 1,200 pairwise comparisons judged blind in both presentation orders. The protocol audits its own reliability through diagnostic controls and bounded human calibration, with three annotators corroborating the conclusions within explicitly stated reliability bounds. Lit2Test recovers a strict ranking of the four models in all 10,000 bootstrap replicates, and the separation comes from the quality of the proposed tests and metrics rather than from surface fluency. We release the benchmark, construction pipeline, and audit artifacts for public use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Lit2Test基准，通过六字段契约要求每个研究提案预先承诺可证伪的结果，从而让提案质量可判定而非仅可争论。基于200个真实论文邻域前瞻性构建，对4个前沿模型的提案进行1,200次成对盲评，并通过诊断控制和有界人类校准确保可靠性。结果显示模型间有严格排名，差异源于测试与指标质量而非表面流畅度。
AI.motivation: 现有评价LLM研究提案的方法缺乏共享决策规则：自由形式评判易受风格和位置影响，而与后续论文对照的评分只能奖励对单一实现轨迹的还原，无法真正衡量提案质量。
AI.method: 构建Lit2Test基准：围绕可证伪结果设计六字段契约，使每份提案预先承诺能证明其错误的观察；从200个真实论文邻域前瞻性收集提案；对4个模型进行1,200次成对盲评（两种呈现顺序）；通过诊断控制和有界人类校准（3位标注者）审计可靠性。
AI.result: Lit2Test在全部10,000次bootstrap重采样中恢复了4个模型的严格排名；模型间差异主要来自提案中的测试和指标质量，而非表面流畅度。
AI.conclusion: 通过让提案预先承诺可证伪的结果，可以建立可判定、可审计的研究提案评价标准，为LLM研究提案评估提供可靠方案，并公开发布基准、构建流程和审计产物。

title: VISTA: Test-Time Compositional Alignment for Visual Autoregressive Generation
summary: Visual autoregressive (VAR) models have emerged as a fast, high-quality alternative to diffusion for text-to-image generation, but like diffusion models they exhibit persistent compositional failures, producing images that violate the attribute bindings and spatial relations specified in the prompt. While a rich line of test-time alignment methods has developed for diffusion, no comparable approach exists for next-scale VAR generation, whose stateful, discrete, multi-resolution sampling process makes existing techniques inapplicable. We close this gap with \textbf{VISTA} (\textbf{Vi}sual Autoregressive \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{T}est-time \textbf{A}lignment), the first gradient-based test-time alignment framework for next-scale autoregressive image generation. Built on Infinity, VISTA intervenes directly in the generation process, optimizing intermediate representations through the frozen transformer to steer visual predictions toward compositional constraints, without modifying model parameters or requiring additional training. VISTA introduces the mechanisms needed to make such optimization stable across scales, together with an extensible objective space that any differentiable constraint on cross-attention can plug into. Across two benchmarks and two model scales, VISTA improves every targeted compositional category, raising the mean targeted score by nearly 20\% on a 2B backbone and almost 6\% on an 8B backbone, with the largest gains on spatial relations. Image quality is preserved: an independent preference model VISTA never optimizes scores its outputs nearly 20\% higher. Notably, the 2B model with VISTA surpasses a backbone four times its size, indicating that a substantial part of the compositional gap between model scales is recoverable at test time.

AI.tldr: VISTA是首个面向next-scale自回归图像生成的梯度式测试时对齐框架，通过冻结Transformer优化中间表征以引导视觉预测满足组合约束，无需修改参数或额外训练，在多个基准上将组合得分提升近20%（2B）和6%（8B），且2B模型可超越4倍规模的骨干模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉自回归（VAR）模型已成为扩散模型的快速高质量替代方案，但与扩散模型一样存在持久的组合失败问题，难以满足提示词中的属性绑定和空间关系。虽然扩散模型已有丰富的测试时对齐方法，但尚无适用于next-scale VAR生成的类似方法，因为其有状态、离散、多分辨率的采样过程使现有技术无法适用。
AI.method: VISTA基于Infinity构建，直接在生成过程中干预，通过冻结的Transformer优化中间表征，将视觉预测引导向组合约束。它引入了跨尺度优化稳定性所需的机制，并提供了可扩展的目标空间，任何可微分的交叉注意力约束都可以接入其中。
AI.result: 在两个基准和两个模型规模上，VISTA提升了所有目标组合类别，2B骨干平均目标得分提升近20%，8B骨干提升近6%，空间关系提升最大。图像质量保持良好，独立偏好模型评分提升近20%。2B模型加VISTA超越了4倍规模骨干模型。
AI.conclusion: 模型规模之间的组合能力差距很大一部分可以在测试时恢复，VISTA表明测试时对齐是提升VAR组合生成能力的有效途径，且无需修改模型参数或额外训练。

title: Tabular foundation models for non-tabular tasks
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for machine learning on tabular data, offering the ability to generalize across datasets without task-specific training. Since many machine learning datasets can be represented as tables, this raises the question: does TFM capability extend beyond tasks traditionally regarded as tabular? We address this question by using TabPFN v3 on three non-tabular classification problems: handwritten digit recognition on MNIST, language identification of French and German words, and image classification on Tiny ImageNet. In each case, the original data are represented as rows of a table and classification is formulated as prediction of a missing label. We evaluate performance as a function of the number of context samples provided to the pretrained model, with no additional training or fine-tuning. Despite having no explicit access to the spatial or sequential structure characterizing the data, TabPFN v3 in some cases achieves accuracies comparable with that of models or methods geared specifically toward the corresponding tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨表格基础模型（TFM）TabPFN v3是否能在非表格任务（MNIST手写数字识别、法语/德语词汇语言识别、Tiny ImageNet图像分类）上表现出色。通过将原始数据表示为表格行、将分类问题表述为缺失标签预测，仅依赖预训练模型的上下文样本，无需额外训练或微调，结果显示TabPFN v3在某些情况下达到了与专用模型相当甚至可比的准确率。
AI.motivation: 由于许多机器学习数据集可以表示为表格，研究者想知道表格基础模型（TFM）的能力是否超越了传统意义上的表格任务，从而探索TFM作为通用学习器的潜力边界。
AI.method: 使用TabPFN v3处理三类非表格分类问题（MNIST、法德词汇语言识别、Tiny ImageNet），将原始数据转化为表格行表示，将分类形式化为缺失标签预测，通过变化上下文样本数量来评估性能，且不进行任何额外训练或微调。
AI.result: 尽管TabPFN v3无法显式访问数据中的空间或序列结构，但它在某些任务上达到了与针对特定任务设计的模型或方法相当的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 表格基础模型的能力可能具有一定通用性，即使在没有显式结构信息访问的条件下，也能在非表格任务上表现出竞争力，但泛化程度因任务而异。

title: The Illusion of Control: Why Bare Classifier Inversion Silently Fails in Concept-Bottleneck Text Generation
summary: Concept-bottleneck controllable generation routes multi-attribute control through a low-dimensional concept code that, at deployment, must be synthesised from a target attribute configuration. We study this problem in concept-bottleneck text generation under multi-axis compositional generalisation, comparing three ways to obtain the inference-time code: classifier inversion against the encoder heads, reference-text encoding, and a post-hoc label-conditioned prior. Since a concept code admits no direct LM-fluency term, regularising inversion must instead constrain the code toward the encoder's training distribution. We therefore test bare inversion and three regularised variants: label-agnostic and label-conditioned Mahalanobis penalties, and a conditional normalising-flow density baseline. Every inversion variant we test underperforms a simple post-hoc prior fitted to per-combination encoder means on the same checkpoints, across three backbone families spanning $124$M to $8$B parameters. The bare form of classifier inversion also silently collapses to chance, traceable to a directly measured off-manifold code. We validate this diagnosis on real-world benchmarks and under external evaluators, enabling fair comparison with published baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究概念瓶颈可控生成中推理时代码的获取问题，比较了分类器反转、参考文本编码和后验标签条件先验三种方法。发现所有反转变体均不如简单后验先验，且裸反转会因离流形代码而退化至随机水平。
AI.motivation: 概念瓶颈可控生成在部署时需从目标属性配置合成概念代码，但该代码不允许直接的LM流畅度项，需对反转进行正则化以约束代码趋于编码器的训练分布。作者旨在系统比较不同推理时代码获取方式在多轴组合泛化下的表现。
AI.method: 在概念瓶颈文本生成框架下，测试三类推理时代码获取方式：分类器反转（含裸反转及三种正则化变体：标签无关/标签条件Mahalanobis惩罚、条件正态化流密度基线）、参考文本编码、后验标签条件先验。实验覆盖三个骨干族，参数量从124M到8B。
AI.result: 所有反转变体均不如简单拟合到每种组合编码器均值的后验先验。裸分类器反转会静默崩溃至随机水平，根源是可直接测量的离流形（off-manifold）代码。该诊断在真实世界基准和外部评估者下得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 在概念瓶颈可控生成中，简单的后验标签条件先验优于复杂的分类器反转方法，反转方法的退化源于离流形代码问题，为后续研究提供了公平比较的基准。

title: RS$^3$-Prune: Read-Sparse, Store-Sparse Token Pruning for Video Object Segmentation
summary: We introduce RS$^3$-Prune, a training-free token-pruning recipe that instantiates as a small set of inference time hooks atop existing video object segmentation (VOS) networks. Modern VOS models have converged on a common, expensive design: an image encoder produces a dense token grid for every frame, and a memory bank accumulates these tokens across all previously processed frames to condition future predictions. As a video grows longer, the resulting token budget governs both per-frame latency and peak GPU memory. Hence these models break on use cases such as --- long-form video or real-time deployment on memory-bounded accelerators. In this work we argue that the right axis along which to compress memory-bank VOS is the token budget itself. RS$^3$-Prune operates in two precise locations within an arbitrary memory-bank VOS pipeline: at the boundary between the image encoder and the memory-attention readout, where we restrict the queries that participate in the cross-frame attention to only a small, geometrically informed subset; and at the boundary between the memory encoder and the memory bank, where we restrict which tokens are ever permitted to enter the bank to those that lie within the object's spatial extent. Over various established benchmarks, RS$^3$-Prune delivers up to $38.8\%$ FPS speedup and reduces $13.1\%$ peak memory usage, while preserving a competitive $\mathcal{J}$&$\mathcal{F}$ compared to the unmodified VOS networks.

AI.tldr: RS³-Prune 是一种免训练的 token 剪枝方法，在现有视频对象分割（VOS）网络上以少量推理时钩子的形式工作。它在两个关键位置进行压缩：图像编码器与记忆注意力读出之间（限制参与跨帧注意力的查询为几何信息丰富的子集），以及记忆编码器与记忆库之间（仅允许对象空间范围内的 token 进入记忆库）。实验表明，该方法在保持竞争力的 J&F 指标同时，可实现最高 38.8% 的 FPS 加速和 13.1% 的峰值内存节省。
AI.motivation: 现代 VOS 模型采用昂贵的统一设计：图像编码器为每帧生成密集 token 网格，记忆库跨帧累积 token 以指导未来预测。随着视频变长，token 预算支配每帧延迟和峰值 GPU 内存，导致模型在长视频或内存受限的实时部署场景中失效。作者认为正确的压缩轴线就是 token 预算本身。
AI.method: RS³-Prune 在任意记忆库 VOS 管道的两个精确位置运行：(1) 图像编码器与记忆注意力读出之间的边界——仅允许一小部分几何信息丰富的查询参与跨帧注意力；(2) 记忆编码器与记忆库之间的边界——仅允许位于对象空间范围内的 token 进入记忆库。该方法为训练无关的推理时钩子，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在多个既有基准上，RS³-Prune 实现了最高 38.8% 的 FPS 加速，减少 13.1% 的峰值内存使用，同时与未修改的 VOS 网络相比保持有竞争力的 J&F 性能。
AI.conclusion: RS³-Prune 证明通过在 token 预算层面进行巧妙的、基于几何信息的剪枝，可以在不牺牲太多分割精度的情况下显著提升 VOS 模型的推理速度和内存效率，适合长视频和内存受限的实时部署场景。

title: Adversarial Agents on Topology Optimization: Understanding the Fragility and Robustness of Deep Learning-based and Physics-Based Design Models under Adversarial Perturbation
summary: Topology optimization, using both physic-based approaches and deep learning surrogates, serves as a cornerstone for generative design agents in cyber-manufacturing systems. While deep learning surrogates have gained widespread adoption due to their speed in online design generation, this work demonstrates their vulnerability under input perturbations. In this work, we present a mechanics-grounded reliability evaluation framework that formulates an adversarial agent targeting the generative design models. We investigate a strictly non-intrusive threat model where bounded perturbations are introduced exclusively to the initial-density channel, while physical boundary conditions, compliance-gradient channels, network architectures, and solver routines remain intact. Evaluating surrogate models across U-Net, convolutional, and generative architectures with varying physics-gradient conditioning depths demonstrates that bounded initialization noise can cause catastrophic mechanical failure, increasing compliance by multiple orders of magnitude through severed load paths and disconnected supports. Furthermore, we discover that incorporating richer physics-gradient conditioning in the deep learning surrogates does not guarantee monotonic robustness across surrogate families. Finally, physics-in-the-loop recovery demonstrates that initializing the classical SIMP optimizer with perturbed topologies mitigates design performance degradation, having a high probability of restoring compliance to near-baseline levels across tested instances. These findings demonstrate that learned surrogates should serve as physics-verified initializers instead of replacing physics-based solvers entirely in a resilient cyber-manufacturing system. Moreover, the proposed adversarial agent provides a foundation for future training generative design agents robust against noise and targeted perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个力学可信的可靠性评估框架，通过对抗性代理攻击生成式设计模型，证明深度学习代理在初始化扰动下会遭受灾难性机械失效（柔度增加多个数量级），但物理在环恢复（用扰动拓扑初始化SIMP优化器）能有效缓解性能退化，最终结论是学习代理应作为物理验证的初始化器而非完全替代物理求解器。
AI.motivation: 深度学习代理因其在线设计生成速度快而被广泛采用，但其在输入扰动下的脆弱性尚未被充分研究。在网络物理制造系统中，理解并量化这些代理模型对扰动的鲁棒性对于构建弹性系统至关重要。
AI.method: 提出力学驱动的可靠性评估框架，构建对抗性代理攻击生成式设计模型。采用严格非侵入式威胁模型，仅向初始密度通道引入有界扰动，保持物理边界条件、柔度梯度通道、网络架构和求解器例程不变。评估多种代理架构（U-Net、卷积、生成式）在不同物理梯度条件深度下的表现，并通过物理在环恢复方式用扰动拓扑初始化SIMP优化器以评估缓解效果。
AI.result: 有界初始化噪声可导致灾难性机械失效，柔度增加多个数量级，表现为载荷路径断裂和支撑断开。更丰富的物理梯度条件并不保证跨代理家族的单调鲁棒性。物理在环恢复能高概率将柔度恢复到接近基线水平，缓解设计性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 学习代理应作为物理验证的初始化器而非完全替代物理求解器，以构建弹性网络制造系统。所提出的对抗性代理为未来训练对噪声和目标扰动鲁棒的生成式设计代理奠定了基础。

title: CausalCache: Conditional High-Fidelity Restoration for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
summary: Long-horizon GUI agents can retain a complete interaction trace cheaply as textual action records, but expose only a few past events to the policy in high-fidelity pixels. We formulate this as conditional fidelity restoration: each event persists in summary-only form and is linked to an archived screenshot, while an active visual-context budget $B$ limits how many events may be promoted to summary-plus-image form. Recent-$B$ spends every slot on the latest events. CausalCache instead reallocates the same $B$ promotions over the complete trace, evicting a recent image only when a distant event has higher conditional marginal utility. Its history-gated key/value (HGKV) adapter modifies only restored history-image tokens and is exactly bypassed with no history image. Matched-budget replacement groups and per-arm-anchored difference-in-differences supervision make uniform history amplification worth zero; a budget-aware selector then chooses which summarized events to restore. On desktop, the frozen policy shows no reliable preference for a task-relevant archived screenshot over the recent frame it would displace; HGKV learns exactly that selectivity inside a pre-specified drift envelope. On OSWorld-Verified, restoring history to high fidelity is worth about $13$ success points over summary-only memory, while same-budget allocations remain indistinguishable. Zero-shot on a cross-application mobile benchmark, CausalCache significantly improves overall success over the same-budget recent allocation ($+3.7$ points on the full roster), and the gain concentrates where it should: $+8.6$ points on the memory-critical split fixed by benchmark metadata at construction, no detectable effect on matched controls, and a significant split-by-method interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalCache方法，用于长时域GUI代理的视觉上下文重建。在有限的视觉上下文预算下，CausalCache将事件从摘要形式提升到摘要+图像形式，通过历史门控KV适配器（HGKV）和预算感知选择器，重新分配预算以优先恢复因果边际效用更高的历史事件，而非仅关注最近的帧。在OSWorld-Verified上相比摘要式记忆提升约13个成功率点，在跨应用移动基准上比同预算的最近分配提升+3.7个点。
AI.motivation: 长时域GUI代理可以廉价地以文本形式保留完整交互轨迹，但只能向策略暴露少量高保真像素事件。现有方法（Recent-B）将所有视觉上下文预算浪费在最近事件上，忽视了更遥远但可能更关键的历史事件。作者希望解决如何在有限视觉预算下最优地选择恢复哪些历史事件的问题。
AI.method: 1) 将问题形式化为条件保真恢复：每个事件以摘要形式持久化，并链接到归档截图；2) 提出CausalCache，重新分配B个预算槽位到完整轨迹上，仅当远处事件的条件边际效用更高时驱逐最近的图像；3) 设计HGKV（历史门控键值）适配器，只修改恢复的历史图像token，无历史图像时完全绕过；4) 使用匹配预算替换组和基于臂锚定的差分-差分监督使统一历史放大为零，再由预算感知选择器选择恢复哪些摘录事件。
AI.result: 在桌面上，冻结策略对任务相关的归档截图与将取代的最近帧没有可靠偏好，而HGKV在预指定漂移包络内学习到精确的选择性。在OSWorld-Verified上，将历史恢复到高保真比摘要式记忆提升约13个成功率点，同预算分配之间不可区分。在跨应用移动基准上的零样本测试中，CausalCache比同预算最近分配显著提升+3.7个点，在记忆关键分割集中提升+8.6个点，对匹配对照无显著影响，且分割×方法交互显著。
AI.conclusion: CausalCache表明，在固定视觉预算下，因果驱动的历史事件恢复策略优于简单的近期优先策略。冻结策略本身没有自然偏好，需要明确的机制（如HGKV和预算感知选择器）来学习选择哪些历史事件恢复为高保真形式。该方法在不增加预算的情况下实现了显著的性能提升，且提升恰好集中在需要记忆的基准分割中。

title: Closed-Loop Bayesian Molecular Inverse Design with Semantic LLM Surrogates
summary: Practical molecular inverse design is rarely a one-shot generation problem; it often takes the form of closed-loop candidate-pool enrichment, where under a limited oracle budget the goal is to \emph{increase the fraction of generated molecules that match a desired property profile}. Bayesian optimization (BO) offers a natural framework for this setting, yet standard Gaussian-process surrogates typically operate in compressed continuous embeddings, which discard the substructural and reference-similarity signals that chemists naturally use to decide where to look next. We propose \textbf{\method}, a closed-loop framework in which the surrogate, rather than the generator, is treated as the locus of design choice, and instantiate it with a frozen large language model that reasons directly over the task instruction, SMILES-level optimization history, and oracle feedback in their native textual form. At each iteration, the surrogate returns a structured decision signal that selects informative reference molecules under an exploration and exploitation principle, optionally with a concise guidance sentence. This signal is converted into next-round conditioning text for a frozen molecular generator, yielding an inspectable optimization trace in natural language. Experiments on MolQA drug and material design tasks show that \method improves over one-shot prompting, is competitive with or stronger than GP-based BO baselines, and reveals a domain-dependent interface: reference-only transfer works best for binary drug targets, while adding a concise surrogate summary is more beneficial for continuous material

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种闭环分子逆向设计框架\method,将代理模型而非生成器作为设计选择的焦点。使用冻结的大语言模型直接在自然语言文本形式上推理任务指令、SMILES优化历史和Oracle反馈,生成结构化决策信号(参考分子+可选指导语句),再转化为下一轮条件文本驱动冻结分子生成器。在MolQA药物和材料设计任务上优于一次性提示,与基于GP的BO基线相当或更强。
AI.motivation: 实用的分子逆向设计通常不是一次性生成问题,而是在有限Oracle预算下的闭环候选池富集问题。标准贝叶斯优化使用高斯过程代理在压缩连续嵌入空间中操作,丢弃了化学家自然使用的子结构和参考相似性信号。需要一种能直接在文本层面推理、并保留化学语义的闭环框架。
AI.method: 将代理模型作为设计选择的焦点,用冻结的LLM直接对任务指令、SMILES级优化历史和Oracle反馈进行文本推理。每轮迭代中,代理返回结构化决策信号(在探索与利用原则下选择信息量大的参考分子,可选配简要指导语句),该信号转换为下一轮条件文本,驱动冻结分子生成器,形成可检查的自然语言优化轨迹。
AI.result: 在MolQA药物和材料设计任务上,\method优于一次性提示方法,与GP-based BO基线竞争或更强。发现领域相关的接口特性:对于二元药物靶点,仅参考分子迁移效果最佳;而对于连续材料性质,添加简洁的代理总结更有益。
AI.conclusion: 文本形式的LLM代理可以在闭环分子设计中有效替代传统GP代理,保留化学语义信息并提供可检查的自然语言优化痕迹。最佳的代理-生成器接口设计取决于具体目标任务领域。

title: SymmAdapt: Symmetrical Flow Matching for Source-Free Domain Adaptation in Medical Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted at SASHIMI 2026, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026. To appear in the Springer LNCS proceedings of the MICCAI 2026 Satellite Events
summary: Domain shift across imaging modalities and acquisition sites remains a significant barrier to the clinical deployment of segmentation models. Source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (SFUDA) addresses this by adapting a pretrained model to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to sensitive source data. We introduce a novel SFUDA framework built on Symmetrical Flow Matching, a unified generative model that segments an input image and synthesizes a source-like image from a mask within the same learned flow. By initializing inference from a domain-agnostic Gaussian origin, the model preserves structural consistency across domains and grounds predictions in learned anatomy rather than shifted texture statistics. Our pipeline leverages this symmetry to generate reliable pseudo-labels and corresponding source-like synthetic images from unlabeled target data, creating a generative replay buffer that anchors source knowledge during a generative self-training stage that fine-tunes on a joint set of real target and synthetic source-like images. We evaluate on abdominal multi-organ and cardiac segmentation, covering cross-modality MRI<->CT shifts, and multi-site prostate segmentation. Our approach outperforms SFUDA baselines and is competitive with conventional UDA methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于对称流匹配（Symmetrical Flow Matching）的无源无监督域适应（SFUDA）分割框架，通过统一的生成模型同时进行图像分割和源风格图像合成，利用域无关的高斯起点保持跨域结构一致性，并通过生成式回放缓冲区在自训练阶段锚定源知识。在腹部多器官、心脏MRI<->CT跨模态及多中心前列腺分割任务上超越SFUDA基线，并与传统UDA方法相当。
AI.motivation: 跨模态和跨采集点的域偏移严重阻碍分割模型的临床部署。SFUDA虽能在不访问敏感源数据的情况下适配目标域，但现有方法难以在无源数据时保持源域知识并生成可靠伪标签。作者希望利用生成模型的对称性同时解决分割和源风格图像合成问题，从而在无源数据条件下更好地锚定源知识。
AI.method: 提出基于对称流匹配（Symmetrical Flow Matching）的SFUDA框架。核心思路是让一个统一的生成模型同时完成两个任务：(1) 对输入图像进行分割；(2) 从分割掩码合成源风格图像。推理时从域无关的高斯分布起点初始化，从而在不同域间保持结构一致性，使预测基于解剖结构而非纹理统计。流程包括：利用这种对称性从未标注目标数据生成可靠伪标签及对应的源风格合成图像；构建生成式回放缓冲区保存源知识；通过生成式自训练阶段在真实目标图像和合成源风格图像的联合集合上微调模型。
AI.result: 在腹部多器官分割、心脏MRI<->CT跨模态分割和多中心前列腺分割上进行了评估。实验结果表明该方法在SFUDA方法中性能最优，且与传统UDA方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 对称流匹配为SFUDA提供了一种优雅的统一框架，通过生成式回放在无源数据条件下有效保留源域知识，显著缩小了SFUDA与传统UDA之间的性能差距，为临床部署中的域偏移问题提供了可靠的解决方案。

title: Mitigating Explanation Leakage in Financial Fraud Detection Systems
summary: Financial fraud detection relies heavily on centralized machine learning models. This creates serious data privacy risks. Federated Learning (FL) decentralizes data processing, but financial regulations still require models to be transparent. This means using Explainable AI (XAI) tools such as TreeSHAP. Recent cybersecurity research shows a problem with this approach. Sharing high-fidelity SHAP explanations exposes the federated network to Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs). This dissertation proposes and evaluates DP-FedSHAP. It is a new architecture that applies client-level differential privacy only to post-hoc TreeSHAP vectors. It is compared against a Weight-Level DP baseline, which perturbs the trained model directly instead. Using the highly imbalanced IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection dataset, this study measures the trade-off between explanation fidelity, privacy preservation, and the model's Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC).

AI.tldr: 本文提出DP-FedSHAP架构，在联邦学习框架下对后验TreeSHAP解释向量施加客户端级差分隐私，以解决金融欺诈检测中共享高保真SHAP解释所面临的成员推理攻击风险，并与权重级差分隐私基线进行对比评估。
AI.motivation: 金融欺诈检测依赖集中式机器学习模型存在数据隐私风险，联邦学习虽然分散了数据处理，但监管要求模型透明（需使用TreeSHAP等XAI工具），而共享高保真SHAP解释会使联邦网络暴露于成员推理攻击之下，需要在解释保真度与隐私保护之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出DP-FedSHAP架构，将客户端级差分隐私仅应用于后验TreeSHAP向量；同时设定权重级差分隐私（直接扰动训练模型）作为对比基线，使用高度不平衡的IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集进行评估。
AI.result: 测量了解释保真度、隐私保护与AUPRC三者之间的权衡关系，比较了DP-FedSHAP与权重级DP基线的表现差异。
AI.conclusion: 在联邦学习金融欺诈检测场景中，对解释向量施加差分隐私是一种可行路径，可通过合理配置在抵御成员推理攻击的同时维持模型性能与解释可用性。

title: Weakly supervised concept Bottleneck Learning for Robust Two stage Object centric visual reasoning
summary: Two-stage neuro-symbolic architectures provide an elegant paradigm for visual problem solving by cleanly separating connectionist perception of predefined symbols from possibly later defined relational reasoning thereon. However, anchoring high-level predicates into visual frames typically necessitates annotations that are expensive to acquire. In this work, we introduce the Dynamic Orthogonal Concept Bottleneck (D-OCB), an object-centric slot- VAE framework designed to extract human-aligned symbolic predicates under extremely weak supervision. D-OCB eliminates the arduous manual tuning of loss-balancing coef- ficients by dynamically learning optimal hyperparameter allocations during training. To infuse prior knowledge on independence of concept categories, in addition to standard re- construction self-supervision we penalize correlation across concept subspaces. Crucially, to combat the instability of very low supervision regimes, D-OCB incorporates a dynamic di- mensionality allocation mechanism; this adaptive formulation allows well-represented con- cepts to yield latent dimensions to underperforming concepts that are lagging behind, effectively preventing representation collapse and significantly improving overall concept accuracy. Through an extensive empirical evaluation, we demonstrate that our framework achieves high concept alignment and downstream visual reasoning accuracy using minimal label budgets, matching or outperforming end-to-end paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D-OCB（动态正交概念瓶颈）框架，一种基于object-centric slot-VAE的方法，在极弱监督下提取人类对齐的符号化谓词。该框架动态学习最优超参数分配、惩罚概念子空间间的相关性，并采用动态维度分配机制防止表征坍缩，以最小标签预算实现高概念对齐和下游视觉推理精度。
AI.motivation: 两阶段神经符号架构需要将高层谓词锚定到视觉帧中，但标注成本昂贵。现有方法需要繁琐的人工调整损失平衡系数，且在极低监督条件下容易不稳定。
AI.method: D-OCB基于object-centric slot-VAE：(1) 动态学习损失平衡超参数分配，免去人工调参；(2) 通过对概念子空间的相关性进行惩罚，注入概念类别独立性的先验知识；(3) 引入动态维度分配机制，使表现好的概念让出潜在维度给落后的概念，防止表征坍缩。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，D-OCB在极小的标签预算下实现了高概念对齐精度和下游视觉推理准确率，匹配或超越了端到端范式。
AI.conclusion: D-OCB通过动态超参数分配、概念正交性约束和自适应维度分配，成功在极弱监督设置下实现高效的概念学习与神经符号推理，避免了昂贵标注和繁琐人工调参。

title: What Does Activation Steering Control? Attribution Across Answer Encodings and Output-Sensitive Subspaces
summary: Activation steering is often evaluated under the answer encoding used to construct the direction. A reported gain may reflect the intended judgment or compatibility with answer identifiers seen during construction. We introduce Cross-Encoding Steering Evaluation, which freezes an intervention while re-encoding answers to the same held-out items. On NormBank, after A/B/C identifiers are reassigned, contrastive activation addition (CAA) induces larger target-versus-source score changes for the extraction indices than for the semantic labels under the new mapping. We call this extraction-index following. Varying identifier vocabulary (A/B/C, X/Y/Z, or 1/2/3) and row order shows that the effect tracks extraction index rather than row position. After matching direction norms across layers, extraction-index following emerges mainly at later depths. A low-rank output-sensitive component containing 15.4% of the direction's squared norm retains 96.3% of this effect. An Inference-Time Intervention (ITI)-style method also favors extraction-index over semantic-label following on NormBank in three models. In aggregate, MNLI favors extraction-index following, whereas Social Chemistry 101 (SC101) favors semantic-label following. Multiple-choice and open-ended evaluations can yield different behavioral conclusions. Thus, a steering gain under one answer encoding does not by itself identify what the intervention controls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交叉编码转向评估（Cross-Encoding Steering Evaluation），通过冻结干预并重新编码答案，发现激活转向方法（如CAA和ITI）在某些基准（NormBank、MNLI）上实际上是跟随提取索引（extraction index）而非语义标签，揭示了传统评估方式的误导性。
AI.motivation: 现有激活转向评估只在构造方向时使用的答案编码下进行，报告的性能提升可能反映的是与答案标识符（如A/B/C）的兼容性，而非干预真正控制了预期的语义判断。这种评估偏差可能导致对干预效果的错误理解。
AI.method: 引入Cross-Encoding Steering Evaluation方法：冻结干预方向，同时将相同保留测试项的答案重新编码。在NormBank上重新分配A/B/C标识符、改变标识符词汇（A/B/C, X/Y/Z, 1/2/3）及行顺序，系统区分提取索引跟随与行位置效应；匹配层间方向范数，分析不同深度效应；进行低秩成分分解。
AI.result: CAA在NormBank上诱导目标vs源分数变化更多对应提取索引而非新映射下的语义标签；效应追踪提取索引而非行位置；主要出现在较深层次；包含15.4%平方范数的低秩输出敏感成分保留了96.3%效应。ITI方法同样偏向提取索引跟随。MNLI整体偏向提取索引，SC101偏向语义标签。选择题与开放问答可得出不同行为结论。
AI.conclusion: 单一答案编码下的转向增益不能证明干预控制了预期目标；评估必须跨编码方式进行，否则可能将提取索引跟随误认为语义控制。

title: Vision-Language Models for Occupational Physical Exposure Assessment: Estimating External Hand Forces in Manual Material Handling Tasks from RGB Video
summary: External hand forces are important inputs to biomechanical analyses of occupational physical exposure and injury risk, yet continuous force measurements during manual material handling (MMH) typically requires instrumented objects or specialized sensing. We evaluated a vision-language model (VLM)-based pipeline that combines task-specific textual cues, visual representations, and known box mass to estimate dynamic, triaxial, bilateral external hand forces from RGB video. Thirty-five healthy young adults performed five MMH tasks involving lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling with box masses of 6, 9, and 12 kg. The pipeline used text-guided localization of participant and handled-object regions of interest (ROIs), pretrained vision-transformer feature extraction, and transformer-based temporal regression. Performance was evaluated using leave-one-subject-out validation across seven camera-view conditions (three single-view and four multi-view conditions) and four ROI strategies. Overall, root mean square error was ~4.7-5.6 N for the horizontal and mediolateral force components and ~10.6-11.0 N for the vertical component. Including the handled object as a second ROI generally improved force estimation, with some of the largest benefits under single-camera conditions, whereas pixel-level segmentation provided little additional improvement. Multi-camera capture provided the clearest benefit for peak-force estimation, particularly for the vertical component, whereas differences in overall frame-level error among camera configurations were comparatively modest. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of estimating continuous, bilateral, directional hand-force estimates from RGB video and known load mass without requiring sensors on the worker or handled objects as model inputs, supporting the development of more scalable occupational physical exposure and risk assessments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的流水线，通过RGB视频和已知箱体质量来估算手工物料搬运（MMH）任务中连续的、三轴双向外力。在35名健康成人、5种MMH任务和7种相机视角条件下的验证中，水平分量RMSE约4.7-5.6 N，垂直分量约10.6-11.0 N，证明了无需工人或物体上传感器的可扩展职业伤害风险评估的可行性。
AI.motivation: 职业物理暴露和伤害风险分析需要外部手力数据作为重要输入，但连续力测量通常需要仪器化物体或专用传感设备，限制了可扩展性，因此需要从普通RGB视频中估算外力的方法。
AI.method: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的流水线，包含：1) 文本引导的参与者与手持物体感兴趣区域（ROI）定位；2) 预训练视觉变换器特征提取；3) 基于变换器的时间回归模型。结合任务特定文本线索、视觉表征和已知箱体质量来估算动态三轴双向外力。
AI.result: 整体上，水平（前后）和内侧-外侧力分量RMSE约4.7-5.6 N，垂直分量约10.6-11.0 N。将手动物作为第二ROI普遍改善力估算（单相机条件下收益最大），像素级分割提升有限；多相机采集对峰值力估算（特别是垂直分量）改善最明显，但各相机配置间的整体帧级误差差异相对较小。
AI.conclusion: 从RGB视频和已知负载质量估算连续、双侧、方向性手力是可行的，无需将传感器作为模型输入（既不在工人身上也不在操作物体上），为更可扩展的职业物理暴露和风险评估方法的发展提供了支持。

title: What AstroPT knows about galaxies, and what that can teach us about LLMs
comment: 13 pages, 12 figures, code at https://github.com/Smith42/astroPT, accepted at Sci-FM@COLM 2026
summary: Interpretability research increasingly asks when concepts emerge during training and whether linear probes recover real structure, but in language models these claims are hard to validate because language offers little ground-truth ordering of concepts or relationships among them. We propose the use of astronomical ground truth through AstroPT, a transformer trained on millions of galaxy images, as a calibration testbed. AstroPT is an LLM-like model trained within a domain where the difficulty ordering of concepts and the relations among them are known in advance. Probing frozen representations across checkpoints, layers, model sizes, and objective choices, we find that galaxy properties emerge in a fixed order that tracks their known difficulty---quantities written almost directly into the pixels (band magnitude) become decodable early in training and shallow in the network, while multiband/spectra based and inferred quantities (such as redshift and specific star formation rate) emerge later and deeper. This order is invariant to our tested training objectives, and scales in magnitude but not in sequence with capacity. Our linear probe directions further recover the known physical structure among galaxy properties. Our findings suggest that astronomy offers a controlled sandbox for calibrating mechanistic interpretability methods we otherwise apply to LLMs blind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用天文学真实世界数据（AstroPT，基于数百万星系图像训练的Transformer）作为可解释性研究的校准测试平台。通过探测冻结表征，发现星系属性按已知难度顺序涌现：直接编码在像素中的属性（如波段星等）在训练早期和浅层网络中即可解码，而需要多波段/光谱推断的属性（如红移、恒星形成率）则在后期和深层网络中涌现。该顺序对训练目标不变，随模型容量缩放但不改变序列。线性探针方向还能恢复星系属性间的物理结构。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的可解释性研究难以验证概念涌现的顺序和关系，因为语言缺乏概念间真实顺序和关系的地面真值。天文学领域提供了已知难度排序和物理关系的概念结构，可作为受控的校准测试环境。
AI.method: 使用AstroPT（在数百万星系图像上训练的类LLM Transformer），在不同检查点、层、模型规模和目标函数下，对冻结表征进行线性探针探测，评估星系属性（波段星等、红移、比恒星形成率等）的可解码性及其涌现顺序，并分析探针方向是否恢复已知的物理结构。
AI.result: 星系属性按固定顺序涌现，该顺序与已知的难度排序一致：直接写入像素的属性早期且浅层就能解码，推断型属性则更晚且更深。该顺序对训练目标保持不变，随容量缩放体现在幅度而非序列上。线性探针方向恢复了星系属性间的已知物理关系。
AI.conclusion: 天文学提供了受控的沙盒环境，用于校准我们否则在LLM上"盲目"应用的机制可解释性方法，使概念涌现和结构恢复的声明可以得到验证。

title: Coalition-Aware Skill Reliability for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Agent skills, structured artifacts distilled from interaction trajectories and dynamically reused from skill banks, have become a central mechanism for enabling large language model (LLM)-based self-evolving agents to learn from past experience. Yet existing work has largely focused on the operational aspects of skills, such as acquisition, evolution, and retrieval, while leaving a more fundamental reliability question unresolved: Do accumulated skills in an agent's skill bank actually make positive mechanistic contributions? We investigate this question through systematic skill-bank audits across alternative bank compositions and deployment domains, measuring the resulting changes in agent behavior. These audits reveal two recurring reliability failures: coalition pollution, where bank-level gains conceal negative coalition-level skill contributions, and cross-domain utility reversal, where source-beneficial skills reverse their effects after transfer. These findings motivate two reliability interventions: coalition-aware skill selection during skill accumulation and label-free skill masking after transfer. Coalition-Aware Skill Selection (CASS) selects more reliable candidate skills for the current bank using sampled Shapley marginals. Unsupervised Skill-Masked Coalition Optimizer (u-SMCO) masks transferred skills whose exclusion improves retrieval quality on unlabeled target-domain data. Agentic experiments on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, HotpotQA, and ALFWorld show that CASS and u-SMCO consistently improve task performance and cross-domain generalization over strong skill-based self-evolving agent baselines. Beyond accuracy, coalition-conditioned reliability modeling reduces sensitivity to noisy outcome-reward fluctuations during reinforcement learning and exposes the limits of isolation-based skill evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了LLM自进化智能体的技能库，发现两种可靠性失效模式（联盟污染和跨域效用反转），并提出两种干预方法（CASS和u-SMCO）来提升技能选择和迁移的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作主要关注技能的操作性方面（获取、演化、检索），但忽略了更根本的可靠性问题：技能库中的技能是否真正带来积极的机制性贡献？
AI.method: 1. 通过系统技能库审计（跨越不同库组成和部署领域）测量行为变化，揭示两种失效模式：联盟污染和跨域效用反转。2. 提出CASS（联盟感知技能选择），使用采样Shapley边际值选择更可靠的候选技能。3. 提出u-SMCO（无监督技能掩码联盟优化器），在无标签目标域数据上掩码排除后能提升检索质量的迁移技能。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo、LongMemEval、HotpotQA和ALFWorld上的智能体实验中，CASS和u-SMCO在任务性能和跨域泛化上持续优于强技能自进化智能体基线。此外，联盟条件的可靠性建模降低了强化学习中噪声奖励波动的敏感性，并揭示了基于隔离技能评估的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 技能可靠性问题需要通过联盟级别的视角来解决，而非孤立的技能评估。提出的两阶段干预方法（积累时选择+迁移后掩码）能有效提升自进化智能体的可靠性，且对奖励噪声更具鲁棒性。

title: LLM Pedagogical Behavior in AI Tutoring Interactions
summary: Students increasingly use LLMs as tutors for coursework and problem solving. Little is known about the level of assistance LLMs provide when students use them as tutors in authentic learning interactions. This matters because tutoring responses can differ substantially in how directly they help students complete a task. We operationalize this dimension as scaffolding level and develop a five-level scale, validated against human annotations, that characterizes responses according to the degree of direct assistance they provide. We apply the scale to 14,637 LLM responses from 203 students in a university AI course. Responses are overwhelmingly concentrated at high levels of assistance, with more than 95% classified as either Explaining or Solving. Scaffolding level is systematically associated with students' subsequent conversational behavior, but provides little additional predictive information about performance on three subsequent exams beyond prior achievement and dialogue behavior. These findings provide an empirical baseline for LLM assistance in tutoring interactions and a measurement framework for evaluating how alternative tutoring designs change that assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了学生在真实学习场景中使用LLM作为导师时，其提供辅助的程度（scaffolding level）。研究者开发了一个五级量表并验证其有效性，应用于203名学生共14,637条LLM回复中。结果显示超过95%的回复属于高辅助级别（解释或解决），辅助级别与学生的后续对话行为有关，但对考试表现的预测能力有限。
AI.motivation: 学生越来越依赖LLM作为课程学习与问题解决的导师，但我们对LLM在真实学习互动中提供辅助的程度知之甚少。不同的辅导响应在直接帮助学生完成任务的程度上有显著差异，而这种差异目前缺乏系统的量化框架。
AI.method: 将LLM辅导的辅助程度操作化为"脚手架级别"（scaffolding level），开发了一个五级量表，并通过人类标注进行验证。将该量表应用于来自某大学AI课程203名学生的14,637条LLM响应。
AI.result: LLM响应绝大多数集中于高辅助级别，超过95%被归类为"解释"或"解决"级别。脚手架级别与学生的后续对话行为存在系统性关联，但对三次后续考试表现的预测能力，除了先前成绩和对话行为之外，几乎没有额外信息增益。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为LLM在辅导互动中的辅助程度提供了经验基线，并建立了一套测量框架，可用于评估不同辅导设计如何改变LLM的辅助程度。

title: AI-based worker guidance in assembly and disassembly operations using multimodal ego/exo-centric data capture and structured task knowledge
comment: 5 pages. Published in CIRP Annals - Manufacturing Technology
summary: Assembly and disassembly processes rely on expert knowledge that is difficult to document, reuse, and transfer. This paper presents a data-centric approach for extracting structured task knowledge from expert demonstrations using egocentric and exocentric recordings. Temporal and multimodal information from video and narration is jointly encoded to derive structured task representations that enable procedural documentation and context-aware worker guidance. The approach is evaluated on a real-world disassembly case study, demonstrating that video-based representations capture procedural structure and execution context beyond static image-based methods. The results highlight the potential of egocentric video understanding for repair, training, and circular manufacturing applications. Project website: https://indego-assistant.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的、基于视频（第一人称与第三人称）和旁白多模态信息联合编码的方法，用于从专家演示中提取结构化的装配/拆卸任务知识，实现程序化文档生成与情境感知的工人指导。
AI.motivation: 装配和拆卸过程依赖难以文档化、复用和传递的专家知识，传统静态图像方法无法充分捕获程序性结构和执行情境。
AI.method: 联合编码视频（第一人称和第三人称视角）与旁白的时间及多模态信息，推导出结构化的任务表示。
AI.result: 在真实拆卸案例研究中验证，视频表示相比静态图像方法能更好地捕获程序结构和执行情境。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了第一人称视频理解在维修、培训及循环制造应用中的潜力。

title: KMGen: A Skill-based Approach for Synthetic Individual Patient Data Generation
summary: Individual patient data (IPD) from clinical trials is the substrate for survival modeling, meta-analysis, and safety research, yet IPD is rarely released. Prior work has addressed only half of this gap: reconstructing Kaplan-Meier (KM) curves from published plots -- typically requiring manual digitization or human-in-the-loop correction -- while offering no mechanism for generating the adverse-event (AE) streams that constitute the other half of a patient record. We introduce KMGen, the first end-to-end framework that (i) fully automates KM curve extraction at accuracy competitive with human-guided tools, and (ii) generates synthetic per-patient AE trajectories from public trial registry records. The extraction stage is a fully automated agentic pipeline -- an agent generates code to extract each step in the KM curve -- achieving a mean Integrated Absolute Error (IAE) of 0.0151 on a 32-plot benchmark spanning clean, edge-case, and adversarial conditions. The IPD generation stage decouples patient archetype extraction from statistical sampling: an LLM distills the trial record into arm-specific statistics, adverse events, patient demographics, and risk multipliers. A mechanistic sampler generates patient events via clinical archetypes, bootstrap rank-correlation coupling to the empirical KM curve (preserving the marginal survival distribution exactly), and cycle-based AE scheduling with an induction/maintenance split. Across three held-out oncology trials spanning an order of magnitude in cohort size and 30 independent regenerations per trial, KMGen achieves mean integrated KM absolute difference $Δ_{\text{KM}}\,{\leq}\,0.051$, sex/ECOG JSD ${\leq}\,0.013$ on 5 of 6 demographic slots, and recovers ${\geq}\,71\%$ of the top-15 AEs by exact MedDRA term under a single fixed parameter set. The pipeline is released as open source at https://github.com/chufangao/kmgen.

AI.tldr: KMGen是首个端到端框架，既能全自动提取Kaplan-Meier曲线（达到与人工辅助工具相当的精度），又能从公共试验注册记录生成合成的不良事件（AE）个体患者轨迹。通过agentic管道自动化KM曲线提取，以及解耦患者原型提取与统计采样的LLM驱动IPD生成，KMGen在多个基准测试中展现出高精度。
AI.motivation: 个体患者数据（IPD）是生存建模、荟萃分析和安全性研究的核心数据，但很少公开发布。现有工作只解决了问题的一半：从已发表的图中重建KM曲线（通常需要人工数字化或人在回路修正），而没有机制生成构成患者记录另一半的不良事件（AE）数据流。
AI.method: KMGen包含两个阶段：(i) 提取阶段：全自动agentic管道，由agent生成代码逐步提取KM曲线的每个步骤；(ii) IPD生成阶段：将患者原型提取与统计采样的解耦——LLM将试验记录提炼为各臂统计特征、不良事件、患者人口统计和风险乘数，然后通过临床原型、bootstrap秩相关耦合到经验KM曲线（精确保留边际生存分布）、以及基于诱导/维持分组的周期性AE调度，由机械采样器生成患者事件。
AI.result: KM曲线提取在32图基准（涵盖清洁、边缘和对抗性条件）上达到平均IAE为0.0151。在三个留出肿瘤试验（队列规模跨越一个数量级，每次试验30次独立再生成）中，KMGen达到平均积分KM绝对差≤0.051，5/6个人口统计槽位的性别/ECOG JSD≤0.013，并在单一固定参数集下按精确MedDRA术语恢复了≥71%的前15名AE。
AI.conclusion: KMGen证明了一个完全自动化的端到端管道能够同时解决KM曲线提取和AE流生成的难题，为临床研究中IPD的合成生成提供了一种可复现、开源且不依赖人工干预的解决方案。

title: DeepSAGE: Stage-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Structured CBT Counseling Dialogue
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based counseling agents can generate fluent and supportive responses, but they often lack the structured, goal-directed progression required to conduct a coherent therapeutic session. We present DeepSAGE (Strategic AI Guidance Engine), a hybrid LLM--Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework for stage-aware counseling dialogue grounded in the first session of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). DeepSAGE represents the session as eleven stages with explicit therapeutic objectives, with an external controller determines stage completion and the DRL model selects therapeutic intentions that guide LLM response generation. We evaluate DeepSAGE against six retrieval-, prompting-, stage-, and policy-based alternatives. DeepSAGE elicits higher simulated client engagement and openness and achieves the strongest balance of stage-goal completion and dialogue efficiency among stage-structured systems. Domain expert review further indicates that the generated conversations exhibit broadly plausible emotional trajectories and recognizable CBT processes. Because the evaluation relies primarily on simulated clients and model-based metrics, these findings demonstrate comparative dialogue-control improvements rather than clinical effectiveness. These results suggest that combining stage-structured dialogue with learned strategy selection is a promising approach for AI counseling, though clinical effectiveness, safety, and real-world utility require further human evaluation.

AI.tldr: DeepSAGE是一个混合LLM与深度强化学习的框架，用于阶段感知的认知行为疗法（CBT）咨询对话。它将咨询过程建模为11个具有明确治疗目标的阶段，由外部控制器判断阶段完成情况，DRL模型选择治疗意图来指导LLM生成响应。实验表明其在模拟客户参与度和开放性上表现更好，并在阶段目标完成与对话效率之间取得最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的咨询代理虽然能生成流畅和支持性的回应，但缺乏结构化和目标导向的推进过程，难以进行连贯的治疗性会话。现有方法未能有效结合咨询的阶段结构性与策略选择。
AI.method: DeepSAGE采用混合架构：将CBT首次会话建模为11个带有明确治疗目标的阶段；外部控制器负责判断阶段是否完成；DRL模型负责选择治疗意图；LLM根据所选意图生成具体的会话响应。
AI.result: 与六种基于检索、提示、阶段和策略的基线方法相比，DeepSAGE能引发更高的模拟客户参与度和开放性，且在阶段结构化系统中实现了阶段目标完成与对话效率的最佳平衡。领域专家评审认为其对话具有合理的情感轨迹和可识别的CBT过程。
AI.conclusion: 将阶段结构化对话与学习到的策略选择相结合是AI咨询领域有前景的方向，但由于评估主要依赖模拟客户和基于模型的指标，这些发现仅表明对话控制方面的改进而非临床有效性。临床效果、安全性和实际可用性仍需进一步的人类评估。

title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality
summary: Large language models (LLMs) require effective unlearning to address privacy regulations and safety concerns. However, achieving precise forgetting without compromising general utility remains challenging. Existing sequence- and token-level methods penalize target outputs without modeling their context-dependent retrieval paths, which can disrupt linguistic structure or suppress benign knowledge. We present ADU, a fine-grained, training-based framework that shifts unlearning from token erasure to contextual attention-pathway decoupling. Exploiting the functional distinction between local and global attention heads, ADU identifies preplan positions that retrieve persistent sensitive anchors and fixes their candidate paths under the original model. It then trains attention-projection adapters to suppress attention mass along these paths while preserving local-attention structure and retain-set language modeling. Post-training activation exchange tests whether the modified attention-output module transmits the learned forgetting effect. ADU achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated baselines on the TOFU and WMDP benchmarks, including a Forget Quality of (0.93) on TOFU. It preserves 87--98% of model utility (92.9% on average versus 81.9% for baselines) while reducing side effects in benign contexts.

AI.tldr: ADU是一个细粒度、基于训练的LLM遗忘框架，通过将遗忘从token擦除转变为上下文注意力路径解耦，利用局部与全局注意力头的功能差异，识别并抑制敏感锚点的检索路径，同时保留模型效用。
AI.motivation: 现有序列级和token级遗忘方法直接惩罚目标输出，未建模上下文相关的检索路径，容易破坏语言结构或抑制良性知识，难以在精确遗忘与保持通用能力之间取得平衡。
AI.method: ADU框架：1）利用局部与全局注意力头的功能差异，识别检索持久敏感锚点的预规划位置；2）在原模型下固定候选路径；3）训练注意力投影适配器以抑制沿这些路径的注意力质量，同时保留局部注意力结构和保留集语言建模；4）通过训练后激活交换测试验证修改后的注意力输出模块是否传递遗忘效果。
AI.result: 在TOFU和WMDP基准上，ADU在评估基线上取得最强聚合性能，TOFU上遗忘质量达0.93；保留模型效用的87-98%（平均92.9%，基线为81.9%），同时减少良性上下文中的副作用。
AI.conclusion: ADU通过注意力路径解耦实现细粒度LLM遗忘，在遗忘效果与模型效用保持之间取得更优权衡，为LLM隐私和安全合规提供了有效方案。

title: OmniCAD: A Large-Scale Benchmark for 3D Spatial Reasoning in Robotics Assemblies
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) show strong capabilities in robotic perception and spatial reasoning, yet their ability to reason about complex mechanical assemblies remains underexplored. We introduce OmniCAD, a large-scale benchmark for assembly-aware 3D spatial reasoning across diverse industrial systems, including robotic mechanisms, automotive components, aerospace structures, and agricultural machinery. OmniCAD contains 25k mechanical assemblies, with an average of 12 parts per assembly and 21 types of mate relationships. Each assembly includes a human-verified ground-truth 3D model and renderings from 20 viewpoints. The benchmark evaluates three capabilities: (1) component-level 3D spatial reasoning, requiring prediction of part positions and orientations; (2) part-to-part relational reasoning, requiring identification of mating relationships and assembly constraints; and (3) tool-augmented agentic reasoning, where models iteratively select viewpoints, inspect visual evidence, and refine predictions. Experiments show that current VLMs struggle with industrial assembly reasoning, often producing inaccurate poses, invalid mating relationships, part interpenetration, and degraded performance as assembly complexity increases. We will open-source the benchmark, evaluation code, and tool interfaces to support research on accurate, physically valid, and scalable 3D assembly reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OmniCAD，一个大规模机械装配感知的3D空间推理基准，包含25k个机械装配、平均12个零件和21种配合关系，用于评估视觉语言模型在工业装配推理中的三项能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）在机器人感知和空间推理方面表现强劲，但其对复杂机械装配的理解能力尚未被充分探索。缺乏大规模、多样化的工业装配基准来系统评估VLM的装配认知能力。
AI.method: 构建OmniCAD基准，涵盖机器人机构、汽车部件、航空航天结构和农业机械等多样化工业系统。每个装配包含人工验证的3D真实模型和20个视角的渲染图。基准评估三个层次的能力：组件级3D空间推理（预测位置和姿态）、零件间关系推理（识别配合关系和装配约束）、以及工具增强的代理推理（迭代选择视角并优化预测）。
AI.result: 实验表明现有VLM在工业装配推理上表现困难，常产生不准确的姿态、无效的配合关系、零件相互穿透等问题，且随着装配复杂性增加性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: OmniCAD揭示了当前VLM在机械装配空间推理方面的显著不足，并将开源基准、评估代码和工具接口，以支持准确、物理有效且可扩展的3D装配推理研究。

title: Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents
summary: Terminal agents are a compelling application of large language models (LLMs), with the potential to integrate deeply into users' daily workflows. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a key technique for improving their capabilities, making scalable training environments a central challenge. Since public real-user interaction data are scarce, synthetic environments provide a practical alternative, but often suffer from domain gaps and limited fidelity, leading to poor generalization. Existing work mainly scales the quantity and diversity of synthetic environments, while reward-signal quality and the mechanisms governing generalization remain under-explored. We study how RL improves terminal agents and propose the Agentic Compositional Generalization hypothesis: rather than teaching new domain-specific skills from scratch, RL primarily shapes high-level decision-making behaviors that compose and route low-level skills acquired during pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). This account is consistent with our empirical results and suggests that verifier quality, which determines which behaviors are reinforced, is more important than simply increasing environment quantity or diversity. Motivated by this insight, we propose River, a simple training recipe that improves reward quality by filtering low-quality environments and augmenting outcome rewards with process-level behavior regularization. Using this recipe, our RL-trained agent achieves the best performance among evaluated open-source RL-trained 8B models across four terminal-agent benchmarks. River also generalizes across model families, scales, agent harnesses, and RL objectives. Using fewer than 30% of the TMax training environments, River improves RL gains by 106% and 30% on average for models ranging from 2B to 27B on Terminal-Bench-Lite and Terminal-Bench-v2.1, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic组合泛化假说，认为RL主要塑造高级决策行为来组合和路由预训练/SFT阶段获得的低级技能，而非从头教授新技能。基于此提出River训练方案，通过过滤低质量环境和加入过程级行为正则化来提升奖励质量，在四个终端智能体基准上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 终端智能体是LLM的重要应用，RL是提升其能力的关键技术，但可扩展的训练环境是核心挑战。由于真实用户交互数据稀缺，合成环境虽可替代但存在领域差距和保真度不足问题。现有工作主要关注扩大环境数量与多样性，而奖励信号质量与泛化机制被忽视。
AI.method: 提出Agentic组合泛化假说，认为RL主要塑造高层次决策行为以组合路由低级技能。据此提出River训练方案：(1)过滤低质量环境以提升奖励信号质量；(2)在结果奖励基础上加入过程级行为正则化，增强奖励信号。
AI.result: River训练的8B模型在四个终端智能体基准上优于其他开源RL训练模型，且跨模型家族、规模、agent框架和RL目标均表现良好。使用不到TMax 30%的训练环境，在2B-27B模型上分别平均提升RL收益106%和30%（Terminal-Bench-Lite和Terminal-Bench-v2.1）。
AI.conclusion: 验证了验证器质量（决定哪些行为被强化）比单纯增加环境数量或多样性更重要。这为终端智能体的RL训练提供了新的方向，挑战了传统的规模驱动的环境扩展思路。

title: CAI-DLLM: Convergence Aware Inference for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models can generate many tokens in parallel, but they still require repeated denoising steps during inference. This makes generation costly, especially when the model continues to recompute tokens that are already stable. To address these limitations, we propose CAI-DLLM, a training-free inference method that uses first-step confidence to guide denoising and reduce inference time. Specifically, CAI-DLLM commits easy tokens earlier, allocates more denoising steps to harder tokens, and adjusts decoding schedules across output blocks. As it relies only on first-step confidence signals, it does not require retraining, extra predictors, or weight updates. We evaluate CAI-DLLM on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct across math, code, reasoning, commonsense, and long-context tasks. CAI-DLLM achieves up to 18.2x wall clock inference speedup on LLaDA GSM8K while improving accuracy from 76.27% to 77.41%, and up to 13.1x speedup on Dream HumanEval while achieving higher pass@1 than no-cache inference, 48.17% compared with 46.95%. On harder reasoning tasks, speedups reach 44.8x, with a largest accuracy drop of 4.4 points, while energy consumption is reduced by up to 95.3%.

AI.tldr: CAI-DLLM是一种无需训练的推理加速方法，利用第一步的置信度信号指导去噪过程，提前提交简单token、为困难token分配更多去噪步骤，并动态调整解码调度，在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上实现最高18.2倍（LLaDA GSM8K）和13.1倍（Dream HumanEval）的墙钟推理加速，同时能耗降低最高95.3%。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽然能并行生成多个token，但推理时仍需多次去噪步骤，且会重复计算已稳定的token，导致生成成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出CAI-DLLM这一无需训练的方法，通过第一步置信度信号引导去噪：提前提交容易的token、将更多去噪步骤分配给困难token、并跨输出块调整解码调度。该方法无需重新训练、额外预测器或权重更新。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上，覆盖数学、代码、推理、常识和长上下文任务：LLaDA GSM8K上取得18.2倍加速且准确率从76.27%提升至77.41%；Dream HumanEval上取得13.1倍加速，pass@1从46.95%提升至48.17%；困难推理任务上加速达44.8倍，准确率最大下降仅4.4点；能耗最高降低95.3%。
AI.conclusion: CAI-DLLM通过置信度引导的自适应去噪策略，在不牺牲甚至提升准确率的情况下大幅加速扩散语言模型推理，并显著降低能耗，证明了训练无关的推理加速方案的有效性。

title: Most of the LLM routing gap is task type
summary:
An LLM router picks which model should answer each query. The appeal is that models fail on different questions. Whatever single model is best overall still gets some wrong, and another model in the pool gets many of those right. Getting that choice right every time is the ceiling, and a router is an attempt to approach it.
  However, recent work reports that routers do not get close. Across 21 routing methods on five benchmarks, sharply different designs land within a fraction of a point of each other, and all of them stay far below that ceiling. Learned routers often fail to beat simply always calling the strongest model.
  We ask what those missed questions have in common. We set fourteen models to answer all 294 questions, with 7 task types across 3 languages: Korean, English and Hindi. We ran the whole matrix twice, changing nothing, but 5.37% of the 4,116 model-question pairs came out scored differently anyway. Run-to-run movement like that is normal, and we argue that a small win does not show that routing did anything, ours or anyone else's.
  Counting an answer correct only when the model got it right in both runs, 29 questions on this matrix can be improved with routing. Every correct-answer count here is on that rule. Task type accounts for most of them: assigning each task type one model in advance, chosen once and never updated, improves 21 of the 29. Splitting each task type by language improves 2 more and leaves 6 of 294 unoptimized. That handful is what a learned router would have been built for, and it is smaller than the run-to-run movement above, which is a share of pairs rather than of questions. The static table we adopted answers 262 of 294 questions at $3.33 per run, against the best single model's 245 at $7.69.
  All of this is fitted and scored on the same 294 questions with no holdout.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑LLM路由器的有效性。作者通过14个模型在294个问题（7种任务类型、3种语言）上的完整实验矩阵发现，路由方法的表现远低于理论上限，且路由器之间的性能差异极小。更关键的是，评测本身存在5.37%的run-to-run波动，小幅度提升可能只是噪声。作者提出一个简单的静态路由表（按任务类型预先分配模型）即可优化29个可改进问题中的21个，且成本更低（$3.33对比$7.69），质疑了学习型路由器的必要性。
AI.motivation: 近年来关于LLM路由器的研究声称可以通过选择不同模型来提升整体性能，但已有工作表明路由器实际效果远低于理论上限，且各种路由方法之间差异甚微。作者希望探究这些被路由器"错过"的问题有何共同特征，并质疑路由器带来的小幅度提升是否真实有效（因为评测本身存在run-to-run波动）。
AI.method: 作者设置14个模型回答294个问题（7种任务类型×3种语言：韩语、英语、印地语），构建完整的4116个模型-问题对矩阵，并重复运行两次以测量run-to-run波动。他们采用"两次运行都正确才算正确"的严格规则，然后分析哪些问题可以通过路由改善，并将学习型路由器与简单的静态路由表（按任务类型预先分配单一模型）进行对比。
AI.result: 5.37%的模型-问题对在不同运行中出现不同评分。严格规则下，294个问题中仅29个可通过路由改善。静态路由表按任务类型分配模型可优化其中21个，按语言细分可再优化2个，仅剩6个无法优化。静态路由表以$3.33/次回答262个问题，优于最佳单模型的245个及$7.69/次的成本。
AI.conclusion: 学习型路由器能优化的空间极小（仅6个问题），远小于评测本身的run-to-run噪声规模。简单静态的路由表（按任务类型选择模型）不仅效果与学习型路由器相当甚至更好，而且成本大幅降低。作者暗示路由领域的"小胜利"很可能是评测噪声而非真实有效的方法提升。

title: Multiple View Neural Regression of a Facial Shape Model
summary:
Creating re-topologized 3D facial meshes is essential for high-quality facial animation but remains labor-intensive and time-consuming. This dissertation explores more efficient approaches for capturing production-ready facial meshes through: (1) the development of VarIS, a custom light sphere for capturing high-resolution stereo geometry and reflectance maps; (2) analysis of camera parameters affecting automatic 2D and 3D landmarking; (3) synthetic-data methods for training neural face regression; and (4) techniques for improving neural multi-view face-shape regression.
  While VarIS enables photorealistic face capture, its operational and processing costs motivate a more scalable approach. A deep learning framework is therefore proposed to directly predict re-topologized facial meshes from synthetic multiview images generated with Visage Craft, an in-house physically based rendering system using an Appearance 3D Morphable Model (A3DMM). The system produces standardized meshes ready for rigging and animation with minimal human supervision. Results show that incorporating accurate camera intrinsics and extrinsics improves landmark accuracy and geometric consistency, while 3D landmark regularization further improves reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用合成多视图图像和深度学习框架直接从图像预测可重拓扑化3D面部网格的方法，该系统基于外观3D形变模型（A3DMM）和内部物理渲染系统Visage Craft，生成的标准网格可直接用于绑定和动画制作，减少了人工干预。
AI.motivation: 创建重拓扑化的3D面部网格对于高质量面部动画至关重要，但目前过程劳动密集且耗时。现有的VarIS光球系统虽然能实现照片级真实感面部捕捉，但其操作和计算成本较高，需要一种更具可扩展性的方法。
AI.method: 该论文采用深度学习方法，从合成多视图图像中直接预测重拓扑化面部网格。合成图像由内部物理渲染系统Visage Craft基于外观3D形变模型（A3DMM）生成。同时分析了相机参数对2D/3D地标检测的影响，并利用3D地标正则化来提升重建质量。
AI.result: 研究表明，引入准确的相机内参和外参能够提高地标精度和几何一致性，而3D地标正则化进一步改善了重建质量。系统能够在最少人工监督下生成可直接用于绑定和动画制作的标准网格。
