We consider a sequential change-point detection problem where the conditional density switches at an unknown time, yet neither the pre- nor post-change distribution admits a closed-form. Classical likelihood-ratio statistics are inapplicable in this settings.
  A conditional diffusion model, trained on pre-change-point data with a frozen context encoder, defines a deterministic bijection via the probability flow ODE. Pre-change observations are mapped onto standard Gaussian latent variables. Post-change observations, processed through the same frozen map, deviate from this reference. We employ the Maximum Mean Discrepancy as the test statistic, derive closed-form expressions for its components under the Gaussian null, and establish its asymptotic distribution as a degenerate U-statistic. Afterwards we apply an online detection procedure of Shiryaev--Roberts to the resulting statistic with exact threshold calibration.
  The method detects arbitrary distributional shifts, including covariance rotations and higher-order structural breaks, without parametric assumptions on either regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于条件扩散模型和概率流ODE的序列变点检测方法。该方法将变点前的观测映射为标准高斯隐变量，变点后的观测则偏离此参考分布，以最大均值差异（MMD）作为检验统计量，并应用Shiryaev-Roberts在线检测程序进行精确阈值校准。该方法无需对前后分布做任何参数假设，可检测协方差旋转和高阶结构断裂等任意分布偏移。
AI.motivation: 许多时序数据任务（如金融市场趋势反转、视频音频自动分段、运动传感器方向变化检测）需要在条件密度未知且无闭式解的变点检测场景下工作。经典似然比统计量在此类设置中不适用，因此需要一种不需要参数假设的通用检测方法。
AI.method: 1) 使用在变点前数据上训练的条件扩散模型，通过概率流ODE建立确定性双射；2) 将变点前观测映射到标准高斯潜变量，变点后观测经同一冻结映射后偏离参考分布；3) 采用MMD作为检验统计量，在高斯零假设下推导其分量的闭式表达式，并建立其作为退化U统计量的渐近分布；4) 将所得统计量应用于Shiryaev-Roberts在线检测程序，实现精确阈值校准。
AI.result: 该方法能够检测任意分布偏移，包括协方差旋转和高阶结构断裂，且无需对两种状态做任何参数假设。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过条件扩散模型将分布偏移问题转化为高斯参考偏差问题，结合MMD统计量和Shiryaev-Roberts在线检测，提供了一种通用的非参数序列变点检测框架。

title: Performance of a domain-specific large language model in answering patient questions in psychiatry
summary: Background This study was designed to evaluate whether a domain-specific large language model (LLM) trained exclusively on patient education resources can answer questions about psychiatric medications, in a manner superior to LLM chatbots. We developed an LLM ("MIND") fine-tuned for clinical fidelity, trained on patient education resources from authoritative medical organizations. Methods We compared the responses of MIND, ChatGPT, and OpenEvidence to patient questions about escitalopram, using two methods: (1) computer analysis according to a rubric measuring accuracy, clarity, completeness, nuance, safety, and referral appropriateness; (2) ratings from N=10 board-licensed psychiatrists on similar metrics. Results When rated by rubric, MIND was rated highest in all domains (p<0.001). When rated by psychiatrists, ChatGPT was rated accurate more often than MIND with a negligible effect size (p=0.021, r=0.073); MIND was rated complete more often than ChatGPT with a small effect size (p<0.001, r=0.160); and MIND and ChatGPT were rated safe with the same frequency (p=0.955, r=0.002). The majority of psychiatrists preferred the responses generated by ChatGPT (57.6%) compared to MIND (42.4%, p=0.003). Conclusions MIND was able to answer many questions about escitalopram in a manner deemed accurate, complete, and safe by psychiatrists the majority of the time. However, despite MIND's ability to provide more complete responses, psychiatrists preferred ChatGPT's responses. MIND represents a step towards building safe LLM systems to enhance patient education in psychiatry.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个仅基于患者教育资源训练的领域专用大语言模型MIND，用于回答精神科药物（艾司西酞普兰）相关问题，并与ChatGPT和OpenEvidence进行对比评估。虽然MIND在规则评分中所有维度均最佳，但精神科医生更偏好ChatGPT的回答（57.6% vs 42.4%），尽管MIND在完整性上表现更好。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM聊天机器人在回答精神科药物相关问题时可能存在准确性或安全性风险，本研究旨在探索是否可以通过仅使用权威患者教育资源微调的领域专用LLM，提供更符合临床规范的患者教育回答。
AI.method: 开发了基于权威医疗机构患者教育资源微调的领域专用LLM"MD"，并将其与ChatGPT、OpenEvidence在艾司西酞普兰患者问题上进行比较。评估采用两种方式：(1)计算机规则评分（准确度、清晰度、完整性、细微性、安全性、转诊适当性）；(2)10名委员会认证精神科医生对相似指标进行评分。
AI.result: 规则评分中MIND在所有领域均得分最高（p<0.001）。精神科医生评分中：ChatGPT在准确性上略优于MIND（效应量可忽略，r=0.073）；MIND在完整性上优于ChatGPT（小效应量，r=0.160）；两者安全性评分无显著差异。多数精神科医生偏好ChatGPT的回答（57.6% vs 42.4%）。
AI.conclusion: MIND能够在大多数情况下提供被精神科医生认为准确、完整、安全的艾司西酞普兰相关回答，但尽管MIND回答更完整，精神科医生仍更偏好ChatGPT的回答。MIND代表了构建安全LLM系统以增强精神科患者教育的重要一步。

title: Counter with Evidence! A Multi-Agent Memory Efficient Reasoning Framework for Hate Category Informed Counterspeech Generation
summary: Counterspeech effectively neutralizes the impact of online hate. Although prior work explores automated counterspeech generation, it largely emphasizes stylistic control while treating hate speech as homogeneous, overlooking that distinct forms of abuse require fundamentally different counterspeech strategies. To address this gap, we introduce FIRE (Factuality Informed Multi-Agent Reasoning Framework) that first decomposes hate speech into one of the five distinct categories (misinformation, stereotype, conspiracy, dehumanizing, non-factual), and then maps it to a targeted counterspeech style. To facilitate FIRE, we curate FactualCS, a novel dataset of $4,784$ instances that provides the annotations regarding hate categories, reasoning traces, and evidence mappings, which are critical elements for grounded generation that are missing in prior work. A comprehensive evaluation across $28$ baseline configurations demonstrates that FIRE significantly surpasses existing methods, despite using compact agents ($<$2B). FIRE achieves a $\sim$ $12 \%$ and $\sim$ $11 \%$ improvements in factual and category-specific accuracy respectively, while simultaneously reducing toxicity by $\sim$ $11 \%$ relative to the strongest baselines. Further human evaluation confirms that responses generated by FIRE are significantly preferred over the strongest baselines, underscoring its effectiveness for real-world deployment. These findings show that decomposing the underlying intent of hate speech is essential for generating safe, effective, and contextually precise counterspeech.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FIRE（基于事实性的多智能体推理框架），通过将仇恨言论分解为五种不同类别（虚假信息、刻板印象、阴谋论、去人性化、非事实），并映射到针对性的回击策略来生成更有效的反言论。配合新数据集FactualCS（4,784个实例，含类别标注、推理轨迹和证据映射），FIRE在28个基线配置下显著超越现有方法，即使使用小于2B参数的紧凑智能体，也在事实准确性和类别准确性上分别提升约12%和11%，同时毒性降低约11%。
AI.motivation: 现有自动反言论生成工作主要强调文体控制，将仇恨言论视为同质化输入，忽略了不同形式的滥用需要根本不同的反驳策略，这限制了反言论的针对性和有效性。
AI.method: 提出FIRE框架：(1) 首先将仇恨言论分解为五种不同类别；(2) 根据类别映射到针对性的回击风格；(3) 构建FactualCS数据集，包含仇恨类别、推理轨迹和证据映射等关键标注，为有根据的生成提供基础。
AI.result: 在28个基线配置的全面评估中，FIRE显著超越现有方法：事实准确性提升约12%，类别特定准确性提升约11%，毒性降低约11%（相对最强基线）。人类评估也确认FIRE生成的反言论显著优于最强基线。
AI.conclusion: 分解仇恨言论的潜在意图对于生成安全、有效且上下文精准的反言论至关重要，FIRE证明了基于类别的针对性策略在实际部署中的有效性。

title: OmicSync: Reliability-Aware Spatial Multi-Omics Clustering with Evidence-Constrained LLM Reasoning
summary: Spatial multi-omics technologies jointly profile gene expression, surface proteins, and histology at each tissue spot, yet most spatial domain discovery methods provide only cluster assignments, without indicating assignment reliability, modality contributions, or why a domain decision should be trusted. We present OmicSync, a reliability-aware spatial multi-omics framework that couples unsupervised domain clustering with evidence-constrained LLM reasoning using model-derived per-spot signals, including assignment confidence, epistemic routing uncertainty, and modality-routing weights. These signals are converted into structured evidence dictionaries and used to generate standard, stepwise, counterfactual, contrastive, and uncertainty-focused explanations. OmicSync integrates a KAN-GCN backbone with spatial encoding, cross-modal fusion, uncertainty-aware routing, cell-type supervision, and missing-modality imputation. We further introduce OmicSync-R, which closes the reasoning-clustering loop by using automatically computed reasoning-quality scores as REINFORCE rewards, allowing reasoning coherence to shape the latent structure without backpropagating through the language model. Across four 10x CytAssist FFPE spatial proteomics benchmarks, OmicSync achieves the best average rank on Human Tonsil (1.44), Glioblastoma (1.78), and Tonsil Add-on (1.22), and second-best on Human Breast Cancer (2.33). OmicSync-R further improves ARI on Human Breast Cancer from 45.73 to 46.72 and outperforms existing methods on six of nine clustering metrics. Together, OmicSync and OmicSync-R enable reliability-aware, spot-level auditable spatial domain discovery guided by evidence-constrained reasoning.

AI.tldr: OmicSync是一个可靠性感知的空间多组学框架，将无监督域聚类与证据约束的LLM推理相结合，通过KAN-GCN骨干网络、不确定性感知路由和缺失模态插补，提供标准、逐步、反事实、对比和不确定性聚焦五种解释。OmicSync-R通过REINFORCE奖励闭环推理-聚类循环，在四个10x CytAssist FFPE基准上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有空间域发现方法仅提供聚类分配结果，缺乏分配可靠性、模态贡献或决策可信任度的说明，导致空间域发现过程缺乏可审计性和可解释性。
AI.method: OmicSync包含KAN-GCN骨干网络、空间编码、跨模态融合、不确定性感知路由、细胞类型监督和缺失模态插补；提取每个位点的分配置信度、认知路由不确定性和模态路由权重三类信号，转换为结构化证据字典，用于生成五种类型的LLM解释。OmicSync-R引入推理-聚类闭环，使用自动计算的推理质量分数作为REINFORCE奖励，使推理连贯性塑造潜在结构而无需通过语言模型反向传播。
AI.result: 在四个10x CytAssist FFPE空间蛋白质组学基准上，OmicSync在人类扁桃体（1.44）、胶质母细胞瘤（1.78）和扁桃体附加（1.22）上取得最佳平均排名，在人类乳腺癌上排名第二（2.33）。OmicSync-R将人类乳腺癌ARI从45.73提升至46.72，并在九个聚类指标中的六个上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: OmicSync和OmicSync-R实现了可靠性感知、位点级可审计的空间域发现，由证据约束推理驱动，兼顾了聚类性能与可解释性。

title: CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?
comment: 39 pages, 6 figures, 21 tables. Work in progress. Code and data: https://github.com/yzhao062/catchbench
summary:
When can an agent failure be caught? An audit is usually limited by the record rather than by the method. CatchBench therefore puts one auditor's question to three information states: the declared configuration before a run (PRE), a growing prefix of its trace (LIVE), and the finished trace (POST). Prior benchmarks fix one of these states or vary the telemetry; to our knowledge none scores all three under one task-method interface. Each state admits different questions, so seven task contracts carry their own labels and metrics rather than one leaderboard. Four are evidential; three are Gold-derived mechanism diagnostics.
  The release scores 72 entrants, from rule scanners and structural models to eleven LLM judges across nine model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Gemma, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Nova), over 1187 declared configurations and 1162 recorded runs. Most of the arena does not order: 47 of 118 pre-declared contrasts separate, and the rest are published unresolved rather than ranked. The two sharpest results cut against our own data. One rule ignores every name and permission; it flags each capability declared after the first. On one of six configuration sources it reaches a perfect F1, so a score there measures how the corpus was built rather than how well a method reasons. Our admissibility bar then rejected one injected substrate and withheld evidential status from the other. A benchmark number is therefore not interpretable until the process behind its labels is published and tested for the shortcut it may leave. We report both, and regenerate every ordering from released predictions with no model call.

AI.tldr: CatchBench 是一个用于评估智能体故障审计（audit）能力的基准测试。它通过在三种信息状态下（运行前的声明配置 PRE、运行中的轨迹前缀 LIVE、运行后的完整轨迹 POST）评测同一审计问题，设计了七个任务契约（四个证据性任务、三个机制诊断任务）。该基准测试了72个参赛者（包括规则扫描器、结构模型及11个LLM裁判，覆盖9个模型家族），在1187个声明配置和1162个记录运行上评估。关键发现是大部分参赛者无法区分（47/118个预先声明的对比可区分），且一个简单规则（忽略所有名称和权限，仅标记第一个声明之后的能力）在某个配置源上达到完美F1分数，揭示了基准分数可能度量的是语料构建方式而非方法推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的审计评估基准要么固定单一信息状态，要么改变遥测方式，但没有一个基准能在统一的任务-方法接口下同时评测三种信息状态（PRE、LIVE、POST）。作者希望解决这一问题，并揭示基准分数可能被捷径（shortcut）所扭曲的问题——即分数可能度量的是语料如何构建，而非方法本身的推理能力。
AI.method: CatchBench 将同一审计问题在三种信息状态下评测：(1) PRE——运行前的声明配置；(2) LIVE——运行的轨迹前缀；(3) POST——完整的运行轨迹。设计了七个任务契约，各自带有独立的标签和度量标准（而非单一的排行榜），其中四个是证据性任务，三个是基于Gold的机制诊断任务。评测了72个参赛者，从规则扫描器到结构模型，再到涵盖9个模型家族的11个LLM裁判。
AI.result: 在72个参赛者中，大部分无法排序：118个预先声明的对比中仅47个可分离，其余作为未解决结果发布而非排名。两个最突出的发现违背了作者自身的数据预期：一个忽略所有名称和权限的简单规则（仅标记每个声明后的第一个能力）在六个配置源之一上达到了完美的F1分数，导致该分数实际上度量的是语料构建方式而非方法推理能力。因此，作者拒绝了这个被注入的基底（substrate），并将另一个从证据性状态中移除。所有排序均由已发布的预测重新生成，无需调用模型。
AI.conclusion: 基准分数在标签背后的过程被公开并测试其可能留下的捷径之前是不具可解释性的。CatchBench 通过在单一任务-方法接口下统一三种信息状态的评测、发布未解决的对比而非强行排名、拒绝被捷径污染的分数，建立了一种更严谨的审计评估范式。其核心洞见是：一个基准数字的可信度取决于其标签生成的透明度与对其捷径的审视。

title: Beyond the Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Context Artifacts for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
summary: Deploying LLMs for enterprise Text-to-SQL is bottlenecked less by the model than by what context reaches it: business logic spans thousands of tables, and no model can ingest a full catalog at once. We argue that the most effective place to intervene is therefore the \emph{knowledge-base context} the model consumes, and that this context should be \emph{constructed} from historical usage rather than tuned for as a fixed input. Using a query-DAG decomposition--the same family of intermediates that enterprise benchmarks like BEAVER annotate, here recovered from production SQL--we compare the value of oracle query graphs versus retrieved knowledge-base context. In this ablation, retrieved knowledge-base context provides the largest marginal improvement when added to the full oracle graph. Building on this, we optimize a distillation procedure that turns historical query profiles into reusable SQL reference cards. On a benchmark of 5176 production queries from a major online retailer, optimizing these context artifacts yields larger gains (${\sim}12$--$25\%$ AST similarity) than optimizing the retrieval harness (${\sim}3$--$12\%$). On the public BEAVER benchmark, which lacks the production-usage signals available in our internal setting, the picture is more mixed: table cards alone perform about the same as raw historical SQL. The best optimized variant retrieves both cards and raw SQL, scoring $9.00\%$ versus $6.33\%$ (p-value $0.12$) for the comparable baseline on a held-out $N{=}300$ subset, using retrieved context and harness changes but no agentic loop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出提升企业Text-to-SQL性能的关键在于构建知识库上下文，而非仅优化模型本身。通过从历史SQL中恢复查询DAG分解，设计蒸馏流程将历史查询转化为可复用的SQL参考卡片。内部基准（5176条生产查询）上优化上下文制品比优化检索框架带来更大提升（AST相似度12-25% vs 3-12%）；公共BEAVER基准上最佳变体同时检索卡片和原始SQL，得分9.00%对比基线6.33%。
AI.motivation: 企业级Text-to-SQL部署的瓶颈不在模型本身，而在于模型所能消费的上下文。业务逻辑横跨上千张表，任何模型都无法一次性摄入完整目录，因此需要对模型消费的知识库上下文进行智能构建而非作为固定输入调优。
AI.method: 使用查询DAG分解（与BEAVER等企业基准标注的中间表示同族）作为分析工具，从生产SQL中恢复查询图结构。通过消融实验比较oracle查询图与检索的知识库上下文的价值，基于此优化蒸馏流程，将历史查询画像转化为可重用的SQL参考卡片。
AI.result: 在5176条生产查询基准上，优化上下文制品比优化检索框架带来更大增益（AST相似度12-25% vs 3-12%）。在公共BEAVER基准（N=300子集）上，最佳优化变体同时检索卡片和原始SQL，得分9.00%对比基线6.33%（p值0.12），无代理循环。
AI.conclusion: 知识库上下文的构建是提升企业Text-to-SQL的最有效干预点；从历史使用中蒸馏的上下文制品（SQL参考卡片）在内部场景显著优于优化检索框架，但在缺乏生产使用信号的公共基准上优势较小，最佳方案仍需结合卡片与原始SQL。

title: Accelerating Diffusion Language Models via Structured Suffix Modeling
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) exhibit strong parallel decoding capabilities by denoising multiple tokens in a single generation step. However, this parallelism comes with substantial computational overhead, as each step requires interactions with all suffix tokens. Existing methods typically reduce this cost by retaining only a local suffix window as a substitute for the full suffix. Despite their effectiveness, these methods overlook the structural heterogeneity across suffix regions and re-initialize suffix tokens with identical representations at each timestep. To this end, we propose a structured suffix modeling method for efficient DLM inference. Specifically, we divide the suffix into three regions, i.e., the local, middle, and tail regions, and retain different numbers of suffix tokens in each region according to their structural roles. Moreover, we incorporate the decoding results from the previous step into the suffix token representations at the current step, allowing them to carry evolving denoising information across generation steps. Notably, our method is training-free and orthogonal to several existing acceleration techniques, such as parallel decoding strategies and KV cache. Empirical results across multiple benchmarks on three DLMs demonstrate that our method can further accelerate DLM inference and improve performance in most cases. In particular, in long-sequence inference, our method achieves up to a \(72.81\times\) speedup when combined with other acceleration techniques. Our code is available at https://github.com/zifengcheng/SSM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结构化后缀建模方法（SSM），用于高效扩散语言模型（DLM）推理。该方法将后缀划分为局部、中部和尾部三个区域，根据各区域的结构角色保留不同数量的后缀令牌，并将上一步的解码结果融入当前步骤的后缀令牌表示中。该方法无需训练，可与其他加速技术（如并行解码和KV缓存）正交结合，在多个基准测试中实现进一步加速并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通过单步去噪多个令牌实现强并行解码，但每一步都需要与所有后缀令牌交互，带来大量计算开销。现有方法虽然通过保留局部后缀窗口来降低成本，却忽略了后缀区域的结构异质性，并且在每个时间步用相同表示重新初始化后缀令牌。
AI.method: 将后缀划分为三个区域（局部、中部、尾部），根据各区域的结构作用保留不同数量的后缀令牌；同时将上一步的解码结果融入当前步骤的后缀令牌表示，使后缀令牌携带跨生成步骤的进化去噪信息。
AI.result: 在三种DLM上的多个基准测试中，该方法进一步加速DLM推理并在大多数情况下提升性能。在长序列推理中，结合其他加速技术可获得最高72.81倍的加速比。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需训练，且与并行解码策略和KV缓存等现有加速技术正交，为DLM推理效率提供了一种有效且通用的补充方案。

title: GuidedFlow: An Attention-Guided Framework for Anomaly Detection in Additive Manufacturing
summary: Additive Manufacturing (AM) plays a vital role in the ongoing industrial revolution. However, quality control remains crucial and challenging due to printing defects or potential cyber-physical intrusions. Image or video-based anomaly detection is a key effort towards addressing these challenges. Various approaches have been explored in this domain, including reconstruction-based, embedding-based, and flow-based methods. Though normalizing flow-based methods address some of the core challenges of unforeseen defects and generalization while maintaining detection performance, existing approaches struggle with tiny/stringing defects common in 3D printing. In a small-data setting, this poses a limitation in generalization. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{GuidedFlow}, a novel attention-guided normalizing flow model for anomaly detection and localization. GuidedFlow employs a pre-trained ResNet model, fine-tuned on the domain dataset. An attention-guided spatial and temporal flow framework models the dynamics across multiple scales and frames. A Spatio-Temporal Attention Network (SAN) enables the flow model to prioritize relevant contextual cues from input frames. We evaluate GuidedFlow on our AM3D-AD dataset, consisting of benign and anomalous real 3D printed object images and videos. We also conduct a comparative study using the MVTec-AD industrial image anomaly detection dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that GuidedFlow outperforms most of the state-of-the-art models with enhanced detection accuracy and AUROC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GuidedFlow，一种基于注意力引导的归一化流模型，用于3D打印过程中的异常检测与定位。该方法利用预训练ResNet（在领域数据上微调）和注意力引导的空时流框架，结合时空注意力网络（SAN）优先关注输入帧中的相关上下文线索，有效解决了传统归一化流方法在处理微小/拉丝缺陷和少量数据泛化方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 3D打印中的质量控制至关重要但充满挑战，现有基于图像/视频的异常检测方法（重建式、嵌入式和流式）在处理微小/拉丝缺陷时表现不佳，尤其在少量数据环境下存在泛化能力受限的问题。归一化流方法虽然解决了部分核心挑战（未预知缺陷和泛化），但仍需改进。
AI.method: GuidedFlow包含三个关键组件：1）预训练ResNet模型在领域数据集上微调提取特征；2）注意力引导的空间和时间流框架，用于跨多尺度和多帧建模动态；3）时空注意力网络（SAN）使流模型优先关注输入帧中的相关上下文线索。
AI.result: 在AM3D-AD数据集（包含真实3D打印物体图像和视频）及MVTec-AD工业图像异常检测数据集上的实验表明，GuidedFlow在检测准确率和AUROC指标上优于大多数最先进的模型。
AI.conclusion: GuidedFlow通过注意力引导的归一化流框架有效提升了3D打印异常检测的性能，特别是在微小/拉丝缺陷检测和少量数据泛化方面，为该领域提供了新的解决方案。

title: SAGE: Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble Feature Selection for Explainable Postpartum Depression Risk Prediction
comment: Accepted for publication at 10th International Artificial Intelligence and Data Processing Symposium (IDAP'26)
summary: Postpartum depression (PPD) poses a major burden on maternal and child health, especially in low- and middle-income countries where prevalence exceeds 19%. Despite advancements in machine learning for PPD prediction, current approaches are limited by opaque global explanations that lack clinical usefulness at the patient level, unstable feature selection, and poor generalization under class imbalance. We propose SAGE, a Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble feature selection system that incorporates both local explainable AI and a genetically optimized artificial neural network (GA-ANN). Using a primary cohort of 766 postpartum women, SAGE combines information-theoretic relevance, PCA-based structure, and graph-based interactions with bootstrap stability weighting to identify robust and non-redundant predictors. The GA-ANN architecture, optimized using a genetic algorithm and enhanced with GAN based oversampling, achieved strong performance with 87.96% accuracy, 86.32% F1 score, and 0.88 AUC using only 16 features, outperforming baseline and other feature selection methods. Psychological and socioeconomic factors such as EPDS score, PHQ-9 score, feelings about motherhood, and abuse history are the main predictors, while demographic factors have less influence. The LIME-based explanations allow instance-based insight into selected features from the graph, enabling personalized risk assessment. The findings make SAGE a scalable, interpretable, and clinical tool for early identification of PPD in health-care limited resources.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGE系统，结合稳定感知的图基集成特征选择、局部可解释AI和遗传算法优化的神经网络（GA-ANN），用于产后抑郁症预测。在766名产后女性队列中仅用16个特征达到87.96%准确率和0.88 AUC，优于基线方法，并提供LIME个性化风险解释。
AI.motivation: 产后抑郁症（PPD）在中低收入国家患病率超19%，负担沉重。现有机器学习预测方法存在三大局限：全局解释缺乏患者层面的临床实用性、特征选择不稳定、类不平衡下泛化能力差。亟需可扩展、可解释且稳定的临床预测工具。
AI.method: SAGE系统整合三大组件：1) 特征选择阶段结合信息论相关性、PCA结构提取和图基交互，并通过bootstrap稳定性加权识别稳健且非冗余的预测因子；2) 采用遗传算法优化的人工神经网络（GA-ANN）进行分类；3) 使用GAN过采样处理类不平衡问题；4) 采用LIME提供实例级（个体患者层面）可解释性。
AI.result: 在766名产后女性队列中，SAGE仅用16个特征实现87.96%准确率、86.32% F1分数和0.88 AUC，优于基线模型及其他特征选择方法。主要预测因子为心理和社会经济因素（EPDS评分、PHQ-9评分、对母职的感受、虐待史），人口统计学因素影响较小。
AI.conclusion: SAGE是有前景的临床工具，兼具可扩展性、可解释性和患者级个性化风险评估能力，适用于医疗资源有限的场景，为PPD早期识别提供支持。

title: Let the Bullets Fly: Multimodal Fake News Detection with Temporal-Aligned Generative Danmaku
summary: The social interactions among crowds via \textit{Danmaku} (a.k.a., bullet comments) on modern multimedia platforms can facilitate both viewpoint conflicts and consensus, providing fine-grained discriminative social signals that can benefit fake news detection. However, the inherent accumulation latency of \textit{Danmaku} in real-world scenarios violates the real-time necessity of fake news detection, making the studies of \textit{Danmaku}-related fake news detection underexplored. To break this violation, we simulate this temporal-aware user interactive process by proposing a novel temporal \textbf{Gen}erative \textbf{da}nmaku framework, called \textbf{Genda}, which consists of: (1) a \textit{Danmaku} Trigger for predicting the timing and intensity of user reactions; and (2) a \textit{Danmaku} Generator for synthesizing corresponding semantic and emotional expressions, thereby mutually constructing a temporally aligned and human-like pseudo \textit{Danmaku} streams. To make the generated \textit{Danmaku} useful for identifying fake news videos, we further design a \textit{Danmaku}-guided Temporal Multimodal fake news detection model - \textbf{DM-FEND}, which enables fine-grained multimodal interactions among video, audio, text, and \textit{Danmaku}, enhancing dynamic modalities alignment and semantic noise inhibition. The experimental results demonstrate that \emph{DM-FEND} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across both Chinese (FakeSV) and English (FakeTT) benchmarks. Further ablations validate the crucial role of temporal \textit{Danmaku} modeling in enhancing robustness and discriminative capability. Finally, this study offers a bright and robust solution for multimodal fake news detection in modern social interactive fashions by bridging the temporal inconsistency between news and user behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Genda框架，通过时序生成式弹幕模拟用户的实时交互行为，并设计了DM-FEND多模态假新闻检测模型，在中文和英文基准上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 弹幕中的社会交互能提供细粒度的判别性社会信号，有助于假新闻检测，但真实场景中弹幕的累积延迟违反了假新闻检测的实时性需求，导致相关研究尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 提出Genda框架，包含两部分：(1) Danmaku Trigger预测用户反应的时间和强度；(2) Danmaku Generator合成相应的语义和情感表达，共同构建时序对齐且类人的伪弹幕流。同时设计DM-FEND模型，实现视频、音频、文本和弹幕间的细粒度多模态交互，增强动态模态对齐和语义噪声抑制。
AI.result: DM-FEND在中文(FakeSV)和英文(FakeTT)两个基准上均持续优于最先进的基线方法，消融实验验证了时序弹幕建模在增强鲁棒性和判别能力方面的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过弥合新闻与用户行为之间的时序不一致性，为现代社交互动方式下的多模态假新闻检测提供了一种明亮且鲁棒的解决方案。

title: CaRGo-T: Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought improves Multimodal Humor Comprehension
summary: Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable versatility across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, understanding humor remains challenging because humorous content often depends on subtle interactions among entities, events, context, and implicit relationships across image and text modalities. These interactions can involve complex chains of reasoning that are difficult to capture through conventional prompting or linear chain-of-thought reasoning. In this work, we propose CaRGo-T (Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought), a reasoning framework that represents the causal and contextual relationships underlying multimodal humor as a lightweight graph-based reasoning structure. The graph is serialized into a code-based representation generated by a VLM, which can subsequently be interpreted by the same or a different VLM to produce the final prediction in zero-shot or in-context learning settings. We evaluate CaRGo-T on humor understanding and humor detection across four datasets spanning diverse forms of comedic content, including satire, sarcasm, and memes. Experiments with state-of-the-art commercial and open-source VLMs show that CaRGo-T consistently improves performance over existing reasoning-based baselines, achieving gains of approximately 1-20% on humor understanding and 1-3% on humor detection. Further analysis using mutual information indicates that the reasoning representations produced by CaRGo-T contain more information relevant to the target output than those generated by baseline reasoning approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/abhi1nandy2/CaRGo-T.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaRGo-T（Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought），一个基于因果推理图的框架，用于提升大规模视觉语言模型（VLM）在多模态幽默理解与检测任务上的表现。该方法将图像与文本中的因果和上下文关系表示为轻量级图结构，序列化为代码形式供VLM解读，在零样本和上下文学习场景下均优于现有推理基线。
AI.motivation: 幽默内容的理解对VLM而言仍具挑战性，因为幽默往往依赖于实体、事件、上下文及跨模态隐含关系之间的微妙交互，涉及复杂的推理链，难以通过常规提示或线性思维链（chain-of-thought）方法捕捉。
AI.method: CaRGo-T将多模态幽默背后的因果与上下文关系构建为轻量级基于图的推理结构，由VLM将该图序列化为基于代码的表示，随后由相同或不同的VLM解释该表示以生成最终预测，可在零样本或上下文学习设置下运行。
AI.result: 在四个涵盖讽刺、挖苦和模因等多样喜剧内容的数据集上，使用商业和开源SOTA VLM进行评估，CaRGo-T在幽默理解上提升约1-20%，在幽默检测上提升约1-3%。互信息分析表明CaRGo-T产生的推理表示包含更多与目标输出相关的信息。
AI.conclusion: 基于图的因果推理结构相比线性推理方法能更有效地捕捉多模态幽默中的复杂关系，为提升VLM在幽默等细粒度多模态理解任务上的能力提供了新的思路。

title: VersaDB: A High-Performance AI Storage Database for Unifying Mutimodal Datasets
summary: The AI field has been rapidly developing, leading to the emergence of a large number of AI training datasets of various types. These datasets contain different modalities, including text, images, audio, etc., and may come in various data storage formats. With the advancement of AI hardware, AI computation units like GPUs, TPUs, and NPUs can greatly accelerate the training speed of AI models, which in turn increases the demand for faster data processing. When using existing AI processing frameworks to handle datasets with different modalities and storage formats, processing speeds may be suboptimal due to issues such as data layout and the way users handle the data. Therefore, using a unified database to store multiple data formats can better manage and optimize data access. In this paper, we introduce VersaDB, a database designed specifically for AI datasets with various modalities. We implemented a page-based storage system, separating structured and unstructured data. Additionally, we generated B+ tree-based index files to accelerate data access. VersaDB supports automatic sharding and maintains a hierarchical metadata management system, with corresponding metadata maintained at the page, shard, and global levels, forming the foundation for the efficient operation of the database. We also focused on ease of use by providing APIs for directly converting datasets into VersaDB, as well as APIs for converting popular AI data storage formats (e.g., CSV, TFRecord, .bin) into VersaDB.Our experiments show that using VersaDB can achieve up to 5.35x acceleration and maintain consistent performance across different parallelism levels.

AI.tldr: VersaDB是一个专门为多模态AI数据集设计的数据库系统，采用页式存储、B+树索引和分层元数据管理，支持自动分片，可将多种AI数据格式（CSV、TFRecord、.bin等）统一转换存储，实验表明可达到最高5.35倍的加速效果，并在不同并行度下保持稳定性能。
AI.motivation: 随着AI领域快速发展，涌现了大量包含不同模态（文本、图像、音频等）和不同存储格式的AI训练数据集。尽管GPU/TPU/NPU等AI硬件大幅加速了模型训练，但现有AI处理框架在处理多模态、多格式数据时，由于数据布局和用户处理方式等问题，处理速度可能达不到最优。因此需要一个统一的数据库来存储多种数据格式，以更好地管理和优化数据访问。
AI.method: VersaDB设计包括：（1）基于页面的存储系统，将结构化与非结构化数据分离存储；（2）生成基于B+树的索引文件以加速数据访问；（3）支持自动分片（sharding）；（4）维护页级、分片级和全局级的分层元数据管理系统；（5）提供直接将数据集转换为VersaDB的API，以及将主流AI数据格式（CSV、TFRecord、.bin）转换为VersaDB的API。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用VersaDB可以实现最高5.35倍的数据处理加速，并且在不同并行度水平下均能保持一致的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: VersaDB通过统一的多模态数据存储架构、高效的索引和分层元数据管理，有效解决了AI数据集在异构硬件和框架下的数据处理性能瓶颈问题，为AI数据管理提供了实用且高性能的解决方案。

title: Fairness-Aware Mixture-of-Experts via Subgroup Reweighting and Gate Regularization
summary: Deep learning models often produce performance disparities across demographic groups, due to the training data imbalance with respect to sensitive attributes such as gender or age. To address this problem, existing work has explored fair representation learning, data re-sampling, and adversarial training, which can be broadly categorized into two main approaches. Single-stage methods typically learn a shared representation for fairness, but often struggle to handle heterogeneous subgroup distributions. Two-stage methods learn representations separately from the final prediction task, which can lead to misalignment between fairness objectives and downstream predictions. We identify routing-induced bias, a failure mode in which subgroup imbalance drives the gating network to route subgroups onto a few experts, and propose an end-to-end Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that corrects it. Specifically, we apply subgroup reweighting to correct data imbalance, and introduce gate entropy regularization to prevent routing from collapsing onto subgroup attributes, keeping expert utilization both balanced and interpretable. Beyond improving fairness, the routing distribution offers an interpretable view of how subgroups are allocated across experts. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach improves fairness while maintaining competitive predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端的Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）框架，通过子组重加权修正数据不平衡，并引入门控熵正则化防止路由塌缩到子组属性上，从而解决深度学习中因训练数据不平衡导致的人口统计群体性能差异问题，在提升公平性的同时保持预测性能。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型常因训练数据中敏感属性（如性别、年龄）不平衡而产生跨人口统计群体的性能差异。现有方法分为单阶段和两阶段两类：单阶段方法学习共享表征处理公平性但难以应对异质子组分布；两阶段方法将表征学习与预测任务分离，导致公平目标与下游预测不对齐。本文识别出"路由诱导偏差"这一失效模式，即子组不平衡使得门控网络将子组路由到少数专家上，亟需解决。
AI.method: 提出端到端的MoE框架：1）应用子组重加权（subgroup reweighting）修正数据不平衡；2）引入门控熵正则化（gate entropy regularization）防止路由塌缩到子组属性上，保持专家利用的平衡性和可解释性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提方法在提升公平性的同时保持了竞争性的预测性能，且路由分布提供了子组在专家间如何分配的可解释视角。
AI.conclusion: 通过端到端MoE框架结合子组重加权和门控熵正则化，有效纠正了路由诱导偏差，同时兼顾公平性提升、预测性能保持以及路由分配的强可解释性。

title: FinixDoc: Rethinking Financial Document Parsing Beyond Saturated Benchmarks
summary: Financial document parsing requires accuracy, structural consistency, and verifiability that current benchmarks often fail to reflect. We present FinixDoc, an end-to-end agentic parsing system for real-world financial documents, with FinixDoc-VL, a 4B-scale vision-language model built on Qwen3-VL-4B, as its core parser. To characterize the gap between benchmark and deployment performance, we introduce a Document Parsing Capability Matrix organized along two practical axes: visual quality and document scale. Guided by this matrix, FinixDoc-VL is trained with a domain-adapted recipe combining homoglyph-aware contrastive learning and multi-stage reinforcement learning with composite domain-specific rewards. To better leverage our accumulated advantage in low-quality financial-document data and support large-scale, high-quality data production, we further build a human-in-the-loop Data Factory pipeline with confidence-aware expert review. For evaluation, we construct FinixDocBench, a financial-domain evaluation suite covering digital-native, camera-captured, ultra-large-page, and internal-workflow scenarios, with a compliance-reviewed subset released alongside this technical report. On its main subsets, FinixDoc-VL achieves the highest overall score (81.43) among evaluated baselines, outperforming the next-best open-source model by 5.13 points, with the largest gains on internal financial workflows (FinixInner: 84.08 vs. 78.73).

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinixDoc，一个端到端的智能体金融文档解析系统，其核心是构建在Qwen3-VL-4B基础上的4B参数视觉语言模型FinixDoc-VL。系统引入了文档解析能力矩阵来刻画基准测试与部署性能差距，并设计了领域适配训练方案（同形字感知对比学习+多阶段强化学习）。此外还构建了人机协同的数据工厂流水线和金融领域评估套件FinixDocBench，在主要子集上取得了81.43的最高综合分数，超越最佳开源模型5.13分。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试无法真实反映金融文档解析在实际部署中的准确性、结构一致性和可验证性需求，存在基准性能与部署性能之间的巨大鸿沟。
AI.method: 1) 提出文档解析能力矩阵，沿视觉质量和文档规模两个实践轴刻画性能差距；2) 采用同形字感知对比学习与多阶段强化学习（复合领域奖励）的训练配方；3) 构建人机协同的Data Factory流水线，包含置信度感知的专家审核机制；4) 构建金融领域评估套件FinixDocBench，覆盖数字原生、相机拍摄、超大幅面和内部工作流四类场景。
AI.result: FinixDoc-VL在FinixDocBench主要子集上取得81.43的最高综合得分，领先最佳开源模型5.13分；在内部金融工作流（FinixInner）子集上优势最大，得分84.08对比78.73。
AI.conclusion: 通过领域适配训练、数据工厂流水线和针对性的评估套件，能够有效弥合金融文档解析中基准测试与真实部署之间的性能差距，并在内部金融工作流场景中取得最显著的提升。

title: LongWoF-Bench: Evaluating EvoMap Genes for Verifiable Long-Workflow Tasks
summary: Large language models are increasingly expected to execute complex workflows whose success depends on maintaining interdependent constraints and producing artifacts that satisfy strict end-to-end verification. Yet successful execution experience is typically lost after a single run, forcing subsequent models to rediscover strategies and failure modes from scratch. We study whether such experience can instead be externalized and reused through EvoMap, where verifier-confirmed execution trajectories are consolidated into structured Gene. To evaluate this setting, we introduce the Long-Workflow Benchmark (LongWoF-Bench), comprising 778 machine-verifiable tasks across code generation, agent-environment synthesis, mathematical reasoning, and rule following. On the 252 tasks with verifier-confirmed Opus trajectories, evolved EvoMap Gene outperform Skill across all seven evaluated models by 8.7-15.5 percentage points, with the gains extending to consumer models from different model families. In contrast, reference-distilled Gene do not exhibit the same advantage, indicating that compact representation alone is insufficient and that Gene utility is closely associated with verified experience provenance. For Claude Opus, Gene reuse also completes 39 more tasks than Skill while reducing solve-time token consumption by 9.9%. Together, these results show that verified execution experience can be retained and shared as a reusable external resource, enabling models to improve long-workflow completion without repeatedly paying the full cost of experience discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoMap框架，将验证器确认过的执行轨迹整合为结构化"Gene"（基因）并复用，使大语言模型在执行长流程任务时无需从头重新发现策略。作者引入LongWoF-Bench基准（778个可机器验证任务），实验表明EvoMap Gene在252个任务上比Skill方法提升8.7-15.5个百分点，且相比参考蒸馏的Gene更具优势，凸显了"经验溯源"（verified experience provenance）的重要性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型执行复杂工作流时，成功经验在一次运行后即丢失，后续模型不得不从头重新发现策略和失败模式，导致重复付出高昂的"经验发现成本"。作者希望将验证器确认过的执行经验外部化并复用，避免重复探索。
AI.method: 提出EvoMap框架：将验证器确认的成功执行轨迹整合为结构化的Gene（基因）。同时引入LongWoF-Bench基准，涵盖代码生成、智能体环境综合、数学推理和规则遵循四类共778个机器可验证任务。通过对比演化的Gene、参考蒸馏的Gene与Skill方法的性能差异，评估经验复用效果。
AI.result: 在252个具有验证器确认的Opus轨迹任务上，演化得到的EvoMap Gene在全部7个评估模型上比Skill方法高出8.7-15.5个百分点，且收益延伸到不同模型家族的消费级模型。参考蒸馏的Gene没有相同优势，说明紧凑表示本身不够，Gene效用与验证经验溯源密切相关。对Claude Opus，Gene复用比Skill多完成39个任务，同时减少9.9%的求解期token消耗。
AI.conclusion: 验证过的执行经验可以被保留并作为可复用的外部资源共享，使模型在不重复付出完整经验发现成本的前提下提升长工作流完成能力。Gene的有效性关键在于经验来源的验证可信度，而非仅靠紧凑的表示形式。

title: Direct, Parallel, or Sequential? A Comparative Study of Training-Free Multi-Subject Image-to-Video Generation
summary: Text-conditioned image-to-video (I2V) generation has advanced rapidly, yet generating videos with multiple subjects remains challenging. A model must simultaneously preserve the appearance of each subject, assign distinct motions, and maintain coherent spatial and temporal interactions. This paper presents a systematic study of three representative paradigms for training-free multi-subject I2V generation: direct, parallel, and sequential generation. Direct generation applies a pretrained I2V model to the complete reference image and prompt, requiring all subjects and motions to be synthesized jointly. Parallel and sequential generation instead decompose the reference image and prompt into subject-specific visual and textual conditions. Parallel generation synthesizes each subject independently and subsequently composes the resulting videos, reducing the complexity of each generation step at the cost of weaker inter-subject context. Sequential generation first synthesizes a background video and then progressively introduces individual subjects. This preserves accumulated scene context but introduces sensitivity to subject ordering and error propagation. We empirically evaluate the three paradigms across diverse multi-subject scenes, comparing appearance preservation, motion fidelity, temporal consistency, and inter-subject coherence, while also characterizing their distinct failure modes. Our findings reveal the strengths and limitations of each paradigm and offer practical insights for designing controllable multi-subject video generation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了无训练多主体图像到视频（I2V）生成的三种代表性范式：直接生成、并行生成和顺序生成，并对其在主体外观保持、运动保真度、时间一致性和主体间连贯性等方面进行了实证评估，揭示了各范式的优势、局限和失败模式。
AI.motivation: 多主体I2V生成具有挑战性，模型需要同时保持每个主体的外观、分配不同运动并维持连贯的空间与时间交互。目前缺乏对现有无训练多主体I2V方法的系统性比较研究，因此本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 将多主体I2V生成归纳为三种代表性范式：直接生成（对完整参考图像和提示直接应用预训练I2V模型）、并行生成（将参考图像和提示分解为逐主体条件，独立合成后再拼接视频）、顺序生成（先合成背景视频，再逐步引入各个主体）。在多样化的多主体场景下进行实证对比。
AI.result: 通过实验对比了三种范式在主体外观保持、运动保真度、时间一致性和主体间连贯性四个维度上的表现，并刻画了各自独特的失败模式。并行生成降低了单步生成复杂度但主体间上下文较弱；顺序生成保留了场景上下文累积但受主体顺序和错误传播影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了每种范式的优缺点，为设计可控的多主体视频生成系统提供了实用见解和指导。

title: DIME: Query-Efficient Framework for Membership Inference on Diffusion Models
summary: Membership inference attacks expose whether individual records were used to train a model, yet existing attacks on diffusion models are largely heuristic and can require substantial query budgets. We introduce DIME (Denoiser Ideal Membership Error), a theoretically grounded and query-efficient framework for membership inference on diffusion models. Our starting point is an exact characterization of the optimal diffusion denoiser for a finite training set, which reveals that membership leakage is governed by the denoiser's implicit reconstruction error. This error decomposes into two complementary signals: a bias term, capturing reconstruction accuracy, and a previously unexplored local crowding term, capturing the geometry of nearby training examples. Both admit efficient estimators using only model queries, yielding a practical attack with as few as two queries. Across CIFAR-10/100, STL10-U, CelebA, and ImageNet, DIME consistently outperforms prior attacks at comparable or substantially lower query cost, improving TPR at 1% FPR by up to $3\times$; remarkably, its two-query variant can outperform existing 30-query baselines. Finally, we suggest, discuss, and evaluate specific defenses to counteract such powerful membership tests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DIME（Denoiser Ideal Membership Error），一个基于理论推导且查询高效的扩散模型成员推断攻击框架。通过精确刻画有限训练集上最优扩散去噪器的形式，发现成员泄露由去噪器的隐式重建误差决定，该误差分解为偏置项（捕捉重建精度）和局部拥挤项（捕捉邻近训练样本的几何结构）。通过仅两次模型查询即可有效估计，在多个数据集上以更低查询成本显著优于现有攻击方法。
AI.motivation: 现有针对扩散模型的成员推断攻击大多是启发式的，且需要大量查询预算。作者希望建立一个理论上有依据、查询高效的成员推断攻击框架，以更好地理解扩散模型中的隐私泄露问题。
AI.method: 1) 从理论上精确刻画有限训练集上最优扩散去噪器的形式；2) 将成员泄露归因于去噪器的隐式重建误差，并分解为偏置项和局部拥挤项两个互补信号；3) 提出仅需两次模型查询的高效估计方法，形成实用攻击框架DIME。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100、STL10-U、CelebA和ImageNet等数据集上，DIME在相同或更低查询成本下一致优于现有攻击方法，在1% FPR下的TPR提升最高达3倍；仅两次查询的变体即可超越现有需要30次查询的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DIME提供了理论严谨且查询高效的扩散模型成员推断攻击，揭示了去噪器重建误差中隐藏的成员泄露信号，并提出和评估了相应的防御措施来应对此类强大攻击。

title: GSAR: Goal-State-Anchor Rewards for Mobile GUI Agents with Self-Evolving Data Synthesis
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) based GUI agents stand to benefit significantly from online reinforcement learning (RL). However, their training is bottlenecked by two fundamental issues: current data synthesis methods for GUI Agents rely on specific environments and struggle to generate diverse data, while existing evaluators either suffer from limited scalability or provide inaccurate and unreliable reward signals. To overcome these challenges, we introduce GSAR (Goal-State-Anchor Reward), a RL reward framework that supports scalable task generation and delivers reliable reward signals for stable and efficient policy optimization. Our approach features self-evolving data synthesis, which produces multiple environments through task execution and generates diverse tasks and goal states. Complementing this, a state-anchor mechanism automatically annotates task-relevant UI elements in successful goal states as reference anchors. During RL training, these reference anchors provide accurate, scalable reward signals that substantially enhance efficiency. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework achieves over 90% accuracy on offline trajectory verification and performs closest to rule-based methods. Furthermore, agents trained using our reward framework exhibit strong performance on both AndroidWorld and our constructed benchmark, establishing a scalable approach for GUI agent training.

AI.tldr: 提出了GSAR（Goal-State-Anchor Reward）框架，通过自进化数据合成生成多样化GUI任务，并利用状态锚点机制提供可靠、可扩展的奖励信号，用于视觉语言模型GUI智能体的在线强化学习训练。
AI.motivation: 基于VLM的GUI智能体能从在线强化学习中显著受益，但训练受两大瓶颈限制：现有数据合成方法依赖特定环境且难以生成多样化数据；现有评估器要么可扩展性有限，要么提供不准确不可靠的奖励信号。
AI.method: GSAR框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 自进化数据合成——通过任务执行生成多个环境，产生多样化的任务和目标状态；(2) 状态锚点机制——自动标注成功目标状态中与任务相关的UI元素作为参考锚点，在RL训练中提供准确且可扩展的奖励信号。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该框架在离线轨迹验证上达到90%以上的准确率，最接近基于规则的基准方法。使用该奖励框架训练的智能体在AndroidWorld和自建基准上均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: GSAR建立了可扩展的GUI智能体训练方法，有效解决了数据多样性和奖励信号可靠性两大核心挑战，为GUI智能体的强化学习训练提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

title: SiZeUp: Fast 3D Proxy from Aerial Images via Depth Ordinal Loss
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
summary: We present SiZeUp, a fast and scalable approach for constructing large-scale 3D urban proxy models directly from calibrated oblique aerial imagery. Our method adopts a height-from-footprint representation, reducing 3D building abstraction to a low-dimensional optimization problem in which building footprints are extruded by a single height parameter. To enable efficient and robust height estimation, we introduce an ordinal depth consistency loss that enforces agreement between the relative depth ordering of rendered proxies and depth priors predicted by a monocular depth model. This is realized through a differentiable renderer that maps parametric building proxies into multi-view depth images, allowing gradients to be propagated from depth supervision to building heights. Our ordinal formulation produces stable optimization in practice and avoids explicit feature matching or dense point cloud reconstruction. Rather than relying on metric depth, which can be unreliable under monocular scale ambiguity, our ordinal depth consistency loss operates on relative depths, providing a more reliable signal across views. Combined with an efficient dynamic view selection, our approach achieves a 23-52$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art proxy reconstruction pipelines while maintaining comparable proxy-level coverage and volume consistency, making it well suited for large-scale urban modeling tasks.

AI.tldr: SiZeUp是一种快速可扩展的3D城市代理模型构建方法，直接从倾斜航空影像出发，采用高度-足迹表示，通过序数深度一致性损失和可微渲染器来高效估计建筑高度，相比现有方法实现23-52倍加速，同时保持相当的代理覆盖率与体积一致性。
AI.motivation: 大规模3D城市建模需要快速且可扩展的代理模型构建方法。现有方法依赖特征匹配或稠密点云重建，成本高、速度慢，且基于度量深度的方法在单目尺度模糊下不可靠。作者希望绕开这些瓶颈，直接从倾斜航空影像高效构建城市代理模型。
AI.method: 采用高度-足迹（height-from-footprint）表示，将建筑抽象为足迹加单一高度参数的优化问题。引入序数深度一致性损失，通过可微渲染器将参数化代理映射为多视角深度图像，与单目深度模型预测的相对深度排序对齐以传播梯度，结合动态视图选择提升效率。
AI.result: 相比现有最先进代理重建管线实现23-52倍加速，同时保持可比的代理级覆盖率和体积一致性，适用于大规模城市建模。
AI.conclusion: SiZeUp证明了序数深度一致性损失结合可微渲染能稳定有效地估计建筑高度，避免了对度量深度和稠密点云的依赖，为大规模城市场景提供了高效可行的解决方案。

title: Hierarchy-Aware Supervised Uncertainty Estimation for Black-box LLM Taxonomic Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for scientific decision support, yet reliable confidence estimation remains difficult in black-box settings. We study uncertainty estimation for hierarchical taxonomic reasoning generated by a black-box LLM in a long-tailed biodiversity monitoring pipeline. Using proxy features extracted by an open-source tool LLM, we train lightweight supervised estimators with hierarchy-aware supervision to predict rank-wise correctness. Across three tool LLMs, the supervised estimators consistently outperform a token-likelihood baseline for micro discrimination and selective prediction under a single global rejection threshold, improving micro AUROC from 0.57 to 0.75--0.80. The best results are achieved by a rank-specific multi-head design (H3), suggesting that accounting for hierarchical output structure is important when a unified abstention rule is required. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/uoguelph-mlrg/hierarchy-aware-llm-uq

AI.tldr: 该论文研究黑盒大语言模型（LLM）在长尾生物多样性监测管道中做层级分类推理时的置信度估计问题。作者利用开源工具LLM提取代理特征，训练轻量级监督估计器，并采用层级感知监督来预测各分类层级（rank）的正确性。实验结果表明，监督估计器在三个工具LLM上均优于token似然基线，将micro AUROC从0.57提升至0.75-0.80，其中rank-specific多任务头设计（H3）效果最佳。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用于科学决策支持，但在黑盒设置下可靠的置信度估计仍然困难。特别是在长尾生物多样性监测这样的层级分类任务中，需要准确的置信度估计来支持选择性预测和决策。
AI.method: 使用开源工具LLM提取代理特征，训练轻量级监督估计器，采用层级感知的监督信号（hierarchy-aware supervision）预测每个分类层级（rank）的正确性。提出三种设计，其中最好的H3采用rank-specific多任务头架构，考虑了输出的层级结构。
AI.result: 在三个工具LLM上，监督估计器始终优于token似然基线。在全局单一拒绝阈值下的micro判别和选择性预测方面，micro AUROC从0.57提升到0.75-0.80。H3（rank-specific多任务头设计）取得最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 当需要统一弃权规则（abstention rule）时，考虑层级输出结构对于不确定性估计很重要。这一方法为黑盒LLM在层级分类任务中的置信度估计提供了可行且有效的解决方案。

title: Your AI, On a Dial: Controlling Investment Bias in LLMs with a Single Neuron
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in investment decision-making, yet prior work shows that they exhibit systematic, model-specific investment preferences. We study whether a model's overall investment stance can be calibrated to a specified direction and strength. We introduce an investment-bias dial, an inference-time intervention on a single neuron that continuously adjusts a model-level decision prior---its overall tendency toward buying or selling---without targeting specific firms or investment attributes. Using matched positive and negative evidence, we evaluate five open-weight LLMs and find that the dial produces monotonic changes in investment stance without modifying prompts or model parameters. At the response level, the dial shifts both investment decisions and the evidential emphasis of generated rationales under identical inputs. In an agentic retrieval setting, the dial also changes what information the model searches for, which evidence it selects, and which evidence is reflected in its final analysis. In a long-context evaluation, the dial maintains stable stance control as context length increases, whereas a matched system-prompt instruction progressively attenuates. We further show that changes in the dial propagate to security rankings and downstream portfolio composition in an exploratory backtest. Overall, our results show that an LLM's aggregate investment stance can be calibrated toward a specified target at inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"投资偏好拨盘"（investment-bias dial），即对单个神经元的推理时干预，可连续调节大语言模型整体的买卖倾向，无需修改提示词或模型参数，并验证了其在决策、推理、检索和长上下文场景下的有效性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在投资决策中表现出系统性、模型特定的投资偏好，这可能导致不可控的决策偏差。现有方法（如系统提示指令）在长上下文场景下效果衰减，因此需要一种更稳定、可连续校准模型整体投资立场的手段。
AI.method: 作者引入"投资偏好拨盘"，通过对单个神经元的推理时干预，连续调整模型层的决策先验（即整体买卖倾向）。使用匹配的正负证据，在五个开放权重LLM上评估，涵盖响应级决策、生成推理的论证重点、智能体检索设置、长上下文评估以及安全排名和下游投资组合的回测。
AI.result: 拨盘在五个模型上产生单调的投资立场变化；在响应级别同步改变投资决策与推理中的证据侧重；在检索场景中改变模型搜索的信息、选择的证据以及最终分析反映的证据；在长上下文评估中保持稳定的立场控制，而系统提示指令则逐渐衰减；变化传播到安全排名和下游投资组合构成。
AI.conclusion: LLM的总体投资立场可以通过推理时的单神经元干预被校准到指定方向和强度，提供了一种比提示词更稳定、更精细的投资偏差控制方法。

title: A Multi-Domain and Multi-Task Generative Framework with Explicit Task and Domain Conditioning for Cross-Domain Event Extraction
summary: Event extraction aims to identify event triggers, classify event types, and extract arguments to construct structured event representations. Despite strong in-domain performance, developing models that generalize robustly across domains remains challenging due to variations in contextual expressions and event schemas. Prior unified and multi-task approaches improve in-domain accuracy but exhibit limited flexibility when applied to unseen domains. Even large language model-based methods that provide full event ontologies at inference time often underperform compared to smaller, task-specific fine-tuned models. We propose a unified multi-domain and multi-task training framework that models heterogeneous event schemas within a single model. Our approach introduces domain conditioning signals, jointly with task-specific prompts, enabling dynamic adaptation to dataset-specific schemas without requiring complete event label sets at inference time. The framework supports both pipeline and end-to-end extraction settings, facilitating efficient task- and domain-level transfer. Experiments on diverse event extraction benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance, strong cross-domain generalization, and practical scalability, while preserving domain-specific precision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的多领域、多任务事件抽取训练框架，通过领域条件信号和任务特定提示，在单一模型中建模异构事件模式，无需在推理时提供完整事件标签集，同时支持pipeline和端到端两种抽取设置，实验表明该方法在跨域泛化和可扩展性上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的统一和多任务方法虽然能提升域内准确率，但在面对未见领域时灵活性有限；即便是基于大语言模型在推理时提供完整事件本体，其性能仍常不如小规模任务特定微调模型。因此需要一种能在单一模型中灵活适应不同领域事件模式的统一训练框架。
AI.method: 提出统一的多领域多任务训练框架，在单个模型中建模异构事件模式。核心创新包括：1) 引入领域条件信号（domain conditioning signals）；2) 结合任务特定提示（task-specific prompts）；3) 支持动态适应数据集特定模式，无需推理时提供完整事件标签集；4) 同时支持pipeline和端到端两种事件抽取设置。
AI.result: 在多种事件抽取基准上的实验表明，该方法取得具有竞争力的性能，展现出强大的跨领域泛化能力，具备实际可扩展性，同时保持了领域特定的抽取精度。
AI.conclusion: 该统一训练框架有效解决了事件抽取中的跨域泛化难题，在不需要推理时提供完整事件本体的条件下，通过领域条件信号和任务提示实现了对异构事件模式的动态适应，为多领域事件抽取提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案。

title: VeCAS: Vessel-Focused Contrast-Free Angiogram Synthesis for Vascular Interventions
summary: X-ray angiography relies on iodinated contrast agents to visualize vascular structures during image-guided interventions. However, contrast administration carries risks of adverse events, motivating the development of contrast-free alternatives. Generating X-ray angiograms directly from non-contrast X-ray images offers a potential solution, but existing approaches remain limited by (i) insufficient control over vascular localization and (ii) inefficient modeling of redundant background content. To address these challenges, we propose VeCAS, a two-stage vessel-focused contrast-free angiogram synthesis framework that separates vascular structure localization from angiographic appearance synthesis. In Stage I, a discriminative model localizes vascular structures in non-contrast X-ray images, while cross-modality latent distillation transfers vessel-sensitive knowledge from X-ray angiograms during training. In Stage II, a vessel-focused inpainting model synthesizes angiographic appearance within the localized vascular regions while preserving the non-vascular background. Experiments on an in-house lower-limb vascular intervention dataset show that VeCAS outperforms the comparison methods in terms of vascular structural fidelity and image quality. Visual Turing tests and physician assessments indicate the perceptual realism of the synthesized angiograms. In addition, robotic guidewire navigation experiments in vascular phantoms show that VeCAS guidance reduces the time to target by 41.4% and the number of operation steps by 40.7% compared with non-contrast guidance. Together, these results suggest the potential of VeCAS to serve as ``meta contrast agent'' for vascular interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VeCAS，一种两阶段的无对比剂血管造影合成框架，将血管结构定位与造影外观生成分离，通过判别模型定位血管并结合跨模态潜在蒸馏，再利用血管聚焦修复模型合成造影外观，在临床和机器人导航实验中均展现出显著优势。
AI.motivation: 传统的X射线血管造影依赖碘化造影剂，存在不良反应风险。直接从无对比剂X光图像生成血管造影图虽有潜力，但现有方法在血管定位控制和背景冗余建模方面存在不足。
AI.method: VeCAS采用两阶段设计：Stage I使用判别模型在无对比剂X光图像中定位血管结构，并通过跨模态潜在蒸馏从真实血管造影中迁移血管敏感知识；Stage II利用血管聚焦修复模型在定位的血管区域内合成造影外观，同时保持非血管背景不变。
AI.result: 在下肢血管介入数据集上，VeCAS在血管结构保真度和图像质量上优于对比方法；视觉图灵测试和医生评估证实了合成血管造影的感知真实性；机器人导丝导航实验中，VeCAS引导将到达目标时间缩短41.4%，操作步骤减少40.7%。
AI.conclusion: VeCAS展现出作为血管介入"元造影剂"的潜力，能够有效替代传统造影剂进行血管可视化引导，同时避免造影剂相关不良反应风险。

title: RIBOSPAN: A Long-Context RNA Foundation Model for Versatile RNA Modeling
summary: Full-length RNAs, particularly messenger RNAs, often exceed the context lengths used to pretrain existing RNA foundation models, limiting complete-transcript modeling at single-nucleotide resolution. We present RIBOSPAN, a 1.61-billion-parameter bidirectional RNA foundation model natively pretrained with context lengths up to 10,240 nt. RIBOSPAN combines dense bidirectional self-attention, single-nucleotide tokenization, and attention-isolated sequence packing to enable high-resolution modeling of complete long RNAs. We evaluate the model through nucleotide reconstruction, a controlled long-context representation benchmark, and frozen RNA-type representation analysis. Native 10K pretraining preserves strong reconstruction at 10,240 tokens, while continued pretraining with 40% masking improves recovery under heavy corruption while preserving representation quality. The long-context benchmark further shows that native 10K models maintain strong contextual responsiveness and context-specific representation separation while keeping perturbation-induced representation changes highly localized. Inference-time YaRN scaling recovers much of the contextual organization lost by direct extrapolation of short-context models, but induces substantially greater distal representation diffusion. Frozen-representation evaluations further demonstrate state-of-the-art RNA representation quality, with RIBOSPAN achieving the strongest overall performance across diverse RNA types and retaining a clear advantage on long RNAs. Building on the same backbone, we develop a multidimensionally conditioned discrete-diffusion framework for full-length mRNA generation and redesign, including synonymous-codon diffusion for protein-preserving CDS optimization. Together, RIBOSPAN establishes a powerful long-context foundation for transferable RNA representation learning and full-transcript mRNA design.

AI.tldr: RIBIOSPAN是一个16.1亿参数的RNA基础模型，原生预训练支持长达10,240个核苷酸的上下文长度，结合双向自注意力、单核苷酸标记化和注意力隔离的序列打包技术，实现完整长RNA的高分辨率建模。实验表明其在长上下文表示学习和全长mRNA生成方面均达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有RNA基础模型的预训练上下文长度往往短于全长RNA（特别是mRNA）的实际长度，限制了在单核苷酸分辨率下对完整转录本的建模能力。
AI.method: 提出RIBIOSPAN模型，采用：(1) 密集双向自注意力架构，(2) 单核苷酸标记化，(3) 注意力隔离的序列打包技术，实现原生10,240核苷酸上下文长度的预训练。同时开发了基于同一骨干的多维条件离散扩散框架用于全长mRNA生成与重设计，包括同义密码子扩散用于蛋白质保持的CDS优化。
AI.result: 原生10K预训练在10,240标记长度下保持强重建能力；40%掩码的持续预训练在重度损坏下改善恢复同时保持表示质量；长上下文基准显示原生10K模型保持强上下文响应性和上下文特异性表示分离，扰动引起的表示变化高度局部化。冻结表示评估达到最先进水平，在多种RNA类型上表现最强，尤其对长RNA有明显优势。
AI.conclusion: RIBIOSPAN建立了强大的长上下文RNA基础模型，为可迁移的RNA表示学习和全长转录本mRNA设计提供了坚实基础，同时发现推理时YaRN缩放虽然能恢复部分上下文组织，但会引入更大的远端表示扩散。

title: Proxy reliance in large language model decisions is uncalibrated to predictive evidence
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are entering decisions in triage and lending, where task-relevant inference must be distinguished from impermissible proxy use. Current audits ask whether decisions change when demographics change. But attributes correlated with a protected group carry predictive value, so a changed decision can be discrimination or sound inference. We measure causal proxy effects in four LLMs on a clinical-ranking task with known ground truth, where the reliance the evidence warrants can be computed exactly and used as the reference. One audit signal yields three verdicts: over-reliance, warranted and under-reliance. Under neutral labels every model relies on proxies with no information. Informative proxies draw all three. Social field names push reliance down, below the reference in one model. Two findings explain this. Reliance severely undertracks the evidence, and social-label suppression is fragile, since in-context examples raise it above zero in every model. Accuracy-based evaluation detects none of this.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型在分诊和借贷等决策中可能不当使用受保护群体代理变量（proxy）的问题，提出了一种度量因果代理效应的审计方法。在具有已知真实基准的临床排序任务中，该方法能区分过度依赖、合理依赖和依赖不足三种情况，并发现模型普遍对信息量低的代理变量过度依赖，而对信息丰富的代理变量依赖不足，且社交媒体标签抑制脆弱，传统基于准确率的评估无法发现这些问题。
AI.motivation: 现有审计方法仅检查决策是否随人口统计属性变化而改变，但无法区分这是歧视行为还是基于关联属性的合理推断，因为与受保护群体相关的属性本身携带预测信息。需要一个能区分"正当依赖"与"不当代理使用"的审计框架。
AI.method: 在具有已知真实标签的临床排序任务上，精确计算证据所应支持的依赖程度作为参考基准，对四种LLM测量因果代理效应，将审计信号划分为过度依赖、合理依赖和依赖不足三类，并通过中性标签、信息标签和社会领域名称等不同实验条件进行对比分析。
AI.result: 中性标签下所有模型都依赖无信息代理变量；信息性代理变量诱导出三类依赖模式；社会领域名称降低了依赖度，其中一个模型低于参考基准。发现模型对证据的依赖严重不足，且社会标签抑制效果脆弱——上下文示例能在所有模型中将其重新提升到零以上。基于准确率的评估完全无法检测到这些问题。
AI.conclusion: 现有基于准确率的审计方式无法揭示LLM的代理变量使用问题，需要以因果效应为导向、以精确基准为参照的审计方法。同时，简单的标签抑制手段不可靠，需要更稳健的干预措施来防止LLM在决策中不当使用受保护群体信息。

title: Credal Large Language Models for Semantic Commitment under Uncertainty
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often produce fluent but incorrect answers with unwarranted confidence. A central limitation is that standard LLMs represent uncertainty through a single predictive distribution, conflating epistemic ignorance with genuine ambiguity. We introduce Credal Large Language Models (CLLMs): an ensemble of LoRA adapters induces a credal set whose lower and upper probabilities expose the spread of plausible predictive distributions rather than collapsing to a single softmax output. From this representation we derive two complementary commitment scores. Credal Token Commitment (CTC) is a token-space score that combines lower-bound support, credal width, and intersection entropy, computed without additional generation. Semantic Commitment Consistency (SCC) extends commitment to semantic space using sampled completions, with SCC-Gap measuring the mismatch between token-level and semantic-level support. We evaluate hallucination detection, calibration, selective prediction, and reasoning on Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B across OpenBookQA, CoQA, TriviaQA, and ARC-Challenge. CLLM is the best method on QA accuracy at competitive expected calibration error, and CTC tracks the best hallucination AUROC within 1.5 pp on most settings without additional generation. On selective prediction at 80% coverage, CLLM with SCC reaches 99.0% accuracy on OpenBookQA, and on ARC-Challenge CLLM with Csem confidence achieves <= 0.6% ECE across the three backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Credal Large Language Models (CLLMs)，通过LoRA适配器集成诱导credal set，用上下概率暴露预测分布的分散性而非坍缩为单一softmax输出，并据此推导出两种互补的承诺分数（CTC和SCC），在幻觉检测、校准、选择性预测和推理任务上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 标准LLM通过单一预测分布表示不确定性，混淆了认知无知（epistemic ignorance）与真实歧义（genuine ambiguity），导致模型经常产生流畅但错误且过度自信的答案。
AI.method: 1) 用LoRA适配器集成构造credal set表示不确定性；2) 从credal set推导两种承诺分数：Credal Token Commitment (CTC)在token空间结合下界支持、credal宽度和交叉熵；Semantic Commitment Consistency (SCC)在语义空间利用采样完成度衡量token级与语义级支持的不匹配（SCC-Gap）。
AI.result: 在Gemma-2-9B、Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B三个骨干模型上，CLLM在OpenBookQA、CoQA、TriviaQA和ARC-Challenge上取得最佳QA准确率且具有竞争力的期望校准误差；CTC在大多数设置下幻觉检测AUROC仅差最优方法1.5个百分点且无需额外生成；在80%覆盖率的选择性预测中，CLLM+SCC在OpenBookQA达到99.0%准确率，CLLM+Csem在ARC-Challenge上三个骨干的ECE不超过0.6%。
AI.conclusion: CLLM通过credal set表示能够有效区分认知不确定性与歧义，在无需额外生成的情况下实现接近最优的幻觉检测性能，并在选择性预测和校准方面表现优异，为LLM不确定性建模提供了新范式。

title: Following Motion for Sequential Modeling in Video Frame Interpolation
summary: State Space Models (SSMs) have surfaced as a promising architecture in Video Frame Interpolation (VFI), as they can capture long-range dependencies with linear computational complexity. However, their predefined scanning order limits their effectiveness in modeling the dynamic motion trajectories inherent in VFI problems. To tackle this challenge, we propose Motion-Guided Mamba for Video Frame Interpolation (MGMVFI), an adaptation of the selective state space model tailored explicitly for VFI. MGMVFI introduces Motion-Guided Serialization (MGS), which leverages optical flow to define a motion-adaptive 1D input order for the SSM. This aligns the causal state updates with semantically related tokens, enabling motion-consistent feature propagation, particularly for large and dynamic motions. Additionally, to mitigate the unreliable feature representations caused by inaccurate optical flow estimates, we introduce contextual synthesis that utilizes the surrounding spatial context for robust inter-frame feature synthesis. These components are seamlessly integrated within our tailored Mamba architecture, which also employs a lightweight refinement block to enhance local detail reconstruction at a reduced computational cost. Extensive experiments on standard VFI benchmarks demonstrate that MGMVFI achievesstate-of-the-artperformance,particularly on complex and dynamic motions, thereby establishing a new direction for sequence modeling in video interpolation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MGMVFI，一种针对视频帧插值（VFI）任务定制的选择性状态空间模型（Mamba）架构。通过Motion-Guided Serialization（MGS）利用光流定义运动自适应的1D输入顺序，使SSM的状态更新与语义相关token对齐；同时引入上下文合成机制应对光流估计不准确的问题，并采用轻量级精化模块提升局部细节重建。在标准VFI基准上取得最先进性能。
AI.motivation: SSM（如Mamba）在VFI中具备线性复杂度捕获长程依赖的潜力，但其固定的扫描顺序无法有效建模VFI中固有的动态运动轨迹，限制了其表现力。
AI.method: 1) Motion-Guided Serialization (MGS)：利用光流将帧内token按运动轨迹重新排序为运动自适应的1D序列，使SSM的因果状态更新与语义相关的token对齐；2) 上下文合成：利用周围空间上下文进行鲁棒的帧间特征合成，缓解光流估计不准确带来的不可靠特征；3) 轻量级精化模块：以较低计算成本增强局部细节重建。
AI.result: 在标准VFI基准数据集上取得最先进性能，尤其在复杂和动态运动场景下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: MGMVFI验证了序列建模在视频插值中的新方向，即通过运动引导的序列化方式使SSM更好地适应VFI的动态运动建模需求。

title: Thinking at the Right Size: Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs
summary: Practical deployment of large language models (LLMs) requires families of post-trained variants---instruction-tuned, reasoning-tuned, and chat-style models---each at multiple sizes to meet diverse latency and memory budgets. Producing each (variant, size) pair independently is prohibitive, so model families typically span only a handful of coarse-grained sizes per post-trained variant. Boomerang distillation (Kangaslahti et al., 2026) reduces this cost along the size axis for base models. Through model size interpolation, it constructs models of intermediate sizes from a single teacher-student pair without additional training. However, it still treats each post-trained variant as a separate object of optimization. We introduce ADAPT---Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs---a framework for amortizing distillation across both axes of a model family: size and post-training variant, producing $L \times K$ models for $L$ interpolated sizes across $K$ post-trained variants with a single distillation run. ADAPT combines two components. First, a two-phase distillation procedure constructs post-trained students through pre-training alignment and supervised fine-tuning distillation, enabling smooth size--performance interpolation on generation and reasoning tasks. Second, weight-delta initialization approximates this construction across post-trained variants by transferring the distillation-induced weight change from the base model to students initialized from different post-trained variants. The resulting continuum of interpolated models also enables adaptive model-size selection at inference time, improving the compute--accuracy trade-off for long-form reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ADAPT框架，通过单次蒸馏运行同时沿"规模"和"后训练变体"两个轴摊销蒸馏成本，从一对教师-学生对生成L×K个模型（L种插值规模×K种后训练变体）。该方法结合两阶段蒸馏过程和权重增量初始化两大组件，有效降低模型家族生产与部署成本。
AI.motivation: 实际部署大语言模型需要多种后训练变体（指令微调、推理微调、聊天模型）且每种变体需多个规模以适应不同延迟和内存预算。独立生产每个(变体, 规模)组合成本过高，现有Boomerang蒸馏仅沿规模轴降低成本，但后训练变体仍被当作独立优化对象，缺乏跨变体的摊销方案。
AI.method: ADAPT包含两个核心组件：(1) 两阶段蒸馏过程——通过预训练对齐和指令微调蒸馏构建后训练学生模型，实现规模与性能间的平滑插值；(2) 权重增量初始化——通过将基础模型蒸馏引起的权重变化迁移到从不同后训练变体初始化的学生模型上，近似跨变体的构建过程。
AI.result: ADAPT能够在单次蒸馏运行中同时沿规模和后训练变体两个轴生成L×K个模型。生成的插值模型连续体还支持推理时的自适应模型规模选择，改善了长形式推理任务上的计算-精度权衡。
AI.conclusion: ADAPT通过摊销蒸馏成本实现了高效的模型家族构建，将成本从每个(变体,规模)对独立优化降低为单次蒸馏运行，同时保留了生成与推理任务上的性能，并解锁了推理时自适应规模选择的能力。

title: CDEG: Learning Decision-Critical Evidence for Long-Horizon Diagnostic Agents
summary: Unlike static medical question answering, long-horizon diagnosis captures the sequential nature of clinical practice: evidence is progressively acquired, integrated, and evaluated over multiple rounds of interaction before reaching a final diagnosis. However, existing doctor agents often fail when critical evidence is either not acquired or not adequately incorporated into diagnostic reasoning. Recent agentic approaches attempt to address these failures by reusing historical trajectories or distilled memories. But their diagnostic gains remain constrained because such experience may contain noisy or incidental information and is typically reused without validating which evidence actually drives diagnostic decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce CDEG, a graph-based framework that learns reusable decision-critical evidence from historical diagnostic trajectories. CDEG contrasts successful and failed trajectories from the same case to identify candidate evidence, validates their diagnostic impact through controlled counterfactual interventions, and organizes the resulting diagnosis--evidence--action relations into a structured graph. During inference, CDEG tracks the evolving patient evidence state to retrieve relevant diagnostic relations and selectively guide missing evidence acquisition or overlooked evidence reappraisal. Across in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks with multiple doctor agent backbones, CDEG consistently improves diagnostic performance, achieving up to an 11.5% accuracy gain over vanilla agents. These results demonstrate that reliable long-horizon diagnosis requires moving beyond trajectory-level experience reuse toward evidence-level learning of the factors that truly shape clinical decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CDEG框架，一个基于图结构的方法，通过对比成功与失败的诊断轨迹来识别关键证据，并通过反事实干预验证其诊断影响力，最终将诊断-证据-动作关系组织成结构化图。在推理时，CDEG跟踪患者证据状态以检索相关诊断关系，引导缺失证据获取或被忽视证据的重新评估。在多个基准和医生代理骨干上，CDEG实现了最高11.5%的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的医生代理在长时序诊断中经常失败，因为关键证据要么未被获取，要么未被充分整合到诊断推理中。虽然近期代理方法尝试通过复用历史轨迹或蒸馏记忆来解决这些问题，但其诊断收益受限，因为这些经验可能包含噪声或偶然信息，且通常未验证哪些证据真正驱动了诊断决策。
AI.method: CDEG框架包含三个核心步骤：(1) 对比同一案例中成功与失败的诊断轨迹以识别候选证据；(2) 通过受控的反事实干预验证候选证据的诊断影响；(3) 将验证后的诊断-证据-动作关系组织为结构化图。在推理阶段，CDEG跟踪不断演变的患者证据状态，检索相关的诊断关系，并选择性引导缺失证据获取或对忽视的证据进行重新评估。
AI.result: 在域内和域外分布基准上，使用多种医生代理骨干，CDEG一致地提升了诊断性能，与普通代理相比实现了最高11.5%的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的长时序诊断需要超越轨迹级经验复用，转向证据级学习，理解真正塑造临床决策的因素。

title: Future Querying: Can LLMs Serve as Implicit Medical World Models?
comment: This paper is accepted at The 1st MICCAI Workshop on Medical World Models (MICCAI-2026)
summary: Traditional clinical prediction models rely on task-specific pipelines and curated, structured data, which scale poorly and underutilize unstructured text. To address this, we introduce future querying, a paradigm that probes whether large language models (LLMs) can function as implicit medical world models by evaluating their ability to answer time-indexed clinical queries about a patient's future. Our framework operates on unstructured clinical documentation using endpoint-agnostic training, enabling a single model to answer diverse clinical queries over patient trajectories without manual feature engineering or task-specific retraining. We show that small, locally fine-tuned open-weight models can match or approach larger proprietary systems, making the framework suitable for privacy-preserving, on-premise deployment. Evaluated on a new synthetic medical reports dataset and real ICU notes from the MIMIC-IV dataset, our results provide encouraging evidence that LLMs can capture aspects of clinical dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"未来查询"（future querying）范式，探索将大语言模型（LLM）作为隐式医学世界模型，直接基于非结构化临床文本回答关于患者未来的时间索引临床查询，无需任务特定管线或人工特征工程。
AI.motivation: 传统临床预测模型依赖任务特定的管线和高昂的结构化数据，扩展性差且未能充分利用非结构化文本信息，亟需更灵活、通用的预测范式。
AI.method: 提出未来查询范式，基于非结构化临床文档，采用端点无关（endpoint-agnostic）训练，使单一模型能回答多种时间索引的临床预测查询，无需特征工程或任务特定重训练。
AI.result: 在新型合成医学报告数据集和MIMIC-IV真实ICU笔记上评估，小型本地微调的开源权重模型可匹配或接近大型专有模型，验证了LLM能够捕捉临床动态的某些方面。
AI.conclusion: LLM有潜力作为隐式医学世界模型进行临床预测，且小型开源模型在隐私保护、本地部署场景下具备可行性，为临床预测建模提供了新方向。

title: Toward Sub-1 kB Identity-Preserving Face Compression: A Benchmark of Codecs, a Custom Learned Codec, and Studies of Resolution, Demographic Fairness, Recompression, and Adversarial Robustness
summary:
Storing face images under a hard sub-kilobyte budget, as required for identity documents, smart-card biometrics and bandwidth-constrained verification, forces a codec to discard most of the signal while keeping what a face matcher actually reads: identity. Generic codecs optimize pixel fidelity, not the embedding distances that drive verification, so which codec, resolution and setting best preserve identity at 1024 bytes or less, and how that degrades at 512, is unclear.
  We benchmark ten general and face-specific codecs across resolutions, byte budgets, two datasets (controlled Color FERET, in-the-wild AI-Solutions-KK) and four anchor face matchers, with a fourteen-model ViT and CNN roster confirming the ranking is backbone-invariant. We then train a custom identity-preserving codec that hits the byte budget exactly via binary search over a frozen gain table, and run four studies: resolution, demographic fairness, recompression, and no-box adversarial robustness.
  Sub-kilobyte identity preservation is feasible, but which codec to deploy depends entirely on the budget. At 1024 bytes and the 112 px working resolution the problem is close to solved: modern codecs hold Color FERET equal-error rate under 0.35 percent on the ArcFace anchor. At 512 bytes the field re-sorts: AVIF, HEIF, JPEG XL and legacy JPEG collapse to 28 to 98 percent false-non-match rate at FMR 1e-4, while WebP, JPEG-AI and our byte-budgeted learned codecs stay out of that band, with 24.3 percent for WebP against 6.9 percent for our accurate variant in the wild. That re-sort, not the 1024-byte ranking, is the operational result: a codec chosen at 1 kB is not the codec to deploy at half that.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了亚千字节（sub-kilobyte）预算下的人脸图像压缩与身份保持问题。作者基准测试了十种通用与专用人脸编解码器，在不同分辨率、字节预算、两个数据集和四个锚定人脸匹配器下评估。随后训练了一种自定义的保身份编解码器，通过二分搜索冻结增益表精确命中字节预算。核心发现：1024字节和112px工作分辨率下问题接近解决（Color FERET上ArcFace锚定的EER低于0.35%），但在512字节时编解码器排名完全重排，AVIF、HEIF、JPEG XL和JPEG崩溃至28-98%的FNMR，而WebP、JPEG-AI和学习的编解码器保持可用。关键结论是：1kB下选择的编解码器不适用于512字节。
AI.motivation: 身份文档、智能卡生物识别和带宽受限验证需要在极低字节预算（1024字节以下）下存储人脸图像，但通用编解码器优化像素保真度而非驱动验证的嵌入距离。目前尚不清楚哪种编解码器、分辨率和设置在1024字节及512字节下最能保持身份信息，以及性能如何随预算缩减而退化。
AI.method: 基准测试十种通用和专用人脸编解码器，覆盖多个分辨率、字节预算、两个数据集（受控的Color FERET和自然场景AI-Solutions-KK）以及四个锚定人脸匹配器，并用14个模型的ViT和CNN阵容验证排名与骨干网络无关。随后训练自定义保身份编解码器，通过冻结增益表上的二分搜索精确命中字节预算。进行了四项研究：分辨率、人口统计公平性、再压缩和黑盒对抗鲁棒性。
AI.result: 亚千字节身份保持是可行的，但部署哪个编解码器完全取决于预算。1024字节和112px分辨率下现代编解码器在ArcFace锚定上Color FERET的EER低于0.35%。512字节时排名重排：AVIF、HEIF、JPEG XL和JPEG的FNMR在FMR 1e-4下崩溃至28-98%，而WebP（24.3%）、JPEG-AI和字节预算学习的编解码器（野外准确变体6.9%）保持在该带之外。
AI.conclusion: 关键操作结论是榜单重排现象：1kB下选择的编解码器并非512字节下应该部署的编解码器。这种重新排序而非1024字节排名才是实际部署中最需要关注的结果。

title: Mapping the Concept Landscape: Structural Perception of Global Distributions for Transparent Data Pruning
summary: Existing data pruning methods predominantly rely on high-dimensional feature embeddings to measure sample importance. However, these compressed vectors often obscure fine-grained semantic interactions, leading to suboptimal coverage of rare semantic concepts in the pruned subsets. In this paper, we propose Mapping the Concept Landscape (MCL), a novel structural perception framework for transparent data pruning. Instead of abstract embeddings, we represent each image-caption pair as an explicit sample-level graph comprising entities, events, and attributes. By integrating these individual graphs into a comprehensive dataset-level graph, we characterize the global distribution of semantic concepts and quantify their rarity across the entire corpus. Based on this structured perception, we develop a greedy concept-coverage maximization algorithm that iteratively selects samples to maximize the marginal gain of high-value, under-represented concepts. Experimental results on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method not only achieves superior pruning efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods but also provides a transparent and interpretable audit trail for the selection process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCL（Mapping the Concept Landscape）框架，用显式的语义概念图（实体、事件、属性）替代高维特征嵌入来表征样本，通过数据集级图谱量化概念稀有度，并采用贪婪的概念覆盖最大化算法进行数据剪枝，在多个基准上取得了优于现有方法的剪枝效率，同时提供了可解释的选择过程。
AI.motivation: 现有数据剪枝方法依赖高维特征嵌入来度量样本重要性，但这些压缩向量会模糊细粒度的语义交互，导致剪枝子集中稀有语义概念的覆盖不足。
AI.method: 1) 将每个图像-文本对表示为包含实体、事件和属性的样本级显式图；2) 将个体图整合为数据集级图以刻画语义概念的全局分布并量化稀有度；3) 设计贪心概念覆盖最大化算法，迭代选择样本以最大化高价值且欠表达概念边际增益。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，MCL相比最先进方法实现了更优的剪枝效率，同时提供了透明可解释的选择审计轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化的概念图谱感知替代抽象嵌入，MCL在提升剪枝性能的同时实现了选择过程的可解释性，为数据剪枝提供了新的透明化方向。

title: Beyond Observed Auxiliary Relations: Environment-Conditioned Modeling for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026 (35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management). 11 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables
summary: Multi-behavior recommendation (MBR) leverages auxiliary behavioral signals, such as clicks and add-to-cart, to enhance target behavior prediction like purchases. While recent graph neural network-based approaches have achieved strong performance by systematically propagating auxiliary behavior signals, they still suffer from two fundamental challenges inherent to auxiliary behaviors: (1) missing auxiliary signals, which hinder generalization to items without auxiliary observations, and (2) unreliable auxiliary signals, which amplify noise misaligned with the target behavior. To address these challenges in a unified manner, we propose BOAR, an environment-conditioned MBR framework that addresses missing and unreliable auxiliary signals through two complementary modules conditioned on auxiliary observability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BOAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving up to 7.82% gains in HR@10 overall and up to 44.2% gains for target items without auxiliary observations, highlighting its ability to capture hidden preferences beyond observed auxiliary relations. Our code is available at: https://github.com/LSH0411/BOAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BOAR，一个环境条件化的多行为推荐框架，通过两个基于辅助行为可观测性条件的互补模块，统一解决辅助信号缺失和不可靠两个核心挑战。实验显示BOAR在HR@10上最高提升7.82%，对无辅助观测的目标物品最高提升44.2%。
AI.motivation: 多行为推荐利用点击、加购等辅助行为信号来增强购买等目标行为预测。然而现存的基于图神经网络的方法面临两个根本性挑战：辅助信号缺失（阻碍对无辅助观测物品的泛化）和辅助信号不可靠（放大与目标行为不一致的噪声）。现有方法未能统一处理这两个问题。
AI.method: 提出BOAR（环境条件化的MBR框架），通过两个互补模块来分别处理缺失和不可靠的辅助信号，且这两个模块以辅助行为可观测性为条件进行设计，实现统一建模。
AI.result: 在广泛实验中，BOAR一致优于最先进的基线方法，HR@10整体最高提升7.82%，对无辅助观测的目标物品最高提升44.2%，展示了捕获超出已观测辅助关系之外隐藏偏好的能力。
AI.conclusion: BOAR有效解决了多行为推荐中辅助信号缺失与不可靠的双重挑战，尤其对缺乏辅助观测的物品表现出显著优势，代码已开源。

title: A Scalable Cross-Domain Event Extraction System via a Unified Generative Training Framework
summary: Event extraction is fundamental to information extraction. Prior approaches often separate event detection and argument extraction or depend on dataset-specific designs, limiting scalability and cross-domain generalization. We propose a unified generative sequence-to-sequence framework that performs event extraction subtasks jointly and supports both pipeline and end-to-end configurations. We fine-tune pretrained language models on multiple event datasets across diverse domains, enabling a single model to retain domain-specific semantics while generalizing over large and evolving label spaces. We demonstrate these capabilities through a web-based application tailored for researchers and practitioners. The platform supports document upload, schema-aware event extraction, visualization of triggers and arguments, and comparison of different extraction configurations across domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的生成式序列到序列框架，用于联合执行事件抽取的子任务，同时支持pipeline和端到端两种配置。通过在多个跨领域事件数据集上微调预训练语言模型，使单一模型既能保留领域特定语义，又能泛化到大规模和演进的标签空间，并构建了面向研究者和实践者的Web应用平台。
AI.motivation: 现有的事件抽取方法往往将事件检测和参数抽取分离处理，或依赖数据集特定的设计，导致可扩展性和跨领域泛化能力受限。作者旨在解决这些局限性，提出统一的框架以支持跨领域的通用事件抽取。
AI.method: 采用统一的生成式序列到序列（seq2seq）框架，将事件抽取的多个子任务联合建模。框架支持pipeline和端到端两种配置，通过在多样领域的多个事件数据集上微调预训练语言模型，使单一模型能够适应大规模和不断演进的标签空间。同时开发了基于Web的应用程序，支持文档上传、模式感知的事件抽取、触发词和参数的视觉化展示，以及跨领域不同抽取配置的比较。
AI.result: 论文展示了通过Web应用平台实现的能力，包括文档上传、模式感知抽取、触发词和参数可视化，以及跨领域抽取配置对比。验证了所提框架在统一多任务学习和跨领域泛化方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 统一的生成式seq2seq框架能够有效联合执行事件抽取子任务，在不牺牲领域特定语义的前提下实现跨领域泛化，并通过实际Web应用验证了其在研究与实践场景中的实用价值。

title: Large-Small Model Collaboration for Zero-Shot Surgical Phase Recognition
summary: Task-specific lightweight models for surgical phase recognition excel at capturing temporal dynamics but generalize poorly under domain shift. Conversely, surgical foundation models (FMs) offer superior transferability via large-scale pretraining, yet their lack of explicit temporal modeling often yields temporally inconsistent predictions, leading to degraded performance. To exploit the complementary strengths of both paradigms, we propose \textbf{La}rge-\textbf{S}mall \textbf{T}emporal adaptation (\textbf{LaST}), a novel large-small collaborative framework that enables zero-shot adaptation to unseen clinical domains. In LaST, the FM initiates the pipeline by generating frame-level phase priors that serve as initial weak supervision. To effectively utilize these noisy phase priors, we introduce an iterative temporal refinement scheme that integrates dynamic quality control to filter reliable predictions and dual-model cross-learning to mitigate confirmation bias. Simultaneously, the lightweight model leverages its intrinsic temporal modeling ability to progressively correct inconsistent predictions and enhance overall accuracy across iterations. At the end, a cycle replay strategy is employed to close the loop: the refined, more accurate predictions are utilized as upgraded supervision signals for the subsequent iterations, fostering a self-reinforcing evolution of both label quality and model capability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LaST achieves robust adaptation to unseen domains for zero-shot surgical phase recognition, outperforming the baseline (PeskaVLP) by 24.85\%-43.17\% in accuracy and even surpassing fully supervised linear probing and several state-of-the-art few-shot approaches. Codes will be released at https://github.com/YIYIZH/LaST.

AI.tldr: LaST是一个大-小模型协同的零样本手术阶段识别框架，通过大型基础模型生成帧级相位先验，小型轻量模型利用时序建模能力迭代修正预测，并采用循环回放策略不断提升标签质量，实现未见过临床域的自适应。
AI.motivation: 任务特定的轻量级手术阶段识别模型擅长捕捉时序动态但在域偏移下泛化差；而手术基础模型迁移能力强但缺乏显式时序建模导致预测时序不一致。两种范式各有优劣，互补结合有望解决零样本跨域适应问题。
AI.method: 提出大-小协同框架LaST：1) 基础模型(FM)生成帧级相位先验作为初始弱监督；2) 引入迭代时序精炼方案，包含动态质量控制筛选可靠预测和双模型交叉学习缓解确认偏差；3) 轻量模型利用时序建模能力逐步修正不一致预测；4) 循环回放策略将精炼后的准确预测作为增强监督信号反馈至后续迭代，形成自增强演化。
AI.result: 大量实验证明LaST在零样本手术阶段识别中实现了对未见过域的鲁棒适应，相比基线PeskaVLP准确率提升24.85%-43.17%，甚至超越了全监督线性探测和多个最先进的少样本方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过大-小模型协作和迭代自增强机制，LaST有效地弥合了基础模型迁移能力与轻量模型时序建模能力之间的鸿沟，为手术阶段识别领域的零样本跨域适应提供了新的解决方案。

title: Stochastic Separability of Embedding Manifolds
summary:
Neurobiological studies and representation learning have observed that representations of objects belonging to the same category in high-dimensional neural spaces exhibit low-dimensional object manifold characteristics, and different object manifolds are linearly separable in these neural spaces. However, these experimentally observed phenomena lack rigorous theoretical validation to date.
  This paper proposes a new stochastic separability theorem for embedding manifolds of two different object categories. First, we establish a projection measure concentration theorem for embedding manifolds under general conditions. We develop a new two-layer measure concentration analysis technique, which unifies two estimation bounds via the law of total expectation to derive measure concentration inequalities.
  Based on the measure concentration theorem, we further prove a stochastic separability theorem for embedding manifolds of two different object categories. If two datasets have distinct means and bounded total variances, their samples become linearly separable with high probability, provided that the projection direction satisfies a non-singularity condition.
  The main contributions of this paper are twofold:
  1. We prove the projection concentration properties of embedding manifolds in high-dimensional spaces by using two-lawyer tail-bound inequalities.
