Using Random Forest classifiers as a baseline evaluator, our empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that mapping unlabeled instances into a predictive probability space and weighting the result by entropy often dominates the other options for active learning selection with Greedy K-center.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了Greedy K-center主动学习方法在不同度量空间（原始特征空间、LDA空间、模型导出概率空间（有无熵加权））的性能表现，使用随机森林分类器作为基线评估器，在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，将未标记实例映射到预测概率空间并利用熵加权在Greedy K-center主动学习选择中通常优于其他方案。
AI.motivation: 主动学习是解决分类模型需要大量标注数据问题的潜在方法，池化主动学习通过查询最有信息量的样本来降低成本，而多样性方法试图选择数据的代表性子集。本文旨在评估Greedy K-center在不同度量空间中的性能，以确定最优的主动学习选择策略。
AI.method: 使用Greedy K-center作为主动学习选择方法，在四种度量空间中进行评估：原始特征空间、线性判别分析（LDA）空间、模型导出的概率空间（不加熵加权）、以及带熵加权的模型导出概率空间。以随机森林分类器作为基线评估器，在合成数据集和真实数据集上进行实验。
AI.result: 实证结果表明，将未标记实例映射到预测概率空间并对结果进行熵加权，在Greedy K-center主动学习选择中通常优于其他方案。
AI.conclusion: 概率空间映射结合熵加权是Greedy K-center主动学习中最有效的度量空间选择，为主动学习中的多样性采样提供了更优的实现方式。

title: SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning
summary: Self-reflection is a powerful mechanism for credit assignment in human learning, converting sparse outcome feedback into actionable guidance. However, its potential for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. We propose Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a framework that internalizes this capability. SRPO enables LLMs to analyze their own completed trajectories, synthesize errors into concise "reflection patches," and use reflection-conditioned teacher scores on student on-policy rollouts as dense token-level training signals. This process effectively transforms sparse terminal supervision into dense, token-level learning signals without requiring external critics, separate reward models, or larger teacher models. We demonstrate that SRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across mathematical reasoning and long-horizon agentic benchmarks with exceptional data efficiency. Using a Qwen3-8B base model, SRPO attains 73.3% on AIME'24 using only 8% (0.08x) of the training FLOPs required by scaled supervised fine-tuning, while significantly improving success rates on WebShop (64.7%), ALFWorld (76.8%), and SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%). Code is available at https://github.com/Galleons2029/SRPO

AI.tldr: SRPO框架通过让LLM自我反思完成轨迹，并将稀疏的终端奖励转化为密集的token级训练信号，无需外部评判模型，实现了数学推理和智能体任务上的SOTA性能与极高的数据效率。
AI.motivation: 人类学习中自我反思是强大的信用分配机制，能将稀疏的反馈转化为可操作的指导，但其在LLM训练后阶段的潜力尚未被充分探索。现有方法依赖外部评判器或奖励模型，缺乏内在的自我反思能力。
AI.method: SRPO让LLM分析自身完成的轨迹，将错误综合为简洁的"反思补丁"，并利用反思条件化的教师评分作用于学生策略的在线轨迹，作为密集的token级训练信号。该过程无需外部评判器、独立奖励模型或更大的教师模型。
AI.result: SRPO在数学推理和长时程智能体基准上取得SOTA表现。基于Qwen3-8B，在AIME'24上达到73.3%，仅需SFT所需8%的训练FLOPs；在WebShop（64.7%）、ALFWorld（76.8%）和SWE-Bench-Lite（31.2%）上显著提升成功率。
AI.conclusion: SRPO证明自我反思可以内化为LLM的训练机制，将稀疏的终端监督有效转化为密集的token级学习信号，以极高的数据效率实现优异性能，为LLM后训练提供了一条无需外部模型的创新路径。

title: E2S-Pruner: Progressive Two-Stage Evidence Fusion for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models typically encode an image into hundreds of visual tokens, incurring substantial inference latency and GPU memory overhead. Existing pruning methods largely rely on attention scores and directly aggregate outputs across attention heads and network layers, making it difficult to characterize evidential uncertainty and conflict. We propose E2S-Pruner, a progressive two-stage evidence-fusion framework for visual token pruning that requires no auxiliary model, trainable parameters, or fine-tuning. In the first stage, E2S-Pruner treats each attention head as an independent evidence source, estimates its reliability from evidence clarity and inter-head consistency, and represents each visual token using three states: important, unimportant, and uncertain. In the second stage, Dempster--Shafer evidence theory is used to quantify inter-layer conflict and fuse complementary evidence from multiple network layers. We further introduce a spatial novelty constraint that promotes coverage of distinct image regions and prevents the retained tokens from concentrating in a few locally salient areas. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, E2S-Pruner retains 98.0%, 96.8%, and 90.6% of the aggregate performance when the average numbers of retained visual tokens are 192, 128, and 64, respectively, while improving throughput by 1.96x and 2.09x under the 128-token and 64-token settings. Experiments on Qwen2-VL-7B further demonstrate cross-model generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/taoyu-qian/E2S-Pruner.git.

AI.tldr: 提出E2S-Pruner，一种无需微调、无需辅助模型的两阶段证据融合式视觉token剪枝框架，利用Dempster-Shafer证据理论建模注意力头间不确定性与层间冲突，配合空间新颖性约束，在LLaVA和Qwen2-VL上实现高压缩率下性能保持与推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型将图像编码为数百个视觉token，造成高推理延迟和GPU内存开销；已有剪枝方法多依赖注意力分数且直接跨头跨层聚合，难以刻画证据的不确定性和冲突。
AI.method: 两阶段渐进式证据融合框架：第一阶段将每个注意力头视为独立证据源，从证据清晰度和头间一致性估计可靠性，将token分为重要/不重要/不确定三态；第二阶段用Dempster-Shafer证据理论量化层间冲突并融合多层互补证据；另引入空间新颖性约束防止保留token集中于局部显著区域。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，保留192/128/64个视觉token时分别保持98.0%/96.8%/90.6%的聚合性能，128和64token设置下吞吐量提升1.96x和2.09x；Qwen2-VL-7B实验验证了跨模型泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: E2S-Pruner证明了将证据理论引入视觉token剪枝的可行性，通过建模不确定性与冲突来替代简单注意力聚合，实现了无需训练的高效剪枝，且具备跨模型通用性。

title: ProxyFormer: A Dual-Stream Proxy Architecture for Ultra-Long Context and High-Resolution Generation
summary: The quadratic growth of attention computation and key-value (KV) cache with respect to sequence length is a central bottleneck for ultra-long-context language models and high-resolution generative models. We propose ProxyFormer, a general dual-stream architecture built upon proxy tokens. In each layer, fine-grained local features are compressed bottom-up into a small set of proxy states; expensive global interactions are performed only in the compressed proxy space; the globally contextualized proxies are then decompressed and injected top-down back into the local stream. Because the local stream persists across layers, fine-grained information that is not captured by one compression step remains accessible for later refinement, alleviating the irreversible information loss of conventional one-shot compression. We further introduce factorized multi-level compression/decompression, layer-wise dynamic compression ratios, asymmetric dual embeddings, and a proxy-only KV-cache inference scheme. On a 16GB GPU with batch size 1, a standard decoder-only model can train sequences of only about 20K tokens, whereas ProxyFormer with a compression ratio of 64 extends the trainable sequence length to about 0.7M. A model trained with a 64K window retains 92%-95% retrieval accuracy on a multi-needle retrieval task with 1,048,576 tokens, and a model trained with an 8K window exceeds 94% accuracy when extrapolated to 256K tokens. Preliminary image-generation experiments demonstrate the feasibility of ProxyFormer for both pixel-space and latent-space flow matching.

AI.tldr: ProxyFormer提出了一种基于代理令牌的双流架构，通过将细粒度局部特征压缩为少量代理状态、在压缩空间中执行全局交互、再解压回局部流的方式，克服了注意力计算和KV缓存随序列长度二次增长的核心瓶颈，支持超长上下文训练与推理。
AI.motivation: 注意力计算和KV缓存随序列长度呈二次增长，这是超长上下文语言模型和高分辨率生成模型的核心瓶颈。现有的一次性压缩方法存在不可逆的信息丢失问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出双流架构：局部流跨层保留，代理流完成全局交互；2) 引入因子化多级压缩/解压、逐层动态压缩比率、非对称双嵌入；3) 提出代理专用KV缓存推理方案，避免存储全部token的KV。
AI.result: 在16GB GPU、batch size为1的条件下，标准decoder-only模型只能训练约20K token序列，而ProxyFormer在压缩比64下可将可训练序列长度扩展至约0.7M。64K窗口训练的模型在1,048,576 token的多针检索任务上保持92%-95%的检索准确率，8K窗口训练的模型外推至256K token时准确率超过94%。图像生成实验验证了其在像素空间和潜空间流匹配中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: ProxyFormer通过代理令牌进行全局信息压缩与交互，有效解决了长序列下的计算和存储瓶颈，同时通过局部流跨层保留缓解了一次性压缩的信息损失，在语言模型和生成模型场景均展现出良好的扩展性与可行性。

title: Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty
summary: Reasoning-Induced Misalignment, where fine-tuning on reasoning data containing no harmful content, including mathematics, code, and problem-solving with chain-of-thought traces can induce harmful behaviors of LLM, posing a serious challenge to the safety of LLM reasoning. Cross-architecture, cross-scale, and cross-dataset checks show that RIM does not always emerge. Previous work attributed RIM to neuron-level entanglement, but did not identify the geometry of the representation space underlying this entanglement or propose a training-time fix. We provide both: a representation-space analysis of RIM and the Safety-Direction Penalty (SDP), which penalizes movement along a learned safety direction during reasoning fine-tuning. The analysis extracts two activation-space directions, one encoding reasoning ability and the other safety behavior. These directions are coupled: fine-tuning that improves reasoning shifts safety representations, and prompts with larger shifts show larger safety degradation. CKA distance ratios and probes locate the safety-decision layers where this shift is most relevant. These findings guide the design of SDP: the coupling motivates penalizing displacement along the safety direction, and the layer localization sets the initial scope. When the initial scope leaves compensatory shifts beyond the penalized layers, the same diagnostics guide iterative expansion. On Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, SDP restores safety while preserving benchmark reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"推理诱导的失对齐"(RIM)现象——在数学、代码和推理链数据上进行微调（即使不含任何有害内容）也会诱发LLM有害行为。作者通过表征空间分析识别出推理能力方向与安全行为方向之间存在耦合，并据此提出安全方向惩罚(SDP)方法，在微调时惩罚沿安全方向的移动，从而在保持推理性能的同时恢复安全性。
AI.motivation: 先前研究已发现RIM现象并提出神经元层面的纠缠解释，但未能识别表征空间的几何结构，也未能提出训练时的修复方案。理解RIM的潜在机制并开发训练期干预措施对LLM推理安全至关重要。
AI.method: 1) 通过激活空间分析提取两个方向：编码推理能力的方向和编码安全行为的方向，发现二者存在耦合——提升推理的微调会移动安全表征。2) 利用CKA距离比率和探针定位安全决策层，确定安全方向位移最相关的层。3) 基于此设计安全方向惩罚(SDP)：在推理微调中惩罚沿安全方向的位移；初始层范围由定位诊断确定，若超出惩罚层的补偿性位移出现，则迭代扩展惩罚范围。
AI.result: SDP在Qwen2.5-3B和7B模型上能够恢复安全性，同时保持基准推理性能不受损。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了RIM的表征空间几何解释（推理方向与安全方向的耦合），并验证了基于该理解的训练时修复方法SDP的有效性，为安全推理微调提供了可操作方案。

title: Progressively Learning Heterogeneous Skills in a Unified Latent Space
summary: We propose HetSkills, a novel framework designed to progressively learn heterogeneous skills within a unified latent space for physics-based character control. The core idea is to treat this latent space as a shared executable interface, enabling seamless integration of skills learned from diverse data sources, supervision forms, and tasks. HetSkills begins by learning a tracking skill that establishes a strong foundation in motion control and creates a shared motion decoder, which can be reused across tasks without the need for retraining or separate controllers. To prevent the text-to-motion skill from exploiting shortcut pathways instead of learning language semantics, we introduce motion intuition distillation to ground text-to-motion generation in language semantics and a task-guidance module that dynamically adjusts actions based on high-level language instructions. This enables HetSkills to preserve natural motion while continuously expanding its skill repertoire, making it highly adaptable for long-horizon tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness in motion tracking, text-to-motion generation, motion completion, and downstream task adaptation, achieving impressive success rates even under challenging conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HetSkills框架，在统一潜空间内渐进式学习异构技能用于物理驱动的角色控制，将潜空间作为共享可执行接口，整合不同数据源、监督形式和任务的技能，并引入运动直觉蒸馏和任务引导模块防止捷径路径，实验证明在运动追踪、文本生成运动、运动补全和下游任务适应中均有效。
AI.motivation: 物理驱动的角色控制需要整合来自多种数据源、监督形式和任务的异构技能，但现有方法往往各自建立独立控制器，缺乏统一的技能表示与共享接口，导致无法高效复用和扩展技能。
AI.method: 1) 先学习一个追踪技能，建立运动控制基础并创建可跨任务复用的共享运动解码器；2) 引入运动直觉蒸馏（motion intuition distillation）将文本生成运动任务锚定在语言语义上，防止模型走捷径；3) 设计任务引导模块，根据高层语言指令动态调整动作。
AI.result: 实验验证HetSkills在运动追踪、文本到运动生成、运动补全和下游任务适应方面均表现优异，即使在具有挑战性的条件下也取得了令人印象深刻的成功率。
AI.conclusion: HetSkills通过统一潜空间作为共享可执行接口，实现了异构技能的渐进式学习与无缝集成，既能保持自然运动又能持续扩展技能库，对长时域任务具有高度适应性。

title: RAD: Rule-Augmented Relational Anomaly Detection
summary: Anomaly detection is often applied to data stored in relational databases, yet most existing methods require flattening multiple tables into a single feature matrix. This flattening can obscure entity identity, schema structure, and multi-hop dependencies, limiting the detection of anomalies that depend on relational context rather than isolated feature values. Beyond preserving relational structure, relational anomaly detection raises an additional challenge: how to incorporate symbolic behavioral evidence into learned relational representations. To address these challenges, we study relational anomaly detection, where the goal is to identify anomalous entities or events in a multi-table database. We propose RAD, a rule-augmented relational anomaly detector that combines heterogeneous graph representation learning with refined symbolic rule signals. RAD derives candidate rules from random-forest paths over flattened summaries of the entities or events being scored, refines them into compact interpretable predicates, injects the resulting rule features into the graph model, and learns anomaly scores using reconstruction-based and pairwise-ranking supervision. To evaluate this setting, we introduce a relational anomaly detection benchmark spanning three settings: LANL cybersecurity event detection and two unexpected user-churn anomaly tasks derived from Amazon and H&M relational databases. Experiments show that RAD improves anomaly ranking over flattened tabular detectors and relational baselines under natural class imbalance, achieving the best average rank on AUROC and AUPRC across the benchmark. Ablations show that direct rule injection and ranking-based supervision are key contributors to performance, while edge reconstruction is not uniformly beneficial. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/noahd15/RAD_RelationalAnomalyDetection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAD（规则增强的关系异常检测器），将异构图表示学习与符号规则信号相结合，用于多表关系数据库中的异常检测。RAD从随机森林路径中提取候选规则，精炼为可解释谓词并注入图模型，通过重建和成对排序监督学习异常分数。在LANL网络安全和Amazon/H&M用户流失三个基准上，RAD在AUROC和AUPRC上取得最佳平均排名。
AI.motivation: 现有异常检测方法通常需要将多表关系数据库展平为单一特征矩阵，这会丢失实体身份、模式结构和多跳依赖关系等信息，限制了依赖关系上下文而非孤立特征值异常的检测能力。此外，如何将符号行为证据融入学习到的关系表示也是一个未解决的挑战。
AI.method: RAD包含以下步骤：1）从实体/事件的展平摘要上通过随机森林路径推导候选规则；2）将候选规则精炼为紧凑可解释的谓词；3）将规则特征注入异构图神经网络；4）使用重建损失和成对排序监督学习异常分数。
AI.result: 在LANL网络安全事件检测和Amazon/H&M用户流失三个基准上，RAD在自然类别不平衡条件下优于展平表格检测器和关系基线，在AUROC和AUPRC上取得最佳平均排名。消融实验表明直接规则注入和排序监督是关键贡献，而边重建并非普遍有益。
AI.conclusion: RAD证明了结合符号规则信号与关系图表示学习可以有效提升关系数据库中的异常检测性能，为处理多表依赖关系的异常检测提供了新思路。代码和数据已开源。

title: EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards
summary: Earth-system analysis reconstructs changing physical processes from observations that differ in source, scale, timing, and modality. Natural hazards make this work consequential because incomplete evidence can change estimates of severity, exposure, and mechanism. We introduce EarthVerse, a benchmark that evaluates scientific agents through package-scoped investigations. Its 405 reproducible tasks are grounded in 199 documented events and 19 hazard families. Agents inspect heterogeneous event packages, choose compatible evidence, execute transparent calculations, reconcile source differences, and preserve provenance in the final answer. We provide executable ground truth that decomposes each task into fine-grained answer units, together with task-specific rubrics that assess the supporting research process while allowing multiple valid paths. We evaluate 25 model and agent systems under a controlled tool-using protocol, then use controlled studies to locate failures in evidence access, tool selection, memory, reasoning, interaction, and scientific execution. Across systems, the best mean answer-unit accuracy is 84.65%, while the highest Strict@95 is only 34.81%. The gap shows that current agents often complete individual steps without maintaining a consistent chain across evidence, scales, units, calculations, and physical interpretation. EarthVerse provides a reproducible basis for measuring end-to-end scientific reliability in dynamic Earth systems.

AI.tldr: EarthVerse是一个评估科学智能体的基准测试，包含405个可复现任务、覆盖199个文档化事件和19类灾害。它要求智能体通过检查异构事件包、选择兼容证据、执行透明计算、协调来源差异并保留溯源来完成任务。在25个模型和智能体系统的评估中，最佳平均答案单元准确率为84.65%，但最高Strict@95仅为34.81%，表明现有智能体在端到端科学推理一致性上仍有很大提升空间。
AI.motivation: 地球系统分析需要从不间断的来源、尺度、时间和模态各异的观测中重建变化的物理过程，而自然灾害使得这项工作至关重要——不完整的证据可能导致对严重性、暴露程度和机制的估计发生偏差。现有智能体在单个步骤上表现良好，但缺乏跨证据、尺度、单位、计算和物理解释的一致链式推理能力，因此需要一个系统性的基准来评估端到端的科学可靠性。
AI.method: 作者提出EarthVerse基准，其405个可复现任务基于199个文档化事件和19个灾害家族。智能体需检查异构事件包、选择兼容证据、执行透明计算、调和来源差异并在最终答案中保留溯源。基准提供可执行的ground truth，将每个任务分解为细粒度答案单元，并配有针对支持研究过程的任务特定评分标准，允许多种有效路径。作者在受控工具使用协议下评估了25种模型和智能体系统，并通过受控研究定位证据获取、工具选择、记忆、推理、交互和科学执行方面的失败。
AI.result: 在25个系统和模型评估中，最佳平均答案单元准确率为84.65%，但最高Strict@95仅34.81%。这一差距表明当前智能体经常能完成个人步骤，却无法在证据、尺度、单位、计算和物理解释间维持一致的推理链。控制研究进一步定位了各系统中的具体失败环节。
AI.conclusion: EarthVerse为动态地球系统中测量端到端科学可靠性提供了可复现的基础。当前AI系统在分步任务执行上表现可接受，但整体科学推理链条的一致性仍不足，需要进一步发展以弥合步骤执行与完整科学论证之间的差距。

title: Dual-Grained Agent Memory and Shapley Context Attribution for Multimodal Agentic Learner
summary: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) deliver impressive perception yet still falter on scientific and mathematical reasoning. Parameter-level adaptation is unavailable for closed-weight or on-device backbones, and stateless prompting forfeits any compounding benefit from problems already solved. We propose \textbf{DG-Mem}, a dual-grained agentic memory framework that augments a frozen MLLM with a non-parametric, externally stored memory built once from training-time rollouts and consulted read-only at test time. Motivated by the Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) account of human memory, DG-Mem factors its store into an instance-grounded exemplar memory and a category-level schema memory of IF-THEN rules, with a transient reflection store mediating their construction so that schemas are synthesized only from abstract reflections, never from exemplar text. Two design choices distinguish DG-Mem: an online concept categorizer that grows the category space incrementally during training rather than committing to a predefined taxonomy, and a Shapley context attribution procedure that decomposes correctness across the entire retrieved rule set and yields a per-rule utility that re-weights retrieval at test time. The pipeline introduces no gradient updates and is deployable on closed-weight or on-device backbones. Across MathVista, MMMU, and MMMU-Pro on four open-weight and proprietary backbones (Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, GPT-5-Nano, Gemini-3-Flash), DG-Mem improves consistently over no-memory and competitive memory baselines.

AI.tldr: DG-Mem是一个双粒度智能体记忆框架，通过为冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）配备非参数化的外部存储记忆来增强其科学和数学推理能力，在多个基准和多骨干网络上优于无记忆和竞争性记忆基线。
AI.motivation: 前沿多模态大语言模型在感知上表现出色，但在科学和数学推理上仍显不足。参数级适配对闭源权重或设备端骨干不可用，而无状态提示无法从已解决的问题中获得累积收益，因此需要一种不依赖梯度更新的外部记忆机制。
AI.method: DG-Mem受人类互补学习系统（CLS）理论的启发，将存储分为实例级范例记忆和类别级IF-THEN规则模式记忆，并通过一个瞬态反思存储来介导两者的构建（模式仅从抽象反思中合成，而非从范例文本中）。两个关键设计包括：在线概念分类器（训练期间增量增长类别空间，而非预先设定分类法）和Shapley上下文归因过程（分解整个检索规则集的正确性贡献，生成每条规则的效用以在测试时重新加权检索）。整个过程无梯度更新，可部署于闭源权重或设备端骨干。
AI.result: 在MathVista、MMMU和MMMU-Pro三个基准上，DG-Mem在四个开源和专有骨干网络（Qwen3.5-27B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B、GPT-5-Nano、Gemini-3-Flash）上均一致地优于无记忆基线和竞争性记忆基线。
AI.conclusion: DG-Mem通过受人类记忆机制启发的双粒度外部记忆框架，在不进行任何梯度更新的情况下显著提升了冻结MLLM的科学推理能力，为闭源和端侧模型提供了一条实用的推理增强路径。

title: MetaCaster: Meta-Harness-Optimized Agent for End-to-End Few-Shot Learning of Lightweight Time Series Forecasters
summary: Time series forecasting (TSF) is evolving toward multimodal and agentic settings, yet using foundation models remains uneconomical in resource-constrained scenarios, where compact, specialized forecasters are more desirable. However, lightweight forecasters typically require substantial training data, limiting their use in domains with scarce, slowly accumulated, or privacy-sensitive time series. To address this dilemma, we investigate the challenging problem of few-shot learning for lightweight forecasters. We propose MetaCaster, a meta-harness-optimized multi-agent framework that uses agentic data generation to automatically train specialized lightweight forecasters from only a few examples and textual contexts. Our work highlights a new TSF paradigm in which agents act not as forecasters but as intermediary engineers that prepare efficient, task-specific forecasters for deployment. Experiments on 18 datasets, 23 state-of-the-art lightweight forecasters, and 14 baselines demonstrate that MetaCaster achieves both data efficiency and computational efficiency while maintaining high-quality TSF performance.

AI.tldr: MetaCaster是一个元优化多智能体框架，通过智能体数据生成，从少量样本和文本上下文中自动训练轻量级专用预测器，解决资源受限场景下轻量级预测器的少样本学习难题。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测正朝着多模态和智能体化方向发展，但基础模型在资源受限场景下不经济。轻量级专用预测器更受青睐，但它们通常需要大量训练数据，难以应用于数据稀缺、积累缓慢或隐私敏感的时间序列领域。因此需要解决轻量级预测器的少样本学习问题。
AI.method: 提出MetaCaster，一个元优化（meta-harness-optimized）的多智能体框架。采用智能体数据生成（agentic data generation）策略，从仅有的少量样本和文本上下文中自动训练任务特定的轻量级预测器。其核心思想是让智能体不直接作为预测器，而是作为中间工程师，为部署准备高效的专用预测器。
AI.result: 在18个数据集、23个SOTA轻量级预测器和14个基线上进行实验，MetaCaster实现了数据效率和计算效率的双重提升，同时保持了高质量的时间序列预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一个新的TSF范式：智能体不作为预测器本身，而是作为中间工程师来准备高效的、任务特定的轻量级预测器，从而在资源受限场景下兼顾数据效率和计算效率。

title: Correcting a learned physical invariant improves world-model rollouts
summary: World models can predict video without learning dynamics that they reliably preserve. We test whether a frozen DreamerV3 trained only on pendulum video learns a scalar that its own latent transition treats as approximately conserved. A label-free search recovers the same energy-like invariant across independently trained conservative models, while the same procedure finds no comparable invariant in matched damped models. During autonomous rollouts, this quantity drifts. Projecting the latent state back toward its initial level set reduces rollout error in all three conservative models, whereas matched random constraints usually increase it. These results distinguish a dynamically meaningful invariant from a merely decodable correlate and reveal a concrete failure mode: a world model can learn a physical constraint from pixels yet violate that constraint when it imagines forward.

AI.tldr: 本文发现世界模型（World Models）可以从视频中学习到物理不变量（如能量），但在自主想象（rollout）过程中却会违反该约束。研究者使用无标签搜索方法，在仅训练于摆锤视频的DreamerV3模型中恢复了能量类不变量，并通过投影回初始水平集减少轨迹误差，揭示了世界模型"学到物理约束但想象时违反"的具体失败模式。
AI.motivation: 世界模型虽然能够预测视频，但不一定能可靠地学习并保留动态系统中的物理不变量（如能量守恒）。作者想要区分"可解码的相关量"与"动态上有意义的不变量"，并揭示世界模型在想象力过程中违反物理约束的具体失败模式。
AI.method: 1) 使用冻结的DreamerV3模型，仅用摆锤视频训练；2) 通过无标签搜索（label-free search）寻找一个标量，使其在潜在状态转移中近似守恒；3) 在独立训练的保守模型和阻尼模型中进行对比实验；4) 自主rollout期间测量该量的漂移；5) 将潜在状态投影回初始水平集以减少rollout误差，并与随机约束进行对照。
AI.result: 1) 无标签搜索在三个独立训练的保守模型中恢复了相同的能量类不变量；2) 相同方法在阻尼模型中未找到可比较的不变量；3) 在自主rollout中该物理量会发生漂移；4) 将潜在状态投影回初始水平集可减少三个保守模型的rollout误差；5) 匹配的随机约束通常会增加误差。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型可以从像素中学习物理约束（能量不变量），但在想象未来时却会违反这一约束。这区分了动态上有意义的物理不变量与仅仅可解码的相关量，并揭示了一个具体失败模式：模型在训练中捕获了物理规律，却在推理/想象阶段无法保持该规律。

title: Spatiotemporally Decoupled Autoregressive Diffusion Model for Human Motion Generation
summary: Text-driven human motion synthesis has made substantial development with two core modules of motion representation and generative architecture. For representation, Vector Quantization (VQ)-based methods compress motion data into discrete tokens while latent-based models operate directly in continuous space. However, both of these representations exhibit significant limitations. VQ-based methods suffer from inherent information loss, which compromises the quality, diversity, and generalization of generated motions, while continuous representation on holistic whole-body motion hinders part-level flexibility. For architecture, diffusion and autoregressive diffusion models have demonstrated their superiority, yet the fine-grained controllability over individual body parts is also limited. Thus, we propose a unified spatiotemporally decoupled framework named DeMoDiff, which jointly redesigns representation and architecture. To enhance representation extraction capabilities and offer greater part-level controllability, we present a spatial-temporal VAE that encodes each body joint rather than compressing the whole-body motion into a single latent space. Then, we incorporate spatial-temporal masking and attention mechanisms into an autoregressive diffusion generator, achieving both generative capability and controllable editability. Extensive experiments on the HumanML3D and KIT-ML datasets demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance and compelling motion generation results. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong temporal and spatial editing capabilities, further validating its effectiveness. Our project page: https://rex0191.github.io/DeMoDiff/

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeMoDiff，一个统一的时空解耦框架，通过联合重新设计运动表示和生成架构来解决现有文本驱动人体运动合成方法的局限性。它采用空间-时间VAE对每个身体关节进行编码，并结合时空掩码与注意力机制的自回归扩散生成器，在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上取得SOTA重建性能和优秀的生成质量，同时具备强大的时空编辑能力。
AI.motivation: 现有运动表示方法存在显著缺陷：VQ-based方法因信息损失降低生成质量、多样性和泛化性；连续表示在整体全身运动上缺乏部件级别的灵活性。同时，扩散和自回归扩散架构在细粒度部件级控制上能力有限。因此需要一种统一框架同时重新设计表示与架构。
AI.method: 提出DeMoDiff框架：(1) 提出时空VAE，对每个身体关节分别编码而非将全身运动压缩到单一潜在空间，以增强表示提取能力和部件级控制；(2) 将时空掩码和注意力机制融入自回归扩散生成器中，兼顾生成能力与可控编辑性。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上取得SOTA级别的重建性能和令人信服的生成结果，并展现出强大的时间和空间编辑能力。
AI.conclusion: DeMoDiff通过时空解耦的表示与架构设计，同时提升了运动合成质量和部件级可控性，验证了联合重新设计表示与架构的有效性。

title: Provably adaptive sampling with uniform and remasking discrete diffusion models
summary: Discrete diffusion models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation by enabling parallel updates, but their sampling efficiency can depend strongly on the choice of the forward process and the sampler. For the uniform forward process, existing lower bounds for the standard $τ$-leaping sampler scale linearly with the ambient dimension $d$, raising the question of whether this dependence is intrinsic to the forward process. We answer this question in the negative. We consider a first-order sampler based on the leave-one-out denoiser for uniform and remasking processes whose coordinate updates can be performed in parallel. In both cases, the sampler can correct denoising mistakes during the sampling process, which becomes necessary when many coordinates are updated together. Our main result establishes an adaptive sampling guarantee: up to logarithmic factors, $N = O(\mathrm{DTC}(X_0) / \varepsilon)$ discretization steps suffice to achieve sampling error $O(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{score}}+\varepsilon)$, where $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{score}}$ is the error in score estimation. Thus, the sampling complexity is governed by the intrinsic dependence structure of the target distribution, as measured by its dual total correlation $\mathrm{DTC}(X_0)$, rather than directly by the ambient dimension $d$. Our analysis proceeds through a Bayes-optimal auxiliary sampler that separates discretization error from score-estimation error. We also derive an exact information-theoretic representation of the discretization error in terms of the mutual information between different coordinates of the forward process at different times. This representation applies to general forward processes and, in the uniform and remasking cases, can be controlled by $\mathrm{DTC}(X_0)$. Numerical experiments on structured synthetic distributions illustrate the predicted dimension-adaptive behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了离散扩散模型的采样效率问题，提出了一种基于leave-one-out去噪器的一阶采样器，适用于均匀和重掩码（remasking）前向过程。作者证明了采样复杂度可由目标分布的固有依赖结构（双重总相关DTC）控制，而非环境维度d，实现了维度自适应的采样保证。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型的采样效率高度依赖于前向过程和采样器的选择。对于均匀前向过程，现有标准τ-leaping采样器的下界随环境维度d线性增长，作者想要探究这种维度依赖是否是前向过程所固有的。
AI.method: 提出基于leave-one-out去噪器的一阶采样器，支持坐标并行更新。通过贝叶斯最优辅助采样器将离散化误差与分数估计误差分离。利用信息论表示将离散化误差表达为前向过程不同坐标间在不同时间的互信息，在均匀和重掩码情形下由DTC(X0)控制。
AI.result: 主要结果表明，在双对数因子内，N = O(DTC(X0)/ε)阶离散化步骤足以达到O(ε_score+ε)的采样误差。采样复杂度由目标分布的固有依赖结构（DTC）决定，而非直接取决于环境维度d。数值实验验证了维度自适应行为。
AI.conclusion: 作者否定了之前认为均匀前向过程的采样复杂度必须随维度线性增长的猜想。采样复杂度取决于目标分布的固有依赖结构（DTC），这表明可以通过更好的采样器设计来克服前向过程的维度瓶颈。离散化误差的信息论表示适用于一般前向过程，具有广泛的理论意义。

title: How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development: A Study of Learning with Logic Puzzles
comment: Accepted at Human-AI Complementarity and Alignment (HCOMP) 2026
summary: While AI assistance can improve human task performance in the short term, it may also undermine the development of skills in the longer term. We examine this tension in a controlled logic-puzzle experiment involving on-demand AI assistance, where participants complete tasks before, during, and after AI is available. By experimentally varying AI request costs, we find that lower-cost assistance induces more frequent AI use. We also find that participants who request AI assistance during the AI-access phase perform worse at the task after assistance is removed, and their subsequent unassisted performance is overestimated when predicted from earlier AI-assisted performance. We use a Bayesian latent ability model to separate initial ability, post-AI ability, and participant-specific skill change, while estimating how independent reasoning during the AI-access phase relates to skill development. The results show that greater independent problem-solving effort is associated with larger gains in latent ability, consistent with the interpretation that skill development is weaker when AI assistance substitutes for independent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控逻辑谜题实验研究AI辅助任务中的短期表现提升与长期技能发展之间的张力。研究发现低成本的AI协助会导致更频繁的使用，且使用AI协助的参与者在移除AI后表现更差；利用贝叶斯潜在能力模型揭示，独立推理努力与技能发展正相关，当AI协助替代独立推理时技能发展较弱。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注AI辅助的短期绩效提升，但对其长期技能发展可能产生的不利影响缺乏严格因果证据。作者希望通过受控实验厘清AI协助（尤其是低成本、按需提供）对个体能力长期发展的影响，并探究"使用即退化"的潜在机制。
AI.method: 采用受控逻辑谜题实验，分三个阶段（AI可用前、AI可用期间、AI移除后）完成任务。通过实验操纵AI请求成本（高/低成本）来影响使用频率。构建贝叶斯潜在能力模型，分离初始能力、AI后能力及个体技能变化，同时估计AI可用阶段的独立推理努力与技能发展的关系。
AI.result: 1）较低成本的AI协助导致更频繁的AI使用；2）在AI可用阶段请求AI协助的参与者在AI移除后任务表现更差；3）基于AI辅助期间表现预测的未辅助表现存在高估；4）独立问题解决努力越多，潜在能力增益越大，说明AI替代独立推理会削弱技能发展。
AI.conclusion: AI协助的便利性在提升短期任务表现的同时，可能以牺牲长期技能发展为代价。当AI协助替代而非补充独立推理时，技能积累会受到损害。这对AI工具的设计与部署策略（如如何设置使用门槛）具有重要启示。

title: Spotter: Efficient Urban Visual Localization via Geo-Referenced Facade Landmarks in GPS-Degraded Environments
summary: Accurate visual localization on robotic and wearable platforms remains challenging in dense urban environments. Existing methodologies typically rely on GPS for absolute positioning, yet GPS signals frequently degrade in urban canyons due to multipath propagation. Consequently, standard solutions like visual odometry suffer from unmitigated drift over time, while map-matching techniques struggle to acquire the reliable GPS priors they need, on top of being too computationally heavy for real-time edge execution. To address these limitations, we propose Spotter, a robuts and real-time visual localization framework that uses building facades as a reliable source of global geo-reference, while retaining the capability to integrate GPS signals when available. In an offline stage, Spotter processes Google Street View panoramas by semantically segmenting facades and pairing multi-view stereo depth with cartographic data to build a compact metric database. At runtime, query images are matched via a cascaded retrieval and geometric verification pipeline to recover fine-grained global camera localization. We benchmark Spotter on a newly collected dataset of pedestrian sequences acquired with wearable smart glasses across several districts of Barcelona. Experimental results show that Spotter outperforms odometry-based baselines and achieves localization accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art map-based methods while operating at significantly higher frame rates.

AI.tldr: Spotter是一个实时视觉定位框架，利用建筑物立面作为全局地理参考源，在离线阶段处理Google Street View全景图构建紧凑度量数据库，运行时通过级联检索与几何验证实现全局相机定位，在巴塞罗那行人数据集上优于里程计基线，达到与最先进地图方法相当的精度且帧率更高。
AI.motivation: 密集城市环境中GPS信号易受多路径传播影响而退化，视觉里程计产生累积漂移，地图匹配方法依赖不可靠的GPS先验且计算量大，难以满足实时边缘执行需求。需要一个不依赖GPS的可靠实时视觉定位方案。
AI.method: Spotter框架包含两个阶段：(1) 离线阶段：对Google Street View全景图进行语义分割提取建筑立面，将多视角立体深度与制图数据配对，构建紧凑度量数据库；(2) 运行时阶段：查询图像通过级联检索与几何验证流程，恢复细粒度的全局相机定位，同时保留GPS信号可用时的集成能力。
AI.result: 在巴塞罗那多个区域使用智能眼镜采集的行人序列新数据集上，Spotter优于基于里程计的基线方法，定位精度与最先进的基于地图的方法相当，同时运行帧率显著更高。
AI.conclusion: Spotter证明了利用建筑立面作为全球地理参考源实现实时、鲁棒的视觉定位是可行的，在GPS退化环境中提供了有效的替代方案，且兼顾精度与计算效率。

title: How to Train a Critic Stably and Efficiently
summary: Group-based reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO for large language models avoid training a critic by sampling multiple responses for each prompt. A reliable critic could instead estimate token-level advantages from one response, but standard critic-based training recipes are often unstable. We study this instability and develop \textbf{Best-Practice Critic Optimization (BPCO)}, a recipe that combines DPPO, value predictions bounded to the reward range, Monte Carlo value targets, unnormalized policy advantages, and length-adaptive generalized advantage estimation. Because the critic is used only during training, BPCO can also condition it on reward-defining information, such as a reference answer or grading rubric, that is hidden from the policy. Controlled experiments isolate the effect of each design choice. Across mathematical reasoning tasks with models ranging from 1.5B parameters to 30B-A3B mixtures of experts, BPCO improves a strong critic-based baseline consistently, and matches or exceeds a group-based baseline while sampling one response per prompt. The same recipe also improves learning with rubric-based rewards. These results show that a carefully designed critic provides a reliable alternative to group-relative advantage estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/QPHutu/golden_critic

AI.tldr: 本文提出BPCO（最佳实践评论家优化）方法，通过结合DPPO、受限价值预测、蒙特卡洛价值目标、未归一化策略优势以及长度自适应GAE等技术，解决了评论家（critic）训练不稳定问题，在数学推理任务中无需分组采样即可实现与GRPO等分组方法相当或更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 基于评论家的强化学习方法在大语言模型训练中通常不稳定，而分组方法（如GRPO）通过采样多个响应来避免训练评论家，但需要额外采样成本。作者希望研究这种不稳定性并开发稳定可靠的评论家训练方案，从而用单个响应即可估计token级优势，提高训练效率。
AI.method: 提出BPCO训练配方，包含五个关键组件：DPPO（参考标准PPO训练的变体）、将价值预测限制在奖励范围内、使用蒙特卡洛价值目标、使用未归一化的策略优势、以及长度自适应GAE。此外，由于评论家仅在训练时使用，BPCO可以让评论家利用策略不可见的额外信息（如参考答案或评分标准）进行条件化训练。
AI.result: 在1.5B到30B-A3B混合专家模型规模的数学推理任务中，BPCO一致性地优于强评论家基线，并且在使用单个响应/提示的情况下达到或超过分组基线（如GRPO）的性能。该配方同样改善了基于评分标准的奖励学习。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的评论家可以成为分组相对优势估计的可靠替代方案，为语言模型强化学习提供了更高效且稳定的训练范式。

title: What Memory Composition Does Not Tell Us About Anomaly Detection
summary: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于记忆的异常检测器中"覆盖选择"与"训练污染"之间的耦合关系。实验发现全局覆盖选择会严重过度表征稀疏污染，而提出的CLEANCON门控机制能将最终记忆污染降至接近零，并在12组对比中全部提升P-AP。然而，沿保留曲线观察，污染最低的记忆并非P-AP最高的，性能在污染上升时仍持续改善，说明记忆污染程度不能用于排序记忆的P-AP表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于记忆的异常检测器在将训练补丁选入记忆作为正常参考时，缺乏对几何罕见性（即可能的污染）的独立检查。研究者希望探究这种"覆盖选择"与"稀疏污染"之间的耦合关系，验证记忆污染是否真正影响检测性能。
AI.method: 在固定表示和记忆预算下，比较随机、质心、局部和全局四种覆盖选择器；提出CLEANCON——一种基于袋外交叉图像的支持门控机制，通过改变候选图像资格来过滤污染，同时保持表示、绝对记忆大小、构建器和推理规则不变；沿保留曲线进行污染度与P-AP的关联分析。
AI.result: 全局覆盖选择会过度表征稀疏污染；CLEANCON将最终记忆污染降至约零并在全部12个配对比较中提升类别宏平均P-AP；但保留曲线显示最低污染的记忆并未达到最高P-AP，性能随污染上升仍在改善。
AI.conclusion: 记忆污染程度不能作为预测或排序最终记忆P-AP表现的可靠指标，覆盖选择与污染的关系比想象的更复杂，需要重新审视基于记忆的异常检测器中污染控制的评估标准。

title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
summary: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity ($11.95^\circ$ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts ($64$\,s, $384$ latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.

AI.tldr: ReWorld是一个交互式世界模型，通过分离训练时的控制（短时域）与记忆（长时域）并在推理时约束两者，解决了交互世界模型中控制与记忆的结构性矛盾。它采用混合逐头注意力窗口、随机头路由和随机块丢弃来训练，推理时使用有界KV缓存与姿态索引地标库，配合度量尺对齐数据引擎和LoRA蒸馏，实现了704x1280视频的4步实时流式生成。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型需要同时满足三个要求：遵循用户动作（控制）、记住展示过的场景（记忆）、实时流式生成。但控制需要短视界，记忆需要无限视界，存在结构性张力。现有方法难以同时兼顾三者。
AI.method: 1) 训练阶段：混合逐头注意力窗口（多数头关注近期、少数全局头关注全部历史）、随机头路由防止能力绑定、随机块丢弃使稀疏历史在分布内；2) 推理阶段：固定预算下有界KV缓存+姿态索引地标库，检索当前姿态最近的地标；3) 数据引擎：8种数据源对齐到统一物理动作尺度（相同按键移动相同距离），回文轨迹提供重访证据；4) 蒸馏：分布匹配蒸馏到LoRA适配器，压缩到4步采样，一个骨干服务多步高保真与实时交互两种模式。
AI.result: 在三轴协议（动作跟随、长时域回忆、视频质量）下对比六种近期交互世界模型，ReWorld在控制保真度上最优（11.95°旋转误差、最佳相机运动一致性）和生成质量最优；在64秒、384潜变量的分钟级往返 rollout中，固定12块缓存仍能重建起始视角，而滑动窗口已丢失证据、全KV注意力已内存耗尽。
AI.conclusion: ReWorld通过在训练时分离控制与记忆、推理时约束两者，成功实现了既遵循操作又具备长时域记忆且能实时流式生成的交互世界模型。固定预算的缓存策略使其在超长rollout中依然保持记忆能力，同时兼顾了生成质量与实时性。

Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP.Code is publicly available at https://github.com/jw-chae/cleancon.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于记忆的异常检测器中，记忆构建策略与稀疏训练污染之间的耦合关系。作者提出CLEANCON——一种基于袋外交叉图像支持门控的方法，能在固定表征和记忆预算下减少最终记忆中的污染并提升性能，但同时发现记忆污染程度与P-AP性能并非单调对应关系。
AI.motivation: 基于记忆的异常检测器将训练补丁作为正常参考，但选择覆盖的补丁未经过几何稀有性检查，可能将污染样本当作正常参考。现有工作未充分探究记忆选择策略与训练污染（特别是稀疏污染）之间的交互影响。
AI.method: 1) 在固定表征和记忆预算下，对比随机、质心、局部和全局四种覆盖选择器；2) 提出CLEANCON，一种袋外交叉图像支持门控方法，通过改变候选图像的资格来过滤污染，同时保持表征、记忆大小、构建器和推理规则不变；3) 沿保留曲线（retention sweep）分析记忆污染与性能的关系。
AI.result: 全局覆盖策略会严重过度表现稀疏污染；CLEANCON将最终记忆污染降至接近零，并在全部12组匹配对比中提升类别宏平均P-AP；然而在保留曲线上，最低污染的记忆并非获得最高P-AP，性能在污染上升时仍持续改善。
AI.conclusion: 记忆污染程度并不能作为P-AP性能的排序指标——污染更低不必然意味着性能更好。这表明在异常检测的记忆构建中，需要更细致的视角看待污染的影响，单纯追求低污染并非最优策略。

title: Grounding Free-Form Instructions for Fashion Complementary Image Generation
summary: Fashion complementary image generation (CIG) aims to create garments that stylistically match a seed item based on user intent, making it a natural multimodal grounding problem where models must interpret language in visual context. Existing CIG benchmarks rely on rigid template prompts (e.g., "a photo of a skirt"), failing to reflect natural user queries and obscuring model behavior across levels of linguistic specificity. We introduce fashion complementary image generation with free-form instructions, a multimodal language-grounding setting where a model generates a compatible garment from a seed image and a natural-language instruction. To this end, we enrich three CIG benchmarks with low-, medium-, and high-specificity instructions generated by a vision-language model and validated by human annotators. We instantiate the task with StyleFlow, a Rectified Flow Matching model that jointly conditions on the seed image and instruction within a single multimodal transformer. Across image quality metrics, catalog-alignment analysis, ablations, and human evaluation, StyleFlow consistently produces instruction-aligned and stylistically coherent garments while reducing architectural complexity and inference cost relative to auxiliary-module approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于自由文本指令的时尚互补图像生成任务，并引入StyleFlow模型，通过统一的多模态Transformer联合条件化种子图像和自然语言指令，在三个基准上优于现有方法，同时降低架构复杂度和推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的时尚互补图像生成（CIG）基准依赖僵硬的模板提示（如"裙子的照片"），无法反映真实的自然用户查询，也无法揭示模型在不同语言具体性层级下的行为差异。
AI.method: 1) 引入自由格式指令下的CIG任务，将问题框定为多模态语言接地问题；2) 使用视觉语言模型生成低、中、高三个具体性层级的指令，并经人工标注验证，扩充三个CIG基准；3) 提出StyleFlow——一种基于Rectified Flow Matching的模型，在单一多模态Transformer中联合条件化种子图像和指令。
AI.result: 通过图像质量指标、目录对齐分析、消融实验和人工评估，StyleFlow持续生成与指令对齐且风格连贯的服装，同时相比辅助模块方法减少架构复杂性和推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 自由文本指令比模板提示更能反映真实用户需求，而统一的多模态Transformer架构能够在保持高效性的同时实现指令对齐的互补服装生成。

title: Thinking Beyond Videos: Unifying Video Reasoning and Deep Research for Open-World Video Agents
summary: Open-world video understanding often requires a model to locate sparse visual evidence and acquire external knowledge that is absent from the video and its parametric memory. While Thinking-with-Videos enables active temporal perception and Deep Research supports multi-step information seeking, the two capabilities are typically developed in isolation. We introduce VideoRover, a unified Video Deep Research framework that iteratively coordinates video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage browsing. Given a video-question pair, VideoRover uses each tool result to select the next action, so localized video clips guide external retrieval and retrieved evidence triggers further video inspection and verification. To develop this capability, we construct an automated data curation pipeline, producing 26K verified SFT trajectories and 3K challenging RL instances. We also introduce VideoRover-Bench, a benchmark stratified by video duration and research difficulty. Experiments on VideoDR and VideoRover-Bench show that our VideoRover-8B-RL achieves performance comparable to proprietary models in the direct-answer setting without tool use while outperforming larger open-source models equipped with the same tool suite. Ablation studies and training dynamics further validate the complementary roles of active video grounding, external retrieval, and long-horizon reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VideoRover，一个统一的视频深度研究框架，通过迭代协调视频裁剪、多模态搜索和网页浏览来完成开放世界视频理解任务，并构建了数据流水线和评测基准。
AI.motivation: 开放世界视频理解通常需要定位稀疏的视觉证据并获取视频和模型参数记忆之外的外部知识。现有方法中，Thinking-with-Videos支持主动时序感知，Deep Research支持多步信息搜索，但两者往往被孤立开发，缺乏统一框架来协调视频时序感知与外部知识检索。
AI.method: VideoRover采用统一的视频深度研究框架，迭代地协调视频裁剪、多模态搜索和网页浏览三种工具。给定视频-问题对，模型根据每个工具的结果选择下一步动作，使局部视频剪辑引导外部检索，检索到的证据又触发进一步的视频检查和验证。开发方面，构建了自动化数据整理流水线，生成26K条验证过的SFT轨迹和3K条具有挑战性的RL实例，并引入分层视频时长和研究难度的VideoRover-Bench基准。
AI.result: 在VideoDR和VideoRover-Bench上的实验表明，VideoRover-8B-RL在无需工具使用的直接回答设置下能达到与专有模型相当的性能，同时在配备相同工具套件时优于更大的开源模型。消融研究和训练动态分析验证了主动视频接地、外部检索和长程强化学习三者之间的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: VideoRover展示了视频时序感知与外部知识检索协同工作的价值，证明统一框架加长程强化学习是提升开放世界视频理解能力的关键路径。

title: IntentQA: Intent Question Answering in Videos by Cognitive Context Reasoning
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. Accepted manuscript of an article published in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
summary: Video understanding requires intelligent agents to transcend mere recognition of visual facts and comprehend the underlying intents behind human actions (often termed the "dark matter" of social intelligence). To bridge the gap between visual observation and intent reasoning, we introduce a novel task, IntentQA, and contribute a large-scale VideoQA dataset specifically tailored for this purpose. However, recognizing that standard metrics may overestimate capabilities due to dataset biases, we go beyond simple accuracy to rigorously evaluate model robustness. We augment the benchmark by generating five distinct contrast sets via Large Language Models (LLMs) and introducing a "Contrast Performance Decline" metric. We propose the X-CaVIR (eXplainable Context-aware Video Intent Reasoning) framework, which leverages three types of "Cognitive Context" to enhance video analysis: i) Situational Context via a cross-modal Video Query Language (VQL) module, ii) Contrastive Context via a Contrastive Learning module, and iii) Commonsense Context via a Commonsense Reasoning module. Crucially, to overcome the opacity of traditional black-box models, we refine the integration of LLMs within X-CaVIR by employing a transparent pipeline that synergizes video captions with VQA model outputs. This approach not only improves performance by effectively utilizing rich commonsense knowledge but also renders the reasoning process explicitly interpretable. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our components, the superiority of X-CaVIR over state-of-the-art baselines, and its stability against perturbations on the contrast sets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IntentQA任务及大规模视频问答数据集，并构建X-CaVIR框架，通过情境、对比和常识三种认知上下文增强视频意图推理，同时利用LLM生成五个对比集和"对比性能下降"指标来评估模型鲁棒性，实现可解释的视频意图理解。
AI.motivation: 视频理解需要从单纯的视觉事实识别跨越到对人类行为背后意图的理解，但目前缺少针对意图推理的大规模数据集，且标准评估指标因数据集偏差而高估模型能力，模型推理过程不透明。
AI.method: 1) 提出IntentQA任务和大型VideoQA数据集；2) 利用LLM生成五种对比集并引入"对比性能下降"指标评估鲁棒性；3) 提出X-CaVIR框架，包含三个模块：基于跨模态Video Query Language的情境上下文模块、基于对比学习的对比上下文模块、基于常识推理的常识上下文模块；4) 采用透明管道整合视频字幕与VQA模型输出，使推理过程可解释。
AI.result: 大量实验证明各组件有效性，X-CaVIR在多个SOTA基线上表现优越，并在对比集扰动下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: X-CaVIR有效提升了视频意图推理性能，实现了可解释的推理过程，且对对比集扰动具有鲁棒性，为视频意图理解提供了新方向。

title: Can Coding Agents Build Robust Baselines? A Skill-Based Approach for Automating the Medical Imaging Model-Development Pipeline
summary: Developing competitive deep learning baselines for medical imaging remains a highly iterative process requiring literature review, implementation, experimentation, and expert refinement. Existing automation approaches typically optimize isolated components, such as architecture search or hyperparameter tuning, rather than the complete baseline development process. We present an agentic AI Scientist workflow that combines literature-guided reasoning, automated code generation, and hypothesis-driven experimentation to generate competitive baseline models for medical imaging challenges. The framework is evaluated on four public benchmarks spanning segmentation, classification, and detection. Across all tasks, the Experimentation Pipeline consistently improves validation performance, achieving competitive leaderboard results, including 6th place on both PUMA tracks (15 teams) and 31st place on MILK10k (125 teams). On MIDOG25, the resulting model also demonstrates strong domain generalization across scanners, tumor types, and species. Using the same workflow across all challenges without task-specific redesign, we demonstrate that skill-based, literature-guided agentic workflows can substantially reduce the engineering effort required to develop competitive medical imaging baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种智能体AI科学家工作流，结合文献引导推理、自动代码生成和假设驱动实验，为医学影像挑战生成具有竞争力的基线模型。该框架在四个公共基准（分割、分类、检测）上评估，取得了竞争力排行榜成绩（如PUMA双赛道第6名、MILK10k第31名），且无需任务特定重新设计即可跨任务使用。
AI.motivation: 开发医学影像的深度学习基线模型是高度迭代的过程，需要文献综述、实现、实验和专家精炼。现有自动化方法仅优化孤立组件（如架构搜索或超参数调优），而非完整的基线开发流程。
AI.method: 提出智能体AI Scientist工作流，包含三个核心组件：文献引导推理（literature-guided reasoning）、自动代码生成（automated code generation）和假设驱动实验（hypothesis-driven experimentation），以完整流程方式生成竞争性医学影像基线模型。
AI.result: 在四个公共基准（涵盖分割、分类、检测任务）上评估，实验管线持续提升验证性能并取得竞争性排行榜成绩：PUMA双赛道第6名（15队）、MILK10k第31名（125队）。在MIDOG25上模型展现出跨扫描仪、肿瘤类型和物种的强领域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过在所有挑战中使用相同工作流且无需任务特定重新设计，证明了基于技能的、文献引导的智能体工作流能大幅减少开发竞争性医学影像基线所需的工程工作量。

title: Controllable blind deblurring with diffusion models
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted to IEEE ICIP 2026
summary: Image acquisition with a camera involves several degradations due to the optical system, sensor, or low-level processing steps. We address blind deblurring in professional photography: we aim to invert unknown isotropic blur without knowledge of the degradation kernel.For such inverse problems,where some high-frequency information is lost, it is challenging to use generative models to produce details that are both photo-realistic and faithful to the input. We propose SuperSharpen, a diffusion-based blind deblurring method offering explicit control over restoration strength through a blur measure. We compare two conditioning strategies: a ControlNet-style adapter on a frozen backbone, and full finetuning of the diffusion prior. Our experiments show that finetuning achieves better fidelity with fewer hallucinated details. We validate our approach on synthetic and real-world blur, demonstrating improved perceptual quality and controllable restoration strength.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SuperSharpen，一种基于扩散模型的盲去模糊方法，通过模糊度量对恢复强度进行显式控制，应用于专业摄影中的未知各向同性模糊去除。
AI.motivation: 相机成像过程中存在光学系统、传感器和低层处理带来的多种退化，而在盲去模糊中需要在不了解退化核的情况下恢复高频信息。生成模型在产生既逼真又忠实于输入的细节方面具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出基于扩散的盲去模糊方法SuperSharpen，通过模糊度量显式控制恢复强度。比较了两种条件化策略：在冻结骨干网络上使用ControlNet风格的适配器，以及对扩散先验进行完全微调。
AI.result: 实验表明完全微调在保真度上优于ControlNet式适配器，产生更少的幻觉细节。在合成和真实模糊数据上验证了该方法，展示了改进的感知质量和可控的恢复强度。
AI.conclusion: 完全微调扩散先验是实现高保真盲去模糊的更优策略，能够减少幻觉细节的同时提供可控的恢复强度，适用于专业摄影场景。

title: DF-MoE: Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Multimodal Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Audio-visual deepfake detection is an actively studied topic, where one of the main challenges is to develop detectors able to generalize across deepfake generation methods. We conjecture that overfitting can be mitigated by extracting multiple high-level cues from the available audio and visual modalities via pre-trained models. We therefore assemble a wide variety of pre-trained models to extract features that encode mouth movements, face parsing, facial expressions, head pose, gaze tracking, heart rate, audio emotion and speech activity. We further integrate both unimodal and multimodal cues via a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone to detect deepfakes. We perform in-domain and cross-domain experiments on five benchmarks for deepfake detection (MAVOS-DD, AVLips, PolyGlotFake, BioDeepAV, FakeAVCeleb) to compare our framework (DF-MoE) with state-of-the-art methods. Our results indicate that DF-MoE obtains superior deepfake detection results, surpassing all competing methods. We release our code at https://github.com/vladhondru25/DF-MoE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DF-MoE框架，通过集成多种预训练模型提取音频和视觉模态的多层次高级线索（如嘴部运动、面部解析、表情、头部姿态、凝视追踪、心率、音频情感和语音活动），并利用Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）骨干网络融合单模态和多模态线索进行深度伪造检测。在五个基准数据集上的域内和跨域实验中，DF-MoE超越了所有现有方法。
AI.motivation: 音频-视觉深度伪造检测面临的主要挑战是检测器难以跨伪造生成方法泛化，存在过拟合问题。作者推测通过预训练模型从音频和视觉模态提取多种高级线索可以缓解过拟合。
AI.method: 1) 组装多种预训练模型提取丰富的多模态线索：嘴部运动、面部解析、面部表情、头部姿态、凝视追踪、心率、音频情感和语音活动；2) 使用Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）骨干网络整合单模态和多模态线索进行伪造检测。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集（MAVOS-DD, AVLips, PolyGlotFake, BioDeepAV, FakeAVCeleb）上进行了域内和跨域实验，DF-MoE在所有对比方法中取得最优的深度伪造检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过提取多样化的高级多模态线索并利用MoE架构进行融合，可以有效提升深度伪造检测的泛化能力并超越现有方法。代码已开源。

title: Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds
summary: Video generation is progressing beyond isolated clips toward long-form narratives and interactive worlds, requiring models to preserve identities, follow user controls, and remain stable over extended rollouts. We present JoyAI-Echo-1.5, a unified audio-visual generation system with two purpose-built variants. The long-video variant introduces composable cross-shot memory that aggregates visual evidence across multiple prior shots and speaker cues derived from speech-filtered full-shot audio, enabling persistent character appearance and voice identity across flexible combinations of text, image, and memory conditioning. The world-model variant converts heterogeneous navigation inputs into calibrated metric 6-DoF camera trajectories and injects them through a geometry-aware conditioning pathway, enabling controller-agnostic interaction across flexible viewpoints. To support efficient long-horizon generation, we transform a bidirectional audio-visual backbone into a causal few-step generator using progressive teacher forcing and short- and long-horizon Self-Gradient Forcing on self-generated rollouts. Experiments demonstrate strong performance in both settings. JoyAI-Echo-1.5 achieves improvements over existing long-video baselines in cross-shot consistency, visual quality, text alignment, and speech fidelity. Its world-model variant ranks first on WBench, with an average score of 81.7, and achieves leading visual quality and long-horizon persistence on SANA-WM-Bench. Together, these results indicate that memory, geometric control, and rollout-aware training provide a practical foundation for generating coherent stories and continuously evolving interactive worlds. Project page: https://echo-team-joy-future-academy-jd.github.io/Echo-1.5-Page/.

AI.tldr: JoyAI-Echo-1.5是一个统一的音视频生成系统，包含长视频变体和世界模型变体两个版本。长视频变体通过可组合的跨镜头记忆和说话人线索实现持久角色身份保持；世界模型变体将导航输入转换为度量6-DoF相机轨迹，支持控制器无关的交互。系统通过渐进式教师强制和自梯度强制实现高效的因果少步生成。实验表明在长视频一致性和世界模型基准上均达到领先水平。
AI.motivation: 视频生成正从孤立片段向长篇叙事和交互式世界发展，需要模型保持角色身份、遵循用户控制并在长时间生成中保持稳定。现有方法在这些方面存在不足，需要统一且高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出两个变体：(1) 长视频变体：引入可组合的跨镜头记忆聚合多个先前镜头的视觉证据，以及从语音过滤的全镜头音频中提取说话人线索，支持文本、图像和记忆条件的灵活组合；(2) 世界模型变体：将异构导航输入转换为校准的度量6-DoF相机轨迹，通过几何感知条件路径注入。训练时采用渐进式教师强制和短/长时域自梯度强制，将双向音频视觉骨干网络转换为因果少步生成器。
AI.result: 长视频变体在跨镜头一致性、视觉质量、文本对齐和语音保真度上优于现有基线。世界模型变体在WBench上排名第一（平均分81.7），在SANA-WM-Bench上取得领先的视觉质量和长时域持久性。
AI.conclusion: 记忆、几何控制和滚动感知训练为生成连贯故事和持续演化的交互世界提供了实用基础。

title: MomADv2: Reliable Temporal Memory for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Long-horizon planning is critical for safe autonomous driving in complex scenarios. Existing methods improve planning continuity with temporal memory, but such memory may become invalid and mislead decisions when the driving command changes. Thus, selectively leveraging useful history while suppressing command-inconsistent memory remains a key challenge. To address this issue, we propose MomADv2, a reliable state-space memory framework for long-horizon end-to-end autonomous driving. At its core, MomADv2 introduces a Selective State-Space Planning Memory Query Module, which filters historical planning queries based on temporal continuity and command consistency, selects planning modes relevant to the current command, and models the evolution of planning intentions through a selective state-space mechanism. To further alleviate local trajectory deviations and error accumulation in long-horizon planning, we design a Flow-Matching Trajectory Residual Refiner. It learns a continuous residual correction field from the refined planning output to the expert trajectory, enabling fine-grained trajectory refinement while preserving the stability of anchor-based planning. Extensive experiments on closed-loop NAVSIM and Bench2Drive, as well as open-loop nuScenes, demonstrate that MomADv2 improves long-horizon planning consistency and reduces the average collision rate by 15.6% over MomAD under 6-second planning.

AI.tldr: MomADv2提出了一种可靠的状态空间记忆框架，用于长时程端到端自动驾驶规划。它通过选择性状态空间规划记忆查询模块过滤历史规划信息，并结合流匹配轨迹残差细化器来减少轨迹偏差与误差累积，在NAVSIM、Bench2Drive和nuScenes上验证了有效性，较MomAD将6秒规划下的平均碰撞率降低15.6%。
AI.motivation: 长时程规划对自动驾驶安全至关重要。现有方法利用时间记忆提升规划的连续性，但当驾驶指令改变时，这些历史记忆可能失效并误导决策。因此，如何在指令变化时选择性利用有效历史信息、抑制与当前指令不一致的记忆，是亟待解决的关键挑战。
AI.method: MomADv2包含两个核心模块：(1) 选择性状态空间规划记忆查询模块，基于时间连续性和指令一致性过滤历史规划查询，选取与当前指令相关的规划模式，并通过选择性状态空间机制建模规划意图的演化；(2) 流匹配轨迹残差细化器，从细化规划输出到专家轨迹学习连续残差校正场，在保持锚点规划稳定性的同时实现细粒度轨迹细化。
AI.result: 在闭环NAVSIM和Bench2Drive以及开环nuScenes上进行了广泛实验。MomADv2提升了长时程规划的一致性，在6秒规划场景下较MomAD将平均碰撞率降低了15.6%。
AI.conclusion: MomADv2通过选择性记忆机制和流匹配残差细化有效解决了驾驶指令变化时历史记忆失效的问题，验证了在长时程自动驾驶规划中同时保证记忆可靠性与轨迹精细度的可行性。

title: Photorealistic Novel View Synthesis of Human Faces using Next-Scale Transformers
summary: Photorealistic novel view synthesis of people remains challenging at high spatial resolutions and across multiple target cameras, where preserving identity, fine appearance details, and geometric coherence is critical. We build on the next-scale autoregressive paradigm and adapt it for human-centric view synthesis by enabling higher image resolutions, multi-view outputs and stronger cross-view consistency in a single forward pass. We train on a synthetic dataset of human faces spanning diverse identities and apparel. Contrary to diffusion models, this paradigm does not need 2D pre-training and, thanks to its next-scale architecture, it benefits from lower-resolution, general-purpose pre-trainings, with the full-sized purpose-specific images being used only in the last training stages. This enables our architecture to converge with a smaller amount of purpose-specific training data, allowing us to use a smaller but more realistic training dataset. The resulting model produces sharp and realistic views, with the option to synthesize multiple novel viewpoints simultaneously for improved agreement across views. Empirically, we observe gains in perceptual fidelity and cross-view coherence on human subjects, demonstrating that next-scale autoregression is an effective backbone for scalable, multi-output human view synthesis. We also couple our pipeline with an existing transformer-based model for pixel-aligned 3D gaussian lifting from multi-view facial inputs, resulting in accurate and photorealistic 3D models of human faces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于下一尺度自回归范式的人体视角合成方法，支持高分辨率、多视角输出和跨视角一致性，通过小规模但更真实的数据集训练即可获得清晰逼真的结果，并可结合3D高斯提升模型生成人脸3D重建。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率、多目标相机条件下的人物照片级新视角合成仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在保持身份特征、精细外观细节和几何一致性方面。现有扩散模型需要大量2D预训练且数据需求大。
AI.method: 基于下一尺度自回归范式（next-scale autoregressive paradigm），扩展以支持更高图像分辨率、多视角输出和更强的跨视角一致性，采用单次前向传播。在合成人脸数据集上训练，利用低分辨率通用预训练权重，仅在最后阶段使用全尺寸特定任务图像。
AI.result: 在人体目标上取得感知保真度和跨视角一致性的提升，证明下一尺度自回归是高效的可扩展多输出人体视角合成骨干。与像素对齐3D高斯提升模型结合后，可生成准确且照片级的人脸3D模型。
AI.conclusion: 下一尺度自回归无需2D预训练、数据效率高，是人体视角合成的有效方案，支持多视角同步输出并增强视图间一致性。

title: Image-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Quality Assurance of Organ-at-Risk Segmentations in Radiotherapy
comment: Submitted to the MICCAI 2026 UNSURE Workshop
summary: Accurate organ-at-risk segmentation is essential for radiotherapy planning, but reviewing segmentations is time-consuming and subjective. We investigate normative modelling for segmentation error detection in head-and-neck CT, comparing a VAE framework with an image-conditioned segmentation diffusion model. Models were evaluated on RADCURE brainstem and spinal cord segmentations using simulated boundary and width perturbations. Error detection was assessed using the Dice similarity coefficient and the Distance to Agreement (DTA) between the input and reconstructed segmentations. While both models detected some simulated errors, regional DTA showed that the diffusion model localised subtle boundary errors more consistently. These results support image-conditioned diffusion reconstruction as a promising framework for localised, anatomy-aware segmentation QA.

AI.tldr: 本文研究用于头颈部CT分割误差检测的规范建模方法，比较VAE框架与图像条件分割扩散模型的性能，发现扩散模型在定位细微边界误差方面更一致，支持其作为分割QA的可行框架。
AI.motivation: 放疗规划中危及器官的准确分割至关重要，但人工审查分割结果既耗时又具主观性，需要自动化的分割误差检测方法。
AI.method: 对比两种模型：VAE框架与图像条件分割扩散模型；在RADCURE数据集的脑干和脊髓分割上，通过模拟边界扰动和宽度扰动生成误差，利用Dice相似系数和输入与重建分割之间的Distance to Agreement (DTA) 评估误差检测性能。
AI.result: 两种模型都能检测部分模拟误差，但区域DTA分析表明扩散模型在定位细微边界误差方面表现更一致。
AI.conclusion: 图像条件扩散重建是用于局部化、解剖感知的分割QA的有前景框架。

title: Towards Comprehensive Basketball Understanding
summary: Understanding a basketball game requires recognizing events, localizing actions, identifying players, and relating these to structured game knowledge. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate these abilities one at a time, leaving the interactions among these abilities under-explored. We introduce BasketballBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising 7,980 questions across ten tasks in text, image, and video. It is built from the 2025-2026 NBA season and includes official playby-play, rosters and profiles for 530 active players, and 2,501 possession-level broadcast clips. We further propose BasketballSkills, an agent that composes eight basketball-specific perception and retrieval tools under four reusable skills that specify tool order, evidence bindings, and stopping conditions. Experiments show that current MLLMs struggle particularly on questions requiring the integration of multiple capabilities, whereas BasketballSkills outperforms them, highlighting the effectiveness of explicitly composing domain-specific capabilities for comprehensive basketball understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BasketballBench——一个包含7980个问题、覆盖文本/图像/视频三种模态及十项任务的多模态篮球理解基准，同时提出BasketballSkills智能体，通过组合八个篮球专用感知与检索工具（四种可复用技能）显著优于现有MLLM，尤其在需要多能力整合的复杂问题上表现突出。
AI.motivation: 现有篮球理解基准大多只单独评估事件识别、动作定位、球员识别等单项能力，忽略了这些能力之间的交互与耦合。作者希望构建一个能同时考察多项能力整合的基准，并验证组合领域专用能力的方法是否优于简单依赖通用大模型。
AI.method: 构建BasketballBench基准：基于2025-2026 NBA赛季数据，包含官方play-by-play记录、530名现役球员的名册与资料、2501个回合级转播片段，共7980个问题覆盖十项任务三种模态。提出BasketballSkills智能体：将八个篮球专用感知与检索工具组合成四种可复用技能，每种技能明确指定工具调用顺序、证据绑定和停止条件。
AI.result: 实验表明现有MLLM在需要多种能力整合的问题上表现困难，而BasketballSkills在这些场景下显著超越现有MLLM，证明显式组合领域专用能力对全面篮球理解的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式组合领域专用能力（通过技能定义的推理流程）比单纯依赖通用多模态大模型更能有效实现复杂场景的综合理解，为篮球乃至更广泛的体育视频理解提供了新范式。

title: Geometry-Driven Opti-Acoustic Co-Registration and View-Invariant Reflectivity Mapping for Side-Scan Sonar
summary: Side-Scan Sonar (SSS) is a primary modality for large-scale underwater mapping, yet automated perception and cross-modal alignment are severely bottlenecked by acoustic complexities such as speckle noise, shadows, and extreme viewpoint dependencies. Traditional handcrafted descriptors and modern deep learning matchers fail to bridge the physical domain gap between optical and acoustic imagery without 3D geometric constraints. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel geometry-driven framework for pixel-level opti-acoustic co-registration and view-invariant reflectivity mapping. Our method utilizes Structure-from-Motion (SfM) to reconstruct a dense 3D seafloor mesh, acting as a geometric anchor between the visual and acoustic domains. We introduce a First Bottom Return (FBR) extraction algorithm to dynamically correct non-linear altitude drift caused by uncalibrated SfM reconstruction. Furthermore, we apply an inverse Lambertian model and a dual-Gaussian weighting function to isolate the intrinsic seabed reflectivity, effectively neutralizing slant-range propagation loss and geometric view-dependence. By deterministically associating these isolated acoustic properties with optical pixels, our pipeline generates highly accurate, strictly co-registered multi-modal datasets. This automated, physics-guided approach eliminates the need for manual annotation and paves the way for advanced self-supervised learning in benthic habitat mapping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于几何驱动的框架，用于侧扫声呐（SSS）与光学图像的像素级联合配准及视点无关的反射率映射。该方法利用运动恢复结构（SfM）重建海底3D网格作为几何锚点，结合首次底回波（FBR）提取算法校正高度漂移，并通过逆朗伯模型与双高斯加权函数分离海底固有反射率，从而自动生成高精度联合配准的多模态数据集，无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: 侧扫声呐是大型水下测绘的主要模态，但其自动感知与跨模态对齐受斑点噪声、阴影和极端视点依赖等声学复杂性严重制约。传统手工描述子和现代深度学习匹配器在缺乏3D几何约束时无法弥合光学与声学图像之间的物理域差距。
AI.method: 1) 使用SfM重建密集3D海底网格作为视觉与声学域的几何锚点；2) 提出首底回波（FBR）提取算法动态校正未校准SfM重建导致的非线性高度漂移；3) 应用逆朗伯模型和双高斯加权函数隔离海底固有反射率，中和斜距传播损耗与几何视点依赖性；4) 将隔离的声学属性与光学像素确定性关联，生成联合配准的多模态数据集。
AI.result: 该方法能够生成高精度、严格联合配准的多模态数据集，实现自动化物理引导的配准流程，消除了人工标注的需求。
AI.conclusion: 该自动化、物理引导的方法无需人工标注即可实现光学-声学联合配准，为底栖栖息地测绘中的高级自监督学习铺平了道路。

title: GeoWAM: Visual Geometry World Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: World action models (WAMs) have recently gained increasing attention as a framework for jointly modeling scene evolution and ego actions in autonomous driving. Most existing WAMs learn scene dynamics in pixel space by combining a video-generation backbone for future-observation prediction with an action head for ego-trajectory prediction. Pixels, however, provide only an indirect representation of these dynamics: they entangle geometry and motion with appearance, texture, and illumination, forcing the model to infer three-dimensional transformations from two-dimensional observations. We argue that geometry, represented by point clouds, offers a more natural state space for driving because it explicitly captures spatial structure and the rigid and non-rigid transformations that govern scene evolution while directly aligning with the space in which driving actions are executed. Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{GeoWAM}, a visual geometry world action model for autonomous driving. Rather than predicting future images, GeoWAM is pretrained to forecast future scene geometry, yielding representations that jointly encode spatial structure and temporal evolution. A geometry-conditioned action head then leverages these learned geometric dynamics to predict future ego trajectories. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop evaluations show that visual geometry world modeling yields substantially stronger driving policies than image-based alternatives, establishing future-geometry prediction as an effective pretraining objective for autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: GeoWAM提出了一种基于视觉几何的世界动作模型（World Action Model），通过预测未来场景几何（点云）而非像素图像来建模驾驶场景动态，并利用几何条件化的动作头预测未来自车轨迹。实验表明，几何世界建模相比传统的基于图像的方法能产生更强的驾驶策略。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）大多在像素空间学习场景动态，但像素将几何与运动同外观、纹理、光照纠缠在一起，迫使模型从二维观测推断三维变换。作者认为点云表示的几何是驾驶更自然的状态空间，因为它显式捕捉空间结构及控制场景演化的刚性和非刚性变换，并且与驾驶动作执行的空间直接对齐。
AI.method: GeoWAM包含两个核心组件：（1）预训练阶段预测未来场景几何（点云），生成联合编码空间结构与时间演化的表示；（2）几何条件化的动作头（geometry-conditioned action head），利用学到的几何动态来预测未来的自车轨迹。整体框架将传统的视频生成骨干替换为几何预测任务。
AI.result: 在开放环路和闭环评估中，视觉几何世界建模产生的驾驶策略显著优于基于图像的替代方法，验证了未来几何预测作为自动驾驶预训练目标的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了未来几何预测作为自动驾驶预训练目标的有效性，表明将几何作为驾驶世界模型的状态空间比像素空间更具优势，为自动驾驶世界模型的设计提供了新的方向。

title: SVD-Based Typicality Maps for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Vision Transformers
summary: We present a method for analyzing the internal representations of Vision Transformers (ViTs) exploiting the geometry of their learned parameters. Each affine layer's weight matrix is factored via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), and activations are projected onto the leading right singular vectors to obtain compact, layer-intrinsic representations. A class-conditional density model is then fitted at each layer, producing per-class \emph{typicality scores} that are stacked across depth into \emph{typicality maps}: two-dimensional summaries of how class-specific evidence evolves through the network. From these maps, we derive two post-hoc scores for Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) detection: a \emph{Prototype Alignment Score} (PAS), measuring agreement with class reference prototype patterns, and a \emph{Multi-Layer Soft Voting} (MLSV) score, capturing cross-layer consensus without stored prototypes. On ViT-B/16 fine-tuned on CIFAR-100, the proposed scores achieve competitive detection performance without retraining or OOD exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于ViT内部表示几何分析的方法，通过SVD分解仿射层权重矩阵，将激活投影到右奇异向量上获得层内表示，构建类条件密度模型生成典型性图（typicality maps），并从中推导出两种OOD检测分数（PAS和MLSV），无需重训练或OOD数据暴露即可实现竞争性检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有ViT的OOD检测方法通常需要重新训练或暴露于OOD数据，作者希望通过分析网络内部表示的几何结构，实现无需额外训练的后验OOD检测。
AI.method: 1) 对每个仿射层的权重矩阵进行SVD分解；2) 将激活投影到前导右奇异向量上获得紧凑的层内表示；3) 在每层拟合类条件密度模型，计算每类的典型性分数（typicality scores）；4) 跨深度堆叠这些分数形成典型性图（typicality maps）；5) 从典型性图推导两种OOD检测分数：原型对齐分数（PAS）和多层软投票（MLSV）。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100上微调的ViT-B/16上，所提分数在无需重训练或OOD暴露的情况下达到了有竞争力的OOD检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用ViT层内参数的几何结构，可以有效地从网络内部表示中提取类特定信息用于OOD检测，为后验OOD检测提供了轻量级的替代方案。

title: Action-Aligned Retrieval with Pairwise Multimodal Reranking for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search
comment: Accepted to the AI City workshop @ ECCV 2026
summary: Text-based person anomaly search requires distinguishing individuals based on fine-grained, context-dependent behaviors rather than mere appearance. Existing methods struggle to capture these context-conditioned actions, frequently relying on isolated skeletal geometry, discarding raw query details during reformulation, or utilizing absolute pointwise scoring for multimodal verification. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{ActPair}, a unified three-stage coarse-to-fine framework that combines action-aligned retrieval with pairwise multimodal reranking to bridge the pose-semantic gap. First, we fine-tune a vision-language model (VLM) with an action-aligned multi-task objective that encourages the representations to encode action-discriminative semantics. Second, we perform parallel late-fusion retrieval using the original query and a large language model (LLM)-generated context-grounded rewrite, retaining complementary details from both semantic views. Finally, we propose an efficient off-the-shelf reranking module that leverages a pivot-promote algorithm to perform direct pairwise visual comparisons, mitigating residual spatial and compositional ambiguities without the prohibitive inference costs of exhaustive evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves the best results among the compared methods on the Pedestrian Anomaly Behavior (PAB) public test and transfers effectively to an unseen, non-anomaly-specific dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ActPair，一个统一的三阶段粗到细框架，用于基于文本的行人异常行为搜索。该框架结合动作对齐检索与成对多模态重排序，通过微调VLM、并行后期融合检索和枢轴提升重排序模块，弥合姿态-语义差距，在PAB数据集上取得最佳效果。
AI.motivation: 现有文本行人异常搜索方法存在三大局限：(1)依赖孤立的骨骼几何，难以捕捉上下文条件化的行为；(2)在查询改写过程中丢弃原始查询细节；(3)使用绝对逐点评分进行多模态验证，无法进行直接成对比较。这些问题导致难以根据细粒度、上下文依赖的行为而非外貌来区分个体。
AI.method: ActPair是一个三阶段粗到细框架：第一阶段，使用动作对齐的多任务目标微调视觉语言模型(VLM)，使表征编码动作判别语义；第二阶段，执行并行后期融合检索，同时使用原始查询和LLM生成的上下文感知改写查询，保留两种语义视图的互补细节；第三阶段，提出高效的即插即用重排序模块，采用枢轴提升(pivot-promote)算法进行直接成对视觉比较，缓解残余的空间和组合歧义，同时避免穷举评估的过高推理成本。
AI.result: 在Pedestrian Anomaly Behavior (PAB)公开测试集上，ActPair在所有对比方法中取得最佳结果，并能有效迁移到未见过的非异常专用数据集。
AI.conclusion: ActPair通过动作对齐检索与成对多模态重排序的有机结合，有效解决了文本行人异常搜索中姿态-语义鸿沟问题，验证了三阶段粗到细框架在该任务上的优越性和泛化能力。

title: Investigating Relational Reasoning in VLMs
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong performance in visual reasoning tasks, but it remains unclear whether they understand visual relations, or simply employ shortcuts such as language cues or priors. To investigate this, we use the Qwen3-VL-4B (Bai et al., 2025), a modern VLM, to decode how visual information is encoded across depths. For this, we propose a synthetic dataset of simple geometric shapes for controlled analysis, along with queries crafted to precisely test language cues. Furthermore, the dataset is modified to test causal reliance on visual evidence. Our results show that current VLMs combine genuine visual reasoning with shortcut strategies primarily rooted in language cues.

AI.tldr: 本文通过合成几何图形数据集和精心设计的语言线索查询，探究现代视觉语言模型（Qwen3-VL-4B）在视觉关系推理中是否真正理解视觉信息，还是依赖语言线索等捷径。结果显示当前VLM既进行真实的视觉推理，也主要依赖基于语言线索的捷径策略。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在视觉推理任务上表现强劲，但研究者对其是否真正理解视觉关系存疑——模型可能只是利用语言先验或线索等捷径，而非真正的视觉理解。现有研究缺乏对视觉信息编码机制的深入分析。
AI.method: 1) 使用Qwen3-VL-4B作为研究对象，解码视觉信息在不同深度层级的编码方式；2) 提出一个由简单几何形状组成的合成数据集，用于受控分析；3) 设计精确的查询以测试语言线索；4) 修改数据集以测试模型对视觉证据的因果依赖。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前VLM在视觉推理中混合了真实的视觉推理能力与基于语言线索的捷径策略，且语言线索在模型决策中占据主导地位。
AI.conclusion: 现代VLM并非纯粹的视觉推理器，其在视觉任务中会策略性地结合真实视觉理解和语言捷径。研究揭示了对VLM能力评价需谨慎，并强调了解耦视觉与语言线索对构建更可靠VLM的重要性。

title: Predicting Multiple Clinical Outcomes Related to Functional Recovery and Social Isolation Among Older Adults After Lower-Limb Fracture or Hip Replacement
summary: Older adults recovering after lower-limb fracture or hip replacement may experience complex recovery trajectories. Most of the time, these clinical aspects are studied in isolation, masking their joint impact on recovery. This study used the MAISON-LLF dataset, which contains multimodal sensor and clinical assessment data from 18 older adults recovering in the community after lower-limb fracture or hip replacement. Participants were monitored for up to eight weeks, corresponding to a maximum of 1,008 participant-days of sensor monitoring. Forty-six daily features were extracted from indoor motion, acceleration, step count, heart rate, out-of-home mobility, and sleep data. Five clinical outcomes were assessed every two weeks: the Social Isolation Scale, Oxford Hip Score, Oxford Knee Score, Timed Up and Go test, and 30-second Chair Stand test. We utilize an inherent relationship between multi-modal sensor data and different clinical scores and formulate it as a multi-output regression problem. We tested various machine learning and deep learning single- and multi-output regression algorithms to predict these scores simultaneously. The results showed that predicting clinical scores jointly was better than separately. The tabular DL multi-output regressor, NODE, gave a remarkable performance of MSE=3.96 and MAE=1.02 in comparison to other multi- and single-output regressors. The SHAP feature analysis further showed the importance of including multimodal sensors to provide a good estimate of patients' recovery trajectory. This work may support the simultaneous assessment of functional recovery and social engagement among community-dwelling older adults and ultimately help improve their care and quality of life.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用MAISON-LLF多模态传感器数据集（18名下肢骨折或髋关节置换术后社区康复老年人，最长监测8周），提取46项日常特征，将5项临床评分的同时预测建模为多输出回归问题。结果显示联合预测优于单独预测，其中表格深度学习多输出回归器NODE表现最佳（MSE=3.96，MAE=1.02），SHAP分析证实多模态传感器的重要性。
AI.motivation: 老年人下肢骨折或髋关节置换后的康复轨迹复杂，但以往研究往往孤立地研究单个临床方面（如功能恢复或社交参与），忽略了这些因素对康复过程的联合影响，因此需要一种同时评估多个临床结局的方法。
AI.method: 使用MAISON-LLF数据集，采集18名老年人最多8周的室内运动、加速度、步数、心率、户外活动和睡眠等多模态传感数据，提取46个每日特征。每两周评估5项临床评分（社会隔离、牛津髋/膝评分、TUG、30秒椅站测试）。将问题建模为多输出回归，比较多种机器学习和深度学习的单输出与多输出回归算法，并使用SHAP进行特征重要性分析。
AI.result: 多输出回归（联合预测临床评分）的效果优于单输出回归。NODE（表格深度学习多输出回归器）表现最佳，MSE=3.96，MAE=1.02。SHAP分析证实了多模态传感数据的纳入对准确估计患者康复轨迹的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作有望支持对社区独居老年人功能性恢复和社会参与的同时评估，从而改善他们的护理和生活质量。多模态传感数据与多输出深度学习相结合，为康复轨迹的全面监测提供了有效途径。

title: FixAnything: 3D-Consistent Rendering Refinement via Video Generative Priors
comment: Appearing in ECCV 2026. Project page: https://fix-anything.github.io
summary: Rendering views using 3D scene representations such as Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), meshes, or even point clouds produces artifacts when input views are sparse or target views lie far from the input. Recent work mitigates these artifacts using diffusion-based generative priors, but is specialized to individual representations and require custom architectures or extensive retraining. We present FixAnything, a single model for fixing a wide range of rendering artifacts. It does so by repurposing a pretrained video generative model, leveraging its implicit multi-view priors with only minimal modification and lightweight finetuning. Our key insight is that even noisily-rendered sequences preserve camera motion and coarse scene structure, allowing cleanup to be formulated as video-to-video translation. To control what scene structure should be preserved, we introduce a binary mask denoting the clean pixels, enabling the model to anchor its output to high-quality inputs (e.g. training views) while refining the rest. To encourage FixAnything to produce 3D-consistent renderings that support downstream reconstruction, we use camera pose accuracy (recovered via structure-from-motion) as a reward signal for direct preference optimization (DPO). Across four distinct 3D representations, FixAnything consistently improves rendering quality with lightweight finetuning, demonstrating that a single generalist video prior can replace multiple specialist refinement pipelines. The simplicity of the framework enables immediate adoption of stronger future video models without architectural redesign.

AI.tldr: FixAnything是一个通用的渲染伪影修复模型，通过将预训练的视频生成模型重新用于视频到视频的转换任务，仅需轻量级微调即可修复多种3D表示（如3DGS、NeRF、网格、点云）中的渲染伪影，并利用DPO优化保证3D一致性。
AI.motivation: 稀疏输入视图或远距离目标视图会导致各种3D场景表示（3DGS、NeRF、网格、点云）产生渲染伪影。现有方法虽然利用扩散模型缓解此问题，但都针对特定表示定制专用架构或需要大量重新训练，缺乏通用性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 1) 将渲染清理问题重新表述为视频到视频转换任务，因为即使噪声渲染序列也保留相机运动和粗粒度场景结构。2) 重用预训练的视频生成模型，仅需最小修改和轻量级微调。3) 引入二进制掩码标注干净像素，锚定高质量输入同时细化其余部分。4) 使用结构从运动恢复的相机位姿精度作为奖励信号进行直接偏好优化（DPO），确保3D一致的渲染输出。
AI.result: 在四种不同的3D表示上，FixAnything均能一致地提升渲染质量，且仅需轻量级微调。一个通用的视频先验模型可以替代多个专用的细化流水线。
AI.conclusion: FixAnything证明了单一通用视频先验模型可以统一解决多种3D表示的渲染伪影问题，其框架简单，可以即时采用未来更强大的视频模型而无需架构重新设计，具有很好的前瞻性和泛化能力。

title: EG-ARSA: An Expert-Grounded Open Model for Visual Road Safety Auditing in Low-Resource Settings
summary: Road traffic injuries remain a major challenge in low- and middle-income countries, where proactive road safety auditing is limited by incomplete crash records, shortages of qualified auditors, and the high cost of large-scale field inspections. To address this problem, we propose Expert-Grounded Distillation (EGD), a novel artificial intelligence framework that transfers institutional road safety expertise into a compact vision-language model for scalable visual road safety auditing. The key innovation is a quantified expert-grounding stage in which the teacher vision-language model is calibrated against authoritative field audits. Large-scale annotation is permitted only after the teacher reaches substantial agreement with expert risk assessments (Cohen's kappa = 0.74). The calibrated teacher then generates structured supervision that is distilled into an 8-billion-parameter student vision-language model using Low-Rank Adaptation and a single leakage-free prompt. We also introduce Bangladesh Road Safety Audit (BD-ARSA), the first open, expert-grounded Bangladeshi visual road safety audit dataset containing 21,947 image-audit records with near-national coverage, and Expert-Grounded Road Safety Auditor (EG-ARSA), the first vision-language model developed specifically for this task. Experimental results show that grounded fine-tuning substantially improves ordinal risk assessment over the zero-shot baseline, while blind expert evaluation demonstrates that the compact student outperforms both its 31 billion-parameter teacher and Gemini-2.5-Flash. These findings demonstrate that EGD provides an effective and scalable engineering solution for proactive road safety auditing in resource-constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种专家接地蒸馏（EGD）框架，将机构道路安全专业知识迁移到紧凑的视觉语言模型中，用于可扩展的视觉道路安全审计。通过量化专家接地阶段校准教师模型，并使用低秩适配和单一无泄漏提示将其蒸馏为80亿参数的轻量学生模型，同时发布了孟加拉国首个开放的道路安全审计数据集BD-ARSA（含21,947条图像审计记录）。实验表明，接地微调显著改善序数风险评估，紧凑学生模型在盲专家评估中优于其310亿参数教师和Gemini-2.5-Flash。
AI.motivation: 在中低收入国家，道路交通事故仍是一个重大挑战。现有的主动式道路安全审计受限于三个问题：事故记录不完整、合格审计人员短缺、大规模现场检查成本高昂。因此需要一个可扩展的自动化解决方案来弥补这些资源约束。
AI.method: 提出EGD框架，包含三个关键部分：（1）专家接地阶段——使用权威实地审计对教师视觉语言模型进行量化校准（Cohen's kappa=0.74后才允许大规模标注）；（2）蒸馏阶段——将校准教师生成的结构化监督通过低秩适配（LoRA）和单一无泄漏提示蒸馏到80亿参数学生模型；（3）构建BD-ARSA数据集（含21,947条图像审计记录的孟加拉国首个开放专家接地安全审计数据集）和EG-ARSA专用视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 实验结果显示：接地微调相比零样本基线显著改善了序数风险评估；盲专家评估表明紧凑的学生模型在性能上超越了其310亿参数的教师模型以及Gemini-2.5-Flash。这些结果证明了EGD方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EGD为资源受限环境下的主动式道路安全审计提供了一种有效且可扩展的工程解决方案，验证了将专家知识系统性蒸馏到轻量级模型中的可行性，为未来在类似环境中的大规模部署奠定了基础。
